الْوُزَرَاءُ هُمْ أَوْسَطُ الْعَرَبِ دَارًا، وَأَعْرَبُهُمْ أَحْسَابًا فَبَايِعُوا عُمَرَ أَوْ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بَلْ نُبَايِعُكَ أَنْتَ، فَأَنْتَ سَيِّدُنَا وَخَيْرُنَا وَأَحَبُّنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ عُمَرُ بِيَدِهِ فَبَايَعَهُ، وَبَايَعَهُ النَّاسُ، فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ قَتَلْتُمْ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ قَتَلَهُ اللَّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maata waaabuw bakrin bialssunhi qaala iismaa'iylu ya'niy bial'aaliyaai faqaama 'umaru yaquwlu waalllahi maa maata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaalat waqaala 'umaru waalllahi maa kaana yaqa'u fiy nafsiy iilaaa dhaaka walayab'athannahu alllahu falayaqta'anna aaydiya rijaalin waaarjulahum‏.‏ fajaa'a aabuw bakrin fakashafa 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqabbalahu qaala biaabiy aanta waaummiy tibta hayyana wamayyitana, waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laa yudhiyquka alllahu almawtatayni aabadana‏.‏ thumma kharaja faqaala aayyuhaa alhaalifu 'alaa rislika‏.‏ falammaa takallama aabuw bakrin jalasa 'umaru‏.‏ fahamida alllaha aabuw bakrin waaathnaa 'alayhi waqaala aalaa man kaana ya'budu muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm faiinna muhammadana qad maata, waman kaana ya'budu alllaha faiinna alllaha haaaun laa yamuwtu‏.‏ waqaala ‏{‏iinnaka mayyitun waiinnahum mayyituwna‏}‏ waqaala ‏{‏wamaa muhammadun iilaaa rasuwlun qad khalat min qablihi alrrusulu aafaiin maata aaw qutila anqalabtum 'alaa aa'qaabikum waman yanqalib 'alaa 'aqibayhi falan yadurra alllaha shayiana wasayajziy alllahu alshhaakiriyna‏}‏ qaala fanashaja alnnaasu yabkuwna qaala waajtama'ati alaansaaru iilaa sa'di bni 'ubaadaaa fiy saqiyfaai baniy saa'idaaa faqaaluwa minnaa aamiyrun waminkum aamiyrun, fadhahaba iilayhim aabuw bakrin wa'umaru bnu alkhattaabi waaabuw 'ubaydaaa bnu aljarraahi, fadhahaba 'umaru yatakallamu faaaskatahu aabuw bakrin, wakaana 'umaru yaquwlu waalllahi maa aaradtu bidhalika iilaaa aanniy qad hayyaatu kalaamana qad aa'jabaniy khashiytu aan laa yablughahu aabuw bakrin, thumma takallama aabuw bakrin fatakallama aablagha alnnaasi faqaala fiy kalaamihi nahnu alaumaraa'u waaantumu alwuzaraa'u‏.‏ faqaala hubaabu bnu almundhiri laa waalllahi laa naf'alu, minnaa aamiyrun waminkum aamiyrun‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin laa, walakinnaa alaumaraa'u waaantumu alwuzaraa'u hum aawsatu al'arabi daarana, waaa'rabuhum aahsaabana fabaayi'uwa 'umara aaw aabaa 'ubaydaaa‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru bal nubaayi'uka aanta, faaanta sayyidunaa wakhayrunaa waaahabbunaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faaakhadha 'umaru biyadihi fabaaya'ahu, wabaaya'ahu alnnaasu, faqaala qaaiilun qataltum sa'da bna 'ubaadaaa‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru qatalahu alllahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Aisha: (the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died while Abu Bakr was at a place called As-Sunah (Al-'Aliya) 'Umar stood up and said, "By Allah! Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is not dead!" 'Umar (later on) said, "By Allah! Nothing occurred to my mind except that." He said, "Verily! Allah will resurrect him and he will cut the hands and legs of some men." Then Abu Bakr came and uncovered the face of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), kissed him and said, "Let my mother and father be sacrificed for you, (O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)), you are good in life and in death. By Allah in Whose Hands my life is, Allah will never make you taste death twice." Then he went out and said, "O oath-taker! Don't be hasty." When Abu Bakr spoke, 'Umar sat down. Abu Bakr praised and glorified Allah and said, No doubt! Whoever worshipped Muhammad, then Muhammad is dead, but whoever worshipped Allah, then Allah is Alive and shall never die." Then he recited Allah's Statement.:-- "(O Muhammad) Verily you will die, and they also will die." (39.30) He also recited:-- "Muhammad is no more than an Apostle; and indeed many Apostles have passed away, before him, If he dies Or is killed, will you then Turn back on your heels? And he who turns back On his heels, not the least Harm will he do to Allah And Allah will give reward to those Who are grateful." (3.144) The people wept loudly, and the Ansar were assembled with Sad bin 'Ubada in the shed of Bani Saida. They said (to the emigrants). "There should be one 'Amir from us and one from you." Then Abu Bakr, Umar bin Al-Khattab and Abu 'baida bin Al-Jarrah went to them. 'Umar wanted to speak but Abu Bakr stopped him. 'Umar later on used to say, "By Allah, I intended only to say something that appealed to me and I was afraid that Abu Bakr would not speak so well. Then Abu Bakr spoke and his speech was very eloquent. He said in his statement, "We are the rulers and you (Ansars) are the ministers (i.e. advisers)," Hubab bin Al-Mundhir said, "No, by Allah we won't accept this. But there must be a ruler from us and a ruler from you." Abu Bakr said, "No, we will be the rulers and you will be the ministers, for they (i.e. Quraish) are the best family amongst the 'Arabs and of best origin. So you should elect either 'Umar or Abu 'Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah as your ruler." 'Umar said (to Abu Bakr), "No but we elect you, for you are our chief and the best amongst us and the most beloved of all of us to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." So 'Umar took Abu Bakr's hand and gave the pledge of allegiance and the people too gave the pledge of allegiance to Abu Bakr. Someone said, "You have killed Sad bin Ubada." 'Umar said, "Allah has killed him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَالِمٍ عَنِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ، قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ أَخْبَرَنِي الْقَاسِمُ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ شَخَصَ بَصَرُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ فِي الرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا، وَقَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ، قَالَتْ فَمَا كَانَتْ مِنْ خُطْبَتِهِمَا مِنْ خُطْبَةٍ إِلاَّ نَفَعَ اللَّهُ بِهَا، لَقَدْ خَوَّفَ عُمَرُ النَّاسَ وَإِنَّ فِيهِمْ لَنِفَاقًا، فَرَدَّهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذَلِكَ‏.‏ ثُمَّ لَقَدْ بَصَّرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ النَّاسَ الْهُدَى وَعَرَّفَهُمُ الْحَقَّ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِمْ وَخَرَجُوا بِهِ يَتْلُونَ ‏{‏وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلاَّ رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ‏}‏ إِلَى ‏{‏الشَّاكِرِينَ‏}‏
verses.translit: waqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu saalimin 'ani alzzubaydiyyi, qaala 'abdu alrrahmani bnu alqaasimi aakhbaraniy alqaasimu, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat shakhasa basaru alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qaala ‏"‏ fiy alrrafiyqi alaa'laa ‏"‏‏.‏ thalaathana, waqassa alhadiytha, qaalat famaa kaanat min khutbatihimaa min khutbaain iilaaa nafa'a alllahu bihaa, laqad khawwafa 'umaru alnnaasa waiinna fiyhim lanifaaqana, faraddahumu alllahu bidhalika‏.‏ thumma laqad bassara aabuw bakrin alnnaasa alhudaa wa'arrafahumu alhaqqa alladhiy 'alayhim wakharajuwa bihi yatluwna ‏{‏wamaa muhammadun iilaaa rasuwlun qad khalat min qablihi alrrusulu‏}‏ iilaa ‏{‏alshhaakiriyna‏}‏
verses.translation: Aisha said (in another narration), ("When the Prophet (ﷺ) was on his death-bed) he looked up and said thrice, (Amongst) the Highest Companion (See Qur'an 4.69)' Aisha said, Allah benefited the people by their two speeches. 'Umar frightened the people some of whom were hypocrites whom Allah caused to abandon Islam because of 'Umar's speech. Then Abu Bakr led the people to True Guidance and acquainted them with the right path they were to follow so that they went out reciting:-- "Muhammad is no more than an Apostle and indeed many Apostles have passed away before him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ تَسْأَلُهُ مِيرَاثَهَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، تَطْلُبُ صَدَقَةَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّتِي بِالْمَدِينَةِ وَفَدَكٍ وَمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ خُمُسِ خَيْبَرَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ نُورَثُ، مَا تَرَكْنَا فَهْوَ صَدَقَةٌ، إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ مِنْ هَذَا الْمَالِ ـ يَعْنِي مَالَ اللَّهِ ـ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَزِيدُوا عَلَى الْمَأْكَلِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لاَ أُغَيِّرُ شَيْئًا مِنْ صَدَقَاتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّتِي كَانَتْ عَلَيْهَا فِي عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَلأَعْمَلَنَّ فِيهَا بِمَا عَمِلَ فِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَتَشَهَّدَ عَلِيٌّ، ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّا قَدْ عَرَفْنَا يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَضِيلَتَكَ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ قَرَابَتَهُمْ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَقَّهُمْ‏.‏ فَتَكَلَّمَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَقَرَابَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ أَنْ أَصِلَ مِنْ قَرَابَتِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna faatimaaa 'alayhaa alssalaamu aarsalat iilaa aabiy bakrin tasaaluhu miyraathahaa mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiymaa aafaa'a alllahu 'alaa rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm, tatlubu sadaqaaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm allatiy bialmadiynaai wafadakin wamaa baqiya min khumusi khaybara‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa nuwrathu, maa taraknaa fahwa sadaqaaun, iinnamaa yaakulu alu muhammadin min hadhaa almaali ya'niy maala alllahi laysa lahum aan yaziyduwa 'alaa almaakali ‏"‏‏.‏ waiinniy waalllahi laa aughayyiru shayiana min sadaqaati alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm allatiy kaanat 'alayhaa fiy 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, walaa'malanna fiyhaa bimaa 'amila fiyhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ fatashahhada 'aliyyun, thumma qaala iinnaa qad 'arafnaa yaa aabaa bakrin fadiylataka‏.‏ wadhakara qaraabatahum min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaqqahum‏.‏ fatakallama aabuw bakrin faqaala waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi, laqaraabaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahabbu iilaaaa aan aasila min qaraabatiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Aisha: Fatima sent somebody to Abu Bakr asking him to give her her inheritance from the Prophet (ﷺ) from what Allah had given to His Apostle through Fai (i.e. booty gained without fighting). She asked for the Sadaqa (i.e. wealth assigned for charitable purposes) of the Prophet (ﷺ) at Medina, and Fadak, and what remained of the Khumus (i.e., one-fifth) of the Khaibar booty. Abu Bakr said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'We (Prophets), our property is not inherited, and whatever we leave is Sadaqa, but Muhammad's Family can eat from this property, i.e. Allah's property, but they have no right to take more than the food they need.' By Allah! I will not bring any change in dealing with the Sadaqa of the Prophet (and will keep them) as they used to be observed in his (i.e. the Prophet's) life-time, and I will dispose with it as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do," Then 'Ali said, "I testify that None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and that Muhammad is His Apostle," and added, "O Abu Bakr! We acknowledge your superiority." Then he (i.e. 'Ali) mentioned their own relationship to Allah's Apostle and their right. Abu Bakr then spoke saying, "By Allah in Whose Hands my life is. I love to do good to the relatives of Allah's Apostle rather than to my own relatives
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاطِمَةَ ابْنَتَهُ فِي شَكْوَاهُ الَّذِي قُبِضَ فِيهَا، فَسَارَّهَا بِشَىْءٍ فَبَكَتْ، ثُمَّ دَعَاهَا فَسَارَّهَا فَضَحِكَتْ، قَالَتْ فَسَأَلْتُهَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ سَارَّنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّهُ يُقْبَضُ فِي وَجَعِهِ الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ فَبَكَيْتُ، ثُمَّ سَارَّنِي فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنِّي أَوَّلُ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ أَتْبَعُهُ فَضَحِكْتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat da'aa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faatimaaa abnatahu fiy shakwaahu alladhiy qubida fiyhaa, fasaarrahaa bishaa'in fabakat, thumma da'aahaa fasaarrahaa fadahikat, qaalat fasaaaltuhaa 'an dhalika‏.‏ faqaalat saarraniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbaraniy aannahu yuqbadu fiy waja'ihi alladhiy tuwuffiya fiyhi fabakaytu, thumma saarraniy faaakhbaraniy aanniy aawwalu aahli baytihi aatba'uhu fadahiktu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) called his daughter Fatima during his illness in which he died, and told her a secret whereupon she wept. Then he called her again and told her a secret whereupon she laughed. When I asked her about that, she replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) spoke to me in secret and informed me that he would die in the course of the illness during which he died, so I wept. He again spoke to me in secret and informed me that I would be the first of his family to follow him (after his death) and on that I laughed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ لَمْ يَبْقَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ تِلْكَ الأَيَّامِ الَّتِي قَاتَلَ فِيهِنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرُ طَلْحَةَ وَسَعْدٍ‏.‏ عَنْ حَدِيثِهِمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, qaala lam yabqa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'di tilka alaayyaami allatiy qaatala fiyhinna rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghayru talhaaa wasa'din‏.‏ 'an hadiythihimaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu `Uthman:During one of the Ghazawat in which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was fighting, none remained with the Prophet (ﷺ) but Talha and Sa`d
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ فِي حَيَاةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا رَأَى رُؤْيَا قَصَّهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَتَمَنَّيْتُ أَنْ أَرَى رُؤْيَا أَقُصُّهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَكُنْتُ غُلاَمًا أَعْزَبَ، وَكُنْتُ أَنَامُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنَّ مَلَكَيْنِ أَخَذَانِي فَذَهَبَا بِي إِلَى النَّارِ، فَإِذَا هِيَ مَطْوِيَّةٌ كَطَىِّ الْبِئْرِ، فَإِذَا لَهَا قَرْنَانِ كَقَرْنَىِ الْبِئْرِ، وَإِذَا فِيهَا نَاسٌ قَدْ عَرَفْتُهُمْ، فَجَعَلْتُ أَقُولُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ‏.‏ فَلَقِيَهُمَا مَلَكٌ آخَرُ فَقَالَ لِي لَنْ تُرَاعَ‏. فَقَصَصْتُهَا عَلَى حَفْصَةَ‏.‏ فَقَصَّتْهَا حَفْصَةُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ نِعْمَ الرَّجُلُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، لَوْ كَانَ يُصَلِّي بِاللَّيْلِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سَالِمٌ فَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لاَ يَنَامُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu nasrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alrrajulu fiy hayaaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa raaaa ruuyaa qassahaa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fatamannaytu aan aaraa ruuyaa aaqussuhaa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, wakuntu ghulaamana aa'zaba, wakuntu aanaamu fiy almasjidi 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faraaaytu fiy almanaami kaaanna malakayni aakhadhaaniy fadhahabaa biy iilaa alnnaari, faiidhaa hiya matwiyyaaun kataaai albiiri, faiidhaa lahaa qarnaani kaqarnaai albiiri, waiidhaa fiyhaa naasun qad 'araftuhum, faja'altu aaquwlu aa'uwdhu bialllahi mina alnnaari, aa'uwdhu bialllahi mina alnnaari‏.‏ falaqiyahumaa malakun akharu faqaala liy lan turaa'a‏. faqasastuhaa 'alaa hafsaaa‏.‏ faqassathaa hafsaau 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ ni'ma alrrajulu 'abdu alllahi, law kaana yusalliy bialllayli ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala saalimun fakaana 'abdu alllahi laa yanaamu mina alllayli iilaaa qaliylaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:If a man saw a dream during the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) he would narrate it to the Prophet. Once I wished to see a dream and narrate it to the Prophet (ﷺ) I was young, unmarried, and used to sleep in the Mosque during the lifetime of the Prophet. I dreamt that two angels took me and went away with me towards the (Hell) Fire which looked like a well with the inside walls built up, and had two side-walls like those of a well. There I saw some people in it whom I knew. I started saying, "I seek Refuge with Allah from the (Hell) Fire, I seek Refuge with Allah from the (Hell) Fire." Then another angel met the other two and said to me, "Do not be afraid." I narrated my dream to Hafsa who, in her turn, narrated it to the Prophet. He said, "What an excellent man `Abdullah is if he only observes the night prayer." (Salim, a sub-narrator said, "Abdullah used not to sleep at night but very little hence forward)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أُخْتِهِ، حَفْصَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهَا ‏ "‏ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ رَجُلٌ صَالِحٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an aukhtihi, hafsaaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahaa ‏ "‏ iinna 'abda alllahi rajulun saalihun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar from Hafsa his sister:That the Prophet (ﷺ) had said to her, "`Abdullah is a pious man
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَسْرُوقًا، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَكُنْ فَاحِشًا وَلاَ مُتَفَحِّشًا وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنْ أَحَبِّكُمْ إِلَىَّ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْتَقْرِئُوا الْقُرْآنَ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، وَسَالِمٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ، وَأُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، وَمُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu aabaa waaiilin, qaala sami'tu masruwqana, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'amrinw iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yakun faahishana walaa mutafahhishana waqaala ‏"‏ iinna min aahabbikum iilaaaa aahsanakum aakhlaaqana ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ astaqriiuwa alqurana min aarba'aain min 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, wasaalimin mawlaa aabiy hudhayfaaa, waaubaaai bni ka'bin, wamu'aadhi bni jabalin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) neither talked in an insulting manner nor did he ever speak evil intentionally. He used to say, "The most beloved to me amongst you is the one who has the best character and manners." He added, " Learn the Qur'an from (any of these) four persons. `Abdullah bin Mas`ud, Salim the freed slave of Abu Hudhaifa, Ubai bin Ka`b, and Mu`adh bin Jabal
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ أَبَا الْمِنْهَالِ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ مُطْعِمٍ، قَالَ بَاعَ شَرِيكٌ لِي دَرَاهِمَ فِي السُّوقِ نَسِيئَةً فَقُلْتُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ أَيَصْلُحُ هَذَا فَقَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ بِعْتُهَا فِي السُّوقِ فَمَا عَابَهُ أَحَدٌ، فَسَأَلْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ فَقَالَ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ نَتَبَايَعُ هَذَا الْبَيْعَ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا كَانَ يَدًا بِيَدٍ فَلَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسٌ، وَمَا كَانَ نَسِيئَةً فَلاَ يَصْلُحُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَالْقَ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ فَاسْأَلْهُ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ أَعْظَمَنَا تِجَارَةً، فَسَأَلْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ فَقَالَ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً فَقَالَ قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وَنَحْنُ نَتَبَايَعُ، وَقَالَ نَسِيئَةً إِلَى الْمَوْسِمِ أَوِ الْحَجِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, sami'a aabaa alminhaali 'abda alrrahmani bna mut'imin, qaala baa'a shariykun liy daraahima fiy alssuwqi nasiyiaaan faqultu subhaana alllahi aayasluhu hadhaa faqaala subhaana alllahi, waalllahi laqad bi'tuhaa fiy alssuwqi famaa 'aabahu aahadun, fasaaaltu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin faqaala qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu natabaaya'u hadhaa albay'a, faqaala ‏ "‏ maa kaana yadana biyadin falaysa bihi baasun, wamaa kaana nasiyiaaan falaa yasluhu ‏"‏‏.‏ waalqa zayda bna aarqama faasaalhu faiinnahu kaana aa'zamanaa tijaaraaan, fasaaaltu zayda bna aarqama faqaala mithlahu‏.‏ waqaala sufyaanu marraaan faqaala qadima 'alaynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa wanahnu natabaaya'u, waqaala nasiyiaaan iilaa almawsimi aawi alhajji‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Al-Minhal `AbdurRahman bin Mut`im:A partner of mine sold some Dirhams on credit in the market. I said, "Glorified be Allah! Is this legal?" He replied, "Glorified be Allah! By Allah, when I sold them in the market, nobody objected to it." Then I asked Al-Bara' bin `Azib (about it) he said, "We used to make such a transaction when the Prophet came to Medina. So he said, 'There is no harm in it if it is done from hand to hand, but it is not allowed on credit.' Go to Zaid bin Al- Arqam and ask him about it for he was the greatest trader of all of us." So I asked Zaid bin Al-Arqam., and he said the same (as Al-Bara) did
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رَفَعَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ يُعَذَّبُ فِي قَبْرِهِ بِبُكَاءِ أَهْلِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَيُعَذَّبُ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ وَذَنْبِهِ، وَإِنَّ أَهْلَهُ لَيَبْكُونَ عَلَيْهِ الآنَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَذَاكَ مِثْلُ قَوْلِهِ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ عَلَى الْقَلِيبِ وَفِيهِ قَتْلَى بَدْرٍ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ مَا قَالَ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَسْمَعُونَ مَا أَقُولُ‏.‏ إِنَّمَا قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمُ الآنَ لَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ مَا كُنْتُ أَقُولُ لَهُمْ حَقٌّ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَتْ ‏{‏إِنَّكَ لاَ تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتَى‏}‏ ‏{‏وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ‏}‏ تَقُولُ حِينَ تَبَوَّءُوا مَقَاعِدَهُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala dhukira 'inda 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna abna 'umara rafa'a iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna almayyita yu'adhhabu fiy qabrihi bibukaa'i aahlihi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaalat iinnamaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnahu layu'adhhabu bikhatiyiatihi wadhanbihi, waiinna aahlahu layabkuwna 'alayhi alana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat wadhaaka mithlu qawlihi iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama 'alaa alqaliybi wafiyhi qatlaa badrin mina almushrikiyna, faqaala lahum maa qaala iinnahum layasma'uwna maa aaquwlu‏.‏ iinnamaa qaala ‏"‏ iinnahumu alana laya'lamuwna aanna maa kuntu aaquwlu lahum haqqun ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaraaat ‏{‏iinnaka laa tusmi'u almawtaa‏}‏ ‏{‏wamaa aanta bimusmi'in man fiy alqubuwri‏}‏ taquwlu hiyna tabawwa'uwa maqaa'idahum mina alnnaari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham's father:It was mentioned before `Aisha that Ibn `Umar attributed the following statement to the Prophet (ﷺ) "The dead person is punished in the grave because of the crying and lamentation Of his family." On that, `Aisha said, "But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'The dead person is punished for his crimes and sins while his family cry over him then." She added, "And this is similar to the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he stood by the (edge of the) well which contained the corpses of the pagans killed at Badr, 'They hear what I say.' She added, "But he said now they know very well what I used to tell them was the truth." `Aisha then recited: 'You cannot make the dead hear.' (30.52) and 'You cannot make those who are in their Graves, hear you.' (35.22) that is, when they had taken their places in the (Hell) Fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ وَقَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى قَلِيبِ بَدْرٍ فَقَالَ ‏{‏هَلْ وَجَدْتُمْ مَا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّهُمُ الآنَ يَسْمَعُونَ مَا أَقُولُ‏}‏ فَذُكِرَ لِعَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّمَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمُ الآنَ لَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ الَّذِي كُنْتُ أَقُولُ لَهُمْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَتْ ‏{‏إِنَّكَ لاَ تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتَى‏}‏ حَتَّى قَرَأَتِ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'uthmaanu, haddathanaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala waqafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa qaliybi badrin faqaala ‏{‏hal wajadtum maa wa'ada rabbukum haqqana thumma qaala iinnahumu alana yasma'uwna maa aaquwlu‏}‏ fadhukira li'aaiishaaa faqaalat iinnamaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnahumu alana laya'lamuwna aanna alladhiy kuntu aaquwlu lahum huwa alhaqqu ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaraaat ‏{‏iinnaka laa tusmi'u almawtaa‏}‏ hattaa qaraaati alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) stood at the well of Badr (which contained the corpses of the pagans) and said, "Have you found true what your lord promised you?" Then he further said, "They now hear what I say." This was mentioned before `Aisha and she said, "But the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Now they know very well that what I used to tell them was the truth.' Then she recited (the Holy Verse):-- "You cannot make the dead hear... ...till the end of Verse
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَ رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عَمَّيْهِ، وَكَانَا، شَهِدَا بَدْرًا أَخْبَرَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الْمَزَارِعِ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِسَالِمٍ فَتُكْرِيهَا أَنْتَ قَالَ نَعَمْ، إِنَّ رَافِعًا أَكْثَرَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a, haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an maalikin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aanna saalima bna 'abdi alllahi, aakhbarahu qaala aakhbara raafi'u bnu khadiyjin 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, aanna 'ammayhi, wakaanaa, shahidaa badrana aakhbaraahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an kiraa'i almazaari'i‏.‏ qultu lisaalimin fatukriyhaa aanta qaala na'am, iinna raafi'ana aakthara 'alaa nafsihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Salim bin `Abdullah told me that Rafi` bin Khadij told `Abdullah bin `Umar that his two paternal uncles who had fought in the battle of Badr informed him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the renting of fields. I said to Salim, "Do you rent your land?" He said, "Yes, for Rafi` is mistaken
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ يَقْتُلُ الْحَيَّاتِ كُلَّهَا‏.‏ حَتَّى حَدَّثَهُ أَبُو لُبَابَةَ الْبَدْرِيُّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ قَتْلِ جِنَّانِ الْبُيُوتِ، فَأَمْسَكَ عَنْهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma kaana yaqtulu alhayyaati kullahaa‏.‏ hattaa haddathahu aabuw lubaabaaa albadriyyu, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an qatli jinnaani albuyuwti, faaamsaka 'anhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar used to kill all kinds of snakes until Abu Lubaba Al-Badri told him that the Prophet (ﷺ) had forbidden the killing of harmless snakes living in houses and called Jinnan. So Ibn `Umar gave up killing them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَوْسِ بْنِ الْحَدَثَانِ النَّصْرِيُّ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ دَعَاهُ إِذْ جَاءَهُ حَاجِبُهُ يَرْفَا فَقَالَ هَلْ لَكَ فِي عُثْمَانَ، وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَالزُّبَيْرِ وَسَعْدٍ يَسْتَأْذِنُونَ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ، فَأَدْخِلْهُمْ‏.‏ فَلَبِثَ قَلِيلاً، ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقَالَ هَلْ لَكَ فِي عَبَّاسٍ وَعَلِيٍّ يَسْتَأْذِنَانِ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا دَخَلاَ قَالَ عَبَّاسٌ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، اقْضِ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ هَذَا، وَهُمَا يَخْتَصِمَانِ فِي الَّذِي أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ، فَاسْتَبَّ عَلِيٌّ وَعَبَّاسٌ، فَقَالَ الرَّهْطُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، اقْضِ بَيْنَهُمَا وَأَرِحْ أَحَدَهُمَا مِنَ الآخَرِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ اتَّئِدُوا، أَنْشُدُكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي بِإِذْنِهِ تَقُومُ السَّمَاءُ وَالأَرْضُ، هَلْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ نُورَثُ، مَا تَرَكْنَا صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ نَفْسَهُ‏.‏ قَالُوا قَدْ قَالَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ عُمَرُ عَلَى عَبَّاسٍ وَعَلِيٍّ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكُمَا بِاللَّهِ هَلْ تَعْلَمَانِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ قَالَ ذَلِكَ قَالاَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنِّي أُحَدِّثُكُمْ عَنْ هَذَا الأَمْرِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ سُبْحَانَهُ كَانَ خَصَّ رَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هَذَا الْفَىْءِ بِشَىْءٍ لَمْ يُعْطِهِ أَحَدًا غَيْرَهُ فَقَالَ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهُ ‏{‏وَمَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ مِنْهُمْ فَمَا أَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَلاَ رِكَابٍ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏قَدِيرٌ‏}‏ فَكَانَتْ هَذِهِ خَالِصَةً لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ وَاللَّهِ مَا احْتَازَهَا دُونَكُمْ، وَلاَ اسْتَأْثَرَهَا عَلَيْكُمْ، لَقَدْ أَعْطَاكُمُوهَا وَقَسَمَهَا فِيكُمْ، حَتَّى بَقِيَ هَذَا الْمَالُ مِنْهَا، فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنْفِقُ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ نَفَقَةَ سَنَتِهِمْ مِنْ هَذَا الْمَالِ، ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ مَا بَقِيَ فَيَجْعَلُهُ مَجْعَلَ مَالِ اللَّهِ، فَعَمِلَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَيَاتَهُ، ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَأَنَا وَلِيُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَقَبَضَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَعَمِلَ فِيهِ بِمَا عَمِلَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنْتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَى عَلِيٍّ وَعَبَّاسٍ وَقَالَ تَذْكُرَانِ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ عَمِلَ فِيهِ كَمَا تَقُولاَنِ، وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُ فِيهِ لَصَادِقٌ بَارٌّ رَاشِدٌ تَابِعٌ لِلْحَقِّ ثُمَّ تَوَفَّى اللَّهُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا وَلِيُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ‏.‏ فَقَبَضْتُهُ سَنَتَيْنِ مِنْ إِمَارَتِي أَعْمَلُ فِيهِ بِمَا عَمِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فِيهِ صَادِقٌ بَارٌّ رَاشِدٌ تَابِعٌ لِلْحَقِّ، ثُمَّ جِئْتُمَانِي كِلاَكُمَا وَكَلِمَتُكُمَا وَاحِدَةٌ وَأَمْرُكُمَا جَمِيعٌ، فَجِئْتَنِي ـ يَعْنِي عَبَّاسًا ـ فَقُلْتُ لَكُمَا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ نُورَثُ، مَا تَرَكْنَا صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا بَدَا لِي أَنْ أَدْفَعَهُ إِلَيْكُمَا قُلْتُ إِنْ شِئْتُمَا دَفَعْتُهُ إِلَيْكُمَا عَلَى أَنَّ عَلَيْكُمَا عَهْدَ اللَّهِ وَمِيثَاقَهُ لَتَعْمَلاَنِ فِيهِ بِمَا عَمِلَ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَمَا عَمِلْتُ فِيهِ مُذْ وَلِيتُ، وَإِلاَّ فَلاَ تُكَلِّمَانِي، فَقُلْتُمَا ادْفَعْهُ إِلَيْنَا بِذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَدَفَعْتُهُ إِلَيْكُمَا، أَفَتَلْتَمِسَانِ مِنِّي قَضَاءً غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ فَوَاللَّهِ الَّذِي بِإِذْنِهِ تَقُومُ السَّمَاءُ وَالأَرْضُ لاَ أَقْضِي فِيهِ بِقَضَاءٍ غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ، فَإِنْ عَجَزْتُمَا عَنْهُ، فَادْفَعَا إِلَىَّ فَأَنَا أَكْفِيكُمَاهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَدَّثْتُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ، عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَالَ صَدَقَ مَالِكُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ، أَنَا سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَقُولُ أَرْسَلَ أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عُثْمَانَ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ يَسْأَلْنَهُ ثُمُنَهُنَّ مِمَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَكُنْتُ أَنَا أَرُدُّهُنَّ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُنَّ أَلاَ تَتَّقِينَ اللَّهَ، أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْنَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ نُورَثُ، مَا تَرَكْنَا صَدَقَةٌ ـ يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ نَفْسَهُ ـ إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هَذَا الْمَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْتَهَى أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى مَا أَخْبَرَتْهُنَّ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَتْ هَذِهِ الصَّدَقَةُ بِيَدِ عَلِيٍّ، مَنَعَهَا عَلِيٌّ عَبَّاسًا فَغَلَبَهُ عَلَيْهَا، ثُمَّ كَانَ بِيَدِ حَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، ثُمَّ بِيَدِ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، ثُمَّ بِيَدِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ وَحَسَنِ بْنِ حَسَنٍ، كِلاَهُمَا كَانَا يَتَدَاوَلاَنِهَا، ثُمَّ بِيَدِ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَسَنٍ، وَهْىَ صَدَقَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَقًّا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy maaliku bnu aawsi bni alhadathaani alnnasriyyu, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh da'aahu iidh jaa'ahu haajibuhu yarfaa faqaala hal laka fiy 'uthmaana, wa'abdi alrrahmani, waalzzubayri wasa'din yastaadhinuwna faqaala na'am, faaadkhilhum‏.‏ falabitha qaliylaan, thumma jaa'a faqaala hal laka fiy 'abbaasin wa'aliyyin yastaadhinaani qaala na'am‏.‏ falammaa dakhalaa qaala 'abbaasun yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna, aqdi bayniy wabayna hadhaa, wahumaa yakhtasimaani fiy alladhiy aafaa'a alllahu 'alaa rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm min baniy alnnadiyri, faastabba 'aliyyun wa'abbaasun, faqaala alrrahtu yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna, aqdi baynahumaa waaarih aahadahumaa mina alakhari‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru attaiiduwa, aanshudukum bialllahi alladhiy biiidhnihi taquwmu alssamaa'u waalaardu, hal ta'lamuwna aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa nuwrathu, maa taraknaa sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ yuriydu bidhalika nafsahu‏.‏ qaaluwa qad qaala dhalika‏.‏ faaaqbala 'umaru 'alaa 'abbaasin wa'aliyyin faqaala aanshudukumaa bialllahi hal ta'lamaani aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad qaala dhalika qaalaa na'am‏.‏ qaala faiinniy auhaddithukum 'an hadhaa alaamri, iinna alllaha subhaanahu kaana khassa rasuwlahu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hadhaa alfaa'i bishaa'in lam yu'tihi aahadana ghayrahu faqaala jalla dhikruhu ‏{‏wamaa aafaa'a alllahu 'alaa rasuwlihi minhum famaa aawjaftum 'alayhi min khaylin walaa rikaabin‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏qadiyrun‏}‏ fakaanat hadhihi khaalisaaan lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, thumma waalllahi maa ahtaazahaa duwnakum, walaa astaatharahaa 'alaykum, laqad aa'taakumuwhaa waqasamahaa fiykum, hattaa baqiya hadhaa almaalu minhaa, fakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yunfiqu 'alaa aahlihi nafaqaaa sanatihim min hadhaa almaali, thumma yaakhudhu maa baqiya fayaj'aluhu maj'ala maali alllahi, fa'amila dhalika rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hayaatahu, thumma tuwuffiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aabuw bakrin faaanaa waliyyu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faqabadahu aabuw bakrin, fa'amila fiyhi bimaa 'amila bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaantum hiynaiidhin‏.‏ faaaqbala 'alaa 'aliyyin wa'abbaasin waqaala tadhkuraani aanna aabaa bakrin 'amila fiyhi kamaa taquwlaani, waalllahu ya'lamu iinnahu fiyhi lasaadiqun baarrun raashidun taabi'un lilhaqqi thumma tawaffaa alllahu aabaa bakrin faqultu aanaa waliyyu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabiy bakrin‏.‏ faqabadtuhu sanatayni min iimaaratiy aa'malu fiyhi bimaa 'amila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin, waalllahu ya'lamu aanniy fiyhi saadiqun baarrun raashidun taabi'un lilhaqqi, thumma jiitumaaniy kilaakumaa wakalimatukumaa waahidaaun waaamrukumaa jamiy'un, fajiitaniy ya'niy 'abbaasana faqultu lakumaa iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa nuwrathu, maa taraknaa sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa badaa liy aan aadfa'ahu iilaykumaa qultu iin shiitumaa dafa'tuhu iilaykumaa 'alaa aanna 'alaykumaa 'ahda alllahi wamiythaaqahu lata'malaani fiyhi bimaa 'amila fiyhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin, wamaa 'amiltu fiyhi mudh waliytu, waiilaaa falaa tukallimaaniy, faqultumaa adfa'hu iilaynaa bidhalika‏.‏ fadafa'tuhu iilaykumaa, aafataltamisaani minniy qadaa'an ghayra dhalika fawaalllahi alladhiy biiidhnihi taquwmu alssamaa'u waalaardu laa aaqdiy fiyhi biqadaa'in ghayri dhalika hattaa taquwma alssaa'aau, faiin 'ajaztumaa 'anhu, faadfa'aa iilaaaa faaanaa aakfiykumaahu‏.‏ qaala fahaddathtu hadhaa alhadiytha, 'urwaaa bna alzzubayri faqaala sadaqa maaliku bnu aawsin, aanaa sami'tu 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm taquwlu aarsala aazwaaju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'uthmaana iilaa aabiy bakrin yasaalnahu thumunahunna mimmaa aafaa'a alllahu 'alaa rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fakuntu aanaa aarudduhunna, faqultu lahunna aalaa tattaqiyna alllaha, aalam ta'lamna aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa nuwrathu, maa taraknaa sadaqaaun yuriydu bidhalika nafsahu iinnamaa yaakulu alu muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hadhaa almaali ‏"‏‏.‏ faantahaa aazwaaju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa maa aakhbarathunna‏.‏ qaala fakaanat hadhihi alssadaqaau biyadi 'aliyyin, mana'ahaa 'aliyyun 'abbaasana faghalabahu 'alayhaa, thumma kaana biyadi hasani bni 'aliyyin, thumma biyadi husayni bni 'aliyyin, thumma biyadi 'aliyyi bni husaynin wahasani bni hasanin, kilaahumaa kaanaa yatadaawalaanihaa, thumma biyadi zaydi bni hasanin, wahaa sadaqaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm haqqana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Malik bin Aus Al-Hadathan An-Nasri:That once `Umar bin Al-Khattab called him and while he was sitting with him, his gatekeeper, Yarfa came and said, "Will you admit `Uthman, `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf, Az-Zubair and Sa`d (bin Abi Waqqas) who are waiting for your permission?" `Umar said, "Yes, let them come in." After a while, Yarfa- came again and said, "Will you admit `Ali and `Abbas who are asking your permission?" `Umar said, "Yes." So, when the two entered, `Abbas said, "O chief of the believers! Judge between me and this (i.e. `Ali). "Both of them had a dispute regarding the property of Bani An-Nadir which Allah had given to His Apostle as Fai (i.e. booty gained without fighting), `Ali and `Abbas started reproaching each other. The (present) people (i.e. `Uthman and his companions) said, "O chief of the believers! Give your verdict in their case and relieve each from) the other." `Umar said, "Wait I beseech you, by Allah, by Whose Permission both the heaven and the earth stand fast! Do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'We (Prophets) our properties are not to be inherited, and whatever we leave, is to be spent in charity,' and he said it about himself?" They (i.e. `Uthman and his company) said, "He did say it. "`Umar then turned towards `Ali and `Abbas and said, "I beseech you both, by Allah! Do you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said this?" They replied in the affirmative. He said, "Now I am talking to you about this matter. Allah the Glorified favored His Apostle with something of this Fai (i.e. booty won without fighting) which He did not give to anybody else. Allah said:-- "And what Allah gave to His Apostle ("Fai"" Booty) from them--For which you made no expedition With either Calvary or camelry. But Allah gives power to His Apostles Over whomsoever He will And Allah is able to do all things." (59.6) So this property was especially granted to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . But by Allah, the Prophet (ﷺ) neither took it all for himself only, nor deprived you of it, but he gave it to all of you and distributed it amongst you till only this remained out of it. And from this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to spend the yearly maintenance for his family, and whatever used to remain, he used to spend it where Allah's Property is spent (i.e. in charity), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on acting like that during all his life, Then he died, and Abu Bakr said, 'I am the successor of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ).' So he (i.e. Abu Bakr) took charge of this property and disposed of it in the same manner as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do, and all of you (at that time) knew all about it." Then `Umar turned towards `Ali and `Abbas and said, "You both remember that Abu Bakr disposed of it in the way you have described and Allah knows that, in that matter, he was sincere, pious, rightly guided and the follower of the right. Then Allah caused Abu Bakr to die and I said, 'I am the successor of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr.' So I kept this property in my possession for the first two years of my rule (i.e. Caliphate and I used to dispose of it in the same wa as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr used to do; and Allah knows that I have been sincere, pious, rightly guided an the follower of the right (in this matter). Later on both of you (i.e. `Ali and `Abbas) came to me, and the claim of you both was one and the same, O `Abbas! You also came to me. So I told you both that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Our property is not inherited, but whatever we leave is to be given in charity.' Then when I thought that I should better hand over this property to you both on the condition that you will promise and pledge before Allah that you will dispose it off in the same way as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr did and as I have done since the beginning of my caliphate or else you should not speak to me (about it).' So, both of you said to me, 'Hand it over to us on this condition.' And on this condition I handed it over to you. Do you want me now to give a decision other than that (decision)? By Allah, with Whose Permission both the sky and the earth stand fast, I will never give any decision other than that (decision) till the Last Hour is established. But if you are unable to manage it (i.e. that property), then return it to me, and I will manage on your behalf." The sub-narrator said, "I told `Urwa bin Az-Zubair of this Hadith and he said, 'Malik bin Aus has told the truth" I heard `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'The wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) sent `Uthman to Abu Bakr demanding from him their 1/8 of the Fai which Allah had granted to his Apostle. But I used to oppose them and say to them: Will you not fear Allah? Don't you know that the Prophet used to say: Our property is not inherited, but whatever we leave is to be given in charity? The Prophet (ﷺ) mentioned that regarding himself. He added: 'The family of Muhammad can take their sustenance from this property. So the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) stopped demanding it when I told them of that.' So, this property (of Sadaqa) was in the hands of `Ali who withheld it from `Abbas and overpowered him. Then it came in the hands of Hasan bin `Ali, then in the hands of Husain bin `Ali, and then in the hands of `Ali bin Husain and Hasan bin Hasan, and each of the last two used to manage it in turn, then it came in the hands of Zaid bin Hasan, and it was truly the Sadaqa of Allah's Apostle
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ وَالْعَبَّاسَ أَتَيَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ يَلْتَمِسَانِ مِيرَاثَهُمَا، أَرْضَهُ مِنْ فَدَكٍ، وَسَهْمَهُ مِنْ خَيْبَرَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ نُورَثُ، مَا تَرَكْنَا صَدَقَةٌ، إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ فِي هَذَا الْمَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَاللَّهِ لَقَرَابَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ أَنْ أَصِلَ مِنْ قَرَابَتِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna faatimaaa 'alayhaa alssalaamu waal'abbaasa aatayaa aabaa bakrin yaltamisaani miyraathahumaa, aardahu min fadakin, wasahmahu min khaybara‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa nuwrathu, maa taraknaa sadaqaaun, iinnamaa yaakulu alu muhammadin fiy hadhaa almaali ‏"‏‏.‏ waalllahi laqaraabaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahabbu iilaaaa aan aasila min qaraabatiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima and Al-`Abbas came to Abu Bakr, claiming their inheritance of the Prophet's land of Fadak and his share from Khaibar. Abu Bakr said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'Our property is not inherited, and whatever we leave is to be given in charity. But the family of Muhammad can take their sustenance from this property.' By Allah, I would love to do good to the Kith and kin of Allah's Apostle rather than to my own Kith and kin
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَقِينَا الْمُشْرِكِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ، وَأَجْلَسَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَيْشًا مِنَ الرُّمَاةِ، وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَبْرَحُوا، إِنْ رَأَيْتُمُونَا ظَهَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فَلاَ تَبْرَحُوا وَإِنْ رَأَيْتُمُوهُمْ ظَهَرُوا عَلَيْنَا فَلاَ تُعِينُونَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا لَقِينَا هَرَبُوا حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ النِّسَاءَ يَشْتَدِدْنَ فِي الْجَبَلِ، رَفَعْنَ عَنْ سُوقِهِنَّ قَدْ بَدَتْ خَلاَخِلُهُنَّ، فَأَخَذُوا يَقُولُونَ الْغَنِيمَةَ الْغَنِيمَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَهِدَ إِلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ لاَ تَبْرَحُوا‏.‏ فَأَبَوْا، فَلَمَّا أَبَوْا صُرِفَ وُجُوهُهُمْ، فَأُصِيبَ سَبْعُونَ قَتِيلاً، وَأَشْرَفَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَقَالَ أَفِي الْقَوْمِ مُحَمَّدٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُجِيبُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَفِي الْقَوْمِ ابْنُ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُجِيبُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَفِي الْقَوْمِ ابْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ هَؤُلاَءِ قُتِلُوا، فَلَوْ كَانُوا أَحْيَاءً لأَجَابُوا، فَلَمْ يَمْلِكْ عُمَرُ نَفْسَهُ فَقَالَ كَذَبْتَ يَا عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ، أَبْقَى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ مَا يُخْزِيكَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ أُعْلُ هُبَلْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَجِيبُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا مَا نَقُولُ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُولُوا اللَّهُ أَعْلَى وَأَجَلُّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ لَنَا الْعُزَّى وَلاَ عُزَّى لَكُمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَجِيبُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا مَا نَقُولُ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُولُوا اللَّهُ مَوْلاَنَا وَلاَ مَوْلَى لَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ يَوْمٌ بِيَوْمِ بَدْرٍ، وَالْحَرْبُ سِجَالٌ، وَتَجِدُونَ مُثْلَةً لَمْ آمُرْ بِهَا وَلَمْ تَسُؤْنِي‏.‏ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ اصْطَبَحَ الْخَمْرَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ نَاسٌ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوا شُهَدَاءَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i rda allh 'nh qaala laqiynaa almushrikiyna yawmaiidhin, waaajlasa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm jayshana mina alrrumaaai, waaammara 'alayhim 'abda alllahi waqaala ‏"‏ laa tabrahuwa, iin raaaytumuwnaa zaharnaa 'alayhim falaa tabrahuwa waiin raaaytumuwhum zaharuwa 'alaynaa falaa tu'iynuwnaa ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa laqiynaa harabuwa hattaa raaaytu alnnisaa'a yashtadidna fiy aljabali, rafa'na 'an suwqihinna qad badat khalaakhiluhunna, faaakhadhuwa yaquwluwna alghaniymaaa alghaniymaaa‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi 'ahida iilaaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan laa tabrahuwa‏.‏ faaabawa, falammaa aabawa surifa wujuwhuhum, faausiyba sab'uwna qatiylaan, waaashrafa aabuw sufyaana faqaala aafiy alqawmi muhammadun faqaala ‏"‏ laa tujiybuwhu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aafiy alqawmi abnu aabiy quhaafaaa qaala ‏"‏ laa tujiybuwhu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aafiy alqawmi abnu alkhattaabi faqaala iinna hauulaa'i qutiluwa, falaw kaanuwa aahyaa'an laajaabuwa, falam yamlik 'umaru nafsahu faqaala kadhabta yaa 'aduwwa alllahi, aabqaa alllahu 'alayka maa yukhziyka‏.‏ qaala aabuw sufyaana au'lu hubal‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aajiybuwhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa maa naquwlu qaala ‏"‏ quwluwa alllahu aa'laa waaajallu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw sufyaana lanaa al'uzzaa walaa 'uzzaa lakum‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aajiybuwhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa maa naquwlu qaala ‏"‏ quwluwa alllahu mawlaanaa walaa mawlaa lakum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw sufyaana yawmun biyawmi badrin, waalharbu sijaalun, watajiduwna muthlaaan lam amur bihaa walam tasuuniy‏.‏ aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an jaabirin, qaala astabaha alkhamra yawma auhudin naasun thumma qutiluwa shuhadaa'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:We faced the pagans on that day (of the battle of Uhud) and the Prophet (ﷺ) placed a batch of archers (at a special place) and appointed `Abdullah (bin Jubair) as their commander and said, "Do not leave this place; if you should see us conquering the enemy, do not leave this place, and if you should see them conquering us, do not (come to) help us," So, when we faced the enemy, they took to their heels till I saw their women running towards the mountain, lifting up their clothes from their legs, revealing their leg-bangles. The Muslims started saying, "The booty, the booty!" `Abdullah bin Jubair said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) had taken a firm promise from me not to leave this place." But his companions refused (to stay). So when they refused (to stay there), (Allah) confused them so that they could not know where to go, and they suffered seventy casualties. Abu Sufyan ascended a high place and said, "Is Muhammad present amongst the people?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not answer him." Abu Sufyan said, "Is the son of Abu Quhafa present among the people?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not answer him." `Abu Sufyan said, "Is the son of Al-Khattab amongst the people?" He then added, "All these people have been killed, for, were they alive, they would have replied." On that, `Umar could not help saying, "You are a liar, O enemy of Allah! Allah has kept what will make you unhappy." Abu Sufyan said, "Superior may be Hubal!" On that the Prophet said (to his companions), "Reply to him." They asked, "What may we say?" He said, "Say: Allah is More Elevated and More Majestic!" Abu Sufyan said, "We have (the idol) Al-`Uzza, whereas you have no `Uzza!" The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to his companions), "Reply to him." They said, "What may we say?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Say: Allah is our Helper and you have no helper." Abu Sufyan said, "(This) day compensates for our loss at Badr and (in) the battle (the victory) is always undecided and shared in turns by the belligerents. You will see some of your dead men mutilated, but neither did I urge this action, nor am I sorry for it." Narrated Jabir: Some people took wine in the morning of the day of Uhud and were then killed as martyrs
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ مُعْتَمِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ زَعَمَ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْقَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ تِلْكَ الأَيَّامِ الَّتِي يُقَاتِلُ فِيهِنَّ غَيْرُ طَلْحَةَ وَسَعْدٍ‏.‏ عَنْ حَدِيثِهِمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, 'an mu'tamirin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala za'ama aabuw 'uthmaana aannahu lam yabqa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'di tilka alaayyaami allatiy yuqaatilu fiyhinna ghayru talhaaa wasa'din‏.‏ 'an hadiythihimaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mu'tamir's father:`Uthman said that on the day of the battle of Uhud, none remained with the Prophet (ﷺ) but Talha and Sa`d
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ مِنْ قَتْلَى أُحُدٍ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَيُّهُمْ أَكْثَرُ أَخْذًا لِلْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَإِذَا أُشِيرَ لَهُ إِلَى أَحَدٍ، قَدَّمَهُ فِي اللَّحْدِ، وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا شَهِيدٌ عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَمَرَ بِدَفْنِهِمْ بِدِمَائِهِمْ، وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَلَمْ يُغَسَّلُوا‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، قَالَ لَمَّا قُتِلَ أَبِي جَعَلْتُ أَبْكِي وَأَكْشِفُ الثَّوْبَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ،، فَجَعَلَ أَصْحَابُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَوْنِي وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَنْهَ، وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَبْكِيهِ أَوْ مَا تَبْكِيهِ، مَا زَالَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ تُظِلُّهُ بِأَجْنِحَتِهَا حَتَّى رُفِعَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni ka'bi bni maalikin, aanna jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yajma'u bayna alrrajulayni min qatlaa auhudin fiy thawbin waahidin thumma yaquwlu ‏"‏ aayyuhum aaktharu aakhdhana lilqurani ‏"‏‏.‏ faiidhaa aushiyra lahu iilaa aahadin, qaddamahu fiy alllahdi, waqaala ‏"‏ aanaa shahiydun 'alaa hauulaa'i yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏ waaamara bidafnihim bidimaaiihim, walam yusalli 'alayhim, walam yughassaluwa‏.‏ waqaala aabuw alwaliydi 'an shu'baaa, 'ani abni almunkadiri, qaala sami'tu jaabirana, qaala lammaa qutila aabiy ja'altu aabkiy waaakshifu althhawba 'an wajhihi, , faja'ala aashaabu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanhawniy waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yanha, waqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tabkiyhi aaw maa tabkiyhi, maa zaalati almalaaiikaau tuzilluhu biaajnihatihaa hattaa rufi'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to shroud two martyrs of Uhud in one sheet and then say, "Which of them knew Qur'an more?" When one of the two was pointed out, he would put him first in the grave. Then he said, "I will be a witness for them on the Day of Resurrection." He ordered them to be buried with their blood (on their bodies). Neither was the funeral prayer offered for them, nor were they washed. Jabir added, "When my father was martyred, I started weeping and uncovering his face. The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) stopped me from doing so but the Prophet (ﷺ) did not stop me. Then the Prophet said, '(O Jabir.) don't weep over him, for the angels kept on covering him with their wings till his body was carried away (for burial)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ، وَالْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، قَالاَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ قَلَّدَ الْهَدْىَ وَأَشْعَرَ وَأَحْرَمَ مِنْهَا‏.‏ لاَ أُحْصِي كَمْ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ سُفْيَانَ حَتَّى سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ لاَ أَحْفَظُ مِنَ الزُّهْرِيِّ الإِشْعَارَ وَالتَّقْلِيدَ، فَلاَ أَدْرِي ـ يَعْنِي ـ مَوْضِعَ الإِشْعَارِ وَالتَّقْلِيدِ، أَوِ الْحَدِيثَ كُلَّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an marwaana, waalmiswari bni makhramaaa, qaalaa kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama alhudaybiyaai fiy bid'a 'ashraaa miaiaaan min aashaabihi, falammaa kaana bidhiy alhulayfaai qallada alhadaa waaash'ara waaahrama minhaa‏.‏ laa auhsiy kam sami'tuhu min sufyaana hattaa sami'tuhu yaquwlu laa aahfazu mina alzzuhriyyi aliish'aara waalttaqliyda, falaa aadriy ya'niy mawdi'a aliish'aari waalttaqliydi, aawi alhadiytha kullahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Marwan and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out in the company of 1300 to 1500 of his companions in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and when they reached Dhul-Hulaifa, he garlanded and marked his Hadi and assumed the state of Ihram
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ إِلَى السُّوقِ، فَلَحِقَتْ عُمَرَ امْرَأَةٌ شَابَّةٌ فَقَالَتْ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ هَلَكَ زَوْجِي وَتَرَكَ صِبْيَةً صِغَارًا، وَاللَّهِ مَا يُنْضِجُونَ كُرَاعًا، وَلاَ لَهُمْ زَرْعٌ وَلاَ ضَرْعٌ، وَخَشِيتُ أَنْ تَأْكُلَهُمُ الضَّبُعُ، وَأَنَا بِنْتُ خُفَافِ بْنِ إِيمَاءَ الْغِفَارِيِّ، وَقَدْ شَهِدَ أَبِي الْحُدَيْبِيَةَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَوَقَفَ مَعَهَا عُمَرُ، وَلَمْ يَمْضِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ مَرْحَبًا بِنَسَبٍ قَرِيبٍ‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَى بَعِيرٍ ظَهِيرٍ كَانَ مَرْبُوطًا فِي الدَّارِ، فَحَمَلَ عَلَيْهِ غِرَارَتَيْنِ مَلأَهُمَا طَعَامًا، وَحَمَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا نَفَقَةً وَثِيَابًا، ثُمَّ نَاوَلَهَا بِخِطَامِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ اقْتَادِيهِ فَلَنْ يَفْنَى حَتَّى يَأْتِيَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِخَيْرٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَكْثَرْتَ لَهَا‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ ثَكِلَتْكَ أُمُّكَ، وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَى أَبَا هَذِهِ وَأَخَاهَا قَدْ حَاصَرَا حِصْنًا زَمَانًا، فَافْتَتَحَاهُ، ثُمَّ أَصْبَحْنَا نَسْتَفِيءُ سُهْمَانَهُمَا فِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kharajtu ma'a 'umara bni alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh iilaa alssuwqi, falahiqat 'umara amraaaaun shaabbaaun faqaalat yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna halaka zawjiy wataraka sibyaaan sighaarana, waalllahi maa yundijuwna kuraa'ana, walaa lahum zar'un walaa dar'un, wakhashiytu aan taakulahumu alddabu'u, waaanaa bintu khufaafi bni iiymaa'a alghifaariyyi, waqad shahida aabiy alhudaybiyaaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fawaqafa ma'ahaa 'umaru, walam yamdi, thumma qaala marhabana binasabin qariybin‏.‏ thumma ansarafa iilaa ba'iyrin zahiyrin kaana marbuwtana fiy alddaari, fahamala 'alayhi ghiraaratayni malaahumaa ta'aamana, wahamala baynahumaa nafaqaaan wathiyaabana, thumma naawalahaa bikhitaamihi thumma qaala aqtaadiyhi falan yafnaa hattaa yaatiyakumu alllahu bikhayrin‏.‏ faqaala rajulun yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna aaktharta lahaa‏.‏ qaala 'umaru thakilatka aummuka, waalllahi iinniy laaraa aabaa hadhihi waaakhaahaa qad haasaraa hisnana zamaanana, faaftatahaahu, thumma aasbahnaa nastafiy'u suhmaanahumaa fiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: (Narrated Aslam:Once I went with `Umar bin Al-Khattab to the market. A young woman followed `Umar and said, "O chief of the believers! My husband has died, leaving little children. By Allah, they have not even a sheep's trotter to cook; they have no farms or animals. I am afraid that they may die because of hunger, and I am the daughter of Khufaf bin Ima Al-Ghafari, and my father witnessed the Pledge of allegiance) of Al-Hudaibiya with the Prophet.' `Umar stopped and did not proceed, and said, "I welcome my near relative." Then he went towards a strong camel which was tied in the house, and carried on to it, two sacks he had loaded with food grains and put between them money and clothes and gave her its rope to hold and said, "Lead it, and this provision will not finish till Allah gives you a good supply." A man said, "O chief of the believers! You have given her too much." "`Umar said disapprovingly. "May your mother be bereaved of you! By Allah, I have seen her father and brother besieging a fort for a long time and conquering it, and then we were discussing what their shares they would have from that war booty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، حِينَ حَدَّثَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ،، حَفِظْتُ بَعْضَهُ، وَثَبَّتَنِي مَعْمَرٌ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، وَمَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، يَزِيدُ أَحَدُهُمَا عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ قَالاَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، فَلَمَّا أَتَى ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ قَلَّدَ الْهَدْىَ، وَأَشْعَرَهُ، وَأَحْرَمَ مِنْهَا بِعُمْرَةٍ، وَبَعَثَ عَيْنًا لَهُ مِنْ خُزَاعَةَ، وَسَارَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى كَانَ بِغَدِيرِ الأَشْطَاطِ، أَتَاهُ عَيْنُهُ قَالَ إِنَّ قُرَيْشًا جَمَعُوا لَكَ جُمُوعًا، وَقَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكَ الأَحَابِيشَ، وَهُمْ مُقَاتِلُوكَ وَصَادُّوكَ عَنِ الْبَيْتِ وَمَانِعُوكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشِيرُوا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عَلَىَّ، أَتَرَوْنَ أَنْ أَمِيلَ إِلَى عِيَالِهِمْ وَذَرَارِيِّ هَؤُلاَءِ الَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يَصُدُّونَا عَنِ الْبَيْتِ، فَإِنْ يَأْتُونَا كَانَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ قَدْ قَطَعَ عَيْنًا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَإِلاَّ تَرَكْنَاهُمْ مَحْرُوبِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، خَرَجْتَ عَامِدًا لِهَذَا الْبَيْتِ، لاَ تُرِيدُ قَتْلَ أَحَدٍ وَلاَ حَرْبَ أَحَدٍ، فَتَوَجَّهْ لَهُ، فَمَنْ صَدَّنَا عَنْهُ قَاتَلْنَاهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ امْضُوا عَلَى اسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'tu alzzuhriyya, hiyna haddatha hadhaa alhadiytha, , hafiztu ba'dahu, wathabbataniy ma'marun 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'ani almiswari bni makhramaaa, wamarwaana bni alhakami, yaziydu aahaduhumaa 'alaa saahibihi qaalaa kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama alhudaybiyaai fiy bid'a 'ashraaa miaiaaan min aashaabihi, falammaa aataa dhaa alhulayfaai qallada alhadaa, waaash'arahu, waaahrama minhaa bi'umraain, waba'atha 'aynana lahu min khuzaa'aaa, wasaara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa kaana bighadiyri alaashtaati, aataahu 'aynuhu qaala iinna qurayshana jama'uwa laka jumuw'ana, waqad jama'uwa laka alaahaabiysha, wahum muqaatiluwka wasaadduwka 'ani albayti wamaani'uwka‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aashiyruwa aayyuhaa alnnaasu 'alaaaa, aatarawna aan aamiyla iilaa 'iyaalihim wadharaariyyi hauulaa'i alladhiyna yuriyduwna aan yasudduwnaa 'ani albayti, faiin yaatuwnaa kaana alllahu 'azza wajalla qad qata'a 'aynana mina almushrikiyna, waiilaaa taraknaahum mahruwbiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw bakrin yaa rasuwla alllahi, kharajta 'aamidana lihadhaa albayti, laa turiydu qatla aahadin walaa harba aahadin, fatawajjah lahu, faman saddanaa 'anhu qaatalnaahu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ amduwa 'alaa asmi alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and Marwan bin Al-Hakam:(one of them said more than his friend): The Prophet (ﷺ) set out in the company of more than onethousand of his companions in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and when he reached Dhul-Hulaifa, he garlanded his Hadi (i.e. sacrificing animal), assumed the state of Ihram for `Umra from that place and sent a spy of his from Khuzi'a (tribe). The Prophet (ﷺ) proceeded on till he reached (a village called) Ghadir-al-Ashtat. There his spy came and said, "The Quraish (infidels) have collected a great number of people against you, and they have collected against you the Ethiopians, and they will fight with you, and will stop you from entering the Ka`ba and prevent you." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Give me your opinion. Do you recommend that I should destroy the families and offspring of those who want to stop us from the Ka`ba? If they should come to us (for peace) then Allah will destroy a spy from the pagans, or otherwise we will leave them in a miserable state." On that Abu Bakr said, "O Allah's Apostle! You have come with the intention of visiting this House (i.e. Ka`ba) and you do not want to kill or fight anybody. So proceed to it, and whoever should stop us from it, we will fight him." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Proceed on, in the Name of Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ، وَالْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، يُخْبِرَانِ خَبَرًا مِنْ خَبَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي عُمْرَةِ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فَكَانَ فِيمَا أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ عَنْهُمَا أَنَّهُ لَمَّا كَاتَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُهَيْلَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ عَلَى قَضِيَّةِ الْمُدَّةِ، وَكَانَ فِيمَا اشْتَرَطَ سُهَيْلُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو أَنَّهُ قَالَ لاَ يَأْتِيكَ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ عَلَى دِينِكَ إِلاَّ رَدَدْتَهُ إِلَيْنَا، وَخَلَّيْتَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ‏.‏ وَأَبَى سُهَيْلٌ أَنْ يُقَاضِيَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، فَكَرِهَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ذَلِكَ وَامَّعَضُوا، فَتَكَلَّمُوا فِيهِ، فَلَمَّا أَبَى سُهَيْلٌ أَنْ يُقَاضِيَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، كَاتَبَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَرَدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَا جَنْدَلِ بْنَ سُهَيْلٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلَى أَبِيهِ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، وَلَمْ يَأْتِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحَدٌ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ إِلاَّ رَدَّهُ فِي تِلْكَ الْمُدَّةِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسْلِمًا، وَجَاءَتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ، فَكَانَتْ أُمُّ كُلْثُومٍ بِنْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ مُعَيْطٍ مِمَّنْ خَرَجَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْىَ عَاتِقٌ، فَجَاءَ أَهْلُهَا يَسْأَلُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَرْجِعَهَا إِلَيْهِمْ، حَتَّى أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِي الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مَا أَنْزَلَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa ya'quwbu, haddathaniy abnu aakhiy abni shihaabin, 'an 'ammihi, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a marwaana bna alhakami, waalmiswara bna makhramaaa, yukhbiraani khabarana min khabari rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy 'umraai alhudaybiyaai fakaana fiymaa aakhbaraniy 'urwaau 'anhumaa aannahu lammaa kaataba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm suhayla bna 'amrinw, yawma alhudaybiyaai 'alaa qadiyyaai almuddaai, wakaana fiymaa ashtarata suhaylu bnu 'amrinw aannahu qaala laa yaatiyka minnaa aahadun waiin kaana 'alaa diynika iilaaa radadtahu iilaynaa, wakhallayta baynanaa wabaynahu‏.‏ waaabaa suhaylun aan yuqaadiya rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa 'alaa dhalika, fakariha almuuminuwna dhalika waamma'aduwa, fatakallamuwa fiyhi, falammaa aabaa suhaylun aan yuqaadiya rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa 'alaa dhalika, kaatabahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, faradda rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aabaa jandali bna suhaylin yawmaiidhin iilaa aabiyhi suhayli bni 'amrinw, walam yaati rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahadun mina alrrijaali iilaaa raddahu fiy tilka almuddaai, waiin kaana muslimana, wajaa'ati almuuminaatu muhaajiraatin, fakaanat aummu kulthuwmin bintu 'uqbaaa bni mu'aytin mimman kharaja iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaa 'aatiqun, fajaa'a aahluhaa yasaaluwna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yarji'ahaa iilayhim, hattaa aanzala alllahu ta'aalaa fiy almuuminaati maa aanzala‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair:That he heard Marwan bin Al-Hakam and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama relating one of the events that happened to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the `Umra of Al-Hudaibiya. They said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) concluded the truce with Suhail bin `Amr on the day of Al-Hudaibiya, one of the conditions which Suhail bin `Amr stipulated, was his saying (to the Prophet), "If anyone from us (i.e. infidels) ever comes to you, though he has embraced your religion, you should return him to us, and should not interfere between us and him." Suhail refused to conclude the truce with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except on this condition. The believers disliked this condition and got disgusted with it and argued about it. But when Suhail refused to conclude the truce with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except on that condition, Allah's Apostle concluded it. Accordingly, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then returned Abu Jandal bin Suhail to his father, Suhail bin `Amr, and returned every man coming to him from them during that period even if he was a Muslim. The believing women Emigrants came (to Medina) and Um Kulthum, the daughter of `Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait was one of those who came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and she was an adult at that time. Her relatives came, asking Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to return her to them, and in this connection, Allah revealed the Verses dealing with the believing (women)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، رضى الله عنهم أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَصَابُوا حُمُرًا فَطَبَخُوهَا، فَنَادَى مُنَادِي النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكْفِئُوا الْقُدُورَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'adiyyu bnu thaabitin, 'ani albaraa'i, wa'abdi alllahi bni aabiy aawfaa, rda allh 'nhm aannahum kaanuwa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaasaabuwa humurana fatabakhuwhaa, fanaadaa munaadiy alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakfiiuwa alquduwra‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara and `Abdullah bin Abi `Aufa:That when they were in the company of the Prophet, they got some donkeys which they (slaughtered and) cooked. Then the announcer of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Turn the cooking pots upside down (i.e. throw out the meat)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، وَابْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، يُحَدِّثَانِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ وَقَدْ نَصَبُوا الْقُدُورَ أَكْفِئُوا الْقُدُورَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'adiyyu bnu thaabitin, sami'tu albaraa'a, waabna aabiy aawfaa, yuhaddithaani 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala yawma khaybara waqad nasabuwa alquduwra aakfiiuwa alquduwra‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara' and Ibn Abi `Aufa:On the day of Khaibar when the cooking pots were put on the fire, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Turn the cooking pots upside down
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ بِنْتَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ تَسْأَلُهُ مِيرَاثَهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِمَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِالْمَدِينَةِ وَفَدَكَ، وَمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ خُمُسِ خَيْبَرَ، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ نُورَثُ، مَا تَرَكْنَا صَدَقَةٌ، إِنَّمَا يَأْكُلُ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هَذَا الْمَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لاَ أُغَيِّرُ شَيْئًا مِنْ صَدَقَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ حَالِهَا الَّتِي كَانَ عَلَيْهَا فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلأَعْمَلَنَّ فِيهَا بِمَا عَمِلَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَبَى أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَنْ يَدْفَعَ إِلَى فَاطِمَةَ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا فَوَجَدَتْ فَاطِمَةُ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي ذَلِكَ فَهَجَرَتْهُ، فَلَمْ تُكَلِّمْهُ حَتَّى تُوُفِّيَتْ، وَعَاشَتْ بَعْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِتَّةَ أَشْهُرٍ، فَلَمَّا تُوُفِّيَتْ، دَفَنَهَا زَوْجُهَا عَلِيٌّ لَيْلاً، وَلَمْ يُؤْذِنْ بِهَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا، وَكَانَ لِعَلِيٍّ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَجْهٌ حَيَاةَ فَاطِمَةَ، فَلَمَّا تُوُفِّيَتِ اسْتَنْكَرَ عَلِيٌّ وُجُوهَ النَّاسِ، فَالْتَمَسَ مُصَالَحَةَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَمُبَايَعَتَهُ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ يُبَايِعُ تِلْكَ الأَشْهُرَ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَنِ ائْتِنَا، وَلاَ يَأْتِنَا أَحَدٌ مَعَكَ، كَرَاهِيَةً لِمَحْضَرِ عُمَرَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لاَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ تَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَحْدَكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَمَا عَسَيْتَهُمْ أَنْ يَفْعَلُوا بِي، وَاللَّهِ لآتِيَنَّهُمْ‏.‏ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَتَشَهَّدَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَالَ إِنَّا قَدْ عَرَفْنَا فَضْلَكَ، وَمَا أَعْطَاكَ، اللَّهُ وَلَمْ نَنْفَسْ عَلَيْكَ خَيْرًا سَاقَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ، وَلَكِنَّكَ اسْتَبْدَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِالأَمْرِ، وَكُنَّا نَرَى لِقَرَابَتِنَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَصِيبًا‏.‏ حَتَّى فَاضَتْ عَيْنَا أَبِي بَكْرٍ، فَلَمَّا تَكَلَّمَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ قَالَ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَقَرَابَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ أَنْ أَصِلَ مِنْ قَرَابَتِي، وَأَمَّا الَّذِي شَجَرَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ مِنْ هَذِهِ الأَمْوَالِ، فَلَمْ آلُ فِيهَا عَنِ الْخَيْرِ، وَلَمْ أَتْرُكْ أَمْرًا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْنَعُهُ فِيهَا إِلاَّ صَنَعْتُهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ مَوْعِدُكَ الْعَشِيَّةُ لِلْبَيْعَةِ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا صَلَّى أَبُو بَكْرٍ الظُّهْرَ رَقِيَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، فَتَشَهَّدَ وَذَكَرَ شَأْنَ عَلِيٍّ، وَتَخَلُّفَهُ عَنِ الْبَيْعَةِ، وَعُذْرَهُ بِالَّذِي اعْتَذَرَ إِلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ اسْتَغْفَرَ، وَتَشَهَّدَ عَلِيٌّ فَعَظَّمَ حَقَّ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَحَدَّثَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَحْمِلْهُ عَلَى الَّذِي صَنَعَ نَفَاسَةً عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَلاَ إِنْكَارًا لِلَّذِي فَضَّلَهُ اللَّهُ بِهِ، وَلَكِنَّا نَرَى لَنَا فِي هَذَا الأَمْرِ نَصِيبًا، فَاسْتَبَدَّ عَلَيْنَا، فَوَجَدْنَا فِي أَنْفُسِنَا، فَسُرَّ بِذَلِكَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَقَالُوا أَصَبْتَ‏.‏ وَكَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ قَرِيبًا، حِينَ رَاجَعَ الأَمْرَ الْمَعْرُوفَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna faatimaaa 'alayhaa alssalaamu binta alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aarsalat iilaa aabiy bakrin tasaaluhu miyraathahaa min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mimmaa aafaa'a alllahu 'alayhi bialmadiynaai wafadaka, wamaa baqiya min khumusi khaybara, faqaala aabuw bakrin iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa nuwrathu, maa taraknaa sadaqaaun, iinnamaa yaakulu alu muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hadhaa almaali ‏"‏‏.‏ waiinniy waalllahi laa aughayyiru shayiana min sadaqaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an haalihaa allatiy kaana 'alayhaa fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walaa'malanna fiyhaa bimaa 'amila bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaabaa aabuw bakrin aan yadfa'a iilaa faatimaaa minhaa shayiana fawajadat faatimaau 'alaa aabiy bakrin fiy dhalika fahajarathu, falam tukallimhu hattaa tuwuffiyat, wa'aashat ba'da alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm sittaaa aashhurin, falammaa tuwuffiyat, dafanahaa zawjuhaa 'aliyyun laylaan, walam yuudhin bihaa aabaa bakrin wasallaa 'alayhaa, wakaana li'aliyyin mina alnnaasi wajhun hayaaaa faatimaaa, falammaa tuwuffiyati astankara 'aliyyun wujuwha alnnaasi, faaltamasa musaalahaaa aabiy bakrin wamubaaya'atahu, walam yakun yubaayi'u tilka alaashhura, faaarsala iilaa aabiy bakrin aani aitinaa, walaa yaatinaa aahadun ma'aka, karaahiyaaan limahdari 'umara‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru laa waalllahi laa tadkhulu 'alayhim wahdaka‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin wamaa 'asaytahum aan yaf'aluwa biy, waalllahi latiyannahum‏.‏ fadakhala 'alayhim aabuw bakrin, fatashahhada 'aliyyun faqaala iinnaa qad 'arafnaa fadlaka, wamaa aa'taaka, alllahu walam nanfas 'alayka khayrana saaqahu alllahu iilayka, walakinnaka astabdadta 'alaynaa bialaamri, wakunnaa naraa liqaraabatinaa min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nasiybana‏.‏ hattaa faadat 'aynaa aabiy bakrin, falammaa takallama aabuw bakrin qaala waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laqaraabaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahabbu iilaaaa aan aasila min qaraabatiy, waaammaa alladhiy shajara bayniy wabaynakum min hadhihi alaamwaali, falam alu fiyhaa 'ani alkhayri, walam aatruk aamrana raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasna'uhu fiyhaa iilaaa sana'tuhu‏.‏ faqaala 'aliyyun laabiy bakrin maw'iduka al'ashiyyaau lilbay'aai‏.‏ falammaa sallaa aabuw bakrin alzzuhra raqiya 'alaa alminbari, fatashahhada wadhakara shaana 'aliyyin, watakhallufahu 'ani albay'aai, wa'udhrahu bialladhiy a'tadhara iilayhi, thumma astaghfara, watashahhada 'aliyyun fa'azzama haqqa aabiy bakrin, wahaddatha aannahu lam yahmilhu 'alaa alladhiy sana'a nafaasaaan 'alaa aabiy bakrin, walaa iinkaarana lilladhiy faddalahu alllahu bihi, walakinnaa naraa lanaa fiy hadhaa alaamri nasiybana, faastabadda 'alaynaa, fawajadnaa fiy aanfusinaa, fasurra bidhalika almuslimuwna waqaaluwa aasabta‏.‏ wakaana almuslimuwna iilaa 'aliyyin qariybana, hiyna raaja'a alaamra alma'ruwfa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima the daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) sent someone to Abu Bakr (when he was a caliph), asking for her inheritance of what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had left of the property bestowed on him by Allah from the Fai (i.e. booty gained without fighting) in Medina, and Fadak, and what remained of the Khumus of the Khaibar booty. On that, Abu Bakr said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Our property is not inherited. Whatever we leave, is Sadaqa, but the family of (the Prophet) Muhammad can eat of this property.' By Allah, I will not make any change in the state of the Sadaqa of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and will leave it as it was during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and will dispose of it as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to do." So Abu Bakr refused to give anything of that to Fatima. So she became angry with Abu Bakr and kept away from him, and did not task to him till she died. She remained alive for six months after the death of the Prophet. When she died, her husband `Ali, buried her at night without informing Abu Bakr and he said the funeral prayer by himself. When Fatima was alive, the people used to respect `Ali much, but after her death, `Ali noticed a change in the people's attitude towards him. So `Ali sought reconciliation with Abu Bakr and gave him an oath of allegiance. `Ali had not given the oath of allegiance during those months (i.e. the period between the Prophet's death and Fatima's death). `Ali sent someone to Abu Bakr saying, "Come to us, but let nobody come with you," as he disliked that `Umar should come, `Umar said (to Abu Bakr), "No, by Allah, you shall not enter upon them alone " Abu Bakr said, "What do you think they will do to me? By Allah, I will go to them' So Abu Bakr entered upon them, and then `Ali uttered Tashah-hud and said (to Abu Bakr), "We know well your superiority and what Allah has given you, and we are not jealous of the good what Allah has bestowed upon you, but you did not consult us in the question of the rule and we thought that we have got a right in it because of our near relationship to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ." Thereupon Abu Bakr's eyes flowed with tears. And when Abu Bakr spoke, he said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is to keep good relations with the relatives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is dearer to me than to keep good relations with my own relatives. But as for the trouble which arose between me and you about his property, I will do my best to spend it according to what is good, and will not leave any rule or regulation which I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) following, in disposing of it, but I will follow." On that `Ali said to Abu Bakr, "I promise to give you the oath of allegiance in this afternoon." So when Abu Bakr had offered the Zuhr prayer, he ascended the pulpit and uttered the Tashah-hud and then mentioned the story of `Ali and his failure to give the oath of allegiance, and excused him, accepting what excuses he had offered; Then `Ali (got up) and praying (to Allah) for forgiveness, he uttered Tashah-hud, praised Abu Bakr's right, and said, that he had not done what he had done because of jealousy of Abu Bakr or as a protest of what Allah had favored him with. `Ali added, "But we used to consider that we too had some right in this affair (of rulership) and that he (i.e. Abu Bakr) did not consult us in this matter, and therefore caused us to feel sorry."
