verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالاَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اقْضِ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَقَامَ خَصْمُهُ فَقَالَ صَدَقَ فَاقْضِ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ إِنَّ ابْنِي كَانَ عَسِيفًا عَلَى هَذَا فَزَنَى بِامْرَأَتِهِ، فَقَالُوا لِي عَلَى ابْنِكَ الرَّجْمُ‏.‏ فَفَدَيْتُ ابْنِي مِنْهُ بِمِائَةٍ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ وَوَلِيدَةٍ، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُ أَهْلَ الْعِلْمِ فَقَالُوا إِنَّمَا عَلَى ابْنِكَ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبُ عَامٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لأَقْضِيَنَّ بَيْنَكُمَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، أَمَّا الْوَلِيدَةُ وَالْغَنَمُ فَرَدٌّ عَلَيْكَ، وَعَلَى ابْنِكَ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبُ عَامٍ، وَأَمَّا أَنْتَ يَا أُنَيْسُ ـ لِرَجُلٍ ـ فَاغْدُ عَلَى امْرَأَةِ هَذَا فَارْجُمْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَغَدَا عَلَيْهَا أُنَيْسٌ فَرَجَمَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, wazaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi, qaalaa jaa'a aa'raabiyyun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aqdi baynanaa bikitaabi alllahi faqaama khasmuhu faqaala sadaqa faaqdi baynanaa bikitaabi alllahi‏.‏ faqaala alaa'raabiyyu iinna abniy kaana 'asiyfana 'alaa hadhaa fazanaa biamraaatihi, faqaaluwa liy 'alaa abnika alrrajmu‏.‏ fafadaytu abniy minhu bimiaiaain mina alghanami wawaliydaain, thumma saaaltu aahla al'ilmi faqaaluwa iinnamaa 'alaa abnika jaldu miaiaain wataghriybu 'aamin‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laaqdiyanna baynakumaa bikitaabi alllahi, aammaa alwaliydaau waalghanamu faraddun 'alayka, wa'alaa abnika jaldu miaiaain wataghriybu 'aamin, waaammaa aanta yaa aunaysu lirajulin faaghdu 'alaa amraaaai hadhaa faarjumhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faghadaa 'alayhaa aunaysun farajamahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:A bedouin came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Judge between us according to Allah's Book (Laws)." His opponent stood up and said, "He has said the truth, so judge between us according to Allah's Laws." The bedouin said, "My son was a laborer for this man and committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife. The people said to me, 'Your son is to be stoned to death,' so I ransomed my son for one hundred sheep and a slave girl. Then I asked the religious learned men and they said to me, 'Your son has to receive one hundred lashes plus one year of exile.' " The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I shall judge between you according to Allah's Book (Laws)! As for the slave girl and the sheep, it shall be returned to you, and your son shall receive one-hundred lashes and be exiled for one year. O you, Unais!" The Prophet (ﷺ) addressed some man, "Go in the morning to the wife of this man and stone her to death." So Unais went to her the next morning and stoned her to death
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ "بَايَعْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى السَّمْعِ وَالطَّاعَةِ فِي الْمَنْشَطِ وَالْمَكْرَهِ‏.‏ ‏‏وَأَنْ لاَ نُنَازِعَ الأَمْرَ أَهْلَهُ، وَأَنْ نَقُومَ ـ أَوْ نَقُولَ ـ بِالْحَقِّ حَيْثُمَا كُنَّا لاَ نَخَافُ فِي اللَّهِ لَوْمَةَ لاَئِمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa iismaa'iylu, hadaathaniy maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaadaau bnu alwaliydi, aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alsaaamiti, qaala "baaya'naa rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alsaam'i waaltaaa'aai fiy almanshati waalmakrahi‏.‏ ‏‏waaan laa nunaazi'a alaamra aahlahu, waaan naquwma aaw naquwla bialhaqii haythumaa kunaaa laa nakhaafu fiy allaahi lawmaaa laaiimin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:We gave the oath of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that we would listen to and obey him both at the time when we were active and at the time when we were tired and that we would not fight against the ruler or disobey him, and would stand firm for the truth or say the truth wherever we might be, and in the Way of Allah we would not be afraid of the blame of the blamers. (See Hadith No. 178 and)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَكُونُ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَمِيرًا ـ فَقَالَ كَلِمَةً لَمْ أَسْمَعْهَا فَقَالَ أَبِي إِنَّهُ قَالَ ـ كُلُّهُمْ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathaniy muhamaadu bnu almuthanaaa, hadaathanaa ghundarun, hadaathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi almaliki, sami'tu jaabira bna samuraaa, qaala sami'tu alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yakuwnu athnaa 'ashara aamiyrana faqaala kalimaaan lam aasma'haa faqaala aabiy iinaahu qaala kuluuhum min qurayshin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "There will be twelve Muslim rulers (who will rule all the Islamic world)." He then said a sentence which I did not hear. My father said, "All of them (those rulers) will be from Quraish
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ وَزَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ أَخْبَرَاهُ أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ اخْتَصَمَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna 'ubayda alllahi bna 'abdi alllahi, aakhbarahu aanna aabaa hurayraaa wazayda bna khaalidin aakhbaraahu aanna rajulayni akhtasamaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:Two men sued each other before the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، قَالاَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لأَقْضِيَنَّ بَيْنَكُمَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, wazaydi bni khaalidin, qaalaa kunnaa 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ laaqdiyanna baynakumaa bikitaabi alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira and Zaid bin Khalid:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) when he said (to two men), "I shall judge between you according to Allah's Book (Laws)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاسْتُخْلِفَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ بَعْدَهُ، وَكَفَرَ مَنْ كَفَرَ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ قَالَ عُمَرُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ كَيْفَ تُقَاتِلُ النَّاسَ، وَقَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَقُولُوا لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَمَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ عَصَمَ مِنِّي مَالَهُ وَنَفْسَهُ، إِلاَّ بِحَقِّهِ، وَحِسَابُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لأُقَاتِلَنَّ مَنْ فَرَّقَ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ، فَإِنَّ الزَّكَاةَ حَقُّ الْمَالِ، وَاللَّهِ لَوْ مَنَعُونِي عِقَالاً كَانُوا يُؤَدُّونَهُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَقَاتَلْتُهُمْ عَلَى مَنْعِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا هُوَ إِلاَّ أَنْ رَأَيْتُ اللَّهَ قَدْ شَرَحَ صَدْرَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ لِلْقِتَالِ فَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ عَنَاقًا‏.‏ وَهْوَ أَصَحُّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala lammaa tuwuffiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waastukhlifa aabuw bakrin ba'dahu, wakafara man kafara mina al'arabi qaala 'umaru laabiy bakrin kayfa tuqaatilu alnnaasa, waqad qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aumirtu aan auqaatila alnnaasa hattaa yaquwluwa laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ faman qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ 'asama minniy maalahu wanafsahu, iilaaa bihaqqihi, wahisaabuhu 'alaa alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala waalllahi lauqaatilanna man farraqa bayna alssalaaai waalzzakaaai, faiinna alzzakaaaa haqqu almaali, waalllahi law mana'uwniy 'iqaalaan kaanuwa yuuadduwnahu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laqaataltuhum 'alaa man'ihi‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru fawaalllahi maa huwa iilaaa aan raaaytu alllaha qad sharaha sadra aabiy bakrin lilqitaali fa'araftu aannahu alhaqqu‏.‏ qaala abnu bukayrin wa'abdu alllahi 'ani alllaythi 'anaaqana‏.‏ wahwa aasahhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died and Abu Bakr was elected as a Caliph after him, some of the Arabs reverted to disbelief, `Umar said to Abu Bakr, "How dare you fight the people while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, I have been ordered to fight the people till they say 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah' And whoever says: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah.' waves his wealth and his life from me unless he deserves a legal punishment lusty, and his account will be with Allah! Abu Bakr said, "By Allah, I will fight him who discriminates between Zakat and prayers, for Zakat is the Compulsory right to be taken from the wealth By Allah, if they refuse to give me even a tying rope which they use to give to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I would fight them for withholding it." `Umar said, 'By Allah, It was nothing, except I saw that Allah had opened the chest of Abu Bakr to the fight, and I came to know for certain that was the truth
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ إِمْلاَصِ الْمَرْأَةِ ـ هِيَ الَّتِي يُضْرَبُ بَطْنُهَا فَتُلْقِي جَنِينًا ـ فَقَالَ أَيُّكُمْ سَمِعَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهِ شَيْئًا فَقُلْتُ أَنَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَا هُوَ قُلْتُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ فِيهِ غُرَّةٌ عَبْدٌ أَوْ أَمَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ تَبْرَحْ حَتَّى تَجِيئَنِي بِالْمَخْرَجِ فِيمَا قُلْتَ‏.فَخَرَجْتُ فَوَجَدْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ مَسْلَمَةَ فَجِئْتُ بِهِ، فَشَهِدَ مَعِي أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ فِيهِ غُرَّةٌ عَبْدٌ أَوْ أَمَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muhamaadun, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, hadaathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, qaala saaala 'umaru bnu alkhataaabi 'an iimlaasi almaraaai hiya alaatiy yudrabu batnuhaa fatulqiy janiynana faqaala aayuukum sami'a mina alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhi shayiana faqultu aanaa‏.‏ faqaala maa huwa qultu sami'tu alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ fiyhi ghuraaaun 'abdun aaw aamaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala laa tabrah hataaa tajiyianiy bialmakhraji fiymaa qulta‏.fakharajtu fawajadtu muhammada bna maslamaaa fajiitu bihi, fashahida ma'iy aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ fiyhi ghurraaun 'abdun aaw aamaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu abnu aabiy alzzinaadi 'an aabiyhi 'an 'urwaaa 'ani almughiyraai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:`Umar bin Al-Khattab asked (the people) about the Imlas of a woman, i.e., a woman who has an abortion because of having been beaten on her `Abdomen, saying, "Who among you has heard anything about it from the Prophet?" I said, "I did.'' He said, "What is that?" I said, "I heard the Prophet saying, "Its Diya (blood money) is either a male or a female slave.' " `Umar said, "Do not leave till you present witness in support of your statement." So I went out, and found Muhammad bin Maslama. I brought him, and he bore witness with me that he had heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Its Diya (blood money) is either a male slave or a female slave
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ادْفِنِّي مَعَ صَوَاحِبِي وَلاَ تَدْفِنِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْبَيْتِ، فَإِنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُزَكَّى‏.‏ وَعَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، أَرْسَلَ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ ائْذَنِي لِي أَنْ أُدْفَنَ مَعَ صَاحِبَىَّ فَقَالَتْ إِي وَاللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا مِنَ الصَّحَابَةِ قَالَتْ لاَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أُوثِرُهُمْ بِأَحَدٍ أَبَدًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat li'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri adfinniy ma'a sawaahibiy walaa tadfinniy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy albayti, faiinniy aakrahu aan auzakkaa‏.‏ wa'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna 'umara, aarsala iilaa 'aaiishaaa aidhaniy liy aan audfana ma'a saahibaaaa faqaalat iiy waalllahi‏.‏ qaala wakaana alrrajulu iidhaa aarsala iilayhaa mina alssahaabaai qaalat laa waalllahi laa auwthiruhum biaahadin aabadana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham's father:`Aisha said to `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair, "Bury me with my female companions (i.e. the wives of the Prophet) and do not bury me with the Prophet (ﷺ) in the house, for I do not like to be regarded as sanctified (just for being buried there).'' Narrated Hisham's father: `Umar sent a message to `Aisha, saying, "Will you allow me to be buried with my two companions (the Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr) ?" She said, "Yes, by Allah." though it was her habit that if a man from among the companions (of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) sent her a message asking her to allow him to be buried there, she would say, "No, by Allah, I will never give permission to anyone to be buried with them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ حَالَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَقُرَيْشٍ فِي دَارِي الَّتِي بِالْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏ وَقَنَتَ شَهْرًا يَدْعُو عَلَى أَحْيَاءٍ مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa musadaadun, hadaathanaa 'abaaadu bnu 'abaaadin, hadaathanaa 'aasimun alaahwalu, 'an aanasin, qaala haalafa alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna alaansaari waqurayshin fiy daariy alaatiy bialmadiynaai‏.‏ waqanata shahrana yad'uw 'alaa aahyaa'in min baniy sulaymin
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) brought the Ansar and the Quraish people into alliance in my house at Medina, and he invoked Allah for one month against the tribe of Bani Sulaim in (the last rak`a of each compulsory) prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ بْنِ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، وَأَبَا، هُرَيْرَةَ حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ أَخَا بَنِي عَدِيٍّ الأَنْصَارِيَّ وَاسْتَعْمَلَهُ عَلَى خَيْبَرَ، فَقَدِمَ بِتَمْرٍ جَنِيبٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَكُلُّ تَمْرِ خَيْبَرَ هَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا لَنَشْتَرِي الصَّاعَ بِالصَّاعَيْنِ مِنَ الْجَمْعِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَفْعَلُوا، وَلَكِنْ مِثْلاً بِمِثْلٍ، أَوْ بِيعُوا هَذَا وَاشْتَرُوا بِثَمَنِهِ مِنْ هَذَا وَكَذَلِكَ الْمِيزَانُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aakhiyhi, 'an sulaymaana bni bilaalin, 'an 'abdi almajiydi bni suhayli bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, aannahu sami'a sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, yuhaddithu aanna aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, waaabaa, hurayraaa haddathaahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha aakhaa baniy 'adiyyin alaansaariyya waasta'malahu 'alaa khaybara, faqadima bitamrin janiybin faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aakullu tamri khaybara hakadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laa waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa lanashtariy alssaa'a bialssaa'ayni mina aljam'i‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taf'aluwa, walakin mithlaan bimithlin, aaw biy'uwa hadhaa waashtaruwa bithamanihi min hadhaa wakadhalika almiyzaanu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri and Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent the brother of the tribe of Bani Adi Al-Ansari as governor of Khaibar. Then the man returned, bringing Janib (a good kind of date). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked him, "Are all the dates of Khaibar like that?" He replied, "No, by Allah, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We take one Sa' of these (good) dates for two Sas of mixed dates." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said, "Do not do so. You should either take one Sa of this (kind) for one Sa' of the other; or sell one kind and then buy with its price the other kind (of dates), and you should do the same in weighing
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عَلِّمْنِي دُعَاءً أَدْعُو بِهِ فِي صَلاَتِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَغْفِرَةً، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, haddathaniy abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'an yaziyda, 'an aabiy alkhayri, sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'amrinw, aanna aabaa bakrin alssiddiyqa rda allh 'nh qaala lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaa rasuwla alllahi 'allimniy du'aa'an aad'uw bihi fiy salaatiy‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ quli alllahumma iinniy zalamtu nafsiy zulmana kathiyrana, walaa yaghfiru aldhhunuwba iilaaa aanta, faaghfir liy min 'indika maghfiraaan, iinnaka aanta alghafuwru alrrahiymu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Abu Bakr As-Siddiq said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Teach me an invocation with which I may invoke Allah in my prayers." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Say: O Allah! I have wronged my soul very much (oppressed myself), and none forgives the sins but You; so please bestow Your Forgiveness upon me. No doubt, You are the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُقَدَّمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقْبِضُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الأَرْضَ وَتَكُونُ السَّمَوَاتُ بِيَمِينِهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ ‏"‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ سَعِيدٌ عَنْ مَالِكٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمًا سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو الْيَمَانِ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَقْبِضُ اللَّهُ الأَرْضَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muqaddamu bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathaniy 'ammiy alqaasimu bnu yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha yaqbidu yawma alqiyaamaai alaarda watakuwnu alssamawaatu biyamiynihi thumma yaquwlu aanaa almaliku ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu sa'iydun 'an maalikin‏.‏ waqaala 'umaru bnu hamzaaa sami'tu saalimana sami'tu abna 'umara 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa‏.‏ waqaala aabuw alyamaani aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaqbidu alllahu alaarda ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will grasp the whole Earth by His Hand, and all the Heavens in His right, and then He will say, 'I am the King." Abu Huraira said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said," Allah will grasp the Earth
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ النَّاسُ يَصْعَقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِمُوسَى آخِذٌ بِقَائِمَةٍ مِنْ قَوَائِمِ الْعَرْشِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْمَاجِشُونُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ بُعِثَ فَإِذَا مُوسَى آخِذٌ بِالْعَرْشِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amriw bni yahyaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alnnaasu yas'aquwna yawma alqiyaamaai faiidhaa aanaa bimuwsaa akhidhun biqaaiimaain min qawaaiimi al'arshi ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala almaajishuwnu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alfadli, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ faaakuwnu aawwala man bu'itha faiidhaa muwsaa akhidhun bial'arshi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people will fall unconscious on the Day of Resurrection, then suddenly I will see Moses holding one of the pillars of the Throne." Abu Huraira said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I will be the first person to be resurrected and will see Moses holding the Throne
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّاسَ، قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ نَرَى رَبَّنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلْ تُضَارُّونَ فِي الشَّمْسِ لَيْسَ دُونَهَا سَحَابٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّكُمْ تَرَوْنَهُ كَذَلِكَ، يَجْمَعُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ شَيْئًا فَلْيَتَّبِعْهُ‏.‏ فَيَتْبَعُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ الشَّمْسَ الشَّمْسَ، وَيَتْبَعُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ الْقَمَرَ الْقَمَرَ، وَيَتْبَعُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ الطَّوَاغِيتَ الطَّوَاغِيتَ، وَتَبْقَى هَذِهِ الأُمَّةُ فِيهَا شَافِعُوهَا ـ أَوْ مُنَافِقُوهَا شَكَّ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ـ فَيَأْتِيهِمُ اللَّهُ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا رَبُّكُمْ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ هَذَا مَكَانُنَا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَنَا رَبُّنَا فَإِذَا جَاءَنَا رَبُّنَا عَرَفْنَاهُ فَيَأْتِيهِمُ اللَّهُ فِي صُورَتِهِ الَّتِي يَعْرِفُونَ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا رَبُّكُمْ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ أَنْتَ رَبُّنَا‏.‏ فَيَتْبَعُونَهُ وَيُضْرَبُ الصِّرَاطُ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَىْ جَهَنَّمَ، فَأَكُونُ أَنَا وَأُمَّتِي أَوَّلَ مَنْ يُجِيزُهَا، وَلاَ يَتَكَلَّمُ يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلاَّ الرُّسُلُ، وَدَعْوَى الرُّسُلِ يَوْمَئِذٍ اللَّهُمَّ سَلِّمْ سَلِّمْ‏.‏ وَفِي جَهَنَّمَ كَلاَلِيبُ مِثْلُ شَوْكِ السَّعْدَانِ، هَلْ رَأَيْتُمُ السَّعْدَانَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهَا مِثْلُ شَوْكِ السَّعْدَانِ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا قَدْرُ عِظَمِهَا إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، تَخْطَفُ النَّاسَ بِأَعْمَالِهِمْ، فَمِنْهُمُ الْمُوبَقُ بَقِيَ بِعَمَلِهِ، أَوِ الْمُوثَقُ بِعَمَلِهِ، وَمِنْهُمُ الْمُخَرْدَلُ أَوِ الْمُجَازَى أَوْ نَحْوُهُ، ثُمَّ يَتَجَلَّى حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْقَضَاءِ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ وَأَرَادَ أَنْ يُخْرِجَ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ أَرَادَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ أَمَرَ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ أَنْ يُخْرِجُوا مِنَ النَّارِ مَنْ كَانَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا، مِمَّنْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَرْحَمَهُ مِمَّنْ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، فَيَعْرِفُونَهُمْ فِي النَّارِ بِأَثَرِ السُّجُودِ، تَأْكُلُ النَّارُ ابْنَ آدَمَ إِلاَّ أَثَرَ السُّجُودِ، حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّارِ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ أَثَرَ السُّجُودِ، فَيَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ قَدِ امْتُحِشُوا، فَيُصَبُّ عَلَيْهِمْ مَاءُ الْحَيَاةِ فَيَنْبُتُونَ تَحْتَهُ كَمَا تَنْبُتُ الْحِبَّةُ فِي حَمِيلِ السَّيْلِ، ثُمَّ يَفْرُغُ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْقَضَاءِ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ، وَيَبْقَى رَجُلٌ مُقْبِلٌ بِوَجْهِهِ عَلَى النَّارِ هُوَ آخِرُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ دُخُولاً الْجَنَّةَ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ اصْرِفْ وَجْهِي عَنِ النَّارِ، فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ قَشَبَنِي رِيحُهَا وَأَحْرَقَنِي ذَكَاؤُهَا‏.‏ فَيَدْعُو اللَّهَ بِمَا شَاءَ أَنْ يَدْعُوَهُ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ هَلْ عَسَيْتَ إِنْ أُعْطِيتَ ذَلِكَ أَنْ تَسْأَلَنِي غَيْرَهُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لاَ وَعِزَّتِكَ لاَ أَسْأَلُكَ غَيْرَهُ، وَيُعْطِي رَبَّهُ مِنْ عُهُودٍ وَمَوَاثِيقَ مَا شَاءَ، فَيَصْرِفُ اللَّهُ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ النَّارِ، فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَ عَلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَرَآهَا سَكَتَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَسْكُتَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ قَدِّمْنِي إِلَى باب الْجَنَّةِ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَلَسْتَ قَدْ أَعْطَيْتَ عُهُودَكَ وَمَوَاثِيقَكَ أَنْ لاَ تَسْأَلَنِي غَيْرَ الَّذِي أُعْطِيتَ أَبَدًا، وَيْلَكَ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ مَا أَغْدَرَكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ‏.‏ وَيَدْعُو اللَّهَ حَتَّى يَقُولَ هَلْ عَسَيْتَ إِنْ أُعْطِيتَ ذَلِكَ أَنْ تَسْأَلَ غَيْرَهُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لاَ وَعِزَّتِكَ لاَ أَسْأَلُكَ غَيْرَهُ، وَيُعْطِي مَا شَاءَ مِنْ عُهُودٍ وَمَوَاثِيقَ، فَيُقَدِّمُهُ إِلَى باب الْجَنَّةِ، فَإِذَا قَامَ إِلَى باب الْجَنَّةِ انْفَهَقَتْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ فَرَأَى مَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْحَبْرَةِ وَالسُّرُورِ، فَيَسْكُتُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَسْكُتَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي الْجَنَّةَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ أَلَسْتَ قَدْ أَعْطَيْتَ عُهُودَكَ وَمَوَاثِيقَكَ أَنْ لاَ تَسْأَلَ غَيْرَ مَا أُعْطِيتَ ـ فَيَقُولُ ـ وَيْلَكَ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ مَا أَغْدَرَكَ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ أَىْ رَبِّ لاَ أَكُونَنَّ أَشْقَى خَلْقِكَ فَلاَ يَزَالُ يَدْعُو حَتَّى يَضْحَكَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ فَإِذَا ضَحِكَ مِنْهُ قَالَ لَهُ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ‏.‏ فَإِذَا دَخَلَهَا قَالَ اللَّهُ لَهُ تَمَنَّهْ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَ رَبَّهُ وَتَمَنَّى حَتَّى إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُذَكِّرُهُ يَقُولُ كَذَا وَكَذَا، حَتَّى انْقَطَعَتْ بِهِ الأَمَانِيُّ قَالَ اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ لَكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ لاَ يَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ حَدِيثِهِ شَيْئًا حَتَّى إِذَا حَدَّثَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى قَالَ ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ لَكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ ‏"‏ وَعَشَرَةُ أَمْثَالِهِ مَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ مَا حَفِظْتُ إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ لَكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ أَشْهَدُ أَنِّي حَفِظْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ ذَلِكَ لَكَ وَعَشَرَةُ أَمْثَالِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ آخِرُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ دُخُولاً الْجَنَّةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda alllaythiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnaasa, qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi hal naraa rabbanaa yawma alqiyaamaai faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hal tudaarruwna fiy alqamari laylaaa albadri ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laa yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fahal tudaarruwna fiy alshhamsi laysa duwnahaa sahaabun ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laa yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinnakum tarawnahu kadhalika, yajma'u alllahu alnnaasa yawma alqiyaamaai fayaquwlu man kaana ya'budu shayiana falyattabi'hu‏.‏ fayatba'u man kaana ya'budu alshhamsa alshhamsa, wayatba'u man kaana ya'budu alqamara alqamara, wayatba'u man kaana ya'budu alttawaaghiyta alttawaaghiyta, watabqaa hadhihi alaummaau fiyhaa shaafi'uwhaa aaw munaafiquwhaa shakka iibraahiymu fayaatiyhimu alllahu fayaquwlu aanaa rabbukum‏.‏ fayaquwluwna hadhaa makaanunaa hattaa yaatiyanaa rabbunaa faiidhaa jaa'anaa rabbunaa 'arafnaahu fayaatiyhimu alllahu fiy suwratihi allatiy ya'rifuwna fayaquwlu aanaa rabbukum‏.‏ fayaquwluwna aanta rabbunaa‏.‏ fayatba'uwnahu wayudrabu alssiraatu bayna zahraa jahannama, faaakuwnu aanaa waaummatiy aawwala man yujiyzuhaa, walaa yatakallamu yawmaiidhin iilaaa alrrusulu, wada'waa alrrusuli yawmaiidhin alllahumma sallim sallim‏.‏ wafiy jahannama kalaaliybu mithlu shawki alssa'daani, hal raaaytumu alssa'daana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa na'am yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinnahaa mithlu shawki alssa'daani, ghayra aannahu laa ya'lamu maa qadru 'izamihaa iilaaa alllahu, takhtafu alnnaasa biaa'maalihim, faminhumu almuwbaqu baqiya bi'amalihi, aawi almuwthaqu bi'amalihi, waminhumu almukhardalu aawi almujaazaa aaw nahwuhu, thumma yatajallaa hattaa iidhaa faragha alllahu mina alqadaa'i bayna al'ibaadi waaaraada aan yukhrija birahmatihi man aaraada min aahli alnnaari aamara almalaaiikaaa aan yukhrijuwa mina alnnaari man kaana laa yushriku bialllahi shayiana, mimman aaraada alllahu aan yarhamahu mimman yashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, faya'rifuwnahum fiy alnnaari biaathari alssujuwdi, taakulu alnnaaru abna adama iilaaa aathara alssujuwdi, harrama alllahu 'alaa alnnaari aan taakula aathara alssujuwdi, fayakhrujuwna mina alnnaari qadi amtuhishuwa, fayusabbu 'alayhim maa'u alhayaaai fayanbutuwna tahtahu kamaa tanbutu alhibbaau fiy hamiyli alssayli, thumma yafrughu alllahu mina alqadaa'i bayna al'ibaadi, wayabqaa rajulun muqbilun biwajhihi 'alaa alnnaari huwa akhiru aahli alnnaari dukhuwlaan aljannaaa fayaquwlu aaa rabbi asrif wajhiy 'ani alnnaari, faiinnahu qad qashabaniy riyhuhaa waaahraqaniy dhakaauuhaa‏.‏ fayad'uw alllaha bimaa shaa'a aan yad'uwahu thumma yaquwlu alllahu hal 'asayta iin au'tiyta dhalika aan tasaalaniy ghayrahu‏.‏ fayaquwlu laa wa'izzatika laa aasaaluka ghayrahu, wayu'tiy rabbahu min 'uhuwdin wamawaathiyqa maa shaa'a, fayasrifu alllahu wajhahu 'ani alnnaari, faiidhaa aaqbala 'alaa aljannaai waraahaa sakata maa shaa'a alllahu aan yaskuta thumma yaquwlu aaa rabbi qaddimniy iilaa bab aljannaai‏.‏ fayaquwlu alllahu lahu aalasta qad aa'tayta 'uhuwdaka wamawaathiyqaka aan laa tasaalaniy ghayra alladhiy au'tiyta aabadana, waylaka yaa abna adama maa aaghdaraka‏.‏ fayaquwlu aaa rabbi‏.‏ wayad'uw alllaha hattaa yaquwla hal 'asayta iin au'tiyta dhalika aan tasaala ghayrahu‏.‏ fayaquwlu laa wa'izzatika laa aasaaluka ghayrahu, wayu'tiy maa shaa'a min 'uhuwdin wamawaathiyqa, fayuqaddimuhu iilaa bab aljannaai, faiidhaa qaama iilaa bab aljannaai anfahaqat lahu aljannaau faraaaa maa fiyhaa mina alhabraai waalssuruwri, fayaskutu maa shaa'a alllahu aan yaskuta thumma yaquwlu aaa rabbi aadkhilniy aljannaaa‏.‏ fayaquwlu alllahu aalasta qad aa'tayta 'uhuwdaka wamawaathiyqaka aan laa tasaala ghayra maa au'tiyta fayaquwlu waylaka yaa abna adama maa aaghdaraka‏.‏ fayaquwlu aaa rabbi laa aakuwnanna aashqaa khalqika falaa yazaalu yad'uw hattaa yadhaka alllahu minhu faiidhaa dahika minhu qaala lahu adkhuli aljannaaa‏.‏ faiidhaa dakhalahaa qaala alllahu lahu tamannah‏.‏ fasaaala rabbahu watamannaa hattaa iinna alllaha layudhakkiruhu yaquwlu kadhaa wakadhaa, hattaa anqata'at bihi alaamaaniyyu qaala alllahu dhalika laka wamithluhu ma'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'ataa'u bnu yaziyda waaabuw sa'iydin alkhudriyyu ma'a aabiy hurayraaa laa yaruddu 'alayhi min hadiythihi shayiana hattaa iidhaa haddatha aabuw hurayraaa aanna alllaha tabaaraka wata'aalaa qaala ‏"‏ dhalika laka wamithluhu ma'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw sa'iydin alkhudriyyu ‏"‏ wa'asharaau aamthaalihi ma'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏ yaa aabaa hurayraaa‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa maa hafiztu iilaaa qawlahu ‏"‏ dhalika laka wamithluhu ma'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw sa'iydin alkhudriyyu aashhadu aanniy hafiztu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qawlahu ‏"‏ dhalika laka wa'asharaau aamthaalihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa fadhalika alrrajulu akhiru aahli aljannaai dukhuwlaan aljannaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ata' bin Yazid Al-Laithi: On the authority of Abu Huraira: The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall we see our Lord on the Day of Resurrection?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do you have any difficulty in seeing the moon on a full moon night?" They said, "No, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He said, "Do you have any difficulty in seeing the sun when there are no clouds?" They said, "No, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He said, "So you will see Him, like that. Allah will gather all the people on the Day of Resurrection, and say, 'Whoever worshipped something (in the world) should follow (that thing),' so, whoever worshipped the sun will follow the sun, and whoever worshiped the moon will follow the moon, and whoever used to worship certain (other false) deities, he will follow those deities. And there will remain only this nation with its good people (or its hypocrites). (The sub-narrator, Ibrahim is in doubt.) Allah will come to them and say, 'I am your Lord.' They will (deny Him and) say, 'We will stay here till our Lord comes, for when our Lord comes, we will recognize Him.' So Allah will come to them in His appearance which they know, and will say, 'I am your Lord.' They will say, 'You are our Lord,' so they will follow Him. Then a bridge will be laid across Hell (Fire)' I and my followers will be the first ones to go across it and none will speak on that Day except the Apostles. And the invocation of the Apostles on that Day will be, 'O Allah, save! Save!' In Hell (or over The Bridge) there will be hooks like the thorns of As-Sa'dan (thorny plant). Have you seen As-Sa'dan? " They replied, "Yes, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "So those hooks look like the thorns of As-Sa'dan, but none knows how big they are except Allah. Those hooks will snap the people away according to their deeds. Some of the people will stay in Hell (be destroyed) because of their (evil) deeds, and some will be cut or torn by the hooks (and fall into Hell) and some will be punished and then relieved. When Allah has finished His Judgments among the people, He will take whomever He will out of Hell through His Mercy. He will then order the angels to take out of the Fire all those who used to worship none but Allah from among those whom Allah wanted to be merciful to and those who testified (in the world) that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah. The angels will recognize them in the Fire by the marks of prostration (on their foreheads), for the Fire will eat up all the human body except the mark caused by prostration as Allah has forbidden the Fire to eat the mark of prostration. They will come out of the (Hell) Fire, completely burnt and then the water of life will be poured over them and they will grow under it as does a seed that comes in the mud of the torrent. Then Allah will finish the judgments among the people, and there will remain one man facing the (Hell) Fire and he will be the last person among the people of Hell to enter Paradise. He will say, 'O my Lord! Please turn my face away from the fire because its air has hurt me and its severe heat has burnt me.' So he will invoke Allah in the way Allah will wish him to invoke, and then Allah will say to him, 'If I grant you that, will you then ask for anything else?' He will reply, 'No, by Your Power, (Honor) I will not ask You for anything else.' He will give his Lord whatever promises and covenants Allah will demand. So Allah will turn his face away from Hell (Fire). When he will face Paradise and will see it, he will remain quiet for as long as Allah will wish him to remain quiet, then he will say, 'O my Lord! Bring me near to the gate of Paradise.' Allah will say to him, 'Didn't you give your promises and covenants that you would never ask for anything more than what you had been given? Woe on you, O Adam's son! How treacherous you are!' He will say, 'O my lord,' and will keep on invoking Allah till He says to him, 'If I give what you are asking, will you then ask for anything else?' He will reply, 'No, by Your (Honor) Power, I will not ask for anything else.' Then he will give covenants and promises to Allah and then Allah will bring him near to the gate of Paradise. When he stands at the gate of Paradise, Paradise will be opened and spread before him, and he will see its splendor and pleasures whereupon he will remain quiet as long as Allah will wish him to remain quiet, and then he will say, O my Lord! Admit me into Paradise.' Allah will say, 'Didn't you give your covenants and promises that you would not ask for anything more than what you had been given?' Allah will say, 'Woe on you, O Adam's son! How treacherous you are! ' The man will say, 'O my Lord! Do not make me the most miserable of Your creation,' and he will keep on invoking Allah till Allah will laugh because of his sayings, and when Allah will laugh because of him, He will say to him, 'Enter Paradise,' and when he will enter it, Allah will say to him, 'Wish for anything.' So he will ask his Lord, and he will wish for a great number of things, for Allah Himself will remind him to wish for certain things by saying, '(Wish for) so-and-so.' When there is nothing more to wish for, Allah will say, 'This is for you, and its equal (is for you) as well." 'Ata' bin Yazid added: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri who was present with Abu Huraira, did not deny whatever the latter said, but when Abu Huraira said that Allah had said, "That is for you and its equal as well," Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri said, "And ten times as much, O Abu Huraira!" Abu Huraira said, "I do not remember, except his saying, 'That is for you and its equal as well.'" Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri then said, "I testify that I remember the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'That is for you, and ten times as much.' ' Abu Huraira then added, "That man will be the last person of the people of Paradise to enter Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، أَنَّ الأَعْرَجَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ السَّابِقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَبِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَنْفِقْ أُنْفِقْ عَلَيْكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, aanna alaa'raja, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ nahnu alakhiruwna alssaabiquwna yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏ wabihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏"‏ qaala alllahu aanfiq aunfiq 'alayka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We (Muslims) are the last (to come) but will be the foremost on the Day of Resurrection." The narrators of this Hadith said: Allah said (to man), 'Spend (in charity), for then I will compensate you (generously)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا حَنْظَلَةُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ بُنِيَ الإِسْلاَمُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَالْحَجِّ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, qaala aakhbaranaa hanzalaau bnu aabiy sufyaana, 'an 'ikrimaaa bni khaalidin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ buniya aliislaamu 'alaa khamsin shahaadaai aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi, waiiqaami alssalaaai, waiiytaa'i alzzakaaai, waalhajji, wasawmi ramadaana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Islam is based on (the following) five (principles): 1. To testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). 2. To offer the (compulsory congregational) prayers dutifully and perfectly. 3. To pay Zakat (i.e. obligatory charity) . 4. To perform Hajj. (i.e. Pilgrimage to Mecca) 5. To observe fast during the month of Ramadan
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الإِيمَانُ بِضْعٌ وَسِتُّونَ شُعْبَةً، وَالْحَيَاءُ شُعْبَةٌ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu, qaala haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aliiymaanu bid'un wasittuwna shu'baaan, waalhayaa'u shu'baaun mina aliiymaani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Faith (Belief) consists of more than sixty branches (i.e. parts). And Haya (This term "Haya" covers a large number of concepts which are to be taken together; amongst them are self respect, modesty, bashfulness, and scruple, etc.) is a part of faith
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ، وَالْمُهَاجِرُ مَنْ هَجَرَ مَا نَهَى اللَّهُ عَنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَقَالَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ عَنْ عَامِرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى عَنْ دَاوُدَ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy alssafari, waiismaa'iyla, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almuslimu man salima almuslimuwna min lisaanihi wayadihi, waalmuhaajiru man hajara maa nahaa alllahu 'anhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi waqaala aabuw mu'aawiyaaa haddathanaa daawudu 'an 'aamirin qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu alaa'laa 'an daawuda 'an 'aamirin 'an 'abdi alllahi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Amr: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim is the one who avoids harming Muslims with his tongue and hands. And a Muhajir (emigrant) is the one who gives up (abandons) all what Allah has forbidden
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْقُرَشِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الإِسْلاَمِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu yahyaa bni sa'iydin alqurashiyyi, qaala haddathanaa aabiy qaala, haddathanaa aabuw burdaaa bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi aaaau aliislaami aafdalu qaala ‏ "‏ man salima almuslimuwna min lisaanihi wayadihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa: Some people asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Whose Islam is the best? i.e. (Who is a very good Muslim)?" He replied, "One who avoids harming the Muslims with his tongue and hands
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الإِسْلاَمِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرَأُ السَّلاَمَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu khaalidin, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw rda allh 'nhma aanna rajulaan, saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau aliislaami khayrun qaala ‏ "‏ tut'imu altta'aama, wataqraau alssalaama 'alaa man 'arafta waman lam ta'rif ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Amr: A man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) , "What sort of deeds or (what qualities of) Islam are good?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, 'To feed (the poor) and greet those whom you know and those whom you do not Know (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَعَنْ حُسَيْنٍ الْمُعَلِّمِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa musadaadun, qaala hadaathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ wa'an husaynin almu'aliimi, qaala hadaathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ la yuuminu aahadukum hataaa yuhibaa laakhiyhi maa yuhibuu linafsihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ وَالِدِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, qaala haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ fawaalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laa yuuminu aahadukum hattaa aakuwna aahabba iilayhi min waalidihi wawaladihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hands my life is, none of you will have faith till he loves me more than his father and his children
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ وَالِدِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yuuminu aahadukum hattaa aakuwna aahabba iilayhi min waalidihi wawaladihi waalnnaasi aajma'iyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said "None of you will have faith till he loves me more than his father, his children and all mankind
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ وَجَدَ حَلاَوَةَ الإِيمَانِ أَنْ يَكُونَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا سِوَاهُمَا، وَأَنْ يُحِبَّ الْمَرْءَ لاَ يُحِبُّهُ إِلاَّ لِلَّهِ، وَأَنْ يَكْرَهَ أَنْ يَعُودَ فِي الْكُفْرِ كَمَا يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُقْذَفَ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi althhaqafiyyu, qaala haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ thalaathun man kunna fiyhi wajada halaawaaa aliiymaani aan yakuwna alllahu warasuwluhu aahabba iilayhi mimmaa siwaahumaa, waaan yuhibba almar'a laa yuhibbuhu iilaaa lillahi, waaan yakraha aan ya'uwda fiy alkufri kamaa yakrahu aan yuqdhafa fiy alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever possesses the following three qualities will have the sweetness (delight) of faith: 1. The one to whom Allah and His Apostle become dearer than anything else. 2. Who loves a person and he loves him only for Allah's sake. 3. Who hates to revert to Atheism (disbelief) as he hates to be thrown into the fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ آيَةُ الإِيمَانِ حُبُّ الأَنْصَارِ، وَآيَةُ النِّفَاقِ بُغْضُ الأَنْصَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni jabrin, qaala sami'tu aanasana, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ayaau aliiymaani hubbu alaansaari, waayaau alnnifaaqi bughdu alaansaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Love for the Ansar is a sign of faith and hatred for the Ansar is a sign of hypocrisy
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ، عَائِذُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ عُبَادَةَ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَكَانَ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا، وَهُوَ أَحَدُ النُّقَبَاءِ لَيْلَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَحَوْلَهُ عِصَابَةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ ‏ "‏ بَايِعُونِي عَلَى أَنْ لاَ تُشْرِكُوا بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا، وَلاَ تَسْرِقُوا، وَلاَ تَزْنُوا، وَلاَ تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلاَدَكُمْ، وَلاَ تَأْتُوا بِبُهْتَانٍ تَفْتَرُونَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَرْجُلِكُمْ، وَلاَ تَعْصُوا فِي مَعْرُوفٍ، فَمَنْ وَفَى مِنْكُمْ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا فَعُوقِبَ فِي الدُّنْيَا فَهُوَ كَفَّارَةٌ لَهُ، وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ، فَهُوَ إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنْ شَاءَ عَفَا عَنْهُ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ عَاقَبَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَبَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw iidriysa, 'aaiidhu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi aanna 'ubaadaaa bna alssaamiti rda allh 'nh wakaana shahida badrana, wahuwa aahadu alnnuqabaa'i laylaaa al'aqabaai aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala wahawlahu 'isaabaaun min aashaabihi ‏ "‏ baayi'uwniy 'alaa aan laa tushrikuwa bialllahi shayiana, walaa tasriquwa, walaa taznuwa, walaa taqtuluwa aawlaadakum, walaa taatuwa bibuhtaanin taftaruwnahu bayna aaydiykum waaarjulikum, walaa ta'suwa fiy ma'ruwfin, faman wafaa minkum faaajruhu 'alaa alllahi, waman aasaaba min dhalika shayiana fa'uwqiba fiy alddunyaa fahuwa kaffaaraaun lahu, waman aasaaba min dhalika shayiana thumma satarahu alllahu, fahuwa iilaa alllahi iin shaa'a 'afaa 'anhu, waiin shaa'a 'aaqabahu ‏"‏‏.‏ fabaaya'naahu 'alaa dhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit: who took part in the battle of Badr and was a Naqib (a person heading a group of six persons), on the night of Al-'Aqaba pledge: Allah's Apostle said while a group of his companions were around him, "Swear allegiance to me for: 1. Not to join anything in worship along with Allah. 2. Not to steal. 3. Not to commit illegal sexual intercourse. 4. Not to kill your children. 5. Not to accuse an innocent person (to spread such an accusation among people). 6. Not to be disobedient (when ordered) to do good deed." The Prophet (ﷺ) added: "Whoever among you fulfills his pledge will be rewarded by Allah. And whoever indulges in any one of them (except the ascription of partners to Allah) and gets the punishment in this world, that punishment will be an expiation for that sin. And if one indulges in any of them, and Allah conceals his sin, it is up to Him to forgive or punish him (in the Hereafter)." 'Ubada bin As-Samit added: "So we swore allegiance for these." (points to Allah's Apostle)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَكُونَ خَيْرَ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِ غَنَمٌ يَتْبَعُ بِهَا شَعَفَ الْجِبَالِ وَمَوَاقِعَ الْقَطْرِ، يَفِرُّ بِدِينِهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'sa'aaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aannahu qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yuwshiku aan yakuwna khayra maali almuslimi ghanamun yatba'u bihaa sha'afa aljibaali wamawaaqi'a alqatri, yafirru bidiynihi mina alfitani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Said Al-Khudri: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A time will soon come when the best property of a Muslim will be sheep which he will take on the top of mountains and the places of rainfall (valleys) so as to flee with his religion from afflictions
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَمَرَهُمْ أَمَرَهُمْ مِنَ الأَعْمَالِ بِمَا يُطِيقُونَ قَالُوا إِنَّا لَسْنَا كَهَيْئَتِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ غَفَرَ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ‏.‏ فَيَغْضَبُ حَتَّى يُعْرَفَ الْغَضَبُ فِي وَجْهِهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَتْقَاكُمْ وَأَعْلَمَكُمْ بِاللَّهِ أَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu salaamin, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aamarahum aamarahum mina alaa'maali bimaa yutiyquwna qaaluwa iinnaa lasnaa kahayiatika yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinna alllaha qad ghafara laka maa taqaddama min dhanbika wamaa taaakhhara‏.‏ fayaghdabu hattaa yu'rafa alghadabu fiy wajhihi thumma yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna aatqaakum waaa'lamakum bialllahi aanaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Aisha: Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered the Muslims to do something, he used to order them deeds which were easy for them to do, (according to their strength and endurance). They said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are not like you. Allah has forgiven your past and future sins." So Allah's Apostle became angry and it was apparent on his face. He said, "I am the most Allah fearing, and know Allah better than all of you do
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ وَجَدَ حَلاَوَةَ الإِيمَانِ مَنْ كَانَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا سِوَاهُمَا، وَمَنْ أَحَبَّ عَبْدًا لاَ يُحِبُّهُ إِلاَّ لِلَّهِ، وَمَنْ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَعُودَ فِي الْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أَنْقَذَهُ اللَّهُ، كَمَا يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ thalaathun man kunna fiyhi wajada halaawaaa aliiymaani man kaana alllahu warasuwluhu aahabba iilayhi mimmaa siwaahumaa, waman aahabba 'abdana laa yuhibbuhu iilaaa lillahi, waman yakrahu aan ya'uwda fiy alkufri ba'da iidh aanqadhahu alllahu, kamaa yakrahu aan yulqaa fiy alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever possesses the following three qualities will taste the sweetness of faith: 1. The one to whom Allah and His Apostle become dearer than anything else. 2. Who loves a person and he loves him only for Allah's sake. 3. Who hates to revert to disbelief (Atheism) after Allah has brought (saved) him out from it, as he hates to be thrown in fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى الْمَازِنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَدْخُلُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَهْلُ النَّارِ النَّارَ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَخْرِجُوا مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ‏.‏ فَيُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا قَدِ اسْوَدُّوا فَيُلْقَوْنَ فِي نَهَرِ الْحَيَا ـ أَوِ الْحَيَاةِ، شَكَّ مَالِكٌ ـ فَيَنْبُتُونَ كَمَا تَنْبُتُ الْحِبَّةُ فِي جَانِبِ السَّيْلِ، أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهَا تَخْرُجُ صَفْرَاءَ مُلْتَوِيَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو ‏"‏ الْحَيَاةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ خَيْرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an 'amriw bni yahyaa almaaziniyyi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ yadkhulu aahlu aljannaai aljannaaa, waaahlu alnnaari alnnaara, thumma yaquwlu alllahu ta'aalaa aakhrijuwa man kaana fiy qalbihi mithqaalu habbaain min khardalin min iiymaanin‏.‏ fayukhrajuwna minhaa qadi aswadduwa fayulqawna fiy nahari alhayaa aawi alhayaaai, shakka maalikun fayanbutuwna kamaa tanbutu alhibbaau fiy jaanibi alssayli, aalam tara aannahaa takhruju safraa'a multawiyaaan ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala wuhaybun haddathanaa 'amrunw ‏"‏ alhayaaai ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ khardalin min khayrin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Said Al-Khudri: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the people of Paradise will enter Paradise and the people of Hell will go to Hell, Allah will order those who have had faith equal to the weight of a grain of mustard seed to be taken out from Hell. So they will be taken out but (by then) they will be blackened (charred). Then they will be put in the river of Haya' (rain) or Hayat (life) (the Narrator is in doubt as to which is the right term), and they will revive like a grain that grows near the bank of a flood channel. Don't you see that it comes out yellow and twisted?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَيْنَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ رَأَيْتُ النَّاسَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَىَّ، وَعَلَيْهِمْ قُمُصٌ مِنْهَا مَا يَبْلُغُ الثُّدِيَّ، وَمِنْهَا مَا دُونَ ذَلِكَ، وَعُرِضَ عَلَىَّ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَعَلَيْهِ قَمِيصٌ يَجُرُّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا فَمَا أَوَّلْتَ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الدِّينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy aumaamaaa bni sahlin, aannahu sami'a aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ baynaa aanaa naaiimun raaaytu alnnaasa yu'raduwna 'alaaaa, wa'alayhim qumusun minhaa maa yablughu althhudiyya, waminhaa maa duwna dhalika, wa'urida 'alaaaa 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi wa'alayhi qamiysun yajurruhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa famaa aawwalta dhalika yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ alddiyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Said Al-Khudri: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While I was sleeping I saw (in a dream) some people wearing shirts of which some were reaching up to the breasts only while others were even shorter than that. Umar bin Al-Khattab was shown wearing a shirt that he was dragging." The people asked, "How did you interpret it? (What is its interpretation) O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) replied, "It is the Religion
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَهُوَ يَعِظُ أَخَاهُ فِي الْحَيَاءِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ دَعْهُ فَإِنَّ الْحَيَاءَ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maaliku bnu aanasin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm marra 'alaa rajulin mina alaansaari wahuwa ya'izu aakhaahu fiy alhayaa'i, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ da'hu faiinna alhayaa'a mina aliiymaani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah (bin 'Umar): Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by an Ansari (man) who was admonishing his brother regarding Haya'. On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Leave him as Haya' is a part of faith." (See Hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمُسْنَدِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَوْحٍ الْحَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ وَاقِدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَيُقِيمُوا الصَّلاَةَ، وَيُؤْتُوا الزَّكَاةَ، فَإِذَا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ عَصَمُوا مِنِّي دِمَاءَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّ الإِسْلاَمِ، وَحِسَابُهُمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin almusnadiyyu, qaala haddathanaa aabuw rawhin alharamiyyu bnu 'umaaraaa, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an waaqidi bni muhammadin, qaala sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aumirtu aan auqaatila alnnaasa hattaa yashhaduwa aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi, wayuqiymuwa alssalaaaa, wayuutuwa alzzakaaaa, faiidhaa fa'aluwa dhalika 'asamuwa minniy dimaa'ahum waaamwaalahum iilaaa bihaqqi aliislaami, wahisaabuhum 'alaa alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "I have been ordered (by Allah) to fight against the people until they testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and offer the prayers perfectly and give the obligatory charity, so if they perform that, then they save their lives and property from me except for Islamic laws and then their reckoning (accounts) will be done by Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَمُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ أَىُّ الْعَمَلِ أَفْضَلُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِيمَانٌ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قِيلَ ثُمَّ مَاذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قِيلَ ثُمَّ مَاذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ حَجٌّ مَبْرُورٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, wamuwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaalaa haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, qaala haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm suiila aaaau al'amali aafdalu faqaala ‏"‏ iiymaanun bialllahi warasuwlihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qiyla thumma maadhaa qaala ‏"‏ aljihaadu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ qiyla thumma maadhaa qaala ‏"‏ hajjun mabruwrun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked, "What is the best deed?" He replied, "To believe in Allah and His Apostle (Muhammad). The questioner then asked, "What is the next (in goodness)? He replied, "To participate in Jihad (religious fighting) in Allah's Cause." The questioner again asked, "What is the next (in goodness)?" He replied, "To perform Hajj (Pilgrim age to Mecca) 'Mubrur, (which is accepted by Allah and is performed with the intention of seeking Allah's pleasure only and not to show off and without committing a sin and in accordance with the traditions of the Prophet)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْطَى رَهْطًا وَسَعْدٌ جَالِسٌ، فَتَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً هُوَ أَعْجَبُهُمْ إِلَىَّ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَكَ عَنْ فُلاَنٍ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَاهُ مُؤْمِنًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْ مُسْلِمًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَكَتُّ قَلِيلاً، ثُمَّ غَلَبَنِي مَا أَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ فَعُدْتُ لِمَقَالَتِي فَقُلْتُ مَا لَكَ عَنْ فُلاَنٍ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَاهُ مُؤْمِنًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْ مُسْلِمًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ غَلَبَنِي مَا أَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ فَعُدْتُ لِمَقَالَتِي وَعَادَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا سَعْدُ، إِنِّي لأُعْطِي الرَّجُلَ وَغَيْرُهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْهُ، خَشْيَةَ أَنْ يَكُبَّهُ اللَّهُ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ يُونُسُ وَصَالِحٌ وَمَعْمَرٌ وَابْنُ أَخِي الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'aamiru bnu sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, 'an sa'din, rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aa'taa rahtana wasa'dun jaalisun, fataraka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulaan huwa aa'jabuhum iilaaaa faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi maa laka 'an fulaanin fawaalllahi iinniy laaraahu muuminana‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aaw muslimana ‏"‏‏.‏ fasakattu qaliylaan, thumma ghalabaniy maa aa'lamu minhu fa'udtu limaqaalatiy faqultu maa laka 'an fulaanin fawaalllahi iinniy laaraahu muuminana faqaala ‏"‏ aaw muslimana ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma ghalabaniy maa aa'lamu minhu fa'udtu limaqaalatiy wa'aada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qaala ‏"‏ yaa sa'du, iinniy lau'tiy alrrajula waghayruhu aahabbu iilaaaa minhu, khashyaaa aan yakubbahu alllahu fiy alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ warawaahu yuwnusu wasaalihun wama'marun waabnu aakhiy alzzuhriyyi 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa'd: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) distributed (Zakat) amongst (a group of) people while I was sitting there but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left a man whom I thought the best of the lot. I asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why have you left that person? By Allah I regard him as a faithful believer." The Prophet (ﷺ) commented: "Or merely a Muslim." I remained quiet for a while, but could not help repeating my question because of what I knew about him. And then asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Why have you left so and so? By Allah! He is a faithful believer." The Prophet (ﷺ) again said, "Or merely a Muslim." And I could not help repeating my question because of what I knew about him. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Sa'd! I give to a person while another is dearer to me, for fear that he might be thrown on his face in the Fire by Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الإِسْلاَمِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرَأُ السَّلاَمَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, aanna rajulaan, saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau aliislaami khayrun qaala ‏ "‏ tut'imu altta'aama, wataqraau alssalaama 'alaa man 'arafta waman lam ta'rif ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Amr: A person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "What (sort of) deeds in or (what qualities of) Islam are good?" He replied, "To feed (the poor) and greet those whom you know and those whom you don't know
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أُرِيتُ النَّارَ فَإِذَا أَكْثَرُ أَهْلِهَا النِّسَاءُ يَكْفُرْنَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قِيلَ أَيَكْفُرْنَ بِاللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَكْفُرْنَ الْعَشِيرَ، وَيَكْفُرْنَ الإِحْسَانَ، لَوْ أَحْسَنْتَ إِلَى إِحْدَاهُنَّ الدَّهْرَ ثُمَّ رَأَتْ مِنْكَ شَيْئًا قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ مِنْكَ خَيْرًا قَطُّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ auriytu alnnaara faiidhaa aaktharu aahlihaa alnnisaa'u yakfurna ‏"‏‏.‏ qiyla aayakfurna bialllahi qaala ‏"‏ yakfurna al'ashiyra, wayakfurna aliihsaana, law aahsanta iilaa iihdaahunna alddahra thumma raaat minka shayiana qaalat maa raaaytu minka khayrana qattu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "I was shown the Hell-fire and that the majority of its dwellers were women who were ungrateful." It was asked, "Do they disbelieve in Allah?" (or are they ungrateful to Allah?) He replied, "They are ungrateful to their husbands and are ungrateful for the favors and the good (charitable deeds) done to them. If you have always been good (benevolent) to one of them and then she sees something in you (not of her liking), she will say, 'I have never received any good from you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ الأَحْدَبِ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ، قَالَ لَقِيتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ بِالرَّبَذَةِ، وَعَلَيْهِ حُلَّةٌ، وَعَلَى غُلاَمِهِ حُلَّةٌ، فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَابَبْتُ رَجُلاً، فَعَيَّرْتُهُ بِأُمِّهِ، فَقَالَ لِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ أَعَيَّرْتَهُ بِأُمِّهِ إِنَّكَ امْرُؤٌ فِيكَ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ، إِخْوَانُكُمْ خَوَلُكُمْ، جَعَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ تَحْتَ أَيْدِيكُمْ، فَمَنْ كَانَ أَخُوهُ تَحْتَ يَدِهِ فَلْيُطْعِمْهُ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ، وَلْيُلْبِسْهُ مِمَّا يَلْبَسُ، وَلاَ تُكَلِّفُوهُمْ مَا يَغْلِبُهُمْ، فَإِنْ كَلَّفْتُمُوهُمْ فَأَعِينُوهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an waasilin alaahdabi, 'ani alma'ruwri, qaala laqiytu aabaa dharrin bialrrabadhaai, wa'alayhi hullaaun, wa'alaa ghulaamihi hullaaun, fasaaaltuhu 'an dhalika, faqaala iinniy saababtu rajulaan, fa'ayyartuhu biaummihi, faqaala liya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa aabaa dharrin aa'ayyartahu biaummihi iinnaka amruuun fiyka jaahiliyyaaun, iikhwaanukum khawalukum, ja'alahumu alllahu tahta aaydiykum, faman kaana aakhuwhu tahta yadihi falyut'imhu mimmaa yaakulu, walyulbishu mimmaa yalbasu, walaa tukallifuwhum maa yaghlibuhum, faiin kallaftumuwhum faaa'iynuwhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Ma'rur: At Ar-Rabadha I met Abu Dhar who was wearing a cloak, and his slave, too, was wearing a similar one. I asked about the reason for it. He replied, "I abused a person by calling his mother with bad names." The Prophet said to me, 'O Abu Dhar! Did you abuse him by calling his mother with bad names You still have some characteristics of ignorance. Your slaves are your brothers and Allah has put them under your command. So whoever has a brother under his command should feed him of what he eats and dress him of what he wears. Do not ask them (slaves) to do things beyond their capacity (power) and if you do so, then help them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، وَيُونُسُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ الأَحْنَفِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ ذَهَبْتُ لأَنْصُرَ هَذَا الرَّجُلَ، فَلَقِيَنِي أَبُو بَكْرَةَ فَقَالَ أَيْنَ تُرِيدُ قُلْتُ أَنْصُرُ هَذَا الرَّجُلَ‏.‏ قَالَ ارْجِعْ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِذَا الْتَقَى الْمُسْلِمَانِ بِسَيْفَيْهِمَا فَالْقَاتِلُ وَالْمَقْتُولُ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا الْقَاتِلُ فَمَا بَالُ الْمَقْتُولِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَرِيصًا عَلَى قَتْلِ صَاحِبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu alraahmani bnu almubaaraki, hadaathanaa hamaaadu bnu zaydin, hadaathanaa aayuuwbu, wayuwnusu, 'ani alhasani, 'ani alaahnafi bni qaysin, qaala dhahabtu laansura hadhaa alraajula, falaqiyaniy aabuw bakraaa faqaala aayna turiydu qultu aansuru hadhaa alraajula‏.‏ qaala arji' faiiniiy sami'tu rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iidhaa altaqaa almuslimaani bisayfayhimaa faalqaatilu waalmaqtuwlu fiy alnaaari ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla allaahi hadhaa alqaatilu famaa baalu almaqtuwli qaala ‏"‏ iinaahu kaana hariysana 'alaa qatli saahibihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Ahnaf bin Qais: While I was going to help this man ('Ali Ibn Abi Talib), Abu Bakra met me and asked, "Where are you going?" I replied, "I am going to help that person." He said, "Go back for I have heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'When two Muslims fight (meet) each other with their swords, both the murderer as well as the murdered will go to the Hell-fire.' I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It is all right for the murderer but what about the murdered one?' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "He surely had the intention to kill his companion
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتِ ‏{‏الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوا إِيمَانَهُمْ بِظُلْمٍ‏}‏ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيُّنَا لَمْ يَظْلِمْ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, h‏.‏ qaala wahaddathaniy bishrun, qaala haddathanaa muhammadun, 'an shu'baaa, 'an sulaymaana, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala lammaa nazalati ‏{‏alladhiyna amanuwa walam yalbisuwa iiymaanahum bizulmin‏}‏ qaala aashaabu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aayyunaa lam yazlim faaanzala alllahu ‏{‏iinna alshhirka lazulmun 'aziymun‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah: When the following Verse was revealed: "It is those who believe and confuse not their belief with wrong (worshipping others besides Allah.)" (6:83), the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked, "Who is amongst us who had not done injustice (wrong)?" Allah revealed: "No doubt, joining others in worship with Allah is a great injustice (wrong) indeed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَبِي عَامِرٍ أَبُو سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ آيَةُ الْمُنَافِقِ ثَلاَثٌ إِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ، وَإِذَا وَعَدَ أَخْلَفَ، وَإِذَا اؤْتُمِنَ خَانَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu aabuw alrrabiy'i, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, qaala haddathanaa naafi'u bnu maaliki bni aabiy 'aamirin aabuw suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ayaau almunaafiqi thalaathun iidhaa haddatha kadhaba, waiidhaa wa'ada aakhlafa, waiidhaa autumina khaana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The signs of a hypocrite are three: 1. Whenever he speaks, he tells a lie. 2. Whenever he promises, he always breaks it (his promise ). 3. If you trust him, he proves to be dishonest. (If you keep something as a trust with him, he will not return it)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَرْبَعٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ كَانَ مُنَافِقًا خَالِصًا، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ فِيهِ خَصْلَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ كَانَتْ فِيهِ خَصْلَةٌ مِنَ النِّفَاقِ حَتَّى يَدَعَهَا إِذَا اؤْتُمِنَ خَانَ وَإِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ وَإِذَا عَاهَدَ غَدَرَ، وَإِذَا خَاصَمَ فَجَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau bnu 'uqbaaa, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aarba'un man kunna fiyhi kaana munaafiqana khaalisana, waman kaanat fiyhi khaslaaun minhunna kaanat fiyhi khaslaaun mina alnnifaaqi hattaa yada'ahaa iidhaa autumina khaana waiidhaa haddatha kadhaba waiidhaa 'aahada ghadara, waiidhaa khaasama fajara ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu shu'baau 'ani alaa'mashi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Amr: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever has the following four (characteristics) will be a pure hypocrite and whoever has one of the following four characteristics will have one characteristic of hypocrisy unless and until he gives it up. 1. Whenever he is entrusted, he betrays. 2. Whenever he speaks, he tells a lie. 3. Whenever he makes a covenant, he proves treacherous. 4. Whenever he quarrels, he behaves in a very imprudent, evil and insulting manner
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَقُمْ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
