verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala iinna alnnaasa yaquwluwna aakthara aabuw hurayraaa, walawlaa ayataani fiy kitaabi alllahi maa haddathtu hadiythana, thumma yatluw ‏{‏iinna alladhiyna yaktumuwna maa aanzalnaa mina albayyinaati‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏alrrahiymu‏}‏ iinna iikhwaananaa mina almuhaajiriyna kaana yashghaluhumu alssafqu bialaaswaaqi, wiiinna iikhwaananaa mina alaansaari kaana yashghaluhumu al'amalu fiy aamwaalihim, waiinna aabaa hurayraaa kaana yalzamu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bishiba'i batnihi wayahduru maa laa yahduruwna, wayahfazu maa laa yahfazuwna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:People say that I have narrated many Hadiths (The Prophet's narration). Had it not been for two verses in the Qur'an, I would not have narrated a single Hadith, and the verses are: "Verily those who conceal the clear sign and the guidance which We have sent down . . . (up to) Most Merciful." (2:159-160). And no doubt our Muhajir (emigrant) brothers used to be busy in the market with their business (bargains) and our Ansari brothers used to be busy with their property (agriculture). But I (Abu Huraira) used to stick to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) contented with what will fill my stomach and I used to attend that which they used not to attend and I used to memorize that which they used not to memorize
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَبُو مُصْعَبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي أَسْمَعُ مِنْكَ حَدِيثًا كَثِيرًا أَنْسَاهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ابْسُطْ رِدَاءَكَ ‏"‏ فَبَسَطْتُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَغَرَفَ بِيَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ضُمُّهُ ‏"‏ فَضَمَمْتُهُ فَمَا نَسِيتُ شَيْئًا بَعْدَهُ‏. حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ بِهَذَا أَوْ قَالَ غَرَفَ بِيَدِهِ فِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aahmadu bnu aabiy bakrin aabuw mus'abin, qaala hadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu iibraahiyma bni diynaarin, 'ani abni aabiy dhiibin, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyii, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qultu yaa rasuwla allaahi, iiniiy aasma'u minka hadiythana kathiyrana aansaahu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ absut ridaa'aka ‏"‏ fabasattuhu‏.‏ qaala fagharafa biyadayhi thumaa qaala ‏"‏ dumuuhu ‏"‏ fadamamtuhu famaa nasiytu shayiana ba'dahu‏. hadaathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri qaala hadaathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin bihadhaa aaw qaala gharafa biyadihi fiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "I hear many narrations (Hadiths) from you but I forget them." Allah's Apostle said, "Spread your Rida' (garment)." I did accordingly and then he moved his hands as if filling them with something (and emptied them in my Rida') and then said, "Take and wrap this sheet over your body." I did it and after that I never forgot any thing. Narrated Ibrahim bin Al-Mundhir: Ibn Abi Fudaik narrated the same as above (Hadith...119) but added that the Prophet (ﷺ) had moved his hands as if filling them with something and then he emptied them in the Rida' of Abu Huraira
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ حَفِظْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وِعَاءَيْنِ، فَأَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَبَثَثْتُهُ، وَأَمَّا الآخَرُ فَلَوْ بَثَثْتُهُ قُطِعَ هَذَا الْبُلْعُومُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy aakhiy, 'ani abni aabiy dhiibin, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala hafiztu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wi'aa'ayni, faaammaa aahaduhumaa fabathathtuhu, waaammaa alakharu falaw bathathtuhu quti'a hadhaa albul'uwmu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I have memorized two kinds of knowledge from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . I have propagated one of them to you and if I propagated the second, then my pharynx (throat) would be cut (i.e. killed)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُدْرِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهُ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏"‏ اسْتَنْصِتِ النَّاسَ ‏"‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaajun, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'aliyyu bnu mudrikin, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an jariyrin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahu fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i ‏"‏ astansiti alnnaasa ‏"‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laa tarji'uwa ba'diy kuffaarana yadribu ba'dukum riqaaba ba'din ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jarir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me during Hajjat-al-Wida`: Let the people keep quiet and listen. Then he said (addressing the people), "Do not (become infidels) revert to disbelief after me by striking the necks (cutting the throats) of one another (killing each other)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِنَّ نَوْفًا الْبِكَالِيَّ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّ مُوسَى لَيْسَ بِمُوسَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، إِنَّمَا هُوَ مُوسَى آخَرُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ كَذَبَ عَدُوُّ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَامَ مُوسَى النَّبِيُّ خَطِيبًا فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، فَسُئِلَ أَىُّ النَّاسِ أَعْلَمُ فَقَالَ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَعَتَبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ، إِذْ لَمْ يَرُدَّ الْعِلْمَ إِلَيْهِ، فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّ عَبْدًا مِنْ عِبَادِي بِمَجْمَعِ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ مِنْكَ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَبِّ وَكَيْفَ بِهِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ احْمِلْ حُوتًا فِي مِكْتَلٍ فَإِذَا فَقَدْتَهُ فَهْوَ ثَمَّ، فَانْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقَ بِفَتَاهُ يُوشَعَ بْنِ نُونٍ، وَحَمَلاَ حُوتًا فِي مِكْتَلٍ، حَتَّى كَانَا عِنْدَ الصَّخْرَةِ وَضَعَا رُءُوسَهُمَا وَنَامَا فَانْسَلَّ الْحُوتُ مِنَ الْمِكْتَلِ فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ سَرَبًا، وَكَانَ لِمُوسَى وَفَتَاهُ عَجَبًا، فَانْطَلَقَا بَقِيَّةَ لَيْلَتِهِمَا وَيَوْمِهِمَا فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ مُوسَى لِفَتَاهُ آتِنَا غَدَاءَنَا، لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِنْ سَفَرِنَا هَذَا نَصَبًا، وَلَمْ يَجِدْ مُوسَى مَسًّا مِنَ النَّصَبِ حَتَّى جَاوَزَ الْمَكَانَ الَّذِي أُمِرَ بِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ فَتَاهُ أَرَأَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ، قَالَ مُوسَى ذَلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِي، فَارْتَدَّا عَلَى آثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا، فَلَمَّا انْتَهَيَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ إِذَا رَجُلٌ مُسَجًّى بِثَوْبٍ ـ أَوْ قَالَ تَسَجَّى بِثَوْبِهِ ـ فَسَلَّمَ مُوسَى‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْخَضِرُ وَأَنَّى بِأَرْضِكَ السَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ أَنَا مُوسَى‏.‏ فَقَالَ مُوسَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُعَلِّمَنِي مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رَشَدًا قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا، يَا مُوسَى إِنِّي عَلَى عِلْمٍ مِنْ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ عَلَّمَنِيهِ لاَ تَعْلَمُهُ أَنْتَ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى عِلْمٍ عَلَّمَكَهُ لاَ أَعْلَمُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ صَابِرًا، وَلاَ أَعْصِي لَكَ أَمْرًا، فَانْطَلَقَا يَمْشِيَانِ عَلَى سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ لَيْسَ لَهُمَا سَفِينَةٌ، فَمَرَّتْ بِهِمَا سَفِينَةٌ، فَكَلَّمُوهُمْ أَنْ يَحْمِلُوهُمَا، فَعُرِفَ الْخَضِرُ، فَحَمَلُوهُمَا بِغَيْرِ نَوْلٍ، فَجَاءَ عُصْفُورٌ فَوَقَعَ عَلَى حَرْفِ السَّفِينَةِ، فَنَقَرَ نَقْرَةً أَوْ نَقْرَتَيْنِ فِي الْبَحْرِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْخَضِرُ يَا مُوسَى، مَا نَقَصَ عِلْمِي وَعِلْمُكَ مِنْ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ كَنَقْرَةِ هَذَا الْعُصْفُورِ فِي الْبَحْرِ‏.‏ فَعَمَدَ الْخَضِرُ إِلَى لَوْحٍ مِنْ أَلْوَاحِ السَّفِينَةِ فَنَزَعَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مُوسَى قَوْمٌ حَمَلُونَا بِغَيْرِ نَوْلٍ، عَمَدْتَ إِلَى سَفِينَتِهِمْ فَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا قَالَ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا نَسِيتُ‏.‏ فَكَانَتِ الأُولَى مِنْ مُوسَى نِسْيَانًا‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَا فَإِذَا غُلاَمٌ يَلْعَبُ مَعَ الْغِلْمَانِ، فَأَخَذَ الْخَضِرُ بِرَأْسِهِ مِنْ أَعْلاَهُ فَاقْتَلَعَ رَأْسَهُ بِيَدِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مُوسَى أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكَ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا ـ قَالَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ وَهَذَا أَوْكَدُ ـ فَانْطَلَقَا حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَيَا أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ اسْتَطْعَمَا أَهْلَهَا، فَأَبَوْا أَنْ يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا، فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَنْقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ الْخَضِرُ بِيَدِهِ فَأَقَامَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ مُوسَى لَوْ شِئْتَ لاَتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا‏.‏ قَالَ هَذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مُوسَى، لَوَدِدْنَا لَوْ صَبَرَ حَتَّى يُقَصَّ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ أَمْرِهِمَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathanaa 'amrunw, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu jubayrin, qaala qultu laibni 'abbaasin iinna nawfana albikaaliyya yaz'umu aanna muwsaa laysa bimuwsaa baniy iisraaiiyla, iinnamaa huwa muwsaa akharu‏.‏ faqaala kadhaba 'aduwwu alllahi, haddathanaa aubaaau bnu ka'bin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ qaama muwsaa alnnabiyyu khatiybana fiy baniy iisraaiiyla, fasuiila aaaau alnnaasi aa'lamu faqaala aanaa aa'lamu‏.‏ fa'ataba alllahu 'alayhi, iidh lam yarudda al'ilma iilayhi, faaawhaa alllahu iilayhi aanna 'abdana min 'ibaadiy bimajma'i albahrayni huwa aa'lamu minka‏.‏ qaala yaa rabbi wakayfa bihi faqiyla lahu ahmil huwtana fiy miktalin faiidhaa faqadtahu fahwa thamma, faantalaqa waantalaqa bifataahu yuwsha'a bni nuwnin, wahamalaa huwtana fiy miktalin, hattaa kaanaa 'inda alssakhraai wada'aa ru'uwsahumaa wanaamaa faansalla alhuwtu mina almiktali faattakhadha sabiylahu fiy albahri sarabana, wakaana limuwsaa wafataahu 'ajabana, faantalaqaa baqiyyaaa laylatihimaa wayawmihimaa falammaa aasbaha qaala muwsaa lifataahu atinaa ghadaa'anaa, laqad laqiynaa min safarinaa hadhaa nasabana, walam yajid muwsaa massana mina alnnasabi hattaa jaawaza almakaana alladhiy aumira bihi‏.‏ faqaala lahu fataahu aaraaayta iidh aawaynaa iilaa alssakhraai faiinniy nasiytu alhuwta, qaala muwsaa dhalika maa kunnaa nabghiy, faartaddaa 'alaa athaarihimaa qasasana, falammaa antahayaa iilaa alssakhraai iidhaa rajulun musajjana bithawbin aaw qaala tasajjaa bithawbihi fasallama muwsaa‏.‏ faqaala alkhadiru waaannaa biaardika alssalaamu faqaala aanaa muwsaa‏.‏ faqaala muwsaa baniy iisraaiiyla qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala hal aattabi'uka 'alaa aan tu'allimaniy mimmaa 'ullimta rashadana qaala iinnaka lan tastatiy'a ma'iya sabrana, yaa muwsaa iinniy 'alaa 'ilmin min 'ilmi alllahi 'allamaniyhi laa ta'lamuhu aanta, waaanta 'alaa 'ilmin 'allamakahu laa aa'lamuhu‏.‏ qaala satajiduniy iin shaa'a alllahu saabirana, walaa aa'siy laka aamrana, faantalaqaa yamshiyaani 'alaa saahili albahri laysa lahumaa safiynaaun, famarrat bihimaa safiynaaun, fakallamuwhum aan yahmiluwhumaa, fa'urifa alkhadiru, fahamaluwhumaa bighayri nawlin, fajaa'a 'usfuwrun fawaqa'a 'alaa harfi alssafiynaai, fanaqara naqraaan aaw naqratayni fiy albahri‏.‏ faqaala alkhadiru yaa muwsaa, maa naqasa 'ilmiy wa'ilmuka min 'ilmi alllahi iilaaa kanaqraai hadhaa al'usfuwri fiy albahri‏.‏ fa'amada alkhadiru iilaa lawhin min aalwaahi alssafiynaai fanaza'ahu‏.‏ faqaala muwsaa qawmun hamaluwnaa bighayri nawlin, 'amadta iilaa safiynatihim fakharaqtahaa litughriqa aahlahaa qaala aalam aaqul iinnaka lan tastatiy'a ma'iya sabrana qaala laa tuuaakhidhniy bimaa nasiytu‏.‏ fakaanati alauwlaa min muwsaa nisyaanana‏.‏ faantalaqaa faiidhaa ghulaamun yal'abu ma'a alghilmaani, faaakhadha alkhadiru biraasihi min aa'laahu faaqtala'a raasahu biyadihi‏.‏ faqaala muwsaa aaqatalta nafsana zakiyyaaan bighayri nafsin qaala aalam aaqul laka iinnaka lan tastatiy'a ma'iya sabrana qaala abnu 'uyaynaaa wahadhaa aawkadu faantalaqaa hattaa iidhaa aatayaa aahla qaryaain astat'amaa aahlahaa, faaabawa aan yudayyifuwhumaa, fawajadaa fiyhaa jidaarana yuriydu aan yanqadda faaaqaamahu‏.‏ qaala alkhadiru biyadihi faaaqaamahu‏.‏ faqaala lahu muwsaa law shiita laattakhadhta 'alayhi aajrana‏.‏ qaala hadhaa firaaqu bayniy wabaynika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yarhamu alllahu muwsaa, lawadidnaa law sabara hattaa yuqassa 'alaynaa min aamrihimaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I said to Ibn `Abbas, "Nauf-Al-Bakali claims that Moses (the companion of Khadir) was not the Moses of Bani Israel but he was another Moses." Ibn `Abbas remarked that the enemy of Allah (Nauf) was a liar. Narrated Ubai bin Ka`b: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Once the Prophet Moses (ﷺ) stood up and addressed Bani Israel. He was asked, "Who is the most learned man amongst the people. He said, "I am the most learned." Allah admonished Moses as he did not attribute absolute knowledge to Him (Allah). So Allah inspired to him "At the junction of the two seas there is a slave amongst my slaves who is more learned than you." Moses said, "O my Lord! How can I meet him?" Allah said: Take a fish in a large basket (and proceed) and you will find him at the place where you will lose the fish. So Moses set out along with his (servant) boy, Yusha` bin Noon and carried a fish in a large basket till they reached a rock, where they laid their heads (i.e. lay down) and slept. The fish came out of the basket and it took its way into the sea as in a tunnel. So it was an amazing thing for both Moses and his (servant) boy. They proceeded for the rest of that night and the following day. When the day broke, Moses said to his (servant) boy: "Bring us our early meal. No doubt, we have suffered much fatigue in this journey." Moses did not get tired till he passed the place about which he was told. There the (servant) boy told Moses, "Do you remember when we betook ourselves to the rock, I indeed forgot the fish." Moses remarked, "That is what we have been seeking. So they went back retracing their footsteps, till they reached the rock. There they saw a man covered with a garment (or covering himself with his own garment). Moses greeted him. Al-Khadir replied saying, "How do people greet each other in your land?" Moses said, "I am Moses." He asked, "The Moses of Bani Israel?" Moses replied in the affirmative and added, "May I follow you so that you teach me of that knowledge which you have been taught." Al-Khadir replied, "Verily! You will not be able to remain patient with me, O Moses! I have some of the knowledge of Allah which He has taught me and which you do not know, while you have some knowledge which Allah has taught you which I do not know." Moses said, "Allah willing, you will find me patient and I will disobey no order of yours. So both of them set out walking along the seashore, as they did not have a boat. In the meantime a boat passed by them and they requested the crew of the boat to take them on board. The crew recognized Al-Khadir and took them on board without fare. Then a sparrow came and stood on the edge of the boat and dipped its beak once or twice in the sea. Al-Khadir said: "O Moses! My knowledge and your knowledge have not decreased Allah's knowledge except as much as this sparrow has decreased the water of the sea with its beak." Al- Khadir went to one of the planks of the boat and plucked it out. Moses said, "These people gave us a free lift but you have broken their boat and scuttled it so as to drown its people." Al-Khadir replied, "Didn't I tell you that you will not be able to remain patient with me." Moses said, "Call me not to account for what I forgot." The first (excuse) of Moses was that he had forgotten. Then they proceeded further and found a boy playing with other boys. Al-Khadir took hold of the boy's head from the top and plucked it out with his hands (i.e. killed him). Moses said, "Have you killed an innocent soul who has killed none." Al-Khadir replied, "Did I not tell you that you cannot remain patient with me?" Then they both proceeded till when they came to the people of a town, they asked them for food, but they refused to entertain them. Then they found there a wall on the point of collapsing. Al-Khadir repaired it with his own hands. Moses said, "If you had wished, surely you could have taken wages for it." Al-Khadir replied, "This is the parting between you and me." The Prophet added, "May Allah be Merciful to Moses! Would that he could have been more patient to learn more about his story with Al-Khadir
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا الْقِتَالُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ أَحَدَنَا يُقَاتِلُ غَضَبًا، وَيُقَاتِلُ حَمِيَّةً‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ إِلَيْهِ رَأْسَهُ ـ قَالَ وَمَا رَفَعَ إِلَيْهِ رَأْسَهُ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ كَانَ قَائِمًا ـ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَاتَلَ لِتَكُونَ كَلِمَةُ اللَّهِ هِيَ الْعُلْيَا فَهُوَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, qaala aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, maa alqitaalu fiy sabiyli alllahi faiinna aahadanaa yuqaatilu ghadabana, wayuqaatilu hamiyyaaan‏.‏ farafa'a iilayhi raasahu qaala wamaa rafa'a iilayhi raasahu iilaaa aannahu kaana qaaiimana faqaala ‏ "‏ man qaatala litakuwna kalimaau alllahi hiya al'ulyaa fahuwa fiy sabiyli alllahi 'azza wajalla ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What kind of fighting is in Allah's cause? (I ask this), for some of us fight because of being enraged and angry and some for the sake of his pride and haughtiness." The Prophet (ﷺ) raised his head (as the questioner was standing) and said, "He who fights so that Allah's Word (Islam) should be superior, then he fights in Allah's cause
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ وَهُوَ يُسْأَلُ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَحَرْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْمِ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ آخَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْحَرْ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَمَا سُئِلَ عَنْ شَىْءٍ قُدِّمَ وَلاَ أُخِّرَ إِلاَّ قَالَ افْعَلْ وَلاَ حَرَجَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'iysaa bni talhaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda aljamraai wahuwa yusaalu, faqaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi nahartu qabla aan aarmiya‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ armi walaa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala akharu yaa rasuwla alllahi halaqtu qabla aan aanhara‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ anhar walaa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏ famaa suiila 'an shaa'in quddima walaa aukhhira iilaaa qaala af'al walaa haraja‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Ammar:I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) near the Jamra and the people were asking him questions (about religious problems). A man asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have slaughtered the Hadi (animal) before doing the Rami." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Do the Rami (now) and there is no harm." Another person asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I got my head shaved before slaughtering the animal." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Do the slaughtering (now) and there is no harm." So on that day, when the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about anything as regards the ceremonies of Hajj performed before or after its due time his reply was, "Do it (now) and there is no harm
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، سُلَيْمَانُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا أَمْشِي، مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي خَرِبِ الْمَدِينَةِ، وَهُوَ يَتَوَكَّأُ عَلَى عَسِيبٍ مَعَهُ، فَمَرَّ بِنَفَرٍ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ سَلُوهُ عَنِ الرُّوحِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لاَ تَسْأَلُوهُ لاَ يَجِيءُ فِيهِ بِشَىْءٍ تَكْرَهُونَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لَنَسْأَلَنَّهُ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ، مَا الرُّوحُ فَسَكَتَ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّهُ يُوحَى إِلَيْهِ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ، فَلَمَّا انْجَلَى عَنْهُ، قَالَ ‏{‏وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتُيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ هَكَذَا فِي قِرَاءَتِنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qaysu bnu hafsin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, qaala haddathanaa alaa'mashu, sulaymaanu 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala baynaa aanaa aamshiy, ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy kharibi almadiynaai, wahuwa yatawakkaau 'alaa 'asiybin ma'ahu, famarra binafarin mina alyahuwdi, faqaala ba'duhum liba'din saluwhu 'ani alrruwhi‏.‏ waqaala ba'duhum laa tasaaluwhu laa yajiy'u fiyhi bishaa'in takrahuwnahu‏.‏ faqaala ba'duhum lanasaalannahu‏.‏ faqaama rajulun minhum faqaala yaa aabaa alqaasimi, maa alrruwhu fasakata‏.‏ faqultu iinnahu yuwhaa iilayhi‏.‏ faqumtu, falammaa anjalaa 'anhu, qaala ‏{‏wayasaaluwnaka 'ani alrruwhi quli alrruwhu min aamri rabbiy wamaa auwtuytum mina al'ilmi iilaaa qaliylaan‏}‏‏.‏ qaala alaa'mashu hakadhaa fiy qiraa'atinaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:While I was going with the Prophet (ﷺ) through the ruins of Medina and he was reclining on a date-palm leaf stalk, some Jews passed by. Some of them said to the others: Ask him (the Prophet) about the spirit. Some of them said that they should not ask him that question as he might give a reply which would displease them. But some of them insisted on asking, and so one of them stood up and asked, "O Abul-Qasim ! What is the spirit?" The Prophet (ﷺ) remained quiet. I thought he was being inspired Divinely. So I stayed till that state of the Prophet (while being inspired) was over. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "And they ask you (O Muhammad) concerning the spirit --Say: The spirit -- its knowledge is with my Lord. And of knowledge you (mankind) have been given only a little
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ تُسِرُّ إِلَيْكَ كَثِيرًا فَمَا حَدَّثَتْكَ فِي الْكَعْبَةِ قُلْتُ قَالَتْ لِي قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ، لَوْلاَ قَوْمُكِ حَدِيثٌ عَهْدُهُمْ ـ قَالَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ بِكُفْرٍ ـ لَنَقَضْتُ الْكَعْبَةَ فَجَعَلْتُ لَهَا بَابَيْنِ باب يَدْخُلُ النَّاسُ، وَبَابٌ يَخْرُجُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَفَعَلَهُ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaaswadi, qaala qaala liy abnu alzzubayri kaanat 'aaiishaau tusirru iilayka kathiyrana famaa haddathatka fiy alka'baai qultu qaalat liy qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa 'aaiishaau, lawlaa qawmuki hadiythun 'ahduhum qaala abnu alzzubayri bikufrin lanaqadtu alka'baaa faja'altu lahaa baabayni bab yadkhulu alnnaasu, wabaabun yakhrujuwna ‏"‏‏.‏ fafa'alahu abnu alzzubayri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aswad:Ibn Az-Zubair said to me, "Aisha used to tell you secretly a number of things. What did she tell you about the Ka`ba?" I replied, "She told me that once the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'O `Aisha! Had not your people been still close to the pre-Islamic period of ignorance (infidelity)! I would have dismantled the Ka`ba and would have made two doors in it; one for entrance and the other for exit." Later on Ibn Az-Zubair did the same
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ مَعْرُوفِ بْنِ خَرَّبُوذٍ عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ بِذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'ubaydu allaahi bnu muwsaa 'an ma'ruwfi bni kharaabuwdhin 'an aabiy altuufayli 'an 'aliyinn bidhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu at-Tufail:The above mentioned Statement of `Ali
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمُعَاذٌ رَدِيفُهُ عَلَى الرَّحْلِ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ بْنَ جَبَلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صِدْقًا مِنْ قَلْبِهِ إِلاَّ حَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَفَلاَ أُخْبِرُ بِهِ النَّاسَ فَيَسْتَبْشِرُوا قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذًا يَتَّكِلُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَخْبَرَ بِهَا مُعَاذٌ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ تَأَثُّمًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, qaala haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wamu'aadhun radiyfuhu 'alaa alrrahli qaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu bna jabalin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi wasa'dayka‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ yaa mu'aadhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi wasa'dayka‏.‏ thalaathana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ maa min aahadin yashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi sidqana min qalbihi iilaaa harramahu alllahu 'alaa alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, aafalaa aukhbiru bihi alnnaasa fayastabshiruwa qaala ‏"‏ iidhana yattakiluwa ‏"‏‏.‏ waaakhbara bihaa mu'aadhun 'inda mawtihi taaathhumana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:"Once Mu`adh was along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as a companion rider. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Mu`adh bin Jabal." Mu`adh replied, "Labbaik and Sa`daik. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Again the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Mu`adh!" Mu`adh said thrice, "Labbaik and Sa`daik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is none who testifies sincerely that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is his Apostle, except that Allah, will save him from the Hell-fire." Mu`adh said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ! Should I not inform the people about it so that they may have glad tidings?" He replied, "When the people hear about it, they will solely depend on it." Then Mu`adh narrated the above-mentioned Hadith just before his death, being afraid of committing sin (by not telling the knowledge)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، قَالَ ذُكِرَ لِي أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِمُعَاذٍ ‏"‏ مَنْ لَقِيَ اللَّهَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَلاَ أُبَشِّرُ النَّاسَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ، إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يَتَّكِلُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu aabiy qaala, sami'tu aanasana, qaala dhukira liy aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala limu'aadhin ‏"‏ man laqiya alllaha laa yushriku bihi shayiana dakhala aljannaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aalaa aubashhiru alnnaasa qaala ‏"‏ laa, iinniy aakhaafu aan yattakiluwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:I was informed that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said to Mu`adh, "Whosoever will meet Allah without associating anything in worship with Him will go to Paradise." Mu`adh asked the Prophet, "Should I not inform the people of this good news?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "No, I am afraid, lest they should depend upon it (absolutely)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ، فَهَلْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ مِنْ غُسْلٍ إِذَا احْتَلَمَتْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا رَأَتِ الْمَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَغَطَّتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ ـ تَعْنِي وَجْهَهَا ـ وَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَتَحْتَلِمُ الْمَرْأَةُ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ تَرِبَتْ يَمِينُكِ فَبِمَ يُشْبِهُهَا وَلَدُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu salaamin, qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, qaala haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an zaynaba abnaai aummi salamaaa, 'an aummi salamaaa, qaalat jaa'at aummu sulaymin iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna alllaha laa yastahyiy mina alhaqqi, fahal 'alaa almaraaai min ghuslin iidhaa ahtalamat qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa raaati almaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏ faghattat aummu salamaaa ta'niy wajhahaa waqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi watahtalimu almaraaau qaala ‏"‏ na'am taribat yamiynuki fabima yushbihuhaa waladuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:Um-Sulaim came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "Verily, Allah is not shy of (telling you) the truth. Is it necessary for a woman to take a bath after she has a wet dream (nocturnal sexual discharge?) The Prophet replied, "Yes, if she notices a discharge." Um Salama, then covered her face and asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Does a woman get a discharge?" He replied, "Yes, let your right hand be in dust (An Arabic expression you say to a person when you contradict his statement meaning "you will not achieve goodness"), and that is why the son resembles his mother
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ شَجَرَةً لاَ يَسْقُطُ وَرَقُهَا، وَهِيَ مَثَلُ الْمُسْلِمِ، حَدِّثُونِي مَا هِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَوَقَعَ النَّاسُ فِي شَجَرِ الْبَادِيَةِ، وَوَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَّهَا النَّخْلَةُ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَخْبِرْنَا بِهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَحَدَّثْتُ أَبِي بِمَا وَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي فَقَالَ لأَنْ تَكُونَ قُلْتَهَا أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ أَنْ يَكُونَ لِي كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna mina alshhajari shajaraaan laa yasqutu waraquhaa, wahiya mathalu almuslimi, haddithuwniy maa hiya ‏"‏‏.‏ fawaqa'a alnnaasu fiy shajari albaadiyaai, wawaqa'a fiy nafsiy aannahaa alnnakhlaau‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi faastahyaytu‏.‏ faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, aakhbirnaa bihaa‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hiya alnnakhlaau ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi fahaddathtu aabiy bimaa waqa'a fiy nafsiy faqaala laan takuwna qultahaa aahabbu iilaaaa min aan yakuwna liy kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Amongst the trees there is a tree, the leaves of which do not fall and is like a Muslim, tell me the name of that tree." Everybody started thinking about the trees of the desert areas and I thought of the date-palm tree but felt shy (to answer). The others asked, "O Allah's Apostle! inform us of it." He replied, "It is the date-palm tree." I told my father what had come to my mind and on that he said, "Had you said it I would have preferred it to such and such a thing that I might possess
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُنْذِرٍ الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ رَجُلاً مَذَّاءً فَأَمَرْتُ الْمِقْدَادَ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ فِيهِ الْوُضُوءُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu daawuda, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an mundhirin althhawriyyi, 'an muhammadin abni alhanafiyyaai, 'an 'aliyyin, qaala kuntu rajulaan madhhaa'an faaamartu almiqdaada aan yasaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu faqaala ‏ "‏ fiyhi alwuduw'u ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:I used to get the emotional urethral discharge frequently so I requested Al-Miqdad to ask the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. Al-Miqdad asked him and he replied, "One has to perform ablution (after it)." (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ،‏.‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَامَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مِنْ أَيْنَ تَأْمُرُنَا أَنْ نُهِلَّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُهِلُّ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ، وَيُهِلُّ أَهْلُ الشَّأْمِ مِنَ الْجُحْفَةِ، وَيُهِلُّ أَهْلُ نَجْدٍ مِنْ قَرْنٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَيَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ وَيُهِلُّ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ مِنْ يَلَمْلَمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ لَمْ أَفْقَهْ هَذِهِ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu bnu sa'din, qaala haddathanaa naafi'un, mawlaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara bni alkhattaabi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, ‏.‏ aanna rajulaan, qaama fiy almasjidi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, min aayna taamurunaa aan nuhilla faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yuhillu aahlu almadiynaai min dhiy alhulayfaai, wayuhillu aahlu alshhaami mina aljuhfaai, wayuhillu aahlu najdin min qarnin ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala abnu 'umara wayaz'umuwna aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ wayuhillu aahlu alyamani min yalamlama ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana abnu 'umara yaquwlu lam aafqah hadhihi min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar said: "A man got up in the mosque and said: 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) At which place you order us that we should assume the Ihram?' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, 'The residents of Medina should assure the Ihram from Dhil-Hulaifa, the people of Syria from Al-Juhfa and the people of Najd from Qarn." Ibn `Umar further said, "The people consider that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had also said, 'The residents of Yemen should assume Ihram from Yalamlam.' " Ibn `Umar used to say, "I do not remember whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said the last statement or not
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَعَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَهُ مَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَلْبَسِ الْقَمِيصَ وَلاَ الْعِمَامَةَ وَلاَ السَّرَاوِيلَ وَلاَ الْبُرْنُسَ وَلاَ ثَوْبًا مَسَّهُ الْوَرْسُ أَوِ الزَّعْفَرَانُ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ النَّعْلَيْنِ فَلْيَلْبَسِ الْخُفَّيْنِ وَلْيَقْطَعْهُمَا حَتَّى يَكُونَا تَحْتَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ wa'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rajulaan saaalahu maa yalbasu almuhrimu faqaala ‏ "‏ laa yalbasi alqamiysa walaa al'imaamaaa walaa alssaraawiyla walaa alburnusa walaa thawbana massahu alwarsu aawi alzza'faraanu, faiin lam yajidi alnna'layni falyalbasi alkhuffayni walyaqta'humaa hattaa yakuwnaa tahta alka'bayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) : "What (kinds of clothes) should a Muhrim (a Muslim intending to perform `Umra or Hajj) wear? He replied, "He should not wear a shirt, a turban, trousers, a head cloak or garment scented with saffron or Wars (kinds of perfumes). And if he has no slippers, then he can use Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather) but the socks should be cut short so as to make the ankles bare." (See Hadith No. 615, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تُقْبَلُ صَلاَةُ مَنْ أَحْدَثَ حَتَّى يَتَوَضَّأَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ حَضْرَمَوْتَ مَا الْحَدَثُ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ فُسَاءٌ أَوْ ضُرَاطٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaala aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tuqbalu salaaau man aahdatha hattaa yatawaddaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala rajulun min hadramawta maa alhadathu yaa aabaa hurayraaa qaala fusaa'un aaw duraatun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The prayer of a person who does Hadath (passes urine, stool or wind) is not accepted till he performs the ablution." A person from Hadaramout asked Abu Huraira, "What is 'Hadath'?" Abu Huraira replied, " 'Hadath' means the passing of wind
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ نُعَيْمٍ الْمُجْمِرِ، قَالَ رَقِيتُ مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَتَوَضَّأَ فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أُمَّتِي يُدْعَوْنَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ غُرًّا مُحَجَّلِينَ مِنْ آثَارِ الْوُضُوءِ، فَمَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يُطِيلَ غُرَّتَهُ فَلْيَفْعَلْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an khaalidin, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy hilaalin, 'an nu'aymin almujmiri, qaala raqiytu ma'a aabiy hurayraaa 'alaa zahri almasjidi, fatawaddaaa faqaala iinniy sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna aummatiy yud'awna yawma alqiyaamaai ghurrana muhajjaliyna min athaari alwuduw'i, famani astataa'a minkum aan yutiyla ghurratahu falyaf'al ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nu`am Al-Mujmir:Once I went up the roof of the mosque, along with Abu Huraira. He performed ablution and said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "On the Day of Resurrection, my followers will be called "Al-Ghurr-ul- Muhajjalun" from the trace of ablution and whoever can increase the area of his radiance should do so (i.e. by performing ablution regularly)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَنَّهُ شَكَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ يَجِدُ الشَّىْءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْفَتِلْ ـ أَوْ لاَ يَنْصَرِفْ ـ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ صَوْتًا أَوْ يَجِدَ رِيحًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, wa'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi, aannahu shakaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alrrajulu alladhiy yukhayyalu iilayhi aannahu yajidu alshhaa'a fiy alssalaaai‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ laa yanfatil aaw laa yansarif hattaa yasma'a sawtana aaw yajida riyhana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim:My uncle asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about a person who imagined to have passed wind during the prayer. Allah's Apostle replied: "He should not leave his prayers unless he hears sound or smells something
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي كُرَيْبٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَامَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى ـ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ ـ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَصَلَّى‏.‏ ثُمَّ حَدَّثَنَا بِهِ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً بَعْدَ مَرَّةٍ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ لَيْلَةً، فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي بَعْضِ اللَّيْلِ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْ شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقٍ وُضُوءًا خَفِيفًا ـ يُخَفِّفُهُ عَمْرٌو وَيُقَلِّلُهُ ـ وَقَامَ يُصَلِّي فَتَوَضَّأْتُ نَحْوًا مِمَّا تَوَضَّأَ، ثُمَّ جِئْتُ فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ ـ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ سُفْيَانُ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ ـ فَحَوَّلَنِي فَجَعَلَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ، فَنَامَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ الْمُنَادِي فَآذَنَهُ بِالصَّلاَةِ، فَقَامَ مَعَهُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ، فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏ قُلْنَا لِعَمْرٍو إِنَّ نَاسًا يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَنَامُ عَيْنُهُ وَلاَ يَنَامُ قَلْبُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ يَقُولُ رُؤْيَا الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَحْىٌ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏إِنِّي أَرَى فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, qaala aakhbaraniy kuraybun, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm naama hattaa nafakha thumma sallaa warubbamaa qaala adtaja'a hattaa nafakha thumma qaama fasallaa‏.‏ thumma haddathanaa bihi sufyaanu marraaan ba'da marraain 'an 'amrinw 'an kuraybin 'ani abni 'abbaasin qaala bittu 'inda khaalatiy maymuwnaaa laylaaan, faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alllayli, falammaa kaana fiy ba'di alllayli qaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fatawaddaaa min shannin mu'allaqin wuduw'ana khafiyfana yukhaffifuhu 'amrunw wayuqalliluhu waqaama yusalliy fatawaddaatu nahwana mimmaa tawaddaaa, thumma jiitu faqumtu 'an yasaarihi warubbamaa qaala sufyaanu 'an shimaalihi fahawwalaniy faja'alaniy 'an yamiynihi, thumma sallaa maa shaa'a alllahu, thumma adtaja'a, fanaama hattaa nafakha, thumma aataahu almunaadiy faadhanahu bialssalaaai, faqaama ma'ahu iilaa alssalaaai, fasallaa walam yatawaddaa‏.‏ qulnaa li'amrinw iinna naasana yaquwluwna iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tanaamu 'aynuhu walaa yanaamu qalbuhu‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw sami'tu 'ubayda bna 'umayrin yaquwlu ruuyaa alaanbiyaa'i wahaun, thumma qaraaa ‏{‏iinniy aaraa fiy almanaami aanniy aadhbahuka‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Kuraib:Ibn `Abbas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) slept till he snored and then prayed (or probably lay till his breath sounds were heard and then got up and prayed)." Ibn `Abbas added: "I stayed overnight in the house of my aunt, Maimuna, the Prophet (ﷺ) slept for a part of the night, (See Fath-al-Bari page 249, Vol. 1), and late in the night, he got up and performed ablution from a hanging water skin, a light (perfect) ablution and stood up for the prayer. I, too, performed a similar ablution, then I went and stood on his left. He drew me to his right and prayed as much as Allah wished, and again lay and slept till his breath sounds were heard. Later on the Mu'adh-dhin (call maker for the prayer) came to him and informed him that it was time for Prayer. The Prophet (ﷺ) went with him for the prayer without performing a new ablution." (Sufyan said to `Amr that some people said, "The eyes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sleep but his heart does not sleep." `Amr replied, "I heard `Ubaid bin `Umar saying that the dreams of Prophets were Divine Inspiration, and then he recited the verse: 'I (Abraham) see in a dream, (O my son) that I offer you in sacrifice (to Allah)." (37.102) (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ دَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ عَرَفَةَ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِالشِّعْبِ نَزَلَ فَبَالَ، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وَلَمْ يُسْبِغِ الْوُضُوءَ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ الصَّلاَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الصَّلاَةُ أَمَامَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَكِبَ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ نَزَلَ فَتَوَضَّأَ، فَأَسْبَغَ الْوُضُوءَ، ثُمَّ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ، ثُمَّ أَنَاخَ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ بَعِيرَهُ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ، ثُمَّ أُقِيمَتِ الْعِشَاءُ فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, aannahu sami'ahu yaquwlu dafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min 'arafaaa hattaa iidhaa kaana bialshhi'bi nazala fabaala, thumma tawaddaaa walam yusbighi alwuduw'a‏.‏ faqultu alssalaaaa yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ alssalaaau aamaamaka ‏"‏‏.‏ farakiba, falammaa jaa'a almuzdalifaaa nazala fatawaddaaa, faaasbagha alwuduw'a, thumma auqiymati alssalaaau fasallaa almaghriba, thumma aanaakha kullu iinsaanin ba'iyrahu fiy manzilihi, thumma auqiymati al'ishaa'u fasallaa walam yusalli baynahumaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) proceeded from `Arafat till when he reached the mountain pass, he dismounted, urinated and then performed ablution but not a perfect one. I said to him, ("Is it the time for) the prayer, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" He said, "The (place of) prayer is ahead of you." He rode till when he reached Al-Muzdalifa, he dismounted and performed ablution and a perfect one, The (call for) Iqama was pronounced and he led the Maghrib prayer. Then everybody made his camel kneel down at its place. Then the Iqama was pronounced for the `Isha' prayer which the Prophet (ﷺ) led and no prayer was offered in between the two . prayers (`Isha' and Maghrib)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ الْخُزَاعِيُّ، مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ بِلاَلٍ ـ يَعْنِي سُلَيْمَانَ ـ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ تَوَضَّأَ فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ غَرْفَةً مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَمَضْمَضَ بِهَا وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ غَرْفَةً مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَجَعَلَ بِهَا هَكَذَا، أَضَافَهَا إِلَى يَدِهِ الأُخْرَى، فَغَسَلَ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ غَرْفَةً مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَغَسَلَ بِهَا يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ غَرْفَةً مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَغَسَلَ بِهَا يَدَهُ الْيُسْرَى، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ غَرْفَةً مِنْ مَاءٍ فَرَشَّ عَلَى رِجْلِهِ الْيُمْنَى حَتَّى غَسَلَهَا، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ غَرْفَةً أُخْرَى، فَغَسَلَ بِهَا رِجْلَهُ ـ يَعْنِي الْيُسْرَى ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ هَكَذَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw salamaaa alkhuzaa'iyyu, mansuwru bnu salamaaa qaala aakhbaranaa abnu bilaalin ya'niy sulaymaana 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aannahu tawaddaaa faghasala wajhahu, thumma aakhadha gharfaaan min maa'in, famadmada bihaa waastanshaqa, thumma aakhadha gharfaaan min maa'in, faja'ala bihaa hakadhaa, aadaafahaa iilaa yadihi alaukhraa, faghasala bihimaa wajhahu, thumma aakhadha gharfaaan min maa'in, faghasala bihaa yadahu alyumnaa, thumma aakhadha gharfaaan min maa'in, faghasala bihaa yadahu alyusraa, thumma masaha biraasihi, thumma aakhadha gharfaaan min maa'in farashha 'alaa rijlihi alyumnaa hattaa ghasalahaa, thumma aakhadha gharfaaan aukhraa, faghasala bihaa rijlahu ya'niy alyusraa thumma qaala hakadhaa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yatawaddaau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ata' bin Yasar:Ibn `Abbas performed ablution and washed his face (in the following way): He ladled out a handful of water, rinsed his mouth and washed his nose with it by putting in water and then blowing it out. He then, took another handful (of water) and did like this (gesturing) joining both hands, and washed his face, took another handful of water and washed his right forearm. He again took another handful of water and washed his left forearm, and passed wet hands over his head and took another handful of water and poured it over his right foot (up to his ankles) and washed it thoroughly and similarly took another handful of water and washed thoroughly his left foot (up to the ankles) and said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performing ablution in this way
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا أَتَى أَهْلَهُ قَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا‏.‏ فَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَلَدٌ، لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, yablughu bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ law aanna aahadakum iidhaa aataa aahlahu qaala bismi alllahi alllahumma jannibnaa alshhaytaana wajannibi alshhaytaana maa razaqtanaa‏.‏ faqudiya baynahumaa waladun, lam yadurrahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you on having sexual relations with his wife said (and he must say it before starting) 'In the name of Allah. O Allah! Protect us from Satan and also protect what you bestow upon us (i.e. the coming offspring) from Satan,' and if it is destined that they should have a child then, Satan will never be able to harm that offspring
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا دَخَلَ الْخَلاَءَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ ابْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ غُنْدَرٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ إِذَا أَتَى الْخَلاَءَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُوسَى عَنْ حَمَّادٍ إِذَا دَخَلَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa dakhala alkhalaa'a qaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika mina alkhubuthi waalkhabaaiithi ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu abnu 'ar'araaa 'an shu'baaa‏.‏ waqaala ghundarun 'an shu'baaa iidhaa aataa alkhalaa'a‏.‏ waqaala muwsaa 'an hammaadin iidhaa dakhala‏.‏ waqaala sa'iydu bnu zaydin haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi iidhaa aaraada aan yadkhula‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, he used to say, "Allah-umma inni a`udhu bika minal khubuthi wal khaba'ith i.e. O Allah, I seek Refuge with You from all offensive and wicked things (evil deeds and evil spirits)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ الْخَلاَءَ، فَوَضَعْتُ لَهُ وَضُوءًا قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ وَضَعَ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأُخْبِرَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ فَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa haashimu bnu alqaasimi, qaala haddathanaa warqaa'u, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy yaziyda, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala alkhalaa'a, fawada'tu lahu waduw'ana qaala ‏"‏ man wada'a hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faaukhbira faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma faqqihhu fiy alddiyni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) entered a lavatory and I placed water for his ablution. He asked, "Who placed it?" He was informed accordingly and so he said, "O Allah! Make him (Ibn `Abbas) a learned scholar in religion (Islam)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَتَى أَحَدُكُمُ الْغَائِطَ فَلاَ يَسْتَقْبِلِ الْقِبْلَةَ وَلاَ يُوَلِّهَا ظَهْرَهُ، شَرِّقُوا أَوْ غَرِّبُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, qaala haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda alllaythiyyi, 'an aabiy aayyuwba alaansaariyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aataa aahadukumu alghaaiita falaa yastaqbili alqiblaaa walaa yuwallihaa zahrahu, sharriquwa aaw gharribuwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you goes to an open space for answering the call of nature he should neither face nor turn his back towards the Qibla; he should either face the east or the west
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، وَاسِعِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ إِنَّ نَاسًا يَقُولُونَ إِذَا قَعَدْتَ عَلَى حَاجَتِكَ، فَلاَ تَسْتَقْبِلِ الْقِبْلَةَ وَلاَ بَيْتَ الْمَقْدِسِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ لَقَدِ ارْتَقَيْتُ يَوْمًا عَلَى ظَهْرِ بَيْتٍ لَنَا، فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى لَبِنَتَيْنِ مُسْتَقْبِلاً بَيْتَ الْمَقْدِسِ لِحَاجَتِهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لَعَلَّكَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى أَوْرَاكِهِمْ، فَقُلْتُ لاَ أَدْرِي وَاللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ مَالِكٌ يَعْنِي الَّذِي يُصَلِّي وَلاَ يَرْتَفِعُ عَنِ الأَرْضِ، يَسْجُدُ وَهُوَ لاَصِقٌ بِالأَرْضِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an muhamaadi bni yahyaa bni habaaana, 'an 'amiihi, waasi'i bni habaaana, 'an 'abdi allaahi bni 'umara, aanaahu kaana yaquwlu iinaa naasana yaquwluwna iidhaa qa'adta 'alaa haajatika, falaa tastaqbili alqiblaaa walaa bayta almaqdisi‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu allaahi bnu 'umara laqadi artaqaytu yawmana 'alaa zahri baytin lanaa, faraaaytu rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa labinatayni mustaqbilaan bayta almaqdisi lihaajatihi‏.‏ waqaala la'alaaka mina alaadhiyna yusaluuwna 'alaa aawraakihim, faqultu laa aadriy waallaahi‏.‏ qaala maalikun ya'niy alaadhiy yusaliiy walaa yartafi'u 'ani alaardi, yasjudu wahuwa laasiqun bialaardi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:People say, "Whenever you sit for answering the call of nature, you should not face the Qibla or Baitul-Maqdis (Jerusalem)." I told them, "Once I went up the roof of our house and I saw Allah's Apostle answering the call of nature while sitting on two bricks facing Baitul-Maqdis (Jerusalem) (but there was a screen covering him. ' (Fath-al-Bari, Page 258, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أَزْوَاجَ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم كُنَّ يَخْرُجْنَ بِاللَّيْلِ إِذَا تَبَرَّزْنَ إِلَى الْمَنَاصِعِ ـ وَهُوَ صَعِيدٌ أَفْيَحُ ـ فَكَانَ عُمَرُ يَقُولُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْجُبْ نِسَاءَكَ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْعَلُ، فَخَرَجَتْ سَوْدَةُ بِنْتُ زَمْعَةَ زَوْجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً مِنَ اللَّيَالِي عِشَاءً، وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَةً طَوِيلَةً، فَنَادَاهَا عُمَرُ أَلاَ قَدْ عَرَفْنَاكِ يَا سَوْدَةُ‏.‏ حِرْصًا عَلَى أَنْ يَنْزِلَ الْحِجَابُ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ آيَةَ الْحِجَابِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna aazwaaja alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm kunna yakhrujna bialllayli iidhaa tabarrazna iilaa almanaasi'i wahuwa sa'iydun aafyahu fakaana 'umaru yaquwlu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ahjub nisaa'aka‏.‏ falam yakun rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaf'alu, fakharajat sawdaau bintu zam'aaa zawju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm laylaaan mina alllayaaliy 'ishaa'an, wakaanati amraaaaan tawiylaaan, fanaadaahaa 'umaru aalaa qad 'arafnaaki yaa sawdaau‏.‏ hirsana 'alaa aan yanzila alhijaabu, faaanzala alllahu ayaaa alhijaabi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to go to Al-Manasi, a vast open place (near Baqi` at Medina) to answer the call of nature at night. `Umar used to say to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Let your wives be veiled," but Allah's Apostle did not do so. One night Sauda bint Zam`a the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) went out at `Isha' time and she was a tall lady. `Umar addressed her and said, "I have recognized you, O Sauda." He said so, as he desired eagerly that the verses of Al-Hijab (the observing of veils by the Muslim women) may be revealed. So Allah revealed the verses of "Al-Hijab" (A complete body cover excluding the eyes)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ قَدْ أُذِنَ أَنْ تَخْرُجْنَ فِي حَاجَتِكُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ هِشَامٌ يَعْنِي الْبَرَازَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, qaala haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ qad audhina aan takhrujna fiy haajatikunna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala hishaamun ya'niy albaraaza‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to his wives, "You are allowed to go out to answer the call of nature
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ وَاسِعِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ ارْتَقَيْتُ فَوْقَ ظَهْرِ بَيْتِ حَفْصَةَ لِبَعْضِ حَاجَتِي، فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْضِي حَاجَتَهُ مُسْتَدْبِرَ الْقِبْلَةِ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الشَّأْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, qaala haddathanaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an muhammadi bni yahyaa bni habbaana, 'an waasi'i bni habbaana, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala artaqaytu fawqa zahri bayti hafsaaa liba'di haajatiy, faraaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqdiy haajatahu mustadbira alqiblaai mustaqbila alshhaami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I went up to the roof of Hafsa's house for some job and I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) answering the call of nature facing Sham (Syria, Jordan, Palestine and Lebanon regarded as one country) with his back towards the Qibla. (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، أَنَّ عَمَّهُ، وَاسِعَ بْنَ حَبَّانَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَهَرْتُ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ عَلَى ظَهْرِ بَيْتِنَا، فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَاعِدًا عَلَى لَبِنَتَيْنِ مُسْتَقْبِلَ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala hadaathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, qaala aakhbaranaa yahyaa, 'an muhamaadi bni yahyaa bni habaaana, aanaa 'amaahu, waasi'a bna habaaana, aakhbarahu aanaa 'abda allaahi bna 'umara aakhbarahu qaala laqad zahartu dhaata yawmin 'alaa zahri baytinaa, faraaaytu rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaa'idana 'alaa labinatayni mustaqbila bayti almaqdisi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Once I went up the roof of our house and saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) answering the call of nature while sitting over two bricks facing Baitul-Maqdis (Jerusalem). (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاذٍ ـ وَاسْمُهُ عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا خَرَجَ لِحَاجَتِهِ أَجِيءُ أَنَا وَغُلاَمٌ مَعَنَا إِدَاوَةٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ‏.‏ يَعْنِي يَسْتَنْجِي بِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, hishaamu bnu 'abdi almaliki qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy mu'aadhin waasmuhu 'ataa'u bnu aabiy maymuwnaaa qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa kharaja lihaajatihi aajiy'u aanaa waghulaamun ma'anaa iidaawaaun min maa'in‏.‏ ya'niy yastanjiy bihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, I along with another boy used to accompany him with a tumbler full of water. (Hisham commented, "So that he might wash his private parts with it)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاذٍ ـ هُوَ عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا خَرَجَ لِحَاجَتِهِ تَبِعْتُهُ أَنَا وَغُلاَمٌ مِنَّا مَعَنَا إِدَاوَةٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy mu'aadhin huwa 'ataa'u bnu aabiy maymuwnaaa qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa kharaja lihaajatihi tabi'tuhu aanaa waghulaamun minnaa ma'anaa iidaawaaun min maa'in‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, I along with another boy from us used to go behind him with a tumbler full of water
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْخُلُ الْخَلاَءَ، فَأَحْمِلُ أَنَا وَغُلاَمٌ إِدَاوَةً مِنْ مَاءٍ، وَعَنَزَةً، يَسْتَنْجِي بِالْمَاءِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ النَّضْرُ وَشَاذَانُ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ‏.‏ الْعَنَزَةُ عَصًا عَلَيْهِ زُجٌّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'ataa'i bni aabiy maymuwnaaa, sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadkhulu alkhalaa'a, faaahmilu aanaa waghulaamun iidaawaaan min maa'in, wa'anazaaan, yastanjiy bialmaa'i‏.‏ taaba'ahu alnnadru washaadhaanu 'an shu'baaa‏.‏ al'anazaau 'asana 'alayhi zujjun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, I along with another boy used to carry a tumbler full of water (for cleaning the private parts) and a short spear (or stick)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ ـ هُوَ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ ـ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا شَرِبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلاَ يَتَنَفَّسْ فِي الإِنَاءِ، وَإِذَا أَتَى الْخَلاَءَ فَلاَ يَمَسَّ ذَكَرَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ، وَلاَ يَتَمَسَّحْ بِيَمِينِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu fadaalaaa, qaala haddathanaa hishaamun huwa alddastawaaiiyyu 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa shariba aahadukum falaa yatanaffas fiy aliinaa'i, waiidhaa aataa alkhalaa'a falaa yamassa dhakarahu biyamiynihi, walaa yatamassah biyamiynihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qatada:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whenever anyone of you drinks water, he should not breathe in the drinking utensil, and whenever anyone of you goes to a lavatory, he should neither touch his penis nor clean his private parts with his right hand
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا بَالَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلاَ يَأْخُذَنَّ ذَكَرَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ، وَلاَ يَسْتَنْجِي بِيَمِينِهِ، وَلاَ يَتَنَفَّسْ فِي الإِنَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa baala aahadukum falaa yaakhudhanna dhakarahu biyamiynihi, walaa yastanjiy biyamiynihi, walaa yatanaffas fiy aliinaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qatada:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whenever anyone of you makes water he should not hold his penis or clean his private parts with his right hand. (And while drinking) one should not breathe in the drinking utensil
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَكِّيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْمَكِّيُّ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ اتَّبَعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَخَرَجَ لِحَاجَتِهِ، فَكَانَ لاَ يَلْتَفِتُ فَدَنَوْتُ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ ابْغِنِي أَحْجَارًا أَسْتَنْفِضْ بِهَا ـ أَوْ نَحْوَهُ ـ وَلاَ تَأْتِنِي بِعَظْمٍ وَلاَ رَوْثٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِأَحْجَارٍ بِطَرَفِ ثِيَابِي فَوَضَعْتُهَا إِلَى جَنْبِهِ وَأَعْرَضْتُ عَنْهُ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى أَتْبَعَهُ بِهِنَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu muhammadin almakkiyyu, qaala haddathanaa 'amruw bnu yahyaa bni sa'iydi bni 'amrinw almakkiyyu, 'an jaddihi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala attaba'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wakharaja lihaajatihi, fakaana laa yaltafitu fadanawtu minhu faqaala ‏ "‏ abghiniy aahjaarana aastanfid bihaa aaw nahwahu walaa taatiniy bi'azmin walaa rawthin ‏"‏‏.‏ faaataytuhu biaahjaarin bitarafi thiyaabiy fawada'tuhaa iilaa janbihi waaa'radtu 'anhu, falammaa qadaa aatba'ahu bihinna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I followed the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was going out to answer the call of nature. He used not to look this way or that. So, when I approached near him he said to me, "Fetch for me some stones for ' cleaning the privates parts (or said something similar), and do not bring a bone or a piece of dung." So I brought the stones in the corner of my garment and placed them by his side and I then went away from him. When he finished (from answering the call of nature) he used, them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ لَيْسَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ذَكَرَهُ وَلَكِنْ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الأَسْوَدِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ أَتَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْغَائِطَ، فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ آتِيَهُ بِثَلاَثَةِ أَحْجَارٍ، فَوَجَدْتُ حَجَرَيْنِ، وَالْتَمَسْتُ الثَّالِثَ فَلَمْ أَجِدْهُ، فَأَخَذْتُ رَوْثَةً، فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِهَا، فَأَخَذَ الْحَجَرَيْنِ وَأَلْقَى الرَّوْثَةَ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هَذَا رِكْسٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa zuhayrun, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala laysa aabuw 'ubaydaaa dhakarahu walakin 'abdu alrrahmani bnu alaaswadi 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi, yaquwlu aataa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alghaaiita, faaamaraniy aan atiyahu bithalaathaai aahjaarin, fawajadtu hajarayni, waaltamastu althhaalitha falam aajidhu, faaakhadhtu rawthaaan, faaataytuhu bihaa, faaakhadha alhajarayni waaalqaa alrrawthaaa waqaala ‏ "‏ hadhaa riksun ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala iibraahiymu bnu yuwsufa 'an aabiyhi 'an aabiy iishaaqa haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature and asked me to bring three stones. I found two stones and searched for the third but could not find it. So I took a dried piece of dung and brought it to him. He took the two stones and threw away the dung and said, "This is a filthy thing
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ تَوَضَّأَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّةً مَرَّةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala tawaddaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm marraaan marraaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution by washing the body parts only once
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَوَضَّأَ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'iysaa, qaala haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa fulayhu bnu sulaymaana, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakri bni 'amriw bni hazmin, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni zaydin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm tawaddaaa marratayni marratayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) performed ablution by washing the body parts twice
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأُوَيْسِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ عَطَاءَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ حُمْرَانَ مَوْلَى عُثْمَانَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، رَأَى عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ دَعَا بِإِنَاءٍ، فَأَفْرَغَ عَلَى كَفَّيْهِ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ فَغَسَلَهُمَا، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَمِينَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ فَمَضْمَضَ، وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثًا، وَيَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ نَحْوَ وُضُوئِي هَذَا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، لاَ يُحَدِّثُ فِيهِمَا نَفْسَهُ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi alauwaysiyyu, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna 'ataa'a bna yaziyda, aakhbarahu aanna humraana mawlaa 'uthmaana aakhbarahu aannahu, raaaa 'uthmaana bna 'affaana da'aa biiinaa'in, faaafragha 'alaa kaffayhi thalaatha miraarin faghasalahumaa, thumma aadkhala yamiynahu fiy aliinaa'i famadmada, waastanshaqa, thumma ghasala wajhahu thalaathana, wayadayhi iilaa almirfaqayni thalaatha miraarin, thumma masaha biraasihi, thumma ghasala rijlayhi thalaatha miraarin iilaa alka'bayni, thumma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man tawaddaaa nahwa wuduwiiy hadhaa, thumma sallaa rak'atayni, laa yuhaddithu fiyhimaa nafsahu, ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humran: (the slave of 'Uthman) I saw 'Uthman bin 'Affan asking for a tumbler of water (and when it was brought) he poured water over his hands and washed them thrice and then put his right hand in the water container and rinsed his mouth, washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out. then he washed his face and forearms up to the elbows thrice, passed his wet hands over his head and washed his feet up to the ankles thrice. Then he said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said 'If anyone performs ablution like that of mine and offers a two-rak'at prayer during which he does not think of anything else (not related to the present prayer) then his past sins will be forgiven
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَعَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ قَالَ صَالِحُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَلَكِنْ عُرْوَةُ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ حُمْرَانَ،، فَلَمَّا تَوَضَّأَ عُثْمَانُ قَالَ أَلاَ أُحَدِّثُكُمْ حَدِيثًا لَوْلاَ آيَةٌ مَا حَدَّثْتُكُمُوهُ، سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَتَوَضَّأُ رَجُلٌ فَيُحْسِنُ وُضُوءَهُ، وَيُصَلِّي الصَّلاَةَ إِلاَّ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ الآيَةُ ‏{‏إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْتُمُونَ مَا أَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'an iibraahiyma, qaala qaala saalihu bnu kaysaana qaala abnu shihaabin walakin 'urwaau yuhaddithu 'an humraana, , falammaa tawaddaaa 'uthmaanu qaala aalaa auhaddithukum hadiythana lawlaa ayaaun maa haddathtukumuwhu, sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa yatawaddaau rajulun fayuhsinu wuduw'ahu, wayusalliy alssalaaaa iilaaa ghufira lahu maa baynahu wabayna alssalaaai hattaa yusalliyahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'urwaau alayaau ‏{‏iinna alladhiyna yaktumuwna maa aanzalnaa mina albayyinaati‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: After performing the ablution 'Uthman said, "I am going to tell you a Hadith which I would not have told you, had I not been compelled by a certain Holy Verse (the sub narrator 'Urwa said:This verse is: "Verily, those who conceal the clear signs and the guidance which we have sent down...)" (2:159). I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'If a man performs ablution perfectly and then offers the compulsory congregational prayer, Allah will forgive his sins committed between that (prayer) and the (next) prayer till he offers it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَلْيَسْتَنْثِرْ، وَمَنِ اسْتَجْمَرَ فَلْيُوتِرْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw iidriysa, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ man tawaddaaa falyastanthir, wamani astajmara falyuwtir ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever performs ablution should clean his nose with water by putting the water in it and then blowing it out, and whoever cleans his private parts with stones should do it with odd number of stones
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَجْعَلْ فِي أَنْفِهِ ثُمَّ لِيَنْثُرْ، وَمَنِ اسْتَجْمَرَ فَلْيُوتِرْ، وَإِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ فَلْيَغْسِلْ يَدَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْخِلَهَا فِي وَضُوئِهِ، فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لاَ يَدْرِي أَيْنَ بَاتَتْ يَدُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa tawaddaaa aahadukum falyaj'al fiy aanfihi thumma liyanthur, wamani astajmara falyuwtir, waiidhaa astayqaza aahadukum min nawmihi falyaghsil yadahu qabla aan yudkhilahaa fiy waduwiihi, faiinna aahadakum laa yadriy aayna baatat yaduhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you performs ablution he should put water in his nose and then blow it out and whoever cleans his private parts with stones should do so with odd numbers. And whoever wakes up from his sleep should wash his hands before putting them in the water for ablution, because nobody knows where his hands were during sleep
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ تَخَلَّفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنَّا فِي سَفْرَةٍ سَافَرْنَاهَا، فَأَدْرَكَنَا وَقَدْ أَرْهَقْنَا الْعَصْرَ، فَجَعَلْنَا نَتَوَضَّأُ وَنَمْسَحُ عَلَى أَرْجُلِنَا، فَنَادَى بِأَعْلَى صَوْتِهِ ‏ "‏ وَيْلٌ لِلأَعْقَابِ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, qaala haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an yuwsufa bni maahaka, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala takhallafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'annaa fiy safraain saafarnaahaa, faaadrakanaa waqad aarhaqnaa al'asra, faja'alnaa natawaddaau wanamsahu 'alaa aarjulinaa, fanaadaa biaa'laa sawtihi ‏ "‏ waylun lilaa'qaabi mina alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ marratayni aaw thalaathana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:The Prophet (ﷺ) remained behind us on a journey. He joined us while we were performing ablution for the `Asr prayer which was overdue and we were just passing wet hands over our feet (not washing them thoroughly) so he addressed us in a loud voice saying twice , "Save your heels from the fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ حُمْرَانَ، مَوْلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ أَنَّهُ رَأَى عُثْمَانَ دَعَا بِوَضُوءٍ، فَأَفْرَغَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ مِنْ إِنَائِهِ، فَغَسَلَهُمَا ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَمِينَهُ فِي الْوَضُوءِ، ثُمَّ تَمَضْمَضَ، وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، وَاسْتَنْثَرَ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثًا وَيَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ كُلَّ رِجْلٍ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ نَحْوَ وُضُوئِي هَذَا وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ نَحْوَ وُضُوئِي هَذَا ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، لاَ يُحَدِّثُ فِيهِمَا نَفْسَهُ، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
