verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'u bnu yaziyda, 'an humraana, mawlaa 'uthmaana bni 'affaana aannahu raaaa 'uthmaana da'aa biwaduw'in, faaafragha 'alaa yadayhi min iinaaiihi, faghasalahumaa thalaatha marraatin, thumma aadkhala yamiynahu fiy alwaduw'i, thumma tamadmada, waastanshaqa, waastanthara, thumma ghasala wajhahu thalaathana wayadayhi iilaa almirfaqayni thalaathana, thumma masaha biraasihi, thumma ghasala kulla rijlin thalaathana, thumma qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yatawaddaau nahwa wuduwiiy hadhaa waqaala ‏ "‏ man tawaddaaa nahwa wuduwiiy hadhaa thumma sallaa rak'atayni, laa yuhaddithu fiyhimaa nafsahu, ghafara alllahu lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humran:(the freed slave of `Uthman bin `Affan) I saw `Uthman bin `Affan asking (for a tumbler of water) to perform ablution (and when it was brought) he poured water from it over his hands and washed them thrice and then put his right hand in the water container and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out. Then he washed his face thrice and (then) forearms up to the elbows thrice, then passed his wet hands over his head and then washed each foot thrice. After that `Uthman said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) performing ablution like this of mine, and he said, 'If anyone performs ablution like that of mine and offers a two-rak`at prayer during which he does not think of anything else (not related to the present prayer) then his past sins will be forgiven
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ وَكَانَ يَمُرُّ بِنَا وَالنَّاسُ يَتَوَضَّئُونَ مِنَ الْمِطْهَرَةِ ـ قَالَ أَسْبِغُوا الْوُضُوءَ فَإِنَّ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَيْلٌ لِلأَعْقَابِ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ziyaadin, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa wakaana yamurru binaa waalnnaasu yatawaddaiuwna mina almitharaai qaala aasbighuwa alwuduw'a faiinna aabaa alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ waylun lilaa'qaabi mina alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad Ibn Ziyad:I heard Abu Huraira saying as he passed by us while the people were performing ablution from a utensil containing water, "Perform ablution perfectly and thoroughly for Abul-Qasim (the Prophet) said, 'Save your heels from the Hell-fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، رَأَيْتُكَ تَصْنَعُ أَرْبَعًا لَمْ أَرَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِكَ يَصْنَعُهَا‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَا هِيَ يَا ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ رَأَيْتُكَ لاَ تَمَسُّ مِنَ الأَرْكَانِ إِلاَّ الْيَمَانِيَيْنِ، وَرَأَيْتُكَ تَلْبَسُ النِّعَالَ السِّبْتِيَّةَ، وَرَأَيْتُكَ تَصْبُغُ بِالصُّفْرَةِ، وَرَأَيْتُكَ إِذَا كُنْتَ بِمَكَّةَ أَهَلَّ النَّاسُ إِذَا رَأَوُا الْهِلاَلَ وَلَمْ تُهِلَّ أَنْتَ حَتَّى كَانَ يَوْمُ التَّرْوِيَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَمَّا الأَرْكَانُ فَإِنِّي لَمْ أَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمَسُّ إِلاَّ الْيَمَانِيَيْنِ، وَأَمَّا النِّعَالُ السِّبْتِيَّةُ فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَلْبَسُ النَّعْلَ الَّتِي لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَعَرٌ وَيَتَوَضَّأُ فِيهَا، فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَلْبَسَهَا، وَأَمَّا الصُّفْرَةُ فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْبُغُ بِهَا، فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَصْبُغَ بِهَا، وَأَمَّا الإِهْلاَلُ فَإِنِّي لَمْ أَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُهِلُّ حَتَّى تَنْبَعِثَ بِهِ رَاحِلَتُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an 'ubaydi bni jurayjin, aannahu qaala li'abdi alllahi bni 'umara yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani, raaaytuka tasna'u aarba'ana lam aara aahadana min aashaabika yasna'uhaa‏.‏ qaala wamaa hiya yaa abna jurayjin qaala raaaytuka laa tamassu mina alaarkaani iilaaa alyamaaniyayni, waraaaytuka talbasu alnni'aala alssibtiyyaaa, waraaaytuka tasbughu bialssufraai, waraaaytuka iidhaa kunta bimakkaaa aahalla alnnaasu iidhaa raaawua alhilaala walam tuhilla aanta hattaa kaana yawmu alttarwiyaai‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi aammaa alaarkaanu faiinniy lam aara rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yamassu iilaaa alyamaaniyayni, waaammaa alnni'aalu alssibtiyyaau faiinniy raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yalbasu alnna'la allatiy laysa fiyhaa sha'arun wayatawaddaau fiyhaa, faaanaa auhibbu aan aalbasahaa, waaammaa alssufraau faiinniy raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasbughu bihaa, faaanaa auhibbu aan aasbugha bihaa, waaammaa aliihlaalu faiinniy lam aara rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhillu hattaa tanba'itha bihi raahilatuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ubaid Ibn Juraij:I asked `Abdullah bin `Umar, "O Abu `Abdur-Rahman! I saw you doing four things which I never saw being done by anyone of you companions?" `Abdullah bin `Umar said, "What are those, O Ibn Juraij?" I said, "I never saw you touching any corner of the Ka`ba except these (two) facing south (Yemen) and I saw you wearing shoes made of tanned leather and dyeing your hair with Hinna (a kind of red dye). I also noticed that whenever you were in Mecca, the people assume Ihram on seeing the new moon crescent (1st of Dhul-Hijja) while you did not assume the Ihlal (Ihram) -(Ihram is also called Ihlal which means 'Loud calling' because a Muhrim has to recite Talbiya aloud when assuming the state of Ihram) - till the 8th of Dhul-Hijja (Day of Tarwiya). `Abdullah replied, "Regarding the corners of Ka`ba, I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) touching except those facing south (Yemen) and regarding the tanned leather shoes, no doubt I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wearing non-hairy shoes and he used to perform ablution while wearing the shoes (i.e. wash his feet and then put on the shoes). So I love to wear similar shoes. And about the dyeing of hair with Hinna; no doubt I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dyeing his hair with it and that is why I like to dye (my hair with it). Regarding Ihlal, I did not see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assuming Ihlal till he set out for Hajj (on the 8th of Dhul-Hijja)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَهُنَّ فِي غُسْلِ ابْنَتِهِ ‏ "‏ ابْدَأْنَ بِمَيَامِنِهَا وَمَوَاضِعِ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an hafsaaa binti siyriyna, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lahunna fiy ghusli abnatihi ‏ "‏ abdaana bimayaaminihaa wamawaadi'i alwuduw'i minhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um-`Atiya:That the Prophet (ﷺ) at the time of washing his deceased daughter had said to them, "Start from the right side beginning with those parts which are washed in ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَشْعَثُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعْجِبُهُ التَّيَمُّنُ فِي تَنَعُّلِهِ وَتَرَجُّلِهِ وَطُهُورِهِ وَفِي شَأْنِهِ كُلِّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy aash'athu bnu sulaymin, qaala sami'tu aabiy, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yu'jibuhu alttayammunu fiy tana''ulihi watarajjulihi watuhuwrihi wafiy shaanihi kullihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to like to start from the right side on wearing shoes, combing his hair and cleaning or washing himself and on doing anything else
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَانَتْ صَلاَةُ الْعَصْرِ، فَالْتَمَسَ النَّاسُ الْوَضُوءَ فَلَمْ يَجِدُوهُ، فَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِوَضُوءٍ، فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ذَلِكَ الإِنَاءِ يَدَهُ، وَأَمَرَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّئُوا مِنْهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُ الْمَاءَ يَنْبُعُ مِنْ تَحْتِ أَصَابِعِهِ حَتَّى تَوَضَّئُوا مِنْ عِنْدِ آخِرِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaanat salaaau al'asri, faaltamasa alnnaasu alwaduw'a falam yajiduwhu, faautiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biwaduw'in, fawada'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy dhalika aliinaa'i yadahu, waaamara alnnaasa aan yatawaddaiuwa minhu‏.‏ qaala faraaaytu almaa'a yanbu'u min tahti aasaabi'ihi hattaa tawaddaiuwa min 'indi akhirihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when the `Asr prayer was due and the people searched for water to perform ablution but they could not find it. Later on (a pot full of) water for ablution was brought to Allah's Apostle. He put his hand in that pot and ordered the people to perform ablution from it. I saw the water springing out from underneath his fingers till all of them performed the ablution (it was one of the miracles of the Prophet)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَبِيدَةَ عِنْدَنَا مِنْ شَعَرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَصَبْنَاهُ مِنْ قِبَلِ أَنَسٍ، أَوْ مِنْ قِبَلِ أَهْلِ أَنَسٍ فَقَالَ لأَنْ تَكُونَ عِنْدِي شَعَرَةٌ مِنْهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an 'aasimin, 'ani abni siyriyna, qaala qultu li'abiydaaa 'indanaa min sha'ari alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aasabnaahu min qibali aanasin, aaw min qibali aahli aanasin faqaala laan takuwna 'indiy sha'araaun minhu aahabbu iilaaaa mina alddunyaa wamaa fiyhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Seereen:I said to `Abida, "I have some of the hair of the Prophet (ﷺ) which I got from Anas or from his family." `Abida replied. "No doubt if I had a single hair of that it would have been dearer to me than the whole world and whatever is in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا حَلَقَ رَأْسَهُ كَانَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَخَذَ مِنْ شَعَرِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, qaala aakhbaranaa sa'iydu bnu sulaymaana, qaala haddathanaa 'abbaadun, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'ani abni siyriyna, 'an aanasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lammaa halaqa raasahu kaana aabuw talhaaa aawwala man aakhadha min sha'arihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got his head shaved, Abu- Talha was the first to take some of his hair
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا شَرِبَ الْكَلْبُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيَغْسِلْهُ سَبْعًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, 'an maalikin, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa shariba alkalbu fiy iinaa'i aahadikum falyaghsilhu sab'ana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If a dog drinks from the utensil of anyone of you it is essential to wash it seven times
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً رَأَى كَلْبًا يَأْكُلُ الثَّرَى مِنَ الْعَطَشِ، فَأَخَذَ الرَّجُلُ خُفَّهُ فَجَعَلَ يَغْرِفُ لَهُ بِهِ حَتَّى أَرْوَاهُ، فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ فَأَدْخَلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, sami'tu aabiy, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanna rajulaan raaaa kalbana yaakulu althharaa mina al'atashi, faaakhadha alrrajulu khuffahu faja'ala yaghrifu lahu bihi hattaa aarwaahu, fashakara alllahu lahu faaadkhalahu aljannaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man saw a dog eating mud from (the severity of) thirst. So, that man took a shoe (and filled it) with water and kept on pouring the water for the dog till it quenched its thirst. So Allah approved of his deed and made him to enter Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَتِ الْكِلاَبُ تَبُولُ وَتُقْبِلُ وَتُدْبِرُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فِي زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَكُونُوا يَرُشُّونَ شَيْئًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala aahmadu bnu shabiybin haddathanaa aabiy, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala haddathaniy hamzaau bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaanati alkilaabu tabuwlu watuqbilu watudbiru fiy almasjidi fiy zamaani rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falam yakuwnuwa yarushhuwna shayiana min dhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: And narrated Hamza bin 'Abdullah:My father said. "During the lifetime of Allah's Apostle, the dogs used to urinate, and pass through the mosques (come and go), nevertheless they never used to sprinkle water on it (urine of the dog)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَرْسَلْتَ كَلْبَكَ الْمُعَلَّمَ فَقَتَلَ فَكُلْ، وَإِذَا أَكَلَ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ، فَإِنَّمَا أَمْسَكَهُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ أُرْسِلُ كَلْبِي فَأَجِدُ مَعَهُ كَلْبًا آخَرَ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ، فَإِنَّمَا سَمَّيْتَ عَلَى كَلْبِكَ، وَلَمْ تُسَمِّ عَلَى كَلْبٍ آخَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani abni aabiy alssafari, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, qaala saaaltu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa aarsalta kalbaka almu'allama faqatala fakul, waiidhaa aakala falaa taakul, faiinnamaa aamsakahu 'alaa nafsihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu aursilu kalbiy faaajidu ma'ahu kalbana akhara qaala ‏"‏ falaa taakul, faiinnamaa sammayta 'alaa kalbika, walam tusammi 'alaa kalbin akhara ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:I asked the Prophet (about the hunting dogs) and he replied, "If you let loose (with Allah's name) your tamed dog after a game and it hunts it, you may eat it, but if the dog eats of (that game) then do not eat it because the dog has hunted it for itself." I further said, "Sometimes I send my dog for hunting and find another dog with it. He said, "Do not eat the game for you have mentioned Allah's name only on sending your dog and not the other dog
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَزَالُ الْعَبْدُ فِي صَلاَةٍ مَا كَانَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَنْتَظِرُ الصَّلاَةَ، مَا لَمْ يُحْدِثْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ أَعْجَمِيٌّ مَا الْحَدَثُ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ الصَّوْتُ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الضَّرْطَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yazaalu al'abdu fiy salaaain maa kaana fiy almasjidi yantaziru alssalaaaa, maa lam yuhdith ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rajulun aa'jamiyyun maa alhadathu yaa aabaa hurayraaa qaala alssawtu‏.‏ ya'niy alddartaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A person is considered in prayer as long as he is waiting for the prayer in the mosque as long as he does not do Hadath." A non-Arab man asked, "O Abu Huraira! What is Hadath?" I replied, "It is the passing of wind (from the anus) (that is one of the types of Hadath)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْصَرِفْ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ صَوْتًا أَوْ يَجِدَ رِيحًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yansarif hattaa yasma'a sawtana aaw yajida riyhana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim:My uncle said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "One should not leave his prayer unless he hears sound or smells something
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُنْذِرٍ أَبِي يَعْلَى الثَّوْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ كُنْتُ رَجُلاً مَذَّاءً، فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرْتُ الْمِقْدَادَ بْنَ الأَسْوَدِ فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ فِيهِ الْوُضُوءُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an mundhirin aabiy ya'laa althhawriyyi, 'an muhammadin abni alhanafiyyaai, qaala qaala 'aliyyun kuntu rajulaan madhhaa'an, faastahyaytu aan aasaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaamartu almiqdaada bna alaaswadi fasaaalahu faqaala ‏ "‏ fiyhi alwuduw'u ‏"‏‏.‏ warawaahu shu'baau 'ani alaa'mashi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:I used to get emotional urethral discharges frequently and felt shy to ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. So I requested Al-Miqdad bin Al-Aswad to ask (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) about it. Al-Miqdad asked him and he replied, "One has to perform ablution (after it)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ عَطَاءَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنْ زَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَأَلَ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قُلْتُ أَرَأَيْتَ إِذَا جَامَعَ فَلَمْ يُمْنِ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ يَتَوَضَّأُ كَمَا يَتَوَضَّأُ لِلصَّلاَةِ، وَيَغْسِلُ ذَكَرَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَسَأَلْتُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ عَلِيًّا، وَالزُّبَيْرَ، وَطَلْحَةَ، وَأُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ فَأَمَرُوهُ بِذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'du bnu hafsin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, aanna 'ataa'a bna yasaarin, aakhbarahu aan zayda bna khaalidin aakhbarahu aannahu, saaala 'uthmaana bna 'affaana rda allh 'nh qultu aaraaayta iidhaa jaama'a falam yumni qaala 'uthmaanu yatawaddaau kamaa yatawaddaau lilssalaaai, wayaghsilu dhakarahu‏.‏ qaala 'uthmaanu sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ fasaaaltu 'an dhalika 'aliyyana, waalzzubayra, watalhaaa, waaubaaaa bna ka'bin rda allh 'nhm faaamaruwhu bidhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid:I asked `Uthman bin `Affan about a person who engaged in intercourse but did no discharge. `Uthman replied, "He should perform ablution like the one for an ordinary prayer but he must wash his penis." `Uthman added, "I heard it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." I asked `Ali Az-Zubair, Talha and Ubai bin Ka`b about it and they, too, gave the same reply. (This order was canceled later on and taking a bath became necessary for such cases)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْسَلَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَجَاءَ وَرَأْسُهُ يَقْطُرُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَعَلَّنَا أَعْجَلْنَاكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا أُعْجِلْتَ أَوْ قُحِطْتَ، فَعَلَيْكَ الْوُضُوءُ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ وَهْبٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ غُنْدَرٌ وَيَحْيَى عَنْ شُعْبَةَ الْوُضُوءُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, qaala aakhbaranaa alnnadru, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an dhakwaana aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aarsala iilaa rajulin mina alaansaari fajaa'a waraasuhu yaqturu, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ la'allanaa aa'jalnaaka ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala na'am‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa au'jilta aaw quhitta, fa'alayka alwuduw'u ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu wahbun qaala haddathanaa shu'baau‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi walam yaqul ghundarun wayahyaa 'an shu'baaa alwuduw'u‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for a Ansari man who came with water dropping from his head. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Perhaps we have forced you to hurry up, haven't we?" The Ansari replied, "Yes." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) further said, "If you are forced to hurry up (during intercourse) or you do not discharge then ablution is due on you (This order was canceled later on, i.e. one has to take a bath)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا أَفَاضَ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ عَدَلَ إِلَى الشِّعْبِ، فَقَضَى حَاجَتَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ فَجَعَلْتُ أَصُبُّ عَلَيْهِ وَيَتَوَضَّأُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتُصَلِّي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمُصَلَّى أَمَامَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu salaamin, qaala aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, 'an yahyaa, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lammaa aafaada min 'arafaaa 'adala iilaa alshhi'bi, faqadaa haajatahu‏.‏ qaala ausaamaau bnu zaydin faja'altu aasubbu 'alayhi wayatawaddaau faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aatusalliy faqaala ‏ "‏ almusallaa aamaamaka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:"When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) departed from `Arafat, he turned towards a mountain pass where he answered the call of nature. (After he had finished) I poured water and he performed ablution and then I said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will you offer the prayer?" He replied, "The Musalla (place of the prayer) is ahead of you (in Al-Muzdalifa)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعْدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ، وَأَنَّهُ ذَهَبَ لِحَاجَةٍ لَهُ، وَأَنَّ مُغِيرَةَ جَعَلَ يَصُبُّ الْمَاءَ عَلَيْهِ، وَهُوَ يَتَوَضَّأُ، فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ وَمَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ وَمَسَحَ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala sami'tu yahyaa bna sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'du bnu iibraahiyma, aanna naafi'a bna jubayri bni mut'imin, aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a 'urwaaa bna almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, yuhaddithu 'ani almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, aannahu kaana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin, waaannahu dhahaba lihaajaain lahu, waaanna mughiyraaa ja'ala yasubbu almaa'a 'alayhi, wahuwa yatawaddaau, faghasala wajhahu wayadayhi wamasaha biraasihi wamasaha 'alaa alkhuffayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:I was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on one of the journeys and he went out to answer the call of nature (and after he finished) I poured water and he performed ablution; he washed his face, forearms and passed his wet hand over his head and over the two Khuff (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، بَاتَ لَيْلَةً عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ خَالَتُهُ فَاضْطَجَعْتُ فِي عَرْضِ الْوِسَادَةِ، وَاضْطَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْلُهُ فِي طُولِهَا، فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى إِذَا انْتَصَفَ اللَّيْلُ، أَوْ قَبْلَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ، اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَلَسَ يَمْسَحُ النَّوْمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الْعَشْرَ الآيَاتِ الْخَوَاتِمَ مِنْ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقَةٍ، فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهَا فَأَحْسَنَ وُضُوءَهُ، ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُمْتُ فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعَ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ، فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رَأْسِي، وَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي الْيُمْنَى، يَفْتِلُهَا، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ، حَتَّى أَتَاهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، فَقَامَ، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an makhramaaa bni sulaymaana, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin, aakhbarahu aannahu, baata laylaaan 'inda maymuwnaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahiya khaalatuhu faadtaja'tu fiy 'ardi alwisaadaai, waadtaja'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaahluhu fiy tuwlihaa, fanaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa iidhaa antasafa alllaylu, aaw qablahu biqaliylin aaw ba'dahu biqaliylin, astayqaza rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajalasa yamsahu alnnawma 'an wajhihi biyadihi, thumma qaraaa al'ashra alayaati alkhawaatima min suwraai ali 'imraana, thumma qaama iilaa shannin mu'allaqaain, fatawaddaaa minhaa faaahsana wuduw'ahu, thumma qaama yusalliy‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin faqumtu fasana'tu mithla maa sana'a, thumma dhahabtu, faqumtu iilaa janbihi, fawada'a yadahu alyumnaa 'alaa raasiy, waaakhadha biaudhuniy alyumnaa, yaftiluhaa, fasallaa rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma aawtara, thumma adtaja'a, hattaa aataahu almuuadhhinu, faqaama, fasallaa rak'atayni khafiyfatayni, thumma kharaja fasallaa alssubha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:That he stayed overnight in the house of Maimuna the wife of the Prophet, his aunt. He added: I lay on the bed (cushion transversally) while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his wife lay in the lengthwise direction of the cushion. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept till the middle of the night, either a bit before or a bit after it and then woke up, rubbing the traces of sleep off his face with his hands. He then, recited the last ten verses of Sura Al-`Imran, got up and went to a hanging water-skin. He then Performed the ablution from it and it was a perfect ablution, and then stood up to offer the prayer. I, too, got up and did as the Prophet had done. Then I went and stood by his side. He placed his right hand on my head and caught my right ear and twisted it. He prayed two rak`at, then two rak`at and then two rak`at and then two rak`at and then two rak`at and then two rak`at (separately six times), and finally one rak`a (the witr). Then he lay down again in the bed till the Mu'adh-dhin came to him where upon the Prophet (ﷺ) got up, offered a two light rak`at prayer and went out and led the Fajr prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنِ امْرَأَتِهِ، فَاطِمَةَ عَنْ جَدَّتِهَا، أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ أَتَيْتُ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ خَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَإِذَا النَّاسُ قِيَامٌ يُصَلُّونَ، وَإِذَا هِيَ قَائِمَةٌ تُصَلِّي فَقُلْتُ مَا لِلنَّاسِ فَأَشَارَتْ بِيَدِهَا نَحْوَ السَّمَاءِ وَقَالَتْ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ آيَةٌ فَأَشَارَتْ أَىْ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ حَتَّى تَجَلاَّنِي الْغَشْىُ، وَجَعَلْتُ أَصُبُّ فَوْقَ رَأْسِي مَاءً، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ شَىْءٍ كُنْتُ لَمْ أَرَهُ إِلاَّ قَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا حَتَّى الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ، وَلَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّكُمْ تُفْتَنُونَ فِي الْقُبُورِ مِثْلَ أَوْ قَرِيبًا مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ ـ لاَ أَدْرِي أَىَّ ذَلِكَ قَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ ـ يُؤْتَى أَحَدُكُمْ فَيُقَالُ مَا عِلْمُكَ بِهَذَا الرَّجُلِ فَأَمَّا الْمُؤْمِنُ ـ أَوِ الْمُوقِنُ لاَ أَدْرِي أَىَّ ذَلِكَ قَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ ـ فَيَقُولُ هُوَ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، جَاءَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالْهُدَى، فَأَجَبْنَا وَآمَنَّا وَاتَّبَعْنَا، فَيُقَالُ نَمْ صَالِحًا، فَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ لَمُؤْمِنًا، وَأَمَّا الْمُنَافِقُ ـ أَوِ الْمُرْتَابُ لاَ أَدْرِي أَىَّ ذَلِكَ قَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ ـ فَيَقُولُ لاَ أَدْرِي، سَمِعْتُ النَّاسَ يَقُولُونَ شَيْئًا فَقُلْتُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'ani amraaatihi, faatimaaa 'an jaddatihaa, aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin aannahaa qaalat aataytu 'aaiishaaa zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna khasafati alshhamsu, faiidhaa alnnaasu qiyaamun yusalluwna, waiidhaa hiya qaaiimaaun tusalliy faqultu maa lilnnaasi faaashaarat biyadihaa nahwa alssamaa'i waqaalat subhaana alllahi‏.‏ faqultu ayaaun faaashaarat aaa na'am‏.‏ faqumtu hattaa tajalaaaniy alghashau, waja'altu aasubbu fawqa raasiy maa'an, falammaa ansarafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi, thumma qaala ‏ "‏ maa min shaa'in kuntu lam aarahu iilaaa qad raaaytuhu fiy maqaamiy hadhaa hattaa aljannaai waalnnaari, walaqad auwhiya iilaaaa aannakum tuftanuwna fiy alqubuwri mithla aaw qariybana min fitnaai alddajjaali laa aadriy aaaaa dhalika qaalat aasmaa'u yuutaa aahadukum fayuqaalu maa 'ilmuka bihadhaa alrrajuli faaammaa almuuminu aawi almuwqinu laa aadriy aaaaa dhalika qaalat aasmaa'u fayaquwlu huwa muhammadun rasuwlu alllahi, jaa'anaa bialbayyinaati waalhudaa, faaajabnaa waamannaa waattaba'naa, fayuqaalu nam saalihana, faqad 'alimnaa iin kunta lamuuminana, waaammaa almunaafiqu aawi almurtaabu laa aadriy aaaaa dhalika qaalat aasmaa'u fayaquwlu laa aadriy, sami'tu alnnaasa yaquwluwna shayiana faqultuhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:I came to `Aisha the wife of the Prophet (ﷺ) during the solar eclipse. The people were standing and offering the prayer and she was also praying. I asked her, "What is wrong with the people?" She beckoned with her hand towards the sky and said, "Subhan Allah." I asked her, "Is there a sign?" She pointed out, "Yes." So I, too, stood for the prayer till I fell unconscious and later on I poured water on my head. After the prayer, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) praised and glorified Allah and said, "Just now I have seen something which I never saw before at this place of mine, including Paradise and Hell. I have been inspired (and have understood) that you will be put to trials in your graves and these trials will be like the trials of Ad-Dajjal, or nearly like it (the sub narrator is not sure of what Asma' said). Angels will come to every one of you and ask, 'What do you know about this man?' A believer will reply, 'He is Muhammad, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , and he came to us with self-evident truth and guidance. So we accepted his teaching, believed and followed him.' Then the angels will say to him to sleep in peace as they have come to know that he was a believer. On the other hand a hypocrite or a doubtful person will reply, 'I do not know but heard the people saying something and so I said the same
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى الْمَازِنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ـ وَهُوَ جَدُّ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى ـ أَتَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تُرِيَنِي، كَيْفَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ، فَأَفْرَغَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ فَغَسَلَ يَدَهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ مَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْثَرَ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ بِيَدَيْهِ، فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِمَا وَأَدْبَرَ، بَدَأَ بِمُقَدَّمِ رَأْسِهِ، حَتَّى ذَهَبَ بِهِمَا إِلَى قَفَاهُ، ثُمَّ رَدَّهُمَا إِلَى الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي بَدَأَ مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'amriw bni yahyaa almaaziniyyi, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rajulaan, qaala li'abdi alllahi bni zaydin wahuwa jaddu 'amriw bni yahyaa aatastatiy'u aan turiyaniy, kayfa kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yatawaddaau faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu zaydin na'am‏.‏ fada'aa bimaa'in, faaafragha 'alaa yadayhi faghasala yadahu marratayni, thumma madmada waastanthara thalaathana, thumma ghasala wajhahu thalaathana, thumma ghasala yadayhi marratayni marratayni iilaa almirfaqayni, thumma masaha raasahu biyadayhi, faaaqbala bihimaa waaadbara, badaaa bimuqaddami raasihi, hattaa dhahaba bihimaa iilaa qafaahu, thumma raddahumaa iilaa almakaani alladhiy badaaa minhu, thumma ghasala rijlayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Yahya Al-Mazini:A person asked `Abdullah bin Zaid who was the grandfather of `Amr bin Yahya, "Can you show me how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to perform ablution?" `Abdullah bin Zaid replied in the affirmative and asked for water. He poured it on his hands and washed them twice, then he rinsed his mouth thrice and washed his nose with water thrice by putting water in it and blowing it out. He washed his face thrice and after that he washed his forearms up to the elbows twice and then passed his wet hands over his head from its front to its back and vice versa (beginning from the front and taking them to the back of his head up to the nape of the neck and then brought them to the front again from where he had started) and washed his feet (up to the ankles)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، شَهِدْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ أَبِي حَسَنٍ سَأَلَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زَيْدٍ عَنْ وُضُوءِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَا بِتَوْرٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَتَوَضَّأَ لَهُمْ وُضُوءَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَكْفَأَ عَلَى يَدِهِ مِنَ التَّوْرِ، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي التَّوْرِ، فَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ وَاسْتَنْثَرَ ثَلاَثَ غَرَفَاتٍ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فَمَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ، فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِمَا وَأَدْبَرَ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, qaala haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an 'amrinw, 'an aabiyhi, shahidtu 'amraw bna aabiy hasanin saaala 'abda alllahi bna zaydin 'an wuduw'i alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm fada'aa bitawrin min maa'in, fatawaddaaa lahum wuduw'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakfaaa 'alaa yadihi mina alttawri, faghasala yadayhi thalaathana, thumma aadkhala yadahu fiy alttawri, famadmada waastanshaqa waastanthara thalaatha gharafaatin, thumma aadkhala yadahu faghasala wajhahu thalaathana, thumma aadkhala yadahu faghasala yadayhi marratayni iilaa almirfaqayni marratayni, thumma aadkhala yadahu famasaha raasahu, faaaqbala bihimaa waaadbara marraaan waahidaaan, thumma ghasala rijlayhi iilaa alka'bayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr:My father saw `Amr bin Abi Hasan asking `Abdullah bin Zaid about the ablution of the Prophet. `Abdullah bin Zaid asked for earthenware pot containing water and in front of them performed ablution like that of the Prophet (ﷺ) . He poured water from the pot over his hand and washed his hands thrice and then he put his hands in the pot and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out with three handfuls of water. Again he put his hand in the water and washed his face thrice and washed his forearms up to the elbows twice; and then put his hands in the water and then passed them over his head by bringing them to the front and then to the rear of the head once, and then he washed his feet up to the ankles
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جُحَيْفَةَ، يَقُولُ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْهَاجِرَةِ، فَأُتِيَ بِوَضُوءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ، فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَأْخُذُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ وَضُوئِهِ فَيَتَمَسَّحُونَ بِهِ، فَصَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الظُّهْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَالْعَصْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ عَنَزَةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathanaa alhakamu, qaala sami'tu aabaa juhayfaaa, yaquwlu kharaja 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhaajiraai, faautiya biwaduw'in fatawaddaaa, faja'ala alnnaasu yaakhudhuwna min fadli waduwiihi fayatamassahuwna bihi, fasallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alzzuhra rak'atayni waal'asra rak'atayni, wabayna yadayhi 'anazaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Juhaifa:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us at noon and water for ablution was brought to him. After he had performed ablution, the remaining water was taken by the people and they started smearing their bodies with it (as a blessed thing). The Prophet (ﷺ) offered two rak`at of the Zuhr prayer and then two rak`at of the `Asr prayer while a short spear (or stick) was there (as a Sutra) in front of him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَدَحٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ وَوَجْهَهُ فِيهِ، وَمَجَّ فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُمَا اشْرَبَا مِنْهُ، وَأَفْرِغَا عَلَى وُجُوهِكُمَا وَنُحُورِكُمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala aabuw muwsaa da'aa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biqadahin fiyhi maa'un, faghasala yadayhi wawajhahu fiyhi, wamajja fiyhi thumma qaala lahumaa ashrabaa minhu, waaafrighaa 'alaa wujuwhikumaa wanuhuwrikumaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa said:The Prophet asked for a tumbler containing water and washed both his hands and face in it and then threw a mouthful of water in the tumbler and said to both of us (Abu Musa and Bilal), "Drink from the tumbler and pour some of its water on your faces and chests
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَحْمُودُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، قَالَ وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَجَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي وَجْهِهِ وَهْوَ غُلاَمٌ مِنْ بِئْرِهِمْ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُرْوَةُ عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ وَغَيْرِهِ يُصَدِّقُ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ وَإِذَا تَوَضَّأَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَادُوا يَقْتَتِلُونَ عَلَى وَضُوئِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, qaala haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy mahmuwdu bnu alrrabiy'i, qaala wahuwa alladhiy majja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy wajhihi wahwa ghulaamun min biirihim‏.‏ waqaala 'urwaau 'ani almiswari waghayrihi yusaddiqu kullu waahidin minhumaa saahibahu waiidhaa tawaddaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm kaaduwa yaqtatiluwna 'alaa waduwiihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Shihab:Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi` who was the person on whose face the Prophet (ﷺ) had ejected a mouthful of water from his family's well while he was a boy, and `Urwa (on the authority of Al-Miswar and others) who testified each other, said, "Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) , performed ablution, his companions were nearly fighting for the remains of the water
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يُونُسَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الْجَعْدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، يَقُولُ ذَهَبَتْ بِي خَالَتِي إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ ابْنَ أُخْتِي وَجِعٌ‏.‏ فَمَسَحَ رَأْسِي وَدَعَا لِي بِالْبَرَكَةِ، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ فَشَرِبْتُ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ، ثُمَّ قُمْتُ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ، فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى خَاتَمِ النُّبُوَّةِ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ مِثْلِ زِرِّ الْحَجَلَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu yuwnusa, qaala haddathanaa haatimu bnu iismaa'iyla, 'ani alja'di, qaala sami'tu alssaaiiba bna yaziyda, yaquwlu dhahabat biy khaalatiy iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinna abna aukhtiy waji'un‏.‏ famasaha raasiy wada'aa liy bialbarakaai, thumma tawaddaaa fasharibtu min waduwiihi, thumma qumtu khalfa zahrihi, fanazartu iilaa khaatami alnnubuwwaai bayna katifayhi mithli zirri alhajalaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:My aunt took me to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! This son of my sister has got a disease in his legs." So he passed his hands on my head and prayed for Allah's blessings for me; then he performed ablution and I drank from the remaining water. I stood behind him and saw the seal of Prophethood between his shoulders, and it was like the "Zir-al-Hijla" (means the button of a small tent, but some said 'egg of a partridge.' etc)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ أَفْرَغَ مِنَ الإِنَاءِ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ أَوْ مَضْمَضَ، وَاسْتَنْشَقَ مِنْ كَفَّةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، فَفَعَلَ ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثًا، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، وَمَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ مَا أَقْبَلَ وَمَا أَدْبَرَ، وَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ هَكَذَا وُضُوءُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa 'amruw bnu yahyaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni zaydin, aannahu aafragha mina aliinaa'i 'alaa yadayhi faghasalahumaa, thumma ghasala aaw madmada, waastanshaqa min kaffaain waahidaain, fafa'ala dhalika thalaathana, faghasala yadayhi iilaa almirfaqayni marratayni marratayni, wamasaha biraasihi maa aaqbala wamaa aadbara, waghasala rijlayhi iilaa alka'bayni, thumma qaala hakadhaa wuduw'u rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr bin Yahya:(on the authority of his father) `Abdullah bin Zaid poured water on his hands from a utensil containing water and washed them and then with one handful of water he rinsed his mouth and cleaned his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out. He repeated it thrice. He, then, washed his hands and forearms up to the elbows twice and passed wet hands over his head, both forwards and backwards, and washed his feet up to the ankles and said, "This is the ablution of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ أَبِي حَسَنٍ سَأَلَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زَيْدٍ عَنْ وُضُوءِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَا بِتَوْرٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَتَوَضَّأَ لَهُمْ، فَكَفَأَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ، فَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، وَاسْتَنْثَرَ ثَلاَثًا بِثَلاَثِ غَرَفَاتٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ، فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ، فَمَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ فَأَقْبَلَ بِيَدَيْهِ وَأَدْبَرَ بِهِمَا، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي الإِنَاءِ فَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ قَالَ مَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ مَرَّةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa wuhaybun, qaala haddathanaa 'amruw bnu yahyaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala shahidtu 'amraw bna aabiy hasanin saaala 'abda alllahi bna zaydin 'an wuduw'i alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm fada'aa bitawrin min maa'in, fatawaddaaa lahum, fakafaaa 'alaa yadayhi faghasalahumaa thalaathana, thumma aadkhala yadahu fiy aliinaa'i, famadmada waastanshaqa, waastanthara thalaathana bithalaathi gharafaatin min maa'in, thumma aadkhala yadahu fiy aliinaa'i, faghasala wajhahu thalaathana, thumma aadkhala yadahu fiy aliinaa'i, faghasala yadayhi iilaa almirfaqayni marratayni marratayni, thumma aadkhala yadahu fiy aliinaa'i, famasaha biraasihi faaaqbala biyadayhi waaadbara bihimaa, thumma aadkhala yadahu fiy aliinaa'i faghasala rijlayhi‏.‏ wahaddathanaa muwsaa qaala haddathanaa wuhaybun qaala masaha raasahu marraaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr bin Yahya:My father said, "I saw `Amr bin Abi Hasan asking `Abdullah bin Zaid about the ablution of the Prophet. `Abdullah bin Zaid asked for an earthenware pot containing water and performed ablution in front of them. He poured water over his hands and washed them thrice. Then he put his (right) hand in the pot and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out thrice with three handfuls of water Again he put his hand in the water and washed his face thrice. After that he put his hand in the pot and washed his forearms up to the elbows twice and then again put his hand in the water and passed wet hands over his head by bringing them to the front and then to the back and once more he put his hand in the pot and washed his feet (up to the ankles.)" Narrated Wuhaib: That he (the Prophet (ﷺ) in narration 191 above) had passed his wet hands on the head once only
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ يَتَوَضَّئُونَ فِي زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَمِيعًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aannahu qaala kaana alrrijaalu waalnnisaa'u yatawaddaiuwna fiy zamaani rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jamiy'ana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar:"During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) men and women used to perform ablution together
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُنِي، وَأَنَا مَرِيضٌ لاَ أَعْقِلُ، فَتَوَضَّأَ وَصَبَّ عَلَىَّ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ، فَعَقَلْتُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لِمَنِ الْمِيرَاثُ إِنَّمَا يَرِثُنِي كَلاَلَةٌ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الْفَرَائِضِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, qaala sami'tu jaabirana, yaquwlu jaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'uwduniy, waaanaa mariydun laa aa'qilu, fatawaddaaa wasabba 'alaaaa min waduwiihi, fa'aqaltu faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi limani almiyraathu iinnamaa yarithuniy kalaalaaun‏.‏ fanazalat ayaau alfaraaiidi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to visit me while I was sick and unconscious. He performed ablution and sprinkled the remaining water on me and I became conscious and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! To whom will my inheritance go as I have neither ascendants nor descendants?" Then the Divine verses regarding Fara'id (inheritance) were revealed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُنِيرٍ، سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ بَكْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ، فَقَامَ مَنْ كَانَ قَرِيبَ الدَّارِ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ، وَبَقِيَ قَوْمٌ، فَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِخْضَبٍ مِنْ حِجَارَةٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ، فَصَغُرَ الْمِخْضَبُ أَنْ يَبْسُطَ فِيهِ كَفَّهُ، فَتَوَضَّأَ الْقَوْمُ كُلُّهُمْ‏.‏ قُلْنَا كَمْ كُنْتُمْ قَالَ ثَمَانِينَ وَزِيَادَةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muniyrin, sami'a 'abda alllahi bna bakrin, qaala haddathanaa humaydun, 'an aanasin, qaala hadarati alssalaaau, faqaama man kaana qariyba alddaari iilaa aahlihi, wabaqiya qawmun, faautiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimikhdabin min hijaaraain fiyhi maa'un, fasaghura almikhdabu aan yabsuta fiyhi kaffahu, fatawaddaaa alqawmu kulluhum‏.‏ qulnaa kam kuntum qaala thamaaniyna waziyaadaaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:It was the time for prayer, and those whose houses were near got up and went to their people (to perform ablution), and there remained some people (sitting). Then a painted stove pot (Mikhdab) containing water was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The pot was small, not broad enough for one to spread one's hand in; yet all the people performed ablution. (The sub narrator said, "We asked Anas, 'How many persons were you?' Anas replied 'We were eighty or more"). (It was one of the miracles of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَعَا بِقَدَحٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ وَوَجْهَهُ فِيهِ وَمَجَّ فِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, qaala haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm da'aa biqadahin fiyhi maa'un, faghasala yadayhi wawajhahu fiyhi wamajja fiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for a tumbler containing water. He washed his hands and face in it and also threw a mouthful of water in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ أَتَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْرَجْنَا لَهُ مَاءً فِي تَوْرٍ مِنْ صُفْرٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ، فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثًا وَيَدَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، وَمَسَحَ بِرَأْسِهِ فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِ وَأَدْبَرَ، وَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, qaala haddathanaa 'amruw bnu yahyaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni zaydin, qaala aataa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhrajnaa lahu maa'an fiy tawrin min sufrin fatawaddaaa, faghasala wajhahu thalaathana wayadayhi marratayni marratayni, wamasaha biraasihi faaaqbala bihi waaadbara, waghasala rijlayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us and we brought out water for him in a brass pot. He performed ablution thus: He washed his face thrice, and his forearms to the elbows twice, then passed his wet hands lightly over the head from front to rear and brought them to front again and washed his feet (up to the ankles)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا ثَقُلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاشْتَدَّ بِهِ وَجَعُهُ، اسْتَأْذَنَ أَزْوَاجَهُ فِي أَنْ يُمَرَّضَ فِي بَيْتِي، فَأَذِنَّ لَهُ، فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ تَخُطُّ رِجْلاَهُ فِي الأَرْضِ بَيْنَ عَبَّاسٍ وَرَجُلٍ آخَرَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَأَخْبَرْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ أَتَدْرِي مَنِ الرَّجُلُ الآخَرُ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ هُوَ عَلِيٌّ‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ تُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ بَعْدَ مَا دَخَلَ بَيْتَهُ وَاشْتَدَّ وَجَعُهُ ‏ "‏ هَرِيقُوا عَلَىَّ مِنْ سَبْعِ قِرَبٍ، لَمْ تُحْلَلْ أَوْكِيَتُهُنَّ، لَعَلِّي أَعْهَدُ إِلَى النَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأُجْلِسَ فِي مِخْضَبٍ لِحَفْصَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ طَفِقْنَا نَصُبُّ عَلَيْهِ تِلْكَ حَتَّى طَفِقَ يُشِيرُ إِلَيْنَا أَنْ قَدْ فَعَلْتُنَّ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى النَّاسِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, aanna 'aaiishaaa, qaalat lammaa thaqula alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waashtadda bihi waja'uhu, astaadhana aazwaajahu fiy aan yumarrada fiy baytiy, faaadhinna lahu, fakharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna rajulayni takhuttu rijlaahu fiy alaardi bayna 'abbaasin warajulin akhara‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi faaakhbartu 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin faqaala aatadriy mani alrrajulu alakharu qultu laa‏.‏ qaala huwa 'aliyyun‏.‏ wakaanat 'aaiishaau rda allh 'nha tuhaddithu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ba'da maa dakhala baytahu waashtadda waja'uhu ‏ "‏ hariyquwa 'alaaaa min sab'i qirabin, lam tuhlal aawkiyatuhunna, la'alliy aa'hadu iilaa alnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ waaujlisa fiy mikhdabin lihafsaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, thumma tafiqnaa nasubbu 'alayhi tilka hattaa tafiqa yushiyru iilaynaa aan qad fa'altunna, thumma kharaja iilaa alnnaasi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When the ailment of the Prophet (ﷺ) became aggravated and his disease became severe, he asked his wives to permit him to be nursed (treated) in my house. So they gave him the permission. Then the Prophet came (to my house) with the support of two men, and his legs were dragging on the ground, between `Abbas, and another man." 'Ubaidullah (the sub narrator) said, "I informed `Abdullah bin `Abbas of what `Aisha said. Ibn `Abbas said: 'Do you know who was the other man?' I replied in the negative. Ibn `Abbas said, 'He was `Ali (bin Abi Talib)." `Aisha further said, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) came to my house and his sickness became aggravated he ordered us to pour seven skins full of water on him, so that he might give some advice to the people. So he was seated in a Mikhdab (brass tub) belonging to Hafsa, the wife of the Prophet. Then, all of us started pouring water on him from the water skins till he beckoned to us to stop and that we have done (what he wanted us to do). After that he went out to the people
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ عَمِّي يُكْثِرُ مِنَ الْوُضُوءِ، قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَخْبِرْنِي كَيْفَ رَأَيْتَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ فَدَعَا بِتَوْرٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَكَفَأَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي التَّوْرِ، فَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْثَرَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ مِنْ غَرْفَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فَاغْتَرَفَ بِهَا فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ مَاءً، فَمَسَحَ رَأْسَهُ، فَأَدْبَرَ بِيَدَيْهِ وَأَقْبَلَ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ هَكَذَا رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, qaala haddathanaa sulaymaanu, qaala haddathaniy 'amruw bnu yahyaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaana 'ammiy yukthiru mina alwuduw'i, qaala li'abdi alllahi bni zaydin aakhbirniy kayfa raaayta alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yatawaddaau fada'aa bitawrin min maa'in, fakafaaa 'alaa yadayhi faghasalahumaa thalaatha miraarin, thumma aadkhala yadahu fiy alttawri, famadmada waastanthara thalaatha marraatin min gharfaain waahidaain, thumma aadkhala yadahu faaghtarafa bihaa faghasala wajhahu thalaatha marraatin, thumma ghasala yadayhi iilaa almirfaqayni marratayni marratayni, thumma aakhadha biyadihi maa'an, famasaha raasahu, faaadbara biyadayhi waaaqbala thumma ghasala rijlayhi, faqaala hakadhaa raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yatawaddaau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr bin Yahya:(on the authority of his father) My uncle used to perform ablution extravagantly and once he asked `Abdullah bin Zaid to tell him how he had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) performing ablution. He asked for an earthenware pot containing water, and poured water from it on his hands and washed them thrice, and then put his hand in the earthenware pot and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out thrice with one handful of water; he again put his hand in the water and took a handful of water and washed his face thrice, then washed his hands up to the elbows twice, and took water with his hand, and passed it over his head from front to back and then from back to front, and then washed his feet (up to the ankles) and said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) performing ablution in that way
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَعَا بِإِنَاءٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَأُتِيَ بِقَدَحٍ رَحْرَاحٍ فِيهِ شَىْءٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَوَضَعَ أَصَابِعَهُ فِيهِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَجَعَلْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْمَاءِ يَنْبُعُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ، قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَحَزَرْتُ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ مَا بَيْنَ السَّبْعِينَ إِلَى الثَّمَانِينَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm da'aa biiinaa'in min maa'in, faautiya biqadahin rahraahin fiyhi shaa'un min maa'in, fawada'a aasaabi'ahu fiyhi‏.‏ qaala aanasun faja'altu aanzuru iilaa almaa'i yanbu'u min bayni aasaabi'ihi, qaala aanasun fahazartu man tawaddaaa maa bayna alssab'iyna iilaa althhamaaniyna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Thabit:Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for water and a tumbler with a broad base and not so deep, containing a small quantity of water, was brought to him whereby he put his fingers in it." Anas further said, 'I noticed the water springing out from amongst his fingers.' Anas added, 'I estimated that the people who performed ablution with it numbered between seventy to eighty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ جَبْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْسِلُ ـ أَوْ كَانَ يَغْتَسِلُ ـ بِالصَّاعِ إِلَى خَمْسَةِ أَمْدَادٍ، وَيَتَوَضَّأُ بِالْمُدِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa mis'arun, qaala haddathaniy abnu jabrin, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaghsilu aaw kaana yaghtasilu bialssaa'i iilaa khamsaai aamdaadin, wayatawaddaau bialmuddi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to take a bath with one Sa` up to five Mudds (1 Sa` = [??] Mudds) of water and used to perform ablution with one Mudd of water
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَصْبَغُ بْنُ الْفَرَجِ الْمِصْرِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو النَّضْرِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ مَسَحَ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ‏.‏ وَأَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ سَأَلَ عُمَرَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ إِذَا حَدَّثَكَ شَيْئًا سَعْدٌ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ تَسْأَلْ عَنْهُ غَيْرَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو النَّضْرِ أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ سَعْدًا حَدَّثَهُ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aasbaghu bnu alfaraji almisriyyu, 'ani abni wahbin, qaala haddathaniy 'amrunw, haddathaniy aabuw alnnadri, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu masaha 'alaa alkhuffayni‏.‏ waaanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara saaala 'umara 'an dhalika faqaala na'am iidhaa haddathaka shayiana sa'dun 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaa tasaal 'anhu ghayrahu‏.‏ waqaala muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa aakhbaraniy aabuw alnnadri aanna aabaa salamaaa aakhbarahu aanna sa'dana haddathahu faqaala 'umaru li'abdi alllahi‏.‏ nahwahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) passed wet hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)." `Abdullah bin `Umar asked `Umar about it. `Umar replied in the affirmative and added, "Whenever Sa`d narrates a Hadith from the Prophet, there is no need to ask anyone else about it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ الْحَرَّانِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ خَرَجَ لِحَاجَتِهِ فَاتَّبَعَهُ الْمُغِيرَةُ بِإِدَاوَةٍ فِيهَا مَاءٌ، فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِ حِينَ فَرَغَ مِنْ حَاجَتِهِ، فَتَوَضَّأَ وَمَسَحَ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu khaalidin alharraaniyyu, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an naafi'i bni jubayrin, 'an 'urwaaa bni almughiyraai, 'an aabiyhi almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kharaja lihaajatihi faattaba'ahu almughiyraau biiidaawaain fiyhaa maa'un, fasabba 'alayhi hiyna faragha min haajatihi, fatawaddaaa wamasaha 'alaa alkhuffayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to answer the call of nature and I followed him with a tumbler containing water, and when he finished, I poured water and he performed ablution and passed wet hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ الضَّمْرِيِّ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، رَأَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ‏.‏ وَتَابَعَهُ حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ وَأَبَانُ عَنْ يَحْيَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an ja'fari bni 'amriw bni aumayyaaa alddamriyyi, aanna aabaahu, aakhbarahu aannahu, raaaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yamsahu 'alaa alkhuffayni‏.‏ wataaba'ahu harbu bnu shaddaadin waaabaanu 'an yahyaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ja`far bin `Amr bin Umaiya Ad-Damri:My father said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) passing wet hands over his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُ عَلَى عِمَامَتِهِ وَخُفَّيْهِ‏.‏ وَتَابَعَهُ مَعْمَرٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa alaawzaa'iyyu, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an ja'fari bni 'amrinw, 'an aabiyhi, qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yamsahu 'alaa 'imaamatihi wakhuffayhi‏.‏ wataaba'ahu ma'marun 'an yahyaa 'an aabiy salamaaa 'an 'amrinw qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ja`far bin `Amr:My father said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) passing wet hands over his turban and Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ، فَأَهْوَيْتُ لأَنْزِعَ خُفَّيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ دَعْهُمَا، فَإِنِّي أَدْخَلْتُهُمَا طَاهِرَتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَمَسَحَ عَلَيْهِمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, 'an 'aamirin, 'an 'urwaaa bni almughiyraai, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kuntu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin, faaahwaytu laanzi'a khuffayhi faqaala ‏ "‏ da'humaa, faiinniy aadkhaltuhumaa taahiratayni ‏"‏‏.‏ famasaha 'alayhimaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa bin Al-Mughira:My father said, "Once I was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a journey and I dashed to take off his Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather). He ordered me to leave them as he had put them after performing ablution. So he passed wet hands over them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،‏.‏ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكَلَ كَتِفَ شَاةٍ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, ‏.‏ aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakala katifa shaaain, thumma sallaa walam yatawaddaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ate a piece of cooked mutton from the shoulder region and prayed without repeating ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَحْتَزُّ مِنْ كَتِفِ شَاةٍ، فَدُعِيَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَأَلْقَى السِّكِّينَ فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy ja'faru bnu 'amriw bni aumayyaaa, aanna aabaahu, aakhbarahu aannahu, raaaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yahtazzu min katifi shaaain, fadu'iya iilaa alssalaaai faaalqaa alssikkiyna fasallaa walam yatawaddaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ja`far bin `Amr bin Umaiya:My father said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) taking a piece of (cooked) mutton from the shoulder region and then he was called for prayer. He put his knife down and prayed without repeating ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، مَوْلَى بَنِي حَارِثَةَ أَنَّ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ النُّعْمَانِ، أَخْبَرَهُ‏.‏ أَنَّهُ، خَرَجَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ خَيْبَرَ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانُوا بِالصَّهْبَاءِ ـ وَهِيَ أَدْنَى خَيْبَرَ ـ فَصَلَّى الْعَصْرَ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِالأَزْوَادِ، فَلَمْ يُؤْتَ إِلاَّ بِالسَّوِيقِ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَثُرِّيَ، فَأَكَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَكَلْنَا، ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى الْمَغْرِبِ، فَمَضْمَضَ وَمَضْمَضْنَا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an bushayri bni yasaarin, mawlaa baniy haarithaaa aanna suwayda bna alnnu'maani, aakhbarahu‏.‏ aannahu, kharaja ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama khaybara, hattaa iidhaa kaanuwa bialssahbaa'i wahiya aadnaa khaybara fasallaa al'asra, thumma da'aa bialaazwaadi, falam yuuta iilaaa bialssawiyqi, faaamara bihi fathurriya, faaakala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaakalnaa, thumma qaama iilaa almaghribi, famadmada wamadmadnaa, thumma sallaa walam yatawaddaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Suwaid bin Al-Nu`man:In the year of the conquest of Khaibar I went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till we reached Sahba, a place near Khaibar, where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the `Asr prayer and asked for food. Nothing but saweeq was brought. He ordered it to be moistened with water. He and all of us ate it and the Prophet (ﷺ) got up for the evening prayer (Maghrib prayer), rinsed his mouth with water and we did the same, and he then prayed without repeating the ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَصْبَغُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكَلَ عِنْدَهَا كَتِفًا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aasbaghu, qaala aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'an bukayrin, 'an kuraybin, 'an maymuwnaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aakala 'indahaa katifana, thumma sallaa walam yatawaddaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:The Prophet (ﷺ) ate (a piece of) mutton from the shoulder region and then prayed without repeating the ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَرِبَ لَبَنًا، فَمَضْمَضَ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لَهُ دَسَمًا ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ يُونُسُ وَصَالِحُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, waqutaybaau, qaalaa hadaathanaa allaaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi allaahi bni 'abdi allaahi bni 'utbaaa, 'ani abni 'abaaasin, aanaa rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shariba labanana, famadmada waqaala ‏ "‏ iinaa lahu dasamana ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu yuwnusu wasaalihu bnu kaysaana 'ani alzuuhriyii‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank milk, rinsed his mouth and said, "It has fat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا نَعَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَلْيَرْقُدْ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ عَنْهُ النَّوْمُ، فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا صَلَّى وَهُوَ نَاعِسٌ لاَ يَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ يَسْتَغْفِرُ فَيَسُبَّ نَفْسَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa na'asa aahadukum wahuwa yusalliy falyarqud hattaa yadhhaba 'anhu alnnawmu, faiinna aahadakum iidhaa sallaa wahuwa naa'isun laa yadriy la'allahu yastaghfiru fayasubba nafsahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you feels drowsy while praying he should go to bed (sleep) till his slumber is over because in praying while drowsy one does not know whether one is asking for forgiveness or for a bad thing for oneself
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا نَعَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَلْيَنَمْ حَتَّى يَعْلَمَ مَا يَقْرَأُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa na'asa aahadukum fiy alssalaaai falyanam hattaa ya'lama maa yaqraau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you feels drowsy while praying, he should sleep till he understands what he is saying (reciting)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ‏.‏ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ قَالَ يُجْزِئُ أَحَدَنَا الْوُضُوءُ مَا لَمْ يُحْدِثْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amriw bni 'aamirin, qaala sami'tu aanasana, h qaala wahaddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathaniy 'amruw bnu 'aamirin, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yatawaddaau 'inda kulli salaaain‏.‏ qultu kayfa kuntum tasna'uwna qaala yujziiu aahadanaa alwuduw'u maa lam yuhdith‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr bin `Amir:Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to perform ablution for every prayer." I asked Anas, "What did you used to do?' Anas replied, "We used to pray with the same ablution until we break it with Hadath
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي بُشَيْرُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ خَيْبَرَ، حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِالصَّهْبَاءِ، صَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعَصْرَ، فَلَمَّا صَلَّى دَعَا بِالأَطْعِمَةِ، فَلَمْ يُؤْتَ إِلاَّ بِالسَّوِيقِ، فَأَكَلْنَا وَشَرِبْنَا، ثُمَّ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْمَغْرِبِ فَمَضْمَضَ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى لَنَا الْمَغْرِبَ وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, qaala haddathanaa sulaymaanu, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy bushayru bnu yasaarin, qaala aakhbaraniy suwaydu bnu alnnu'maani, qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama khaybara, hattaa iidhaa kunnaa bialssahbaa'i, sallaa lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'asra, falammaa sallaa da'aa bialaat'imaai, falam yuuta iilaaa bialssawiyqi, faaakalnaa washaribnaa, thumma qaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa almaghribi famadmada, thumma sallaa lanaa almaghriba walam yatawaddaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Suwaid bin Nu`man:In the year of the conquest of Khaibar I went with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) till we reached As-Sahba' where Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led the `Asr prayer and asked for the food. Nothing but saweeq was brought and we ate it and drank (water). The Prophet (ﷺ) got up for the (Maghrib) Prayer, rinsed his mouth with water and then led the prayer without repeating the ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِحَائِطٍ مِنْ حِيطَانِ الْمَدِينَةِ أَوْ مَكَّةَ، فَسَمِعَ صَوْتَ إِنْسَانَيْنِ يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي قُبُورِهِمَا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُعَذَّبَانِ، وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ ‏"‏، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى، كَانَ أَحَدُهُمَا لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ، وَكَانَ الآخَرُ يَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِجَرِيدَةٍ فَكَسَرَهَا كِسْرَتَيْنِ، فَوَضَعَ عَلَى كُلِّ قَبْرٍ مِنْهُمَا كِسْرَةً‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لِمَ فَعَلْتَ هَذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يُخَفَّفَ عَنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ تَيْبَسَا أَوْ إِلَى أَنْ يَيْبَسَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, qaala haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala marra alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bihaaiitin min hiytaani almadiynaai aaw makkaaa, fasami'a sawta iinsaanayni yu'adhhabaani fiy qubuwrihimaa, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yu'adhhabaani, wamaa yu'adhhabaani fiy kabiyrin ‏"‏, thumma qaala ‏"‏ balaa, kaana aahaduhumaa laa yastatiru min bawlihi, wakaana alakharu yamshiy bialnnamiymaai ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma da'aa bijariydaain fakasarahaa kisratayni, fawada'a 'alaa kulli qabrin minhumaa kisraaan‏.‏ faqiyla lahu yaa rasuwla alllahi lima fa'alta hadhaa qaala ‏"‏ la'allahu aan yukhaffafa 'anhumaa maa lam taybasaa aaw iilaa aan yaybasaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once the Prophet, while passing through one of the graveyards of Medina or Mecca heard the voices of two persons who were being tortured in their graves. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "These two persons are being tortured not for a major sin (to avoid)." The Prophet (ﷺ) then added, "Yes! (they are being tortured for a major sin).
