Indeed, one of them never saved himself from being soiled with his urine while the other used to go about with calumnies (to make enmity between friends). The Prophet (ﷺ) then asked for a green leaf of a date-palm tree, broke it into two pieces and put one on each grave. On being asked why he had done so, he replied, "I hope that their torture might be lessened, till these get dried
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي رَوْحُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا تَبَرَّزَ لِحَاجَتِهِ أَتَيْتُهُ بِمَاءٍ فَيَغْسِلُ بِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala haddathaniy rawhu bnu alqaasimi, qaala haddathaniy 'ataa'u bnu aabiy maymuwnaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa tabarraza lihaajatihi aataytuhu bimaa'in fayaghsilu bihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) went to answer the call of nature, I used to bring water with which he used to clean his private parts
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَازِمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَبْرَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمَا لَيُعَذَّبَانِ، وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ أَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَكَانَ لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنَ الْبَوْلِ، وَأَمَّا الآخَرُ فَكَانَ يَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ جَرِيدَةً رَطْبَةً، فَشَقَّهَا نِصْفَيْنِ، فَغَرَزَ فِي كُلِّ قَبْرٍ وَاحِدَةً‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لِمَ فَعَلْتَ هَذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّهُ يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَيْبَسَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى وَحَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا مِثْلَهُ ‏"‏ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathanaa muhammadu bnu khaazimin, qaala haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an mujaahidin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala marra alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biqabrayni faqaala ‏"‏ iinnahumaa layu'adhhabaani, wamaa yu'adhhabaani fiy kabiyrin aammaa aahaduhumaa fakaana laa yastatiru mina albawli, waaammaa alakharu fakaana yamshiy bialnnamiymaai ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma aakhadha jariydaaan ratbaaan, fashaqqahaa nisfayni, fagharaza fiy kulli qabrin waahidaaan‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, lima fa'alta hadhaa qaala ‏"‏ la'allahu yukhaffafu 'anhumaa maa lam yaybasaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu almuthannaa wahaddathanaa wakiy'un qaala haddathanaa alaa'mashu qaala sami'tu mujaahidana mithlahu ‏"‏ yastatiru min bawlihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) once passed by two graves and said, "These two persons are being tortured not for a major sin (to avoid). One of them never saved himself from being soiled with his urine, while the other used to go about with calumnies (to make enmity between friends)." The Prophet (ﷺ) then took a green leaf of a date-palm tree, split it into (pieces) and fixed one on each grave. They said, "O Allah's Apostle! Why have you done so?" He replied, "I hope that their punishment might be lessened till these (the pieces of the leaf) become dry." (See the footnote of Hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى أَعْرَابِيًّا يَبُولُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ دَعُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَصَبَّهُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa hammaamun, aakhbaranaa iishaaqu, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa aa'raabiyyana yabuwlu fiy almasjidi faqaala ‏ "‏ da'uwhu ‏"‏‏.‏ hattaa iidhaa faragha da'aa bimaa'in fasabbahu 'alayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a Bedouin making water in the mosque and told the people not to disturb him. When he finished, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked for some water and poured it over (the urine)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَامَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَبَالَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَتَنَاوَلَهُ النَّاسُ، فَقَالَ لَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ دَعُوهُ وَهَرِيقُوا عَلَى بَوْلِهِ سَجْلاً مِنْ مَاءٍ، أَوْ ذَنُوبًا مِنْ مَاءٍ، فَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُمْ مُيَسِّرِينَ، وَلَمْ تُبْعَثُوا مُعَسِّرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaama aa'raabiyyun fabaala fiy almasjidi fatanaawalahu alnnaasu, faqaala lahumu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ da'uwhu wahariyquwa 'alaa bawlihi sajlaan min maa'in, aaw dhanuwbana min maa'in, faiinnamaa bu'ithtum muyassiriyna, walam tub'athuwa mu'assiriyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A Bedouin stood up and started making water in the mosque. The people caught him but the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to leave him and to pour a bucket or a tumbler of water over the place where he had passed the urine. The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "You have been sent to make things easy and not to make them difficult
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said as above
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِصَبِيٍّ، فَبَالَ عَلَى ثَوْبِهِ، فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَأَتْبَعَهُ إِيَّاهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa aummi almuuminiyna, aannahaa qaalat autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bisabiyyin, fabaala 'alaa thawbihi, fada'aa bimaa'in faaatba'ahu iiyyaahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the mother of faithful believers) A child was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and it urinated on the garment of the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked for water and poured it over the soiled place
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ، أَنَّهَا أَتَتْ بِابْنٍ لَهَا صَغِيرٍ، لَمْ يَأْكُلِ الطَّعَامَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَجْلَسَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حِجْرِهِ، فَبَالَ عَلَى ثَوْبِهِ، فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَنَضَحَهُ وَلَمْ يَغْسِلْهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'an aummi qaysin binti mihsanin, aannahaa aatat biabnin lahaa saghiyrin, lam yaakuli altta'aama iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, faaajlasahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hijrihi, fabaala 'alaa thawbihi, fada'aa bimaa'in fanadahahu walam yaghsilhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Qais bint Mihsin:I brought my young son, who had not started eating (ordinary food) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who took him and made him sit in his lap. The child urinated on the garment of the Prophet, so he asked for water and poured it over the soiled (area) and did not wash it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ أَتَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُبَاطَةَ قَوْمٍ فَبَالَ قَائِمًا، ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ، فَجِئْتُهُ بِمَاءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala aataa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm subaataaa qawmin fabaala qaaiimana, thumma da'aa bimaa'in, fajiituhu bimaa'in fatawaddaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the dumps of some people and passed urine while standing. He then asked for water and so I brought it to him and he performed ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُنِي أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم نَتَمَاشَى، فَأَتَى سُبَاطَةَ قَوْمٍ خَلْفَ حَائِطٍ، فَقَامَ كَمَا يَقُومُ أَحَدُكُمْ فَبَالَ، فَانْتَبَذْتُ مِنْهُ، فَأَشَارَ إِلَىَّ فَجِئْتُهُ، فَقُمْتُ عِنْدَ عَقِبِهِ حَتَّى فَرَغَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaala haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala raaaytuniy aanaa waalnnabiyyu, sla allh 'lyh wslm natamaashaa, faaataa subaataaa qawmin khalfa haaiitin, faqaama kamaa yaquwmu aahadukum fabaala, faantabadhtu minhu, faaashaara iilaaaa fajiituhu, faqumtu 'inda 'aqibihi hattaa faragha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa':The Prophet (ﷺ) and I walked till we reached the dumps of some people. He stood, as any one of you stands, behind a wall and urinated. I went away, but he beckoned me to come. So I approached him and stood near his back till he finished
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، قَالَ كَانَ أَبُو مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيُّ يُشَدِّدُ فِي الْبَوْلِ وَيَقُولُ إِنَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَانَ إِذَا أَصَابَ ثَوْبَ أَحَدِهِمْ قَرَضَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ لَيْتَهُ أَمْسَكَ، أَتَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُبَاطَةَ قَوْمٍ فَبَالَ قَائِمًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ar'araaa, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, qaala kaana aabuw muwsaa alaash'ariyyu yushaddidu fiy albawli wayaquwlu iinna baniy iisraaiiyla kaana iidhaa aasaaba thawba aahadihim qaradahu‏.‏ faqaala hudhayfaau laytahu aamsaka, aataa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm subaataaa qawmin fabaala qaaiimana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Wail:Abu Musa Al-Ash`ari used to lay great stress on the question of urination and he used to say, "If anyone from Bani Israel happened to soil his clothes with urine, he used to cut that portion away." Hearing that, Hudhaifa said to Abu Wail, "I wish he (Abu Musa) didn't (lay great stress on that matter)." Hudhaifa added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to the dumps of some people and urinated while standing
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي فَاطِمَةُ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ أَرَأَيْتَ إِحْدَانَا تَحِيضُ فِي الثَّوْبِ كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَحُتُّهُ، ثُمَّ تَقْرُصُهُ بِالْمَاءِ، وَتَنْضَحُهُ وَتُصَلِّي فِيهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an hishaamin, qaala haddathatniy faatimaau, 'an aasmaa'a, qaalat jaa'ati amraaaaun alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat aaraaayta iihdaanaa tahiydu fiy althhawbi kayfa tasna'u qaala ‏ "‏ tahuttuhu, thumma taqrusuhu bialmaa'i, watandahuhu watusalliy fiyhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Asma':A woman came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "If anyone of us gets menses in her clothes then what should she do?" He replied, "She should (take hold of the soiled place), rub it and put it in the water and rub it in order to remove the traces of blood and then pour water over it. Then she can pray in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ ابْنَةُ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ أُسْتَحَاضُ فَلاَ أَطْهُرُ، أَفَأَدَعُ الصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ، إِنَّمَا ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ، وَلَيْسَ بِحَيْضٍ، فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتْ حَيْضَتُكِ فَدَعِي الصَّلاَةَ، وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَاغْسِلِي عَنْكِ الدَّمَ ثُمَّ صَلِّي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ أَبِي ‏"‏ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّئِي لِكُلِّ صَلاَةٍ، حَتَّى يَجِيءَ ذَلِكَ الْوَقْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, qaala haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat jaa'at faatimaau abnaau aabiy hubayshin iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy amraaaaun austahaadu falaa aathuru, aafaaada'u alssalaaaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa, iinnamaa dhaliki 'irqun, walaysa bihaydin, faiidhaa aaqbalat haydatuki fada'iy alssalaaaa, waiidhaa aadbarat faaghsiliy 'anki alddama thumma salliy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala waqaala aabiy ‏"‏ thumma tawaddaiiy likulli salaaain, hattaa yajiy'a dhalika alwaqtu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima bint Abi Hubaish came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I get persistent bleeding from the uterus and do not become clean. Shall I give up my prayers?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "No, because it is from a blood vessel and not the menses. So when your real menses begins give up your prayers and when it has finished wash off the blood (take a bath) and offer your prayers." Hisham (the sub narrator) narrated that his father had also said, (the Prophet (ﷺ) told her): "Perform ablution for every prayer till the time of the next period comes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ الْجَزَرِيُّ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْسِلُ الْجَنَابَةَ مِنْ ثَوْبِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَيَخْرُجُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ، وَإِنَّ بُقَعَ الْمَاءِ فِي ثَوْبِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa 'amruw bnu maymuwnin aljazariyyu, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu aaghsilu aljanaabaaa min thawbi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fayakhruju iilaa alssalaaai, waiinna buqa'a almaa'i fiy thawbihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I used to wash the traces of Janaba (semen) from the clothes of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he used to go for prayers while traces of water were still on it (water spots were still visible)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ الْمَنِيِّ، يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ فَقَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْسِلُهُ مِنْ ثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَيَخْرُجُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ وَأَثَرُ الْغَسْلِ فِي ثَوْبِهِ بُقَعُ الْمَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, qaala haddathanaa yaziydu, qaala haddathanaa 'amrunw, 'an sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu 'aaiishaaa, h wahaddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, qaala haddathanaa 'amruw bnu maymuwnin, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa 'ani almaniyyi, yusiybu althhawba faqaalat kuntu aaghsiluhu min thawbi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fayakhruju iilaa alssalaaai waaatharu alghasli fiy thawbihi buqa'u almaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sulaiman bin Yasar:I asked `Aisha about the clothes soiled with semen. She replied, "I used to wash it off the clothes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he would go for the prayer while water spots were still visible
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ فِي الثَّوْبِ تُصِيبُهُ الْجَنَابَةُ قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ كُنْتُ أَغْسِلُهُ مِنْ ثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ وَأَثَرُ الْغَسْلِ فِيهِ بُقَعُ الْمَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, qaala haddathanaa 'amruw bnu maymuwnin, qaala saaaltu sulaymaana bna yasaarin fiy althhawbi tusiybuhu aljanaabaau qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau kuntu aaghsiluhu min thawbi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, thumma yakhruju iilaa alssalaaai waaatharu alghasli fiyhi buqa'u almaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun:I heard Sulaiman bin Yasar talking about the clothes soiled with semen. He said that `Aisha had said, "I used to wash it off the clothes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he would go for the prayers while water spots were still visible on them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَغْسِلُ الْمَنِيَّ مِنْ ثَوْبِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ أَرَاهُ فِيهِ بُقْعَةً أَوْ بُقَعًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu khaalidin, qaala haddathanaa zuhayrun, qaala haddathanaa 'amruw bnu maymuwni bni mihraana, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa kaanat taghsilu almaniyya min thawbi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, thumma aaraahu fiyhi buq'aaan aaw buqa'ana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aishah:I used to wash the semen off the clothes of the Prophet (ﷺ) and even then I used to notice one or more spots on them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَدِمَ أُنَاسٌ مِنْ عُكْلٍ أَوْ عُرَيْنَةَ، فَاجْتَوَوُا الْمَدِينَةَ، فَأَمَرَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِلِقَاحٍ، وَأَنْ يَشْرَبُوا مِنْ أَبْوَالِهَا وَأَلْبَانِهَا، فَانْطَلَقُوا، فَلَمَّا صَحُّوا قَتَلُوا رَاعِيَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاسْتَاقُوا النَّعَمَ، فَجَاءَ الْخَبَرُ فِي أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ، فَبَعَثَ فِي آثَارِهِمْ، فَلَمَّا ارْتَفَعَ النَّهَارُ جِيءَ بِهِمْ، فَأَمَرَ فَقَطَعَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَرْجُلَهُمْ، وَسُمِرَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ، وَأُلْقُوا فِي الْحَرَّةِ يَسْتَسْقُونَ فَلاَ يُسْقَوْنَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ فَهَؤُلاَءِ سَرَقُوا وَقَتَلُوا وَكَفَرُوا بَعْدَ إِيمَانِهِمْ، وَحَارَبُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala hadaathanaa hamaaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayuuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala qadima aunaasun min 'uklin aaw 'uraynaaa, faajtawawua almadiynaaa, faaamarahumu alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm biliqaahin, waaan yashrabuwa min aabwaalihaa waaalbaanihaa, faantalaquwa, falamaaa sahuuwa qataluwa raa'iya alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm waastaaquwa alnaa'ama, fajaa'a alkhabaru fiy aawaali alnaahaari, faba'atha fiy athaarihim, falamaaa artafa'a alnaahaaru jiy'a bihim, faaamara faqata'a aaydiyahum waaarjulahum, wasumirat aa'yunuhum, waaulquwa fiy alharaaai yastasquwna falaa yusqawna‏.‏ qaala aabuw qilaabaaa fahauulaa'i saraquwa waqataluwa wakafaruwa ba'da iiymaanihim, wahaarabuwa allaaha warasuwlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qilaba:Anas said, "Some people of `Ukl or `Uraina tribe came to Medina and its climate did not suit them. So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered them to go to the herd of (Milch) camels and to drink their milk and urine (as a medicine). So they went as directed and after they became healthy, they killed the shepherd of the Prophet and drove away all the camels. The news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) early in the morning and he sent (men) in their pursuit and they were captured and brought at noon. He then ordered to cut their hands and feet (and it was done), and their eyes were branded with heated pieces of iron, They were put in 'Al-Harra' and when they asked for water, no water was given to them." Abu Qilaba said, "Those people committed theft and murder, became infidels after embracing Islam and fought against Allah and His Apostle
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو التَّيَّاحِ، يَزِيدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي قَبْلَ أَنْ يُبْنَى الْمَسْجِدُ فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw alttayyaahi, yaziydu bnu humaydin 'an aanasin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy qabla aan yubnaa almasjidu fiy maraabidi alghanami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Prior to the construction of the mosque, the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the prayers at sheep-folds
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنْ فَأْرَةٍ سَقَطَتْ فِي سَمْنٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلْقُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا فَاطْرَحُوهُ‏.‏ وَكُلُوا سَمْنَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an maymuwnaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm suiila 'an faaraain saqatat fiy samnin faqaala ‏ "‏ aalquwhaa wamaa hawlahaa faatrahuwhu‏.‏ wakuluwa samnakum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked regarding ghee (cooking butter) in which a mouse had fallen. He said, "Take out the mouse and throw away the ghee around it and use the rest
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنْ فَأْرَةٍ سَقَطَتْ فِي سَمْنٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ خُذُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا فَاطْرَحُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَعْنٌ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ مَا لاَ أُحْصِيهِ يَقُولُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa ma'nun, qaala haddathanaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an maymuwnaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm suiila 'an faaraain saqatat fiy samnin faqaala ‏ "‏ khudhuwhaa wamaa hawlahaa faatrahuwhu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala ma'nun haddathanaa maalikun maa laa auhsiyhi yaquwlu 'ani abni 'abbaasin 'an maymuwnaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked regarding ghee in which a mouse had fallen. He said, "Take out the mouse and throw away the ghee around it (and use the rest)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ كَلْمٍ يُكْلَمُهُ الْمُسْلِمُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يَكُونُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَهَيْئَتِهَا إِذْ طُعِنَتْ، تَفَجَّرُ دَمًا، اللَّوْنُ لَوْنُ الدَّمِ، وَالْعَرْفُ عَرْفُ الْمِسْكِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu muhammadin, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ kullu kalmin yuklamuhu almuslimu fiy sabiyli alllahi yakuwnu yawma alqiyaamaai kahayiatihaa iidh tu'inat, tafajjaru damana, alllawnu lawnu alddami, waal'arfu 'arfu almiski ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A wound which a Muslim receives in Allah's cause will appear on the Day of Resurrection as it was at the time of infliction; blood will be flowing from the wound and its color will be that of the blood but will smell like musk
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ هُرْمُزَ الأَعْرَجَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ السَّابِقُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw alzzinaadi, aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna hurmuza alaa'raja, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ nahnu alakhiruwna alssaabiquwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "We (Muslims) are the last (people to come in the world) but (will be) the foremost (on the Day of Resurrection)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَبِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَبُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ الَّذِي لاَ يَجْرِي، ثُمَّ يَغْتَسِلُ فِيهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wabiiisnaadihi qaala ‏ "‏ laa yabuwlanna aahadukum fiy almaa'i alddaaiimi alladhiy laa yajriy, thumma yaghtasilu fiyhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: The same narrator said that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said: "You should not pass urine in stagnant water which is not flowing then (you may need to) wash in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَاجِدٌ ح قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُرَيْحُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ، وَأَبُو جَهْلٍ وَأَصْحَابٌ لَهُ جُلُوسٌ، إِذْ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَيُّكُمْ يَجِيءُ بِسَلَى جَزُورِ بَنِي فُلاَنٍ فَيَضَعُهُ عَلَى ظَهْرِ مُحَمَّدٍ إِذَا سَجَدَ فَانْبَعَثَ أَشْقَى الْقَوْمِ فَجَاءَ بِهِ، فَنَظَرَ حَتَّى إِذَا سَجَدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَضَعَهُ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ، لاَ أُغَيِّرُ شَيْئًا، لَوْ كَانَ لِي مَنْعَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلُوا يَضْحَكُونَ وَيُحِيلُ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَاجِدٌ لاَ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ، حَتَّى جَاءَتْهُ فَاطِمَةُ، فَطَرَحَتْ عَنْ ظَهْرِهِ، فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِقُرَيْشٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، فَشَقَّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِذْ دَعَا عَلَيْهِمْ ـ قَالَ وَكَانُوا يُرَوْنَ أَنَّ الدَّعْوَةَ فِي ذَلِكَ الْبَلَدِ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ ـ ثُمَّ سَمَّى ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ بِأَبِي جَهْلٍ، وَعَلَيْكَ بِعُتْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَشَيْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، وَالْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، وَأُمَيَّةَ بْنِ خَلَفٍ، وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَدَّ السَّابِعَ فَلَمْ يَحْفَظْهُ قَالَ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الَّذِينَ عَدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَرْعَى فِي الْقَلِيبِ قَلِيبِ بَدْرٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an 'amriw bni maymuwnin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala baynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm saajidun h qaala wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu 'uthmaana qaala haddathanaa shurayhu bnu maslamaaa qaala haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu yuwsufa 'an aabiyhi 'an aabiy iishaaqa qaala haddathaniy 'amruw bnu maymuwnin aanna 'abda alllahi bna mas'uwdin haddathahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy 'inda albayti, waaabuw jahlin waaashaabun lahu juluwsun, iidh qaala ba'duhum liba'din aayyukum yajiy'u bisalaa jazuwri baniy fulaanin fayada'uhu 'alaa zahri muhammadin iidhaa sajada faanba'atha aashqaa alqawmi fajaa'a bihi, fanazara hattaa iidhaa sajada alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wada'ahu 'alaa zahrihi bayna katifayhi waaanaa aanzuru, laa aughayyiru shayiana, law kaana liy man'aaun‏.‏ qaala faja'aluwa yadhakuwna wayuhiylu ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din, warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm saajidun laa yarfa'u raasahu, hattaa jaa'athu faatimaau, fatarahat 'an zahrihi, farafa'a raasahu thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma 'alayka biqurayshin ‏"‏‏.‏ thalaatha marraatin, fashaqqa 'alayhim iidh da'aa 'alayhim qaala wakaanuwa yurawna aanna aldda'waaa fiy dhalika albaladi mustajaabaaun thumma sammaa ‏"‏ alllahumma 'alayka biaabiy jahlin, wa'alayka bi'utbaaa bni rabiy'aaa, washaybaaa bni rabiy'aaa, waalwaliydi bni 'utbaaa, waaumayyaaa bni khalafin, wa'uqbaaa bni aabiy mu'aytin ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'adda alssaabi'a falam yahfazhu qaala fawaalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi, laqad raaaytu alladhiyna 'adda rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sar'aa fiy alqaliybi qaliybi badrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was prostrating (as stated below). Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud: Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was offering prayers at the Ka`ba. Abu Jahl was sitting with some of his companions. One of them said to the others, "Who amongst you will bring the Abdominal contents (intestines, etc.) of a camel of Bani so and so and put it on the back of Muhammad, when he prostrates?" The most unfortunate of them got up and brought it. He waited till the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrated and then placed it on his back between his shoulders. I was watching but could not do any thing. I wish I had some people with me to hold out against them. They started laughing and falling on one another. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in prostration and he did not lift his head up till Fatima (Prophet's daughter) came and threw that (camel's Abdominal contents) away from his back. He raised his head and said thrice, "O Allah! Punish Quraish." So it was hard for Abu Jahl and his companions when the Prophet invoked Allah against them as they had a conviction that the prayers and invocations were accepted in this city (Mecca). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Punish Abu Jahl, `Utba bin Rabi`a, Shaiba bin Rabi`a, Al-Walid bin `Utba, Umaiya bin Khalaf, and `Uqba bin Al Mu'it [??] (and he mentioned the seventh whose name I cannot recall). By Allah in Whose Hands my life is, I saw the dead bodies of those persons who were counted by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the Qalib (one of the wells) of Badr
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ بَزَقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ثَوْبِهِ‏.‏ طَوَّلَهُ ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدٌ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an humaydin, 'an aanasin, qaala bazaqa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy thawbihi‏.‏ tawwalahu abnu aabiy maryama qaala aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba haddathaniy humaydun qaala sami'tu aanasana 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) once spat in his clothes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ شَرَابٍ أَسْكَرَ فَهُوَ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ kullu sharaabin aaskara fahuwa haraamun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "All drinks that produce intoxication are Haram (forbidden to drink)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، سَمِعَ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ،، وَسَأَلَهُ النَّاسُ، وَمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ أَحَدٌ بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ دُووِيَ جُرْحُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مَا بَقِيَ أَحَدٌ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، كَانَ عَلِيٌّ يَجِيءُ بِتُرْسِهِ فِيهِ مَاءٌ، وَفَاطِمَةُ تَغْسِلُ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ الدَّمَ، فَأُخِذَ حَصِيرٌ فَأُحْرِقَ فَحُشِيَ بِهِ جُرْحُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, qaala aakhbaranaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aabiy haazimin, sami'a sahla bna sa'din alssaa'idiyya, , wasaaalahu alnnaasu, wamaa bayniy wabaynahu aahadun biaaaai shaa'in duwwiya jurhu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala maa baqiya aahadun aa'lamu bihi minniy, kaana 'aliyyun yajiy'u bitursihi fiyhi maa'un, wafaatimaau taghsilu 'an wajhihi alddama, faaukhidha hasiyrun faauhriqa fahushiya bihi jurhuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Hazim:Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi, was asked by the people, "With what was the wound of the Prophet (ﷺ) treated?" Sahl replied, "None remains among the people living who knows that better than I. `Ali [??] used to bring water in his shield and Fatima used to wash the blood off his face. Then straw mat was burnt and the wound was filled with it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ غَيْلاَنَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدْتُهُ يَسْتَنُّ بِسِوَاكٍ بِيَدِهِ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أُعْ أُعْ ‏"‏، وَالسِّوَاكُ فِي فِيهِ، كَأَنَّهُ يَتَهَوَّعُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, qaala haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an ghaylaana bni jariyrin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fawajadtuhu yastannu bisiwaakin biyadihi yaquwlu ‏ "‏ au' au' ‏"‏, waalssiwaaku fiy fiyhi, kaaannahu yatahawwa'u‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda:My father said, "I came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and saw him carrying a Siwak in his hand and cleansing his teeth, saying, 'U' U'," as if he was retching while the Siwak was in his mouth
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ يَشُوصُ فَاهُ بِالسِّوَاكِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, qaala haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qaama mina alllayli yashuwsu faahu bialssiwaaki‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) got up at night, he used to clean his mouth with Siwak
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا صَخْرُ بْنُ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَرَانِي أَتَسَوَّكُ بِسِوَاكٍ، فَجَاءَنِي رَجُلاَنِ أَحَدُهُمَا أَكْبَرُ مِنَ الآخَرِ، فَنَاوَلْتُ السِّوَاكَ الأَصْغَرَ مِنْهُمَا، فَقِيلَ لِي كَبِّرْ‏.‏ فَدَفَعْتُهُ إِلَى الأَكْبَرِ مِنْهُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ اخْتَصَرَهُ نُعَيْمٌ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala 'afaaanu hadaathanaa sakhru bnu juwayriyaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aaraaniy aatasawaaku bisiwaakin, fajaa'aniy rajulaani aahaduhumaa aakbaru mina alakhari, fanaawaltu alsiiwaaka alaasghara minhumaa, faqiyla liy kabiir‏.‏ fadafa'tuhu iilaa alaakbari minhumaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi allaahi akhtasarahu nu'aymun 'ani abni almubaaraki 'an ausaamaaa 'an naafi'in 'ani abni 'umara‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I dreamt that I was cleaning my teeth with a Siwak and two persons came to me. One of them was older than the other and I gave the Siwak to the younger. I was told that I should give it to the older and so I did
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا أَتَيْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وُضُوءَكَ لِلصَّلاَةِ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّكَ الأَيْمَنِ، ثُمَّ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، اللَّهُمَّ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ‏.‏ فَإِنْ مُتَّ مِنْ لَيْلَتِكَ فَأَنْتَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ، وَاجْعَلْهُنَّ آخِرَ مَا تَتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَدَّدْتُهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا بَلَغْتُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَرَسُولِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ، وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an sa'di bni 'ubaydaaa, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa aatayta madja'aka fatawaddaa wuduw'aka lilssalaaai, thumma adtaji' 'alaa shiqqika alaaymani, thumma quli alllahumma aaslamtu wajhiy iilayka, wafawwadtu aamriy iilayka, waaaljaatu zahriy iilayka, raghbaaan warahbaaan iilayka, laa maljaaa walaa manjaa minka iilaaa iilayka, alllahumma amantu bikitaabika alladhiy aanzalta, wabinabiyyika alladhiy aarsalta‏.‏ faiin mutta min laylatika faaanta 'alaa alfitraai, waaj'alhunna akhira maa tatakallamu bihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faraddadtuhaa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa balaghtu ‏"‏ alllahumma amantu bikitaabika alladhiy aanzalta ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu warasuwlika‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa, wanabiyyika alladhiy aarsalta ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara 'bin `Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Whenever you go to bed perform ablution like that for the prayer, lie on your right side and say, "Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilaika, wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa alja'tu Zahri ilaika raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La Malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta wa bina-biyika-l ladhi arsalta" (O Allah! I surrender to You and entrust all my affairs to You and depend upon You for Your Blessings both with hope and fear of You. There is no fleeing from You, and there is no place of protection and safety except with You O Allah! I believe in Your Book (the Qur'an) which You have revealed and in Your Prophet (Muhammad) whom You have sent). Then if you die on that very night, you will die with faith (i.e. on the religion of Islam). Let the aforesaid words be your last utterance (before sleep)." I repeated it before the Prophet (ﷺ) and when I reached "Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta (O Allah I believe in Your Book which You have revealed)." I said, "Wa-rasulika (and your Apostle)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, (but say): 'Wanabiyika-l-ladhi arsalta (Your Prophet whom You have sent), instead
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ بَدَأَ فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ كَمَا يَتَوَضَّأُ لِلصَّلاَةِ، ثُمَّ يُدْخِلُ أَصَابِعَهُ فِي الْمَاءِ، فَيُخَلِّلُ بِهَا أُصُولَ شَعَرِهِ ثُمَّ يَصُبُّ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلاَثَ غُرَفٍ بِيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ يُفِيضُ الْمَاءَ عَلَى جِلْدِهِ كُلِّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa aghtasala mina aljanaabaai badaaa faghasala yadayhi, thumma yatawaddaau kamaa yatawaddaau lilssalaaai, thumma yudkhilu aasaabi'ahu fiy almaa'i, fayukhallilu bihaa ausuwla sha'arihi thumma yasubbu 'alaa raasihi thalaatha ghurafin biyadayhi, thumma yufiydu almaa'a 'alaa jildihi kullihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) took a bath after Janaba he started by washing his hands and then performed ablution like that for the prayer. After that he would put his fingers in water and move the roots of his hair with them, and then pour three handfuls of water over his head and then pour water all over his body
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ تَوَضَّأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ غَيْرَ رِجْلَيْهِ، وَغَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، وَمَا أَصَابَهُ مِنَ الأَذَى، ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ، ثُمَّ نَحَّى رِجْلَيْهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا، هَذِهِ غُسْلُهُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an maymuwnaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat tawaddaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wuduw'ahu lilssalaaai ghayra rijlayhi, waghasala farjahu, wamaa aasaabahu mina alaadhaa, thumma aafaada 'alayhi almaa'a, thumma nahhaa rijlayhi faghasalahumaa, hadhihi ghusluhu mina aljanaabaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:(the wife of the Prophet) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) performed ablution like that for the prayer but did not wash his feet. He washed off the discharge from his private parts and then poured water over his body. He withdrew his feet from that place (the place where he took the bath) and then washed them. And that was his way of taking the bath of Janaba
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ مِنْ قَدَحٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ الْفَرَقُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu aaghtasilu aanaa waalnnabiyyu, sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in waahidin min qadahin yuqaalu lahu alfaraqu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot called 'Faraq
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ، يَقُولُ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَأَخُو، عَائِشَةَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَسَأَلَهَا أَخُوهَا عَنْ غُسْلِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَتْ بِإِنَاءٍ نَحْوًا مِنْ صَاعٍ، فَاغْتَسَلَتْ وَأَفَاضَتْ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا، وَبَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهَا حِجَابٌ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ وَبَهْزٌ وَالْجُدِّيُّ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ قَدْرِ صَاعٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu muhamaadin, qaala hadaathaniy 'abdu alsaamadi, qaala hadaathaniy shu'baau, qaala hadaathaniy aabuw bakri bnu hafsin, qaala sami'tu aabaa salamaaa, yaquwlu dakhaltu aanaa waaakhuw, 'aaiishaaa 'alaa 'aaiishaaa fasaaalahaa aakhuwhaa 'an ghusli alnaabiyii, sla allh 'lyh wslm fada'at biiinaa'in nahwana min saa'in, faaghtasalat waaafaadat 'alaa raasihaa, wabaynanaa wabaynahaa hijaabun‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi allaahi qaala yaziydu bnu haaruwna wabahzun waaljudiiyuu 'an shu'baaa qadri saa'in‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Salama:`Aisha's brother and I went to `Aisha and he asked her about the bath of the Prophet. She brought a pot containing about a Sa` of water and took a bath and poured it over her head and at that time there was a screen between her and us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ عِنْدَ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ هُوَ وَأَبُوهُ، وَعِنْدَهُ قَوْمٌ فَسَأَلُوهُ عَنِ الْغُسْلِ،‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَكْفِيكَ صَاعٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مَا يَكْفِينِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ جَابِرٌ كَانَ يَكْفِي مَنْ هُوَ أَوْفَى مِنْكَ شَعَرًا، وَخَيْرٌ مِنْكَ، ثُمَّ أَمَّنَا فِي ثَوْبٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, qaala haddathanaa zuhayrun, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala haddathanaa aabuw ja'farin, aannahu kaana 'inda jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi huwa waaabuwhu, wa'indahu qawmun fasaaaluwhu 'ani alghusli, ‏.‏ faqaala yakfiyka saa'un‏.‏ faqaala rajulun maa yakfiyniy‏.‏ faqaala jaabirun kaana yakfiy man huwa aawfaa minka sha'arana, wakhayrun minka, thumma aammanaa fiy thawbin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Ja`far:While I and my father were with Jabir bin `Abdullah, some people asked him about taking a bath. He replied, "A Sa` of water is sufficient for you." A man said, "A Sa` is not sufficient for me." Jabir said, "A Sa` was sufficient for one who had more hair than you and was better than you (meaning the Prophet)." And then Jabir (put on) his garment and led the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَيْمُونَةَ كَانَا يَغْتَسِلاَنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ كَانَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ يَقُولُ أَخِيرًا عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، وَالصَّحِيحُ مَا رَوَى أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala hadaathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, 'an jaabiri bni zaydin, 'ani abni 'abaaasin, aanaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm wamaymuwnaaa kaanaa yaghtasilaani min iinaa'in waahidin‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi allaahi kaana abnu 'uyaynaaa yaquwlu aakhiyrana 'ani abni 'abaaasin 'an maymuwnaaa, waalsaahiyhu maa rawaa aabuw nu'aymin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) and Maimuna used to take a bath from a single pot
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ صُرَدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جُبَيْرُ بْنُ مُطْعِمٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَمَّا أَنَا فَأُفِيضُ عَلَى رَأْسِي ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ بِيَدَيْهِ كِلْتَيْهِمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa zuhayrun, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala haddathaniy sulaymaanu bnu suradin, qaala haddathaniy jubayru bnu mut'imin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aammaa aanaa faaufiydu 'alaa raasiy thalaathana ‏"‏‏.‏ waaashaara biyadayhi kiltayhimaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "As for me, I pour water three times on my head." And he pointed with both his hands
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مِخْوَلِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُفْرِغُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala haddathanaa ghundarun, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mikhwali bni raashidin, 'an muhammadi bni 'aliyyin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yufrighu 'alaa raasihi thalaathana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pour water three times on his head
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي جَابِرٌ أَتَانِي ابْنُ عَمِّكَ يُعَرِّضُ بِالْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ قَالَ كَيْفَ الْغُسْلُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ فَقُلْتُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْخُذُ ثَلاَثَةَ أَكُفٍّ وَيُفِيضُهَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ يُفِيضُ عَلَى سَائِرِ جَسَدِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِي الْحَسَنُ إِنِّي رَجُلٌ كَثِيرُ الشَّعَرِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَكْثَرَ مِنْكَ شَعَرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa ma'maru bnu yahyaa bni saamin, haddathaniy aabuw ja'farin, qaala qaala liy jaabirun aataaniy abnu 'ammika yu'arridu bialhasani bni muhammadin abni alhanafiyyaai qaala kayfa alghuslu mina aljanaabaai faqultu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaakhudhu thalaathaaa aakuffin wayufiyduhaa 'alaa raasihi, thumma yufiydu 'alaa saaiiri jasadihi‏.‏ faqaala liy alhasanu iinniy rajulun kathiyru alshha'ari‏.‏ faqultu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aakthara minka sha'arana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Ja`far:Jabir bin `Abdullah said to me, "Your cousin (Hasan bin Muhammad bin Al-Hanafiya) came to me and asked about the bath of Janaba. I replied, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) used to take three handfuls of water, pour them on his head and then pour more water over his body.' Al-Hasan said to me, 'I am a hairy man.' I replied, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) had more hair than you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَتْ مَيْمُونَةُ وَضَعْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَاءً لِلْغُسْلِ، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَفْرَغَ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ فَغَسَلَ مَذَاكِيرَهُ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ يَدَهُ بِالأَرْضِ، ثُمَّ مَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ وَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ، ثُمَّ تَحَوَّلَ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaalat maymuwnaau wada'tu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa'an lilghusli, faghasala yadayhi marratayni aaw thalaathana, thumma aafragha 'alaa shimaalihi faghasala madhaakiyrahu, thumma masaha yadahu bialaardi, thumma madmada waastanshaqa waghasala wajhahu wayadayhi, thumma aafaada 'alaa jasadihi, thumma tahawwala min makaanihi faghasala qadamayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:I placed water for the bath of the Prophet. He washed his hands twice or thrice and then poured water on his left hand and washed his private parts. He rubbed his hands over the earth (and cleaned them), rinsed his mouth, washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out, washed his face and both forearms and then poured water over his body. Then he withdrew from that place and washed his feet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ دَعَا بِشَىْءٍ نَحْوَ الْحِلاَبِ، فَأَخَذَ بِكَفِّهِ، فَبَدَأَ بِشِقِّ رَأْسِهِ الأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ الأَيْسَرِ، فَقَالَ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'an hanzalaaa, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aghtasala mina aljanaabaai da'aa bishaa'in nahwa alhilaabi, faaakhadha bikaffihi, fabadaaa bishiqqi raasihi alaaymani thumma alaaysari, faqaala bihimaa 'alaa raasihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) took the bath of Janaba (sexual relation or wet dream) he asked for the Hilab or some other scent. He used to take it in his hand, rub it first over the right side of his head and then over the left and then rub the middle of his head with both hands
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنَا مَيْمُونَةُ، قَالَتْ صَبَبْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُسْلاً، فَأَفْرَغَ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ بِيَدِهِ الأَرْضَ فَمَسَحَهَا بِالتُّرَابِ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَهَا، ثُمَّ تَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ، وَأَفَاضَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِمِنْدِيلٍ، فَلَمْ يَنْفُضْ بِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, qaala haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala haddathaniy saalimun, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala haddathatnaa maymuwnaau, qaalat sababtu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghuslaan, faaafragha biyamiynihi 'alaa yasaarihi faghasalahumaa, thumma ghasala farjahu, thumma qaala biyadihi alaarda famasahahaa bialtturaabi, thumma ghasalahaa, thumma tamadmada waastanshaqa, thumma ghasala wajhahu, waaafaada 'alaa raasihi, thumma tanahhaa faghasala qadamayhi, thumma autiya bimindiylin, falam yanfud bihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:I placed water for the bath of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he poured water with his right hand on his left and washed them. Then he washed his private parts and rubbed his hands on the ground, washed them with water, rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out, washed his face and poured water on his head. He withdrew from that place and washed his feet. A piece of cloth (towel) was given to him but he did not use it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ، فَغَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ دَلَكَ بِهَا الْحَائِطَ ثُمَّ غَسَلَهَا، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْ غُسْلِهِ غَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an maymuwnaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aghtasala mina aljanaabaai, faghasala farjahu biyadihi, thumma dalaka bihaa alhaaiita thumma ghasalahaa, thumma tawaddaaa wuduw'ahu lilssalaaai, falammaa faragha min ghuslihi ghasala rijlayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:The Prophet (ﷺ) took the bath of Janaba. (sexual relation or wet dream). He first cleaned his private parts with his hand, and then rubbed it (that hand) on the wall (earth) and washed it. Then he performed ablution like that for the prayer, and after the bath he washed his feet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَفْلَحُ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ تَخْتَلِفُ أَيْدِينَا فِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, aakhbaranaa aaflahu, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu aaghtasilu aanaa waalnnabiyyu, sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in waahidin takhtalifu aaydiynaa fiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot of water and our hands used to go in the pot after each other in turn
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ غَسَلَ يَدَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aghtasala mina aljanaabaai ghasala yadahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took a bath of Janaba, he washed his hands first
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ‏.‏ وَعَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy bakri bni hafsin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu aaghtasilu aanaa waalnnabiyyu, sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in waahidin min janaabaain‏.‏ wa'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi 'an aabiyhi 'an 'aaiishaaa mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot of water after Janaba
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَبْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ يَغْتَسِلاَنِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ‏.‏ زَادَ مُسْلِمٌ وَوَهْبٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni jabrin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waalmaraaau min nisaaiihi yaghtasilaani min iinaa'in waahidin‏.‏ zaada muslimun wawahbun 'an shu'baaa mina aljanaabaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) and one of his wives used to take a bath from a single pot of water. (Shu`ba added to Anas' Statement "After the Janaba)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَتْ مَيْمُونَةُ وَضَعْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَاءً يَغْتَسِلُ بِهِ، فَأَفْرَغَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ، فَغَسَلَهُمَا مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَفْرَغَ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ، فَغَسَلَ مَذَاكِيرَهُ، ثُمَّ دَلَكَ يَدَهُ بِالأَرْضِ، ثُمَّ مَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ غَسَلَ رَأْسَهُ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ أَفْرَغَ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى مِنْ مَقَامِهِ فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu mahbuwbin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, qaala haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaalat maymuwnaau wada'tu lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa'an yaghtasilu bihi, faaafragha 'alaa yadayhi, faghasalahumaa marratayni marratayni aaw thalaathana, thumma aafragha biyamiynihi 'alaa shimaalihi, faghasala madhaakiyrahu, thumma dalaka yadahu bialaardi, thumma madmada waastanshaqa, thumma ghasala wajhahu wayadayhi thumma ghasala raasahu thalaathana, thumma aafragha 'alaa jasadihi, thumma tanahhaa min maqaamihi faghasala qadamayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:I placed water for the bath of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he poured water over his hands and washed them twice or thrice; then he poured water with his right hand over his left and washed his private parts (with his left hand). He rubbed his hand over the earth and rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out. After that he washed his face, both fore arms and head thrice and then poured water over his body. He withdrew from that place and washed his feet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَتْ وَضَعْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُسْلاً وَسَتَرْتُهُ، فَصَبَّ عَلَى يَدِهِ، فَغَسَلَهَا مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ ـ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ لاَ أَدْرِي أَذَكَرَ الثَّالِثَةَ أَمْ لاَ ـ ثُمَّ أَفْرَغَ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ، فَغَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، ثُمَّ دَلَكَ يَدَهُ بِالأَرْضِ أَوْ بِالْحَائِطِ، ثُمَّ تَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، وَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ، وَغَسَلَ رَأْسَهُ، ثُمَّ صَبَّ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ، فَنَاوَلْتُهُ خِرْقَةً، فَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا، وَلَمْ يُرِدْهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an maymuwnaaa binti alhaarithi, qaalat wada'tu lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghuslaan wasatartuhu, fasabba 'alaa yadihi, faghasalahaa marraaan aaw marratayni qaala sulaymaanu laa aadriy aadhakara althhaalithaaa aam laa thumma aafragha biyamiynihi 'alaa shimaalihi, faghasala farjahu, thumma dalaka yadahu bialaardi aaw bialhaaiiti, thumma tamadmada waastanshaqa, waghasala wajhahu wayadayhi, waghasala raasahu, thumma sabba 'alaa jasadihi, thumma tanahhaa faghasala qadamayhi, fanaawaltuhu khirqaaan, faqaala biyadihi hakadhaa, walam yuridhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna bint Al-Harith:I placed water for the bath of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and put a screen. He poured water over his hands, and washed them once or twice. (The sub-narrator added that he did not remember if she had said thrice or not). Then he poured water with his right hand over his left one and washed his private parts. He rubbed his hand over the earth or the wall and washed it. He rinsed his mouth and washed his nose by putting water in it and blowing it out. He washed his face, forearms and head. He poured water over his body and then withdrew from that place and washed his feet. I presented him a piece of cloth (towel) and he pointed with his hand (that he does not want it) and did not take it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ ذَكَرْتُهُ لِعَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَيَطُوفُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ، ثُمَّ يُصْبِحُ مُحْرِمًا يَنْضَخُ طِيبًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, wayahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an iibraahiyma bni muhammadi bni almuntashiri, 'an aabiyhi, qaala dhakartuhu li'aaiishaaa faqaalat yarhamu alllahu aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani, kuntu autayyibu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fayatuwfu 'alaa nisaaiihi, thumma yusbihu muhrimana yandakhu tiybana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad bin Al-Muntathir:on the authority of his father that he had asked `Aisha (about the Hadith of Ibn `Umar). She said, "May Allah be Merciful to Abu `Abdur-Rahman. I used to put scent on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he used to go round his wives, and in the morning he assumed the Ihram, and the fragrance of scent was still coming out from his body
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدُورُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فِي السَّاعَةِ الْوَاحِدَةِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَهُنَّ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ أَوَكَانَ يُطِيقُهُ قَالَ كُنَّا نَتَحَدَّثُ أَنَّهُ أُعْطِيَ قُوَّةَ ثَلاَثِينَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ إِنَّ أَنَسًا حَدَّثَهُمْ تِسْعُ نِسْوَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu bashaaarin, qaala hadaathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, qaala hadaathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, qaala hadaathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, qaala kaana alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaduwru 'alaa nisaaiihi fiy alsaaa'aai alwaahidaai mina allaayli waalnaahaari, wahunaa iihdaa 'ashraaa‏.‏ qaala qultu laanasin aawakaana yutiyquhu qaala kunaaa natahadaathu aanaahu au'tiya quwaaaa thalaathiyna‏.‏ waqaala sa'iydun 'an qataadaaa iinaa aanasana hadaathahum tis'u niswaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qatada:Anas bin Malik said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to visit all his wives in a round, during the day and night and they were eleven in number." I asked Anas, "Had the Prophet (ﷺ) the strength for it?" Anas replied, "We used to say that the Prophet (ﷺ) was given the strength of thirty (men)." And Sa`id said on the authority of Qatada that Anas had told him about nine wives only (not eleven)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ رَجُلاً مَذَّاءً فَأَمَرْتُ رَجُلاً أَنْ يَسْأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِمَكَانِ ابْنَتِهِ فَسَأَلَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ تَوَضَّأْ وَاغْسِلْ ذَكَرَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa zaaiidaau, 'an aabiy hasiynin, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aliyyin, qaala kuntu rajulaan madhhaa'an faaamartu rajulaan aan yasaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm limakaani abnatihi fasaaala faqaala ‏ "‏ tawaddaa waaghsil dhakaraka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:I used to get emotional urethral discharge frequently. Being the son-in-law of the Prophet (ﷺ) I requested a man to ask him about it. So the man asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Perform ablution after washing your organ (penis)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ فَذَكَرْتُ لَهَا قَوْلَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُصْبِحَ، مُحْرِمًا أَنْضَخُ طِيبًا‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَنَا طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ طَافَ فِي نِسَائِهِ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحَ مُحْرِمًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, qaala haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an iibraahiyma bni muhammadi bni almuntashiri, 'an aabiyhi, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa fadhakartu lahaa qawla abni 'umara maa auhibbu aan ausbiha, muhrimana aandakhu tiybana‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau aanaa tayyabtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma taafa fiy nisaaiihi thumma aasbaha muhrimana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad bin Al-Muntathir:on the authority of his father that he had asked `Aisha about the saying of Ibn `Umar (i.e. he did not like to be a Muhrim while the smell of scent was still coming from his body). `Aisha said, "I scented Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he went round (had sexual intercourse with) all his wives, and in the morning he was Muhrim (after taking a bath)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ الطِّيبِ فِي مَفْرِقِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathanaa alhakamu, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa wabiysi alttiybi fiy mafriqi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa muhrimun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:It is as if I am just looking at the glitter of scent in the parting of the Prophet's head hair while he was a Muhrim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ غَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ، وَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ ثُمَّ اغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ يُخَلِّلُ بِيَدِهِ شَعَرَهُ، حَتَّى إِذَا ظَنَّ أَنْ قَدْ أَرْوَى بَشَرَتَهُ، أَفَاضَ عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ سَائِرَ جَسَدِهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ نَغْرِفُ مِنْهُ جَمِيعًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aghtasala mina aljanaabaai ghasala yadayhi, watawaddaaa wuduw'ahu lilssalaaai thumma aghtasala, thumma yukhallilu biyadihi sha'arahu, hattaa iidhaa zanna aan qad aarwaa basharatahu, aafaada 'alayhi almaa'a thalaatha marraatin, thumma ghasala saaiira jasadihi‏.‏ waqaalat kuntu aaghtasilu aanaa warasuwlu alllahi, sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in waahidin naghrifu minhu jamiy'ana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham bin `Urwa:(on the authority of his father) `Aisha said, "Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took the bath of Janaba, he cleaned his hands and performed ablution like that for prayer and then took a bath and rubbed his hair, till he felt that the whole skin of the head had become wet, then he would pour water thrice and wash the rest of the body." `Aisha further said, "I and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to take a bath from a single water container, from which we took water simultaneously
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ غَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ، وَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ ثُمَّ اغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ يُخَلِّلُ بِيَدِهِ شَعَرَهُ، حَتَّى إِذَا ظَنَّ أَنْ قَدْ أَرْوَى بَشَرَتَهُ، أَفَاضَ عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ سَائِرَ جَسَدِهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ نَغْرِفُ مِنْهُ جَمِيعًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aghtasala mina aljanaabaai ghasala yadayhi, watawaddaaa wuduw'ahu lilssalaaai thumma aghtasala, thumma yukhallilu biyadihi sha'arahu, hattaa iidhaa zanna aan qad aarwaa basharatahu, aafaada 'alayhi almaa'a thalaatha marraatin, thumma ghasala saaiira jasadihi‏.‏ waqaalat kuntu aaghtasilu aanaa warasuwlu alllahi, sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in waahidin naghrifu minhu jamiy'ana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham bin `Urwa:(on the authority of his father) `Aisha said, "Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took the bath of Janaba, he cleaned his hands and performed ablution like that for prayer and then took a bath and rubbed his hair, till he felt that the whole skin of the head had become wet, then he would pour water thrice and wash the rest of the body." `Aisha further said, "I and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to take a bath from a single water container, from which we took water simultaneously
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، قَالَتْ وَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَضُوءًا لِجَنَابَةٍ فَأَكْفَأَ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ مَرَّتَيْنِ، أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ يَدَهُ بِالأَرْضِ ـ أَوِ الْحَائِطِ ـ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا، ثُمَّ مَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، وَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَذِرَاعَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ الْمَاءَ، ثُمَّ غَسَلَ جَسَدَهُ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى فَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِخِرْقَةٍ، فَلَمْ يُرِدْهَا، فَجَعَلَ يَنْفُضُ بِيَدِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yuwsufu bnu 'iysaa, qaala aakhbaranaa alfadlu bnu muwsaa, qaala aakhbaranaa alaa'mashu, 'an saalimin, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an maymuwnaaa, qaalat wada'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waduw'ana lijanaabaain faaakfaaa biyamiynihi 'alaa shimaalihi marratayni, aaw thalaathana, thumma ghasala farjahu, thumma daraba yadahu bialaardi aawi alhaaiiti marratayni aaw thalaathana, thumma madmada waastanshaqa, waghasala wajhahu wadhiraa'ayhi, thumma aafaada 'alaa raasihi almaa'a, thumma ghasala jasadahu, thumma tanahhaa faghasala rijlayhi‏.‏ qaalat faaataytuhu bikhirqaain, falam yuridhaa, faja'ala yanfudu biyadihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:Water was placed for the ablution of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) after Janaba. He poured water with his right hand over his left twice or thrice and then washed his private parts and rubbed his hand on the earth or on a wall twice or thrice and then rinsed his mouth, washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out and then washed his face and forearms and poured water over his head and washed his body. Then he shifted from that place and washed his feet. I brought a piece of cloth, but he did not take it and removed the traces of water from his body with his hand
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ، وَعُدِّلَتِ الصُّفُوفُ قِيَامًا، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا قَامَ فِي مُصَلاَّهُ ذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ جُنُبٌ فَقَالَ لَنَا ‏:‏ ‏ "‏ مَكَانَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَاغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَيْنَا وَرَأْسُهُ يَقْطُرُ، فَكَبَّرَ فَصَلَّيْنَا مَعَهُ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ الأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, qaala aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala auqiymati alssalaaau, wa'uddilati alssufuwfu qiyaamana, fakharaja iilaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa qaama fiy musalaaahu dhakara aannahu junubun faqaala lanaa ‏:‏ ‏ "‏ makaanakum ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma raja'a faaghtasala, thumma kharaja iilaynaa waraasuhu yaqturu, fakabbara fasallaynaa ma'ahu‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'abdu alaa'laa 'an ma'marin 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏ warawaahu alaawzaa'iyyu 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once the call (Iqama) for the prayer was announced and the rows were straightened. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out; and when he stood up at his Musalla, he remembered that he was Junub. Then he ordered us to stay at our places and went to take a bath and then returned with water dropping from his head. He said, "Allahu-Akbar", and we all offered the prayer with him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حَمْزَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الأَعْمَشَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَتْ مَيْمُونَةُ وَضَعْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُسْلاً، فَسَتَرْتُهُ بِثَوْبٍ، وَصَبَّ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ فَغَسَلَهُمَا، ثُمَّ صَبَّ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ، فَغَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، فَضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ الأَرْضَ فَمَسَحَهَا، ثُمَّ غَسَلَهَا فَمَضْمَضَ، وَاسْتَنْشَقَ، وَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَذِرَاعَيْهِ، ثُمَّ صَبَّ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، وَأَفَاضَ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ، فَنَاوَلْتُهُ ثَوْبًا فَلَمْ يَأْخُذْهُ، فَانْطَلَقَ وَهْوَ يَنْفُضُ يَدَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw hamzaaa, qaala sami'tu alaa'masha, 'an saalimin, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaalat maymuwnaau wada'tu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghuslaan, fasatartuhu bithawbin, wasabba 'alaa yadayhi faghasalahumaa, thumma sabba biyamiynihi 'alaa shimaalihi, faghasala farjahu, fadaraba biyadihi alaarda famasahahaa, thumma ghasalahaa famadmada, waastanshaqa, waghasala wajhahu wadhiraa'ayhi, thumma sabba 'alaa raasihi, waaafaada 'alaa jasadihi, thumma tanahhaa faghasala qadamayhi, fanaawaltuhu thawbana falam yaakhudhhu, faantalaqa wahwa yanfudu yadayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:I placed water for the bath of the Prophet (ﷺ) and screened him with a garment. He poured water over his hands and washed them. After that he poured water with his right hand over his left and washed his private parts, rubbed his hands with earth and washed them, rinsed his mouth, washed his nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out and then washed his face and forearms. He poured water over his head and body. He then shifted from that place and washed his feet. I gave him a piece of cloth but he did not take it and came out removing the water (from his body) with both his hands
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
