verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلاَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا إِذَا أَصَابَتْ إِحْدَانَا جَنَابَةٌ، أَخَذَتْ بِيَدَيْهَا ثَلاَثًا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهَا، ثُمَّ تَأْخُذُ بِيَدِهَا عَلَى شِقِّهَا الأَيْمَنِ، وَبِيَدِهَا الأُخْرَى عَلَى شِقِّهَا الأَيْسَرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalaaadu bnu yahyaa, qaala haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu naafi'in, 'ani alhasani bni muslimin, 'an safiyyaaa binti shaybaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kunnaa iidhaa aasaabat iihdaanaa janaabaaun, aakhadhat biyadayhaa thalaathana fawqa raasihaa, thumma taakhudhu biyadihaa 'alaa shiqqihaa alaaymani, wabiyadihaa alaukhraa 'alaa shiqqihaa alaaysari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Whenever any one of us was Junub, she poured water over her head thrice with both her hands and then rubbed the right side of her head with one hand and rubbed the left side of the head with the other hand
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَانَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ يَغْتَسِلُونَ عُرَاةً، يَنْظُرُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ، وَكَانَ مُوسَى يَغْتَسِلُ وَحْدَهُ، فَقَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا يَمْنَعُ مُوسَى أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ مَعَنَا إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ آدَرُ، فَذَهَبَ مَرَّةً يَغْتَسِلُ، فَوَضَعَ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى حَجَرٍ، فَفَرَّ الْحَجَرُ بِثَوْبِهِ، فَخَرَجَ مُوسَى فِي إِثْرِهِ يَقُولُ ثَوْبِي يَا حَجَرُ‏.‏ حَتَّى نَظَرَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ إِلَى مُوسَى، فَقَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا بِمُوسَى مِنْ بَأْسٍ‏.‏ وَأَخَذَ ثَوْبَهُ، فَطَفِقَ بِالْحَجَرِ ضَرْبًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَنَدَبٌ بِالْحَجَرِ سِتَّةٌ أَوْ سَبْعَةٌ ضَرْبًا بِالْحَجَرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu nasrin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ kaanat banuw iisraaiiyla yaghtasiluwna 'uraaaan, yanzuru ba'duhum iilaa ba'din, wakaana muwsaa yaghtasilu wahdahu, faqaaluwa waalllahi maa yamna'u muwsaa aan yaghtasila ma'anaa iilaaa aannahu adaru, fadhahaba marraaan yaghtasilu, fawada'a thawbahu 'alaa hajarin, fafarra alhajaru bithawbihi, fakharaja muwsaa fiy iithrihi yaquwlu thawbiy yaa hajaru‏.‏ hattaa nazarat banuw iisraaiiyla iilaa muwsaa, faqaaluwa waalllahi maa bimuwsaa min baasin‏.‏ waaakhadha thawbahu, fatafiqa bialhajari darbana ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw hurayraaa waalllahi iinnahu lanadabun bialhajari sittaaun aaw sab'aaun darbana bialhajari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The (people of) Bani Israel used to take bath naked (all together) looking at each other. The Prophet Moses (ﷺ) used to take a bath alone. They said, 'By Allah! Nothing prevents Moses from taking a bath with us except that he has a scrotal hernia.' So once Moses went out to take a bath and put his clothes over a stone and then that stone ran away with his clothes. Moses followed that stone saying, "My clothes, O stone! My clothes, O stone! till the people of Bani Israel saw him and said, 'By Allah, Moses has got no defect in his body. Moses took his clothes and began to beat the stone." Abu Huraira added, "By Allah! There are still six or seven marks present on the stone from that excessive beating
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَا أَيُّوبُ يَغْتَسِلُ عُرْيَانًا فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِ جَرَادٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ، فَجَعَلَ أَيُّوبُ يَحْتَثِي فِي ثَوْبِهِ، فَنَادَاهُ رَبُّهُ يَا أَيُّوبُ، أَلَمْ أَكُنْ أَغْنَيْتُكَ عَمَّا تَرَى قَالَ بَلَى وَعِزَّتِكَ وَلَكِنْ لاَ غِنَى بِي عَنْ بَرَكَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَا أَيُّوبُ يَغْتَسِلُ عُرْيَانًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ baynaa aayyuwbu yaghtasilu 'uryaanana fakharra 'alayhi jaraadun min dhahabin, faja'ala aayyuwbu yahtathiy fiy thawbihi, fanaadaahu rabbuhu yaa aayyuwbu, aalam aakun aaghnaytuka 'ammaa taraa qaala balaa wa'izzatika walakin laa ghinaa biy 'an barakatika ‏"‏‏.‏ warawaahu iibraahiymu 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa 'an safwaana 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ baynaa aayyuwbu yaghtasilu 'uryaanana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When the Prophet Job (Aiyub) (ﷺ) was taking a bath naked, golden locusts began to fall on him. Job started collecting them in his clothes. His Lord addressed him, 'O Job! Haven't I given you enough so that you are not in need of them.' Job replied, 'Yes! By Your Honor (power)! But I cannot dispense with Your Blessings
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ أَبَا مُرَّةَ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ هَانِئٍ بِنْتِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أُمَّ هَانِئٍ بِنْتَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، تَقُولُ ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ الْفَتْحِ، فَوَجَدْتُهُ يَغْتَسِلُ وَفَاطِمَةُ تَسْتُرُهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا أُمُّ هَانِئٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an aabiy alnnadri, mawlaa 'umara bni 'ubaydi alllahi aanna aabaa murraaa, mawlaa aummi haaniiin binti aabiy taalibin aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a aumma haaniiin binta aabiy taalibin, taquwlu dhahabtu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama alfathi, fawajadtuhu yaghtasilu wafaatimaau tasturuhu faqaala ‏ "‏ man hadhihi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu aanaa aummu haaniiin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Hani bint Abi Talib:I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the year of the conquest of Mecca and found him taking a bath while Fatima was screening him. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Who is it?" I replied, "I am Um-Hani
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، قَالَتْ سَتَرْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ، فَغَسَلَ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ صَبَّ بِيَمِينِهِ عَلَى شِمَالِهِ، فَغَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، وَمَا أَصَابَهُ، ثُمَّ مَسَحَ بِيَدِهِ عَلَى الْحَائِطِ أَوِ الأَرْضِ، ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلاَةِ، غَيْرَ رِجْلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ عَلَى جَسَدِهِ الْمَاءَ، ثُمَّ تَنَحَّى فَغَسَلَ قَدَمَيْهِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ أَبُو عَوَانَةَ وَابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ فِي السَّتْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an maymuwnaaa, qaalat satartu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yaghtasilu mina aljanaabaai, faghasala yadayhi thumma sabba biyamiynihi 'alaa shimaalihi, faghasala farjahu, wamaa aasaabahu, thumma masaha biyadihi 'alaa alhaaiiti aawi alaardi, thumma tawaddaaa wuduw'ahu lilssalaaai, ghayra rijlayhi, thumma aafaada 'alaa jasadihi almaa'a, thumma tanahhaa faghasala qadamayhi‏.‏ taaba'ahu aabuw 'awaanaaa waabnu fudaylin fiy alssatri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:I screened the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was taking a bath of Janaba. He washed his hands, poured water from his right hand over his left and washed his private parts. Then he rubbed his hand over a wall or the earth, and performed ablution similar to that for the prayer but did not wash his feet. Then he poured water over his body, shifted from that place, and washed his feet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ امْرَأَةُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ، هَلْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ مِنْ غُسْلٍ إِذَا هِيَ احْتَلَمَتْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ إِذَا رَأَتِ الْمَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an zaynaba binti aabiy salamaaa, 'an aummi salamaaa aummi almuuminiyna, aannahaa qaalat jaa'at aummu sulaymin amraaaau aabiy talhaaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinna alllaha laa yastahyiy mina alhaqqi, hal 'alaa almaraaai min ghuslin iidhaa hiya ahtalamat faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ na'am iidhaa raaati almaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um-Salama:(the mother of the believers) Um Sulaim, the wife of Abu Talha, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Verily Allah is not shy of (telling you) the truth. Is it necessary for a woman to take a bath after she has a wet dream (nocturnal sexual discharge)?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "Yes, if she notices a discharge
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَقِيَهُ فِي بَعْضِ طَرِيقِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَهْوَ جُنُبٌ، فَانْخَنَسْتُ مِنْهُ، فَذَهَبَ فَاغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ كُنْتَ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ كُنْتُ جُنُبًا، فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُجَالِسَكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى غَيْرِ طَهَارَةٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ لاَ يَنْجُسُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, qaala haddathanaa humaydun, qaala haddathanaa bakrun, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm laqiyahu fiy ba'di tariyqi almadiynaai wahwa junubun, faankhanastu minhu, fadhahaba faaghtasala, thumma jaa'a faqaala ‏"‏ aayna kunta yaa aabaa hurayraaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala kuntu junubana, fakarihtu aan aujaalisaka waaanaa 'alaa ghayri tahaaraain‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ subhaana alllahi, iinna almuumina laa yanjusu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) came across me in one of the streets of Medina and at that time I was Junub. So I slipped away from him and went to take a bath. On my return the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Huraira! Where have you been?" I replied, "I was Junub, so I disliked to sit in your company." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Subhan Allah! A believer never becomes impure
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَطُوفُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فِي اللَّيْلَةِ الْوَاحِدَةِ، وَلَهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ تِسْعُ نِسْوَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, qaala haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, qaala haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, aanna aanasa bna maalikin, haddathahum aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yatuwfu 'alaa nisaaiihi fiy alllaylaai alwaahidaai, walahu yawmaiidhin tis'u niswaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to visit all his wives in one night and he had nine wives at that time
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ لَقِيَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا جُنُبٌ، فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي، فَمَشَيْتُ مَعَهُ حَتَّى قَعَدَ فَانْسَلَلْتُ، فَأَتَيْتُ الرَّحْلَ، فَاغْتَسَلْتُ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ وَهْوَ قَاعِدٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ كُنْتَ يَا أَبَا هِرٍّ ‏"‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ يَا أَبَا هِرٍّ إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ لاَ يَنْجُسُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ayyaashun, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa humaydun, 'an bakrin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala laqiyaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa junubun, faaakhadha biyadiy, famashaytu ma'ahu hattaa qa'ada faansalaltu, faaataytu alrrahla, faaghtasaltu thumma jiitu wahwa qaa'idun faqaala ‏"‏ aayna kunta yaa aabaa hirrin ‏"‏ faqultu lahu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ subhaana alllahi yaa aabaa hirrin iinna almuumina laa yanjusu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came across me and I was Junub. He took my hand and I went along with him till he sat down I slipped away, went home and took a bath. When I came back, he was still sitting there. He then said to me, "O Abu Huraira! Where have you been?' I told him about it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Subhan Allah! O Abu Huraira! A believer never becomes impure
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، وَشَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَرْقُدُ وَهْوَ جُنُبٌ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ وَيَتَوَضَّأُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa hishaamun, washaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa aakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yarqudu wahwa junubun qaalat na'am wayatawaddaau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Salama:I asked `Aisha "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to sleep while he was Junub?" She replied, "Yes, but he used to perform ablution (before going to bed)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيَرْقُدُ أَحَدُنَا وَهْوَ جُنُبٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَرْقُدْ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aayarqudu aahadunaa wahwa junubun qaala ‏ "‏ na'am iidhaa tawaddaaa aahadukum falyarqud wahuwa junubun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) "Can any one of us sleep while he is Junub?" He replied, "Yes, if he performs ablution, he can sleep while he is Junub
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ وَهْوَ جُنُبٌ، غَسَلَ فَرْجَهُ، وَتَوَضَّأَ لِلصَّلاَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy ja'farin, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aaraada aan yanaama wahwa junubun, ghasala farjahu, watawaddaaa lilssalaaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) intended to sleep while he was Junub, he used to wash his private parts and perform ablution like that for the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ اسْتَفْتَى عُمَرُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيَنَامُ أَحَدُنَا وَهْوَ جُنُبٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ، إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala astaftaa 'umaru alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aayanaamu aahadunaa wahwa junubun qaala ‏ "‏ na'am, iidhaa tawaddaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:`Umar asked the Prophet (ﷺ) "Can anyone of us sleep while he is Junub?" He replied, "Yes, if he performs ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ ذَكَرَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ تُصِيبُهُ الْجَنَابَةُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَوَضَّأْ وَاغْسِلْ ذَكَرَكَ ثُمَّ نَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aannahu qaala dhakara 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu tusiybuhu aljanaabaau mina alllayli, faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tawaddaa waaghsil dhakaraka thumma nam ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "I became Junub at night." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "Perform ablution after washing your private parts and then sleep
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا جَلَسَ بَيْنَ شُعَبِهَا الأَرْبَعِ ثُمَّ جَهَدَهَا، فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغَسْلُ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَمْرُو بْنُ مَرْزُوقٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu fadaalaaa, qaala haddathanaa hishaamun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, 'an hishaamin, 'an qataadaaa, 'ani alhasani, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa jalasa bayna shu'abihaa alaarba'i thumma jahadahaa, faqad wajaba alghaslu ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'amruw bnu marzuwqin 'an shu'baaa mithlahu‏.‏ waqaala muwsaa haddathanaa aabaanu qaala haddathanaa qataadaau aakhbaranaa alhasanu mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham:as the following Hadith 290. Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a man sits in between the four parts of a woman and did the sexual intercourse with her, bath becomes compulsory
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ، قَالَ يَحْيَى وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ عَطَاءَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَأَلَ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ فَقَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِذَا جَامَعَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ فَلَمْ يُمْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ يَتَوَضَّأُ كَمَا يَتَوَضَّأُ لِلصَّلاَةِ، وَيَغْسِلُ ذَكَرَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَسَأَلْتُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَالزُّبَيْرَ بْنَ الْعَوَّامِ وَطَلْحَةَ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَأُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ فَأَمَرُوهُ بِذَلِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'ani alhusayni, qaala yahyaa waaakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa, aanna 'ataa'a bna yasaarin, aakhbarahu aanna zayda bna khaalidin aljuhaniyya aakhbarahu aannahu, saaala 'uthmaana bna 'affaana faqaala aaraaayta iidhaa jaama'a alrrajulu amraaatahu falam yumni‏.‏ qaala 'uthmaanu yatawaddaau kamaa yatawaddaau lilssalaaai, wayaghsilu dhakarahu‏.‏ qaala 'uthmaanu sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ fasaaaltu 'an dhalika 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin waalzzubayra bna al'awwaami watalhaaa bna 'ubaydi alllahi waaubaaaa bna ka'bin rda allh 'nhm faaamaruwhu bidhalika‏.‏ qaala yahyaa waaakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa aanna 'urwaaa bna alzzubayri aakhbarahu aanna aabaa aayyuwba aakhbarahu aannahu sami'a dhalika min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:I asked `Uthman bin `Affan about a man who engaged in the sexual intercourse with his wife but did not discharge. `Uthman replied, "He should perform ablution like that for the prayer after washing his private parts." `Uthman added, "I heard that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." I asked `Ali bin Abi Talib, Az-Zubair bin Al-`Awwam, Talha bin 'Ubaidullah and Ubai bin Ka`b and they gave the same reply. (Abu Aiyub said that he had heard that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ) (This order was canceled later on so one has to take a bath. See, Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِذَا جَامَعَ الرَّجُلُ الْمَرْأَةَ فَلَمْ يُنْزِلْ قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَغْسِلُ مَا مَسَّ الْمَرْأَةَ مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ وَيُصَلِّي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْغَسْلُ أَحْوَطُ، وَذَاكَ الآخِرُ، وَإِنَّمَا بَيَّنَّا لاِخْتِلاَفِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa musadaadun, hadaathanaa yahyaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy qaala, aakhbaraniy aabuw aayuuwba, qaala aakhbaraniy aubaauu bnu ka'bin, aanaahu qaala yaa rasuwla allaahi iidhaa jaama'a alraajulu almaraaaa falam yunzil qaala ‏ "‏ yaghsilu maa masaa almaraaaa minhu, thumaa yatawadaaau wayusaliiy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi allaahi alghaslu aahwatu, wadhaaka alakhiru, waiinaamaa bayaanaaa laikhtilaafihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ubai bin Ka`b:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about a man who engages in sexual intercourse with his wife but does not discharge. He replied, "He should wash the parts which comes in contact with the private parts of the woman, perform ablution and then pray." (Abu `Abdullah said, "Taking a bath is safer and is the last order)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، تَقُولُ خَرَجْنَا لاَ نَرَى إِلاَّ الْحَجَّ، فَلَمَّا كُنَّا بِسَرِفَ حِضْتُ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا أَبْكِي قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكِ أَنُفِسْتِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذَا أَمْرٌ كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى بَنَاتِ آدَمَ، فَاقْضِي مَا يَقْضِي الْحَاجُّ، غَيْرَ أَنْ لاَ تَطُوفِي بِالْبَيْتِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَضَحَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ نِسَائِهِ بِالْبَقَرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'aliyuu bnu 'abdi allaahi, qaala hadaathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'tu 'abda alraahmani bna alqaasimi, qaala sami'tu alqaasima, yaquwlu sami'tu 'aaiishaaa, taquwlu kharajnaa laa naraa iilaaa alhajaa, falamaaa kunaaa bisarifa hidtu, fadakhala 'alaaaa rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa aabkiy qaala ‏"‏ maa laki aanufisti ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinaa hadhaa aamrun katabahu allaahu 'alaa banaati adama, faaqdiy maa yaqdiy alhaajuu, ghayra aan laa tatuwfiy bialbayti ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat wadahaaa rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an nisaaiihi bialbaqari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Qasim:`Aisha said, "We set out with the sole intention of performing Hajj and when we reached Sarif, (a place six miles from Mecca) I got my menses. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to me while I was weeping. He said 'What is the matter with you? Have you got your menses?' I replied, 'Yes.' He said, 'This is a thing which Allah has ordained for the daughters of Adam. So do what all the pilgrims do with the exception of the Tawaf (Circumambulation) round the Ka`ba." `Aisha added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sacrificed cows on behalf of his wives
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أُرَجِّلُ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu aurajjilu raasa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa haaiidun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:While in menses, I used to comb the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامٌ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ أَتَخْدُمُنِي الْحَائِضُ أَوْ تَدْنُو مِنِّي الْمَرْأَةُ وَهْىَ جُنُبٌ فَقَالَ عُرْوَةُ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ، وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ تَخْدُمُنِي، وَلَيْسَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ فِي ذَلِكَ بَأْسٌ، أَخْبَرَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تُرَجِّلُ ـ تَعْنِي ـ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَئِذٍ مُجَاوِرٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، يُدْنِي لَهَا رَأْسَهُ وَهْىَ فِي حُجْرَتِهَا، فَتُرَجِّلُهُ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, qaala aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu yuwsufa, aanna abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum qaala aakhbaraniy hishaamun, 'an 'urwaaa, aannahu suiila aatakhdumuniy alhaaiidu aaw tadnuw minniy almaraaau wahaa junubun faqaala 'urwaau kullu dhalika 'alaaaa hayyinun, wakullu dhalika takhdumuniy, walaysa 'alaa aahadin fiy dhalika baasun, aakhbaratniy 'aaiishaau aannahaa kaanat turajjilu ta'niy raasa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahiya haaiidun, warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiynaiidhin mujaawirun fiy almasjidi, yudniy lahaa raasahu wahaa fiy hujratihaa, faturajjiluhu wahaa haaiidun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa:A person asked me, "Can a woman in menses serve me? And can a Junub woman come close to me?" I replied, "All this is easy for me. All of them can serve me, and there is no harm for any other person to do the same. `Aisha told me that she used to comb the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while she was in her menses, and he was in I`tikaf (in the mosque). He would bring his head near her in her room and she would comb his hair, while she used to be in her menses
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، سَمِعَ زُهَيْرًا، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ابْنِ صَفِيَّةَ، أَنَّ أُمَّهُ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ حَدَّثَتْهَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَتَّكِئُ فِي حَجْرِي وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin alfadlu bnu dukaynin, sami'a zuhayrana, 'an mansuwrin abni safiyyaaa, aanna aummahu, haddathathu aanna 'aaiishaaa haddathathaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yattakiiu fiy hajriy waaanaa haaiidun, thumma yaqraau alqurana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to lean on my lap and recite Qur'an while I was in menses
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَتْهَا قَالَتْ، بَيْنَا أَنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مُضْطَجِعَةً فِي خَمِيصَةٍ إِذْ حِضْتُ، فَانْسَلَلْتُ فَأَخَذْتُ ثِيَابَ حِيضَتِي قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنُفِسْتِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَدَعَانِي فَاضْطَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ فِي الْخَمِيلَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa almakkiyyu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, aanna zaynaba abnaaa aummi salamaaa, haddathathu aanna aumma salamaaa haddathathaa qaalat, baynaa aanaa ma'a alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm mudtaji'aaan fiy khamiysaain iidh hidtu, faansalaltu faaakhadhtu thiyaaba hiydatiy qaala ‏ "‏ aanufisti ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ fada'aaniy faadtaja'tu ma'ahu fiy alkhamiylaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:While I was laying with the Prophet (ﷺ) under a single woolen sheet, I got the menses. I slipped away and put on the clothes for menses. He said, "Have you got "Nifas" (menses)?" I replied, "Yes." He then called me and made me lie with him under the same sheet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ، كِلاَنَا جُنُبٌ‏.‏ وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُنِي فَأَتَّزِرُ، فَيُبَاشِرُنِي وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ‏.‏ وَكَانَ يُخْرِجُ رَأْسَهُ إِلَىَّ وَهُوَ مُعْتَكِفٌ، فَأَغْسِلُهُ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu aaghtasilu aanaa waalnnabiyyu, sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in waahidin, kilaanaa junubun‏.‏ wakaana yaamuruniy faaattaziru, fayubaashiruniy waaanaa haaiidun‏.‏ wakaana yukhriju raasahu iilaaaa wahuwa mu'takifun, faaaghsiluhu waaanaa haaiidun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take a bath from a single pot while we were Junub. During the menses, he used to order me to put on an Izar (dress worn below the waist) and used to fondle me. While in I`tikaf, he used to bring his head near me and I would wash it while I used to be in my periods (menses)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ ـ هُوَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ ـ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا إِذَا كَانَتْ حَائِضًا، فَأَرَادَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُبَاشِرَهَا، أَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَتَّزِرَ فِي فَوْرِ حَيْضَتِهَا ثُمَّ يُبَاشِرُهَا‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَأَيُّكُمْ يَمْلِكُ إِرْبَهُ كَمَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْلِكُ إِرْبَهُ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ خَالِدٌ وَجَرِيرٌ عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu khaliylin, qaala aakhbaranaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw iishaaqa huwa alshhaybaaniyyu 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alaaswadi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaanat iihdaanaa iidhaa kaanat haaiidana, faaaraada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yubaashirahaa, aamarahaa aan tattazira fiy fawri haydatihaa thumma yubaashiruhaa‏.‏ qaalat waaayyukum yamliku iirbahu kamaa kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yamliku iirbahu‏.‏ taaba'ahu khaalidun wajariyrun 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Al-Aswad:(on the authority of his father) `Aisha said: "Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to fondle anyone of us during her periods (menses), he used to order her to put on an Izar and start fondling her." `Aisha added, "None of you could control his sexual desires as the Prophet (ﷺ) could
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَيْمُونَةَ، كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُبَاشِرَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ نِسَائِهِ أَمَرَهَا فَاتَّزَرَتْ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, qaala haddathanaa alshhaybaaniyyu, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu shaddaadin, qaala sami'tu maymuwnaaa, kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aaraada aan yubaashira amraaaaan min nisaaiihi aamarahaa faattazarat wahaa haaiidun‏.‏ warawaahu sufyaanu 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:When ever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to fondle any of his wives during the periods (menses), he used to ask her to wear an Izar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدٌ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ أَسْلَمَ ـ عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَضْحًى ـ أَوْ فِطْرٍ ـ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى، فَمَرَّ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ النِّسَاءِ تَصَدَّقْنَ، فَإِنِّي أُرِيتُكُنَّ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْنَ وَبِمَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ تُكْثِرْنَ اللَّعْنَ، وَتَكْفُرْنَ الْعَشِيرَ، مَا رَأَيْتُ مِنْ نَاقِصَاتِ عَقْلٍ وَدِينٍ أَذْهَبَ لِلُبِّ الرَّجُلِ الْحَازِمِ مِنْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَ وَمَا نُقْصَانُ دِينِنَا وَعَقْلِنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ شَهَادَةُ الْمَرْأَةِ مِثْلَ نِصْفِ شَهَادَةِ الرَّجُلِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَذَلِكَ مِنْ نُقْصَانِ عَقْلِهَا، أَلَيْسَ إِذَا حَاضَتْ لَمْ تُصَلِّ وَلَمْ تَصُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَ بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَذَلِكَ مِنْ نُقْصَانِ دِينِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, qaala aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala aakhbaraniy zaydun huwa abnu aaslama 'an 'iyaadi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy aadhana aaw fitrin iilaa almusallaa, famarra 'alaa alnnisaa'i faqaala ‏"‏ yaa ma'shara alnnisaa'i tasaddaqna, faiinniy auriytukunna aakthara aahli alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ faqulna wabima yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ tukthirna allla'na, watakfurna al'ashiyra, maa raaaytu min naaqisaati 'aqlin wadiynin aadhhaba lilubbi alrrajuli alhaazimi min iihdaakunna ‏"‏‏.‏ qulna wamaa nuqsaanu diyninaa wa'aqlinaa yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ aalaysa shahaadaau almaraaai mithla nisfi shahaadaai alrrajuli ‏"‏‏.‏ qulna balaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fadhalika min nuqsaani 'aqlihaa, aalaysa iidhaa haadat lam tusalli walam tasum ‏"‏‏.‏ qulna balaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fadhalika min nuqsaani diynihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to the Musalla (to offer the prayer) of `Id-al-Adha or Al-Fitr prayer. Then he passed by the women and said, "O women! Give alms, as I have seen that the majority of the dwellers of Hell-fire were you (women)." They asked, "Why is it so, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" He replied, "You curse frequently and are ungrateful to your husbands. I have not seen anyone more deficient in intelligence and religion than you. A cautious sensible man could be led astray by some of you." The women asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is deficient in our intelligence and religion?" He said, "Is not the evidence of two women equal to the witness of one man?" They replied in the affirmative. He said, "This is the deficiency in her intelligence. Isn't it true that a woman can neither pray nor fast during her menses?" The women replied in the affirmative. He said, "This is the deficiency in her religion
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ نَذْكُرُ إِلاَّ الْحَجَّ، فَلَمَّا جِئْنَا سَرِفَ طَمِثْتُ، فَدَخَلَ عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا أَبْكِي فَقَالَ ‏{‏مَا يُبْكِيكِ‏}‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَوَدِدْتُ وَاللَّهِ أَنِّي لَمْ أَحُجَّ الْعَامَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏{‏لَعَلَّكِ نُفِسْتِ‏}‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ شَىْءٌ كَتَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى بَنَاتِ آدَمَ، فَافْعَلِي مَا يَفْعَلُ الْحَاجُّ، غَيْرَ أَنْ لاَ تَطُوفِي بِالْبَيْتِ حَتَّى تَطْهُرِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kharajnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa nadhkuru iilaaa alhajja, falammaa jiinaa sarifa tamithtu, fadakhala 'alaaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa aabkiy faqaala ‏{‏maa yubkiyki‏}‏‏.‏ qultu lawadidtu waalllahi aanniy lam aahujja al'aama‏.‏ qaala ‏{‏la'allaki nufisti‏}‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ faiinna dhalika shaa'un katabahu alllahu 'alaa banaati adama, faaf'aliy maa yaf'alu alhaajju, ghayra aan laa tatuwfiy bialbayti hattaa tathuriy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:We set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) for Hajj and when we reached Sarif I got my menses. When the Prophet (ﷺ) came to me, I was weeping. He asked, "Why are you weeping?" I said, "I wish if I had not performed Hajj this year." He asked, "May be that you got your menses?" I replied, "Yes." He then said, "This is the thing which Allah has ordained for all the daughters of Adam. So do what all the pilgrims do except that you do not perform the Tawaf round the Ka`ba till you are clean
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ قَالَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لاَ أَطْهُرُ، أَفَأَدَعُ الصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ وَلَيْسَ بِالْحَيْضَةِ، فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَاتْرُكِي الصَّلاَةَ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ قَدْرُهَا فَاغْسِلِي عَنْكِ الدَّمَ وَصَلِّي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat qaalat faatimaau bintu aabiy hubayshin lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy laa aathuru, aafaaada'u alssalaaaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnamaa dhaliki 'irqun walaysa bialhaydaai, faiidhaa aaqbalati alhaydaau faatrukiy alssalaaaa, faiidhaa dhahaba qadruhaa faaghsiliy 'anki alddama wasalliy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima bint Abi Hubaish said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I do not become clean (from bleeding). Shall I give up my prayers?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied: "No, because it is from a blood vessel and not the menses. So when the real menses begins give up your prayers and when it (the period) has finished wash the blood off your body (take a bath) and offer your prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ سَأَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَرَأَيْتَ إِحْدَانَا إِذَا أَصَابَ ثَوْبَهَا الدَّمُ مِنَ الْحَيْضَةِ، كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَصَابَ ثَوْبَ إِحْدَاكُنَّ الدَّمُ مِنَ الْحَيْضَةِ، فَلْتَقْرُصْهُ ثُمَّ لِتَنْضَحْهُ بِمَاءٍ، ثُمَّ لِتُصَلِّي فِيهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaamin, 'an faatimaaa binti almundhiri, 'an aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin, aannahaa qaalat saaalati amraaaaun rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi, aaraaayta iihdaanaa iidhaa aasaaba thawbahaa alddamu mina alhaydaai, kayfa tasna'u faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aasaaba thawba iihdaakunna alddamu mina alhaydaai, faltaqrushu thumma litandahhu bimaa'in, thumma litusalliy fiyhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Asma' bint Abi Bakr:A woman asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What should we do, if the blood of menses falls on our clothes?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "If the blood of menses falls on the garment of anyone of you, she must take hold of the blood spot, rub it, and wash it with water and then pray in (with it)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَصْبَغُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا تَحِيضُ، ثُمَّ تَقْتَرِصُ الدَّمَ مِنْ ثَوْبِهَا عِنْدَ طُهْرِهَا فَتَغْسِلُهُ، وَتَنْضَحُ عَلَى سَائِرِهِ، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي فِيهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aasbaghu, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, haddathahu 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaanat iihdaanaa tahiydu, thumma taqtarisu alddama min thawbihaa 'inda tuhrihaa fataghsiluhu, watandahu 'alaa saaiirihi, thumma tusalliy fiyhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Whenever anyone of us got her menses, she, on becoming clean, used to take hold of the blood spot and rub the blood off her garment, and pour water over it and wash that portion thoroughly and sprinkle water over the rest of the garment. After that she would pray in (with) it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اعْتَكَفَ مَعَهُ بَعْضُ نِسَائِهِ وَهْىَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ تَرَى الدَّمَ، فَرُبَّمَا وَضَعَتِ الطَّسْتَ تَحْتَهَا مِنَ الدَّمِ‏.‏ وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ رَأَتْ مَاءَ الْعُصْفُرِ فَقَالَتْ كَأَنَّ هَذَا شَىْءٌ كَانَتْ فُلاَنَةُ تَجِدُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, qaala haddathanaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an khaalidin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm a'takafa ma'ahu ba'du nisaaiihi wahaa mustahaadaaun taraa alddama, farubbamaa wada'ati alttasta tahtahaa mina alddami‏.‏ waza'ama aanna 'aaiishaaa raaat maa'a al'usfuri faqaalat kaaanna hadhaa shaa'un kaanat fulaanaau tajiduhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Once one of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) did I`tikaf along with him and she was getting bleeding in between her periods. She used to see the blood (from her private parts) and she would perhaps put a dish under her for the blood. (The sub-narrator `Ikrima added, `Aisha once saw the liquid of safflower and said, "It looks like what so and so used to have)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتِ اعْتَكَفَتْ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ، فَكَانَتْ تَرَى الدَّمَ وَالصُّفْرَةَ، وَالطَّسْتُ تَحْتَهَا وَهْىَ تُصَلِّي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, qaala haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an khaalidin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalati a'takafat ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm amraaaaun min aazwaajihi, fakaanat taraa alddama waalssufraaa, waalttastu tahtahaa wahaa tusalliy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:"One of the wives of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) joined him in I`tikaf and she noticed blood and yellowish discharge (from her private parts) and put a dish under her when she prayed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ بَعْضَ، أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اعْتَكَفَتْ وَهْىَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an khaalidin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna ba'da, aummahaati almuuminiyna a'takafat wahaa mustahaadaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:One of the mothers of the faithful believers (i.e. the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) did I`tikaf while she was having bleeding in between her periods
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ مَا كَانَ لإِحْدَانَا إِلاَّ ثَوْبٌ وَاحِدٌ تَحِيضُ فِيهِ، فَإِذَا أَصَابَهُ شَىْءٌ مِنْ دَمٍ، قَالَتْ بِرِيقِهَا فَقَصَعَتْهُ بِظُفْرِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu naafi'in, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, 'an mujaahidin, qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau maa kaana liihdaanaa iilaaa thawbun waahidun tahiydu fiyhi, faiidhaa aasaabahu shaa'un min damin, qaalat biriyqihaa faqasa'athu bizufrihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:None of us had more than a single garment and we used to have our menses while wearing it. Whenever it got soiled with blood of menses we used to apply saliva to the blood spot and rub off the blood with our nails
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ ـ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَوْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ قَالَتْ كُنَّا نُنْهَى أَنْ نُحِدَّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ، إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا، وَلاَ نَكْتَحِلَ وَلاَ نَتَطَيَّبَ وَلاَ نَلْبَسَ ثَوْبًا مَصْبُوغًا إِلاَّ ثَوْبَ عَصْبٍ، وَقَدْ رُخِّصَ لَنَا عِنْدَ الطُّهْرِ إِذَا اغْتَسَلَتْ إِحْدَانَا مِنْ مَحِيضِهَا فِي نُبْذَةٍ مِنْ كُسْتِ أَظْفَارٍ، وَكُنَّا نُنْهَى عَنِ اتِّبَاعِ الْجَنَائِزِ‏.‏ قَالَ رَوَاهُ هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alwahhaabi, qaala haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an hafsaaa qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi aaw hishaami bni hassaana 'an hafsaaa, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa qaalat kunnaa nunhaa aan nuhidda 'alaa mayyitin fawqa thalaathin, iilaaa 'alaa zawjin aarba'aaa aashhurin wa'ashrana, walaa naktahila walaa natatayyaba walaa nalbasa thawbana masbuwghana iilaaa thawba 'asbin, waqad rukhhisa lanaa 'inda alttuhri iidhaa aghtasalat iihdaanaa min mahiydihaa fiy nubdhaain min kusti aazfaarin, wakunnaa nunhaa 'ani attibaa'i aljanaaiizi‏.‏ qaala rawaahu hishaamu bnu hassaana 'an hafsaaa 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um-`Atiya:We were forbidden to mourn for a dead person for more than three days except in the case of a husband for whom mourning was allowed for four months and ten days. (During that time) we were not allowed to put kohl (Antimony eye power) in our eyes or to use perfumes or to put on colored clothes except a dress made of `Asb (a kind of Yemen cloth, very coarse and rough). We were allowed very light perfumes at the time of taking a bath after menses and also we were forbidden to go with the funeral procession
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ ابْنِ صَفِيَّةَ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، سَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ غُسْلِهَا مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ، فَأَمَرَهَا كَيْفَ تَغْتَسِلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ خُذِي فِرْصَةً مِنْ مِسْكٍ فَتَطَهَّرِي بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ كَيْفَ أَتَطَهَّرُ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَطَهَّرِي بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ كَيْفَ قَالَ ‏"‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ تَطَهَّرِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاجْتَبَذْتُهَا إِلَىَّ فَقُلْتُ تَتَبَّعِي بِهَا أَثَرَ الدَّمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa, qaala haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an mansuwri abni safiyyaaa, 'an aummihi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna amraaaaan, saaalati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an ghuslihaa mina almahiydi, faaamarahaa kayfa taghtasilu qaala ‏"‏ khudhiy firsaaan min miskin fatatahhariy bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat kayfa aatatahharu qaala ‏"‏ tatahhariy bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat kayfa qaala ‏"‏ subhaana alllahi tatahhariy ‏"‏‏.‏ faajtabadhtuhaa iilaaaa faqultu tatabba'iy bihaa aathara alddami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:A woman asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about the bath which is taken after finishing from the menses. The Prophet (ﷺ) told her what to do and said, "Purify yourself with a piece of cloth scented with musk." The woman asked, "How shall I purify myself with it?" He said, "Subhan Allah! Purify yourself (with it)." I pulled her to myself and said, "Rub the place soiled with blood with it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ قَالَتْ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَيْفَ أَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ قَالَ ‏"‏ خُذِي فِرْصَةً مُمَسَّكَةً، فَتَوَضَّئِي ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَحْيَا فَأَعْرَضَ بِوَجْهِهِ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَوَضَّئِي بِهَا ‏"‏ فَأَخَذْتُهَا فَجَذَبْتُهَا فَأَخْبَرْتُهَا بِمَا يُرِيدُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, qaala haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa mansuwrun, 'an aummihi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna amraaaaan, mina alaansaari qaalat lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kayfa aaghtasilu mina almahiydi qaala ‏"‏ khudhiy firsaaan mumassakaaan, fatawaddaiiy thalaathana ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm astahyaa faaa'rada biwajhihi aaw qaala ‏"‏ tawaddaiiy bihaa ‏"‏ faaakhadhtuhaa fajadhabtuhaa faaakhbartuhaa bimaa yuriydu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:An Ansari woman asked the Prophet (ﷺ) how to take a bath after finishing from the menses. He replied, "Take a piece of cloth perfumed with musk and clean the private parts with it thrice." The Prophet (ﷺ) felt shy and turned his face. So I pulled her to me and told her what the Prophet (ﷺ) meant
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَهْلَلْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، فَكُنْتُ مِمَّنْ تَمَتَّعَ، وَلَمْ يَسُقِ الْهَدْىَ، فَزَعَمَتْ أَنَّهَا حَاضَتْ، وَلَمْ تَطْهُرْ حَتَّى دَخَلَتْ لَيْلَةُ عَرَفَةَ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذِهِ لَيْلَةُ عَرَفَةَ، وَإِنَّمَا كُنْتُ تَمَتَّعْتُ بِعُمْرَةٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ انْقُضِي رَأْسَكِ، وَامْتَشِطِي، وَأَمْسِكِي عَنْ عُمْرَتِكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَفَعَلْتُ، فَلَمَّا قَضَيْتُ الْحَجَّ أَمَرَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ لَيْلَةَ الْحَصْبَةِ فَأَعْمَرَنِي مِنَ التَّنْعِيمِ مَكَانَ عُمْرَتِي الَّتِي نَسَكْتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, aanna 'aaiishaaa, qaalat aahlaltu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i, fakuntu mimman tamatta'a, walam yasuqi alhadaa, faza'amat aannahaa haadat, walam tathur hattaa dakhalat laylaau 'arafaaa faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi, hadhihi laylaau 'arafaaa, waiinnamaa kuntu tamatta'tu bi'umraain‏.‏ faqaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ anqudiy raasaki, waamtashitiy, waaamsikiy 'an 'umratiki ‏"‏‏.‏ fafa'altu, falammaa qadaytu alhajja aamara 'abda alrrahmani laylaaa alhasbaai faaa'maraniy mina alttan'iymi makaana 'umratiy allatiy nasaktu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:In the last Hajj of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assumed the Ihram for Hajj along with Allah's Apostle. I was one of those who intended Tamattu` (to perform Hajj and `Umra) and did not take the Hadi (animal for sacrifice) with me. I got my menses and was not clean till the night of `Arafa I said, "O Allah's Apostle! It is the night of the day of `Arafat and I intended to perform the Hajj Tamattu` with `Umra. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me to undo my hair and comb it and to postpone the `Umra. I did the same and completed the Hajj. On the night of Al-Hasba (i.e. place outside Mecca where the pilgrims go after finishing all the ceremonies of Hajj at Mina) he (the Prophet) ordered `Abdur Rahman (`Aisha's brother) to take me to at-Tan`im to assume the Ihram for `Umra in lieu of that of Hajj-at-Tamattu` which I had intended to perform
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مُوَافِينَ لِهِلاَلِ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُهِلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ فَلْيُهْلِلْ، فَإِنِّي لَوْلاَ أَنِّي أَهْدَيْتُ لأَهْلَلْتُ بِعُمْرَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَهَلَّ بَعْضُهُمْ بِعُمْرَةٍ، وَأَهَلَّ بَعْضُهُمْ بِحَجٍّ، وَكُنْتُ أَنَا مِمَّنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ، فَأَدْرَكَنِي يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ، فَشَكَوْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعِي عُمْرَتَكِ، وَانْقُضِي رَأْسَكِ وَامْتَشِطِي، وَأَهِلِّي بِحَجٍّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَفَعَلْتُ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ لَيْلَةُ الْحَصْبَةِ أَرْسَلَ مَعِي أَخِي عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، فَخَرَجْتُ إِلَى التَّنْعِيمِ، فَأَهْلَلْتُ بِعُمْرَةٍ مَكَانَ عُمْرَتِي‏.‏ قَالَ هِشَامٌ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ هَدْىٌ وَلاَ صَوْمٌ وَلاَ صَدَقَةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kharajnaa muwaafiyna lihilaali dhiy alhijjaai, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man aahabba aan yuhilla bi'umraain falyuhlil, faiinniy lawlaa aanniy aahdaytu laahlaltu bi'umraain ‏"‏‏.‏ faaahalla ba'duhum bi'umraain, waaahalla ba'duhum bihajjin, wakuntu aanaa mimman aahalla bi'umraain, faaadrakaniy yawmu 'arafaaa waaanaa haaiidun, fashakawtu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ da'iy 'umrataki, waanqudiy raasaki waamtashitiy, waaahilliy bihajjin ‏"‏‏.‏ fafa'altu hattaa iidhaa kaana laylaau alhasbaai aarsala ma'iy aakhiy 'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy bakrin, fakharajtu iilaa alttan'iymi, faaahlaltu bi'umraain makaana 'umratiy‏.‏ qaala hishaamun walam yakun fiy shaa'in min dhalika hadaun walaa sawmun walaa sadaqaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:On the 1st of Dhul-Hijja we set out with the intention of performing Hajj. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Any one who likes to assume the Ihram for `Umra he can do so. Had I not brought the Hadi with me, I would have assumed the Ihram for `Umra. "Some of us assumed the Ihram for `Umra while the others assumed the Ihram for Hajj. I was one of those who assumed the Ihram for `Umra. I got menses and kept on menstruating until the day of `Arafat and complained of that to the Prophet. He told me to postpone my `Umra, undo and comb my hair, and to assume the Ihram of Hajj and I did so. On the night of Hasba, he sent my brother `Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr with me to at-Tan`im, where I assumed the Ihram for `Umra in lieu of the previous one. Hisham said, "For that (`Umra) no Hadi, fasting or alms were required
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ ـ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ـ وَكَّلَ بِالرَّحِمِ مَلَكًا يَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ نُطْفَةٌ، يَا رَبِّ عَلَقَةٌ، يَا رَبِّ مُضْغَةٌ‏.‏ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ خَلْقَهُ قَالَ أَذَكَرٌ أَمْ أُنْثَى شَقِيٌّ أَمْ سَعِيدٌ فَمَا الرِّزْقُ وَالأَجَلُ فَيُكْتَبُ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha 'azza wajalla wakkala bialrrahimi malakana yaquwlu yaa rabbi nutfaaun, yaa rabbi 'alaqaaun, yaa rabbi mudghaaun‏.‏ faiidhaa aaraada aan yaqdiya khalqahu qaala aadhakarun aam aunthaa shaqiyyun aam sa'iydun famaa alrrizqu waalaajalu fayuktabu fiy batni aummihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "At every womb Allah appoints an angel who says, 'O Lord! A drop of semen, O Lord! A clot. O Lord! A little lump of flesh." Then if Allah wishes (to complete) its creation, the angel asks, (O Lord!) Will it be a male or female, a wretched or a blessed, and how much will his provision be? And what will his age be?' So all that is written while the child is still in the mother's womb
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، فَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ، وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجٍّ، فَقَدِمْنَا مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَحْرَمَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَلَمْ يُهْدِ فَلْيُحْلِلْ، وَمَنْ أَحْرَمَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَأَهْدَى فَلاَ يَحِلُّ حَتَّى يَحِلَّ بِنَحْرِ هَدْيِهِ، وَمَنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجٍّ فَلْيُتِمَّ حَجَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَحِضْتُ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ حَائِضًا حَتَّى كَانَ يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ، وَلَمْ أُهْلِلْ إِلاَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ، فَأَمَرَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَنْقُضَ رَأْسِي وَأَمْتَشِطَ، وَأُهِلَّ بِحَجٍّ، وَأَتْرُكَ الْعُمْرَةَ، فَفَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَضَيْتُ حَجِّي، فَبَعَثَ مَعِي عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَعْتَمِرَ مَكَانَ عُمْرَتِي مِنَ التَّنْعِيمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kharajnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i, faminnaa man aahalla bi'umraain, waminnaa man aahalla bihajjin, faqadimnaa makkaaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aahrama bi'umraain walam yuhdi falyuhlil, waman aahrama bi'umraain waaahdaa falaa yahillu hattaa yahilla binahri hadyihi, waman aahalla bihajjin falyutimma hajjahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat fahidtu falam aazal haaiidana hattaa kaana yawmu 'arafaaa, walam auhlil iilaaa bi'umraain, faaamaraniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan aanquda raasiy waaamtashita, waauhilla bihajjin, waaatruka al'umraaa, fafa'altu dhalika hattaa qadaytu hajjiy, faba'atha ma'iy 'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy bakrin, waaamaraniy aan aa'tamira makaana 'umratiy mina alttan'iymi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa:`Aisha said, "We set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) in his last Hajj. Some of us intended to perform `Umra while others Hajj. When we reached Mecca, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Those who had assumed the Ihram for `Umra and had not brought the Hadi should finish his Ihram and whoever had assumed the Ihram for `Umra and brought the Hadi should not finish the Ihram till he has slaughtered his Hadi and whoever had assumed the Ihram for Hajj should complete his Hajj." `Aisha further said, "I got my periods (menses) and kept on menstruating till the day of `Arafat, and I had assumed the Ihram for `Umra only (Tamattu`). The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to undo and comb my head hair and assume the Ihram for Hajj only and leave the `Umra. I did the same till I completed the Hajj. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) sent `Abdur Rahman bin Abi Bakr with me and ordered me to perform `Umra from at-Tan`im in lieu of the missed `Umra
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ، كَانَتْ تُسْتَحَاضُ فَسَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ، وَلَيْسَتْ بِالْحَيْضَةِ، فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَدَعِي الصَّلاَةَ، وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَاغْتَسِلِي وَصَلِّي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna faatimaaa binta aabiy hubayshin, kaanat tustahaadu fasaaalati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ dhaliki 'irqun, walaysat bialhaydaai, faiidhaa aaqbalati alhaydaau fada'iy alssalaaaa, waiidhaa aadbarat faaghtasiliy wasalliy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima bint Abi Hubaish used to have bleeding in between the periods, so she asked the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. He replied, "The bleeding is from a blood vessel and not the menses. So give up the prayers when the (real) menses begins and when it has finished, take a bath and start praying
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي مُعَاذَةُ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، قَالَتْ لِعَائِشَةَ أَتَجْزِي إِحْدَانَا صَلاَتَهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ فَقَالَتْ أَحَرُورِيَّةٌ أَنْتِ كُنَّا نَحِيضُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ يَأْمُرُنَا بِهِ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَتْ فَلاَ نَفْعَلُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa hammaamun, qaala haddathanaa qataadaau, qaala haddathatniy mu'aadhaau, aanna amraaaaan, qaalat li'aaiishaaa aatajziy iihdaanaa salaatahaa iidhaa tahurat faqaalat aaharuwriyyaaun aanti kunnaa nahiydu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaa yaamurunaa bihi‏.‏ aaw qaalat falaa naf'aluhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mu`adha:A woman asked `Aisha, "Should I offer the prayers that which I did not offer because of menses" `Aisha said, "Are you from the Huraura' (a town in Iraq?) We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) and used to get our periods but he never ordered us to offer them (the Prayers missed during menses)." `Aisha perhaps said, "We did not offer them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ حِضْتُ وَأَنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْخَمِيلَةِ، فَانْسَلَلْتُ فَخَرَجْتُ مِنْهَا، فَأَخَذْتُ ثِيَابَ حِيضَتِي فَلَبِسْتُهَا، فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنُفِسْتِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ، فَدَعَانِي فَأَدْخَلَنِي مَعَهُ فِي الْخَمِيلَةِ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَحَدَّثَتْنِي أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُقَبِّلُهَا وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ، وَكُنْتُ أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'du bnu hafsin, qaala haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an zaynaba abnaai aabiy salamaaa, haddathathu aanna aumma salamaaa qaalat hidtu waaanaa ma'a alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alkhamiylaai, faansalaltu fakharajtu minhaa, faaakhadhtu thiyaaba hiydatiy falabistuhaa, faqaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanufisti ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am, fada'aaniy faaadkhalaniy ma'ahu fiy alkhamiylaai‏.‏ qaalat wahaddathatniy aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yuqabbiluhaa wahuwa saaiimun, wakuntu aaghtasilu aanaa waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm min iinaa'in waahidin mina aljanaabaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zainab bint Abi Salama:Um-Salama said, "I got my menses while I was lying with the Prophet (ﷺ) under a woolen sheet. So I slipped away, took the clothes for menses and put them on. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Have you got your menses?' I replied, 'Yes.' Then he called me and took me with him under the woolen sheet." Um Salama further said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to kiss me while he was fasting. The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take the bath of Janaba from a single pot
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ بَيْنَا أَنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم مُضْطَجِعَةً فِي خَمِيلَةٍ حِضْتُ، فَانْسَلَلْتُ فَأَخَذْتُ ثِيَابَ حِيضَتِي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنُفِسْتِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَدَعَانِي فَاضْطَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ فِي الْخَمِيلَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu fadaalaaa, qaala haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an zaynaba abnaai aabiy salamaaa, 'an aummi salamaaa, qaalat baynaa aanaa ma'a alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm mudtaji'aaan fiy khamiylaain hidtu, faansalaltu faaakhadhtu thiyaaba hiydatiy faqaala ‏ "‏ aanufisti ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu na'am‏.‏ fada'aaniy faadtaja'tu ma'ahu fiy alkhamiylaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:While I was lying with the Prophet (ﷺ) under a woolen sheet, I got my menses. I slipped away and put on the clothes for menses. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Have you got your menses?" I replied, "Yes." He called me and I slept with him under the woolen sheet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ سَلاَمٍ ـ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا نَمْنَعُ عَوَاتِقَنَا أَنْ يَخْرُجْنَ فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ، فَقَدِمَتِ امْرَأَةٌ فَنَزَلَتْ قَصْرَ بَنِي خَلَفٍ، فَحَدَّثَتْ عَنْ أُخْتِهَا، وَكَانَ زَوْجُ أُخْتِهَا غَزَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثِنْتَىْ عَشَرَةَ، وَكَانَتْ أُخْتِي مَعَهُ فِي سِتٍّ‏.‏ قَالَتْ كُنَّا نُدَاوِي الْكَلْمَى، وَنَقُومُ عَلَى الْمَرْضَى، فَسَأَلَتْ أُخْتِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعَلَى إِحْدَانَا بَأْسٌ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا جِلْبَابٌ أَنْ لاَ تَخْرُجَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لِتُلْبِسْهَا صَاحِبَتُهَا مِنْ جِلْبَابِهَا، وَلْتَشْهَدِ الْخَيْرَ وَدَعْوَةَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَتْ أُمُّ عَطِيَّةَ سَأَلْتُهَا أَسَمِعْتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ بِأَبِي نَعَمْ ـ وَكَانَتْ لاَ تَذْكُرُهُ إِلاَّ قَالَتْ بِأَبِي ـ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَخْرُجُ الْعَوَاتِقُ وَذَوَاتُ الْخُدُورِ، أَوِ الْعَوَاتِقُ ذَوَاتُ الْخُدُورِ وَالْحُيَّضُ، وَلْيَشْهَدْنَ الْخَيْرَ وَدَعْوَةَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَيَعْتَزِلُ الْحُيَّضُ الْمُصَلَّى ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ فَقُلْتُ الْحُيَّضُ فَقَالَتْ أَلَيْسَ تَشْهَدُ عَرَفَةَ وَكَذَا وَكَذَا
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun huwa abnu salaamin qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, 'an aayyuwba, 'an hafsaaa, qaalat kunnaa namna'u 'awaatiqanaa aan yakhrujna fiy al'iydayni, faqadimati amraaaaun fanazalat qasra baniy khalafin, fahaddathat 'an aukhtihaa, wakaana zawju aukhtihaa ghazaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thintaa 'asharaaa, wakaanat aukhtiy ma'ahu fiy sittin‏.‏ qaalat kunnaa nudaawiy alkalmaa, wanaquwmu 'alaa almardaa, fasaaalat aukhtiy alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aa'alaa iihdaanaa baasun iidhaa lam yakun lahaa jilbaabun aan laa takhruja qaala ‏"‏ litulbishaa saahibatuhaa min jilbaabihaa, waltashhadi alkhayra wada'waaa almuslimiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa qadimat aummu 'atiyyaaa saaaltuhaa aasami'ti alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat biaabiy na'am wakaanat laa tadhkuruhu iilaaa qaalat biaabiy sami'tuhu yaquwlu ‏"‏ yakhruju al'awaatiqu wadhawaatu alkhuduwri, aawi al'awaatiqu dhawaatu alkhuduwri waalhuyyadu, walyashhadna alkhayra wada'waaa almuuminiyna, waya'tazilu alhuyyadu almusallaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat hafsaau faqultu alhuyyadu faqaalat aalaysa tashhadu 'arafaaa wakadhaa wakadhaa
verses.translation: Narrated Aiyub:Hafsa said, 'We used to forbid our young women to go out for the two `Id prayers. A woman came and stayed at the palace of Bani Khalaf and she narrated about her sister whose husband took part in twelve holy battles along with the Prophet (ﷺ) and her sister was with her husband in six (out of these twelve). She (the woman's sister) said, "We used to treat the wounded, look after the patients and once I asked the Prophet, 'Is there any harm for any of us to stay at home if she doesn't have a veil?' He said, 'She should cover herself with the veil of her companion and should participate in the good deeds and in the religious gathering of the Muslims.' When Um `Atiya came I asked her whether she had heard it from the Prophet. She replied, "Yes. May my father be sacrificed for him (the Prophet)! (Whenever she mentioned the Prophet (ﷺ) she used to say, 'May my father be sacrificed for him) I have heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'The unmarried young virgins and the mature girl who stay often screened or the young unmarried virgins who often stay screened and the menstruating women should come out and participate in the good deeds as well as the religious gathering of the faithful believers but the menstruating women should keep away from the Musalla (praying place).' " Hafsa asked Um `Atiya surprisingly, "Do you say the menstruating women?" She replied, "Doesn't a menstruating woman attend `Arafat (Hajj) and such and such (other deeds)?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ بْنَ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ،‏.‏ أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ، سَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ إِنِّي أُسْتَحَاضُ فَلاَ أَطْهُرُ، أَفَأَدَعُ الصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ، إِنَّ ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ، وَلَكِنْ دَعِي الصَّلاَةَ قَدْرَ الأَيَّامِ الَّتِي كُنْتِ تَحِيضِينَ فِيهَا، ثُمَّ اغْتَسِلِي وَصَلِّي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu aabiy rajaa'in, qaala haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, qaala sami'tu hishaama bna 'urwaaa, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an 'aaiishaaa, ‏.‏ aanna faatimaaa binta aabiy hubayshin, saaalati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat iinniy austahaadu falaa aathuru, aafaaada'u alssalaaaa faqaala ‏ "‏ laa, iinna dhaliki 'irqun, walakin da'iy alssalaaaa qadra alaayyaami allatiy kunti tahiydiyna fiyhaa, thumma aghtasiliy wasalliy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Fatima bint Abi Hubaish asked the Prophet, "I got persistent bleeding (in between the periods) and do not become clean. Shall I give up prayers?" He replied, "No, this is from a blood vessel. Give up the prayers only for the days on which you usually get the menses and then take a bath and offer your prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا لاَ نَعُدُّ الْكُدْرَةَ وَالصُّفْرَةَ شَيْئًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat kunnaa laa na'uddu alkudraaa waalssufraaa shayiana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um `Atiya:We never considered yellowish discharge as a thing of importance (as menses)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، وَعَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ اسْتُحِيضَتْ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ، فَسَأَلَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هَذَا عِرْقٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ تَغْتَسِلُ لِكُلِّ صَلاَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, qaala haddathanaa ma'nun, qaala haddathaniy abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, wa'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna aumma habiybaaa astuhiydat sab'a siniyna, fasaaalat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dhalika, faaamarahaa aan taghtasila faqaala ‏ "‏ hadhaa 'irqun ‏"‏‏.‏ fakaanat taghtasilu likulli salaaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Um Habiba got bleeding in between the periods for seven years. She asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it. He ordered her to take a bath (after the termination of actual periods) and added that it was (from) a blood vessel. So she used to take a bath for every prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتَ حُيَىٍّ قَدْ حَاضَتْ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَعَلَّهَا تَحْبِسُنَا، أَلَمْ تَكُنْ طَافَتْ مَعَكُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا بَلَى‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاخْرُجِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakri bni muhammadi bni 'amriw bni hazmin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinna safiyyaaa binta huyaaain qad haadat‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ la'allahaa tahbisunaa, aalam takun taafat ma'akunna ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa balaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faakhrujiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) I told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that Safiya bint Huyai had got her menses. He said, "She will probably delay us. Did she perform Tawaf (Al-Ifada) with you?" We replied, "Yes." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) told her to depart
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ رُخِّصَ لِلْحَائِضِ أَنْ تَنْفِرَ، إِذَا حَاضَتْ‏.‏ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ فِي أَوَّلِ أَمْرِهِ إِنَّهَا لاَ تَنْفِرُ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ تَنْفِرُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَخَّصَ لَهُنَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, qaala haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala rukhhisa lilhaaiidi aan tanfira, iidhaa haadat‏.‏ wakaana abnu 'umara yaquwlu fiy aawwali aamrihi iinnahaa laa tanfiru‏.‏ thumma sami'tuhu yaquwlu tanfiru iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakhhasa lahunna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A woman is allowed to leave (go back home) if she gets menses (after Tawaf-Al-Ifada). Ibn `Umar formerly used to say that she should not leave but later on I heard him saying, "She may leave, since Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave them the permission to leave (after Tawaf-Al-Ifada)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ زُهَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَدَعِي الصَّلاَةَ، وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَاغْسِلِي عَنْكِ الدَّمَ وَصَلِّي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, 'an zuhayrin, qaala haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aaqbalati alhaydaau fada'iy alssalaaaa, waiidhaa aadbarat faaghsiliy 'anki alddama wasalliy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Give up the prayer when your menses begin and when it has finished, wash the blood off your body (take a bath) and start praying
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي سُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شَبَابَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ الْمُعَلِّمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مَاتَتْ فِي بَطْنٍ، فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَامَ وَسَطَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu aabiy surayjin, qaala aakhbaranaa shabaabaau, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an husaynin almu'allimi, 'ani abni buraydaaa, 'an samuraaa bni jundubin, aanna amraaaaan, maatat fiy batnin, fasallaa 'alayhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaama wasatahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Samura bin Jundub:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer for the dead body of a woman who died during delivery (i.e. childbirth) and he stood by the middle of her body
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُدْرِكٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ ـ اسْمُهُ الْوَضَّاحُ ـ مِنْ كِتَابِهِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ خَالَتِي، مَيْمُونَةَ ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَكُونُ حَائِضًا لاَ تُصَلِّي، وَهْىَ مُفْتَرِشَةٌ بِحِذَاءِ مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى خُمْرَتِهِ، إِذَا سَجَدَ أَصَابَنِي بَعْضُ ثَوْبِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu mudrikin, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hammaadin, qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw 'awaanaaa asmuhu alwaddaahu min kitaabihi qaala aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu alshhaybaaniyyu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni shaddaadin, qaala sami'tu khaalatiy, maymuwnaaa zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa kaanat takuwnu haaiidana laa tusalliy, wahaa muftarishaaun bihidhaa'i masjidi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa yusalliy 'alaa khumratihi, iidhaa sajada aasaabaniy ba'du thawbihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Maimuna:(the wife of the Prophet) During my menses, I never prayed, but used to sit on the mat beside the mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He used to offer the prayer on his sheet and in prostration some of his clothes used to touch me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 7 — Rubbing hands and feet with dust (Tayammum)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 7 — Rubbing hands and feet with dust (Tayammum)
