verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, qaala haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an mahmuwdi bni alrrabiy'i, 'an 'itbaana bni maalikin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aataahu fiy manzilihi faqaala ‏ "‏ aayna tuhibbu aan ausalliya laka min baytika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faaashartu lahu iilaa makaanin, fakabbara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wasafafnaa khalfahu, fasallaa rak'atayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Itban bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to my house and said, "Where do you like me to pray?" I pointed to a place. The Prophet then said, "Allahu Akbar", and we aligned behind him and he offered a two-rak`at prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَحْمُودُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، أَنَّ عِتْبَانَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ وَهُوَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ـ أَنَّهُ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَدْ أَنْكَرْتُ بَصَرِي، وَأَنَا أُصَلِّي لِقَوْمِي، فَإِذَا كَانَتِ الأَمْطَارُ سَالَ الْوَادِي الَّذِي بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ، لَمْ أَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ آتِيَ مَسْجِدَهُمْ فَأُصَلِّيَ بِهِمْ، وَوَدِدْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَّكَ تَأْتِينِي فَتُصَلِّيَ فِي بَيْتِي، فَأَتَّخِذَهُ مُصَلًّى‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَأَفْعَلُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عِتْبَانُ فَغَدَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ حِينَ ارْتَفَعَ النَّهَارُ، فَاسْتَأْذَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَذِنْتُ لَهُ، فَلَمْ يَجْلِسْ حَتَّى دَخَلَ الْبَيْتَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ تُحِبُّ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ مِنْ بَيْتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَشَرْتُ لَهُ إِلَى نَاحِيَةٍ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَبَّرَ، فَقُمْنَا فَصَفَّنَا، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ، قَالَ وَحَبَسْنَاهُ عَلَى خَزِيرَةٍ صَنَعْنَاهَا لَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَثَابَ فِي الْبَيْتِ رِجَالٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الدَّارِ ذَوُو عَدَدٍ فَاجْتَمَعُوا، فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ أَيْنَ مَالِكُ بْنُ الدُّخَيْشِنِ أَوِ ابْنُ الدُّخْشُنِ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ ذَلِكَ مُنَافِقٌ لاَ يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَقُلْ ذَلِكَ، أَلاَ تَرَاهُ قَدْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّا نَرَى وَجْهَهُ وَنَصِيحَتَهُ إِلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَ عَلَى النَّارِ مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ يَبْتَغِي بِذَلِكَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُ الْحُصَيْنَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ ـ وَهْوَ أَحَدُ بَنِي سَالِمٍ وَهُوَ مِنْ سَرَاتِهِمْ ـ عَنْ حَدِيثِ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ، فَصَدَّقَهُ بِذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ufayrin, qaala haddathaniy alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylun, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy mahmuwdu bnu alrrabiy'i alaansaariyyu, aanna 'itbaana bna maalikin wahuwa min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mimman shahida badrana mina alaansaari aannahu aataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, qad aankartu basariy, waaanaa ausalliy liqawmiy, faiidhaa kaanati alaamtaaru saala alwaadiy alladhiy bayniy wabaynahum, lam aastati' aan atiya masjidahum faausalliya bihim, wawadidtu yaa rasuwla alllahi aannaka taatiyniy fatusalliya fiy baytiy, faaattakhidhahu musallana‏.‏ qaala faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ saaaf'alu iin shaa'a alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'itbaanu faghadaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin hiyna artafa'a alnnahaaru, faastaadhana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaadhintu lahu, falam yajlis hattaa dakhala albayta thumma qaala ‏"‏ aayna tuhibbu aan ausalliya min baytika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faaashartu lahu iilaa naahiyaain mina albayti, faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakabbara, faqumnaa fasaffanaa, fasallaa rak'atayni thumma sallama, qaala wahabasnaahu 'alaa khaziyraain sana'naahaa lahu‏.‏ qaala fathaaba fiy albayti rijaalun min aahli alddaari dhawuw 'adadin faajtama'uwa, faqaala qaaiilun minhum aayna maaliku bnu alddukhayshini aawi abnu alddukhshuni faqaala ba'duhum dhalika munaafiqun laa yuhibbu alllaha warasuwlahu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taqul dhalika, aalaa taraahu qad qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ yuriydu bidhalika wajha alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ qaala faiinnaa naraa wajhahu wanasiyhatahu iilaa almunaafiqiyna‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faiinna alllaha qad harrama 'alaa alnnaari man qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ yabtaghiy bidhalika wajha alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin thumma saaaltu alhusayna bna muhammadin alaansaariyya wahwa aahadu baniy saalimin wahuwa min saraatihim 'an hadiythi mahmuwdi bni alrrabiy'i, fasaddaqahu bidhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Itban bin Malik:who was one of the companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one of the Ansars who took part in the battle of Badr: I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I have weak eyesight and I lead my people in prayers. When it rains the water flows in the valley between me and my people so I cannot go to their mosque to lead them in prayer. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I wish you would come to my house and pray in it so that I could take that place as a Musalla. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. "Allah willing, I will do so." Next day after the sun rose high, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked for permission to enter. I gave him permission and he did not sit on entering the house but said to me, "Where do you like me to pray?" I pointed to a place in my house. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood there and said, 'Allahu Akbar', and we all got up and aligned behind him and offered a two-rak`at prayer and ended it with Taslim. We requested him to stay for a meal called "Khazira" which we had prepared for him. Many members of our family gathered in the house and one of them said, "Where is Malik bin Al-Dukhaishin or Ibn Al-Dukhshun?" One of them replied, "He is a hypocrite and does not love Allah and His Apostle." Hearing that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not say so. Haven't you seen that he said, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah' for Allah's sake only?" He said, "Allah and His Apostle know better. We have seen him helping and advising hypocrites." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Allah has forbidden the (Hell) fire for those who say, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah' for Allah's sake only
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَشْعَثِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحِبُّ التَّيَمُّنَ مَا اسْتَطَاعَ فِي شَأْنِهِ كُلِّهِ فِي طُهُورِهِ وَتَرَجُّلِهِ وَتَنَعُّلِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaash'athi bni sulaymin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhibbu alttayammuna maa astataa'a fiy shaanihi kullihi fiy tuhuwrihi watarajjulihi watana''ulihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to start every thing from the right (for good things) whenever it was possible in all his affairs; for example: in washing, combing or wearing shoes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ، وَأُمَّ سَلَمَةَ ذَكَرَتَا كَنِيسَةً رَأَيْنَهَا بِالْحَبَشَةِ فِيهَا تَصَاوِيرُ، فَذَكَرَتَا لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أُولَئِكَ إِذَا كَانَ فِيهِمُ الرَّجُلُ الصَّالِحُ فَمَاتَ بَنَوْا عَلَى قَبْرِهِ مَسْجِدًا، وَصَوَّرُوا فِيهِ تِلْكَ الصُّوَرَ، فَأُولَئِكَ شِرَارُ الْخَلْقِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an hishaamin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna aumma habiybaaa, waaumma salamaaa dhakarataa kaniysaaan raaaynahaa bialhabashaai fiyhaa tasaawiyru, fadhakarataa lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ iinna auwlaiika iidhaa kaana fiyhimu alrrajulu alssaalihu famaata banawa 'alaa qabrihi masjidana, wasawwaruwa fiyhi tilka alssuwara, faauwlaiika shiraaru alkhalqi 'inda alllahi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Um Habiba and Um Salama mentioned about a church they had seen in Ethiopia in which there were pictures. They told the Prophet (ﷺ) about it, on which he said, "If any religious man died amongst those people they would build a place of worship at his grave and make these pictures in it. They will be the worst creature in the sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ فَنَزَلَ أَعْلَى الْمَدِينَةِ، فِي حَىٍّ يُقَالُ لَهُمْ بَنُو عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ‏.‏ فَأَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهِمْ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ لَيْلَةً، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ إِلَى بَنِي النَّجَّارِ فَجَاءُوا مُتَقَلِّدِي السُّيُوفِ، كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ رِدْفُهُ، وَمَلأُ بَنِي النَّجَّارِ حَوْلَهُ، حَتَّى أَلْقَى بِفِنَاءِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، وَكَانَ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ حَيْثُ أَدْرَكَتْهُ الصَّلاَةُ، وَيُصَلِّي فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ، وَأَنَّهُ أَمَرَ بِبِنَاءِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى مَلإٍ مِنْ بَنِي النَّجَّارِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا بَنِي النَّجَّارِ ثَامِنُونِي بِحَائِطِكُمْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ وَاللَّهِ، لاَ نَطْلُبُ ثَمَنَهُ إِلاَّ إِلَى اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ فَكَانَ فِيهِ مَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ، قُبُورُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَفِيهِ خَرِبٌ، وَفِيهِ نَخْلٌ، فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقُبُورِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَنُبِشَتْ، ثُمَّ بِالْخَرِبِ فَسُوِّيَتْ، وَبِالنَّخْلِ فَقُطِعَ، فَصَفُّوا النَّخْلَ قِبْلَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَجَعَلُوا عِضَادَتَيْهِ الْحِجَارَةَ، وَجَعَلُوا يَنْقُلُونَ الصَّخْرَ، وَهُمْ يَرْتَجِزُونَ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَهُمْ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُ الآخِرَهْ فَاغْفِرْ لِلأَنْصَارِ وَالْمُهَاجِرَهْ ‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, 'an aanasin, qaala qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa fanazala aa'laa almadiynaai, fiy haaain yuqaalu lahum banuw 'amriw bni 'awfin‏.‏ faaaqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhim aarba'a 'ashraaa laylaaan, thumma aarsala iilaa baniy alnnajjaari fajaa'uwa mutaqallidiy alssuyuwfi, kaaanniy aanzuru iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa raahilatihi, waaabuw bakrin ridfuhu, wamalau baniy alnnajjaari hawlahu, hattaa aalqaa bifinaa'i aabiy aayyuwba, wakaana yuhibbu aan yusalliya haythu aadrakathu alssalaaau, wayusalliy fiy maraabidi alghanami, waaannahu aamara bibinaa'i almasjidi, faaarsala iilaa maliin min baniy alnnajjaari faqaala ‏"‏ yaa baniy alnnajjaari thaaminuwniy bihaaiitikum hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa laa waalllahi, laa natlubu thamanahu iilaaa iilaa alllahi‏.‏ faqaala aanasun fakaana fiyhi maa aaquwlu lakum, qubuwru almushrikiyna, wafiyhi kharibun, wafiyhi nakhlun, faaamara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biqubuwri almushrikiyna fanubishat, thumma bialkharibi fasuwwiyat, wabialnnakhli faquti'a, fasaffuwa alnnakhla qiblaaa almasjidi, waja'aluwa 'idaadatayhi alhijaaraaa, waja'aluwa yanquluwna alssakhra, wahum yartajizuwna, waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'ahum wahuwa yaquwlu ‏"‏ alllahumma laa khayra iilaaa khayru alakhirah faaghfir lilaansaari waalmuhaajirah ‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived in Medina he dismounted at `Awali-il-Medina amongst a tribe called Banu `Amr bin `Auf. He stayed there For fourteen nights. Then he sent for Bani An-Najjar and they came armed with their swords. As if I am looking (just now) as the Prophet (ﷺ) was sitting over his Rahila (Mount) with Abu Bakr riding behind him and all Banu An-Najjar around him till he dismounted at the courtyard of Abu Aiyub's house. The Prophet (ﷺ) loved to pray wherever the time for the prayer was due even at sheep-folds. Later on he ordered that a mosque should be built and sent for some people of Banu-An-Najjar and said, "O Banu An-Najjar! Suggest to me the price of this (walled) piece of land of yours." They replied, "No! By Allah! We do not demand its price except from Allah." Anas added: There were graves of pagans in it and some of it was unleveled and there were some date-palm trees in it. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that the graves of the pagans be dug out and the unleveled land be levelled and the date-palm trees be cut down . (So all that was done). They aligned these cut date-palm trees towards the Qibla of the mosque (as a wall) and they also built two stone side-walls (of the mosque). His companions brought the stones while reciting some poetic verses. The Prophet (ﷺ) was with them and he kept on saying, "There is no goodness except that of the Hereafter, O Allah! So please forgive the Ansars and the emigrants
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ، ثُمَّ سَمِعْتُهُ بَعْدُ يَقُولُ كَانَ يُصَلِّي فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُبْنَى الْمَسْجِدُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy fiy maraabidi alghanami, thumma sami'tuhu ba'du yaquwlu kaana yusalliy fiy maraabidi alghanami qabla aan yubnaa almasjidu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Al-Taiyah [??]:Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed in the sheep fold." Later on I heard him saying, "He prayed in the sheep folds before the construction of the, mosque
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ يُصَلِّي إِلَى بَعِيرِهِ وَقَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْعَلُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau bnu alfadli, qaala aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu bnu hayyaana, qaala haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, qaala raaaytu abna 'umara yusalliy iilaa ba'iyrihi waqaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaf'aluhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:"I saw Ibn `Umar praying while taking his camel as a Sutra in front of him and he said, "I saw the Prophet doing the same
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ انْخَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُرِيتُ النَّارَ، فَلَمْ أَرَ مَنْظَرًا كَالْيَوْمِ قَطُّ أَفْظَعَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, qaala ankhasafati alshhamsu, fasallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qaala ‏ "‏ auriytu alnnaara, falam aara manzarana kaalyawmi qattu aafza'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:The sun eclipsed and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the eclipse prayer and said, "I have been shown the Hellfire (now) and I never saw a worse and horrible sight than the sight I have seen today
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اجْعَلُوا فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ مِنْ صَلاَتِكُمْ، وَلاَ تَتَّخِذُوهَا قُبُورًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aj'aluwa fiy buyuwtikum min salaatikum, walaa tattakhidhuwhaa qubuwrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) had said, "Offer some of your prayers (Nawafil) at home, and do not take your houses as graves
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُوا عَلَى هَؤُلاَءِ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونُوا بَاكِينَ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُونُوا بَاكِينَ فَلاَ تَدْخُلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ، لاَ يُصِيبُكُمْ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tadkhuluwa 'alaa hauulaa'i almu'adhhabiyna iilaaa aan takuwnuwa baakiyna, faiin lam takuwnuwa baakiyna falaa tadkhuluwa 'alayhim, laa yusiybukum maa aasaabahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Do not enter (the places) of these people where Allah's punishment had fallen unless you do so weeping. If you do not weep, do not enter (the places of these people) because Allah's curse and punishment which fell upon them may fall upon you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، ذَكَرَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَنِيسَةً رَأَتْهَا بِأَرْضِ الْحَبَشَةِ يُقَالُ لَهَا مَارِيَةُ، فَذَكَرَتْ لَهُ مَا رَأَتْ فِيهَا مِنَ الصُّوَرِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أُولَئِكَ قَوْمٌ إِذَا مَاتَ فِيهِمُ الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ ـ أَوِ الرَّجُلُ الصَّالِحُ ـ بَنَوْا عَلَى قَبْرِهِ مَسْجِدًا، وَصَوَّرُوا فِيهِ تِلْكَ الصُّوَرَ، أُولَئِكَ شِرَارُ الْخَلْقِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna aumma salamaaa, dhakarat lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaniysaaan raaathaa biaardi alhabashaai yuqaalu lahaa maariyaau, fadhakarat lahu maa raaat fiyhaa mina alssuwari, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ auwlaiika qawmun iidhaa maata fiyhimu al'abdu alssaalihu aawi alrrajulu alssaalihu banawa 'alaa qabrihi masjidana, wasawwaruwa fiyhi tilka alssuwara, auwlaiika shiraaru alkhalqi 'inda alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Um Salama told Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about a church which she had seen in Ethiopia and which was called Mariya. She told him about the pictures which she had seen in it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If any righteous pious man dies amongst them, they would build a place of worship at his grave and make these pictures in it; they are the worst creatures in the sight of Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالاَ لَمَّا نَزَلَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَفِقَ يَطْرَحُ خَمِيصَةً لَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ، فَإِذَا اغْتَمَّ بِهَا كَشَفَهَا عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، فَقَالَ وَهْوَ كَذَلِكَ ‏ "‏ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى اتَّخَذُوا قُبُورَ أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ مَسَاجِدَ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُحَذِّرُ مَا صَنَعُوا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, aanna 'aaiishaaa, wa'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin, qaalaa lammaa nazala birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tafiqa yatrahu khamiysaaan lahu 'alaa wajhihi, faiidhaa aghtamma bihaa kashafahaa 'an wajhihi, faqaala wahwa kadhalika ‏ "‏ la'naau alllahi 'alaa alyahuwdi waalnnasaaraa attakhadhuwa qubuwra aanbiyaaiihim masaajida ‏"‏‏.‏ yuhadhhiru maa sana'uwa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha and `Abdullah bin `Abbas:When the last moment of the life of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came he started putting his 'Khamisa' on his face and when he felt hot and short of breath he took it off his face and said, "May Allah curse the Jews and Christians for they built the places of worship at the graves of their Prophets." The Prophet (ﷺ) was warning (Muslims) of what those had done
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ قَاتَلَ اللَّهُ الْيَهُودَ اتَّخَذُوا قُبُورَ أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ مَسَاجِدَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ qaatala alllahu alyahuwda attakhadhuwa qubuwra aanbiyaaiihim masaajida ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "May Allah's curse be on the Jews for they built the places of worship at the graves of their Prophets
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارٌ ـ هُوَ أَبُو الْحَكَمِ ـ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ الْفَقِيرُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أُعْطِيتُ خَمْسًا لَمْ يُعْطَهُنَّ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ قَبْلِي، نُصِرْتُ بِالرُّعْبِ مَسِيرَةَ شَهْرٍ، وَجُعِلَتْ لِيَ الأَرْضُ مَسْجِدًا وَطَهُورًا، وَأَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ مِنْ أُمَّتِي أَدْرَكَتْهُ الصَّلاَةُ فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَأُحِلَّتْ لِيَ الْغَنَائِمُ، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ يُبْعَثُ إِلَى قَوْمِهِ خَاصَّةً، وَبُعِثْتُ إِلَى النَّاسِ كَافَّةً، وَأُعْطِيتُ الشَّفَاعَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu sinaanin, qaala haddathanaa hushaymun, qaala haddathanaa sayyaarun huwa aabuw alhakami qaala haddathanaa yaziydu alfaqiyru, qaala haddathanaa jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ au'tiytu khamsana lam yu'tahunna aahadun mina alaanbiyaa'i qabliy, nusirtu bialrru'bi masiyraaa shahrin, waju'ilat liya alaardu masjidana watahuwrana, waaayyumaa rajulin min aummatiy aadrakathu alssalaaau falyusalli, waauhillat liya alghanaaiimu, wakaana alnnabiyyu yub'athu iilaa qawmihi khaassaaan, wabu'ithtu iilaa alnnaasi kaaffaaan, waau'tiytu alshhafaa'aaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have been given five things which were not given to any amongst the Prophets before me. These are: -1. Allah made me victorious by awe (by His frightening my enemies) for a distance of one month's journey. -2. The earth has been made for me (and for my followers) a place for praying and a thing to perform Tayammum. Therefore my followers can pray wherever the time of a prayer is due. -3. The booty has been made Halal (lawful) for me (and was not made so for anyone else). -4. Every Prophet used to be sent to his nation exclusively but I have been sent to all mankind. -5. I have been given the right of intercession (on the Day of Resurrection)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ وَلِيدَةً، كَانَتْ سَوْدَاءَ لِحَىٍّ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ، فَأَعْتَقُوهَا، فَكَانَتْ مَعَهُمْ قَالَتْ فَخَرَجَتْ صَبِيَّةٌ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا وِشَاحٌ أَحْمَرُ مِنْ سُيُورٍ قَالَتْ فَوَضَعَتْهُ أَوْ وَقَعَ مِنْهَا، فَمَرَّتْ بِهِ حُدَيَّاةٌ وَهْوَ مُلْقًى، فَحَسِبَتْهُ لَحْمًا فَخَطَفَتْهُ قَالَتْ فَالْتَمَسُوهُ فَلَمْ يَجِدُوهُ قَالَتْ فَاتَّهَمُونِي بِهِ قَالَتْ فَطَفِقُوا يُفَتِّشُونَ حَتَّى فَتَّشُوا قُبُلَهَا قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَقَائِمَةٌ مَعَهُمْ، إِذْ مَرَّتِ الْحُدَيَّاةُ فَأَلْقَتْهُ قَالَتْ فَوَقَعَ بَيْنَهُمْ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ هَذَا الَّذِي اتَّهَمْتُمُونِي بِهِ ـ زَعَمْتُمْ ـ وَأَنَا مِنْهُ بَرِيئَةٌ، وَهُوَ ذَا هُوَ قَالَتْ فَجَاءَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَسْلَمَتْ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَكَانَ لَهَا خِبَاءٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ أَوْ حِفْشٌ قَالَتْ فَكَانَتْ تَأْتِينِي فَتَحَدَّثُ عِنْدِي قَالَتْ فَلاَ تَجْلِسُ عِنْدِي مَجْلِسًا إِلاَّ قَالَتْ وَيَوْمَ الْوِشَاحِ مِنْ أَعَاجِيبِ رَبِّنَا أَلاَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ بَلْدَةِ الْكُفْرِ أَنْجَانِي قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا مَا شَأْنُكِ لاَ تَقْعُدِينَ مَعِي مَقْعَدًا إِلاَّ قُلْتِ هَذَا قَالَتْ فَحَدَّثَتْنِي بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala hadaathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanaa waliydaaan, kaanat sawdaa'a lihaainn mina al'arabi, faaa'taquwhaa, fakaanat ma'ahum qaalat fakharajat sabiyaaaun lahum 'alayhaa wishaahun aahmaru min suyuwrin qaalat fawada'athu aaw waqa'a minhaa, famaraat bihi hudayaaaaun wahwa mulqana, fahasibathu lahmana fakhatafathu qaalat faaltamasuwhu falam yajiduwhu qaalat faataahamuwniy bihi qaalat fatafiquwa yufatiishuwna hataaa fataashuwa qubulahaa qaalat waallaahi iiniiy laqaaiimaaun ma'ahum, iidh maraati alhudayaaaau faaalqathu qaalat fawaqa'a baynahum qaalat faqultu hadhaa alaadhiy ataahamtumuwniy bihi za'amtum waaanaa minhu bariyiaaun, wahuwa dhaa huwa qaalat fajaa'at iilaa rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaslamat‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau fakaana lahaa khibaa'un fiy almasjidi aaw hifshun qaalat fakaanat taatiyniy fatahadaathu 'indiy qaalat falaa tajlisu 'indiy majlisana iilaaa qaalat wayawma alwishaahi min aa'aajiybi rabiinaa aalaa iinaahu min baldaai alkufri aanjaaniy qaalat 'aaiishaau faqultu lahaa maa shaanuki laa taq'udiyna ma'iy maq'adana iilaaa qulti hadhaa qaalat fahadaathatniy bihadhaa alhadiythi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:There was a black slave girl belonging to an 'Arab tribe and they manumitted her but she remained with them. The slave girl said, "Once one of their girls (of that tribe) came out wearing a red leather scarf decorated with precious stones. It fell from her or she placed it somewhere. A kite passed by that place, saw it Lying there and mistaking it for a piece of meat, flew away with it. Those people searched for it but they did not find it. So they accused me of stealing it and started searching me and even searched my private parts." The slave girl further said, "By Allah! while I was standing (in that state) with those people, the same kite passed by them and dropped the red scarf and it fell amongst them. I told them, 'This is what you accused me of and I was innocent and now this is it.' " `Aisha added: That slave girl came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and embraced Islam. She had a tent or a small room with a low roof in the mosque. Whenever she called on me, she had a talk with me and whenever she sat with me, she would recite the following: "The day of the scarf (band) was one of the wonders of our Lord, verily He rescued me from the disbelievers' town. `Aisha added: "Once I asked her, 'What is the matter with you? Whenever you sit with me, you always recite these poetic verses.' On that she told me the whole story
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَنَامُ وَهْوَ شَابٌّ أَعْزَبُ لاَ أَهْلَ لَهُ فِي مَسْجِدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy naafi'un, qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi, aannahu kaana yanaamu wahwa shaabbun aa'zabu laa aahla lahu fiy masjidi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah bin `Umar said: I used to sleep in the mosque of the Prophet (ﷺ) while I was young and unmarried
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْتَ فَاطِمَةَ، فَلَمْ يَجِدْ عَلِيًّا فِي الْبَيْتِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ ابْنُ عَمِّكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ كَانَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ شَىْءٌ، فَغَاضَبَنِي فَخَرَجَ فَلَمْ يَقِلْ عِنْدِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لإِنْسَانٍ ‏"‏ انْظُرْ أَيْنَ هُوَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ رَاقِدٌ، فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُضْطَجِعٌ، قَدْ سَقَطَ رِدَاؤُهُ عَنْ شِقِّهِ، وَأَصَابَهُ تُرَابٌ، فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْسَحُهُ عَنْهُ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ قُمْ أَبَا تُرَابٍ، قُمْ أَبَا تُرَابٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala jaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bayta faatimaaa, falam yajid 'aliyyana fiy albayti faqaala ‏"‏ aayna abnu 'ammiki ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat kaana bayniy wabaynahu shaa'un, faghaadabaniy fakharaja falam yaqil 'indiy‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liinsaanin ‏"‏ anzur aayna huwa ‏"‏‏.‏ fajaa'a faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, huwa fiy almasjidi raaqidun, fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa mudtaji'un, qad saqata ridaauuhu 'an shiqqihi, waaasaabahu turaabun, faja'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yamsahuhu 'anhu wayaquwlu ‏"‏ qum aabaa turaabin, qum aabaa turaabin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to Fatima's house but did not find `Ali there. So he asked, "Where is your cousin?" She replied, "There was something between us and he got angry with me and went out. He did not sleep (midday nap) in the house." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked a person to look for him. That person came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! He (Ali) is sleeping in the mosque." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went there and `Ali was lying. His upper body cover had fallen down to one side of his body and he was covered with dust. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started cleaning the dust from him saying: "Get up! O Aba Turab. Get up! O Aba Turab (literally means: O father of dust)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ سَبْعِينَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الصُّفَّةِ، مَا مِنْهُمْ رَجُلٌ عَلَيْهِ رِدَاءٌ، إِمَّا إِزَارٌ وَإِمَّا كِسَاءٌ، قَدْ رَبَطُوا فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ، فَمِنْهَا مَا يَبْلُغُ نِصْفَ السَّاقَيْنِ، وَمِنْهَا مَا يَبْلُغُ الْكَعْبَيْنِ، فَيَجْمَعُهُ بِيَدِهِ، كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ تُرَى عَوْرَتُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yuwsufu bnu 'iysaa, qaala haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala raaaytu sab'iyna min aashaabi alssuffaai, maa minhum rajulun 'alayhi ridaa'un, iimmaa iizaarun waiimmaa kisaa'un, qad rabatuwa fiy aa'naaqihim, faminhaa maa yablughu nisfa alssaaqayni, waminhaa maa yablughu alka'bayni, fayajma'uhu biyadihi, karaahiyaaa aan turaa 'awratuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I saw seventy of As-Suffa men and none of them had a Rida' (a garment covering the upper part of the body). They had either Izars (only) or sheets which they tied round their necks. Some of these sheets reached the middle of their legs and some reached their heels and they used to gather them with their hands lest their private parts should become naked
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلاَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَارِبُ بْنُ دِثَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ـ قَالَ مِسْعَرٌ أُرَاهُ قَالَ ضُحًى ـ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ لِي عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ فَقَضَانِي وَزَادَنِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalaaadu bnu yahyaa, qaala haddathanaa mis'arun, qaala haddathanaa muhaaribu bnu dithaarin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa fiy almasjidi qaala mis'arun auraahu qaala duhana faqaala ‏ "‏ salli rak'atayni ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana liy 'alayhi daynun faqadaaniy wazaadaniy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the mosque (the sub-narrator Mis`ar thought that Jabir had said, "In the forenoon.") He ordered me to pray two rak`at. He owed me some money and he repaid it to me and gave more than what was due to me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ السَّلَمِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'aamiri bni 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, 'an 'amriw bni sulaymin alzzuraqiyyi, 'an aabiy qataadaaa alssalamiyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa dakhala aahadukumu almasjida falyarka' rak'atayni qabla aan yajlisa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qatada Al-Aslami:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you enters a mosque, he should pray two rak`at before sitting
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ تُصَلِّي عَلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مَا دَامَ فِي مُصَلاَّهُ الَّذِي صَلَّى فِيهِ، مَا لَمْ يُحْدِثْ، تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almalaaiikaau tusalliy 'alaa aahadikum maa daama fiy musalaaahu alladhiy sallaa fiyhi, maa lam yuhdith, taquwlu alllahumma aghfir lahu alllahumma arhamhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The angels keep on asking Allah's forgiveness for anyone of you, as long as he is at his Musalla (praying place) and he does not pass wind (Hadath). They say, 'O Allah! Forgive him, O Allah! be Merciful to him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ كَانَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَبْنِيًّا بِاللَّبِنِ، وَسَقْفُهُ الْجَرِيدُ، وَعُمُدُهُ خَشَبُ النَّخْلِ، فَلَمْ يَزِدْ فِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ شَيْئًا، وَزَادَ فِيهِ عُمَرُ وَبَنَاهُ عَلَى بُنْيَانِهِ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِاللَّبِنِ وَالْجَرِيدِ، وَأَعَادَ عُمُدَهُ خَشَبًا، ثُمَّ غَيَّرَهُ عُثْمَانُ، فَزَادَ فِيهِ زِيَادَةً كَثِيرَةً، وَبَنَى جِدَارَهُ بِالْحِجَارَةِ الْمَنْقُوشَةِ وَالْقَصَّةِ، وَجَعَلَ عُمُدَهُ مِنْ حِجَارَةٍ مَنْقُوشَةٍ، وَسَقَفَهُ بِالسَّاجِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, qaala haddathanaa naafi'un, aanna 'abda alllahi, aakhbarahu aanna almasjida kaana 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mabniyyana bialllabini, wasaqfuhu aljariydu, wa'umuduhu khashabu alnnakhli, falam yazid fiyhi aabuw bakrin shayiana, wazaada fiyhi 'umaru wabanaahu 'alaa bunyaanihi fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialllabini waaljariydi, waaa'aada 'umudahu khashabana, thumma ghayyarahu 'uthmaanu, fazaada fiyhi ziyaadaaan kathiyraaan, wabanaa jidaarahu bialhijaaraai almanquwshaai waalqassaai, waja'ala 'umudahu min hijaaraain manquwshaain, wasaqafahu bialssaaji‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the mosque was built of adobes, its roof of the leaves of date-palms and its pillars of the stems of date-palms. Abu Bakr did not alter it. `Umar expanded it on the same pattern as it was in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) by using adobes, leaves of date-palms and changing the pillars into wooden ones. `Uthman changed it by expanding it to a great extent and built its walls with engraved stones and lime and made its pillars of engraved stones and its roof of teak wood
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُخْتَارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ لِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَلاِبْنِهِ عَلِيٍّ انْطَلِقَا إِلَى أَبِي سَعِيدٍ فَاسْمَعَا مِنْ حَدِيثِهِ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْنَا فَإِذَا هُوَ فِي حَائِطٍ يُصْلِحُهُ، فَأَخَذَ رِدَاءَهُ فَاحْتَبَى، ثُمَّ أَنْشَأَ يُحَدِّثُنَا حَتَّى أَتَى ذِكْرُ بِنَاءِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ كُنَّا نَحْمِلُ لَبِنَةً لَبِنَةً، وَعَمَّارٌ لَبِنَتَيْنِ لَبِنَتَيْنِ، فَرَآهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَنْفُضُ التُّرَابَ عَنْهُ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ وَيْحَ عَمَّارٍ تَقْتُلُهُ الْفِئَةُ الْبَاغِيَةُ، يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ، وَيَدْعُونَهُ إِلَى النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَقُولُ عَمَّارٌ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu mukhtaarin, qaala haddathanaa khaalidun alhadhhaa'u, 'an 'ikrimaaa, qaala liy abnu 'abbaasin walaibnihi 'aliyyin antaliqaa iilaa aabiy sa'iydin faasma'aa min hadiythihi‏.‏ faantalaqnaa faiidhaa huwa fiy haaiitin yuslihuhu, faaakhadha ridaa'ahu faahtabaa, thumma aanshaaa yuhaddithunaa hattaa aataa dhikru binaa'i almasjidi faqaala kunnaa nahmilu labinaaan labinaaan, wa'ammaarun labinatayni labinatayni, faraahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fayanfudu altturaaba 'anhu wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ wayha 'ammaarin taqtuluhu alfiiaau albaaghiyaau, yad'uwhum iilaa aljannaai, wayad'uwnahu iilaa alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaquwlu 'ammaarun aa'uwdhu bialllahi mina alfitani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ikrima:Ibn `Abbas said to me and to his son `Ali, "Go to Abu Sa`id and listen to what he narrates." So we went and found him in a garden looking after it. He picked up his Rida', wore it and sat down and started narrating till the topic of the construction of the mosque reached. He said, "We were carrying one adobe at a time while `Ammar was carrying two. The Prophet (ﷺ) saw him and started removing the dust from his body and said, "May Allah be Merciful to `Ammar. He will be inviting them (i.e. his murderers, the rebellious group) to Paradise and they will invite him to Hell-fire." `Ammar said, "I seek refuge with Allah from affliction
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى امْرَأَةٍ أَنْ مُرِي غُلاَمَكِ النَّجَّارَ يَعْمَلْ لِي أَعْوَادًا أَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهِنَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahlin, qaala ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa amraaaain aan muriy ghulaamaki alnnajjaara ya'mal liy aa'waadana aajlisu 'alayhinna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent someone to a woman telling her to "Order her slave, carpenter, to prepare a wooden pulpit for him to sit on
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلاَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ أَيْمَنَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَلاَ أَجْعَلُ لَكَ شَيْئًا تَقْعُدُ عَلَيْهِ، فَإِنَّ لِي غُلاَمًا نَجَّارًا قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ شِئْتِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَعَمِلَتِ الْمِنْبَرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalaaadun, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu aaymana, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaabirin, aanna amraaaaan, qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi, aalaa aaj'alu laka shayiana taq'udu 'alayhi, faiinna liy ghulaamana najjaarana qaala ‏ "‏ iin shiiti ‏"‏‏.‏ fa'amilati alminbara‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:A woman said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I get something constructed for you to sit on as I have a slave who is a carpenter?" He replied, "Yes, if you like." So she had that pulpit constructed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَاصِمَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ الْخَوْلاَنِيَّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ، يَقُولُ عِنْدَ قَوْلِ النَّاسِ فِيهِ حِينَ بَنَى مَسْجِدَ الرَّسُولِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّكُمْ أَكْثَرْتُمْ، وَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ بَنَى مَسْجِدًا ـ قَالَ بُكَيْرٌ حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ـ يَبْتَغِي بِهِ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ، بَنَى اللَّهُ لَهُ مِثْلَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, haddathaniy abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, aanna bukayrana, haddathahu aanna 'aasima bna 'umara bni qataadaaa haddathahu aannahu, sami'a 'ubayda alllahi alkhawlaaniyya, aannahu sami'a 'uthmaana bna 'affaana, yaquwlu 'inda qawli alnnaasi fiyhi hiyna banaa masjida alrrasuwli sla allh 'lyh wslm iinnakum aakthartum, waiinniy sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man banaa masjidana qaala bukayrun hasibtu aannahu qaala yabtaghiy bihi wajha alllahi, banaa alllahu lahu mithlahu fiy aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubaidullah Al-Khaulani:I heard `Uthman bin `Affan saying, when people argued too much about his intention to reconstruct the mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "You have talked too much. I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'Whoever built a mosque, (Bukair thought that `Asim, another sub-narrator, added, "Intending Allah's Pleasure"), Allah would build for him a similar place in Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَمْرٍو أَسَمِعْتَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَمَعَهُ سِهَامٌ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَمْسِكْ بِنِصَالِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala qultu li'amrinw aasami'ta jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi yaquwlu marra rajulun fiy almasjidi wama'ahu sihaamun, faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aamsik binisaalihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr:I heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, "A man passed through the mosque carrying arrows. Allah's Apostle said to him, 'Hold them by their heads
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ مَرَّ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ مَسَاجِدِنَا أَوْ أَسْوَاقِنَا بِنَبْلٍ، فَلْيَأْخُذْ عَلَى نِصَالِهَا، لاَ يَعْقِرْ بِكَفِّهِ مُسْلِمًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, qaala haddathanaa aabuw burdaaa bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala sami'tu aabaa burdaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man marra fiy shaa'in min masaajidinaa aaw aaswaaqinaa binablin, falyaakhudh 'alaa nisaalihaa, laa ya'qir bikaffihi muslimana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda bin `Abdullah:(on the authority of his father) The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever passes through our mosques or markets with arrows should hold them by their heads lest he should injure a Muslim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ حَسَّانَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، يَسْتَشْهِدُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَا حَسَّانُ، أَجِبْ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، اللَّهُمَّ أَيِّدْهُ بِرُوحِ الْقُدُسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ نَعَمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani alhakamu bnu naafi'in, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, aannahu sami'a hassaana bna thaabitin alaansaariyya, yastashhidu aabaa hurayraaa aanshuduka alllaha hal sami'ta alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yaa hassaanu, aajib 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, alllahumma aayyidhu biruwhi alqudusi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa na'am‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hassan bin Thabit Al-Ansari:I asked Abu Huraira "By Allah! Tell me the truth whether you heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'O Hassan! Reply on behalf of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). O Allah! Help him with the Holy Spirit." Abu Huraira said, "Yes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا عَلَى باب حُجْرَتِي، وَالْحَبَشَةُ يَلْعَبُونَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتُرُنِي بِرِدَائِهِ، أَنْظُرُ إِلَى لَعِبِهِمْ‏.‏ زَادَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْحَبَشَةُ يَلْعَبُونَ بِحِرَابِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, qaalat laqad raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana 'alaa bab hujratiy, waalhabashaau yal'abuwna fiy almasjidi warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasturuniy biridaaiihi, aanzuru iilaa la'ibihim‏.‏ zaada iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waalhabashaau yal'abuwna bihiraabihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Once I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the door of my house while some Ethiopians were playing in the mosque (displaying their skill with spears). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was screening me with his Rida' so as to enable me to see their display. (`Urwa said that `Aisha said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Ethiopians were playing with their spears
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَتَتْهَا بَرِيرَةُ تَسْأَلُهَا فِي كِتَابَتِهَا فَقَالَتْ إِنْ شِئْتِ أَعْطَيْتُ أَهْلَكِ وَيَكُونُ الْوَلاَءُ لِي‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَهْلُهَا إِنْ شِئْتِ أَعْطَيْتِهَا مَا بَقِيَ ـ وَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً إِنْ شِئْتِ أَعْتَقْتِهَا وَيَكُونُ الْوَلاَءُ لَنَا ـ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَكَّرَتْهُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ابْتَاعِيهَا فَأَعْتِقِيهَا، فَإِنَّ الْوَلاَءَ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ـ وَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً فَصَعِدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ـ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ يَشْتَرِطُونَ شُرُوطًا لَيْسَتْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ، مَنِ اشْتَرَطَ شَرْطًا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ، وَإِنِ اشْتَرَطَ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ قَالَ يَحْيَى وَعَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَمْرَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَةَ قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ‏.‏ رَوَاهُ مَالِكٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَمْرَةَ أَنَّ بَرِيرَةَ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ صَعِدَ الْمِنْبَرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat aatathaa bariyraau tasaaluhaa fiy kitaabatihaa faqaalat iin shiiti aa'taytu aahlaki wayakuwnu alwalaa'u liy‏.‏ waqaala aahluhaa iin shiiti aa'taytihaa maa baqiya waqaala sufyaanu marraaan iin shiiti aa'taqtihaa wayakuwnu alwalaa'u lanaa falammaa jaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhakkarathu dhalika faqaala ‏"‏ abtaa'iyhaa faaa'tiqiyhaa, faiinna alwalaa'a liman aa'taqa ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alminbari waqaala sufyaanu marraaan fasa'ida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alminbari faqaala ‏"‏ maa baalu aaqwaamin yashtarituwna shuruwtana laysat fiy kitaabi alllahi, mani ashtarata shartana laysa fiy kitaabi alllahi falaysa lahu, waiini ashtarata miaiaaa marraain ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'aliyyun qaala yahyaa wa'abdu alwahhaabi 'an yahyaa 'an 'amraaa‏.‏ waqaala ja'faru bnu 'awnin 'an yahyaa qaala sami'tu 'amraaa qaalat sami'tu 'aaiishaaa‏.‏ rawaahu maalikun 'an yahyaa 'an 'amraaa aanna bariyraaa‏.‏ walam yadhkur sa'ida alminbara‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Barirah came to seek my help regarding her manumission (freedom). I told her, "If you like I would pay your price to your masters but your Wala' (allegiance) would be for me." Her masters said, "If you like, you can pay what remains (of the price of her manumission), (Sufyan the sub-narrator once said), or if you like you can manumit her, but her (inheritance) Al-Wala would be for us. "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came, I spoke to him about it. He said, "Buy her and manumit her. No doubt Al-Wala' is for the manumitted." Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood on the pulpit (or Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ascended the pulpit as Sufyan once said), and said, "What about some people who impose conditions which are not present in Allah's Book (Laws)? Whoever imposes conditions which are not in Allah's Book (Laws), his conditions will be invalid even if he imposed them a hundred times
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ كَعْبٍ، أَنَّهُ تَقَاضَى ابْنَ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ دَيْنًا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا حَتَّى سَمِعَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ فِي بَيْتِهِ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمَا حَتَّى كَشَفَ سِجْفَ حُجْرَتِهِ فَنَادَى ‏"‏ يَا كَعْبُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ضَعْ مِنْ دَيْنِكَ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ أَىِ الشَّطْرَ قَالَ لَقَدْ فَعَلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُمْ فَاقْضِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, qaala aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an ka'bin, aannahu taqaadaa abna aabiy hadradin daynana kaana lahu 'alayhi fiy almasjidi, faartafa'at aaswaatuhumaa hattaa sami'ahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa fiy baytihi, fakharaja iilayhimaa hattaa kashafa sijfa hujratihi fanaadaa ‏"‏ yaa ka'bu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ da' min daynika hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waaawmaaa iilayhi aaai alshhatra qaala laqad fa'altu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qum faaqdihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ka`b:In the mosque, I asked Ibn Abi Hadrad to pay the debts which he owed to me and our voices grew louder. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard that while he was in his house. So he came to us raising the curtain of his room and said, "O Ka`b!" I replied, "Labaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)!" He said, "O Ka`b! reduce your debt to one half," gesturing with his hand. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have done so." Then Allah's Apostle said (to Ibn Abi Hadrad), "Get up and pay the debt to him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَسْوَدَ ـ أَوِ امْرَأَةً سَوْدَاءَ ـ كَانَ يَقُمُّ الْمَسْجِدَ، فَمَاتَ، فَسَأَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْهُ فَقَالُوا مَاتَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَفَلاَ كُنْتُمْ آذَنْتُمُونِي بِهِ دُلُّونِي عَلَى قَبْرِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ـ أَوْ قَالَ قَبْرِهَا ـ فَأَتَى قَبْرَهُ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an thaabitin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rajulaan, aaswada aawi amraaaaan sawdaa'a kaana yaqummu almasjida, famaata, fasaaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'anhu faqaaluwa maata‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ aafalaa kuntum adhantumuwniy bihi dulluwniy 'alaa qabrihi ‏"‏‏.‏ aaw qaala qabrihaa faaataa qabrahu fasallaa 'alayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A black man or a black woman used to sweep the mosque and he or she died. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked about her (or him). He was told that she (or he) had died. He said, "Why did you not inform me? Show me his grave (or her grave)." So he went to her (his) grave and offered her (his) funeral prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا أُنْزِلَ الآيَاتُ مِنْ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي الرِّبَا، خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقَرَأَهُنَّ عَلَى النَّاسِ، ثُمَّ حَرَّمَ تِجَارَةَ الْخَمْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, 'an aabiy hamzaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an muslimin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat lammaa aunzila alayaatu min suwraai albaqaraai fiy alrribaa, kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa almasjidi, faqaraaahunna 'alaa alnnaasi, thumma harrama tijaaraaa alkhamri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When the verses of Surat "Al-Baqara"' about the usury Riba were revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) went to the mosque and recited them in front of the people and then banned the trade of alcohol
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً ـ أَوْ رَجُلاً ـ كَانَتْ تَقُمُّ الْمَسْجِدَ ـ وَلاَ أُرَاهُ إِلاَّ امْرَأَةً ـ فَذَكَرَ حَدِيثَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ صَلَّى عَلَى قَبْرِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu waaqidin, qaala haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an thaabitin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna amraaaaan aaw rajulaan kaanat taqummu almasjida walaa auraahu iilaaa amraaaaan fadhakara hadiytha alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu sallaa 'alaa qabrihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Rafi: Abu Huraira said, "A man or a woman used to clean the mosque." (A sub-narrator said, 'Most probably a woman..') Then he narrated the Hadith of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحٌ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ عِفْرِيتًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ تَفَلَّتَ عَلَىَّ الْبَارِحَةَ ـ أَوْ كَلِمَةً نَحْوَهَا ـ لِيَقْطَعَ عَلَىَّ الصَّلاَةَ، فَأَمْكَنَنِي اللَّهُ مِنْهُ، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَرْبِطَهُ إِلَى سَارِيَةٍ مِنْ سَوَارِي الْمَسْجِدِ، حَتَّى تُصْبِحُوا وَتَنْظُرُوا إِلَيْهِ كُلُّكُمْ، فَذَكَرْتُ قَوْلَ أَخِي سُلَيْمَانَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لاَ يَنْبَغِي لأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ رَوْحٌ فَرَدَّهُ خَاسِئًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala aakhbaranaa rawhun, wamuhammadu bnu ja'farin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna 'ifriytana mina aljinni tafallata 'alaaaa albaarihaaa aaw kalimaaan nahwahaa liyaqta'a 'alaaaa alssalaaaa, faaamkananiy alllahu minhu, faaaradtu aan aarbitahu iilaa saariyaain min sawaariy almasjidi, hattaa tusbihuwa watanzuruwa iilayhi kullukum, fadhakartu qawla aakhiy sulaymaana rabbi hab liy mulkana laa yanbaghiy laahadin min ba'diy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala rawhun faraddahu khaasiiana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira: "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Last night a big demon (afreet) from the Jinns came to me and wanted to interrupt my prayers (or said something similar) but Allah enabled me to overpower him. I wanted to fasten him to one of the pillars of the mosque so that all of you could See him in the morning but I remembered the statement of my brother Solomon (as stated in Quran): My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me a kingdom such as shall not belong to anybody after me (38.35)." The sub narrator Rauh said, "He (the demon) was dismissed humiliated
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْلاً قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ، فَجَاءَتْ بِرَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي حَنِيفَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ أُثَالٍ، فَرَبَطُوهُ بِسَارِيَةٍ مِنْ سَوَارِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَطْلِقُوا ثُمَامَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ إِلَى نَخْلٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَاغْتَسَلَ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, qaala haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy sa'iydin, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, qaala ba'atha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaylaan qibala najdin, fajaa'at birajulin min baniy haniyfaaa yuqaalu lahu thumaamaau bnu authaalin, farabatuwhu bisaariyaain min sawaariy almasjidi, fakharaja iilayhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aatliquwa thumaamaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faantalaqa iilaa nakhlin qariybin mina almasjidi, faaghtasala thumma dakhala almasjida faqaala aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent some horsemen to Najd and they brought a man called Thumama bin Uthal from Bani Hanifa. They fastened him to one of the pillars of the mosque. The Prophet (ﷺ) came and ordered them to release him. He went to a (garden of) date-palms near the mosque, took a bath and entered the mosque again and said, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is His Apostle" (i.e. he embraced Islam)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أُصِيبَ سَعْدٌ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ فِي الأَكْحَلِ، فَضَرَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْمَةً فِي الْمَسْجِدِ لِيَعُودَهُ مِنْ قَرِيبٍ، فَلَمْ يَرُعْهُمْ ـ وَفِي الْمَسْجِدِ خَيْمَةٌ مِنْ بَنِي غِفَارٍ ـ إِلاَّ الدَّمُ يَسِيلُ إِلَيْهِمْ فَقَالُوا يَا أَهْلَ الْخَيْمَةِ، مَا هَذَا الَّذِي يَأْتِينَا مِنْ قِبَلِكُمْ فَإِذَا سَعْدٌ يَغْذُو جُرْحُهُ دَمًا، فَمَاتَ فِيهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu yahyaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, qaala haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat ausiyba sa'dun yawma alkhandaqi fiy alaakhali, fadaraba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm khaymaaan fiy almasjidi liya'uwdahu min qariybin, falam yaru'hum wafiy almasjidi khaymaaun min baniy ghifaarin iilaaa alddamu yasiylu iilayhim faqaaluwa yaa aahla alkhaymaai, maa hadhaa alladhiy yaatiynaa min qibalikum faiidhaa sa'dun yaghdhuw jurhuhu damana, famaata fiyhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:On the day of Al-Khandaq (battle of the Trench) the medial arm vein of Sa`d bin Mu`ad [??] was injured and the Prophet (ﷺ) pitched a tent in the mosque to look after him. There was another tent for Banu Ghaffar in the mosque and the blood started flowing from Sa`d's tent to the tent of Bani Ghaffar. They shouted, "O occupants of the tent! What is coming from you to us?" They found that Sa`d's wound was bleeding profusely and Sa`d died in his tent
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ شَكَوْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِّي أَشْتَكِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ طُوفِي مِنْ وَرَاءِ النَّاسِ وَأَنْتِ رَاكِبَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَطُفْتُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي إِلَى جَنْبِ الْبَيْتِ، يَقْرَأُ بِالطُّورِ وَكِتَابٍ مَسْطُورٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni nawfalin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an zaynaba binti aabiy salamaaa, 'an aummi salamaaa, qaalat shakawtu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanniy aashtakiy‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ tuwfiy min waraa'i alnnaasi waaanti raakibaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ fatuftu warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy iilaa janbi albayti, yaqraau bialttuwri wakitaabin mastuwrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:I complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that I was sick. He told me to perform the Tawaf behind the people while riding. So I did so and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was praying beside the Ka`ba and reciting the Sura starting with "Wat-tur wa kitabin mastur
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَا مِنْ عِنْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُظْلِمَةٍ، وَمَعَهُمَا مِثْلُ الْمِصْبَاحَيْنِ يُضِيآنِ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمَا، فَلَمَّا افْتَرَقَا صَارَ مَعَ كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا وَاحِدٌ حَتَّى أَتَى أَهْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, qaala haddathanaa aanasun, aanna rajulayni, min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharajaa min 'indi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy laylaain muzlimaain, wama'ahumaa mithlu almisbaahayni yudiyani bayna aaydiyhimaa, falammaa aftaraqaa saara ma'a kulli waahidin minhumaa waahidun hattaa aataa aahlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Two of the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) departed from him on a dark night and were led by two lights like lamps (going in front of them from Allah as a miracle) lighting the way in front of them, and when they parted, each of them was accompanied by one of these lights till he reached their (respective) houses
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ خَطَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَيَّرَ عَبْدًا بَيْنَ الدُّنْيَا وَبَيْنَ مَا عِنْدَهُ، فَاخْتَارَ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَبَكَى أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَقُلْتُ فِي نَفْسِي مَا يُبْكِي هَذَا الشَّيْخَ إِنْ يَكُنِ اللَّهُ خَيَّرَ عَبْدًا بَيْنَ الدُّنْيَا وَبَيْنَ مَا عِنْدَهُ فَاخْتَارَ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هُوَ الْعَبْدَ، وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَعْلَمَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ لاَ تَبْكِ، إِنَّ أَمَنَّ النَّاسِ عَلَىَّ فِي صُحْبَتِهِ وَمَالِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَلَوْ كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذًا خَلِيلاً مِنْ أُمَّتِي لاَتَّخَذْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، وَلَكِنْ أُخُوَّةُ الإِسْلاَمِ وَمَوَدَّتُهُ، لاَ يَبْقَيَنَّ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ باب إِلاَّ سُدَّ إِلاَّ باب أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu sinaanin, qaala haddathanaa fulayhun, qaala haddathanaa aabuw alnnadri, 'an 'ubaydi bni hunaynin, 'an busri bni sa'iydin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala khataba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha khayyara 'abdana bayna alddunyaa wabayna maa 'indahu, faakhtaara maa 'inda alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ fabakaa aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh faqultu fiy nafsiy maa yubkiy hadhaa alshhaykha iin yakuni alllahu khayyara 'abdana bayna alddunyaa wabayna maa 'indahu faakhtaara maa 'inda alllahi, fakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm huwa al'abda, wakaana aabuw bakrin aa'lamanaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa bakrin laa tabki, iinna aamanna alnnaasi 'alaaaa fiy suhbatihi wamaalihi aabuw bakrin, walaw kuntu muttakhidhana khaliylaan min aummatiy laattakhadhtu aabaa bakrin, walakin aukhuwwaau aliislaami wamawaddatuhu, laa yabqayanna fiy almasjidi bab iilaaa sudda iilaaa bab aabiy bakrin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon and said, "Allah gave a choice to one of (His) slaves either to choose this world or what is with Him in the Hereafter. He chose the latter." Abu Bakr wept. I said to myself, "Why is this Sheikh weeping, if Allah gave choice to one (of His) slaves either to choose this world or what is with Him in the Here after and he chose the latter?" And that slave was Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) himself. Abu Bakr knew more than us. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Bakr! Don't weep. The Prophet (ﷺ) added: Abu- Bakr has favored me much with his property and company. If I were to take a Khalil from mankind I would certainly have taken Abu Bakr but the Islamic brotherhood and friendship is sufficient. Close all the gates in the mosque except that of Abu Bakr
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْجُعْفِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ يَعْلَى بْنَ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ عَاصِبٌ رَأْسَهُ بِخِرْقَةٍ، فَقَعَدَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنَ النَّاسِ أَحَدٌ أَمَنَّ عَلَىَّ فِي نَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ مِنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ، وَلَوْ كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذًا مِنَ النَّاسِ خَلِيلاً لاَتَّخَذْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ خَلِيلاً، وَلَكِنْ خُلَّةُ الإِسْلاَمِ أَفْضَلُ، سُدُّوا عَنِّي كُلَّ خَوْخَةٍ فِي هَذَا الْمَسْجِدِ غَيْرَ خَوْخَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin alju'fiyyu, qaala haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, qaala haddathanaa aabiy qaala, sami'tu ya'laa bna hakiymin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy maradihi alladhiy maata fiyhi 'aasibun raasahu bikhirqaain, faqa'ada 'alaa alminbari, fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala ‏ "‏ iinnahu laysa mina alnnaasi aahadun aamanna 'alaaaa fiy nafsihi wamaalihi min aabiy bakri bni aabiy quhaafaaa, walaw kuntu muttakhidhana mina alnnaasi khaliylaan laattakhadhtu aabaa bakrin khaliylaan, walakin khullaau aliislaami aafdalu, sudduwa 'anniy kulla khawkhaain fiy hadhaa almasjidi ghayra khawkhaai aabiy bakrin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:"Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his fatal illness came out with a piece of cloth tied round his head and sat on the pulpit. After thanking and praising Allah he said, "There is no one who had done more favor to me with life and property than Abu Bakr bin Abi Quhafa. If I were to take a Khalil, I would certainly have taken Abu- Bakr but the Islamic brotherhood is superior. Close all the small doors in this mosque except that of Abu Bakr
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدِمَ مَكَّةَ، فَدَعَا عُثْمَانَ بْنَ طَلْحَةَ، فَفَتَحَ الْبَابَ، فَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِلاَلٌ وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، ثُمَّ أُغْلِقَ الْبَابُ، فَلَبِثَ فِيهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَبَدَرْتُ فَسَأَلْتُ بِلاَلاً فَقَالَ صَلَّى فِيهِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ فِي أَىٍّ قَالَ بَيْنَ الأُسْطُوَانَتَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَذَهَبَ عَلَىَّ أَنْ أَسْأَلَهُ كَمْ صَلَّى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, waqutaybaau, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qadima makkaaa, fada'aa 'uthmaana bna talhaaa, fafataha albaaba, fadakhala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wabilaalun waausaamaau bnu zaydin wa'uthmaanu bnu talhaaa, thumma aughliqa albaabu, falabitha fiyhi saa'aaan thumma kharajuwa‏.‏ qaala abnu 'umara fabadartu fasaaaltu bilaalaan faqaala sallaa fiyhi‏.‏ faqultu fiy aaaain qaala bayna alaustuwaanatayni‏.‏ qaala abnu 'umara fadhahaba 'alaaaa aan aasaalahu kam sallaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Mecca and sent for `Uthman bin Talha. He opened the gate of the Ka`ba and the Prophet, Bilal, Usama bin Zaid and `Uthman bin Talha entered the Ka`ba and then they closed its door (from inside). They stayed there for an hour, and then came out." Ibn `Umar added, "I quickly went to Bilal and asked him (whether the Prophet (ﷺ) had prayed). Bilal replied, 'He prayed in it.' I asked, 'Where?' He replied, 'Between the two pillars.' "Ibn `Umar added, "I forgot to ask how many rak`at he (the Prophet) had prayed in the Ka`ba
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْلاً قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ، فَجَاءَتْ بِرَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي حَنِيفَةَ يُقَالُ لَهُ ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ أُثَالٍ، فَرَبَطُوهُ بِسَارِيَةٍ مِنْ سَوَارِي الْمَسْجِدِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khaylaan qibala najdin, fajaa'at birajulin min baniy haniyfaaa yuqaalu lahu thumaamaau bnu authaalin, farabatuwhu bisaariyaain min sawaariy almasjidi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent some horse men to Najd and they brought a man called Thumama bin Uthal from Bani Hanifa. They fastened him to one of the pillars of the mosque
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْجُعَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ خُصَيْفَةَ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ قَائِمًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَحَصَبَنِي رَجُلٌ، فَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ اذْهَبْ فَأْتِنِي بِهَذَيْنِ‏.‏ فَجِئْتُهُ بِهِمَا‏.‏ قَالَ مَنْ أَنْتُمَا ـ أَوْ مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتُمَا قَالاَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الطَّائِفِ‏.‏ قَالَ لَوْ كُنْتُمَا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَلَدِ لأَوْجَعْتُكُمَا، تَرْفَعَانِ أَصْوَاتَكُمَا فِي مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa alju'aydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala haddathaniy yaziydu bnu khusayfaaa, 'ani alssaaiibi bni yaziyda, qaala kuntu qaaiimana fiy almasjidi fahasabaniy rajulun, fanazartu faiidhaa 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi faqaala adhhab faatiniy bihadhayni‏.‏ fajiituhu bihimaa‏.‏ qaala man aantumaa aaw min aayna aantumaa qaalaa min aahli alttaaiifi‏.‏ qaala law kuntumaa min aahli albaladi laawja'tukumaa, tarfa'aani aaswaatakumaa fiy masjidi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Sa'ib bin Yazid:I was standing in the mosque and somebody threw a gravel at me. I looked and found that he was `Umar bin Al-Khattab. He said to me, "Fetch those two men to me." When I did, he said to them, "Who are you? (Or) where do you come from?" They replied, "We are from Ta'if." `Umar said, "Were you from this city (Medina) I would have punished you for raising your voices in the mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، تَقَاضَى ابْنَ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ دَيْنًا لَهُ عَلَيْهِ، فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا حَتَّى سَمِعَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِهِ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى كَشَفَ سِجْفَ حُجْرَتِهِ وَنَادَى ‏"‏ يَا كَعْبُ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَا كَعْبُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ أَنْ ضَعِ الشَّطْرَ مِنْ دَيْنِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ كَعْبٌ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قُمْ فَاقْضِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu, qaala haddathanaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu ka'bi bni maalikin, aanna ka'ba bna maalikin, aakhbarahu aannahu, taqaadaa abna aabiy hadradin daynana lahu 'alayhi, fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy almasjidi, faartafa'at aaswaatuhumaa hattaa sami'ahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa fiy baytihi, fakharaja iilayhimaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa kashafa sijfa hujratihi wanaadaa ‏"‏ yaa ka'bu bna maalikin, yaa ka'bu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala labbayka yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faaashaara biyadihi aan da'i alshhatra min daynika‏.‏ qaala ka'bun qad fa'altu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ qum faaqdihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ka`b bin Malik:During the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I asked Ibn Abi Hadrad in the mosque to pay the debts which he owed to me and our voices grew so loud that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard them while he was in his house. So he came to us after raising the curtain of his room. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Ka`b bin Malik!" I replied, "Labaik, O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." He gestured with his hand to me to reduce the debt to one half. I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I have done it." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said (to Ibn Abi Hadrad), "Get up and pay it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ مَا تَرَى فِي صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، فَإِذَا خَشِيَ الصُّبْحَ صَلَّى وَاحِدَةً، فَأَوْتَرَتْ لَهُ مَا صَلَّى ‏"‏‏.‏ وَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ اجْعَلُوا آخِرَ صَلاَتِكُمْ وِتْرًا، فَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ بِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala saaala rajulun alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa 'alaa alminbari maa taraa fiy salaaai alllayli qaala ‏ "‏ mathnaa mathnaa, faiidhaa khashiya alssubha sallaa waahidaaan, faaawtarat lahu maa sallaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waiinnahu kaana yaquwlu aj'aluwa akhira salaatikum witrana, faiinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aamara bihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, "While the Prophet (ﷺ) was on the pulpit, a man asked him how to offer the night prayers. He replied, 'Pray two rak`at at a time and then two and then two and so on, and if you are afraid of the dawn (the approach of the time of the Fajr prayer) pray one rak`a and that will be the witr for all the rak`at which you have offered." Ibn `Umar said, "The last rak`at of the night prayer should be odd, for the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered it to be so
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يَخْطُبُ فَقَالَ كَيْفَ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، فَإِذَا خَشِيتَ الصُّبْحَ فَأَوْتِرْ بِوَاحِدَةٍ، تُوتِرُ لَكَ مَا قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً نَادَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, qaala haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rajulaan, jaa'a iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa yakhtubu faqaala kayfa salaaau alllayli faqaala ‏ "‏ mathnaa mathnaa, faiidhaa khashiyta alssubha faaawtir biwaahidaain, tuwtiru laka maa qad sallayta ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alwaliydu bnu kathiyrin haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi aanna abna 'umara haddathahum aanna rajulaan naadaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa fiy almasjidi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was delivering the sermon and asked him how to offer the night prayers. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, 'Pray two rak`at at a time and then two and then two and so on and if you are afraid of dawn (the approach of the time of the Fajr prayer) pray one rak`a and that will be the witr for all the rak`at which you have prayed." Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah bin `Umar: A man called the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was in the mosque
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
