verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, qaala haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala auqiymati alssalaaau fasawwaa alnnaasu sufuwfahum, fakharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fataqaddama wahwa junubun thumma qaala ‏ "‏ 'alaa makaanikum ‏"‏‏.‏ faraja'a faaghtasala thumma kharaja waraasuhu yaqturu maa'an fasallaa bihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once Iqama was pronounced and the people had straightened the rows, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went forward (to lead the prayer) but he was Junub, so he said, "Remain in your places." And he went out, took a bath and returned with water trickling from his head. Then he led the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهِ مَا كِدْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ حَتَّى كَادَتِ الشَّمْسُ تَغْرُبُ، وَذَلِكَ بَعْدَ مَا أَفْطَرَ الصَّائِمُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَاللَّهِ مَا صَلَّيْتُهَا ‏"‏ فَنَزَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى بُطْحَانَ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى ـ يَعْنِي الْعَصْرَ ـ بَعْدَ مَا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى بَعْدَهَا الْمَغْرِبَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa salamaaa, yaquwlu aakhbaranaa jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm jaa'ahu 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi yawma alkhandaqi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, waalllahi maa kidtu aan ausalliya hattaa kaadati alshhamsu taghrubu, wadhalika ba'da maa aaftara alssaaiimu‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalllahi maa sallaytuhaa ‏"‏ fanazala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa buthaana waaanaa ma'ahu fatawaddaaa thumma sallaa ya'niy al'asra ba'da maa gharabati alshhamsu, thumma sallaa ba'dahaa almaghriba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of Al-Khandaq (the trench), `Umar bin Al-Khattab went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, I could not pray (the `Asr) till the sun had set." `Umar told this to the Prophet at the time when a fasting person had done Iftar (taken his meals). The Prophet (ﷺ) then went to Buthan and I was with him. He performed ablution and offered the `Asr prayer after the sun had set and then the Maghrib prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنَاجِي رَجُلاً فِي جَانِبِ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَمَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى نَامَ الْقَوْمُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin 'abdu alllahi bnu 'amrinw, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu suhaybin, 'an aanasin, qaala auqiymati alssalaaau waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yunaajiy rajulaan fiy jaanibi almasjidi, famaa qaama iilaa alssalaaai hattaa naama alqawmu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Once the Iqama was pronounced and the Prophet (ﷺ) was talking to a man (in a low voice) in a corner of the mosque and he did not lead the prayer till (some of) the people had slept (dozed in a sitting posture)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ثَابِتًا الْبُنَانِيَّ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ، يَتَكَلَّمُ بَعْدَ مَا تُقَامُ الصَّلاَةُ فَحَدَّثَنِي عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَعَرَضَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ فَحَبَسَهُ بَعْدَ مَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ayyaashu bnu alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, qaala haddathanaa humaydun, qaala saaaltu thaabitana albunaaniyya 'ani alrrajuli, yatakallamu ba'da maa tuqaamu alssalaaau fahaddathaniy 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala auqiymati alssalaaau fa'arada lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun fahabasahu ba'da maa auqiymati alssalaaau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once Iqama was pronounced a man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and detained him (from the prayer)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ بِحَطَبٍ فَيُحْطَبَ، ثُمَّ آمُرَ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَيُؤَذَّنَ لَهَا، ثُمَّ آمُرَ رَجُلاً فَيَؤُمَّ النَّاسَ، ثُمَّ أُخَالِفَ إِلَى رِجَالٍ فَأُحَرِّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ بُيُوتَهُمْ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَوْ يَعْلَمُ أَحَدُهُمْ أَنَّهُ يَجِدُ عَرْقًا سَمِينًا أَوْ مِرْمَاتَيْنِ حَسَنَتَيْنِ لَشَهِدَ الْعِشَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laqad hamamtu aan amura bihatabin fayuhtaba, thumma amura bialssalaaai fayuuadhhana lahaa, thumma amura rajulaan fayauumma alnnaasa, thumma aukhaalifa iilaa rijaalin faauharriqa 'alayhim buyuwtahum, waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi law ya'lamu aahaduhum aannahu yajidu 'arqana samiynana aaw mirmaatayni hasanatayni lashahida al'ishaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is I was about to order for collecting firewood (fuel) and then order Someone to pronounce the Adhan for the prayer and then order someone to lead the prayer then I would go from behind and burn the houses of men who did not present themselves for the (compulsory congregational) prayer. By Him, in Whose Hands my soul is, if anyone of them had known that he would get a bone covered with good meat or two (small) pieces of meat present in between two ribs, he would have turned up for the `Isha' prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ الْجَمَاعَةِ تَفْضُلُ صَلاَةَ الْفَذِّ بِسَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ salaaau aljamaa'aai tafdulu salaaaa alfadhhi bisab'in wa'ishriyna darajaaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The prayer in congregation is twenty seven times superior to the prayer offered by a person alone
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ الْجَمَاعَةِ تَفْضُلُ صَلاَةَ الْفَذِّ بِخَمْسٍ وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, haddathaniy abnu alhaadi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni khabbaabin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ salaaau aljamaa'aai tafdulu salaaaa alfadhhi bikhamsin wa'ishriyna darajaaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The prayer in congregation is twenty five times superior to the prayer offered by a person alone
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا صَالِحٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي الْجَمَاعَةِ تُضَعَّفُ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ فِي بَيْتِهِ وَفِي سُوقِهِ خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ ضِعْفًا، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ لاَ يُخْرِجُهُ إِلاَّ الصَّلاَةُ، لَمْ يَخْطُ خَطْوَةً إِلاَّ رُفِعَتْ لَهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةٌ، وَحُطَّ عَنْهُ بِهَا خَطِيئَةٌ، فَإِذَا صَلَّى لَمْ تَزَلِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ مَا دَامَ فِي مُصَلاَّهُ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ‏.‏ وَلاَ يَزَالُ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي صَلاَةٍ مَا انْتَظَرَ الصَّلاَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, qaala haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala sami'tu aabaa saalihin, yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ salaaau alrrajuli fiy aljamaa'aai tuda''afu 'alaa salaatihi fiy baytihi wafiy suwqihi khamsana wa'ishriyna di'fana, wadhalika aannahu iidhaa tawaddaaa faaahsana alwuduw'a, thumma kharaja iilaa almasjidi laa yukhrijuhu iilaaa alssalaaau, lam yakhtu khatwaaan iilaaa rufi'at lahu bihaa darajaaun, wahutta 'anhu bihaa khatiyiaaun, faiidhaa sallaa lam tazali almalaaiikaau tusalliy 'alayhi maa daama fiy musalaaahu alllahumma salli 'alayhi, alllahumma arhamhu‏.‏ walaa yazaalu aahadukum fiy salaaain maa antazara alssalaaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The reward of the prayer offered by a person in congregation is twenty five times greater than that of the prayer offered in one's house or in the market (alone). And this is because if he performs ablution and does it perfectly and then proceeds to the mosque with the sole intention of praying, then for every step he takes towards the mosque, he is upgraded one degree in reward and his one sin is taken off (crossed out) from his accounts (of deeds). When he offers his prayer, the angels keep on asking Allah's Blessings and Allah's forgiveness for him as long as he is (staying) at his Musalla. They say, 'O Allah! Bestow Your blessings upon him, be Merciful and kind to him.' And one is regarded in prayer as long as one is waiting for the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ تَفْضُلُ صَلاَةُ الْجَمِيعِ صَلاَةَ أَحَدِكُمْ وَحْدَهُ بِخَمْسٍ وَعِشْرِينَ جُزْءًا، وَتَجْتَمِعُ مَلاَئِكَةُ اللَّيْلِ وَمَلاَئِكَةُ النَّهَارِ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏إِنَّ قُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا‏}‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzuuhriyii, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayaabi, waaabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alraahmani aanaa aabaa hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ tafdulu salaaau aljamiy'i salaaaa aahadikum wahdahu bikhamsin wa'ishriyna juz'ana, watajtami'u malaaiikaau allaayli wamalaaiikaau alnaahaari fiy salaaai alfajri ‏"‏‏.‏ thumaa yaquwlu aabuw hurayraaa faaqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏iinaa qurana alfajri kaana mashhuwdana‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Salama bin `Abdur Rahman:Abu Huraira said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'The reward of a prayer in congregation is twenty five times greater than that of a prayer offered by a person alone. The angels of the night and the angels of the day gather at the time of Fajr prayer.' " Abu Huraira then added, "Recite the Holy Book if you wish, for "Indeed, the recitation of the Qur'an in the early dawn (Fajr prayer) is ever witnessed." (17:)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ شُعَيْبٌ وَحَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ تَفْضُلُهَا بِسَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala shu'aybun wahaddathaniy naafi'un, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala tafduluhaa bisab'in wa'ishriyna darajaaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The reward of the congregational prayer is twenty seven times greater (than that of the prayer offered by a person alone)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمًا، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أُمَّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، تَقُولُ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ وَهْوَ مُغْضَبٌ فَقُلْتُ مَا أَغْضَبَكَ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا أَعْرِفُ مِنْ أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا إِلاَّ أَنَّهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ جَمِيعًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, qaala haddathanaa aabiy qaala, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala sami'tu saalimana, qaala sami'tu aumma alddardaa'i, taquwlu dakhala 'alaaaa aabuw alddardaa'i wahwa mughdabun faqultu maa aaghdabaka faqaala waalllahi maa aa'rifu min aummaai muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm shayiana iilaaa aannahum yusalluwna jamiy'ana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salim:I heard Um Ad-Darda' saying, "Abu Ad-Darda' entered the house in an angry mood. I said to him. 'What makes you angry?' He replied, 'By Allah! I do not find the followers of Muhammad doing those good things (which they used to do before) except the offering of congregational prayer." (This happened in the last days of Abu Ad-Darda' during the rule of `Uthman)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَعْظَمُ النَّاسِ أَجْرًا فِي الصَّلاَةِ أَبْعَدُهُمْ فَأَبْعَدُهُمْ مَمْشًى، وَالَّذِي يَنْتَظِرُ الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَهَا مَعَ الإِمَامِ أَعْظَمُ أَجْرًا مِنَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي ثُمَّ يَنَامُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, qaala haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aa'zamu alnnaasi aajrana fiy alssalaaai aab'aduhum faaab'aduhum mamshana, waalladhiy yantaziru alssalaaaa hattaa yusalliyahaa ma'a aliimaami aa'zamu aajrana mina alladhiy yusalliy thumma yanaamu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The people who get tremendous reward for the prayer are those who are farthest away (from the mosque) and then those who are next farthest and so on. Similarly one who waits to pray with the Imam has greater reward than one who prays and goes to bed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي بِطَرِيقٍ وَجَدَ غُصْنَ شَوْكٍ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ فَأَخَّرَهُ، فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ، فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ الشُّهَدَاءُ خَمْسَةٌ الْمَطْعُونُ، وَالْمَبْطُونُ، وَالْغَرِيقُ، وَصَاحِبُ الْهَدْمِ، وَالشَّهِيدُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ يَعْلَمُ النَّاسُ مَا فِي النِّدَاءِ وَالصَّفِّ الأَوَّلِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَجِدُوا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَسْتَهِمُوا لاَسْتَهَمُوا عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏"‏ وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِي التَّهْجِيرِ لاَسْتَبَقُوا إِلَيْهِ، وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِي الْعَتَمَةِ وَالصُّبْحِ لأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, 'an maalikin, 'an sumaaain, mawlaa aabiy bakrin 'an aabiy saalihin alssammaani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ baynamaa rajulun yamshiy bitariyqin wajada ghusna shawkin 'alaa alttariyqi faaakhharahu, fashakara alllahu lahu, faghafara lahu ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ alshhuhadaa'u khamsaaun almat'uwnu, waalmabtuwnu, waalghariyqu, wasaahibu alhadmi, waalshhahiydu fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ law ya'lamu alnnaasu maa fiy alnnidaa'i waalssaffi alaawwali thumma lam yajiduwa iilaaa aan yastahimuwa laastahamuwa 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ ‏"‏ walaw ya'lamuwna maa fiy alttahjiyri laastabaquwa iilayhi, walaw ya'lamuwna maa fiy al'atamaai waalssubhi laatawhumaa walaw habwana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "While a man was going on a way, he saw a thorny branch and removed it from the way and Allah became pleased by his action and forgave him for that." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Five are martyrs: One who dies of plague, one who dies of an Abdominal disease, one who dies of drowning, one who is buried alive (and) dies and one who is killed in Allah's cause." (The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "If the people knew the reward for pronouncing the Adhan and for standing in the first row (in the congregational prayer) and found no other way to get it except by drawing lots they would do so, and if they knew the reward of offering the Zuhr prayer early (in its stated time), they would race for it and if they knew the reward for `Isha' and Fajr prayers in congregation, they would attend them even if they were to crawl
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا بَنِي سَلِمَةَ أَلاَ تَحْتَسِبُونَ آثَارَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ فِي قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا وَآثَارَهُمْ‏}‏ قَالَ خُطَاهُمْ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدٌ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ، أَنَّ بَنِي سَلِمَةَ، أَرَادُوا أَنْ يَتَحَوَّلُوا، عَنْ مَنَازِلِهِمْ، فَيَنْزِلُوا قَرِيبًا مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَكَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُعْرُوا ‏{‏الْمَدِينَةَ‏}‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ تَحْتَسِبُونَ آثَارَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ خُطَاهُمْ آثَارُهُمْ أَنْ يُمْشَى فِي الأَرْضِ بِأَرْجُلِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni hawshabin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala haddathanaa humaydun, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa baniy salimaaa aalaa tahtasibuwna athaarakum ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala mujaahidun fiy qawlihi ‏{‏wanaktubu maa qaddamuwa waathaarahum‏}‏ qaala khutaahum‏.‏ waqaala abnu aabiy maryama aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathaniy humaydun, haddathaniy aanasun, aanna baniy salimaaa, aaraaduwa aan yatahawwaluwa, 'an manaazilihim, fayanziluwa qariybana mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fakariha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yu'ruwa ‏{‏almadiynaaa‏}‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aalaa tahtasibuwna athaarakum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala mujaahidun khutaahum athaaruhum aan yumshaa fiy alaardi biaarjulihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humaid:Anas said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'O Bani Salima! Don't you think that for every step of yours (that you take towards the mosque) there is a reward (while coming for prayer)?" Mujahid said: "Regarding Allah's Statement: "We record that which they have sent before (them), and their traces" (36.12). 'Their traces' means 'their steps.' " And Anas said that the people of Bani Salima wanted to shift to a place near the Prophet (ﷺ) but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked the idea of leaving their houses uninhabited and said, "Don't you think that you will get the reward for your footprints." Mujahid said, "Their foot prints mean their foot steps and their going on foot
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ صَلاَةٌ أَثْقَلَ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ وَالْعِشَاءِ، وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِيهِمَا لأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا، لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ الْمُؤَذِّنَ فَيُقِيمَ، ثُمَّ آمُرَ رَجُلاً يَؤُمُّ النَّاسَ، ثُمَّ آخُذَ شُعَلاً مِنْ نَارٍ فَأُحَرِّقَ عَلَى مَنْ لاَ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, qaala haddathanaa aabiy qaala, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala haddathaniy aabuw saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laysa salaaaun aathqala 'alaa almunaafiqiyna mina alfajri waal'ishaa'i, walaw ya'lamuwna maa fiyhimaa laatawhumaa walaw habwana, laqad hamamtu aan amura almuuadhhina fayuqiyma, thumma amura rajulaan yauummu alnnaasa, thumma akhudha shu'alaan min naarin faauharriqa 'alaa man laa yakhruju iilaa alssalaaai ba'du ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No prayer is heavier upon the hypocrites than the Fajr and the `Isha' prayers and if they knew what is in them (in reward), they would have attended them, even if (it was) crawling. Certainly, I felt the urge to order the Mu'adh-dhin (call-maker) so that he would pronounce Iqama, then order a man to lead the people (in prayer), then take a flame of fire so that I burn (the houses) upon those who had not left for the prayer yet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَأَذِّنَا وَأَقِيمَا، ثُمَّ لِيَؤُمَّكُمَا أَكْبَرُكُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, qaala haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an maaliki bni alhuwayrithi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa hadarati alssalaaau faaadhhinaa waaaqiymaa, thumma liyauummakumaa aakbarukumaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Malik bin Huwairith:Prophet said (to two persons), "Whenever the prayer time becomes due, you should pronounce Adhan and then Iqama and the older of you should lead the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ تُصَلِّي عَلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مَا دَامَ فِي مُصَلاَّهُ مَا لَمْ يُحْدِثْ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ‏.‏ لاَ يَزَالُ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي صَلاَةٍ مَا دَامَتِ الصَّلاَةُ تَحْبِسُهُ، لاَ يَمْنَعُهُ أَنْ يَنْقَلِبَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ إِلاَّ الصَّلاَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almalaaiikaau tusalliy 'alaa aahadikum maa daama fiy musalaaahu maa lam yuhdith alllahumma aghfir lahu, alllahumma arhamhu‏.‏ laa yazaalu aahadukum fiy salaaain maa daamati alssalaaau tahbisuhu, laa yamna'uhu aan yanqaliba iilaa aahlihi iilaaa alssalaaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The angels keep on asking for Allah's Blessing and Forgiveness for anyone of you as long as he is at his Musalla (praying place) and does not do Hadath (passes wind). The angels say, 'O Allah! Forgive him and be Merciful to him.' Each one of you is in the prayer as long as he is waiting for the prayer and nothing but the prayer detains him from going to his family
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي خُبَيْبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَبْعَةٌ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي ظِلِّهِ يَوْمَ لاَ ظِلَّ إِلاَّ ظِلُّهُ الإِمَامُ الْعَادِلُ، وَشَابٌّ نَشَأَ فِي عِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ، وَرَجُلٌ قَلْبُهُ مُعَلَّقٌ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ، وَرَجُلاَنِ تَحَابَّا فِي اللَّهِ اجْتَمَعَا عَلَيْهِ وَتَفَرَّقَا عَلَيْهِ، وَرَجُلٌ طَلَبَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ ذَاتُ مَنْصِبٍ وَجَمَالٍ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ اللَّهَ‏.‏ وَرَجُلٌ تَصَدَّقَ أَخْفَى حَتَّى لاَ تَعْلَمَ شِمَالُهُ مَا تُنْفِقُ يَمِينُهُ، وَرَجُلٌ ذَكَرَ اللَّهَ خَالِيًا فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy khubaybu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ sab'aaun yuzilluhumu alllahu fiy zillihi yawma laa zilla iilaaa zilluhu aliimaamu al'aadilu, washaabbun nashaaa fiy 'ibaadaai rabbihi, warajulun qalbuhu mu'allaqun fiy almasaajidi, warajulaani tahaabbaa fiy alllahi ajtama'aa 'alayhi watafarraqaa 'alayhi, warajulun talabathu amraaaaun dhaatu mansibin wajamaalin faqaala iinniy aakhaafu alllaha‏.‏ warajulun tasaddaqa aakhfaa hattaa laa ta'lama shimaaluhu maa tunfiqu yamiynuhu, warajulun dhakara alllaha khaaliyana fafaadat 'aynaahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will give shade, to seven, on the Day when there will be no shade but His. (These seven persons are) a just ruler, a youth who has been brought up in the worship of Allah (i.e. worships Allah sincerely from childhood), a man whose heart is attached to the mosques (i.e. to pray the compulsory prayers in the mosque in congregation), two persons who love each other only for Allah's sake and they meet and part in Allah's cause only, a man who refuses the call of a charming woman of noble birth for illicit intercourse with her and says: I am afraid of Allah, a man who gives charitable gifts so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right hand has given (i.e. nobody knows how much he has given in charity), and a person who remembers Allah in seclusion and his eyes are then flooded with tears
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ سُئِلَ أَنَسٌ هَلِ اتَّخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاتَمًا فَقَالَ نَعَمْ، أَخَّرَ لَيْلَةً صَلاَةَ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى شَطْرِ اللَّيْلِ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ بَعْدَ مَا صَلَّى فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلَّى النَّاسُ وَرَقَدُوا وَلَمْ تَزَالُوا فِي صَلاَةٍ مُنْذُ انْتَظَرْتُمُوهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى وَبِيصِ خَاتَمِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an humaydin, qaala suiila aanasun hali attakhadha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khaatamana faqaala na'am, aakhhara laylaaan salaaaa al'ishaa'i iilaa shatri alllayli, thumma aaqbala 'alaynaa biwajhihi ba'da maa sallaa faqaala ‏ "‏ sallaa alnnaasu waraqaduwa walam tazaaluwa fiy salaaain mundhu antazartumuwhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fakaaanniy aanzuru iilaa wabiysi khaatamihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Humaid:Anas was asked, "Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wear a ring?" He said, "Yes. Once he delayed the `Isha' prayer till midnight and after the prayer, he faced us and said, 'The people prayed and have slept and you remained in prayer as long as you waited for it.' " Anas added, "As if I were just now observing the glitter of his ring
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ غَدَا إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ وَرَاحَ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ نُزُلَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ كُلَّمَا غَدَا أَوْ رَاحَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, qaala aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu mutarrifin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man ghadaa iilaa almasjidi waraaha aa'adda alllahu lahu nuzulahu mina aljannaai kullamaa ghadaa aaw raaha ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah will prepare for him who goes to the mosque (every) morning and in the afternoon (for the congregational prayer) an honorable place in Paradise with good hospitality for (what he has done) every morning and afternoon goings
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ، قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعْدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حَفْصَ بْنَ عَاصِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَزْدِ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَالِكٌ ابْنُ بُحَيْنَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى رَجُلاً وَقَدْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَثَ بِهِ النَّاسُ، وَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الصُّبْحَ أَرْبَعًا، الصُّبْحَ أَرْبَعًا ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ غُنْدَرٌ وَمُعَاذٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ فِي مَالِكٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ سَعْدٍ عَنْ حَفْصٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ حَمَّادٌ أَخْبَرَنَا سَعْدٌ عَنْ حَفْصٍ عَنْ مَالِكٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni maalikin abni buhaynaaa, qaala marra alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm birajulin‏.‏ qaala wahaddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani, qaala haddathanaa bahzu bnu aasadin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'du bnu iibraahiyma, qaala sami'tu hafsa bna 'aasimin, qaala sami'tu rajulaan, mina alaazdi yuqaalu lahu maalikun abnu buhaynaaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa rajulaan waqad auqiymati alssalaaau yusalliy rak'atayni, falammaa ansarafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laatha bihi alnnaasu, waqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alssubha aarba'ana, alssubha aarba'ana ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu ghundarun wamu'aadhun 'an shu'baaa fiy maalikin‏.‏ waqaala abnu iishaaqa 'an sa'din 'an hafsin 'an 'abdi alllahi abni buhaynaaa‏.‏ waqaala hammaadun aakhbaranaa sa'dun 'an hafsin 'an maalikin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Malik Ibn Buhaina:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by a man praying two rak`at after the Iqama (had been pronounced). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) completed the prayer, the people gathered around him (the Prophet) or that man and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him (protesting), Are there four rak`at in Fajr prayer? Are there four rak`at in Fajr prayer?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ الأَسْوَدُ قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَذَكَرْنَا الْمُوَاظَبَةَ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ وَالتَّعْظِيمَ لَهَا، قَالَتْ لَمَّا مَرِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَضَهُ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ، فَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَأُذِّنَ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَجُلٌ أَسِيفٌ، إِذَا قَامَ فِي مَقَامِكَ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ، وَأَعَادَ فَأَعَادُوا لَهُ، فَأَعَادَ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُنَّ صَوَاحِبُ يُوسُفَ، مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَصَلَّى، فَوَجَدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ نَفْسِهِ خِفَّةً، فَخَرَجَ يُهَادَى بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ رِجْلَيْهِ تَخُطَّانِ مِنَ الْوَجَعِ، فَأَرَادَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَنْ يَتَأَخَّرَ، فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ مَكَانَكَ، ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِهِ حَتَّى جَلَسَ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ‏.‏ قِيلَ لِلأَعْمَشِ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِصَلاَتِهِ، وَالنَّاسُ يُصَلُّونَ بِصَلاَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ بِرَأْسِهِ نَعَمْ‏.‏ رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ بَعْضَهُ‏.‏ وَزَادَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ جَلَسَ عَنْ يَسَارِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي قَائِمًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy qaala, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma, qaala alaaswadu qaala kunnaa 'inda 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha fadhakarnaa almuwaazabaaa 'alaa alssalaaai waaltta'ziyma lahaa, qaalat lammaa marida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maradahu alladhiy maata fiyhi, fahadarati alssalaaau faaudhhina, faqaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqiyla lahu iinna aabaa bakrin rajulun aasiyfun, iidhaa qaama fiy maqaamika lam yastati' aan yusalliya bialnnaasi, waaa'aada faaa'aaduwa lahu, faaa'aada althhaalithaaa faqaala ‏"‏ iinnakunna sawaahibu yuwsufa, muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ fakharaja aabuw bakrin fasallaa, fawajada alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm min nafsihi khiffaaan, fakharaja yuhaadaa bayna rajulayni kaaanniy aanzuru rijlayhi takhuttaani mina alwaja'i, faaaraada aabuw bakrin aan yataaakhhara, faaawmaaa iilayhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan makaanaka, thumma autiya bihi hattaa jalasa iilaa janbihi‏.‏ qiyla lilaa'mashi wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy waaabuw bakrin yusalliy bisalaatihi, waalnnaasu yusalluwna bisalaaai aabiy bakrin faqaala biraasihi na'am‏.‏ rawaahu aabuw daawuda 'an shu'baaa 'ani alaa'mashi ba'dahu‏.‏ wazaada aabuw mu'aawiyaaa jalasa 'an yasaari aabiy bakrin fakaana aabuw bakrin yusalliy qaaiimana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Aswad:"We were with `Aisha discussing the regularity of offering the prayer and dignifying it. She said, 'When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell sick with the fatal illness and when the time of prayer became due and Adhan was pronounced, he said, 'Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer.' He was told that Abu Bakr was a softhearted man and would not be able to lead the prayer in his place. The Prophet (ﷺ) gave the same order again but he was given the same reply. He gave the order for the third time and said, 'You (women) are the companions of Joseph. Tell Abu Bakr to lead the prayer.' So Abu Bakr came out to lead the prayer. In the meantime the condition of the Prophet (ﷺ) improved a bit and he came out with the help of two men one on each side. As if I was observing his legs dragging on the ground owing to the disease. Abu Bakr wanted to retreat but the Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned him to remain at his place and the Prophet (ﷺ) was brought till he sat beside Abu Bakr." Al-A`mash was asked, "Was the Prophet (ﷺ) praying and Abu Bakr following him, and were the people following Abu Bakr in that prayer?" Al- A`mash replied in the affirmative with a nod of his head. Abu Muawiya said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) was sitting on the left side of Abu Bakr who was praying while standing
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ لَمَّا ثَقُلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاشْتَدَّ وَجَعُهُ اسْتَأْذَنَ أَزْوَاجَهُ أَنْ يُمَرَّضَ فِي بَيْتِي فَأَذِنَّ لَهُ، فَخَرَجَ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ تَخُطُّ رِجْلاَهُ الأَرْضَ، وَكَانَ بَيْنَ الْعَبَّاسِ وَرَجُلٍ آخَرَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ مَا قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقَالَ لِي وَهَلْ تَدْرِي مَنِ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي لَمْ تُسَمِّ عَائِشَةُ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ هُوَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, qaala aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu yuwsufa, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau lammaa thaqula alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waashtadda waja'uhu astaadhana aazwaajahu aan yumarrada fiy baytiy faaadhinna lahu, fakharaja bayna rajulayni takhuttu rijlaahu alaarda, wakaana bayna al'abbaasi warajulin akhara‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi fadhakartu dhalika laibni 'abbaasin maa qaalat 'aaiishaau faqaala liy wahal tadriy mani alrrajulu alladhiy lam tusammi 'aaiishaau qultu laa‏.‏ qaala huwa 'aliyyu bnu aabiy taalibin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:"When the Prophet (ﷺ) became seriously ill and his disease became aggravated he asked for permission from his wives to be nursed in my house and he was allowed. He came out with the help of two men and his legs were dragging on the ground. He was between Al-`Abbas and another man." 'Ubaidullah said, "I told Ibn `Abbas what `Aisha had narrated and he said, 'Do you know who was the (second) man whose name `Aisha did not mention'" I said, 'No.' Ibn `Abbas said, 'He was `Ali Ibn Abi Talib
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَذَّنَ بِالصَّلاَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ ذَاتِ بَرْدٍ وَرِيحٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي الرِّحَالِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْمُرُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ إِذَا كَانَتْ لَيْلَةٌ ذَاتُ بَرْدٍ وَمَطَرٍ يَقُولُ أَلاَ صَلُّوا فِي الرِّحَالِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, aadhhana bialssalaaai fiy laylaain dhaati bardin wariyhin thumma qaala aalaa salluwa fiy alrrihaali‏.‏ thumma qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaamuru almuuadhhina iidhaa kaanat laylaaun dhaatu bardin wamatarin yaquwlu aalaa salluwa fiy alrrihaali‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Once on a very cold and stormy night, Ibn `Umar pronounced the Adhan for the prayer and then said, "Pray in your homes." He (Ibn `Umar) added. "On very cold and rainy nights Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to order the Mu'adh-dhin to say, 'Pray in your homes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّ عِتْبَانَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، كَانَ يَؤُمُّ قَوْمَهُ وَهْوَ أَعْمَى، وَأَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّهَا تَكُونُ الظُّلْمَةُ وَالسَّيْلُ وَأَنَا رَجُلٌ ضَرِيرُ الْبَصَرِ، فَصَلِّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فِي بَيْتِي مَكَانًا أَتَّخِذُهُ مُصَلًّى، فَجَاءَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيْنَ تُحِبُّ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَشَارَ إِلَى مَكَانٍ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ، فَصَلَّى فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an mahmuwdi bni alrrabiy'i alaansaariyyi, aanna 'itbaana bna maalikin, kaana yauummu qawmahu wahwa aa'maa, waaannahu qaala lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinnahaa takuwnu alzzulmaau waalssaylu waaanaa rajulun dariyru albasari, fasalli yaa rasuwla alllahi fiy baytiy makaanana aattakhidhuhu musallana, fajaa'ahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aayna tuhibbu aan ausalliya ‏"‏‏.‏ faaashaara iilaa makaanin mina albayti, fasallaa fiyhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mahmud bin Rabi` Al-Ansari:`Itban bin Malik used to lead his people (tribe) in prayer and was a blind man, he said to Allah's Apostle , "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! At times it is dark and flood water is flowing (in the valley) and I am a blind man, so please pray at a place in my house so that I can take it as a Musalla (praying place)." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to his house and said, "Where do you like me to pray?" 'Itban pointed to a place in his house and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), offered the prayer there
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ، صَاحِبُ الزِّيَادِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي رَدْغٍ، فَأَمَرَ الْمُؤَذِّنَ لَمَّا بَلَغَ حَىَّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلِ الصَّلاَةُ فِي الرِّحَالِ، فَنَظَرَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ، فَكَأَنَّهُمْ أَنْكَرُوا فَقَالَ كَأَنَّكُمْ أَنْكَرْتُمْ هَذَا إِنَّ هَذَا فَعَلَهُ مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي ـ يَعْنِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ إِنَّهَا عَزْمَةٌ، وَإِنِّي كَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُحْرِجَكُمْ‏.‏ وَعَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ نَحْوَهُ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُؤَثِّمَكُمْ، فَتَجِيئُونَ تَدُوسُونَ الطِّينَ إِلَى رُكَبِكُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu 'abdi alwahaaabi, qaala hadaathanaa hamaaadu bnu zaydin, qaala hadaathanaa 'abdu alhamiydi, saahibu alziiyaadiyii qaala sami'tu 'abda allaahi bna alhaarithi, qaala khatabanaa abnu 'abaaasin fiy yawmin dhiy radghin, faaamara almuuadhiina lamaaa balagha haaaa 'alaa alsaalaaai‏.‏ qaala quli alsaalaaau fiy alriihaali, fanazara ba'duhum iilaa ba'din, fakaaanaahum aankaruwa faqaala kaaanaakum aankartum hadhaa iinaa hadhaa fa'alahu man huwa khayrun miniiy ya'niy alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm iinaahaa 'azmaaun, waiiniiy karihtu aan auhrijakum‏.‏ wa'an hamaaadin 'an 'aasimin 'an 'abdi allaahi bni alhaarithi 'ani abni 'abaaasin nahwahu, ghayra aanaahu qaala karihtu aan auuathiimakum, fatajiyiuwna taduwsuwna altiiyna iilaa rukabikum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Al-Harith:Ibn `Abbas addressed us on a (rainy and) muddy day and when the Mu'adh-dhin said, "Come for the prayer" Ibn `Abbas ordered him to say, "Pray in your homes." The people began to look at one another with surprise as if they did not like it. Ibn `Abbas said, "It seems that you thought ill of it but no doubt it was done by one who was better than I (i.e. the Prophet). It (the prayer) is a strict order and I disliked to bring you out." Ibn `Abbas narrated the same as above but he said, "I did not like you to make you sinful (in refraining from coming to the mosque) and to come (to the mosque) covered with mud up to the knees
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ فَقَالَ جَاءَتْ سَحَابَةٌ فَمَطَرَتْ حَتَّى سَالَ السَّقْفُ، وَكَانَ مِنْ جَرِيدِ النَّخْلِ، فَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ، فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْجُدُ فِي الْمَاءِ وَالطِّينِ، حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ أَثَرَ الطِّينِ فِي جَبْهَتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala hadaathanaa hishaamun, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, qaala saaaltu aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyaa faqaala jaa'at sahaabaaun famatarat hataaa saala alsaaqfu, wakaana min jariydi alnaakhli, faauqiymati alsaalaaau, faraaaytu rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yasjudu fiy almaa'i waaltiiyni, hataaa raaaytu aathara altiiyni fiy jabhatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A cloud came and it rained till the roof started leaking and in those days the roof used to be of the branches of date-palms. Iqama was pronounced and I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prostrating in water and mud and even I saw the mark of mud on his forehead
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ إِنِّي لاَ أَسْتَطِيعُ الصَّلاَةَ مَعَكَ‏.‏ وَكَانَ رَجُلاً ضَخْمًا، فَصَنَعَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَعَامًا فَدَعَاهُ إِلَى مَنْزِلِهِ، فَبَسَطَ لَهُ حَصِيرًا وَنَضَحَ طَرَفَ الْحَصِيرِ، صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ آلِ الْجَارُودِ لأَنَسٍ أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُهُ صَلاَّهَا إِلاَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa adamu, qaala hadaathanaa shu'baau, qaala hadaathanaa aanasu bnu siyriyna, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu qaala rajulun mina alaansaari iiniiy laa aastatiy'u alsaalaaaa ma'aka‏.‏ wakaana rajulaan dakhmana, fasana'a lilnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm ta'aamana fada'aahu iilaa manzilihi, fabasata lahu hasiyrana wanadaha tarafa alhasiyri, salaaa 'alayhi rak'atayni‏.‏ faqaala rajulun min ali aljaaruwdi laanasin aakaana alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusaliiy alduuhaa qaala maa raaaytuhu salaaahaa iilaaa yawmaiidhin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Seereen:I heard Anas saying, "A man from Ansar said to the Prophet, 'I cannot pray with you (in congregation).' He was a very fat man and he prepared a meal for the Prophet (ﷺ) and invited him to his house. He spread out a mat for the Prophet, and washed one of its sides with water, and the Prophet (ﷺ) prayed two rak`at on it." A man from the family of Al-Jaruid [??] asked, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray the Duha (forenoon) prayer?" Anas said, "I did not see him praying the Duha prayer except on that day
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا وُضِعَ الْعَشَاءُ وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَابْدَءُوا بِالْعَشَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an hishaamin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy qaala, sami'tu 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa wudi'a al'ashaa'u waauqiymati alssalaaau faabda'uwa bial'ashaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If supper is served, and Iqama is pronounced one should start with the supper
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قُدِّمَ الْعَشَاءُ فَابْدَءُوا بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُصَلُّوا صَلاَةَ الْمَغْرِبِ، وَلاَ تَعْجَلُوا عَنْ عَشَائِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa quddima al'ashaa'u faabda'uwa bihi qabla aan tusalluwa salaaaa almaghribi, walaa ta'jaluwa 'an 'ashaaiikum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If the supper is served start having it before praying the Maghrib prayer and do not be hasty in finishing it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا وُضِعَ عَشَاءُ أَحَدِكُمْ وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَابْدَءُوا بِالْعَشَاءِ، وَلاَ يَعْجَلْ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يُوضَعُ لَهُ الطَّعَامُ وَتُقَامُ الصَّلاَةُ فَلاَ يَأْتِيهَا حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ، وَإِنَّهُ لَيَسْمَعُ قِرَاءَةَ الإِمَامِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, 'an aabiy ausaamaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa wudi'a 'ashaa'u aahadikum waauqiymati alssalaaau faabda'uwa bial'ashaa'i, walaa ya'jal hattaa yafrugha minhu ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana abnu 'umara yuwda'u lahu altta'aamu watuqaamu alssalaaau falaa yaatiyhaa hattaa yafrugha, waiinnahu layasma'u qiraa'aaa aliimaami‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'If the supper is served for anyone of you and the Iqama is pronounced, start with the supper and don't be in haste (and carry on eating) till you finish it." If food was served for Ibn `Umar and Iqama was pronounced, he never came to the prayer till he finished it (i.e. food) in spite of the fact that he heard the recitation (of the Qur'an) by the Imam (in the prayer)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ زُهَيْرٌ وَوَهْبُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ فَلاَ يَعْجَلْ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ حَاجَتَهُ مِنْهُ، وَإِنْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، وَوَهْبٌ مَدِينِيٌّ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala zuhayrun wawahbu bnu 'uthmaana 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa kaana aahadukum 'alaa altta'aami falaa ya'jal hattaa yaqdiya haajatahu minhu, waiin auqiymati alssalaaau ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri 'an wahbi bni 'uthmaana, wawahbun madiyniyyun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you is having his meals, he should not hurry up till he is satisfied even if the prayer has been started
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْكُلُ ذِرَاعًا يَحْتَزُّ مِنْهَا، فَدُعِيَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَقَامَ فَطَرَحَ السِّكِّينَ، فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa iibraahiymu, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy ja'faru bnu 'amriw bni aumayyaaa, aanna aabaahu, qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaakulu dhiraa'ana yahtazzu minhaa, fadu'iya iilaa alssalaaai faqaama fataraha alssikkiyna, fasallaa walam yatawaddaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ja`far bin `Amr bin Umaiya:My father said, "I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eating a piece of meat from the shoulder of a sheep and he was called for the prayer. He stood up, put down the knife and prayed but did not perform ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْنَعُ فِي بَيْتِهِ قَالَتْ كَانَ يَكُونُ فِي مِهْنَةِ أَهْلِهِ ـ تَعْنِي خِدْمَةَ أَهْلِهِ ـ فَإِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ خَرَجَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathanaa alhakamu, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa maa kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yasna'u fiy baytihi qaalat kaana yakuwnu fiy mihnaai aahlihi ta'niy khidmaaa aahlihi faiidhaa hadarati alssalaaau kharaja iilaa alssalaaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Aswad:That he asked `Aisha "What did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to do in his house?" She replied, "He used to keep himself busy serving his family and when it was the time for prayer he would go for it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ الْحُوَيْرِثِ فِي مَسْجِدِنَا هَذَا فَقَالَ إِنِّي لأُصَلِّي بِكُمْ، وَمَا أُرِيدُ الصَّلاَةَ، أُصَلِّي كَيْفَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لأَبِي قِلاَبَةَ كَيْفَ كَانَ يُصَلِّي قَالَ مِثْلَ شَيْخِنَا هَذَا‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ شَيْخًا يَجْلِسُ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السُّجُودِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْهَضَ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الأُولَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa wuhaybun, qaala haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, qaala jaa'anaa maaliku bnu alhuwayrithi fiy masjidinaa hadhaa faqaala iinniy lausalliy bikum, wamaa auriydu alssalaaaa, ausalliy kayfa raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy‏.‏ faqultu laabiy qilaabaaa kayfa kaana yusalliy qaala mithla shaykhinaa hadhaa‏.‏ qaala wakaana shaykhana yajlisu iidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alssujuwdi qabla aan yanhada fiy alrrak'aai alauwlaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aiyub:Abu Qilaba said, "Malik bin Huwairith came to this Mosque of ours and said, 'I pray in front of you and my aim is not to lead the prayer but to show you the way in which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray.' " I asked Abu Qilaba, "How did he use to pray?' " He replied, "(The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray) like this Sheikh of ours and the Sheikh used to sit for a while after the prostration, before getting up after the first rak`a
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ مَرِضَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاشْتَدَّ مَرَضُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ رَقِيقٌ، إِذَا قَامَ مَقَامَكَ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏ فَعَادَتْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرِي أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ، فَإِنَّكُنَّ صَوَاحِبُ يُوسُفَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ الرَّسُولُ فَصَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ فِي حَيَاةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu nasrin, qaala haddathanaa husaynun, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, qaala haddathaniy aabuw burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala marida alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faashtadda maraduhu faqaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau iinnahu rajulun raqiyqun, iidhaa qaama maqaamaka lam yastati' aan yusalliya bialnnaasi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi ‏"‏ fa'aadat faqaala ‏"‏ muriy aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi, faiinnakunna sawaahibu yuwsufa ‏"‏‏.‏ faaataahu alrrasuwlu fasallaa bialnnaasi fiy hayaaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:"The Prophet (ﷺ) became sick and when his disease became aggravated, he said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the prayer." `Aisha said, "He is a softhearted man and would not be able to lead the prayer in your place." The Prophet (ﷺ) said again, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer." She repeated the same reply but he said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer. You are the companions of Joseph." So the messenger went to Abu Bakr (with that order) and he led the people in prayer in the lifetime of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي مَرَضِهِ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ قُلْتُ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ إِذَا قَامَ فِي مَقَامِكَ لَمْ يُسْمِعِ النَّاسَ مِنَ الْبُكَاءِ، فَمُرْ عُمَرَ فَلْيُصَلِّ لِلنَّاسِ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقُلْتُ لِحَفْصَةَ قُولِي لَهُ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ إِذَا قَامَ فِي مَقَامِكَ لَمْ يُسْمِعِ النَّاسَ مِنَ الْبُكَاءِ، فَمُرْ عُمَرَ فَلْيُصَلِّ لِلنَّاسِ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَتْ حَفْصَةُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَهْ، إِنَّكُنَّ لأَنْتُنَّ صَوَاحِبُ يُوسُفَ، مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ لِلنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ لِعَائِشَةَ مَا كُنْتُ لأُصِيبَ مِنْكِ خَيْرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa aummi almuuminiyna rda allh 'nha aannahaa qaalat iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fiy maradihi ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin yusalliy bialnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau qultu iinna aabaa bakrin iidhaa qaama fiy maqaamika lam yusmi'i alnnaasa mina albukaa'i, famur 'umara falyusalli lilnnaasi‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau faqultu lihafsaaa quwliy lahu iinna aabaa bakrin iidhaa qaama fiy maqaamika lam yusmi'i alnnaasa mina albukaa'i, famur 'umara falyusalli lilnnaasi‏.‏ fafa'alat hafsaau‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ mah, iinnakunna laantunna sawaahibu yuwsufa, muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli lilnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaalat hafsaau li'aaiishaaa maa kuntu lausiyba minki khayrana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:the mother of the believers: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his illness said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in prayer." I said to him, "If Abu Bakr stands in your place, the people would not hear him owing to his (excessive) weeping. So please order `Umar to lead the prayer." `Aisha added I said to Hafsa, "Say to him: If Abu Bakr should lead the people in the prayer in your place, the people would not be able to hear him owing to his weeping; so please, order `Umar to lead the prayer." Hafsa did so but Allah's Apostle said, "Keep quiet! You are verily the Companions of Joseph. Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer. " Hafsa said to `Aisha, "I never got anything good from you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ ـ وَكَانَ تَبِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَخَدَمَهُ وَصَحِبَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ كَانَ يُصَلِّي لَهُمْ فِي وَجَعِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الاِثْنَيْنِ وَهُمْ صُفُوفٌ فِي الصَّلاَةِ، فَكَشَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِتْرَ الْحُجْرَةِ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْنَا، وَهْوَ قَائِمٌ كَأَنَّ وَجْهَهُ وَرَقَةُ مُصْحَفٍ، ثُمَّ تَبَسَّمَ يَضْحَكُ، فَهَمَمْنَا أَنْ نَفْتَتِنَ مِنَ الْفَرَحِ بِرُؤْيَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَنَكَصَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ لِيَصِلَ الصَّفَّ، وَظَنَّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَارِجٌ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ، فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَتِمُّوا صَلاَتَكُمْ، وَأَرْخَى السِّتْرَ، فَتُوُفِّيَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin alaansaariyyu wakaana tabi'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wakhadamahu wasahibahu aanna aabaa bakrin kaana yusalliy lahum fiy waja'i alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alladhiy tuwuffiya fiyhi, hattaa iidhaa kaana yawmu alaithnayni wahum sufuwfun fiy alssalaaai, fakashafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm sitra alhujraai yanzuru iilaynaa, wahwa qaaiimun kaaanna wajhahu waraqaau mushafin, thumma tabassama yadhaku, fahamamnaa aan naftatina mina alfarahi biruuyaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fanakasa aabuw bakrin 'alaa 'aqibayhi liyasila alssaffa, wazanna aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm khaarijun iilaa alssalaaai, faaashaara iilaynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan aatimmuwa salaatakum, waaarkhaa alssitra, fatuwuffiya min yawmihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Az-Zuhri:Anas bin Malik Al-Ansari, told me, "Abu Bakr used to lead the people in prayer during the fatal illness of the Prophet (ﷺ) till it was Monday. When the people aligned (in rows) for the prayer the Prophet (ﷺ) lifted the curtain of his house and started looking at us and was standing at that time. His face was (glittering) like a page of the Qur'an and he smiled cheerfully. We were about to be put to trial for the pleasure of seeing the Prophet, Abu Bakr retreated to join the row as he thought that the Prophet (ﷺ) would lead the prayer. The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned us to complete the prayer and he let the curtain fall. On the same day he died
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَمْ يَخْرُجِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثًا، فَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ، فَذَهَبَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَتَقَدَّمُ فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحِجَابِ فَرَفَعَهُ، فَلَمَّا وَضَحَ وَجْهُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا نَظَرْنَا مَنْظَرًا كَانَ أَعْجَبَ إِلَيْنَا مِنْ وَجْهِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ وَضَحَ لَنَا، فَأَوْمَأَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ، وَأَرْخَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْحِجَابَ، فَلَمْ يُقْدَرْ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى مَاتَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin, qaala lam yakhruji alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaathana, faauqiymati alssalaaau, fadhahaba aabuw bakrin yataqaddamu faqaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialhijaabi farafa'ahu, falammaa wadaha wajhu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa nazarnaa manzarana kaana aa'jaba iilaynaa min wajhi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna wadaha lanaa, faaawmaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi iilaa aabiy bakrin aan yataqaddama, waaarkhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alhijaaba, falam yuqdar 'alayhi hattaa maata‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) did not come out for three days. The people stood for the prayer and Abu Bakr went ahead to lead the prayer. (In the meantime) the Prophet (ﷺ) caught hold of the curtain and lifted it. When the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) appeared we had never seen a scene more pleasing than the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) as it appeared then. The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned to Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer and then let the curtain fall. We did not see him (again) till he died
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا اشْتَدَّ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَعُهُ قِيلَ لَهُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَجُلٌ رَقِيقٌ، إِذَا قَرَأَ غَلَبَهُ الْبُكَاءُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوهُ فَيُصَلِّي ‏"‏ فَعَاوَدَتْهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوهُ فَيُصَلِّي، إِنَّكُنَّ صَوَاحِبُ يُوسُفَ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ الزُّبَيْدِيُّ وَابْنُ أَخِي الزُّهْرِيِّ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الْكَلْبِيُّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُقَيْلٌ وَمَعْمَرٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, qaala haddathanaa abnu wahbin, qaala haddathaniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an hamzaaa bni 'abdi alllahi, aannahu aakhbarahu 'an aabiyhi, qaala lammaa ashtadda birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waja'uhu qiyla lahu fiy alssalaaai faqaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli bialnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau iinna aabaa bakrin rajulun raqiyqun, iidhaa qaraaa ghalabahu albukaa'u‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ muruwhu fayusalliy ‏"‏ fa'aawadathu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ muruwhu fayusalliy, iinnakunna sawaahibu yuwsufa ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu alzzubaydiyyu waabnu aakhiy alzzuhriyyi waiishaaqu bnu yahyaa alkalbiyyu 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏ waqaala 'uqaylun wama'marun 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an hamzaaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hamza bin `Abdullah:My father said, "When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became seriously ill, he was told about the prayer. He said, 'Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer.' `Aisha said, 'Abu Bakr is a softhearted man and he would be overpowered by his weeping if he recited the Qur'an.' He said to them, 'Tell him (Abu Bakr) to lead the prayer. The same reply was given to him. He said again, 'Tell him to lead the prayer. You (women) are the companions of Joseph
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ فِي مَرَضِهِ، فَكَانَ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ‏.‏ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ فَوَجَدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي نَفْسِهِ خِفَّةً، فَخَرَجَ فَإِذَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَؤُمُّ النَّاسَ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ اسْتَأْخَرَ، فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ كَمَا أَنْتَ، فَجَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِذَاءَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِصَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ يُصَلُّونَ بِصَلاَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu yahyaa, qaala haddathanaa abnu numayrin, qaala aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat aamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aabaa bakrin aan yusalliya bialnnaasi fiy maradihi, fakaana yusalliy bihim‏.‏ qaala 'urwaau fawajada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy nafsihi khiffaaan, fakharaja faiidhaa aabuw bakrin yauummu alnnaasa, falammaa raahu aabuw bakrin astaakhara, faaashaara iilayhi aan kamaa aanta, fajalasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hidhaa'a aabiy bakrin iilaa janbihi, fakaana aabuw bakrin yusalliy bisalaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasu yusalluwna bisalaaai aabiy bakrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham ibn `Urwa's father:`Aisha said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer during his illness and so he led them in prayer." `Urwa, a sub narrator, added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt a bit relieved and came out and Abu Bakr was leading the people. When Abu Bakr saw the Prophet (ﷺ) he retreated but the Prophet beckoned him to remain there. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sat beside Abu Bakr. Abu Bakr was following the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and the people were following the prayer of Abu Bakr
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَهَبَ إِلَى بَنِي عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ لِيُصْلِحَ بَيْنَهُمْ فَحَانَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَجَاءَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ أَتُصَلِّي لِلنَّاسِ فَأُقِيمَ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَصَلَّى أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ، فَتَخَلَّصَ حَتَّى وَقَفَ فِي الصَّفِّ، فَصَفَّقَ النَّاسُ ـ وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لاَ يَلْتَفِتُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ ـ فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرَ النَّاسُ التَّصْفِيقَ الْتَفَتَ فَرَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِ امْكُثْ مَكَانَكَ، فَرَفَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَدَيْهِ، فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ عَلَى مَا أَمَرَهُ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ اسْتَأْخَرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَتَّى اسْتَوَى فِي الصَّفِّ، وَتَقَدَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَثْبُتَ إِذْ أَمَرْتُكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَا كَانَ لاِبْنِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا لِي رَأَيْتُكُمْ أَكْثَرْتُمُ التَّصْفِيقَ مَنْ رَابَهُ شَىْءٌ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَلْيُسَبِّحْ، فَإِنَّهُ إِذَا سَبَّحَ الْتُفِتَ إِلَيْهِ، وَإِنَّمَا التَّصْفِيقُ لِلنِّسَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy haazimi bni diynaarin, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhahaba iilaa baniy 'amriw bni 'awfin liyusliha baynahum fahaanati alssalaaau fajaa'a almuuadhhinu iilaa aabiy bakrin faqaala aatusalliy lilnnaasi faauqiyma qaala na'am‏.‏ fasallaa aabuw bakrin, fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasu fiy alssalaaai, fatakhallasa hattaa waqafa fiy alssaffi, fasaffaqa alnnaasu wakaana aabuw bakrin laa yaltafitu fiy salaatihi falammaa aakthara alnnaasu alttasfiyqa altafata faraaaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, faaashaara iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aani amkuth makaanaka, farafa'a aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh yadayhi, fahamida alllaha 'alaa maa aamarahu bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min dhalika, thumma astaakhara aabuw bakrin hattaa astawaa fiy alssaffi, wataqaddama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallaa, falammaa ansarafa qaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa bakrin maa mana'aka aan tathbuta iidh aamartuka ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin maa kaana laibni aabiy quhaafaaa aan yusalliya bayna yadaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa liy raaaytukum aakthartumu alttasfiyqa man raabahu shaa'un fiy salaatihi falyusabbih, faiinnahu iidhaa sabbaha altufita iilayhi, waiinnamaa alttasfiyqu lilnnisaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d As-Sa`idi:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to establish peace among Bani `Amr bin `Auf. In the meantime the time of prayer was due and the Mu'adh-dhin went to Abu Bakr and said, "Will you lead the prayer, so that I may pronounce the Iqama?" Abu Bakr replied in the affirmative and led the prayer. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came while the people were still praying and he entered the rows of the praying people till he stood in the (first row). The people clapped their hands. Abu Bakr never glanced sideways in his prayer but when the people continued clapping, Abu Bakr looked and saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) beckoned him to stay at his place. Abu Bakr raised his hands and thanked Allah for that order of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then he retreated till he reached the first row. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went forward and led the prayer. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished the prayer, he said, "O Abu Bakr! What prevented you from staying when I ordered you to do so?" Abu Bakr replied, "How can Ibn Abi Quhafa (Abu Bakr) dare to lead the prayer in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Why did you clap so much? If something happens to anyone during his prayer he should say Subhan Allah. If he says so he will be attended to, for clapping is for women
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ، قَالَ قَدِمْنَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ شَبَبَةٌ، فَلَبِثْنَا عِنْدَهُ نَحْوًا مِنْ عِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً، وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَحِيمًا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ رَجَعْتُمْ إِلَى بِلاَدِكُمْ فَعَلَّمْتُمُوهُمْ، مُرُوهُمْ فَلْيُصَلُّوا صَلاَةَ كَذَا فِي حِينِ كَذَا، وَصَلاَةَ كَذَا فِي حِينِ كَذَا، وَإِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَلْيُؤَذِّنْ لَكُمْ أَحَدُكُمْ، وَلْيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَكْبَرُكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an maaliki bni alhuwayrithi, qaala qadimnaa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu shababaaun, falabithnaa 'indahu nahwana min 'ishriyna laylaaan, wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm rahiymana faqaala ‏ "‏ law raja'tum iilaa bilaadikum fa'allamtumuwhum, muruwhum falyusalluwa salaaaa kadhaa fiy hiyni kadhaa, wasalaaaa kadhaa fiy hiyni kadhaa, waiidhaa hadarati alssalaaau falyuuadhhin lakum aahadukum, walyauummakum aakbarukum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Malik bin Huwairith:We went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and we were all young men and stayed with him for about twenty nights. The Prophet (ﷺ) was very merciful. He said, "When you return home, impart religious teachings to your families and tell them to offer perfectly such and such a prayer at such and such a time and such and such a prayer at such and such a time. And at the time of the prayer one of you should pronounce the Adhan and the oldest of you should lead the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَحْمُودُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عِتْبَانَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَذِنْتُ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيْنَ تُحِبُّ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ مِنْ بَيْتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَشَرْتُ لَهُ إِلَى الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي أُحِبُّ، فَقَامَ وَصَفَفْنَا خَلْفَهُ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ وَسَلَّمْنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu aasadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy mahmuwdu bnu alrrabiy'i, qaala sami'tu 'itbaana bna maalikin alaansaariyya, qaala astaadhana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaadhintu lahu faqaala ‏ "‏ aayna tuhibbu aan ausalliya min baytika ‏"‏‏.‏ faaashartu lahu iilaa almakaani alladhiy auhibbu, faqaama wasafafnaa khalfahu thumma sallama wasallamnaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Itban bin Malik Al-Ansari:The Prophet (came to my house and) asked permission for entering and I allowed him. He asked, "Where do you like me to pray in your house?" I pointed to a place which I liked. He stood up for prayer and we aligned behind him and he finished the prayer with Taslim and we did the same
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَقُلْتُ أَلاَ تُحَدِّثِينِي عَنْ مَرَضِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ بَلَى، ثَقُلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا لاَ، هُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ضَعُوا لِي مَاءً فِي الْمِخْضَبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَفَعَلْنَا فَاغْتَسَلَ فَذَهَبَ لِيَنُوءَ فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ فَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا لاَ، هُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ضَعُوا لِي مَاءً فِي الْمِخْضَبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقَعَدَ فَاغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ لِيَنُوءَ فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا لاَ، هُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ضَعُوا لِي مَاءً فِي الْمِخْضَبِ ‏"‏، فَقَعَدَ فَاغْتَسَلَ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ لِيَنُوءَ فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا لاَ، هُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ـ وَالنَّاسُ عُكُوفٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَنْتَظِرُونَ النَّبِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ لِصَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ الآخِرَةِ ـ فَأَرْسَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ بِأَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ، فَأَتَاهُ الرَّسُولُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ وَكَانَ رَجُلاً رَقِيقًا ـ يَا عُمَرُ صَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ أَنْتَ أَحَقُّ بِذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَصَلَّى أَبُو بَكْرٍ تِلْكَ الأَيَّامَ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَدَ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ خِفَّةً فَخَرَجَ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا الْعَبَّاسُ لِصَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ذَهَبَ لِيَتَأَخَّرَ فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِأَنْ لاَ يَتَأَخَّرَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَجْلِسَانِي إِلَى جَنْبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَجْلَسَاهُ إِلَى جَنْبِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي وَهْوَ يَأْتَمُّ بِصَلاَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ بِصَلاَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَاعِدٌ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَلاَ أَعْرِضُ عَلَيْكَ مَا حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ عَنْ مَرَضِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ هَاتِ‏.‏ فَعَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ حَدِيثَهَا، فَمَا أَنْكَرَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَسَمَّتْ لَكَ الرَّجُلَ الَّذِي كَانَ مَعَ الْعَبَّاسِ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ هُوَ عَلِيٌّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, qaala haddathanaa zaaiidaau, 'an muwsaa bni aabiy 'aaiishaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, qaala dakhaltu 'alaa 'aaiishaaa faqultu aalaa tuhaddithiyniy 'an maradi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat balaa, thaqula alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aasallaa alnnaasu ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa laa, hum yantaziruwnaka‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ da'uwa liy maa'an fiy almikhdabi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat fafa'alnaa faaghtasala fadhahaba liyanuw'a faaughmiya 'alayhi, thumma aafaaqa faqaala sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aasallaa alnnaasu ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa laa, hum yantaziruwnaka yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ da'uwa liy maa'an fiy almikhdabi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat faqa'ada faaghtasala, thumma dhahaba liyanuw'a faaughmiya 'alayhi, thumma aafaaqa faqaala ‏"‏ aasallaa alnnaasu ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa laa, hum yantaziruwnaka yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ da'uwa liy maa'an fiy almikhdabi ‏"‏, faqa'ada faaghtasala, thumma dhahaba liyanuw'a faaughmiya 'alayhi, thumma aafaaqa faqaala ‏"‏ aasallaa alnnaasu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqulnaa laa, hum yantaziruwnaka yaa rasuwla alllahi waalnnaasu 'ukuwfun fiy almasjidi yantaziruwna alnnabiyya 'alayhi alssalaamu lisalaaai al'ishaa'i alakhiraai faaarsala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa aabiy bakrin biaan yusalliya bialnnaasi, faaataahu alrrasuwlu faqaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaamuruka aan tusalliya bialnnaasi‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin wakaana rajulaan raqiyqana yaa 'umaru salli bialnnaasi‏.‏ faqaala lahu 'umaru aanta aahaqqu bidhalika‏.‏ fasallaa aabuw bakrin tilka alaayyaama, thumma iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wajada min nafsihi khiffaaan fakharaja bayna rajulayni aahaduhumaa al'abbaasu lisalaaai alzzuhri, waaabuw bakrin yusalliy bialnnaasi, falammaa raahu aabuw bakrin dhahaba liyataaakhhara faaawmaaa iilayhi alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biaan laa yataaakhhara‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aajlisaaniy iilaa janbihi ‏"‏‏.‏ faaajlasaahu iilaa janbi aabiy bakrin‏.‏ qaala faja'ala aabuw bakrin yusalliy wahwa yaatammu bisalaaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasu bisalaaai aabiy bakrin, waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaa'idun‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi fadakhaltu 'alaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin faqultu lahu aalaa aa'ridu 'alayka maa haddathatniy 'aaiishaau 'an maradi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala haati‏.‏ fa'aradtu 'alayhi hadiythahaa, famaa aankara minhu shayiana, ghayra aannahu qaala aasammat laka alrrajula alladhiy kaana ma'a al'abbaasi qultu laa‏.‏ qaala huwa 'aliyyun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubaidullah Ibn `Abdullah bin `Utba:I went to `Aisha and asked her to describe to me the illness of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). `Aisha said, "Yes. The Prophet became seriously ill and asked whether the people had prayed. We replied, 'No. O Allah's Apostle! They are waiting for you.' He added, 'Put water for me in a trough." `Aisha added, "We did so. He took a bath and tried to get up but fainted. When he recovered, he again asked whether the people had prayed. We said, 'No, they are waiting for you. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ),' He again said, 'Put water in a trough for me.' He sat down and took a bath and tried to get up but fainted again. Then he recovered and said, 'Have the people prayed?' We replied, 'No, they are waiting for you. O Allah's Apostle.' He said, 'Put water for me in the trough.'
