Then he sat down and washed himself and tried to get up but he fainted. When he recovered, he asked, 'Have the people prayed?' We said, 'No, they are waiting for you. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The people were in the mosque waiting for the Prophet (ﷺ) for the `Isha prayer. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent for Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer. The messenger went to Abu Bakr and said, 'Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) orders you to lead the people in the prayer.' Abu Bakr was a softhearted man, so he asked `Umar to lead the prayer but `Umar replied, 'You are more rightful.' So Abu Bakr led the prayer in those days. When the Prophet (ﷺ) felt a bit better, he came out for the Zuhr prayer with the help of two persons one of whom was Al-`Abbas. while Abu Bakr was leading the people in the prayer. When Abu Bakr saw him he wanted to retreat but the Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned him not to do so and asked them to make him sit beside Abu Bakr and they did so. Abu Bakr was following the Prophet (in the prayer) and the people were following Abu Bakr. The Prophet (prayed) sitting." 'Ubaidullah added "I went to `Abdullah bin `Abbas and asked him, Shall I tell you what Aisha has told me about the fatal illness of the Prophet?' Ibn `Abbas said, 'Go ahead. I told him her narration and he did not deny anything of it but asked whether `Aisha told me the name of the second person (who helped the Prophet (ﷺ) ) along with Al-Abbas. I said. 'No.' He said, 'He was `Ali (Ibn Abi Talib)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِهِ وَهْوَ شَاكٍ، فَصَلَّى جَالِسًا وَصَلَّى وَرَاءَهُ قَوْمٌ قِيَامًا، فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَنِ اجْلِسُوا، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ، فَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ فَارْفَعُوا، وَإِذَا صَلَّى جَالِسًا فَصَلُّوا جُلُوسًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa aummi almuuminiyna, aannahaa qaalat sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy baytihi wahwa shaakin, fasallaa jaalisana wasallaa waraa'ahu qawmun qiyaamana, faaashaara iilayhim aani ajlisuwa, falammaa ansarafa qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa ju'ila aliimaamu liyuutamma bihi, faiidhaa raka'a faarka'uwa, waiidhaa rafa'a faarfa'uwa, waiidhaa sallaa jaalisana fasalluwa juluwsana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:the mother of the believers: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during his illness prayed at his house while sitting whereas some people prayed behind him standing. The Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned them to sit down. On completion of the prayer, he said, 'The Imam is to be followed: bow when he bows, raise up your heads (stand erect) when he raises his head and when he says, 'Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah' (Allah heard those who sent praises to Him) say then 'Rabbana wa laka l-hamd' (O our Lord! All the praises are for You), and if he prays sitting then pray sitting
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكِبَ فَرَسًا فَصُرِعَ عَنْهُ، فَجُحِشَ شِقُّهُ الأَيْمَنُ، فَصَلَّى صَلاَةً مِنَ الصَّلَوَاتِ وَهْوَ قَاعِدٌ، فَصَلَّيْنَا وَرَاءَهُ قُعُودًا، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ، فَإِذَا صَلَّى قَائِمًا فَصَلُّوا قِيَامًا، فَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ فَارْفَعُوا، وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ‏.‏ وَإِذَا صَلَّى قَائِمًا فَصَلُّوا قِيَامًا، وَإِذَا صَلَّى جَالِسًا فَصَلُّوا جُلُوسًا أَجْمَعُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ قَوْلُهُ ‏"‏ إِذَا صَلَّى جَالِسًا فَصَلُّوا جُلُوسًا ‏"‏‏.‏ هُوَ فِي مَرَضِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسًا وَالنَّاسُ خَلْفَهُ قِيَامًا، لَمْ يَأْمُرْهُمْ بِالْقُعُودِ، وَإِنَّمَا يُؤْخَذُ بِالآخِرِ فَالآخِرِ مِنْ فِعْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakiba farasana fasuri'a 'anhu, fajuhisha shiqquhu alaaymanu, fasallaa salaaaan mina alssalawaati wahwa qaa'idun, fasallaynaa waraa'ahu qu'uwdana, falammaa ansarafa qaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa ju'ila aliimaamu liyuutamma bihi, faiidhaa sallaa qaaiimana fasalluwa qiyaamana, faiidhaa raka'a faarka'uwa, waiidhaa rafa'a faarfa'uwa, waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu‏.‏ faquwluwa rabbanaa walaka alhamdu‏.‏ waiidhaa sallaa qaaiimana fasalluwa qiyaamana, waiidhaa sallaa jaalisana fasalluwa juluwsana aajma'uwna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi qaala alhumaydiyyu qawluhu ‏"‏ iidhaa sallaa jaalisana fasalluwa juluwsana ‏"‏‏.‏ huwa fiy maradihi alqadiymi, thumma sallaa ba'da dhalika alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm jaalisana waalnnaasu khalfahu qiyaamana, lam yaamurhum bialqu'uwdi, waiinnamaa yuukhadhu bialakhiri faalakhiri min fi'li alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a horse and fell down and the right side (of his body) was injured. He offered one of the prayers while sitting and we also prayed behind him sitting. When he completed the prayer, he said, "The Imam is to be followed. Pray standing if he prays standing and bow when he bows; rise when he rises; and if he says, 'Sami`a l-lahu-liman hamidah, say then, 'Rabbana wa laka lhamd' and pray standing if he prays standing and pray sitting (all of you) if he prays sitting." Humaid said: The saying of the Prophet (ﷺ) "Pray sitting, if he (Imam) prays sitting" was said in his former illness (during his early life) but the Prophet (ﷺ) prayed sitting afterwards (in the last illness) and the people were praying standing behind him and the Prophet (ﷺ) did not order them to sit. We should follow the latest actions of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْبَرَاءُ ـ وَهْوَ غَيْرُ كَذُوبٍ ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ لَمْ يَحْنِ أَحَدٌ مِنَّا ظَهْرَهُ حَتَّى يَقَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَاجِدًا، ثُمَّ نَقَعُ سُجُودًا بَعْدَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathaniy aabuw iishaaqa, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda, qaala haddathaniy albaraa'u wahwa ghayru kadhuwbin qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu‏.‏ lam yahni aahadun minnaa zahrahu hattaa yaqa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm saajidana, thumma naqa'u sujuwdana ba'dahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:(and he was not a liar) When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah" none of us bent his back (for prostration) till the Prophet (ﷺ) prostrated and then we would prostrate after him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، نَحْوَهُ بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, nahwahu bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq:As above
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَا يَخْشَى أَحَدُكُمْ ـ أَوْ لاَ يَخْشَى أَحَدُكُمْ ـ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ قَبْلَ الإِمَامِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ رَأْسَهُ رَأْسَ حِمَارٍ أَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ صُورَتَهُ صُورَةَ حِمَارٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aamaa yakhshaa aahadukum aaw laa yakhshaa aahadukum iidhaa rafa'a raasahu qabla aliimaami aan yaj'ala alllahu raasahu raasa himaarin aaw yaj'ala alllahu suwratahu suwraaa himaarin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Isn't he who raises his head before the Imam afraid that Allah may transform his head into that of a donkey or his figure (face) into that of a donkey?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ الأَوَّلُونَ الْعُصْبَةَ ـ مَوْضِعٌ بِقُبَاءٍ ـ قَبْلَ مَقْدَمِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَؤُمُّهُمْ سَالِمٌ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ، وَكَانَ أَكْثَرَهُمْ قُرْآنًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, qaala haddathanaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala lammaa qadima almuhaajiruwna alaawwaluwna al'usbaaa mawdi'un biqubaa'in qabla maqdami rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yauummuhum saalimun mawlaa aabiy hudhayfaaa, wakaana aaktharahum quranana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When the earliest emigrants came to Al-`Usba [??] a place in Quba', before the arrival of the Prophet- Salim, the slave of Abu Hudhaifa, who knew the Qur'an more than the others used to lead them in prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا، وَإِنِ اسْتُعْمِلَ حَبَشِيٌّ كَأَنَّ رَأْسَهُ زَبِيبَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathaniy aabuw alttayyaahi, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ asma'uwa waaatiy'uwa, waiini astu'mila habashiyyun kaaanna raasahu zabiybaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Listen and obey (your chief) even if an Ethiopian whose head is like a raisin were made your chief
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى الأَشْيَبُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يُصَلُّونَ لَكُمْ، فَإِنْ أَصَابُوا فَلَكُمْ، وَإِنْ أَخْطَئُوا فَلَكُمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alfadlu bnu sahlin, qaala haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muwsaa alaashyabu, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yusalluwna lakum, faiin aasaabuwa falakum, waiin aakhtaiuwa falakum wa'alayhim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If the Imam leads the prayer correctly then he and you will receive the rewards but if he makes a mistake (in the prayer) then you will receive the reward for the prayer and the sin will be his
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَقَالَ لَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَدِيِّ بْنِ خِيَارٍ، أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَهْوَ مَحْصُورٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّكَ إِمَامُ عَامَّةٍ، وَنَزَلَ بِكَ مَا تَرَى وَيُصَلِّي لَنَا إِمَامُ فِتْنَةٍ وَنَتَحَرَّجُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الصَّلاَةُ أَحْسَنُ مَا يَعْمَلُ النَّاسُ، فَإِذَا أَحْسَنَ النَّاسُ فَأَحْسِنْ مَعَهُمْ، وَإِذَا أَسَاءُوا فَاجْتَنِبْ إِسَاءَتَهُمْ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الزُّبَيْدِيُّ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ لاَ نَرَى أَنْ يُصَلَّى خَلْفَ الْمُخَنَّثِ إِلاَّ مِنْ ضَرُورَةٍ لاَ بُدَّ مِنْهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi waqaala lanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'adiyyi bni khiyaarin, aannahu dakhala 'alaa 'uthmaana bni 'affaana rda allh 'nh wahwa mahsuwrun faqaala iinnaka iimaamu 'aammaain, wanazala bika maa taraa wayusalliy lanaa iimaamu fitnaain wanataharraju‏.‏ faqaala alssalaaau aahsanu maa ya'malu alnnaasu, faiidhaa aahsana alnnaasu faaahsin ma'ahum, waiidhaa aasaa'uwa faajtanib iisaa'atahum‏.‏ waqaala alzzubaydiyyu qaala alzzuhriyyu laa naraa aan yusallaa khalfa almukhannathi iilaaa min daruwraain laa budda minhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubaid-Ullah bin Adi bin Khiyar:I went to 'Uthman bin Affan while he was besieged, and said to him, "You are the chief of all Muslims in general and you see what has befallen you. We are led in the Salat (prayer) by a leader of Al-Fitan (trials and afflictions etc.) and we are afraid of being sinful in following him." 'Uthman said. "As-Salat (the prayers) is the best of all deeds so when the people do good deeds do the same with them and when they do bad deeds, avoid those bad deeds." Az-Zuhri said, "In our opinion one should not offer Salat behind an effeminate person unless there is no alternative
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَبِي ذَرٍّ ‏ "‏ اسْمَعْ وَأَطِعْ، وَلَوْ لِحَبَشِيٍّ كَأَنَّ رَأْسَهُ زَبِيبَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabaana, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm laabiy dharrin ‏ "‏ asma' waaati', walaw lihabashiyyin kaaanna raasahu zabiybaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Abu-Dhar, "Listen and obey (your chief) even if he is an Ethiopian with a head like a raisin
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ فِي بَيْتِ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعِشَاءَ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَصَلَّى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ ثُمَّ نَامَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَجِئْتُ فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، فَجَعَلَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فَصَلَّى خَمْسَ رَكَعَاتٍ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ نَامَ حَتَّى سَمِعْتُ غَطِيطَهُ ـ أَوْ قَالَ خَطِيطَهُ ـ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala hadaathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abaaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala bituu fiy bayti khaalatiy maymuwnaaa fasalaaa rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm al'ishaa'a, thumaa jaa'a fasalaaa aarba'a raka'aatin thumaa naama, thumaa qaama fajiitu faqumtu 'an yasaarihi, faja'alaniy 'an yamiynihi, fasalaaa khamsa raka'aatin, thumaa salaaa rak'atayni, thumaa naama hataaa sami'tu ghatiytahu aaw qaala khatiytahu thumaa kharaja iilaa alsaalaaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I passed the night in the house of my aunt Maimuna. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the `Isha' prayer and then came to the house and offered four rak`at and slept. Later on, he woke up and stood for the prayer and I stood on his left side. He drew me to his right and prayed five rak`at and then two. He then slept till I heard him snoring (or heard his breath sounds). Afterwards he went out for the morning prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنْ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ نِمْتُ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَهَا تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ، فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي، فَقُمْتُ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ، فَأَخَذَنِي فَجَعَلَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فَصَلَّى ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، ثُمَّ نَامَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ ـ وَكَانَ إِذَا نَامَ نَفَخَ ـ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، فَخَرَجَ فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ بُكَيْرًا فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي كُرَيْبٌ بِذَلِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu, qaala haddathanaa abnu wahbin, qaala haddathanaa 'amrunw, 'an 'abdi rabbihi bni sa'iydin, 'an makhramaaa bni sulaymaana, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala nimtu 'inda maymuwnaaa waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'indahaa tilka alllaylaaa, fatawaddaaa thumma qaama yusalliy, faqumtu 'alaa yasaarihi, faaakhadhaniy faja'alaniy 'an yamiynihi, fasallaa thalaatha 'ashraaa rak'aaan, thumma naama hattaa nafakha wakaana iidhaa naama nafakha thumma aataahu almuuadhhinu, fakharaja fasallaa walam yatawaddaa‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw fahaddathtu bihi bukayrana faqaala haddathaniy kuraybun bidhalika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:One night I slept at the house of (my aunt) Maimuna and the Prophet (ﷺ) was there on that night. He performed ablution and stood up for the prayer. I joined him and stood on his left side but he drew me to his right and prayed thirteen rak`at and then slept till I heard his breath sounds. And whenever he slept, he used to breathe with audible sounds. The Mu'adh-dhin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he went out and prayed the morning prayer) without repeating the ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ، فَقُمْتُ أُصَلِّي مَعَهُ فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، فَأَخَذَ بِرَأْسِي فَأَقَامَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala bittu 'inda khaalatiy faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy mina alllayli, faqumtu ausalliy ma'ahu faqumtu 'an yasaarihi, faaakhadha biraasiy faaaqaamaniy 'an yamiynihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I passed the night in the house of my aunt Maimuna. The Prophet (ﷺ) stood for the night prayer and I joined him and stood on his left side but he drew me to his right by holding me by the head
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ، كَانَ يُصَلِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ فَيَؤُمُّ قَوْمَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amrinw, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna mu'aadha bna jabalin, kaana yusalliy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma yarji'u fayauummu qawmahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mu`adh bin Jabal:I used to pray the `Isha prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then go to lead my people in the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ يُصَلِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ فَيَؤُمُّ قَوْمَهُ، فَصَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ فَقَرَأَ بِالْبَقَرَةِ، فَانْصَرَفَ الرَّجُلُ، فَكَأَنَّ مُعَاذًا تَنَاوَلَ مِنْهُ، فَبَلَغَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ فَتَّانٌ فَتَّانٌ فَتَّانٌ ‏"‏ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاتِنًا فَاتِنًا فَاتِنٌ ‏"‏ وَأَمَرَهُ بِسُورَتَيْنِ مِنْ أَوْسَطِ الْمُفَصَّلِ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو لاَ أَحْفَظُهُمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala haddathanaa ghundarun, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amrinw, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, qaala kaana mu'aadhu bnu jabalin yusalliy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma yarji'u fayauummu qawmahu, fasallaa al'ishaa'a faqaraaa bialbaqaraai, faansarafa alrrajulu, fakaaanna mu'aadhana tanaawala minhu, fabalagha alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ fattaanun fattaanun fattaanun ‏"‏ thalaatha miraarin aaw qaala ‏"‏ faatinana faatinana faatinun ‏"‏ waaamarahu bisuwratayni min aawsati almufassali‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw laa aahfazuhumaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr:Jabir bin `Abdullah said, "Mu`adh bin Jabal used to pray with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then go to lead his people in prayer Once he led the `Isha' prayer and recited Surat "Al-Baqara." Somebody left the prayer and Mu`adh criticized him. The news reached the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said to Mu`adh, 'You are putting the people to trial,' and repeated it thrice (or said something similar) and ordered him to recite two medium Suras of Mufassal." (`Amr said that he had forgotten the names of those Suras)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَيْسًا، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَتَأَخَّرُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ الْغَدَاةِ مِنْ أَجْلِ فُلاَنٍ مِمَّا يُطِيلُ بِنَا‏.‏ فَمَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَوْعِظَةٍ أَشَدَّ غَضَبًا مِنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مِنْكُمْ مُنَفِّرِينَ، فَأَيُّكُمْ مَا صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ فَلْيَتَجَوَّزْ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِمُ الضَّعِيفَ وَالْكَبِيرَ وَذَا الْحَاجَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, qaala haddathanaa zuhayrun, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala sami'tu qaysana, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw mas'uwdin, aanna rajulaan, qaala waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy laataaakhharu 'an salaaai alghadaaai min aajli fulaanin mimmaa yutiylu binaa‏.‏ famaa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy maw'izaain aashadda ghadabana minhu yawmaiidhin thumma qaala ‏ "‏ iinna minkum munaffiriyna, faaayyukum maa sallaa bialnnaasi falyatajawwaz, faiinna fiyhimu aldda'iyfa waalkabiyra wadhaa alhaajaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:A man came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, I keep away from the morning prayer only because So and so prolongs the prayer when he leads us in it." The narrator said, "I never saw Allah's Apostle more furious in giving advice than he was at that time. He then said, "Some of you make people dislike good deeds (the prayer). So whoever among you leads the people in prayer should shorten it because among them are the weak, the old and the needy
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا صَلَّى أَحَدُكُمْ لِلنَّاسِ فَلْيُخَفِّفْ، فَإِنَّ مِنْهُمُ الضَّعِيفَ وَالسَّقِيمَ وَالْكَبِيرَ، وَإِذَا صَلَّى أَحَدُكُمْ لِنَفْسِهِ فَلْيُطَوِّلْ مَا شَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa sallaa aahadukum lilnnaasi falyukhaffif, faiinna minhumu aldda'iyfa waalssaqiyma waalkabiyra, waiidhaa sallaa aahadukum linafsihi falyutawwil maa shaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you leads the people in the prayer, he should shorten it for amongst them are the weak, the sick and the old; and if anyone among you prays alone then he may prolong (the prayer) as much as he wishes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَتَأَخَّرُ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فِي الْفَجْرِ مِمَّا يُطِيلُ بِنَا فُلاَنٌ فِيهَا‏.‏ فَغَضِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا رَأَيْتُهُ غَضِبَ فِي مَوْضِعٍ كَانَ أَشَدَّ غَضَبًا مِنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ مِنْكُمْ مُنَفِّرِينَ، فَمَنْ أَمَّ النَّاسَ فَلْيَتَجَوَّزْ، فَإِنَّ خَلْفَهُ الضَّعِيفَ وَالْكَبِيرَ وَذَا الْحَاجَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'an qaysi bni aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, qaala qaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy laataaakhharu 'ani alssalaaai fiy alfajri mimmaa yutiylu binaa fulaanun fiyhaa‏.‏ faghadiba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa raaaytuhu ghadiba fiy mawdi'in kaana aashadda ghadabana minhu yawmaiidhin thumma qaala ‏ "‏ yaa aayyuhaa alnnaasu iinna minkum munaffiriyna, faman aamma alnnaasa falyatajawwaz, faiinna khalfahu aldda'iyfa waalkabiyra wadhaa alhaajaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:A man came and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I keep away from the morning prayer because so-and-so (Imam) prolongs it too much." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became furious and I had never seen him more furious than he was on that day. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O people! Some of you make others dislike the prayer, so whoever becomes an Imam he should shorten the prayer, as behind him are the weak, the old and the needy
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَارِبُ بْنُ دِثَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، قَالَ أَقْبَلَ رَجُلٌ بِنَاضِحَيْنِ وَقَدْ جَنَحَ اللَّيْلُ، فَوَافَقَ مُعَاذًا يُصَلِّي، فَتَرَكَ نَاضِحَهُ وَأَقْبَلَ إِلَى مُعَاذٍ، فَقَرَأَ بِسُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ أَوِ النِّسَاءِ، فَانْطَلَقَ الرَّجُلُ، وَبَلَغَهُ أَنَّ مُعَاذًا نَالَ مِنْهُ، فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَشَكَا إِلَيْهِ مُعَاذًا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا مُعَاذُ أَفَتَّانٌ أَنْتَ ـ أَوْ فَاتِنٌ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ ـ فَلَوْلاَ صَلَّيْتَ بِسَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ، وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا، وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى، فَإِنَّهُ يُصَلِّي وَرَاءَكَ الْكَبِيرُ وَالضَّعِيفُ وَذُو الْحَاجَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ أَحْسِبُ هَذَا فِي الْحَدِيثِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَتَابَعَهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَسْرُوقٍ وَمِسْعَرٌ وَالشَّيْبَانِيُّ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مِقْسَمٍ وَأَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَرَأَ مُعَاذٌ فِي الْعِشَاءِ بِالْبَقَرَةِ‏.‏ وَتَابَعَهُ الأَعْمَشُ عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu bnu aabiy iiyaasin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathanaa muhaaribu bnu dithaarin, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyya, qaala aaqbala rajulun binaadihayni waqad janaha alllaylu, fawaafaqa mu'aadhana yusalliy, fataraka naadihahu waaaqbala iilaa mu'aadhin, faqaraaa bisuwraai albaqaraai aawi alnnisaa'i, faantalaqa alrrajulu, wabalaghahu aanna mu'aadhana naala minhu, faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fashakaa iilayhi mu'aadhana, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa mu'aadhu aafattaanun aanta aaw faatinun thalaatha miraarin falawlaa sallayta bisabbihi asma rabbika, waalshhamsi waduhaahaa, waalllayli iidhaa yaghshaa, faiinnahu yusalliy waraa'aka alkabiyru waaldda'iyfu wadhuw alhaajaai ‏"‏‏.‏ aahsibu hadhaa fiy alhadiythi‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi wataaba'ahu sa'iydu bnu masruwqin wamis'arun waalshhaybaaniyyu‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu miqsamin waaabuw alzzubayri 'an jaabirin qaraaa mu'aadhun fiy al'ishaa'i bialbaqaraai‏.‏ wataaba'ahu alaa'mashu 'an muhaaribin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah Al-Ansari:Once a man was driving two Nadihas (camels used for agricultural purposes) and night had fallen. He found Mu`adh praying so he made his camel kneel and joined Mu`adh in the prayer. The latter recited Surat 'Al-Baqara" or Surat "An-Nisa", (so) the man left the prayer and went away. When he came to know that Mu`adh had criticized him, he went to the Prophet, and complained against Mu`adh. The Prophet said thrice, "O Mu`adh ! Are you putting the people to trial?" It would have been better if you had recited "Sabbih Isma Rabbika-l-A`la (87)", Wash-shamsi wa duhaha (91)", or "Wal-laili idha yaghsha (92)", for the old, the weak and the needy pray behind you." Jabir said that Mu`adh recited Sura Al-Baqara in the `Isha' prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُوجِزُ الصَّلاَةَ وَيُكْمِلُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yuwjizu alssalaaaa wayukmiluhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray a short prayer (in congregation) but used to offer it in a perfect manner
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لأَقُومُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُطَوِّلَ فِيهَا، فَأَسْمَعُ بُكَاءَ الصَّبِيِّ، فَأَتَجَوَّزُ فِي صَلاَتِي كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمِّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ بِشْرُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ وَابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ وَبَقِيَّةُ عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, qaala aakhbaranaa alwaliydu, qaala haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi aabiy qataadaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy laaquwmu fiy alssalaaai auriydu aan autawwila fiyhaa, faaasma'u bukaa'a alssabiyyi, faaatajawwazu fiy salaatiy karaahiyaaa aan aashuqqa 'alaa aummihi ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu bishru bnu bakrin waabnu almubaaraki wabaqiyyaau 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin 'Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'When I stand for prayer, I intend to prolong it but on hearing the cries of a child, I cut it short, as I dislike to trouble the child's mother
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ مَا صَلَّيْتُ وَرَاءَ إِمَامٍ قَطُّ أَخَفَّ صَلاَةً وَلاَ أَتَمَّ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَإِنْ كَانَ لَيَسْمَعُ بُكَاءَ الصَّبِيِّ فَيُخَفِّفُ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ تُفْتَنَ أُمُّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, qaala haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, qaala haddathanaa shariyku bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu maa sallaytu waraa'a iimaamin qattu aakhaffa salaaaan walaa aatamma mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, waiin kaana layasma'u bukaa'a alssabiyyi fayukhaffifu makhaafaaa aan tuftana aummuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I never prayed behind any Imam a prayer lighter and more perfect than that behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and he used to cut short the prayer whenever he heard the cries of a child lest he should put the child's mother to trial
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، أَنَّ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لأَدْخُلُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ إِطَالَتَهَا، فَأَسْمَعُ بُكَاءَ الصَّبِيِّ، فَأَتَجَوَّزُ فِي صَلاَتِي مِمَّا أَعْلَمُ مِنْ شِدَّةِ وَجْدِ أُمِّهِ مِنْ بُكَائِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, qaala haddathanaa sa'iydun, qaala haddathanaa qataadaau, aanna aanasa bna maalikin, haddathahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy laadkhulu fiy alssalaaai waaanaa auriydu iitaalatahaa, faaasma'u bukaa'a alssabiyyi, faaatajawwazu fiy salaatiy mimmaa aa'lamu min shiddaai wajdi aummihi min bukaaiihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When I start the prayer I intend to prolong it, but on hearing the cries of a child, I cut short the prayer because I know that the cries of the child will incite its mother's passions
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لأَدْخُلُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَأُرِيدُ إِطَالَتَهَا، فَأَسْمَعُ بُكَاءَ الصَّبِيِّ، فَأَتَجَوَّزُ مِمَّا أَعْلَمُ مِنْ شِدَّةِ وَجْدِ أُمِّهِ مِنْ بُكَائِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy laadkhulu fiy alssalaaai faauriydu iitaalatahaa, faaasma'u bukaa'a alssabiyyi, faaatajawwazu mimmaa aa'lamu min shiddaai wajdi aummihi min bukaaiihi ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala muwsaa haddathanaa aabaanu, haddathanaa qataadaau, haddathanaa aanasun, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet, said, "Whenever I start the prayer I intend to prolong it, but on hearing the cries of a child, I cut short the prayer because I know that the cries of the child will incite its mother's passions
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ مُعَاذٌ يُصَلِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ يَأْتِي قَوْمَهُ فَيُصَلِّي بِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, waaabuw alnnu'maani, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an jaabirin, qaala kaana mu'aadhun yusalliy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma yaatiy qawmahu fayusalliy bihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:Mu`adh used to pray with the Prophet (ﷺ) and then go and lead his people (tribe) in the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَمَّا مَرِضَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَضَهُ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ أَتَاهُ بِلاَلٌ يُؤْذِنُهُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَجُلٌ أَسِيفٌ، إِنْ يَقُمْ مَقَامَكَ يَبْكِي فَلاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى الْقِرَاءَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مِثْلَهُ فَقَالَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُنَّ صَوَاحِبُ يُوسُفَ، مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَصَلَّى وَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُهَادَى بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ، كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ يَخُطُّ بِرِجْلَيْهِ الأَرْضَ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ذَهَبَ يَتَأَخَّرُ، فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ صَلِّ، فَتَأَخَّرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَقَعَدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يُسْمِعُ النَّاسَ التَّكْبِيرَ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مُحَاضِرٌ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu daawuda, qaala haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat lammaa marida alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm maradahu alladhiy maata fiyhi aataahu bilaalun yuudhinuhu bialssalaaai faqaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu iinna aabaa bakrin rajulun aasiyfun, iin yaqum maqaamaka yabkiy falaa yaqdiru 'alaa alqiraa'aai‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu mithlahu faqaala fiy althhaalithaai aawi alrraabi'aai ‏"‏ iinnakunna sawaahibu yuwsufa, muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli ‏"‏‏.‏ fasallaa wakharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhaadaa bayna rajulayni, kaaanniy aanzuru iilayhi yakhuttu birijlayhi alaarda, falammaa raahu aabuw bakrin dhahaba yataaakhharu, faaashaara iilayhi aan salli, fataaakhhara aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh waqa'ada alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa janbihi, waaabuw bakrin yusmi'u alnnaasa alttakbiyra‏.‏ taaba'ahu muhaadirun 'ani alaa'mashi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet, became ill in his fatal illness, Someone came to inform him about the prayer, and the Prophet (ﷺ) told him to tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer. I said, "Abu Bakr is a softhearted man and if he stands for the prayer in your place, he would weep and would not be able to recite the Qur'an." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the prayer." I said the same as before. He (repeated the same order and) on the third or the fourth time he said, "You are the companions of Joseph. Tell Abu Bakr to lead the prayer." So Abu Bakr led the prayer and meanwhile the Prophet (ﷺ) felt better and came out with the help of two men; as if I see him just now dragging his feet on the ground. When Abu Bakr saw him, he tried to retreat but the Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned him to carry on. Abu Bakr retreated a bit and the Prophet (ﷺ) sat on his (left) side. Abu Bakr was repeating the Takbir (Allahu Akbar) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for the people to hear
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا ثَقُلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَ بِلاَلٌ يُؤْذِنُهُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَجُلٌ أَسِيفٌ، وَإِنَّهُ مَتَى مَا يَقُمْ مَقَامَكَ لاَ يُسْمِعُ النَّاسَ، فَلَوْ أَمَرْتَ عُمَرَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِحَفْصَةَ قُولِي لَهُ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَجُلٌ أَسِيفٌ، وَإِنَّهُ مَتَى يَقُمْ مَقَامَكَ لاَ يُسْمِعِ النَّاسَ، فَلَوْ أَمَرْتَ عُمَرَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُنَّ لأَنْتُنَّ صَوَاحِبُ يُوسُفَ، مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَجَدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي نَفْسِهِ خِفَّةً، فَقَامَ يُهَادَى بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ، وَرِجْلاَهُ يَخُطَّانِ فِي الأَرْضِ حَتَّى دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ، فَلَمَّا سَمِعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حِسَّهُ ذَهَبَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَتَأَخَّرُ، فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى جَلَسَ عَنْ يَسَارِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، فَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي قَائِمًا، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي قَاعِدًا، يَقْتَدِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ بِصَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسُ مُقْتَدُونَ بِصَلاَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رضى الله عنه‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat lammaa thaqula rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaa'a bilaalun yuudhinuhu bialssalaaai faqaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin aan yusalliya bialnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinna aabaa bakrin rajulun aasiyfun, waiinnahu mataa maa yaqum maqaamaka laa yusmi'u alnnaasa, falaw aamarta 'umara‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin yusalliy bialnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu lihafsaaa quwliy lahu iinna aabaa bakrin rajulun aasiyfun, waiinnahu mataa yaqum maqaamaka laa yusmi'i alnnaasa, falaw aamarta 'umara‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinnakunna laantunna sawaahibu yuwsufa, muruwa aabaa bakrin aan yusalliya bialnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa dakhala fiy alssalaaai wajada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy nafsihi khiffaaan, faqaama yuhaadaa bayna rajulayni, warijlaahu yakhuttaani fiy alaardi hattaa dakhala almasjida, falammaa sami'a aabuw bakrin hissahu dhahaba aabuw bakrin yataaakhharu, faaawmaaa iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa jalasa 'an yasaari aabiy bakrin, fakaana aabuw bakrin yusalliy qaaiimana, wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy qaa'idana, yaqtadiy aabuw bakrin bisalaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnnaasu muqtaduwna bisalaaai aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nh‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became seriously ill, Bilal came to him for the prayer. He said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Abu Bakr is a softhearted man and if he stands in your place, he would not be able to make the people hear him. Will you order `Umar (to lead the prayer)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." Then I said to Hafsa, "Tell him, Abu Bakr is a softhearted man and if he stands in his place, he would not be able to make the people hear him. Would you order `Umar to lead the prayer?' " Hafsa did so. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Verily you are the companions of Joseph. Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." So Abu Bakr stood for the prayer. In the meantime Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt better and came out with the help of two persons and both of his legs were dragging on the ground till he entered the mosque. When Abu Bakr heard him coming, he tried to retreat but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) beckoned him to carry on. The Prophet (ﷺ) sat on his left side. Abu Bakr was praying while standing and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was leading the prayer while sitting. Abu Bakr was following the Prophet (ﷺ) and the people were following Abu Bakr (in the prayer)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم انْصَرَفَ مِنَ اثْنَتَيْنِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ ذُو الْيَدَيْنِ أَقَصُرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ أَمْ نَسِيتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَصَدَقَ ذُو الْيَدَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّاسُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى اثْنَتَيْنِ أُخْرَيَيْنِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ، ثُمَّ كَبَّرَ فَسَجَدَ مِثْلَ سُجُودِهِ أَوْ أَطْوَلَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an aayyuwba bni aabiy tamiymaaa alssakhtiyaaniyyi, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ansarafa mina athnatayni, faqaala lahu dhuw alyadayni aaqasurati alssalaaau aam nasiyta yaa rasuwla alllahi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aasadaqa dhuw alyadayni ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala alnnaasu na'am‏.‏ faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallaa athnatayni aukhrayayni thumma sallama, thumma kabbara fasajada mithla sujuwdihi aaw aatwala‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed two rak`at (instead of four) and finished his prayer. Dhul-Yadain asked him whether the prayer had been reduced or whether he had forgotten. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked the people whether Dhul-Yadain was telling the truth. The people replied in the affirmative. Then Allah's Apostle stood up, offered the remaining two rak`at and then finished his prayer with Taslim and then said, "Allahu Akbar." He followed it with two prostrations like ordinary prostrations or a bit longer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الظُّهْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فَقِيلَ صَلَّيْتَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ‏.‏ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alzzuhra rak'atayni, faqiyla sallayta rak'atayni‏.‏ fasallaa rak'atayni, thumma sallama thumma sajada sajdatayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed two rak`at of Zuhr prayer (instead of four) and he was told that he had prayed two rak`at only. Then he prayed two more rak`at and finished them with the Taslim followed by two prostrations
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي مَرَضِهِ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ قُلْتُ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ إِذَا قَامَ فِي مَقَامِكَ لَمْ يُسْمِعِ النَّاسَ مِنَ الْبُكَاءِ، فَمُرْ عُمَرَ فَلْيُصَلِّ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ لِلنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ لِحَفْصَةَ قُولِي لَهُ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ إِذَا قَامَ فِي مَقَامِكَ لَمْ يُسْمِعِ النَّاسَ مِنَ الْبُكَاءِ، فَمُرْ عُمَرَ فَلْيُصَلِّ لِلنَّاسِ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَتْ حَفْصَةُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَهْ، إِنَّكُنَّ لأَنْتُنَّ صَوَاحِبُ يُوسُفَ، مُرُوا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَلْيُصَلِّ لِلنَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ لِعَائِشَةَ مَا كُنْتُ لأُصِيبَ مِنْكِ خَيْرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathanaa maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa aummi almuuminiyna, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fiy maradihi ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin yusalliy bialnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau qultu iinna aabaa bakrin iidhaa qaama fiy maqaamika lam yusmi'i alnnaasa mina albukaa'i, famur 'umara falyusalli‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli lilnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau lihafsaaa quwliy lahu iinna aabaa bakrin iidhaa qaama fiy maqaamika lam yusmi'i alnnaasa mina albukaa'i, famur 'umara falyusalli lilnnaasi‏.‏ fafa'alat hafsaau‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ mah, iinnakunna laantunna sawaahibu yuwsufa, muruwa aabaa bakrin falyusalli lilnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat hafsaau li'aaiishaaa maa kuntu lausiyba minki khayrana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:the mother of the faithful believers: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his last illness said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." I said, "If Abu Bakr stood in your place, he would not be able to make the people hear him owing to his weeping. So please order `Umar to lead the prayer." He said, "Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." I said to Hafsa, "Say to him, 'Abu Bakr is a softhearted man and if he stood in your place he would not be able to make the people hear him owing to his weeping. So order `Umar to lead the people in the prayer.' " Hafsa did so but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Keep quiet. Verily you are the companions of (Prophet) Joseph. Tell Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer." Hafsa said to me, "I never got any good from you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمَ بْنَ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَتُسَوُّنَّ صُفُوفَكُمْ أَوْ لَيُخَالِفَنَّ اللَّهُ بَيْنَ وُجُوهِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, hishaamu bnu 'abdi almaliki qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu murraaa, qaala sami'tu saalima bna aabiy alja'di, qaala sami'tu alnnu'maana bna bashiyrin, yaquwlu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ latusawwunna sufuwfakum aaw layukhaalifanna alllahu bayna wujuwhikum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated An-Nu`man bin 'Bashir:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Straighten your rows or Allah will alter your faces
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقِيمُوا الصُّفُوفَ فَإِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aaqiymuwa alssufuwfa faiinniy aaraakum khalfa zahriy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Straighten your rows, for I see you from behind my back
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ بْنُ قُدَامَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، قَالَ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِوَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقِيمُوا صُفُوفَكُمْ وَتَرَاصُّوا، فَإِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ ظَهْرِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu aabiy rajaa'in, qaala haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu 'amrinw, qaala haddathanaa zaaiidaau bnu qudaamaaa, qaala haddathanaa humaydun alttawiylu, haddathanaa aanasun, qaala auqiymati alssalaaau faaaqbala 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biwajhihi faqaala ‏ "‏ aaqiymuwa sufuwfakum wataraassuwa, faiinniy aaraakum min waraa'i zahriy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once the Iqama was pronounced and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) faced us and said, "Straighten your rows and stand closer together, for I see you from behind my back
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الشُّهَدَاءُ الْغَرِقُ وَالْمَطْعُونُ وَالْمَبْطُونُ وَالْهَدْمُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِي التَّهْجِيرِ لاَسْتَبَقُوا ‏{‏إِلَيْهِ‏}‏ وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِي الْعَتَمَةِ وَالصُّبْحِ لأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا، وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِي الصَّفِّ الْمُقَدَّمِ لاَسْتَهَمُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'an maalikin, 'an sumaaain, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alshhuhadaa'u alghariqu waalmat'uwnu waalmabtuwnu waalhadmu ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ walaw ya'lamuwna maa fiy alttahjiyri laastabaquwa ‏{‏iilayhi‏}‏ walaw ya'lamuwna maa fiy al'atamaai waalssubhi laatawhumaa walaw habwana, walaw ya'lamuwna maa fiy alssaffi almuqaddami laastahamuwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Martyrs are those who die because of drowning, plague, an Abdominal disease, or of being buried alive by a falling building." And then he added, "If the people knew the Reward for the Zuhr prayer in its early time, they would race for it. If they knew the reward for the `Isha' and the Fajr prayers in congregation, they would join them even if they had to crawl. If they knew the reward for the first row, they would draw lots for it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ فَلاَ تَخْتَلِفُوا عَلَيْهِ، فَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا، وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَجَدَ فَاسْجُدُوا، وَإِذَا صَلَّى جَالِسًا فَصَلُّوا جُلُوسًا أَجْمَعُونَ، وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّفَّ فِي الصَّلاَةِ، فَإِنَّ إِقَامَةَ الصَّفِّ مِنْ حُسْنِ الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaala aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaamin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa ju'ila aliimaamu liyuutamma bihi falaa takhtalifuwa 'alayhi, faiidhaa raka'a faarka'uwa, waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu‏.‏ faquwluwa rabbanaa laka alhamdu‏.‏ waiidhaa sajada faasjuduwa, waiidhaa sallaa jaalisana fasalluwa juluwsana aajma'uwna, waaaqiymuwa alssaffa fiy alssalaaai, faiinna iiqaamaaa alssaffi min husni alssalaaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Imam is (appointed) to be followed. So do not differ from him, bow when he bows, and say, "Rabbana-lakal hamd" if he says "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah"; and if he prostrates, prostrate (after him), and if he prays sitting, pray sitting all together, and straighten the rows for the prayer, as the straightening of the rows is amongst those things which make your prayer a correct and perfect one. (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَوُّوا صُفُوفَكُمْ فَإِنَّ تَسْوِيَةَ الصُّفُوفِ مِنْ إِقَامَةِ الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ sawwuwa sufuwfakum faiinna taswiyaaa alssufuwfi min iiqaamaai alssalaaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Straighten your rows as the straightening of rows is essential for a perfect and correct prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الطَّائِيُّ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ مَا أَنْكَرْتَ مِنَّا مُنْذُ يَوْمِ عَهِدْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ مَا أَنْكَرْتُ شَيْئًا إِلاَّ أَنَّكُمْ لاَ تُقِيمُونَ الصُّفُوفَ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُقْبَةُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ الْمَدِينَةَ بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu aasadin, qaala aakhbaranaa alfadlu bnu muwsaa, qaala aakhbaranaa sa'iydu bnu 'ubaydin alttaaiiyyu, 'an bushayri bni yasaarin alaansaariyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu qadima almadiynaaa faqiyla lahu maa aankarta minnaa mundhu yawmi 'ahidta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala maa aankartu shayiana iilaaa aannakum laa tuqiymuwna alssufuwfa‏.‏ waqaala 'uqbaau bnu 'ubaydin 'an bushayri bni yasaarin qadima 'alaynaa aanasu bnu maalikin almadiynaaa bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:I arrived at Medina and was asked whether I found any change since the days of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I said, "I have not found any change except that you do not stand in alignment in your prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقِيمُوا صُفُوفَكُمْ فَإِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ ظَهْرِي ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ أَحَدُنَا يُلْزِقُ مَنْكِبَهُ بِمَنْكِبِ صَاحِبِهِ وَقَدَمَهُ بِقَدَمِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu khaalidin, qaala haddathanaa zuhayrun, 'an humaydin, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aaqiymuwa sufuwfakum faiinniy aaraakum min waraa'i zahriy ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana aahadunaa yulziqu mankibahu bimankibi saahibihi waqadamahu biqadamihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Straighten your rows for I see you from behind my back." Anas added, "Everyone of us used to put his shoulder with the shoulder of his companion and his foot with the foot of his companion
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، فَأَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَأْسِي مِنْ وَرَائِي، فَجَعَلَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فَصَلَّى وَرَقَدَ فَجَاءَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، فَقَامَ وَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa daawudu, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala sallaytu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata laylaain faqumtu 'an yasaarihi, faaakhadha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biraasiy min waraaiiy, faja'alaniy 'an yamiynihi, fasallaa waraqada fajaa'ahu almuuadhhinu, faqaama wasallaa walam yatawaddaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I prayed with the Prophet (ﷺ) one night and stood on his left side. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) caught hold of my head from behind and drew me to his right and then offered the prayer and slept. Later the Mu'adh-dhin came and the Prophet (ﷺ) stood up for prayer without performing ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ أَنَا وَيَتِيمٌ، فِي بَيْتِنَا خَلْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأُمِّي أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ خَلْفَنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an iishaaqa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala sallaytu aanaa wayatiymun, fiy baytinaa khalfa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaummiy aummu sulaymin khalfanaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:One night an orphan and I offered the prayers behind the Prophet (ﷺ) in my house and my mother (Um Sulaim) was standing behind us (by herself forming a row)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قُمْتُ لَيْلَةً أُصَلِّي عَنْ يَسَارِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي أَوْ بِعَضُدِي حَتَّى أَقَامَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، وَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ مِنْ وَرَائِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa thaabitu bnu yaziyda, haddathanaa 'aasimun, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala qumtu laylaaan ausalliy 'an yasaari alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhadha biyadiy aaw bi'adudiy hattaa aaqaamaniy 'an yamiynihi, waqaala biyadihi min waraaiiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:One night I stood to the left of the Prophet (ﷺ) in the prayer but he caught hold of me by the hand or by the shoulder (arm) till he made me stand on his right and beckoned with his hand (for me) to go from behind (him). (Al-Kashmaihani [??] , Fath-ul-Bari
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فِي حُجْرَتِهِ، وَجِدَارُ الْحُجْرَةِ قَصِيرٌ، فَرَأَى النَّاسُ شَخْصَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَامَ أُنَاسٌ يُصَلُّونَ بِصَلاَتِهِ، فَأَصْبَحُوا فَتَحَدَّثُوا بِذَلِكَ، فَقَامَ لَيْلَةَ الثَّانِيَةِ، فَقَامَ مَعَهُ أُنَاسٌ يُصَلُّونَ بِصَلاَتِهِ، صَنَعُوا ذَلِكَ لَيْلَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةً، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ جَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَخْرُجْ، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ ذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ النَّاسُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَنْ تُكْتَبَ عَلَيْكُمْ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdaau, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin alaansaariyyi, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy mina alllayli fiy hujratihi, wajidaaru alhujraai qasiyrun, faraaaa alnnaasu shakhsa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaama aunaasun yusalluwna bisalaatihi, faaasbahuwa fatahaddathuwa bidhalika, faqaama laylaaa althhaaniyaai, faqaama ma'ahu aunaasun yusalluwna bisalaatihi, sana'uwa dhalika laylatayni aaw thalaathaaan, hattaa iidhaa kaana ba'da dhalika jalasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falam yakhruj, falammaa aasbaha dhakara dhalika alnnaasu faqaala ‏ "‏ iinniy khashiytu aan tuktaba 'alaykum salaaau alllayli ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray in his room at night. As the wall of the room was low, the people saw him and some of them stood up to follow him in the prayer. In the morning they spread the news. The following night the Prophet (ﷺ) stood for the prayer and the people followed him. This went on for two or three nights. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not stand for the prayer the following night, and did not come out. In the morning, the people asked him about it. He replied, that he way afraid that the night prayer might become compulsory
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ لَهُ حَصِيرٌ يَبْسُطُهُ بِالنَّهَارِ، وَيَحْتَجِرُهُ بِاللَّيْلِ، فَثَابَ إِلَيْهِ نَاسٌ، فَصَلَّوْا وَرَاءَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana lahu hasiyrun yabsutuhu bialnnahaari, wayahtajiruhu bialllayli, fathaaba iilayhi naasun, fasallawa waraa'ahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) had a mat which he used to spread during the day and use as a curtain at night. So a number of people gathered at night facing it and prayed behind him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اتَّخَذَ حُجْرَةً ـ قَالَ حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ـ مِنْ حَصِيرٍ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَصَلَّى فِيهَا لَيَالِيَ، فَصَلَّى بِصَلاَتِهِ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، فَلَمَّا عَلِمَ بِهِمْ جَعَلَ يَقْعُدُ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ قَدْ عَرَفْتُ الَّذِي رَأَيْتُ مِنْ صَنِيعِكُمْ، فَصَلُّوا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ، فَإِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الصَّلاَةِ صَلاَةُ الْمَرْءِ فِي بَيْتِهِ إِلاَّ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، عَنْ بُسْرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, qaala haddathanaa wuhaybun, qaala haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an saalimin aabiy alnnadri, 'an busri bni sa'iydin, 'an zaydi bni thaabitin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm attakhadha hujraaan qaala hasibtu aannahu qaala min hasiyrin fiy ramadaana fasallaa fiyhaa layaaliya, fasallaa bisalaatihi naasun min aashaabihi, falammaa 'alima bihim ja'ala yaq'udu, fakharaja iilayhim faqaala ‏ "‏ qad 'araftu alladhiy raaaytu min saniy'ikum, fasalluwa aayyuhaa alnnaasu fiy buyuwtikum, faiinna aafdala alssalaaai salaaau almar'i fiy baytihi iilaaa almaktuwbaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'affaanu haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa muwsaa, sami'tu aabaa alnnadri, 'an busrin, 'an zaydin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made a small room in the month of Ramadan (Sa`id said, "I think that Zaid bin Thabit said that it was made of a mat") and he prayed there for a few nights, and so some of his companions prayed behind him. When he came to know about it, he kept on sitting. In the morning, he went out to them and said, "I have seen and understood what you did. You should pray in your houses, for the best prayer of a person is that which he prays in his house except the compulsory prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكِبَ فَرَسًا، فَجُحِشَ شِقُّهُ الأَيْمَنُ، قَالَ أَنَسٌ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَصَلَّى لَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ صَلاَةً مِنَ الصَّلَوَاتِ وَهْوَ قَاعِدٌ، فَصَلَّيْنَا وَرَاءَهُ قُعُودًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَمَّا سَلَّمَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ، فَإِذَا صَلَّى قَائِمًا فَصَلُّوا قِيَامًا، وَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ فَارْفَعُوا، وَإِذَا سَجَدَ فَاسْجُدُوا وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin alaansaariyyu, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakiba farasana, fajuhisha shiqquhu alaaymanu, qaala aanasun rda allh 'nh fasallaa lanaa yawmaiidhin salaaaan mina alssalawaati wahwa qaa'idun, fasallaynaa waraa'ahu qu'uwdana, thumma qaala lammaa sallama ‏ "‏ iinnamaa ju'ila aliimaamu liyuutamma bihi, faiidhaa sallaa qaaiimana fasalluwa qiyaamana, waiidhaa raka'a faarka'uwa, waiidhaa rafa'a faarfa'uwa, waiidhaa sajada faasjuduwa waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu‏.‏ faquwluwa rabbanaa walaka alhamdu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik Al-Ansari:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a horse and fell down and the right side of his body was injured. On that day he prayed one of the prayers sitting and we also prayed behind him sitting. When the Prophet (ﷺ) finished the prayer with Taslim, he said, "The Imam is to be followed and if he prays standing then pray standing, and bow when he bows, and raise your heads when he raises his head; prostrate when he prostrates; and if he says "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah", you should say, "Rabbana wa laka l-hamd.:
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ خَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ فَرَسٍ فَجُحِشَ فَصَلَّى لَنَا قَاعِدًا فَصَلَّيْنَا مَعَهُ قُعُودًا، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا الإِمَامُ ـ أَوْ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِمَامُ ـ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ، فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ فَكَبِّرُوا، وَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ فَارْفَعُوا، وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَجَدَ فَاسْجُدُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu qaala kharra rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an farasin fajuhisha fasallaa lanaa qaa'idana fasallaynaa ma'ahu qu'uwdana, thumma ansarafa faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa aliimaamu aaw iinnamaa ju'ila aliimaamu liyuutamma bihi, faiidhaa kabbara fakabbiruwa, waiidhaa raka'a faarka'uwa, waiidhaa rafa'a faarfa'uwa, waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu‏.‏ faquwluwa rabbanaa laka alhamdu‏.‏ waiidhaa sajada faasjuduwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell from a horse and got injured so he led the prayer sitting and we also prayed sitting. When he completed the prayer he said, "The Imam is to be followed; if he says Takbir then say Takbir, bow if he bows; raise your heads when he raises his head, when he says, 'Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah say, 'Rabbana laka l-hamd', and prostrate when he prostrates
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ، فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ فَكَبِّرُوا، وَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا، وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ فَقُولُوا رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سَجَدَ فَاسْجُدُوا، وَإِذَا صَلَّى جَالِسًا فَصَلُّوا جُلُوسًا أَجْمَعُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, qaala haddathaniy aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnamaa ju'ila aliimaamu liyuutamma bihi, faiidhaa kabbara fakabbiruwa, waiidhaa raka'a faarka'uwa, waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu‏.‏ faquwluwa rabbanaa walaka alhamdu‏.‏ waiidhaa sajada faasjuduwa, waiidhaa sallaa jaalisana fasalluwa juluwsana aajma'uwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Imam is to be followed. Say the Takbir when he says it; bow if he bows; if he says 'Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah', say, ' Rabbana wa laka l-hamd', prostrate if he prostrates and pray sitting altogether if he prays sitting
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ حَذْوَ مَنْكِبَيْهِ إِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلاَةَ، وَإِذَا كَبَّرَ لِلرُّكُوعِ، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ رَفَعَهُمَا كَذَلِكَ أَيْضًا وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ لاَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ فِي السُّجُودِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yarfa'u yadayhi hadhwa mankibayhi iidhaa aftataha alssalaaaa, waiidhaa kabbara lilrrukuw'i, waiidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i rafa'ahumaa kadhalika aaydana waqaala ‏ "‏ sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu, rabbanaa walaka alhamdu ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana laa yaf'alu dhalika fiy alssujuwdi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah:My father said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to raise both his hands up to the level of his shoulders when opening the prayer; and on saying the Takbir for bowing. And on raising his head from bowing he used to do the same and then say "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah, Rabbana wa laka l-hamd." And he did not do that (i.e. raising his hands) in prostrations
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، رضى الله عنهما قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَامَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يَكُونَا حَذْوَ مَنْكِبَيْهِ، وَكَانَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ حِينَ يُكَبِّرُ لِلرُّكُوعِ، وَيَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَلاَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ فِي السُّجُودِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, rda allh 'nhma qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qaama fiy alssalaaai rafa'a yadayhi hattaa yakuwnaa hadhwa mankibayhi, wakaana yaf'alu dhalika hiyna yukabbiru lilrrukuw'i, wayaf'alu dhalika iidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu ‏"‏‏.‏ walaa yaf'alu dhalika fiy alssujuwdi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I saw that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood for the prayer, he used to raise both his hands up to the shoulders, and used to do the same on saying the Takbir for bowing and on raising his head from it and used to say, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah". But he did not do that (i.e. raising his hands) in prostrations
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى مَالِكَ بْنَ الْحُوَيْرِثِ إِذَا صَلَّى كَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ، وَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ، وَحَدَّثَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَنَعَ هَكَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu alwaasitiyyu, qaala haddathanaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an khaalidin, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, aannahu raaaa maalika bna alhuwayrithi iidhaa sallaa kabbara warafa'a yadayhi, waiidhaa aaraada aan yarka'a rafa'a yadayhi, waiidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i rafa'a yadayhi, wahaddatha aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sana'a hakadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qilaba:I saw Malik bin Huwairith saying Takbir and raising both his hands (on starting the prayers and raising his hands on bowing and also on raising his head after bowing. Malik bin Huwairith said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did the same
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم افْتَتَحَ التَّكْبِيرَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ، فَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حِينَ يُكَبِّرُ حَتَّى يَجْعَلَهُمَا حَذْوَ مَنْكِبَيْهِ، وَإِذَا كَبَّرَ لِلرُّكُوعِ فَعَلَ مِثْلَهُ، وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ فَعَلَ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَلاَ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ حِينَ يَسْجُدُ وَلاَ حِينَ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السُّجُودِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaranaa saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aftataha alttakbiyra fiy alssalaaai, farafa'a yadayhi hiyna yukabbiru hattaa yaj'alahumaa hadhwa mankibayhi, waiidhaa kabbara lilrrukuw'i fa'ala mithlahu, waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu‏.‏ fa'ala mithlahu waqaala ‏ "‏ rabbanaa walaka alhamdu ‏"‏‏.‏ walaa yaf'alu dhalika hiyna yasjudu walaa hiyna yarfa'u raasahu mina alssujuwdi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) opening the prayer with the Takbir and raising his hands to the level of his shoulders at the time of saying the Takbir, and on saying the Takbir for bowing he did the same; and when he said, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah ", he did the same and then said, "Rabbana wa laka lhamd." But he did not do the same on prostrating and on lifting the head from it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ إِذَا دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ كَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ، وَإِذَا رَكَعَ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ، وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ، وَإِذَا قَامَ مِنَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ‏.‏ وَرَفَعَ ذَلِكَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ إِلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ رَوَاهُ حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ ابْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ وَمُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ مُخْتَصَرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ayyaashun, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, qaala haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, kaana iidhaa dakhala fiy alssalaaai kabbara warafa'a yadayhi, waiidhaa raka'a rafa'a yadayhi, waiidhaa qaala sami'a alllahu liman hamidahu‏.‏ rafa'a yadayhi, waiidhaa qaama mina alrrak'atayni rafa'a yadayhi‏.‏ warafa'a dhalika abnu 'umara iilaa nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ rawaahu hammaadu bnu salamaaa 'an aayyuwba 'an naafi'in 'ani abni 'umara 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ warawaahu abnu tahmaana 'an aayyuwba wamuwsaa bni 'uqbaaa mukhtasarana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Whenever Ibn `Umar started the prayer with Takbir, he used to raise his hands: whenever he bowed, he used to raise his hands (before bowing) and also used to raise his hands on saying, "Sami`a l-lahu liman hamidah", and he used to do the same on rising from the second rak`a (for the 3rd rak`a). Ibn `Umar said: "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to do the same
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّاسُ يُؤْمَرُونَ أَنْ يَضَعَ الرَّجُلُ الْيَدَ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى ذِرَاعِهِ الْيُسْرَى فِي الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو حَازِمٍ لاَ أَعْلَمُهُ إِلاَّ يَنْمِي ذَلِكَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ يُنْمَى ذَلِكَ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ يَنْمِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala kaana alnnaasu yuumaruwna aan yada'a alrrajulu alyada alyumnaa 'alaa dhiraa'ihi alyusraa fiy alssalaaai‏.‏ qaala aabuw haazimin laa aa'lamuhu iilaaa yanmiy dhalika iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaala iismaa'iylu yunmaa dhalika‏.‏ walam yaqul yanmiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The people were ordered to place the right hand on the left forearm in the prayer. Abu Hazim said, "I knew that the order was from the Prophet (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلْ تَرَوْنَ قِبْلَتِي هَا هُنَا وَاللَّهِ مَا يَخْفَى عَلَىَّ رُكُوعُكُمْ وَلاَ خُشُوعُكُمْ، وَإِنِّي لأَرَاكُمْ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِي ‏"‏‏.‏
