verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ hal tarawna qiblatiy haa hunaa waalllahi maa yakhfaa 'alaaaa rukuw'ukum walaa khushuw'ukum, waiinniy laaraakum waraa'a zahriy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "You see me facing the Qibla; but, by Allah, nothing is hidden from me regarding your bowing and submissiveness and I see you from behind my back
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقِيمُوا الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ، فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَاكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِي ـ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ مِنْ بَعْدِ ظَهْرِي ـ إِذَا رَكَعْتُمْ وَسَجَدْتُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala haddathanaa ghundarun, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aaqiymuwa alrrukuw'a waalssujuwda, fawaalllahi iinniy laaraakum min ba'diy warubbamaa qaala min ba'di zahriy iidhaa raka'tum wasajadtum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Perform the bowing and the prostrations properly. By Allah, I see you from behind me (or from behind my back) when you bow or prostrate
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانُوا يَفْتَتِحُونَ الصَّلاَةَ بِ ـ ‏{‏الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabaa bakrin wa'umara rda allh 'nhma kaanuwa yaftatihuwna alssalaaaa bi ‏{‏alhamdu lillahi rabbi al'aalamiyna‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet, Abu Bakr and `Umar used to start the prayer with "Al hamdu li l-lahi Rabbi l-`alamin (All praise is but to Allah, Lord of the Worlds)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْكُتُ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَبَيْنَ الْقِرَاءَةِ إِسْكَاتَةً ـ قَالَ أَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ هُنَيَّةً ـ فَقُلْتُ بِأَبِي وَأُمِّي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِسْكَاتُكَ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَالْقِرَاءَةِ مَا تَقُولُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَاىَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَاىَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu ziyaadin, qaala haddathanaa 'umaaraau bnu alqa'qaa'i, qaala haddathanaa aabuw zur'aaa, qaala haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaskutu bayna alttakbiyri wabayna alqiraa'aai iiskaataaan qaala aahsibuhu qaala hunayyaaan faqultu biaabiy waaummiy yaa rasuwla alllahi, iiskaatuka bayna alttakbiyri waalqiraa'aai maa taquwlu qaala ‏ "‏ aaquwlu alllahumma baa'id bayniy wabayna khataayaaaa kamaa baa'adta bayna almashriqi waalmaghribi, alllahumma naqqiniy mina alkhataayaa kamaa yunaqqaa althhawbu alaabyadu mina alddanasi, alllahumma aghsil khataayaaaa bialmaa'i waalthhalji waalbaradi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to keep silent between the Takbir and the recitation of Qur'an and that interval of silence used to be a short one. I said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "May my parents be sacrificed for you! What do you say in the pause between Takbir and recitation?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I say, 'Allahumma, baa`id baini wa baina khatayaya kama baa`adta baina l-mashriqi wa l-maghrib. Allahumma, naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqa th-thawbu l-abyadu mina d-danas. Allahumma, ighsil khatayaya bi l-maa'i wa th-thalji wa l-barad (O Allah! Set me apart from my sins (faults) as the East and West are set apart from each other and clean me from sins as a white garment is cleaned of dirt (after thorough washing). O Allah! Wash off my sins with water, snow and hail
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى صَلاَةَ الْكُسُوفِ، فَقَامَ فَأَطَالَ الْقِيَامَ، ثُمَّ رَكَعَ فَأَطَالَ الرُّكُوعَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَأَطَالَ الْقِيَامَ، ثُمَّ رَكَعَ فَأَطَالَ الرُّكُوعَ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ، ثُمَّ سَجَدَ فَأَطَالَ السُّجُودَ، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ، ثُمَّ سَجَدَ فَأَطَالَ السُّجُودَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَأَطَالَ الْقِيَامَ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ فَأَطَالَ الرُّكُوعَ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ فَأَطَالَ الْقِيَامَ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ فَأَطَالَ الرُّكُوعَ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ فَسَجَدَ فَأَطَالَ السُّجُودَ، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ، ثُمَّ سَجَدَ فَأَطَالَ السُّجُودَ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ دَنَتْ مِنِّي الْجَنَّةُ حَتَّى لَوِ اجْتَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهَا لَجِئْتُكُمْ بِقِطَافٍ مِنْ قِطَافِهَا، وَدَنَتْ مِنِّي النَّارُ حَتَّى قُلْتُ أَىْ رَبِّ وَأَنَا مَعَهُمْ فَإِذَا امْرَأَةٌ ـ حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ـ تَخْدِشُهَا هِرَّةٌ قُلْتُ مَا شَأْنُ هَذِهِ قَالُوا حَبَسَتْهَا حَتَّى مَاتَتْ جُوعًا، لاَ أَطْعَمَتْهَا، وَلاَ أَرْسَلَتْهَا تَأْكُلُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَافِعٌ حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مِنْ خَشِيشِ أَوْ خُشَاشِ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy maryama, qaala aakhbaranaa naafi'u bnu 'umara, qaala haddathaniy abnu aabiy mulaykaaa, 'an aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa salaaaa alkusuwfi, faqaama faaataala alqiyaama, thumma raka'a faaataala alrrukuw'a, thumma qaama faaataala alqiyaama, thumma raka'a faaataala alrrukuw'a thumma rafa'a, thumma sajada faaataala alssujuwda, thumma rafa'a, thumma sajada faaataala alssujuwda, thumma qaama faaataala alqiyaama thumma raka'a faaataala alrrukuw'a thumma rafa'a faaataala alqiyaama thumma raka'a faaataala alrrukuw'a thumma rafa'a fasajada faaataala alssujuwda, thumma rafa'a, thumma sajada faaataala alssujuwda thumma ansarafa faqaala ‏"‏ qad danat minniy aljannaau hattaa lawi ajtaraatu 'alayhaa lajiitukum biqitaafin min qitaafihaa, wadanat minniy alnnaaru hattaa qultu aaa rabbi waaanaa ma'ahum faiidhaa amraaaaun hasibtu aannahu qaala takhdishuhaa hirraaun qultu maa shaanu hadhihi qaaluwa habasathaa hattaa maatat juw'ana, laa aat'amathaa, walaa aarsalathaa taakulu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala naafi'un hasibtu aannahu qaala ‏"‏ min khashiyshi aaw khushaashi alaardi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Asma' bint Abi Bakr:The Prophet (ﷺ) once offered the eclipse prayer. He stood for a long time and then did a prolonged bowing. He stood up straight again and kept on standing for a long time, then bowed a long bowing and then stood up straight and then prostrated a prolonged prostration and then lifted his head and prostrated a prolonged prostration. And then he stood up for a long time and then did a prolonged bowing and then stood up straight again and kept on standing for a long time. Then he bowed a long bowing and then stood up straight and then prostrated a prolonged prostration and then lifted his head and went for a prolonged prostration. On completion of the prayer, he said, "Paradise became so near to me that if I had dared, I would have plucked one of its bunches for you and Hell became so near to me that I said, 'O my Lord will I be among those people?' Then suddenly I saw a woman and a cat was lacerating her with its claws. On inquiring, it was said that the woman had imprisoned the cat till it died of starvation and she neither fed it nor freed it so that it could feed itself
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ قُلْنَا لِخَبَّابٍ أَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قُلْنَا بِمَ كُنْتُمْ تَعْرِفُونَ ذَاكَ قَالَ بِاضْطِرَابِ لِحْيَتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, qaala haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an 'umaaraaa bni 'umayrin, 'an aabiy ma'marin, qaala qulnaa likhabbaabin aakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy alzzuhri waal'asri qaala na'am‏.‏ qulnaa bima kuntum ta'rifuwna dhaaka qaala biadtiraabi lihyatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Ma`mar:We asked Khabbab whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to recite (the Qur'an) in the Zuhr and the `Asr prayers. He replied in the affirmative. We said, "How did you come to know about it?" He said, "By the movement of his beard
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، يَخْطُبُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْبَرَاءُ، وَكَانَ، غَيْرَ كَذُوبٍ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا صَلَّوْا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَامُوا قِيَامًا حَتَّى يَرَوْنَهُ قَدْ سَجَدَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaajun, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aanbaaanaa aabuw iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna yaziyda, yakhtubu qaala haddathanaa albaraa'u, wakaana, ghayra kadhuwbin aannahum kaanuwa iidhaa sallawa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm farafa'a raasahu mina alrrukuw'i qaamuwa qiyaamana hattaa yarawnahu qad sajada‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:(And Al-Bara was not a liar) Whenever we offered prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he raised his head from the bowing, we used to remain standing till we saw him prostrating
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، رضى الله عنهما قَالَ خَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى، قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، رَأَيْنَاكَ تَنَاوَلُ شَيْئًا فِي مَقَامِكَ، ثُمَّ رَأَيْنَاكَ تَكَعْكَعْتَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي أُرِيتُ الْجَنَّةَ، فَتَنَاوَلْتُ مِنْهَا عُنْقُودًا، وَلَوْ أَخَذْتُهُ لأَكَلْتُمْ مِنْهُ مَا بَقِيَتِ الدُّنْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, rda allh 'nhma qaala khasafati alshhamsu 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallaa, qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, raaaynaaka tanaawalu shayiana fiy maqaamika, thumma raaaynaaka taka'ka'ta‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy auriytu aljannaaa, fatanaawaltu minhaa 'unquwdana, walaw aakhadhtuhu laakaltum minhu maa baqiyati alddunyaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Once solar eclipse occurred during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He offered the eclipse prayer. His companions asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We saw you trying to take something while standing at your place and then we saw you retreating." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I was shown Paradise and wanted to have a bunch of fruit from it. Had I taken it, you would have eaten from it as long as the world remains
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِلاَلُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى لَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ رَقَا الْمِنْبَرَ، فَأَشَارَ بِيَدَيْهِ قِبَلَ قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الآنَ مُنْذُ صَلَّيْتُ لَكُمُ الصَّلاَةَ الْجَنَّةَ وَالنَّارَ مُمَثَّلَتَيْنِ فِي قِبْلَةِ هَذَا الْجِدَارِ، فَلَمْ أَرَ كَالْيَوْمِ فِي الْخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ ‏"‏ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu sinaanin, qaala haddathanaa fulayhun, qaala haddathanaa hilaalu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala sallaa lanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma raqaa alminbara, faaashaara biyadayhi qibala qiblaai almasjidi thumma qaala ‏ "‏ laqad raaaytu alana mundhu sallaytu lakumu alssalaaaa aljannaaa waalnnaara mumathhalatayni fiy qiblaai hadhaa aljidaari, falam aara kaalyawmi fiy alkhayri waalshharri ‏"‏ thalaathana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) led us in prayer and then went up to the pulpit and beckoned with both hands towards the Qibla of the mosque and then said, "When I started leading you in prayer, I saw the display of Paradise and Hell on the wall of the mosque (facing the Qibla). I never saw good and bad as I have seen today." He repeated the last statement thrice
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، أَنَّ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، حَدَّثَهُمْ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ يَرْفَعُونَ أَبْصَارَهُمْ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فِي صَلاَتِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاشْتَدَّ قَوْلُهُ فِي ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيَنْتَهُنَّ عَنْ ذَلِكَ أَوْ لَتُخْطَفَنَّ أَبْصَارُهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, qaala haddathanaa qataadaau, aanna aanasa bna maalikin, haddathahum qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa baalu aaqwaamin yarfa'uwna aabsaarahum iilaa alssamaa'i fiy salaatihim ‏"‏‏.‏ faashtadda qawluhu fiy dhalika hattaa qaala ‏"‏ layantahunna 'an dhalika aaw latukhtafanna aabsaaruhum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "What is wrong with those people who look towards the sky during the prayer?" His talk grew stern while delivering this speech and he said, "They should stop (looking towards the sky during the prayer); otherwise their eyesight would be taken away
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَشْعَثُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ الاِلْتِفَاتِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هُوَ اخْتِلاَسٌ يَخْتَلِسُهُ الشَّيْطَانُ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الْعَبْدِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, qaala haddathanaa aash'athu bnu sulaymin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an alailtifaati fiy alssalaaai faqaala ‏ "‏ huwa akhtilaasun yakhtalisuhu alshhaytaanu min salaaai al'abdi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about looking hither and thither in prayer. He replied, "It is a way of stealing by which Satan takes away (a portion) from the prayer of a person
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى فِي خَمِيصَةٍ لَهَا أَعْلاَمٌ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ شَغَلَتْنِي أَعْلاَمُ هَذِهِ، اذْهَبُوا بِهَا إِلَى أَبِي جَهْمٍ وَأْتُونِي بِأَنْبِجَانِيَّةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa fiy khamiysaain lahaa aa'laamun faqaala ‏ "‏ shaghalatniy aa'laamu hadhihi, adhhabuwa bihaa iilaa aabiy jahmin waatuwniy biaanbijaaniyyaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) prayed on a Khamisa with marks on it and said, "The marks on it diverted my attention, take this Khamisa to Abu Jahm and bring an Inbijaniya (from him)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ رَأَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نُخَامَةً فِي قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَهْوَ يُصَلِّي بَيْنَ يَدَىِ النَّاسِ، فَحَتَّهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ حِينَ انْصَرَفَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا كَانَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قِبَلَ وَجْهِهِ، فَلاَ يَتَنَخَّمَنَّ أَحَدٌ قِبَلَ وَجْهِهِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ وَابْنُ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa laythun, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aannahu qaala raaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm nukhaamaaan fiy qiblaai almasjidi, wahwa yusalliy bayna yadaai alnnaasi, fahattahaa thumma qaala hiyna ansarafa ‏ "‏ iinna aahadakum iidhaa kaana fiy alssalaaai faiinna alllaha qibala wajhihi, falaa yatanakhhamanna aahadun qibala wajhihi fiy alssalaaai ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa waabnu aabiy rawwaadin 'an naafi'in‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw expectoration in the direction of the Qibla of the mosque while he was leading the prayer, and scratched it off. After finishing the prayer, he said, "Whenever any of you is in prayer he should know that Allah is in front of him. So none should spit in front of him in the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسٌ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا الْمُسْلِمُونَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ لَمْ يَفْجَأْهُمْ إِلاَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَشَفَ سِتْرَ حُجْرَةِ عَائِشَةَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَهُمْ صُفُوفٌ، فَتَبَسَّمَ يَضْحَكُ، وَنَكَصَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رضى الله عنه عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ لِيَصِلَ لَهُ الصَّفَّ فَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ يُرِيدُ الْخُرُوجَ، وَهَمَّ الْمُسْلِمُونَ أَنْ يَفْتَتِنُوا فِي صَلاَتِهِمْ، فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَتِمُّوا صَلاَتَكُمْ، فَأَرْخَى السِّتْرَ، وَتُوُفِّيَ مِنْ آخِرِ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanaa laythu bnu sa'din, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aanasun, qaala baynamaa almuslimuwna fiy salaaai alfajri lam yafjaahum iilaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kashafa sitra hujraai 'aaiishaaa fanazara iilayhim wahum sufuwfun, fatabassama yadhaku, wanakasa aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh 'alaa 'aqibayhi liyasila lahu alssaffa fazanna aannahu yuriydu alkhuruwja, wahamma almuslimuwna aan yaftatinuwa fiy salaatihim, faaashaara iilayhim aatimmuwa salaatakum, faaarkhaa alssitra, watuwuffiya min akhiri dhalika alyawmi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:While the Muslims were offering the Fajr prayer, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) suddenly appeared before them by lifting the curtain of the dwelling place of `Aisha, looked towards the Muslims who were standing in rows. He smiled with pleasure. Abu Bakr started retreating to join the row on the assumption that the Prophet wanted to come out for the prayer. The Muslims intended to leave the prayer (and were on the verge of being put to trial), but the Prophet (ﷺ) beckoned them to complete their prayer and then he let the curtain fall. He died in the last hours of that day
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ شَكَا أَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ سَعْدًا إِلَى عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَعَزَلَهُ وَاسْتَعْمَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمَّارًا، فَشَكَوْا حَتَّى ذَكَرُوا أَنَّهُ لاَ يُحْسِنُ يُصَلِّي، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ إِنَّ هَؤُلاَءِ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّكَ لاَ تُحْسِنُ تُصَلِّي قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ أَمَّا أَنَا وَاللَّهِ فَإِنِّي كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي بِهِمْ صَلاَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أَخْرِمُ عَنْهَا، أُصَلِّي صَلاَةَ الْعِشَاءِ فَأَرْكُدُ فِي الأُولَيَيْنِ وَأُخِفُّ فِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ ذَاكَ الظَّنُّ بِكَ يَا أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَ مَعَهُ رَجُلاً أَوْ رِجَالاً إِلَى الْكُوفَةِ، فَسَأَلَ عَنْهُ أَهْلَ الْكُوفَةِ، وَلَمْ يَدَعْ مَسْجِدًا إِلاَّ سَأَلَ عَنْهُ، وَيُثْنُونَ مَعْرُوفًا، حَتَّى دَخَلَ مَسْجِدًا لِبَنِي عَبْسٍ، فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ قَتَادَةَ يُكْنَى أَبَا سَعْدَةَ قَالَ أَمَّا إِذْ نَشَدْتَنَا فَإِنَّ سَعْدًا كَانَ لاَ يَسِيرُ بِالسَّرِيَّةِ، وَلاَ يَقْسِمُ بِالسَّوِيَّةِ، وَلاَ يَعْدِلُ فِي الْقَضِيَّةِ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعْدٌ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لأَدْعُوَنَّ بِثَلاَثٍ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ عَبْدُكَ هَذَا كَاذِبًا، قَامَ رِيَاءً وَسُمْعَةً فَأَطِلْ عُمْرَهُ، وَأَطِلْ فَقْرَهُ، وَعَرِّضْهُ بِالْفِتَنِ، وَكَانَ بَعْدُ إِذَا سُئِلَ يَقُولُ شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ مَفْتُونٌ، أَصَابَتْنِي دَعْوَةُ سَعْدٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ فَأَنَا رَأَيْتُهُ بَعْدُ قَدْ سَقَطَ حَاجِبَاهُ عَلَى عَيْنَيْهِ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ، وَإِنَّهُ لَيَتَعَرَّضُ لِلْجَوَارِي فِي الطُّرُقِ يَغْمِزُهُنَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, qaala haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu 'umayrin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala shakaa aahlu alkuwfaai sa'dana iilaa 'umara rda allh 'nh fa'azalahu waasta'mala 'alayhim 'ammaarana, fashakawa hattaa dhakaruwa aannahu laa yuhsinu yusalliy, faaarsala iilayhi faqaala yaa aabaa iishaaqa iinna hauulaa'i yaz'umuwna aannaka laa tuhsinu tusalliy qaala aabuw iishaaqa aammaa aanaa waalllahi faiinniy kuntu ausalliy bihim salaaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa aakhrimu 'anhaa, ausalliy salaaaa al'ishaa'i faaarkudu fiy alauwlayayni waaukhiffu fiy alaukhrayayni‏.‏ qaala dhaaka alzzannu bika yaa aabaa iishaaqa‏.‏ faaarsala ma'ahu rajulaan aaw rijaalaan iilaa alkuwfaai, fasaaala 'anhu aahla alkuwfaai, walam yada' masjidana iilaaa saaala 'anhu, wayuthnuwna ma'ruwfana, hattaa dakhala masjidana libaniy 'absin, faqaama rajulun minhum yuqaalu lahu ausaamaau bnu qataadaaa yuknaa aabaa sa'daaa qaala aammaa iidh nashadtanaa faiinna sa'dana kaana laa yasiyru bialssariyyaai, walaa yaqsimu bialssawiyyaai, walaa ya'dilu fiy alqadiyyaai‏.‏ qaala sa'dun aamaa waalllahi laad'uwanna bithalaathin, alllahumma iin kaana 'abduka hadhaa kaadhibana, qaama riyaa'an wasum'aaan faaatil 'umrahu, waaatil faqrahu, wa'arridhu bialfitani, wakaana ba'du iidhaa suiila yaquwlu shaykhun kabiyrun maftuwnun, aasaabatniy da'waau sa'din‏.‏ qaala 'abdu almaliki faaanaa raaaytuhu ba'du qad saqata haajibaahu 'alaa 'aynayhi mina alkibari, waiinnahu layata'arradu liljawaariy fiy altturuqi yaghmizuhunna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:The People of Kufa complained against Sa`d to `Umar and the latter dismissed him and appointed `Ammar as their chief . They lodged many complaints against Sa`d and even they alleged that he did not pray properly. `Umar sent for him and said, "O Aba 'Is-haq! These people claim that you do not pray properly." Abu 'Is-haq said, "By Allah, I used to pray with them a prayer similar to that of Allah's Apostle and I never reduced anything of it. I used to prolong the first two rak`at of `Isha prayer and shorten the last two rak`at." `Umar said, "O Aba 'Is-haq, this was what I thought about you." And then he sent one or more persons with him to Kufa so as to ask the people about him. So they went there and did not leave any mosque without asking about him. All the people praised him till they came to the mosque of the tribe of Bani `Abs; one of the men called Usama bin Qatada with a surname of Aba Sa`da stood up and said, "As you have put us under an oath; I am bound to tell you that Sa`d never went himself with the army and never distributed (the war booty) equally and never did justice in legal verdicts." (On hearing it) Sa`d said, "I pray to Allah for three things: O Allah! If this slave of yours is a liar and got up for showing off, give him a long life, increase his poverty and put him to trials." (And so it happened). Later on when that person was asked how he was, he used to reply that he was an old man in trial as the result of Sa`d's curse. `Abdul Malik, the sub narrator, said that he had seen him afterwards and his eyebrows were overhanging his eyes owing to old age and he used to tease and assault the small girls in the way
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ صَلاَةَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَقْرَأْ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an mahmuwdi bni alrrabiy'i, 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa salaaaa liman lam yaqraa bifaatihaai alkitaabi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever does not recite Al-Fatiha in his prayer, his prayer is invalid
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ، فَدَخَلَ رَجُلٌ فَصَلَّى فَسَلَّمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَدَّ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْجِعْ فَصَلِّ، فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ يُصَلِّي كَمَا صَلَّى ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْجِعْ فَصَلِّ فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ ‏"‏ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ مَا أُحْسِنُ غَيْرَهُ فَعَلِّمْنِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا قُمْتَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَكَبِّرْ، ثُمَّ اقْرَأْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، ثُمَّ ارْكَعْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ رَاكِعًا، ثُمَّ ارْفَعْ حَتَّى تَعْتَدِلَ قَائِمًا، ثُمَّ اسْجُدْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ سَاجِدًا، ثُمَّ ارْفَعْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ جَالِسًا، وَافْعَلْ ذَلِكَ فِي صَلاَتِكَ كُلِّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu aabiy sa'iydin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala almasjida, fadakhala rajulun fasallaa fasallama 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faradda waqaala ‏"‏ arji' fasalli, faiinnaka lam tusalli ‏"‏‏.‏ faraja'a yusalliy kamaa sallaa thumma jaa'a fasallama 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ arji' fasalli faiinnaka lam tusalli ‏"‏ thalaathana‏.‏ faqaala waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi maa auhsinu ghayrahu fa'allimniy‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa qumta iilaa alssalaaai fakabbir, thumma aqraa maa tayassara ma'aka mina alqurani, thumma arka' hattaa tatmaiinna raaki'ana, thumma arfa' hattaa ta'tadila qaaiimana, thumma asjud hattaa tatmaiinna saajidana, thumma arfa' hattaa tatmaiinna jaalisana, waaf'al dhalika fiy salaatika kullihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered the mosque and a person followed him. The man prayed and went to the Prophet and greeted him. The Prophet (ﷺ) returned the greeting and said to him, "Go back and pray, for you have not prayed." The man went back prayed in the same way as before, returned and greeted the Prophet who said, "Go back and pray, for you have not prayed." This happened thrice. The man said, "By Him Who sent you with the Truth, I cannot offer the prayer in a better way than this. Please, teach me how to pray." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When you stand for Prayer say Takbir and then recite from the Holy Qur'an (of what you know by heart) and then bow till you feel at ease. Then raise your head and stand up straight, then prostrate till you feel at ease during your prostration, then sit with calmness till you feel at ease (do not hurry) and do the same in all your prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ سَعْدٌ كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي بِهِمْ صَلاَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَتَىِ الْعَشِيِّ لاَ أَخْرِمُ عَنْهَا، أَرْكُدُ فِي الأُولَيَيْنِ وَأَحْذِفُ فِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ذَلِكَ الظَّنُّ بِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala qaala sa'dun kuntu ausalliy bihim salaaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaataai al'ashiyyi laa aakhrimu 'anhaa, aarkudu fiy alauwlayayni waaahdhifu fiy alaukhrayayni‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh dhalika alzzannu bika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:Sa`d said, "I used to pray with them a prayer similar to that of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (the prayer of Zuhr and `Asr) reducing nothing from them. I used to prolong the first two rak`at and shorten the last two rak`at." `Umar said to Sa`d "This was what we thought about you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأُولَيَيْنِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَسُورَتَيْنِ، يُطَوِّلُ فِي الأُولَى، وَيُقَصِّرُ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ، وَيُسْمِعُ الآيَةَ أَحْيَانًا، وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الْعَصْرِ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَسُورَتَيْنِ، وَكَانَ يُطَوِّلُ فِي الأُولَى، وَكَانَ يُطَوِّلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الأُولَى مِنْ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ، وَيُقَصِّرُ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy alrrak'atayni alauwlayayni min salaaai alzzuhri bifaatihaai alkitaabi wasuwratayni, yutawwilu fiy alauwlaa, wayuqassiru fiy althhaaniyaai, wayusmi'u alayaaa aahyaanana, wakaana yaqraau fiy al'asri bifaatihaai alkitaabi wasuwratayni, wakaana yutawwilu fiy alauwlaa, wakaana yutawwilu fiy alrrak'aai alauwlaa min salaaai alssubhi, wayuqassiru fiy althhaaniyaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) in Zuhr prayers used to recite Al-Fatiha along with two other Suras in the first two rak`at: a long one in the first rak`a and a shorter (Sura) in the second, and at times the verses were audible. In the `Asr prayer the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite Al-Fatiha and two more Suras in the first two rak`at and used to prolong the first rak`a. And he used to prolong the first rak`a of the Fajr prayer and shorten the second
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنِي عُمَارَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْنَا خَبَّابًا أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قُلْنَا بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ كُنْتُمْ تَعْرِفُونَ قَالَ بِاضْطِرَابِ لِحْيَتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, qaala haddathanaa aabiy qaala, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathaniy 'umaaraau, 'an aabiy ma'marin, qaala saaalnaa khabbaabana aakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy alzzuhri waal'asri qaala na'am‏.‏ qulnaa biaaaai shaa'in kuntum ta'rifuwna qaala biadtiraabi lihyatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Ma`mar:I asked Khabbab whether the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the Qur'an in the Zuhr and the `Asr prayers. He replied in the affirmative. We said, "How did you come to know that?" He said, "From the movement of his beard
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِخَبَّابِ بْنِ الأَرَتِّ أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بِأَىِّ شَىْءٍ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ قِرَاءَتَهُ قَالَ بِاضْطِرَابِ لِحْيَتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'umaaraaa bni 'umayrin, 'an aabiy ma'marin, qaala qultu likhabbaabi bni alaaratti aakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy alzzuhri waal'asri qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala qultu biaaaai shaa'in kuntum ta'lamuwna qiraa'atahu qaala biadtiraabi lihyatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Ma`mar:I asked Khabbab bin Al-Art whether the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the Qur'an in the Zuhr and the `Asr prayers. He replied in the affirmative. I said, "How did you come to know that?" He replied, "From the movement of his beard
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ، وَسُورَةٍ سُورَةٍ، وَيُسْمِعُنَا الآيَةَ أَحْيَانًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa almakkiyyu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an hishaamin, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy alrrak'atayni mina alzzuhri waal'asri bifaatihaai alkitaabi, wasuwraain suwraain, wayusmi'unaa alayaaa aahyaanana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite Al-Fatiha along with another Sura in the first two rak`at of the Zuhr and the `Asr prayers and at times a verse or so was audible to us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ أُمَّ الْفَضْلِ سَمِعَتْهُ وَهُوَ يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏وَالْمُرْسَلاَتِ عُرْفًا‏}‏ فَقَالَتْ يَا بُنَىَّ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ ذَكَّرْتَنِي بِقِرَاءَتِكَ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ، إِنَّهَا لآخِرُ مَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ بِهَا فِي الْمَغْرِبِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aannahu qaala iinna aumma alfadli sami'athu wahuwa yaqraau ‏{‏waalmursalaati 'urfana‏}‏ faqaalat yaa bunaaaa waalllahi laqad dhakkartaniy biqiraa'atika hadhihi alssuwraaa, iinnahaa lakhiru maa sami'tu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau bihaa fiy almaghribi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:(My mother) Umu-l-Fadl heard me reciting "Wal Mursalati `Urfan" (77) and said, "O my son! By Allah, your recitation made me remember that it was the last Sura I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He recited it in the Maghrib prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ مَا لَكَ تَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِقِصَارٍ، وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ بِطُولِ الطُّولَيَيْنِ
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an marwaana bni alhakami, qaala qaala liy zaydu bnu thaabitin maa laka taqraau fiy almaghribi biqisaarin, waqad sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau bituwli alttuwlayayni
verses.translation: Narrated Marwan bin Al-Hakam:Zaid bin Thabit said to me, "Why do you recite very short Suras in the Maghrib prayer while I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting the longer of the two long Suras?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَرَأَ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِالطُّورِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an muhammadi bni jubayri bni mut'imin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaraaa fiy almaghribi bialttuwri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jubair bin Mut`im:My father said, "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reciting "at-Tur" (52) in the Maghrib prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ الْعَتَمَةَ فَقَرَأَ ‏{‏إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ‏}‏ فَسَجَدَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ قَالَ سَجَدْتُ خَلْفَ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ أَزَالُ أَسْجُدُ بِهَا حَتَّى أَلْقَاهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, qaala haddathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an bakrin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, qaala sallaytu ma'a aabiy hurayraaa al'atamaaa faqaraaa ‏{‏iidhaa alssamaa'u anshaqqat‏}‏ fasajada faqultu lahu qaala sajadtu khalfa aabiy alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaa aazaalu aasjudu bihaa hattaa aalqaahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Rafi`:I offered the `Isha' prayer behind Abu Huraira and he recited, "Idha s-samaa'u n-shaqqat" (84) and prostrated. On my inquiring, he said, "I prostrated behind Abul-Qasim (the Prophet) (when he recited that Sura) and I will go on doing it till I meet him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَقَرَأَ فِي الْعِشَاءِ فِي إِحْدَى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بِالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyin, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana fiy safarin faqaraaa fiy al'ishaa'i fiy iihdaa alrrak'atayni bialttiyni waalzzaytuwni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) was on a journey and recited in one of the first two rak`at of the `Isha' prayer "Wa t-teeni wa z-zaitun
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ الْعَتَمَةَ فَقَرَأَ ‏{‏إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ‏}‏ فَسَجَدَ فَقُلْتُ مَا هَذِهِ قَالَ سَجَدْتُ بِهَا خَلْفَ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ أَزَالُ أَسْجُدُ بِهَا حَتَّى أَلْقَاهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, qaala haddathaniy alttaymiyyu, 'an bakrin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, qaala sallaytu ma'a aabiy hurayraaa al'atamaaa faqaraaa ‏{‏iidhaa alssamaa'u anshaqqat‏}‏ fasajada faqultu maa hadhihi qaala sajadtu bihaa khalfa aabiy alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaa aazaalu aasjudu bihaa hattaa aalqaahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Rafi`:Once I prayed the `Isha' prayer with Abu Huraira and he recited, "Idha s-samaa'u n-shaqqat" (84) and prostrated. I said, "What is that?" He said, "I prostrated behind Abul-Qasim, (the Prophet) (when he recited that Sura) and I will go on doing it till I meet him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلاَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، سَمِعَ الْبَرَاءَ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ ‏{‏وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ‏}‏ فِي الْعِشَاءِ، وَمَا سَمِعْتُ أَحَدًا أَحْسَنَ صَوْتًا مِنْهُ أَوْ قِرَاءَةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalaaadu bnu yahyaa, qaala haddathanaa mis'arun, qaala haddathanaa 'adiyyu bnu thaabitin, sami'a albaraa'a, rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau ‏{‏waalttiyni waalzzaytuwni‏}‏ fiy al'ishaa'i, wamaa sami'tu aahadana aahsana sawtana minhu aaw qiraa'aaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) reciting wa t-teeni wa z-zaitun" (95) in the `Isha' prayer, and I never heard a sweeter voice or a better way of recitation than that of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ لِسَعْدٍ لَقَدْ شَكَوْكَ فِي كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّى الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَمَّا أَنَا فَأَمُدُّ فِي الأُولَيَيْنِ، وَأَحْذِفُ فِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ، وَلاَ آلُو مَا اقْتَدَيْتُ بِهِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ صَدَقْتَ، ذَاكَ الظَّنُّ بِكَ، أَوْ ظَنِّي بِكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy 'awnin, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna samuraaa, qaala qaala 'umaru lisa'din laqad shakawka fiy kulli shaa'in hattaa alssalaaai‏.‏ qaala aammaa aanaa faaamuddu fiy alauwlayayni, waaahdhifu fiy alaukhrayayni, walaa aluw maa aqtadaytu bihi min salaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaala sadaqta, dhaaka alzzannu bika, aaw zanniy bika‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin Samura:`Umar said to Sa`d, "The people complained against you in everything, even in prayer." Sa`d replied, "Really I used to prolong the first two rak`at and shorten the last two and I will never shorten the prayer in which I follow Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." `Umar said, "You are telling the truth and that is what I think about you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارُ بْنُ سَلاَمَةَ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَأَبِي، عَلَى أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ فَسَأَلْنَاهُ عَنْ وَقْتِ الصَّلَوَاتِ، فَقَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ حِينَ تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ، وَالْعَصْرَ وَيَرْجِعُ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالشَّمْسُ حَيَّةٌ، وَنَسِيتُ مَا قَالَ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ، وَلاَ يُبَالِي بِتَأْخِيرِ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى ثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ وَلاَ يُحِبُّ النَّوْمَ قَبْلَهَا، وَلاَ الْحَدِيثَ بَعْدَهَا، وَيُصَلِّي الصُّبْحَ فَيَنْصَرِفُ الرَّجُلُ فَيَعْرِفُ جَلِيسَهُ، وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ أَوْ إِحْدَاهُمَا مَا بَيْنَ السِّتِّينَ إِلَى الْمِائَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathanaa sayyaaru bnu salaamaaa, qaala dakhaltu aanaa waaabiy, 'alaa aabiy barzaaa alaaslamiyyi fasaaalnaahu 'an waqti alssalawaati, faqaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy alzzuhra hiyna tazuwlu alshhamsu, waal'asra wayarji'u alrrajulu iilaa aaqsaa almadiynaai waalshhamsu hayyaaun, wanasiytu maa qaala fiy almaghribi, walaa yubaaliy bitaakhiyri al'ishaa'i iilaa thuluthi alllayli walaa yuhibbu alnnawma qablahaa, walaa alhadiytha ba'dahaa, wayusalliy alssubha fayansarifu alrrajulu faya'rifu jaliysahu, wakaana yaqraau fiy alrrak'atayni aaw iihdaahumaa maa bayna alssittiyna iilaa almiaiaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Saiyar bin Salama:My father and I went to Abu Barza-al-Aslami to ask him about the stated times for the prayers. He replied, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer the Zuhr prayer when the sun just declined from its highest position at noon; the `Asr at a time when if a man went to the farthest place in Medina (after praying) he would find the sun still hot (bright). (The sub narrator said: I have forgotten what Abu Barza said about the Maghrib prayer). The Prophet (ﷺ) never found any harm in delaying the `Isha' prayer to the first third of the night and he never liked to sleep before it and to talk after it. He used to offer the morning prayer at a time when after finishing it one could recognize the person sitting beside him and used to recite between 60 to 100 verses in one or both the rak`at
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ فِي كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ يُقْرَأُ، فَمَا أَسْمَعَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَسْمَعْنَاكُمْ، وَمَا أَخْفَى عَنَّا أَخْفَيْنَا عَنْكُمْ، وَإِنْ لَمْ تَزِدْ عَلَى أُمِّ الْقُرْآنِ أَجْزَأَتْ، وَإِنْ زِدْتَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh yaquwlu fiy kulli salaaain yuqraau, famaa aasma'anaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aasma'naakum, wamaa aakhfaa 'annaa aakhfaynaa 'ankum, waiin lam tazid 'alaa aummi alqurani aajzaaat, waiin zidta fahuwa khayrun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Qur'an is recited in every prayer and in those prayers in which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited aloud for us, we recite aloud in the same prayers for you; and the prayers in which the Prophet (ﷺ) recited quietly, we recite quietly. If you recite "Al-Fatiha" only it is sufficient but if you recite something else in addition, it is better
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ انْطَلَقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَائِفَةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ عَامِدِينَ إِلَى سُوقِ عُكَاظٍ، وَقَدْ حِيلَ بَيْنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ، وَأُرْسِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّهُبُ، فَرَجَعَتِ الشَّيَاطِينُ إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا مَا لَكُمْ فَقَالُوا حِيلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ، وَأُرْسِلَتْ عَلَيْنَا الشُّهُبُ‏.‏ قَالُوا مَا حَالَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ إِلاَّ شَىْءٌ حَدَثَ، فَاضْرِبُوا مَشَارِقَ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبَهَا، فَانْظُرُوا مَا هَذَا الَّذِي حَالَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ فَانْصَرَفَ أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ تَوَجَّهُوا نَحْوَ تِهَامَةَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ بِنَخْلَةَ، عَامِدِينَ إِلَى سُوقِ عُكَاظٍ وَهْوَ يُصَلِّي بِأَصْحَابِهِ صَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ، فَلَمَّا سَمِعُوا الْقُرْآنَ اسْتَمَعُوا لَهُ فَقَالُوا هَذَا وَاللَّهِ الَّذِي حَالَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ خَبَرِ السَّمَاءِ‏.‏ فَهُنَالِكَ حِينَ رَجَعُوا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ وَقَالُوا يَا قَوْمَنَا ‏{‏إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا * يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا‏}‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَىَّ‏}‏ وَإِنَّمَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْهِ قَوْلُ الْجِنِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala antalaqa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy taaiifaain min aashaabihi 'aamidiyna iilaa suwqi 'ukaazin, waqad hiyla bayna alshhayaatiyni wabayna khabari alssamaa'i, waaursilat 'alayhimu alshhuhubu, faraja'ati alshhayaatiynu iilaa qawmihim‏.‏ faqaaluwa maa lakum faqaaluwa hiyla baynanaa wabayna khabari alssamaa'i, waaursilat 'alaynaa alshhuhubu‏.‏ qaaluwa maa haala baynakum wabayna khabari alssamaa'i iilaaa shaa'un hadatha, faadribuwa mashaariqa alaardi wamaghaaribahaa, faanzuruwa maa hadhaa alladhiy haala baynakum wabayna khabari alssamaa'i faansarafa auwlaiika alladhiyna tawajjahuwa nahwa tihaamaaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa binakhlaaa, 'aamidiyna iilaa suwqi 'ukaazin wahwa yusalliy biaashaabihi salaaaa alfajri, falammaa sami'uwa alqurana astama'uwa lahu faqaaluwa hadhaa waalllahi alladhiy haala baynakum wabayna khabari alssamaa'i‏.‏ fahunaalika hiyna raja'uwa iilaa qawmihim waqaaluwa yaa qawmanaa ‏{‏iinnaa sami'naa quranana 'ajabana * yahdiy iilaa alrrushdi faamannaa bihi walan nushrika birabbinaa aahadana‏}‏ faaanzala alllahu 'alaa nabiyyihi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏qul auwhiya iilaaaa‏}‏ waiinnamaa auwhiya iilayhi qawlu aljinni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) set out with the intention of going to Suq `Ukaz (market of `Ukaz) along with some of his companions. At the same time, a barrier was put between the devils and the news of heaven. Fire commenced to be thrown at them. The Devils went to their people, who asked them, "What is wrong with you?" They said, "A barrier has been placed between us and the news of heaven. And fire has been thrown at us." They said, "The thing which has put a barrier between you and the news of heaven must be something which has happened recently. Go eastward and westward and see what has put a barrier between you and the news of heaven." Those who went towards Tihama came across the Prophet at a place called Nakhla and it was on the way to Suq `Ukaz and the Prophet (ﷺ) was offering the Fajr prayer with his companions. When they heard the Qur'an they listened to it and said, "By Allah, this is the thing which has put a barrier between us and the news of heaven." They went to their people and said, "O our people; verily we have heard a wonderful recital (Qur'an) which shows the true path; we believed in it and would not ascribe partners to our Lord." Allah revealed the following verses to his Prophet (Sura 'Jinn') (72): "Say: It has been revealed to me." And what was revealed to him was the conversation of the Jinns
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَرَأَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا أُمِرَ، وَسَكَتَ فِيمَا أُمِرَ ‏{‏وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا‏}‏ ‏{‏لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaraaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiymaa aumira, wasakata fiymaa aumira ‏{‏wamaa kaana rabbuka nasiyyana‏}‏ ‏{‏laqad kaana lakum fiy rasuwli alllahi auswaaun hasanaaun‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited aloud in the prayers in which he was ordered to do so and quietly in the prayers in which he was ordered to do so. "And your Lord is not forgetful." "Verily there was a good example for you in the ways of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَانَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ يَؤُمُّهُمْ فِي مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ، وَكَانَ كُلَّمَا افْتَتَحَ سُورَةً يَقْرَأُ بِهَا لَهُمْ فِي الصَّلاَةِ مِمَّا يَقْرَأُ بِهِ افْتَتَحَ بِ ـ ‏{‏قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ‏}‏ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْهَا، ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةً أُخْرَى مَعَهَا، وَكَانَ يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ، فَكَلَّمَهُ أَصْحَابُهُ فَقَالُوا إِنَّكَ تَفْتَتِحُ بِهَذِهِ السُّورَةِ، ثُمَّ لاَ تَرَى أَنَّهَا تُجْزِئُكَ حَتَّى تَقْرَأَ بِأُخْرَى، فَإِمَّا أَنْ تَقْرَأَ بِهَا وَإِمَّا أَنْ تَدَعَهَا وَتَقْرَأَ بِأُخْرَى‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَا أَنَا بِتَارِكِهَا، إِنْ أَحْبَبْتُمْ أَنْ أَؤُمَّكُمْ بِذَلِكَ فَعَلْتُ، وَإِنْ كَرِهْتُمْ تَرَكْتُكُمْ‏.‏ وَكَانُوا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُ مِنْ أَفْضَلِهِمْ، وَكَرِهُوا أَنْ يَؤُمَّهُمْ غَيْرُهُ، فَلَمَّا أَتَاهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرُوهُ الْخَبَرَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا فُلاَنُ مَا يَمْنَعُكَ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ مَا يَأْمُرُكَ بِهِ أَصْحَابُكَ وَمَا يَحْمِلُكَ عَلَى لُزُومِ هَذِهِ السُّورَةِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أُحِبُّهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ حُبُّكَ إِيَّاهَا أَدْخَلَكَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala 'ubaydu alllahi 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh kaana rajulun mina alaansaari yauummuhum fiy masjidi qubaa'in, wakaana kullamaa aftataha suwraaan yaqraau bihaa lahum fiy alssalaaai mimmaa yaqraau bihi aftataha bi ‏{‏qul huwa alllahu aahadun‏}‏ hattaa yafrugha minhaa, thumma yaqraau suwraaan aukhraa ma'ahaa, wakaana yasna'u dhalika fiy kulli rak'aain, fakallamahu aashaabuhu faqaaluwa iinnaka taftatihu bihadhihi alssuwraai, thumma laa taraa aannahaa tujziiuka hattaa taqraaa biaukhraa, faiimmaa aan taqraaa bihaa waiimmaa aan tada'ahaa wataqraaa biaukhraa‏.‏ faqaala maa aanaa bitaarikihaa, iin aahbabtum aan aauummakum bidhalika fa'altu, waiin karihtum taraktukum‏.‏ wakaanuwa yarawna aannahu min aafdalihim, wakarihuwa aan yauummahum ghayruhu, falammaa aataahumu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbaruwhu alkhabara faqaala ‏"‏ yaa fulaanu maa yamna'uka aan taf'ala maa yaamuruka bihi aashaabuka wamaa yahmiluka 'alaa luzuwmi hadhihi alssuwraai fiy kulli rak'aain ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala iinniy auhibbuhaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hubbuka iiyyaahaa aadkhalaka aljannaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas said:One of the Ansar used to lead the Ansar in Salat in the Quba' mosque and it was his habit to recite Qul Huwal-lahu Ahad whenever he wanted to recite something in Salat. When he finished that Surah, he would recite another one with it. He followed the same procedure in each Rak'a. His companions discussed this with him and said, "You recite this Surah and do not consider it sufficient and then you recite another. So would you recite it alone or leave it and recite some other." He said, "I will never leave it and if you want me to be your Imam on this condition then it is all right ; otherwise I will leave you." They knew that he was the best amongst them and they did not like someone else to lead them in Salat. When the Prophet (ﷺ) went to them as usual, they informed him about it. The Prophet (ﷺ) addressed him and said, "O so-and-so, what forbids you from doing what your companions ask you to do ? Why do you read this Surah particularly in every Rak'a?" He replied, "I love this Surah." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Your love for this Surah will make you enter Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فَقَالَ قَرَأْتُ الْمُفَصَّلَ اللَّيْلَةَ فِي رَكْعَةٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ هَذًّا كَهَذِّ الشِّعْرِ لَقَدْ عَرَفْتُ النَّظَائِرَ الَّتِي كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرِنُ بَيْنَهُنَّ فَذَكَرَ عِشْرِينَ سُورَةً مِنَ الْمُفَصَّلِ سُورَتَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa waaiilin, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa abni mas'uwdin faqaala qaraatu almufassala alllaylaaa fiy rak'aain‏.‏ faqaala hadhhana kahadhhi alshhi'ri laqad 'araftu alnnazaaiira allatiy kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqrinu baynahunna fadhakara 'ishriyna suwraaan mina almufassali suwratayni fiy kulli rak'aain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Wa'il:A man came to Ibn Mas`ud and said, "I recited the Mufassal (Suras) at night in one rak`a." Ibn Mas`ud said, "This recitation is (too quick) like the recitation of poetry. I know the identical Suras which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite in pairs." Ibn Mas`ud then mentioned 20 Mufassal Suras including two Suras from the family of (i.e. those verses which begin with) Ha, Meem [??] (which the Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite) in each rak`a
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الظُّهْرِ فِي الأُولَيَيْنِ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ وَسُورَتَيْنِ، وَفِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأُخْرَيَيْنِ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ، وَيُسْمِعُنَا الآيَةَ، وَيُطَوِّلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الأُولَى مَا لاَ يُطَوِّلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ، وَهَكَذَا فِي الْعَصْرِ وَهَكَذَا فِي الصُّبْحِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an yahyaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau fiy alzzuhri fiy alauwlayayni biaummi alkitaabi wasuwratayni, wafiy alrrak'atayni alaukhrayayni biaummi alkitaabi, wayusmi'unaa alayaaa, wayutawwilu fiy alrrak'aai alauwlaa maa laa yutawwilu fiy alrrak'aai althhaaniyaai, wahakadhaa fiy al'asri wahakadhaa fiy alssubhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) uses to recite Al-Fatiha followed by another Sura in the first two rak`at of the prayer and used to recite only Al-Fatiha in the last two rak`at of the Zuhr prayer. Sometimes a verse or so was audible and he used to prolong the first rak`a more than the second and used to do the same in the `Asr and Fajr prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، قُلْتُ لِخَبَّابٍ أَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قُلْنَا مِنْ أَيْنَ عَلِمْتَ قَالَ بِاضْطِرَابِ لِحْيَتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'umaaraaa bni 'umayrin, 'an aabiy ma'marin, qultu likhabbaabin aakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy alzzuhri waal'asri qaala na'am‏.‏ qulnaa min aayna 'alimta qaala biadtiraabi lihyatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Ma`mar:We said to Khabbab "Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to recite in Zuhr and `Asr prayers?" He replied in the affirmative. We said, "How did you come to know about it?" He said, "By the movement of his beard
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقْرَأُ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ وَسُورَةٍ مَعَهَا فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الأُولَيَيْنِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ وَصَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ، وَيُسْمِعُنَا الآيَةَ أَحْيَانًا، وَكَانَ يُطِيلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الأُولَى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathaniy yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaqraau biaummi alkitaabi wasuwraain ma'ahaa fiy alrrak'atayni alauwlayayni min salaaai alzzuhri wasalaaai al'asri, wayusmi'unaa alayaaa aahyaanana, wakaana yutiylu fiy alrrak'aai alauwlaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite Al-Fatiha along with another Sura in the first two rak`at of the Zuhr and `Asr prayers. A verse or so was audible at times and he used to prolong the first rak`a
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُطَوِّلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الأُولَى مِنْ صَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ، وَيُقَصِّرُ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ، وَيَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ فِي صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yutawwilu fiy alrrak'aai alauwlaa min salaaai alzzuhri, wayuqassiru fiy althhaaniyaai, wayaf'alu dhalika fiy salaaai alssubhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to prolong the first rak`a of the Zuhr prayer and shorten the second one and used to do the same in the Fajr prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبِي، سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّهُمَا أَخْبَرَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَمَّنَ الإِمَامُ فَأَمِّنُوا فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ وَافَقَ تَأْمِينُهُ تَأْمِينَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ آمِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, waaabiy, salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani aannahumaa aakhbaraahu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa aammana aliimaamu faaamminuwa faiinnahu man waafaqa taamiynuhu taamiyna almalaaiikaai ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala abnu shihaabin wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ amiyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Say Amin" when the Imam says it and if the Amin of any one of you coincides with that of the angels then all his past sins will be forgiven." Ibn Shihab said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to Say "Amin
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَالَ أَحَدُكُمْ آمِينَ‏.‏ وَقَالَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ فِي السَّمَاءِ آمِينَ‏.‏ فَوَافَقَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الأُخْرَى، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa qaala aahadukum amiyna‏.‏ waqaalati almalaaiikaau fiy alssamaa'i amiyna‏.‏ fawaafaqat iihdaahumaa alaukhraa, ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If any one of you says, "Amin" and the angels in the heavens say "Amin" and the former coincides with the latter, all his past sins will be forgiven
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا قَالَ الإِمَامُ ‏{‏غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ الضَّالِّينَ‏}‏ فَقُولُوا آمِينَ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ وَافَقَ قَوْلُهُ قَوْلَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنُعَيْمٌ الْمُجْمِرُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضى الله عنه‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an sumaaain, mawlaa aabiy bakrin 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa qaala aliimaamu ‏{‏ghayri almaghduwbi 'alayhim walaa alddaalliyna‏}‏ faquwluwa amiyna‏.‏ faiinnahu man waafaqa qawluhu qawla almalaaiikaai ghufira lahu maa taqaddama min dhanbihi ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu muhammadu bnu 'amrinw 'an aabiy salamaaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanu'aymun almujmiru 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Say Amen when the Imam says 'Ghairi l-maghdubi `alaihim wala d-daalleen' (not the path of those who earn Your Anger (such as Jews) nor of those who go astray (such as Christians)); all the past sins of the person whose saying (of Amin) coincides with that of the angels, will be forgiven
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنِ الأَعْلَمِ ـ وَهْوَ زِيَادٌ ـ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ انْتَهَى إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ رَاكِعٌ، فَرَكَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَصِلَ إِلَى الصَّفِّ، فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ زَادَكَ اللَّهُ حِرْصًا وَلاَ تَعُدْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa hammaamun, 'ani alaa'lami wahwa ziyaadun 'ani alhasani, 'an aabiy bakraaa, aannahu antahaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa raaki'un, faraka'a qabla aan yasila iilaa alssaffi, fadhakara dhalika lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ zaadaka alllahu hirsana walaa ta'ud ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakra:I reached the Prophet (ﷺ) in the mosque while he was bowing in prayer and I too bowed before joining the row. I mentioned it to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said to me, "May Allah increase your love for the good. But do not repeat it again (bowing in that way)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى مَعَ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ بِالْبَصْرَةِ فَقَالَ ذَكَّرَنَا هَذَا الرَّجُلُ صَلاَةً كُنَّا نُصَلِّيهَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَفَعَ وَكُلَّمَا وَضَعَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu alwaasitiyyu, qaala haddathanaa khaalidun, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy al'alaa'i, 'an mutarrifin, 'an 'imraana bni husaynin, qaala sallaa ma'a 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh bialbasraai faqaala dhakkaranaa hadhaa alrrajulu salaaaan kunnaa nusalliyhaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ fadhakara aannahu kaana yukabbiru kullamaa rafa'a wakullamaa wada'a‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Imran bin Husain:I offered the prayer with `Ali in Basra and he made us remember the prayer which we used to pray with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). `Ali said Takbir on each rising and bowing
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ، فَيُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا خَفَضَ وَرَفَعَ، فَإِذَا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ إِنِّي لأَشْبَهُكُمْ صَلاَةً بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu kaana yusalliy bihim, fayukabbiru kullamaa khafada warafa'a, faiidhaa ansarafa qaala iinniy laashbahukum salaaaan birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Salama:When Abu Huraira led us in prayer he used to say Takbir on each bowing and rising. On the completion of the prayer he used to say, "My prayer is more similar to the prayer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) than that of anyone of you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ غَيْلاَنَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَا وَعِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُصَيْنٍ،، فَكَانَ إِذَا سَجَدَ كَبَّرَ، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ كَبَّرَ، وَإِذَا نَهَضَ مِنَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ كَبَّرَ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلاَةَ أَخَذَ بِيَدِي عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُصَيْنٍ فَقَالَ قَدْ ذَكَّرَنِي هَذَا صَلاَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ لَقَدْ صَلَّى بِنَا صَلاَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, qaala haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an ghaylaana bni jariyrin, 'an mutarrifi bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala sallaytu khalfa 'aliyyi bni aabiy taalibin rda allh 'nh aanaa wa'imraanu bnu husaynin, , fakaana iidhaa sajada kabbara, waiidhaa rafa'a raasahu kabbara, waiidhaa nahada mina alrrak'atayni kabbara, falammaa qadaa alssalaaaa aakhadha biyadiy 'imraanu bnu husaynin faqaala qad dhakkaraniy hadhaa salaaaa muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ aaw qaala laqad sallaa binaa salaaaa muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mutarrif bin `Abdullah:`Imran bin Husain and I offered the prayer behind `Ali bin Abi Talib. When `Ali prostrated, he said the Takbir, when he raised his head, he said the Takbir and when he got up for the third rak`a he said the Takbir. On completion of the prayer `Imran took my hand and said, "This (i.e. `Ali) made me remember the prayer of Muhammad" Or he said, "He led us in a prayer like that of Muhammad
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَجُلاً عِنْدَ الْمَقَامِ يُكَبِّرُ فِي كُلِّ خَفْضٍ وَرَفْعٍ وَإِذَا قَامَ وَإِذَا وَضَعَ، فَأَخْبَرْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَوَلَيْسَ تِلْكَ صَلاَةَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ أُمَّ لَكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'awnin, qaala haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, qaala raaaytu rajulaan 'inda almaqaami yukabbiru fiy kulli khafdin waraf'in waiidhaa qaama waiidhaa wada'a, faaakhbartu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nh qaala aawalaysa tilka salaaaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa aumma laka‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ikrima:I saw a person praying at Muqam-Ibrahim (the place of Abraham by the Ka`ba) and he was saying Takbir on every bowing, rising, standing and sitting. I asked Ibn `Abbas (about this prayer). He admonished me saying: "Isn't that the prayer of the Prophet?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ شَيْخٍ بِمَكَّةَ فَكَبَّرَ ثِنْتَيْنِ وَعِشْرِينَ تَكْبِيرَةً، فَقُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِنَّهُ أَحْمَقُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ثَكِلَتْكَ أُمُّكَ، سُنَّةُ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala aakhbaranaa hammaamun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'ikrimaaa, qaala sallaytu khalfa shaykhin bimakkaaa fakabbara thintayni wa'ishriyna takbiyraaan, faqultu laibni 'abbaasin iinnahu aahmaqu‏.‏ faqaala thakilatka aummuka, sunnaau aabiy alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala muwsaa haddathanaa aabaanu haddathanaa qataadaau haddathanaa 'ikrimaau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ikrima:I prayed behind a Sheikh at Mecca and he said twenty two Takbirs (during the prayer). I told Ibn `Abbas that he (i.e. that Sheikh) was foolish. Ibn `Abbas admonished me and said, "This is the tradition of Abul-Qasim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ يُكَبِّرُ حِينَ يَقُومُ، ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ حِينَ يَرْكَعُ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لَمِنْ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ حِينَ يَرْفَعُ صُلْبَهُ مِنَ الرَّكْعَةِ، ثُمَّ يَقُولُ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ ـ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ‏{‏بْنُ صَالِحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ‏}‏ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ ـ ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ حِينَ يَهْوِي، ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ حِينَ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ، ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ حِينَ يَسْجُدُ، ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ حِينَ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ، ثُمَّ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ كُلِّهَا حَتَّى يَقْضِيَهَا، وَيُكَبِّرُ حِينَ يَقُومُ مِنَ الثِّنْتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْجُلُوسِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw bakri bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni alhaarithi, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qaama iilaa alssalaaai yukabbiru hiyna yaquwmu, thumma yukabbiru hiyna yarka'u, thumma yaquwlu sami'a alllahu lamin hamidahu‏.‏ hiyna yarfa'u sulbahu mina alrrak'aai, thumma yaquwlu wahuwa qaaiimun rabbanaa laka alhamdu qaala 'abdu alllahi ‏{‏bnu saalihin 'ani alllaythi‏}‏ walaka alhamdu thumma yukabbiru hiyna yahwiy, thumma yukabbiru hiyna yarfa'u raasahu, thumma yukabbiru hiyna yasjudu, thumma yukabbiru hiyna yarfa'u raasahu, thumma yaf'alu dhalika fiy alssalaaai kullihaa hattaa yaqdiyahaa, wayukabbiru hiyna yaquwmu mina althhintayni ba'da aljuluwsi‏.‏
verses.translation: And narrated Abu Huraira:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood for the prayer, he said Takbir on starting the prayer and then on bowing. On rising from bowing he said, "Sami`a llahu liman hamidah," and then while standing straight he used to say, "Rabbana laka-l hamd" (Al- Laith said, "(The Prophet (ﷺ) said), 'Wa laka l-hamd'." He used to say Takbir on prostrating and on raising his head from prostration; again he would Say Takbir on prostrating and raising his head. He would then do the same in the whole of the prayer till it was completed. On rising from the second rak`a (after sitting for at-Tahiyyat), he used to say Takbir
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُصْعَبَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، يَقُولُ صَلَّيْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِ أَبِي فَطَبَّقْتُ بَيْنَ كَفَّىَّ ثُمَّ وَضَعْتُهُمَا بَيْنَ فَخِذَىَّ، فَنَهَانِي أَبِي وَقَالَ كُنَّا نَفْعَلُهُ فَنُهِينَا عَنْهُ، وَأُمِرْنَا أَنْ نَضَعَ أَيْدِيَنَا عَلَى الرُّكَبِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy ya'fuwrin, qaala sami'tu mus'aba bna sa'din, yaquwlu sallaytu iilaa janbi aabiy fatabbaqtu bayna kaffaaaa thumma wada'tuhumaa bayna fakhidhaaaa, fanahaaniy aabiy waqaala kunnaa naf'aluhu fanuhiynaa 'anhu, waaumirnaa aan nada'a aaydiyanaa 'alaa alrrukabi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mus`ab bin Sa`d:I offered prayer beside my father and approximated both my hands and placed them in between the knees. My father told me not to do so and said, "We used to do the same but we were forbidden (by the Prophet) to do it and were ordered to place the hands on the knees
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ رَأَى حُذَيْفَةُ رَجُلاً لاَ يُتِمُّ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ قَالَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ، وَلَوْ مُتَّ مُتَّ عَلَى غَيْرِ الْفِطْرَةِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu zayda bna wahbin, qaala raaaa hudhayfaau rajulaan laa yutimmu alrrukuw'a waalssujuwda qaala maa sallayta, walaw mutta mutta 'alaa ghayri alfitraai allatiy fatara alllahu muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Wahb:Hudhaifa saw a person who was not performing the bowing and prostration perfectly. He said to him, "You have not prayed and if you should die you would die on a religion other than that of Muhammad
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بَدَلُ بْنُ الْمُحَبَّرِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَكَمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ كَانَ رُكُوعُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسُجُودُهُ وَبَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ، مَا خَلاَ الْقِيَامَ وَالْقُعُودَ، قَرِيبًا مِنَ السَّوَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa badalu bnu almuhabbari, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy alhakamu, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala kaana rukuw'u alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasujuwduhu wabayna alssajdatayni waiidhaa rafa'a mina alrrukuw'i, maa khalaa alqiyaama waalqu'uwda, qariybana mina alssawaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The bowing, the prostration the sitting in between the two prostrations and the standing after the bowing of the Prophet (ﷺ) but not qiyam (standing in the prayer) and qu`ud (sitting in the prayer) used to be approximately equal (in duration)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَدَخَلَ رَجُلٌ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَدَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْجِعْ فَصَلِّ فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ ‏"‏ فَصَلَّى، ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْجِعْ فَصَلِّ فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَمَا أُحْسِنُ غَيْرَهُ فَعَلِّمْنِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا قُمْتَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَكَبِّرْ، ثُمَّ اقْرَأْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، ثُمَّ ارْكَعْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ رَاكِعًا، ثُمَّ ارْفَعْ حَتَّى تَعْتَدِلَ قَائِمًا، ثُمَّ اسْجُدْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ سَاجِدًا، ثُمَّ ارْفَعْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ جَالِسًا، ثُمَّ اسْجُدْ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ سَاجِدًا، ثُمَّ افْعَلْ ذَلِكَ فِي صَلاَتِكَ كُلِّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala aakhbaraniy yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa sa'iydun almaqburiyyu, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala almasjida fadakhala rajulun fasallaa thumma jaa'a fasallama 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faradda alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alayhi alssalaama faqaala ‏"‏ arji' fasalli faiinnaka lam tusalli ‏"‏ fasallaa, thumma jaa'a fasallama 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ arji' fasalli faiinnaka lam tusalli ‏"‏‏.‏ thalaathana‏.‏ faqaala waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi famaa auhsinu ghayrahu fa'allimniy‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa qumta iilaa alssalaaai fakabbir, thumma aqraa maa tayassara ma'aka mina alqurani, thumma arka' hattaa tatmaiinna raaki'ana, thumma arfa' hattaa ta'tadila qaaiimana, thumma asjud hattaa tatmaiinna saajidana, thumma arfa' hattaa tatmaiinna jaalisana, thumma asjud hattaa tatmaiinna saajidana, thumma af'al dhalika fiy salaatika kullihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) entered the mosque, a man came in, offered the prayer and greeted the Prophet. The Prophet returned his greeting and said to him, "Go back and pray again for you have not prayed." The man offered the prayer again, came back and greeted the Prophet. He said to him thrice, "Go back and pray again for you have not prayed." The man said, "By Him Who has sent you with the truth! I do not know a better way of praying. Kindly teach Me how to pray." He said, "When you stand for the prayer, say Takbir and then recite from the Qur'an what you know and then bow with calmness till you feel at ease, then rise from bowing till you stand straight.
