verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy mahmuwdu bnu alrrabiy'i, , waza'ama, aannahu 'aqala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'aqala majjaaan majjahaa min dalwin kaana fiy daarihim‏.‏ qaala sami'tu 'itbaana bna maalikin alaansaariyya, thumma aahada baniy saalimin qaala kuntu ausalliy liqawmiy baniy saalimin, faaataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu iinniy aankartu basariy, waiinna alssuyuwla tahuwlu bayniy wabayna masjidi qawmiy, falawadidtu aannaka jiita fasallayta fiy baytiy makaanana, hattaa aattakhidhahu masjidana faqaala ‏"‏ aaf'alu iin shaa'a alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏ faghadaa 'alaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin ma'ahu ba'da maa ashtadda alnnahaaru, faastaadhana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaadhintu lahu, falam yajlis hattaa qaala ‏"‏ aayna tuhibbu aan ausalliya min baytika ‏"‏‏.‏ faaashaara iilayhi mina almakaani alladhiy aahabba aan yusalliya fiyhi, faqaama fasafafnaa khalfahu thumma sallama, wasallamnaa hiyna sallama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mahmud bin Ar-Rabi`:I remember Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and also the mouthful of water which he took from a bucket in our house and ejected (on me). I heard from `Itban bin Malik Al-Ansari, who was one from Bani Salim, saying, "I used to lead my tribe of Bani Salim in prayer. Once I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said to him, 'I have weak eyesight and at times the rainwater flood intervenes between me and the mosque of my tribe and I wish that you would come to my house and pray at some place so that I could take that place as a place for praying (mosque). He said, "Allah willing, I shall do that." Next day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with Abu Bakr, came to my house after the sun had risen high and he asked permission to enter. I gave him permission, but he didn't sit till he said to me, "Where do you want me to pray in your house?" I pointed to a place in the house where I wanted him to pray. So he stood up for the prayer and we aligned behind him. He completed the prayer with Taslim and we did the same simultaneously
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ أَبَا مَعْبَدٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَفْعَ الصَّوْتِ بِالذِّكْرِ حِينَ يَنْصَرِفُ النَّاسُ مِنَ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ كَانَ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ إِذَا انْصَرَفُوا بِذَلِكَ إِذَا سَمِعْتُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu nasrin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaala aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, aanna aabaa ma'badin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin aakhbarahu aanna abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahu aanna raf'a alssawti bialdhhikri hiyna yansarifu alnnaasu mina almaktuwbaai kaana 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala abnu 'abbaasin kuntu aa'lamu iidhaa ansarafuwa bidhalika iidhaa sami'tuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Ma`bad:(the freed slave of Ibn `Abbas) Ibn `Abbas told me, "In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) it was the custom to celebrate Allah's praises aloud after the compulsory congregational prayers." Ibn `Abbas further said, "When I heard the Dhikr, I would learn that the compulsory congregational prayer had ended
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ‏{‏عَنْ عَمْرٍو،‏}‏ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو مَعْبَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَعْرِفُ انْقِضَاءَ صَلاَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالتَّكْبِيرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, ‏{‏'an 'amrinw, ‏}‏ qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw ma'badin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kuntu aa'rifu anqidaa'a salaaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialttakbiyri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I used to recognize the completion of the prayer of the Prophet (ﷺ) by hearing Takbir
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا ذَهَبَ أَهْلُ الدُّثُورِ مِنَ الأَمْوَالِ بِالدَّرَجَاتِ الْعُلاَ وَالنَّعِيمِ الْمُقِيمِ، يُصَلُّونَ كَمَا نُصَلِّي، وَيَصُومُونَ كَمَا نَصُومُ، وَلَهُمْ فَضْلٌ مِنْ أَمْوَالٍ يَحُجُّونَ بِهَا، وَيَعْتَمِرُونَ، وَيُجَاهِدُونَ، وَيَتَصَدَّقُونَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُحَدِّثُكُمْ بِأَمْرٍ إِنْ أَخَذْتُمْ بِهِ أَدْرَكْتُمْ مَنْ سَبَقَكُمْ وَلَمْ يُدْرِكْكُمْ أَحَدٌ بَعْدَكُمْ، وَكُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ مَنْ أَنْتُمْ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَانَيْهِ، إِلاَّ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِثْلَهُ تُسَبِّحُونَ وَتَحْمَدُونَ، وَتُكَبِّرُونَ خَلْفَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَاخْتَلَفْنَا بَيْنَنَا فَقَالَ بَعْضُنَا نُسَبِّحُ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَنَحْمَدُ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَنُكَبِّرُ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلاَثِينَ‏.‏ فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَقُولُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، حَتَّى يَكُونَ مِنْهُنَّ كُلِّهِنَّ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin, qaala haddathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an sumaaain, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala jaa'a alfuqaraa'u iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa dhahaba aahlu aldduthuwri mina alaamwaali bialddarajaati al'ulaa waalnna'iymi almuqiymi, yusalluwna kamaa nusalliy, wayasuwmuwna kamaa nasuwmu, walahum fadlun min aamwaalin yahujjuwna bihaa, waya'tamiruwna, wayujaahiduwna, wayatasaddaquwna qaala ‏"‏ aalaa auhaddithukum biaamrin iin aakhadhtum bihi aadraktum man sabaqakum walam yudrikkum aahadun ba'dakum, wakuntum khayra man aantum bayna zahraanayhi, iilaaa man 'amila mithlahu tusabbihuwna watahmaduwna, watukabbiruwna khalfa kulli salaaain thalaathana wathalaathiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ faakhtalafnaa baynanaa faqaala ba'dunaa nusabbihu thalaathana wathalaathiyna, wanahmadu thalaathana wathalaathiyna, wanukabbiru aarba'ana wathalaathiyna‏.‏ faraja'tu iilayhi faqaala ‏"‏ taquwlu subhaana alllahi, waalhamdu lillahi, waalllahu aakbaru, hattaa yakuwna minhunna kullihinna thalaathana wathalaathiyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Some poor people came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "The wealthy people will get higher grades and will have permanent enjoyment and they pray like us and fast as we do. They have more money by which they perform the Hajj, and `Umra; fight and struggle in Allah's Cause and give in charity." The Prophet said, "Shall I not tell you a thing upon which if you acted you would catch up with those who have surpassed you? Nobody would overtake you and you would be better than the people amongst whom you live except those who would do the same. Say "Subhana l-lah", "Al hamdu li l-lah" and "Allahu Akbar" thirty three times each after every (compulsory) prayer." We differed and some of us said that we should say, "Subhan-al-lah" thirty three times and "Al hamdu li l-lah" thirty three times and "Allahu Akbar" thirty four times. I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) who said, "Say, "Subhan-al-lah" and "Al hamdu li l-lah" and "Allahu Akbar" all together [??], thirty three times
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، كَاتِبِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ أَمْلَى عَلَىَّ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ فِي كِتَابٍ إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهْوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بِهَذَا، وَعَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُخَيْمِرَةَ عَنْ وَرَّادٍ بِهَذَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ الْجَدُّ غِنًى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an warraadin, kaatibi almughiyraai bni shu'baaa qaala aamlaa 'alaaaa almughiyraau bnu shu'baaa fiy kitaabin iilaa mu'aawiyaaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu fiy duburi kulli salaaain maktuwbaain ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu, lahu almulku, walahu alhamdu, wahwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun, alllahumma laa maani'a limaa aa'tayta, walaa mu'tiya limaa mana'ta, walaa yanfa'u dhaa aljaddi minka aljaddu ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala shu'baau 'an 'abdi almaliki bihadhaa, wa'ani alhakami 'ani alqaasimi bni mukhaymiraaa 'an warraadin bihadhaa‏.‏ waqaala alhasanu aljaddu ghinana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Warrad:(the clerk of Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba) Once Al-Mughira dictated to me in a letter addressed to Muawiya that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say after every compulsory prayer, "La ilaha illa l-lahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu, wa huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani`a lima a`taita, wa la mu`tiya lima mana`ta, wa la yanfa`u dhal-jaddi minka l-jadd. [There is no Deity but Allah, Alone, no Partner to Him. His is the Kingdom and all praise, and Omnipotent is He. O Allah! Nobody can hold back what you gave, nobody can give what You held back, and no struggler's effort can benefit against You]." And Al-Hasan said, "Al-jadd' means prosperity [??]
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا صَلَّى صَلاَةً أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, qaala haddathanaa aabuw rajaa'in, 'an samuraaa bni jundubin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sallaa salaaaan aaqbala 'alaynaa biwajhihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Samura bin Jundub:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to face us on completion of the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ صَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الصُّبْحِ بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ عَلَى إِثْرِ سَمَاءٍ كَانَتْ مِنَ اللَّيْلَةِ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَدْرُونَ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَصْبَحَ مِنْ عِبَادِي مُؤْمِنٌ بِي وَكَافِرٌ، فَأَمَّا مَنْ قَالَ مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ فَذَلِكَ مُؤْمِنٌ بِي وَكَافِرٌ بِالْكَوْكَبِ، وَأَمَّا مَنْ قَالَ بِنَوْءِ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَذَلِكَ كَافِرٌ بِي وَمُؤْمِنٌ بِالْكَوْكَبِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, 'an zaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi, aannahu qaala sallaa lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaaa alssubhi bialhudaybiyaai 'alaa iithri samaa'in kaanat mina alllaylaai, falammaa ansarafa aaqbala 'alaa alnnaasi faqaala ‏"‏ hal tadruwna maadhaa qaala rabbukum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aasbaha min 'ibaadiy muuminun biy wakaafirun, faaammaa man qaala mutirnaa bifadli alllahi warahmatihi fadhalika muuminun biy wakaafirun bialkawkabi, waaammaa man qaala binaw'i kadhaa wakadhaa fadhalika kaafirun biy wamuuminun bialkawkabi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:The Prophet (ﷺ) led us in the Fajr prayer at Hudaibiya after a rainy night. On completion of the prayer, he faced the people and said, "Do you know what your Lord has said (revealed)?" The people replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, "Allah has said, 'In this morning some of my slaves remained as true believers and some became non-believers; whoever said that the rain was due to the Blessings and the Mercy of Allah had belief in Me and he disbelieves in the stars, and whoever said that it rained because of a particular star had no belief in Me but believes in that star
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، سَمِعَ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ أَخَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلاَةَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ إِلَى شَطْرِ اللَّيْلِ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا، فَلَمَّا صَلَّى أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ صَلَّوْا وَرَقَدُوا، وَإِنَّكُمْ لَنْ تَزَالُوا فِي صَلاَةٍ مَا انْتَظَرْتُمُ الصَّلاَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, sami'a yaziyda, qaala aakhbaranaa humaydun, 'an aanasin, qaala aakhhara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alssalaaaa dhaata laylaain iilaa shatri alllayli thumma kharaja 'alaynaa, falammaa sallaa aaqbala 'alaynaa biwajhihi faqaala ‏ "‏ iinna alnnaasa qad sallawa waraqaduwa, waiinnakum lan tazaaluwa fiy salaaain maa antazartumu alssalaaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer until midnight and then came to us. Having prayed he faced us and said, "The people had prayed and slept but you were in the prayer as long as you were waiting for it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ لَنَا آدَمُ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يُصَلِّي فِي مَكَانِهِ الَّذِي صَلَّى فِيهِ الْفَرِيضَةَ‏.‏ وَفَعَلَهُ الْقَاسِمُ‏.‏ وَيُذْكَرُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَفَعَهُ لاَ يَتَطَوَّعُ الإِمَامُ فِي مَكَانِهِ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَصِحَّ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala lanaa adamu haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, qaala kaana abnu 'umara yusalliy fiy makaanihi alladhiy sallaa fiyhi alfariydaaa‏.‏ wafa'alahu alqaasimu‏.‏ wayudhkaru 'an aabiy hurayraaa rafa'ahu laa yatatawwa'u aliimaamu fiy makaanihi‏.‏ walam yasihha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi:Ibn Umar used to offer prayers (Nawafil) at the place where he had offered the compulsory prayer. Al-Qasim (bin Muhammad bin Abi Bakr) did the same. The narration coming from Abu Hurairah (from the Prophet (ﷺ)) forbidding the Imam from offering prayers (optional prayer) at the same place where he was offered the compulsory prayer is incorrect
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ هِنْدٍ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا سَلَّمَ يَمْكُثُ فِي مَكَانِهِ يَسِيرًا‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَنُرَى ـ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ ـ لِكَىْ يَنْفُذَ مَنْ يَنْصَرِفُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ أَخْبَرَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي هِنْدُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ الْفِرَاسِيَّةُ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَتْ مِنْ صَوَاحِبَاتِهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ يُسَلِّمُ فَيَنْصَرِفُ النِّسَاءُ، فَيَدْخُلْنَ بُيُوتَهُنَّ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَنْصَرِفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَتْنِي هِنْدُ الْفِرَاسِيَّةُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ حَدَّثَتْنِي هِنْدُ الْفِرَاسِيَّةُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الزُّبَيْدِيُّ أَخْبَرَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ أَنَّ هِنْدَ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ الْقُرَشِيَّةَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ، وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ الْمِقْدَادِ ـ وَهْوَ حَلِيفُ بَنِي زُهْرَةَ ـ وَكَانَتْ تَدْخُلُ عَلَى أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ شُعَيْبٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ حَدَّثَتْنِي هِنْدُ الْقُرَشِيَّةُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ هِنْدٍ الْفِرَاسِيَّةِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ حَدَّثَتْهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an hindin binti alhaarithi, 'an aummi salamaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa sallama yamkuthu fiy makaanihi yasiyrana‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin fanuraa waalllahu aa'lamu likaa yanfudha man yansarifu mina alnnisaa'i‏.‏ waqaala abnu aabiy maryama aakhbaranaa naafi'u bnu yaziyda, qaala aakhbaraniy ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, aanna abna shihaabin, kataba iilayhi qaala haddathatniy hindu bintu alhaarithi alfiraasiyyaau, 'an aummi salamaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaanat min sawaahibaatihaa qaalat kaana yusallimu fayansarifu alnnisaa'u, fayadkhulna buyuwtahunna min qabli aan yansarifa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala abnu wahbin 'an yuwnusa 'ani abni shihaabin aakhbaratniy hindu alfiraasiyyaau‏.‏ waqaala 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara aakhbaranaa yuwnusu 'ani alzzuhriyyi haddathatniy hindu alfiraasiyyaau‏.‏ waqaala alzzubaydiyyu aakhbaraniy alzzuhriyyu aanna hinda binta alhaarithi alqurashiyyaaa aakhbarathu, wakaanat tahta ma'badi bni almiqdaadi wahwa haliyfu baniy zuhraaa wakaanat tadkhulu 'alaa aazwaaji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala shu'aybun 'ani alzzuhriyyi haddathatniy hindu alqurashiyyaau‏.‏ waqaala abnu aabiy 'atiyqin 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an hindin alfiraasiyyaai‏.‏ waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy yahyaa bnu sa'iydin haddathahu 'ani abni shihaabin 'ani amraaaain min qurayshin haddathathu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:"The Prophet (ﷺ) after finishing the prayer with Taslim used to stay at his place for a while." Ibn Shihab said, "I think (and Allah knows better), that he used to wait for the departure of the women who had prayed." Ibn Shihab wrote that he had heard it from Hind bint Al-Harith Al-Firasiya from Um Salama, the wife of the Prophet (Hind was from the companions of Um Salama) who said, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) finished the prayer with Taslim, the women would depart and enter their houses before Allah's Apostle departed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ وَرَاءَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمَدِينَةِ الْعَصْرَ فَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ قَامَ مُسْرِعًا، فَتَخَطَّى رِقَابَ النَّاسِ إِلَى بَعْضِ حُجَرِ نِسَائِهِ، فَفَزِعَ النَّاسُ مِنْ سُرْعَتِهِ فَخَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَرَأَى أَنَّهُمْ عَجِبُوا مِنْ سُرْعَتِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ ذَكَرْتُ شَيْئًا مِنْ تِبْرٍ عِنْدَنَا فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ يَحْبِسَنِي، فَأَمَرْتُ بِقِسْمَتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydin, qaala haddathanaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, 'an 'umara bni sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu aabiy mulaykaaa, 'an 'uqbaaa, qaala sallaytu waraa'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialmadiynaai al'asra fasallama thumma qaama musri'ana, fatakhattaa riqaaba alnnaasi iilaa ba'di hujari nisaaiihi, fafazi'a alnnaasu min sur'atihi fakharaja 'alayhim, faraaaa aannahum 'ajibuwa min sur'atihi faqaala ‏ "‏ dhakartu shayiana min tibrin 'indanaa fakarihtu aan yahbisaniy, faaamartu biqismatihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Uqba:I offered the `Asr prayer behind the Prophet (ﷺ) at Medina. When he had finished the prayer with Taslim, he got up hurriedly and went out by crossing the rows of the people to one of the dwellings of his wives. The people got scared at his speed . The Prophet (ﷺ) came back and found the people surprised at his haste and said to them, "I remembered a piece of gold Lying in my house and I did not like it to divert my attention from Allah's worship, so I have ordered it to be distributed (in charity)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لاَ يَجْعَلْ أَحَدُكُمْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ شَيْئًا مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ، يَرَى أَنَّ حَقًّا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ لاَ يَنْصَرِفَ إِلاَّ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَثِيرًا يَنْصَرِفُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sulaymaana, 'an 'umaaraaa bni 'umayrin, 'ani alaaswadi, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi laa yaj'al aahadukum lilshhaytaani shayiana min salaatihi, yaraa aanna haqqana 'alayhi aan laa yansarifa iilaaa 'an yamiynihi, laqad raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kathiyrana yansarifu 'an yasaarihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:You should not give away a part of your prayer to Satan by thinking that it is necessary to depart (after finishing the prayer) from one's right side only; I have seen the Prophet (ﷺ) often leave from the left side
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي غَزْوَةِ خَيْبَرَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ ـ يَعْنِي الثُّومَ ـ فَلاَ يَقْرَبَنَّ مَسْجِدَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fiy ghazwaai khaybara ‏ "‏ man aakala min hadhihi alshhajaraai ya'niy althhuwma falaa yaqrabanna masjidanaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During the holy battle of Khaibar the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever ate from this plant (i.e. garlic) should not enter our mosque
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ ـ يُرِيدُ الثُّومَ ـ فَلاَ يَغْشَانَا فِي مَسَاجِدِنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ مَا يَعْنِي بِهِ قَالَ مَا أُرَاهُ يَعْنِي إِلاَّ نِيئَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مَخْلَدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ إِلاَّ نَتْنَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa 'abdu allaahi bnu muhamaadin, qaala hadaathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, qaala aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi allaahi, qaala qaala alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aakala min hadhihi alshaajaraai yuriydu althuuwma falaa yaghshaanaa fiy masaajidinaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu maa ya'niy bihi qaala maa auraahu ya'niy iilaaa niyiahu‏.‏ waqaala makhladu bnu yaziyda 'ani abni jurayjin iilaaa natnahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ata':I heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever eats (from) this plant (he meant garlic) should keep away from our mosque." I said, "What does he mean by that?" He replied, "I think he means only raw garlic
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، زَعَمَ عَطَاءٌ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، زَعَمَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ ثُومًا أَوْ بَصَلاً فَلْيَعْتَزِلْنَا ـ أَوْ قَالَ ـ فَلْيَعْتَزِلْ مَسْجِدَنَا، وَلْيَقْعُدْ فِي بَيْتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِقِدْرٍ فِيهِ خَضِرَاتٌ مِنْ بُقُولٍ، فَوَجَدَ لَهَا رِيحًا فَسَأَلَ فَأُخْبِرَ بِمَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْبُقُولِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قَرِّبُوهَا ‏"‏ إِلَى بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ كَانَ مَعَهُ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ كَرِهَ أَكْلَهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ كُلْ فَإِنِّي أُنَاجِي مَنْ لاَ تُنَاجِي ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ أُتِيَ بِبَدْرٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ يَعْنِي طَبَقًا فِيهِ خُضَرَاتٌ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ اللَّيْثُ وَأَبُو صَفْوَانَ عَنْ يُونُسَ قِصَّةَ الْقِدْرِ، فَلاَ أَدْرِي هُوَ مِنْ قَوْلِ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَوْ فِي الْحَدِيثِ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ufayrin, qaala hadaathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, za'ama 'ataa'un aanaa jaabira bna 'abdi allaahi, za'ama aanaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man aakala thuwmana aaw basalaan falya'tazilnaa aaw qaala falya'tazil masjidanaa, walyaq'ud fiy baytihi ‏"‏‏.‏ waaanaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm autiya biqidrin fiyhi khadiraatun min buquwlin, fawajada lahaa riyhana fasaaala faaukhbira bimaa fiyhaa mina albuquwli faqaala ‏"‏ qariibuwhaa ‏"‏ iilaa ba'di aashaabihi kaana ma'ahu, falamaaa raahu kariha aaklahaa qaala ‏"‏ kul faiiniiy aunaajiy man laa tunaajiy ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala aahmadu bnu saalihin 'ani abni wahbin autiya bibadrin‏.‏ qaala abnu wahbin ya'niy tabaqana fiyhi khudaraatun‏.‏ walam yadhkuri allaaythu waaabuw safwaana 'an yuwnusa qisaaaa alqidri, falaa aadriy huwa min qawli alzuuhriyii aaw fiy alhadiythi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever eats garlic or onion should keep away from our mosque or should remain in his house." (Jabir bin `Abdullah, in another narration said, "Once a big pot containing cooked vegetables was brought. On finding unpleasant smell coming from it, the Prophet (ﷺ) asked, 'What is in it?' He was told all the names of the vegetables that were in it. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered that it should be brought near to some of his companions who were with him. When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw it he disliked to eat it and said, 'Eat. (I don't eat) for I converse with those whom you don't converse with (i.e. the angels)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ أَنَسًا مَا سَمِعْتَ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الثُّومِ فَقَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ فَلاَ يَقْرَبْنَا، أَوْ لاَ يُصَلِّيَنَّ مَعَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, qaala saaala rajulun aanasana maa sami'ta nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy althhuwmi faqaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man aakala min hadhihi alshhajaraai falaa yaqrabnaa, aaw laa yusalliyanna ma'anaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdul `Aziz:A man asked Anas, "What did you hear from the Prophet (ﷺ) about garlic?" He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever has eaten this plant should neither come near us nor pray with us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي غُنْدَرٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ الشَّيْبَانِيَّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، مَرَّ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى قَبْرٍ مَنْبُوذٍ، فَأَمَّهُمْ وَصَفُّوا عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا عَمْرٍو مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathaniy ghundarun, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu sulaymaana alshhaybaaniyya, qaala sami'tu alshha'biyya, qaala aakhbaraniy man, marra ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa qabrin manbuwdhin, faaammahum wasaffuwa 'alayhi‏.‏ faqultu yaa aabaa 'amrinw man haddathaka faqaala abnu 'abbaasin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sulaiman Ash-Shaibani:I heard Ash-Shu`bi saying, "A person who was accompanying the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a grave that was separated from the other graves told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) once led the people in the (funeral) prayer and the people had aligned behind him. I said, "O Aba `Amr! Who told you about it?" He said, "Ibn `Abbas
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي صَفْوَانُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْغُسْلُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُحْتَلِمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathaniy safwaanu bnu sulaymin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alghuslu yawma aljumu'aai waajibun 'alaa kulli muhtalimin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ghusl (taking a bath) on Friday is compulsory for every Muslim reaching the age of puberty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي كُرَيْبٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بِتُّ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ لَيْلَةً، فَنَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي بَعْضِ اللَّيْلِ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْ شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقٍ وُضُوءًا خَفِيفًا ـ يُخَفِّفُهُ عَمْرٌو وَيُقَلِّلُهُ جِدًّا ـ ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي، فَقُمْتُ فَتَوَضَّأْتُ نَحْوًا مِمَّا تَوَضَّأَ، ثُمَّ جِئْتُ فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، فَحَوَّلَنِي فَجَعَلَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ فَنَامَ حَتَّى نَفَخَ، فَأَتَاهُ الْمُنَادِي يُؤْذِنُهُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقَامَ مَعَهُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ، فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ‏.‏ قُلْنَا لِعَمْرٍو إِنَّ نَاسًا يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَنَامُ عَيْنُهُ وَلاَ يَنَامُ قَلْبُهُ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ يَقُولُ إِنَّ رُؤْيَا الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَحْىٌ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏إِنِّي أَرَى فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, qaala aakhbaraniy kuraybun, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala bittu 'inda khaalatiy maymuwnaaa laylaaan, fanaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa kaana fiy ba'di alllayli qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatawaddaaa min shannin mu'allaqin wuduw'ana khafiyfana yukhaffifuhu 'amrunw wayuqalliluhu jiddana thumma qaama yusalliy, faqumtu fatawaddaatu nahwana mimmaa tawaddaaa, thumma jiitu faqumtu 'an yasaarihi, fahawwalaniy faja'alaniy 'an yamiynihi, thumma sallaa maa shaa'a alllahu, thumma adtaja'a fanaama hattaa nafakha, faaataahu almunaadiy yuudhinuhu bialssalaaai faqaama ma'ahu iilaa alssalaaai, fasallaa walam yatawaddaa‏.‏ qulnaa li'amrinw iinna naasana yaquwluwna iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm tanaamu 'aynuhu walaa yanaamu qalbuhu‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw sami'tu 'ubayda bna 'umayrin yaquwlu iinna ruuyaa alaanbiyaa'i wahaun thumma qaraaa ‏{‏iinniy aaraa fiy almanaami aanniy aadhbahuka‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:One night I slept at the house of my aunt Maimuna and the Prophet (ﷺ) slept (too). He got up (for prayer) in the last hours of the night and performed a light ablution from a hanging leather skin. (`Amr, the sub-narrator described that the ablution was very light). Then he stood up for prayer and I got up too and performed the ablution in the same way and joined him on his left side. He pulled me to the right and prayed as much as Allah will. Then he lay down and slept and I heard his breath sounds till the Mu'adh-dhin came to him to inform him about the (Fajr) prayer. He left with him for the prayer and prayed without repeating the ablution. (Sufyan the sub-narrator said: We said to `Amr, "Some people say, 'The eyes of the Prophet (ﷺ) sleep but his heart never sleeps.' " `Amr said, "'Ubai bin `Umar said, 'The dreams of the Prophets are Divine Inspirations. Then he recited, '(O my son), I have seen in dream that I was slaughtering you (offering you in sacrifice)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ جَدَّتَهُ، مُلَيْكَةَ دَعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِطَعَامٍ صَنَعَتْهُ، فَأَكَلَ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ قُومُوا فَلأُصَلِّيَ بِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى حَصِيرٍ لَنَا قَدِ اسْوَدَّ مِنْ طُولِ مَا لُبِسَ، فَنَضَحْتُهُ بِمَاءٍ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالْيَتِيمُ مَعِي، وَالْعَجُوزُ مِنْ وَرَائِنَا، فَصَلَّى بِنَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna jaddatahu, mulaykaaa da'at rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lita'aamin sana'athu, faaakala minhu faqaala ‏ "‏ quwmuwa falausalliya bikum ‏"‏‏.‏ faqumtu iilaa hasiyrin lanaa qadi aswadda min tuwli maa lubisa, fanadahtuhu bimaa'in faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waalyatiymu ma'iy, waal'ajuwzu min waraaiinaa, fasallaa binaa rak'atayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:My grandmother Mulaika invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for a meal which she had prepared specially for him. He ate some of it and said, "Get up. I shall lead you in the prayer." I brought a mat that had become black owing to excessive use and I sprinkled water on it. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood on it and prayed two rak`at; and the orphan was with me (in the first row), and the old lady stood behind us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَقْبَلْتُ رَاكِبًا عَلَى حِمَارٍ أَتَانٍ وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ قَدْ نَاهَزْتُ الاِحْتِلاَمَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ بِمِنًى إِلَى غَيْرِ جِدَارٍ، فَمَرَرْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ بَعْضِ الصَّفِّ، فَنَزَلْتُ وَأَرْسَلْتُ الأَتَانَ تَرْتَعُ وَدَخَلْتُ فِي الصَّفِّ، فَلَمْ يُنْكِرْ ذَلِكَ عَلَىَّ أَحَدٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aannahu qaala aaqbaltu raakibana 'alaa himaarin aataanin waaanaa yawmaiidhin qad naahaztu alaihtilaama warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy bialnnaasi biminana iilaa ghayri jidaarin, famarartu bayna yadaa ba'di alssaffi, fanazaltu waaarsaltu alaataana tarta'u wadakhaltu fiy alssaffi, falam yunkir dhalika 'alaaaa aahadun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I came riding a she-ass and I, then, had just attained the age of puberty. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was leading the people in prayer at Mina facing no wall. I passed in front of the row and let loose the sheass for grazing and joined the row and no one objected to my deed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ أَعْتَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَيَّاشٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ أَعْتَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْعِشَاءِ حَتَّى نَادَاهُ عُمَرُ قَدْ نَامَ النِّسَاءُ وَالصِّبْيَانُ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ يُصَلِّي هَذِهِ الصَّلاَةَ غَيْرُكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَحَدٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ يُصَلِّي غَيْرَ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, qaalat aa'tama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala 'ayyaashun haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa haddathanaa ma'marun 'ani alzzuhriyyi 'an 'urwaaa 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat aa'tama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy al'ishaa'i hattaa naadaahu 'umaru qad naama alnnisaa'u waalssibyaanu‏.‏ fakharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnahu laysa aahadun min aahli alaardi yusalliy hadhihi alssalaaaa ghayrukum ‏"‏‏.‏ walam yakun aahadun yawmaiidhin yusalliy ghayra aahli almadiynaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer till `Umar informed him that the women and children had slept. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out and said: "None from amongst the dwellers of earth have prayed this prayer except you." In those days none but the people of Medina prayed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَابِسٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ شَهِدْتَ الْخُرُوجَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ، وَلَوْلاَ مَكَانِي مِنْهُ مَا شَهِدْتُهُ ـ يَعْنِي مِنْ صِغَرِهِ ـ أَتَى الْعَلَمَ الَّذِي عِنْدَ دَارِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ، ثُمَّ خَطَبَ ثُمَّ أَتَى النِّسَاءَ فَوَعَظَهُنَّ وَذَكَّرَهُنَّ وَأَمَرَهُنَّ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقْنَ فَجَعَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ تُهْوِي بِيَدِهَا إِلَى حَلْقِهَا تُلْقِي فِي ثَوْبِ بِلاَلٍ، ثُمَّ أَتَى هُوَ وَبِلاَلٌ الْبَيْتَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'aabisin, sami'tu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala lahu rajulun shahidta alkhuruwja ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am, walawlaa makaaniy minhu maa shahidtuhu ya'niy min sigharihi aataa al'alama alladhiy 'inda daari kathiyri bni alssalti, thumma khataba thumma aataa alnnisaa'a fawa'azahunna wadhakkarahunna waaamarahunna aan yatasaddaqna faja'alati almaraaau tuhwiy biyadihaa iilaa halqihaa tulqiy fiy thawbi bilaalin, thumma aataa huwa wabilaalun albayta‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin `Abis:A person asked Ibn `Abbas, "Have you ever presented yourself at the (`Id) prayer with Allah's Apostle?" He replied, "Yes." And had it not been for my kinship (position) with the Prophet (ﷺ) it would not have been possible for me to do so (for he was too young). The Prophet (ﷺ) went to the mark near the house of Kathir bin As-Salt and delivered a sermon. He then went towards the women. He advised and reminded them and asked them to give alms. So the woman would bring her hand near her neck and take off her necklace and put it in the garment of Bilal. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) and Bilal came to the house
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ أَعْتَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْعَتَمَةِ حَتَّى نَادَاهُ عُمَرُ نَامَ النِّسَاءُ وَالصِّبْيَانُ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا يَنْتَظِرُهَا أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَلاَ يُصَلَّى يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلاَّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ، وَكَانُوا يُصَلُّونَ الْعَتَمَةَ فِيمَا بَيْنَ أَنْ يَغِيبَ الشَّفَقُ إِلَى ثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ الأَوَّلِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat aa'tama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bial'atamaai hattaa naadaahu 'umaru naama alnnisaa'u waalssibyaanu‏.‏ fakharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ maa yantaziruhaa aahadun ghayrukum min aahli alaardi ‏"‏‏.‏ walaa yusallaa yawmaiidhin iilaaa bialmadiynaai, wakaanuwa yusalluwna al'atamaaa fiymaa bayna aan yaghiyba alshhafaqu iilaa thuluthi alllayli alaawwali‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delayed the `Isha' prayer till `Umar informed him that the women and children had slept. The Prophet (ﷺ) came out and said, "None except you from amongst the dwellers of earth is waiting for this prayer." In those days, there was no prayer except in Medina and they used to pray the `Isha' prayer between the disappearance of the twilight and the first third of the night
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَكُمْ نِسَاؤُكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَأْذَنُوا لَهُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an hanzalaaa, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa astaadhanakum nisaauukum bialllayli iilaa almasjidi faadhanuwa lahunna ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu shu'baau 'ani alaa'mashi 'an mujaahidin 'ani abni 'umara 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If your women ask permission to go to the mosque at night, allow them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي هِنْدُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهَا أَنَّ النِّسَاءَ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُنَّ إِذَا سَلَّمْنَ مِنَ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ قُمْنَ، وَثَبَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَنْ صَلَّى مِنَ الرِّجَالِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ الرِّجَالُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathatniy hindu bintu alhaarithi, aanna aumma salamaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathaa aanna alnnisaa'a fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kunna iidhaa sallamna mina almaktuwbaai qumna, wathabata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waman sallaa mina alrrijaali maa shaa'a alllahu, faiidhaa qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama alrrijaalu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:(the wife of the Prophet) In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the women used to get up when they finished their compulsory prayers with Taslim. The Prophet (ﷺ) and the men would stay on at their places as long as Allah will. When the Prophet (ﷺ) got up, the men would then get up
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ إِنْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيُصَلِّي الصُّبْحَ، فَيَنْصَرِفُ النِّسَاءُ مُتَلَفِّعَاتٍ بِمُرُوطِهِنَّ، مَا يُعْرَفْنَ مِنَ الْغَلَسِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat iin kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm layusalliy alssubha, fayansarifu alnnisaa'u mutalaffi'aatin bimuruwtihinna, maa yu'rafna mina alghalasi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finished the Fajr prayer, the women would leave covered in their sheets and were not recognized owing to the darkness
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِسْكِينٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لأَقُومُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُطَوِّلَ فِيهَا، فَأَسْمَعُ بُكَاءَ الصَّبِيِّ، فَأَتَجَوَّزُ فِي صَلاَتِي كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمِّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu miskiynin, qaala haddathanaa bishrun, aakhbaranaa alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathaniy yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa alaansaariyyi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinniy laaquwmu iilaa alssalaaai waaanaa auriydu aan autawwila fiyhaa, faaasma'u bukaa'a alssabiyyi, faaatajawwazu fiy salaatiy karaahiyaaa aan aashuqqa 'alaa aummihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abi Qatada Al-Ansari:My father said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whenever I stand for prayer, I want to prolong it but on hearing the cries of a child, I would shorten it as I dislike to put its mother in trouble
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَوْ أَدْرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أَحْدَثَ النِّسَاءُ لَمَنَعَهُنَّ كَمَا مُنِعَتْ نِسَاءُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِعَمْرَةَ أَوَ مُنِعْنَ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat law aadraka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa aahdatha alnnisaa'u lamana'ahunna kamaa muni'at nisaa'u baniy iisraaiiyla‏.‏ qultu li'amraaa aawa muni'na qaalat na'am‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Had Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) known what the women were doing, he would have forbidden them from going to the mosque as the women of Bani Israel had been forbidden. Yahya bin Sa`id (a sub-narrator) asked `Amra (another sub-narrator), "Were the women of Bani Israel forbidden?" She replied "Yes
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ هِنْدٍ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَلَّمَ قَامَ النِّسَاءُ حِينَ يَقْضِي تَسْلِيمَهُ، وَيَمْكُثُ هُوَ فِي مَقَامِهِ يَسِيرًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُومَ‏.‏ قَالَ نَرَى ـ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ ـ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ كَانَ لِكَىْ يَنْصَرِفَ النِّسَاءُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْرِكَهُنَّ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, qaala haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an hindin binti alhaarithi, 'an aummi salamaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sallama qaama alnnisaa'u hiyna yaqdiy tasliymahu, wayamkuthu huwa fiy maqaamihi yasiyrana qabla aan yaquwma‏.‏ qaala naraa waalllahu aa'lamu aanna dhalika kaana likaa yansarifa alnnisaa'u qabla aan yudrikahunna aahadun mina alrrijaali‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um Salama:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) completed the prayer with Taslim, the women used to get up immediately and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would remain at his place for some time before getting up. (The sub-narrator (Az-Zuhri) said, "We think, and Allah knows better, that he did so, so that the women might leave before men could get in touch with them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ، فَقُمْتُ وَيَتِيمٌ خَلْفَهُ، وَأُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ خَلْفَنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an iishaaqa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy bayti aummi sulaymin, faqumtu wayatiymun khalfahu, waaummu sulaymin khalfanaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed in the house of Um Sulaim; and I, along with an orphan stood behind him while Um Sulaim (stood) behind us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي الصُّبْحَ بِغَلَسٍ فَيَنْصَرِفْنَ نِسَاءُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، لاَ يُعْرَفْنَ مِنَ الْغَلَسِ، أَوْ لاَ يَعْرِفُ بَعْضُهُنَّ بَعْضًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa fulayhun, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, rda allh 'nha aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy alssubha bighalasin fayansarifna nisaa'u almuuminiyna, laa yu'rafna mina alghalasi, aaw laa ya'rifu ba'duhunna ba'dana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the Fajr prayer when it was still dark and the believing women used to return (after finishing their prayer) and nobody could recognize them owing to darkness, or they could not recognize one another
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ ‏ "‏ إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَتِ امْرَأَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلاَ يَمْنَعْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ ‏ "‏ iidhaa astaadhanati amraaaau aahadikum falaa yamna'haa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salim bin `Abdullah:My father said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'If the wife of any one of you asks permission (to go to the mosque) do not forbid her
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ، فَقُمْتُ وَيَتِيمٌ خَلْفَهُ، وَأُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ خَلْفَنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala hadaathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an iishaaqa, 'an aanasin, qaala salaaa alnaabiyuu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy bayti aumii sulaymin, faqumtu wayatiymun khalfahu, waaumuu sulaymin khalfanaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed in the house of Um Sulaim; and I, along with an orphan stood behind him while Um Sulaim (stood) behind us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ هِنْدَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا سَلَّمَ قَامَ النِّسَاءُ حِينَ يَقْضِي تَسْلِيمَهُ، وَهُوَ يَمْكُثُ فِي مَقَامِهِ يَسِيرًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُومَ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نُرَى ـ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ ـ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ كَانَ لِكَىْ يَنْصَرِفَ النِّسَاءُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْرِكَهُنَّ الرِّجَالُ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa yahyaa bnu qaza'aaa, hadaathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani alzuuhriyii, 'an hinda binti alhaarithi, 'an aumii salamaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa salaama qaama alniisaa'u hiyna yaqdiy tasliymahu, wahuwa yamkuthu fiy maqaamihi yasiyrana qabla aan yaquwma‏.‏ qaalat nuraa waallaahu aa'lamu aanaa dhalika kaana likaa yansarifa alniisaa'u qabla aan yudrikahunaa alriijaalu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Umm Salama:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) completed the Salat with Taslim, the women used to get up immediately and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would remain at his place for sometime before getting up. The sub-narrator (Az-Zuhri) said, "We think, and Allah knows better, that he did so, so that the women might leave before the men could catch up with them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ هُرْمُزَ الأَعْرَجَ، مَوْلَى رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ نَحْنُ الآخِرُونَ السَّابِقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، بَيْدَ أَنَّهُمْ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا، ثُمَّ هَذَا يَوْمُهُمُ الَّذِي فُرِضَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَاخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ، فَهَدَانَا اللَّهُ، فَالنَّاسُ لَنَا فِيهِ تَبَعٌ، الْيَهُودُ غَدًا وَالنَّصَارَى بَعْدَ غَدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, qaala haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna hurmuza alaa'raja, mawlaa rabiy'aaa bni alhaarithi haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ nahnu alakhiruwna alssaabiquwna yawma alqiyaamaai, bayda aannahum auwtuwa alkitaaba min qablinaa, thumma hadhaa yawmuhumu alladhiy furida 'alayhim faakhtalafuwa fiyhi, fahadaanaa alllahu, faalnnaasu lanaa fiyhi taba'un, alyahuwdu ghadana waalnnasaaraa ba'da ghadin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "We (Muslims) are the last (to come) but (will be) the foremost on the Day of Resurrection though the former nations were given the Holy Scriptures before us. And this was their day (Friday) the celebration of which was made compulsory for them but they differed about it. So Allah gave us the guidance for it (Friday) and all the other people are behind us in this respect: the Jews' (holy day is) tomorrow (i.e. Saturday) and the Christians' (is) the day after tomorrow (i.e. Sunday)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْجُمُعَةَ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa jaa'a aahadukumu aljumu'aaa falyaghtasil ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Anyone of you attending the Friday (prayers) should take a bath
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، بَيْنَمَا هُوَ قَائِمٌ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِذْ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ الأَوَّلِينَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَادَاهُ عُمَرُ أَيَّةُ سَاعَةٍ هَذِهِ قَالَ إِنِّي شُغِلْتُ فَلَمْ أَنْقَلِبْ إِلَى أَهْلِي حَتَّى سَمِعْتُ التَّأْذِينَ، فَلَمْ أَزِدْ أَنْ تَوَضَّأْتُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَالْوُضُوءُ أَيْضًا وَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْغُسْلِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a, qaala aakhbaranaa juwayriyaau, 'an maalikin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, baynamaa huwa qaaiimun fiy alkhutbaai yawma aljumu'aai iidh dakhala rajulun mina almuhaajiriyna alaawwaliyna min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fanaadaahu 'umaru aayyaau saa'aain hadhihi qaala iinniy shughiltu falam aanqalib iilaa aahliy hattaa sami'tu alttaadhiyna, falam aazid aan tawaddaatu‏.‏ faqaala waalwuduw'u aaydana waqad 'alimta aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaamuru bialghusli‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:While `Umar bin Al-Khattab was standing and delivering the sermon on a Friday, one of the companions of the Prophet, who was one of the foremost Muhajirs (emigrants) came. `Umar said to him, "What is the time now?" He replied, "I was busy and could not go back to my house till I heard the Adhan. I did not perform more than the ablution." Thereupon `Umar said to him, "Did you perform only the ablution although you know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to order us to take a bath (on Fridays)?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ غُسْلُ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُحْتَلِمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an safwaana bni sulaymin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ghuslu yawmi aljumu'aai waajibun 'alaa kulli muhtalimin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The taking of a bath on Friday is compulsory for every male (Muslim) who has attained the age of puberty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ أَشْهَدُ عَلَى أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْغُسْلُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُحْتَلِمٍ، وَأَنْ يَسْتَنَّ وَأَنْ يَمَسَّ طِيبًا إِنْ وَجَدَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو أَمَّا الْغُسْلُ فَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّهُ وَاجِبٌ، وَأَمَّا الاِسْتِنَانُ وَالطِّيبُ فَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ أَوَاجِبٌ هُوَ أَمْ لاَ، وَلَكِنْ هَكَذَا فِي الْحَدِيثِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ هُوَ أَخُو مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ وَلَمْ يُسَمَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ هَذَا‏.‏ رَوَاهُ عَنْهُ بُكَيْرُ بْنُ الأَشَجِّ وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ وَعِدَّةٌ‏.‏ وَكَانَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ يُكْنَى بِأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, qaala haddathanaa haramiyyu bnu 'umaaraaa, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy bakri bni almunkadiri, qaala haddathaniy 'amruw bnu sulaymin alaansaariyyu, qaala aashhadu 'alaa aabiy sa'iydin qaala aashhadu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alghuslu yawma aljumu'aai waajibun 'alaa kulli muhtalimin, waaan yastanna waaan yamassa tiybana iin wajada ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw aammaa alghuslu faaashhadu aannahu waajibun, waaammaa alaistinaanu waalttiybu faalllahu aa'lamu aawaajibun huwa aam laa, walakin hakadhaa fiy alhadiythi‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi huwa aakhuw muhammadi bni almunkadiri walam yusamma aabuw bakrin hadhaa‏.‏ rawaahu 'anhu bukayru bnu alaashajji wasa'iydu bnu aabiy hilaalin wa'iddaaun‏.‏ wakaana muhammadu bnu almunkadiri yuknaa biaabiy bakrin waaabiy 'abdi alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id:I testify that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The taking of a bath on Friday is compulsory for every male Muslim who has attained the age of puberty and (also) the cleaning of his teeth with Siwak, and the using of perfume if it is available." `Amr (a sub-narrator) said, "I confirm that the taking of a bath is compulsory, but as for the Siwak and the using of perfume, Allah knows better whether it is obligatory or not, but according to the Hadith it is as above
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اغْتَسَلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ غُسْلَ الْجَنَابَةِ ثُمَّ رَاحَ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَّبَ بَدَنَةً، وَمَنْ رَاحَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَّبَ بَقَرَةً، وَمَنْ رَاحَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّالِثَةِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَّبَ كَبْشًا أَقْرَنَ، وَمَنْ رَاحَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الرَّابِعَةِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَّبَ دَجَاجَةً، وَمَنْ رَاحَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الْخَامِسَةِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَّبَ بَيْضَةً، فَإِذَا خَرَجَ الإِمَامُ حَضَرَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الذِّكْرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an sumaaain, mawlaa aabiy bakri bni 'abdi alrrahmani 'an aabiy saalihin alssammaani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mani aghtasala yawma aljumu'aai ghusla aljanaabaai thumma raaha fakaaannamaa qarraba badanaaan, waman raaha fiy alssaa'aai althhaaniyaai fakaaannamaa qarraba baqaraaan, waman raaha fiy alssaa'aai althhaalithaai fakaaannamaa qarraba kabshana aaqrana, waman raaha fiy alssaa'aai alrraabi'aai fakaaannamaa qarraba dajaajaaan, waman raaha fiy alssaa'aai alkhaamisaai fakaaannamaa qarraba baydaaan, faiidhaa kharaja aliimaamu hadarati almalaaiikaau yastami'uwna aldhhikra ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Any person who takes a bath on Friday like the bath of Janaba and then goes for the prayer (in the first hour i.e. early), it is as if he had sacrificed a camel (in Allah's cause); and whoever goes in the second hour it is as if he had sacrificed a cow; and whoever goes in the third hour, then it is as if he had sacrificed a horned ram; and if one goes in the fourth hour, then it is as if he had sacrificed a hen; and whoever goes in the fifth hour then it is as if he had offered an egg. When the Imam comes out (i.e. starts delivering the Khutba), the angels present themselves to listen to the Khutba
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ بَيْنَمَا هُوَ يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِذْ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لِمَ تَحْتَبِسُونَ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ مَا هُوَ إِلاَّ سَمِعْتُ النِّدَاءَ تَوَضَّأْتُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعُوا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا رَاحَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna 'umara rda allh 'nh baynamaa huwa yakhtubu yawma aljumu'aai iidh dakhala rajulun faqaala 'umaru lima tahtabisuwna 'ani alssalaaai faqaala alrrajulu maa huwa iilaaa sami'tu alnnidaa'a tawaddaatu‏.‏ faqaala aalam tasma'uwa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa raaha aahadukum iilaa aljumu'aai falyaghtasil ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:While `Umar (bin Al-Khattab) was delivering the Khutba on a Friday, a man entered (the mosque). `Umar asked him, "What has detained you from the prayer?" The man said, "It was only that when I heard the Adhan I performed ablution (for the prayer)." On that `Umar said, "Did you not hear the Prophet saying: 'Anyone of you going out for the Jumua prayer should take a bath'?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنِ ابْنِ وَدِيعَةَ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَغْتَسِلُ رَجُلٌ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، وَيَتَطَهَّرُ مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ طُهْرٍ، وَيَدَّهِنُ مِنْ دُهْنِهِ، أَوْ يَمَسُّ مِنْ طِيبِ بَيْتِهِ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ، فَلاَ يُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي مَا كُتِبَ لَهُ، ثُمَّ يُنْصِتُ إِذَا تَكَلَّمَ الإِمَامُ، إِلاَّ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ الأُخْرَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'ani abni wadiy'aaa, 'an salmaana alfaarisiyyi, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yaghtasilu rajulun yawma aljumu'aai, wayatatahharu maa astataa'a min tuhrin, wayaddahinu min duhnihi, aaw yamassu min tiybi baytihi thumma yakhruju, falaa yufarriqu bayna athnayni, thumma yusalliy maa kutiba lahu, thumma yunsitu iidhaa takallama aliimaamu, iilaaa ghufira lahu maa baynahu wabayna aljumu'aai alaukhraa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Salman-Al-Farsi:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever takes a bath on Friday, purifies himself as much as he can, then uses his (hair) oil or perfumes himself with the scent of his house, then proceeds (for the Jumua prayer) and does not separate two persons sitting together (in the mosque), then prays as much as (Allah has) written for him and then remains silent while the Imam is delivering the Khutba, his sins in-between the present and the last Friday would be forgiven
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ طَاوُسٌ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ذَكَرُوا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اغْتَسِلُوا يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاغْسِلُوا رُءُوسَكُمْ وَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُونُوا جُنُبًا، وَأَصِيبُوا مِنَ الطِّيبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَمَّا الْغُسْلُ فَنَعَمْ، وَأَمَّا الطِّيبُ فَلاَ أَدْرِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala taawusun qultu laibni 'abbaasin dhakaruwa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aghtasiluwa yawma aljumu'aai waaghsiluwa ru'uwsakum waiin lam takuwnuwa junubana, waaasiybuwa mina alttiybi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin aammaa alghuslu fana'am, waaammaa alttiybu falaa aadriy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Tawus:I said to Ibn `Abbas, "The people are narrating that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Take a bath on Friday and wash your heads (i.e. take a thorough bath) even though you were not Junub and use perfume'." On that Ibn `Abbas replied, "I know about the bath, (i.e. it is essential) but I do not know about the perfume (i.e. whether it is essential or not)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ قَوْلَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَيَمَسُّ طِيبًا أَوْ دُهْنًا إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهِ فَقَالَ لاَ أَعْلَمُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, qaala aakhbaranaa hishaamun, aanna abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum qaala aakhbaraniy iibraahiymu bnu maysaraaa, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aannahu dhakara qawla alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alghusli yawma aljumu'aai faqultu laibni 'abbaasin aayamassu tiybana aaw duhnana iin kaana 'inda aahlihi faqaala laa aa'lamuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Tawus:Ibn `Abbas mentioned the statement of the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding the taking of a bath on Friday and then I asked him whether the Prophet (ﷺ) had ordered perfume or (hair) oil to be used if they could be found in one's house. He (Ibn `Abbas) replied that he did not know about it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، رَأَى حُلَّةَ سِيَرَاءَ عِنْدَ باب الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لَوِ اشْتَرَيْتَ هَذِهِ فَلَبِسْتَهَا يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَلِلْوَفْدِ إِذَا قَدِمُوا عَلَيْكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا يَلْبَسُ هَذِهِ مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَاءَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهَا حُلَلٌ، فَأَعْطَى عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ مِنْهَا حُلَّةً فَقَالَ عُمَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، كَسَوْتَنِيهَا وَقَدْ قُلْتَ فِي حُلَّةِ عُطَارِدٍ مَا قُلْتَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي لَمْ أَكْسُكَهَا لِتَلْبَسَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَسَاهَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَخًا لَهُ بِمَكَّةَ مُشْرِكًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, raaaa hullaaa siyaraa'a 'inda bab almasjidi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, lawi ashtarayta hadhihi falabistahaa yawma aljumu'aai walilwafdi iidhaa qadimuwa 'alayka‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa yalbasu hadhihi man laa khalaaqa lahu fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma jaa'at rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm minhaa hulalun, faaa'taa 'umara bna alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh minhaa hullaaan faqaala 'umaru yaa rasuwla alllahi, kasawtaniyhaa waqad qulta fiy hullaai 'utaaridin maa qulta qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinniy lam aaksukahaa litalbasahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fakasaahaa 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh aakhana lahu bimakkaaa mushrikana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bin Al-Khattab saw a silken cloak (being sold) at the gate of the Mosque and said to Allah's Apostle, "I wish you would buy this to wear on Fridays and also on occasions of the arrivals of the delegations." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "This will be worn by a person who will have no share (reward) in the Hereafter." Later on similar cloaks were given to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he gave one of them to `Umar bin Al-Khattab. On that `Umar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You have given me this cloak although on the cloak of Atarid (a cloak merchant who was selling that silken cloak at the gate of the mosque) you passed such and such a remark." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "I have not given you this to wear". And so `Umar bin Al-Khattab gave it to his pagan brother in Mecca to wear
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْلاَ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي ـ أَوْ عَلَى النَّاسِ ـ لأَمَرْتُهُمْ بِالسِّوَاكِ مَعَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ lawlaa aan aashuqqa 'alaa aummatiy aaw 'alaa alnnaasi laamartuhum bialssiwaaki ma'a kulli salaaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If I had not found it hard for my followers or the people, I would have ordered them to clean their teeth with Siwak for every prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ الْحَبْحَابِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَكْثَرْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي السِّوَاكِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, qaala haddathanaa shu'aybu bnu alhabhaabi, haddathanaa aanasun, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aakthartu 'alaykum fiy alssiwaaki ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I have told you repeatedly to use the Siwak. (The Prophet (ﷺ) put emphasis on the use of the Siwak
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، وَحُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ يَشُوصُ فَاهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, qaala aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, wahusaynin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa qaama mina alllayli yashuwsu faahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hudhaifa:When the Prophet (ﷺ) got up at night (for the night prayer), he used to clean his mouth
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، قَالَ قَالَ هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَمَعَهُ سِوَاكٌ يَسْتَنُّ بِهِ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَعْطِنِي هَذَا السِّوَاكَ يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ‏.‏ فَأَعْطَانِيهِ فَقَصَمْتُهُ ثُمَّ مَضَغْتُهُ، فَأَعْطَيْتُهُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَنَّ بِهِ وَهْوَ مُسْتَسْنِدٌ إِلَى صَدْرِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, qaala qaala hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat dakhala 'abdu alrrahmani bnu aabiy bakrin, wama'ahu siwaakun yastannu bihi, fanazara iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu lahu aa'tiniy hadhaa alssiwaaka yaa 'abda alrrahmani‏.‏ faaa'taaniyhi faqasamtuhu thumma madaghtuhu, faaa'taytuhu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faastanna bihi wahwa mustasnidun iilaa sadriy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:`Abdur-Rahman bin Abi Bakr came holding a Siwak with which he was cleaning his teeth. Allah's Apostle looked at him. I requested `Abdur-Rahman to give the Siwak to me and after he gave it to me I divided it, chewed it and gave it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then he cleaned his teeth with it and (at that time) he was resting against my chest
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ هُرْمُزَ ـ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ ‏{‏الم * تَنْزِيلُ‏}‏ السَّجْدَةَ وَ‏{‏هَلْ أَتَى عَلَى الإِنْسَانِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani huwa abnu hurmuza 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqraau fiy aljumu'aai fiy salaaai alfajri ‏{‏alm * tanziylu‏}‏ alssajdaaa wa‏{‏hal aataa 'alaa aliinsaani‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to recite the following in the Fajr prayer of Friday, "Alif, Lam, Mim, Tanzil" (Suratas- Sajda #32) and "Hal-ata-ala-l-Insani" (i.e. Surah-Ad-Dahr)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ الضُّبَعِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ جُمُعَةٍ جُمِّعَتْ بَعْدَ جُمُعَةٍ فِي مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَسْجِدِ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ بِجُوَاثَى مِنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu, qaala haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu tahmaana, 'an aabiy jamraaa aldduba'iyyi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aannahu qaala iinna aawwala jumu'aain jummi'at ba'da jumu'aain fiy masjidi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy masjidi 'abdi alqaysi bijuwaathaa mina albahrayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The first Jumua prayer which was offered after a Jumua prayer offered at the mosque of Allah's Apostle took place in the mosque of the tribe of `Abdul Qais at Jawathi in Bahrain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَزَادَ اللَّيْثُ قَالَ يُونُسُ كَتَبَ رُزَيْقُ بْنُ حُكَيْمٍ إِلَى ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ـ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِوَادِي الْقُرَى ـ هَلْ تَرَى أَنْ أُجَمِّعَ‏.‏ وَرُزَيْقٌ عَامِلٌ عَلَى أَرْضٍ يَعْمَلُهَا، وَفِيهَا جَمَاعَةٌ مِنَ السُّودَانِ وَغَيْرِهِمْ، وَرُزَيْقٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَى أَيْلَةَ، فَكَتَبَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ ـ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ ـ يَأْمُرُهُ أَنْ يُجَمِّعَ، يُخْبِرُهُ أَنَّ سَالِمًا حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ، وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، الإِمَامُ رَاعٍ وَمَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، وَالرَّجُلُ رَاعٍ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَهْوَ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ، وَالْمَرْأَةُ رَاعِيَةٌ فِي بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا وَمَسْئُولَةٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهَا، وَالْخَادِمُ رَاعٍ فِي مَالِ سَيِّدِهِ وَمَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ ـ قَالَ وَحَسِبْتُ أَنْ قَدْ قَالَ ـ وَالرَّجُلُ رَاعٍ فِي مَالِ أَبِيهِ وَمَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ وَكُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَمَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa bishru bnu muhammadin, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaranaa saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ kullukum raa'in ‏"‏‏.‏ wazaada alllaythu qaala yuwnusu kataba ruzayqu bnu hukaymin iilaa abni shihaabin waaanaa ma'ahu yawmaiidhin biwaadiy alquraa hal taraa aan aujammi'a‏.‏ waruzayqun 'aamilun 'alaa aardin ya'maluhaa, wafiyhaa jamaa'aaun mina alssuwdaani waghayrihim, waruzayqun yawmaiidhin 'alaa aaylaaa, fakataba abnu shihaabin waaanaa aasma'u yaamuruhu aan yujammi'a, yukhbiruhu aanna saalimana haddathahu aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ kullukum raa'in, wakullukum masiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, aliimaamu raa'in wamasiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, waalrrajulu raa'in fiy aahlihi wahwa masiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi, waalmaraaau raa'iyaaun fiy bayti zawjihaa wamasiuwlaaun 'an ra'iyyatihaa, waalkhaadimu raa'in fiy maali sayyidihi wamasiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi qaala wahasibtu aan qad qaala waalrrajulu raa'in fiy maali aabiyhi wamasiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi wakullukum raa'in wamasiuwlun 'an ra'iyyatihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "All of you are Guardians." Yunus said: Ruzaiq bin Hukaim wrote to Ibn Shihab while I was with him at Wadi-al-Qura saying, "Shall I lead the Jumua prayer?" Ruzaiq was working on the land (i.e. farming) and there was a group of Sudanese people and some others with him; Ruzaiq was then the Governor of Aila. Ibn Shihab wrote (to Ruzaiq) ordering him to lead the Jumua prayer and telling him that Salim told him that `Abdullah bin `Umar had said, "I heard Allah's Apostle saying, 'All of you are guardians and responsible for your wards and the things under your care.
