verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، وَثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ بِغَلَسٍ ثُمَّ رَكِبَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ خَرِبَتْ خَيْبَرُ، إِنَّا إِذَا نَزَلْنَا بِسَاحَةِ قَوْمٍ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَخَرَجُوا يَسْعَوْنَ فِي السِّكَكِ وَيَقُولُونَ مُحَمَّدٌ وَالْخَمِيسُ ـ قَالَ وَالْخَمِيسُ الْجَيْشُ ـ فَظَهَرَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَتَلَ الْمُقَاتِلَةَ وَسَبَى الذَّرَارِيَّ، فَصَارَتْ صَفِيَّةُ لِدِحْيَةَ الْكَلْبِيِّ، وَصَارَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَهَا وَجَعَلَ صَدَاقَهَا عِتْقَهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ لِثَابِتٍ يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنْتَ سَأَلْتَ أَنَسًا مَا أَمْهَرَهَا قَالَ أَمْهَرَهَا نَفْسَهَا‏.‏ فَتَبَسَّمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa musadaadun, qaala hadaathanaa hamaaadun, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, wathaabitin albunaaniyii, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanaa rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaa alsuubha bighalasin thumaa rakiba faqaala ‏ "‏ allaahu aakbaru kharibat khaybaru, iinaaa iidhaa nazalnaa bisaahaai qawmin fasaa'a sabaahu almundhariyna ‏"‏‏.‏ fakharajuwa yas'awna fiy alsiikaki wayaquwluwna muhamaadun waalkhamiysu qaala waalkhamiysu aljayshu fazahara 'alayhim rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqatala almuqaatilaaa wasabaa aldhaaraariyaa, fasaarat safiyaaau lidihyaaa alkalbiyii, wasaarat lirasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumaa tazawaajahaa waja'ala sadaaqahaa 'itqahaa‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu al'aziyzi lithaabitin yaa aabaa muhamaadin, aanta saaalta aanasana maa aamharahaa qaala aamharahaa nafsahaa‏.‏ fatabasaama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the Fajr prayer when it was still dark, then he rode and said, 'Allahu Akbar! Khaibar is ruined. When we approach near to a nation, the most unfortunate is the morning of those who have been warned." The people came out into the streets saying, "Muhammad and his army." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) vanquished them by force and their warriors were killed; the children and women were taken as captives. Safiya was taken by Dihya Al-Kalbi and later she belonged to Allah's Apostle, who married her and her Mahr was her manumission
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ أَخَذَ عُمَرُ جُبَّةً مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ تُبَاعُ فِي السُّوقِ، فَأَخَذَهَا فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ابْتَعْ هَذِهِ تَجَمَّلْ بِهَا لِلْعِيدِ وَالْوُفُودِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ لِبَاسُ مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَبِثَ عُمَرُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَلْبَثَ، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِجُبَّةِ دِيبَاجٍ، فَأَقْبَلَ بِهَا عُمَرُ، فَأَتَى بِهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ قُلْتَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ لِبَاسُ مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَرْسَلْتَ إِلَىَّ بِهَذِهِ الْجُبَّةِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَبِيعُهَا أَوْ تُصِيبُ بِهَا حَاجَتَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, qaala aakhadha 'umaru jubbaaan min iistabraqin tubaa'u fiy alssuwqi, faaakhadhahaa faaataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi abta' hadhihi tajammal bihaa lil'iydi waalwufuwdi‏.‏ faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa hadhihi libaasu man laa khalaaqa lahu ‏"‏‏.‏ falabitha 'umaru maa shaa'a alllahu aan yalbatha, thumma aarsala iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bijubbaai diybaajin, faaaqbala bihaa 'umaru, faaataa bihaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaka qulta ‏"‏ iinnamaa hadhihi libaasu man laa khalaaqa lahu ‏"‏‏.‏ waaarsalta iilaaaa bihadhihi aljubbaai faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tabiy'uhaa aaw tusiybu bihaa haajataka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:`Umar bought a silk cloak from the market, took it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Take it and adorn yourself with it during the `Id and when the delegations visit you." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, "This dress is for those who have no share (in the Hereafter)." After a long period Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent to `Umar a cloak of silk brocade. `Umar came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the cloak and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! You said that this dress was for those who had no share (in the Hereafter); yet you have sent me this cloak." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him, "Sell it and fulfill your needs by it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَسَدِيَّ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدِي جَارِيَتَانِ تُغَنِّيَانِ بِغِنَاءِ بُعَاثَ، فَاضْطَجَعَ عَلَى الْفِرَاشِ وَحَوَّلَ وَجْهَهُ، وَدَخَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَانْتَهَرَنِي وَقَالَ مِزْمَارَةُ الشَّيْطَانِ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعْهُمَا ‏"‏ فَلَمَّا غَفَلَ غَمَزْتُهُمَا فَخَرَجَتَا‏.‏ وَكَانَ يَوْمَ عِيدٍ يَلْعَبُ السُّودَانُ بِالدَّرَقِ وَالْحِرَابِ، فَإِمَّا سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَإِمَّا قَالَ ‏"‏ تَشْتَهِينَ تَنْظُرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَقَامَنِي وَرَاءَهُ خَدِّي عَلَى خَدِّهِ، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ دُونَكُمْ يَا بَنِي أَرْفِدَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَتَّى إِذَا مَلِلْتُ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَسْبُكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاذْهَبِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu, qaala haddathanaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaranaa 'amrunw, aanna muhammada bna 'abdi alrrahmani alaasadiyya, haddathahu 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat dakhala 'alaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'indiy jaariyataani tughanniyaani bighinaa'i bu'aatha, faadtaja'a 'alaa alfiraashi wahawwala wajhahu, wadakhala aabuw bakrin faantaharaniy waqaala mizmaaraau alshhaytaani 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaqbala 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi 'alayhi alssalaamu faqaala ‏"‏ da'humaa ‏"‏ falammaa ghafala ghamaztuhumaa fakharajataa‏.‏ wakaana yawma 'iydin yal'abu alssuwdaanu bialddaraqi waalhiraabi, faiimmaa saaaltu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waiimmaa qaala ‏"‏ tashtahiyna tanzuriyna ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu na'am‏.‏ faaaqaamaniy waraa'ahu khaddiy 'alaa khaddihi, wahuwa yaquwlu ‏"‏ duwnakum yaa baniy aarfidaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ hattaa iidhaa maliltu qaala ‏"‏ hasbuki ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faadhhabiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to my house while two girls were singing beside me the songs of Buath (a story about the war between the two tribes of the Ansar, the Khazraj and the Aus, before Islam). The Prophet (ﷺ) lay down and turned his face to the other side. Then Abu Bakr came and spoke to me harshly saying, "Musical instruments of Satan near the Prophet (ﷺ) ?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned his face towards him and said, "Leave them." When Abu Bakr became inattentive, I signaled to those girls to go out and they left. It was the day of `Id, and the Black people were playing with shields and spears; so either I requested the Prophet (ﷺ) or he asked me whether I would like to see the display. I replied in the affirmative. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) made me stand behind him and my cheek was touching his cheek and he was saying, "Carry on! O Bani Arfida," till I got tired. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked me, "Are you satisfied (Is that sufficient for you)?" I replied in the affirmative and he told me to leave
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زُبَيْدٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا نَبْدَأُ مِنْ يَوْمِنَا هَذَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ، ثُمَّ نَرْجِعَ فَنَنْحَرَ، فَمَنْ فَعَلَ فَقَدْ أَصَابَ سُنَّتَنَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaajun, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy zubaydun, qaala sami'tu alshha'biyya, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu faqaala ‏ "‏ iinna aawwala maa nabdaau min yawminaa hadhaa aan nusalliya, thumma narji'a fananhara, faman fa'ala faqad aasaaba sunnatanaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara':I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering a Khutba saying, "The first thing to be done on this day (first day of `Id ul Adha) is to pray; and after returning from the prayer we slaughter our sacrifices (in the name of Allah) and whoever does so, he acted according to our Sunna (traditions)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَخَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعِنْدِي جَارِيَتَانِ مِنْ جَوَارِي الأَنْصَارِ تُغَنِّيَانِ بِمَا تَقَاوَلَتِ الأَنْصَارُ يَوْمَ بُعَاثَ ـ قَالَتْ وَلَيْسَتَا بِمُغَنِّيَتَيْنِ ـ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَمَزَامِيرُ الشَّيْطَانِ فِي بَيْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَذَلِكَ فِي يَوْمِ عِيدٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ إِنَّ لِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ عِيدًا، وَهَذَا عِيدُنَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat dakhala aabuw bakrin wa'indiy jaariyataani min jawaariy alaansaari tughanniyaani bimaa taqaawalati alaansaaru yawma bu'aatha qaalat walaysataa bimughanniyatayni faqaala aabuw bakrin aamazaamiyru alshhaytaani fiy bayti rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wadhalika fiy yawmi 'iydin‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa aabaa bakrin iinna likulli qawmin 'iydana, wahadhaa 'iydunaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Abu Bakr came to my house while two small Ansari girls were singing beside me the stories of the Ansar concerning the Day of Buath. And they were not singers. Abu Bakr said protestingly, "Musical instruments of Satan in the house of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) !" It happened on the `Id day and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Abu Bakr! There is an `Id for every nation and this is our `Id
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَغْدُو يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ حَتَّى يَأْكُلَ تَمَرَاتٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُرَجَّى بْنُ رَجَاءٍ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَيَأْكُلُهُنَّ وِتْرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu sulaymaana, qaala haddathanaa hushaymun, qaala aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu aabiy bakri bni aanasin, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa yaghduw yawma alfitri hattaa yaakula tamaraatin‏.‏ waqaala murajjaa bnu rajaa'in haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi qaala haddathaniy aanasun 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wayaakuluhunna witrana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never proceeded (for the prayer) on the Day of `Id-ul-Fitr unless he had eaten some dates. Anas also narrated: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to eat odd number of dates
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَلْيُعِدْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ يُشْتَهَى فِيهِ اللَّحْمُ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ مِنْ جِيرَانِهِ فَكَأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَدَّقَهُ، قَالَ وَعِنْدِي جَذَعَةٌ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ شَاتَىْ لَحْمٍ، فَرَخَّصَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَبَلَغَتِ الرُّخْصَةُ مَنْ سِوَاهُ أَمْ لاَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man dhabaha qabla alssalaaai falyu'id ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaama rajulun faqaala hadhaa yawmun yushtahaa fiyhi alllahmu‏.‏ wadhakara min jiyraanihi fakaaanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm saddaqahu, qaala wa'indiy jadha'aaun aahabbu iilaaaa min shaataa lahmin, farakhhasa lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm falaa aadriy aabalaghati alrrukhsaau man siwaahu aam laa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever slaughtered (his sacrifice) before the `Id prayer, should slaughter again." A man stood up and said, "This is the day on which one has desire for meat," and he mentioned something about his neighbors. It seemed that the Prophet (ﷺ) believed him. Then the same man added, "I have a young she-goat which is dearer to me than the meat of two sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) permitted him to slaughter it as a sacrifice. I do not know whether that permission was valid only for him or for others as well
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ خَطَبَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الأَضْحَى بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ صَلَّى صَلاَتَنَا وَنَسَكَ نُسُكَنَا فَقَدْ أَصَابَ النُّسُكَ، وَمَنْ نَسَكَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّهُ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ، وَلاَ نُسُكَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ نِيَارٍ خَالُ الْبَرَاءِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَإِنِّي نَسَكْتُ شَاتِي قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ، وَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّ الْيَوْمَ يَوْمُ أَكْلٍ وَشُرْبٍ، وَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ تَكُونَ شَاتِي أَوَّلَ مَا يُذْبَحُ فِي بَيْتِي، فَذَبَحْتُ شَاتِي وَتَغَدَّيْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ آتِيَ الصَّلاَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ شَاتُكَ شَاةُ لَحْمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَإِنَّ عِنْدَنَا عَنَاقًا لَنَا جَذَعَةً هِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ شَاتَيْنِ، أَفَتَجْزِي عَنِّي قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ، وَلَنْ تَجْزِيَ عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, qaala haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma qaala khatabanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alaadhaa ba'da alssalaaai faqaala ‏"‏ man sallaa salaatanaa wanasaka nusukanaa faqad aasaaba alnnusuka, waman nasaka qabla alssalaaai faiinnahu qabla alssalaaai, walaa nusuka lahu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw burdaaa bnu niyaarin khaalu albaraa'i yaa rasuwla alllahi, faiinniy nasaktu shaatiy qabla alssalaaai, wa'araftu aanna alyawma yawmu aaklin washurbin, waaahbabtu aan takuwna shaatiy aawwala maa yudhbahu fiy baytiy, fadhabahtu shaatiy wataghaddaytu qabla aan atiya alssalaaaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ shaatuka shaaau lahmin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, faiinna 'indanaa 'anaaqana lanaa jadha'aaan hiya aahabbu iilaaaa min shaatayni, aafatajziy 'anniy qaala ‏"‏ na'am, walan tajziya 'an aahadin ba'daka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered the Khutba after offering the prayer on the Day of Nahr and said, "Whoever offers the prayer like us and slaughters like us then his Nusuk (sacrifice) will be accepted by Allah. And whoever slaughters his sacrifice before the `Id prayer then he has not done the sacrifice." Abi Burda bin Niyar, the uncle of Al-Bara' said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have slaughtered my sheep before the `Id prayer and I thought today as a day of eating and drinking (not alcoholic drinks), and I liked that my sheep should be the first to be slaughtered in my house. So I slaughtered my sheep and took my food before coming for the prayer." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sheep which you have slaughtered is just mutton (not a Nusuk)." He (Abu Burda) said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I have a young she-goat which is dearer to me than two sheep. Will that be sufficient as a Nusuk on my behalf? "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes, it will be sufficient for you but it will not be sufficient (as a Nusuk) for anyone else after you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدٌ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَرْحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْرُجُ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ وَالأَضْحَى إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى، فَأَوَّلُ شَىْءٍ يَبْدَأُ بِهِ الصَّلاَةُ ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفُ، فَيَقُومُ مُقَابِلَ النَّاسِ، وَالنَّاسُ جُلُوسٌ عَلَى صُفُوفِهِمْ، فَيَعِظُهُمْ وَيُوصِيهِمْ وَيَأْمُرُهُمْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَقْطَعَ بَعْثًا قَطَعَهُ، أَوْ يَأْمُرَ بِشَىْءٍ أَمَرَ بِهِ، ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَلَمْ يَزَلِ النَّاسُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ حَتَّى خَرَجْتُ مَعَ مَرْوَانَ وَهْوَ أَمِيرُ الْمَدِينَةِ فِي أَضْحًى أَوْ فِطْرٍ، فَلَمَّا أَتَيْنَا الْمُصَلَّى إِذَا مِنْبَرٌ بَنَاهُ كَثِيرُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ، فَإِذَا مَرْوَانُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَرْتَقِيَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ، فَجَبَذْتُ بِثَوْبِهِ فَجَبَذَنِي فَارْتَفَعَ، فَخَطَبَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ غَيَّرْتُمْ وَاللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، قَدْ ذَهَبَ مَا تَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مَا أَعْلَمُ وَاللَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا لاَ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنَّ النَّاسَ لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَجْلِسُونَ لَنَا بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ فَجَعَلْتُهَا قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, qaala haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala aakhbaraniy zaydun, 'an 'iyaadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy sarhin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhruju yawma alfitri waalaadhaa iilaa almusallaa, faaawwalu shaa'in yabdaau bihi alssalaaau thumma yansarifu, fayaquwmu muqaabila alnnaasi, waalnnaasu juluwsun 'alaa sufuwfihim, faya'izuhum wayuwsiyhim wayaamuruhum, faiin kaana yuriydu aan yaqta'a ba'thana qata'ahu, aaw yaamura bishaa'in aamara bihi, thumma yansarifu‏.‏ qaala aabuw sa'iydin falam yazali alnnaasu 'alaa dhalika hattaa kharajtu ma'a marwaana wahwa aamiyru almadiynaai fiy aadhana aaw fitrin, falammaa aataynaa almusallaa iidhaa minbarun banaahu kathiyru bnu alssalti, faiidhaa marwaanu yuriydu aan yartaqiyahu qabla aan yusalliya, fajabadhtu bithawbihi fajabadhaniy faartafa'a, fakhataba qabla alssalaaai, faqultu lahu ghayyartum waalllahi‏.‏ faqaala aabaa sa'iydin, qad dhahaba maa ta'lamu‏.‏ faqultu maa aa'lamu waalllahi khayrun mimmaa laa aa'lamu‏.‏ faqaala iinna alnnaasa lam yakuwnuwa yajlisuwna lanaa ba'da alssalaaai faja'altuhaa qabla alssalaaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to proceed to the Musalla on the days of Id-ul-Fitr and Id-ul-Adha; the first thing to begin with was the prayer and after that he would stand in front of the people and the people would keep sitting in their rows. Then he would preach to them, advise them and give them orders, (i.e. Khutba). And after that if he wished to send an army for an expedition, he would do so; or if he wanted to give an order, he would do so, and then depart. The people followed this tradition till I went out with Marwan, the Governor of Medina, for the prayer of Id-ul-Adha or Id-ul-Fitr. When we reached the Musalla, there was a pulpit made by Kathir bin As-Salt. Marwan wanted to get up on that pulpit before the prayer. I got hold of his clothes but he pulled them and ascended the pulpit and delivered the Khutba before the prayer. I said to him, "By Allah, you have changed (the Prophet's tradition)." He replied, "O Abu Sa`id! Gone is that which you know." I said, "By Allah! What I know is better than what I do not know." Marwan said, "People do not sit to listen to our Khutba after the prayer, so I delivered the Khutba before the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ،‏.‏ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي فِي الأَضْحَى وَالْفِطْرِ، ثُمَّ يَخْطُبُ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, qaala haddathanaa aanasun, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, ‏.‏ aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy fiy alaadhaa waalfitri, thumma yakhtubu ba'da alssalaaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer the prayer of `Id-ul-Adha and `Id-ul-Fitr and then deliver the Khutba after the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ، فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّلاَةِ قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَرْسَلَ إِلَى ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ فِي أَوَّلِ مَا بُويِعَ لَهُ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ يُؤَذَّنُ بِالصَّلاَةِ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ، إِنَّمَا الْخُطْبَةُ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ‏.‏ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، وَعَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالاَ لَمْ يَكُنْ يُؤَذَّنُ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ وَلاَ يَوْمَ الأَضْحَى‏.‏ وَعَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّلاَةِ، ثُمَّ خَطَبَ النَّاسَ بَعْدُ، فَلَّمَا فَرَغَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَزَلَ فَأَتَى النِّسَاءَ، فَذَكَّرَهُنَّ وَهْوَ يَتَوَكَّأُ عَلَى يَدِ بِلاَلٍ، وَبِلاَلٌ بَاسِطٌ ثَوْبَهُ، يُلْقِي فِيهِ النِّسَاءُ صَدَقَةً‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ أَتَرَى حَقًّا عَلَى الإِمَامِ الآنَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ النِّسَاءَ فَيُذَكِّرَهُنَّ حِينَ يَفْرُغُ قَالَ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَحَقٌّ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَمَا لَهُمْ أَنْ لاَ يَفْعَلُوا
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, qaala aakhbaranaa hishaamun, aanna abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala sami'tuhu yaquwlu iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja yawma alfitri, fabadaaa bialssalaaai qabla alkhutbaai‏.‏ qaala waaakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, aanna abna 'abbaasin, aarsala iilaa abni alzzubayri fiy aawwali maa buwyi'a lahu iinnahu lam yakun yuuadhhanu bialssalaaai yawma alfitri, iinnamaa alkhutbaau ba'da alssalaaai‏.‏ waaakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, wa'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaalaa lam yakun yuuadhhanu yawma alfitri walaa yawma alaadhaa‏.‏ wa'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala sami'tuhu yaquwlu iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama fabadaaa bialssalaaai, thumma khataba alnnaasa ba'du, fallamaa faragha nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nazala faaataa alnnisaa'a, fadhakkarahunna wahwa yatawakkaau 'alaa yadi bilaalin, wabilaalun baasitun thawbahu, yulqiy fiyhi alnnisaa'u sadaqaaan‏.‏ qultu li'ataa'in aataraa haqqana 'alaa aliimaami alana aan yaatiya alnnisaa'a fayudhakkirahunna hiyna yafrughu qaala iinna dhalika lahaqqun 'alayhim, wamaa lahum aan laa yaf'aluwa
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Juraij:`Ata' said, "Jabir bin `Abdullah said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) went out on the Day of `Id-ul-Fitr and offered the prayer before delivering the Khutba, Ata told me that during the early days of Ibn Az-Zubair, Ibn `Abbas had sent a message to him telling him that the Adhan for the `Id Prayer was never pronounced (in the life time of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) and the Khutba used to be delivered after the prayer. Ata told me that Ibn `Abbas and Jabir bin `Abdullah, had said, "There was no Adhan for the prayer of `Id-ul-Fitr and `Id-ul-Aqha." `Ata' said, "I heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up and started with the prayer, and after it he delivered the Khutba. When the Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) finished (the Khutba), he went to the women and preached to them, while he was leaning on Bilal's hand. Bilal was spreading his garment and the ladies were putting alms in it.' " I said to Ata, "Do you think it incumbent upon an Imam to go to the women and preach to them after finishing the prayer and Khutba?" `Ata' said, "No doubt it is incumbent on Imams to do so, and why should they not do so?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ الْعِيدَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ فَكُلُّهُمْ كَانُوا يُصَلُّونَ قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, qaala aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy alhasanu bnu muslimin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala shahidtu al'iyda ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabiy bakrin wa'umara wa'uthmaana rda allh 'nhm fakulluhum kaanuwa yusalluwna qabla alkhutbaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I offered the `Id prayer with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Abu Bakr, `Umar and `Uthman and all of them offered the prayer before delivering the Khutba
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يُصَلُّونَ الْعِيدَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, qaala haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin wa'umaru rda allh 'nhma yusalluwna al'iydayni qabla alkhutbaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), Abu Bakr and `Umar! used to offer the two `Id prayers before delivering the Khutba
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، لَمْ يُصَلِّ قَبْلَهَا وَلاَ بَعْدَهَا، ثُمَّ أَتَى النِّسَاءَ وَمَعَهُ بِلاَلٌ، فَأَمَرَهُنَّ بِالصَّدَقَةِ، فَجَعَلْنَ يُلْقِينَ، تُلْقِي الْمَرْأَةُ خُرْصَهَا وَسِخَابَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyi bni thaabitin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa yawma alfitri rak'atayni, lam yusalli qablahaa walaa ba'dahaa, thumma aataa alnnisaa'a wama'ahu bilaalun, faaamarahunna bialssadaqaai, faja'alna yulqiyna, tulqiy almaraaau khursahaa wasikhaabahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered a two rak`at prayer on the Day of Id ul Fitr and he did not pray before or after it. Then he went towards women along with Bilal and ordered them to pay alms and so they started giving their earrings and necklaces (in charity)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زُبَيْدٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا نَبْدَأُ فِي يَوْمِنَا هَذَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ، ثُمَّ نَرْجِعَ فَنَنْحَرَ، فَمَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ أَصَابَ سُنَّتَنَا، وَمَنْ نَحَرَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ لَحْمٌ قَدَّمَهُ لأَهْلِهِ، لَيْسَ مِنَ النُّسْكِ فِي شَىْءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ نِيَارٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، ذَبَحْتُ وَعِنْدِي جَذَعَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ مُسِنَّةٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اجْعَلْهُ مَكَانَهُ، وَلَنْ تُوفِيَ أَوْ تَجْزِيَ عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathanaa zubaydun, qaala sami'tu alshha'biyya, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna aawwala maa nabdaau fiy yawminaa hadhaa aan nusalliya, thumma narji'a fananhara, faman fa'ala dhalika faqad aasaaba sunnatanaa, waman nahara qabla alssalaaai faiinnamaa huwa lahmun qaddamahu laahlihi, laysa mina alnnuski fiy shaa'in ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rajulun mina alaansaari yuqaalu lahu aabuw burdaaa bnu niyaarin yaa rasuwla alllahi, dhabahtu wa'indiy jadha'aaun khayrun min musinnaain‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aj'alhu makaanahu, walan tuwfiya aaw tajziya 'an aahadin ba'daka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The first thing that we should do on this day of ours is to pray and then return to slaughter the sacrifice. So anyone who does so, he acted according to our Sunna (tradition), and whoever slaughtered the sacrifice before the prayer, it was just meat which he presented to his family and would not be considered as Nusuk." A person from the Ansar named Abu Burda bin Niyar said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I slaughtered the Nusuk (before the prayer) but I have a young shegoat which is better than an older sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Sacrifice it in lieu of the first, but it will not be sufficient (as a sacrifice) for anybody else after you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ يَحْيَى أَبُو السُّكَيْنِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سُوقَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ حِينَ أَصَابَهُ سِنَانُ الرُّمْحِ فِي أَخْمَصِ قَدَمِهِ، فَلَزِقَتْ قَدَمُهُ بِالرِّكَابِ، فَنَزَلْتُ فَنَزَعْتُهَا وَذَلِكَ بِمِنًى، فَبَلَغَ الْحَجَّاجَ فَجَعَلَ يَعُودُهُ فَقَالَ الْحَجَّاجُ لَوْ نَعْلَمُ مَنْ أَصَابَكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْتَ أَصَبْتَنِي‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَيْفَ قَالَ حَمَلْتَ السِّلاَحَ فِي يَوْمٍ لَمْ يَكُنْ يُحْمَلُ فِيهِ، وَأَدْخَلْتَ السِّلاَحَ الْحَرَمَ وَلَمْ يَكُنِ السِّلاَحُ يُدْخَلُ الْحَرَمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu yahyaa aabuw alssukayni, qaala haddathanaa almuhaaribiyyu, qaala haddathanaa muhammadu bnu suwqaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala kuntu ma'a abni 'umara hiyna aasaabahu sinaanu alrrumhi fiy aakhmasi qadamihi, falaziqat qadamuhu bialrrikaabi, fanazaltu fanaza'tuhaa wadhalika biminana, fabalagha alhajjaaja faja'ala ya'uwduhu faqaala alhajjaaju law na'lamu man aasaabaka‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'umara aanta aasabtaniy‏.‏ qaala wakayfa qaala hamalta alssilaaha fiy yawmin lam yakun yuhmalu fiyhi, waaadkhalta alssilaaha alharama walam yakuni alssilaahu yudkhalu alharama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair:I was with Ibn `Umar when a spear head pierced the sole of his foot and his foot stuck to the paddle of the saddle and I got down and pulled his foot out, and that happened in Mina. Al-Hajjaj got the news and came to inquire about his health and said, "Alas! If we could only know the man who wounded you!" Ibn `Umar said, "You are the one who wounded me." Al-Hajjaj said, "How is that?" Ibn `Umar said, "You have allowed the arms to be carried on a day on which nobody used to carry them and you allowed arms to be carried in the Haram even though it was not allowed before
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ دَخَلَ الْحَجَّاجُ عَلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ وَأَنَا عِنْدَهُ، فَقَالَ كَيْفَ هُوَ فَقَالَ صَالِحٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَنْ أَصَابَكَ قَالَ أَصَابَنِي مَنْ أَمَرَ بِحَمْلِ السِّلاَحِ فِي يَوْمٍ لاَ يَحِلُّ فِيهِ حَمْلُهُ، يَعْنِي الْحَجَّاجَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu ya'quwba, qaala haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu sa'iydi bni 'amriw bni sa'iydi bni al'aasi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala dakhala alhajjaaju 'alaa abni 'umara waaanaa 'indahu, faqaala kayfa huwa faqaala saalihun‏.‏ faqaala man aasaabaka qaala aasaabaniy man aamara bihamli alssilaahi fiy yawmin laa yahillu fiyhi hamluhu, ya'niy alhajjaaja‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin `Amr bin Sa`id bin Al-`Aas:Al-Hajjaj went to Ibn `Umar while I was present there. Al-Hajjaj asked Ibn `Umar, "How are you?" Ibn `Umar replied, "I am all right," Al-Hajjaj asked, "Who wounded you?" Ibn `Umar replied, "The person who allowed arms to be carried on the day on which it was forbidden to carry them (he meant Al-Hajjaj)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا نَبْدَأُ بِهِ فِي يَوْمِنَا هَذَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ ثُمَّ نَرْجِعَ فَنَنْحَرَ، فَمَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ أَصَابَ سُنَّتَنَا، وَمَنْ ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ لَحْمٌ عَجَّلَهُ لأَهْلِهِ، لَيْسَ مِنَ النُّسُكِ فِي شَىْءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ خَالِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ نِيَارٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَنَا ذَبَحْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ وَعِنْدِي جَذَعَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ مُسِنَّةٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اجْعَلْهَا مَكَانَهَا ـ أَوْ قَالَ اذْبَحْهَا ـ وَلَنْ تَجْزِيَ جَذَعَةٌ عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an zubaydin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala khatabanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alnnahri qaala ‏"‏ iinna aawwala maa nabdaau bihi fiy yawminaa hadhaa aan nusalliya thumma narji'a fananhara, faman fa'ala dhalika faqad aasaaba sunnatanaa, waman dhabaha qabla aan yusalliya faiinnamaa huwa lahmun 'ajjalahu laahlihi, laysa mina alnnusuki fiy shaa'in ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaama khaaliy aabuw burdaaa bnu niyaarin faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, aanaa dhabahtu qabla aan ausalliya wa'indiy jadha'aaun khayrun min musinnaain‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aj'alhaa makaanahaa aaw qaala adhbahhaa walan tajziya jadha'aaun 'an aahadin ba'daka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara':The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered the Khutba on the day of Nahr (`Id-ul-Adha) and said, "The first thing we should do on this day of ours is to pray and then return and slaughter (our sacrifices). So anyone who does so he acted according to our Sunna; and whoever slaughtered before the prayer then it was just meat that he offered to his family and would not be considered as a sacrifice in any way. My uncle Abu Burda bin Niyar got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I slaughtered the sacrifice before the prayer but I have a young she-goat which is better than an older sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Slaughter it in lieu of the first and such a goat will not be considered as a sacrifice for anybody else after you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ الْبَطِينِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا الْعَمَلُ فِي أَيَّامِ الْعَشْرِ أَفْضَلَ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ فِي هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ الْجِهَادُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ الْجِهَادُ، إِلاَّ رَجُلٌ خَرَجَ يُخَاطِرُ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ فَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ بِشَىْءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ar'araaa, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sulaymaana, 'an muslimin albatiyni, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏"‏ maa al'amalu fiy aayyaami al'ashri aafdala mina al'amali fiy hadhihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa walaa aljihaadu qaala ‏"‏ walaa aljihaadu, iilaaa rajulun kharaja yukhaatiru binafsihi wamaalihi falam yarji' bishaa'in ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No good deeds done on other days are superior to those done on these (first ten days of Dhul Hijja)." Then some companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Not even Jihad?" He replied, "Not even Jihad, except that of a man who does it by putting himself and his property in danger (for Allah's sake) and does not return with any of those things
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسًا وَنَحْنُ غَادِيَانِ مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ عَنِ التَّلْبِيَةِ كَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ كَانَ يُلَبِّي الْمُلَبِّي لاَ يُنْكَرُ عَلَيْهِ، وَيُكَبِّرُ الْمُكَبِّرُ فَلاَ يُنْكَرُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa maaliku bnu aanasin, qaala haddathaniy muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin althhaqafiyyu, qaala saaaltu aanasana wanahnu ghaadiyaani min minana iilaa 'arafaatin 'ani alttalbiyaai kayfa kuntum tasna'uwna ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala kaana yulabbiy almulabbiy laa yunkaru 'alayhi, wayukabbiru almukabbiru falaa yunkaru 'alayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad bin Abi Bakr Al-Thaqafi:While we were going from Mina to `Arafat, I asked Anas bin Malik, about Talbiya, "How did you use to say Talbiya in the company of the Prophet?" Anas said: "People used to say Talbiya and their saying was not objected to and they used to say Takbir and that was not objected to either
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا نُؤْمَرُ أَنْ نَخْرُجَ يَوْمَ الْعِيدِ، حَتَّى نُخْرِجَ الْبِكْرَ مِنْ خِدْرِهَا، حَتَّى نُخْرِجَ الْحُيَّضَ فَيَكُنَّ خَلْفَ النَّاسِ، فَيُكَبِّرْنَ بِتَكْبِيرِهِمْ، وَيَدْعُونَ بِدُعَائِهِمْ يَرْجُونَ بَرَكَةَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَطُهْرَتَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, qaala haddathanaa aabiy, 'an 'aasimin, 'an hafsaaa, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat kunnaa nuumaru aan nakhruja yawma al'iydi, hattaa nukhrija albikra min khidrihaa, hattaa nukhrija alhuyyada fayakunna khalfa alnnaasi, fayukabbirna bitakbiyrihim, wayad'uwna bidu'aaiihim yarjuwna barakaaa dhalika alyawmi watuhratahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um `Atiya:We used to be ordered to come out on the Day of `Id and even bring out the virgin girls from their houses and menstruating women so that they might stand behind the men and say Takbir along with them and invoke Allah along with them and hope for the blessings of that day and for purification from sins
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ تُرْكَزُ الْحَرْبَةُ قُدَّامَهُ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ وَالنَّحْرِ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana turkazu alharbaau quddaamahu yawma alfitri waalnnahri thumma yusalliy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar: On the day of `Id-ul-Fitr and `Id-ul-Adha a spear used to be planted in front of the Prophet (as a Sutra for the prayer) and then he would pray
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَمْرٍو، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْدُو إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى، وَالْعَنَزَةُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، تُحْمَلُ وَتُنْصَبُ بِالْمُصَلَّى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَيُصَلِّي إِلَيْهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, qaala haddathanaa alwaliydu, qaala haddathanaa aabuw 'amrinw, qaala aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaghduw iilaa almusallaa, waal'anazaau bayna yadayhi, tuhmalu watunsabu bialmusallaa bayna yadayhi fayusalliy iilayhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to proceed to the Musalla and an 'Anaza used to be carried before him and planted in the Musalla in front of him and he would pray facing it (as a Sutra)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ أُمِرْنَا أَنْ نُخْرِجَ، الْعَوَاتِقَ وَذَوَاتِ الْخُدُورِ‏.‏ وَعَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنَحْوِهِ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ حَفْصَةَ قَالَ أَوْ قَالَتِ الْعَوَاتِقَ وَذَوَاتِ الْخُدُورِ، وَيَعْتَزِلْنَ الْحُيَّضُ الْمُصَلَّى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alwahhaabi, qaala haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat aumirnaa aan nukhrija, al'awaatiqa wadhawaati alkhuduwri‏.‏ wa'an aayyuwba 'an hafsaaa binahwihi‏.‏ wazaada fiy hadiythi hafsaaa qaala aaw qaalati al'awaatiqa wadhawaati alkhuduwri, waya'tazilna alhuyyadu almusallaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad:Um 'Atiyya said: "Our Prophet ordered us to come out (on `Id day) with the mature girls and the virgins staying in seclusion." Hafsa narrated the above mentioned Hadith and added, "The mature girls or virgins staying in seclusion but the menstruating women had to keep away from the Musalla
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ فِطْرٍ أَوْ أَضْحَى، فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ خَطَبَ، ثُمَّ أَتَى النِّسَاءَ فَوَعَظَهُنَّ وَذَكَّرَهُنَّ، وَأَمَرَهُنَّ بِالصَّدَقَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'abbaasin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, qaala kharajtu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma fitrin aaw aadhaa, fasallaa thumma khataba, thumma aataa alnnisaa'a fawa'azahunna wadhakkarahunna, waaamarahunna bialssadaqaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I (in my boyhood) went out with the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day of `Id ul Fitr or Id-ul-Adha. The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed and then delivered the Khutba and then went towards the women, preached and advised them and ordered them to give alms
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ أَضْحًى إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ نُسُكِنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هَذَا أَنْ نَبْدَأَ بِالصَّلاَةِ، ثُمَّ نَرْجِعَ فَنَنْحَرَ، فَمَنْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ وَافَقَ سُنَّتَنَا، وَمَنْ ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ شَىْءٌ عَجَّلَهُ لأَهْلِهِ، لَيْسَ مِنَ النُّسُكِ فِي شَىْءٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي ذَبَحْتُ وَعِنْدِي جَذَعَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ مُسِنَّةٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْبَحْهَا، وَلاَ تَفِي عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa muhammadu bnu talhaaa, 'an zubaydin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma aadhana iilaa albaqiy'i fasallaa rak'atayni, thumma aaqbala 'alaynaa biwajhihi waqaala ‏"‏ iinna aawwala nusukinaa fiy yawminaa hadhaa aan nabdaaa bialssalaaai, thumma narji'a fananhara, faman fa'ala dhalika faqad waafaqa sunnatanaa, waman dhabaha qabla dhalika faiinnamaa huwa shaa'un 'ajjalahu laahlihi, laysa mina alnnusuki fiy shaa'in ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaama rajulun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, iinniy dhabahtu wa'indiy jadha'aaun khayrun min musinnaain‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adhbahhaa, walaa tafiy 'an aahadin ba'daka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara':The Prophet (ﷺ) went towards Al-Baqi (the graveyard at Medina) on the day of Id-ul-Adha and offered a two-rak`at prayer (of `Id-ul-Adha) and then faced us and said, "On this day of ours, our first act of worship is the offering of prayer and then we will return and slaughter the sacrifice, and whoever does this concords with our Sunna; and whoever slaughtered his sacrifice before that (i.e. before the prayer) then that was a thing which he prepared earlier for his family and it would not be considered as a Nusuk (sacrifice.)" A man stood up and said, "O, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I slaughtered (the animal before the prayer) but I have a young she-goat which is better than an older sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "Slaughter it. But a similar sacrifice will not be sufficient for anybody else after you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَابِسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قِيلَ لَهُ أَشَهِدْتَ الْعِيدَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ، وَلَوْلاَ مَكَانِي مِنَ الصِّغَرِ مَا شَهِدْتُهُ، حَتَّى أَتَى الْعَلَمَ الَّذِي عِنْدَ دَارِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ خَطَبَ ثُمَّ أَتَى النِّسَاءَ، وَمَعَهُ بِلاَلٌ، فَوَعَظَهُنَّ وَذَكَّرَهُنَّ، وَأَمَرَهُنَّ بِالصَّدَقَةِ، فَرَأَيْتُهُنَّ يُهْوِينَ بِأَيْدِيهِنَّ يَقْذِفْنَهُ فِي ثَوْبِ بِلاَلٍ، ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ هُوَ وَبِلاَلٌ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an sufyaana, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'aabisin, qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, qiyla lahu aashahidta al'iyda ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am, walawlaa makaaniy mina alssighari maa shahidtuhu, hattaa aataa al'alama alladhiy 'inda daari kathiyri bni alssalti fasallaa thumma khataba thumma aataa alnnisaa'a, wama'ahu bilaalun, fawa'azahunna wadhakkarahunna, waaamarahunna bialssadaqaai, faraaaytuhunna yuhwiyna biaaydiyhinna yaqdhifnahu fiy thawbi bilaalin, thumma antalaqa huwa wabilaalun iilaa baytihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin `Abis:Ibn `Abbas was asked whether he had joined the Prophet (ﷺ) in the `Id prayer. He said, "Yes. And I could not have joined him had I not been young. (The Prophet (ﷺ) came out) till he reached the mark which was near the house of Kathir bin As-Salt, offered the prayer, delivered the Khutba and then went towards the women. Bilal was accompanying him. He preached to them and advised them and ordered them to give alms. I saw the women putting their ornaments with their outstretched hands into Bilal's garment. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) along with Bilal returned home
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ نَصْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ، فَصَلَّى فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّلاَةِ ثُمَّ خَطَبَ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ نَزَلَ فَأَتَى النِّسَاءَ، فَذَكَّرَهُنَّ وَهْوَ يَتَوَكَّأُ عَلَى يَدِ بِلاَلٍ وَبِلاَلٌ بَاسِطٌ ثَوْبَهُ، يُلْقِي فِيهِ النِّسَاءُ الصَّدَقَةَ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ زَكَاةَ يَوْمِ الْفِطْرِ قَالَ لاَ وَلَكِنْ صَدَقَةً يَتَصَدَّقْنَ حِينَئِذٍ، تُلْقِي فَتَخَهَا وَيُلْقِينَ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَتُرَى حَقًّا عَلَى الإِمَامِ ذَلِكَ وَيُذَكِّرُهُنَّ قَالَ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَمَا لَهُمْ لاَ يَفْعَلُونَهُ
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma bni nasrin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaala haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala sami'tuhu yaquwlu qaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alfitri, fasallaa fabadaaa bialssalaaai thumma khataba, falammaa faragha nazala faaataa alnnisaa'a, fadhakkarahunna wahwa yatawakkaau 'alaa yadi bilaalin wabilaalun baasitun thawbahu, yulqiy fiyhi alnnisaa'u alssadaqaaa‏.‏ qultu li'ataa'in zakaaaa yawmi alfitri qaala laa walakin sadaqaaan yatasaddaqna hiynaiidhin, tulqiy fatakhahaa wayulqiyna‏.‏ qultu aaturaa haqqana 'alaa aliimaami dhalika wayudhakkiruhunna qaala iinnahu lahaqqun 'alayhim, wamaa lahum laa yaf'aluwnahu
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Juraij:`Ata' told me that he had heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) stood up to offer the prayer of the `Id ul Fitr. He first offered the prayer and then delivered the Khutba. After finishing it he got down (from the pulpit) and went towards the women and advised them while he was leaning on Bilal's hand. Bilal was spreading out his garment where the women were putting their alms." I asked `Ata' whether it was the Zakat of `Id ul Fitr. He said, "No, it was just alms given at that time. Some lady put her finger ring and the others would do the same." I said, (to `Ata'), "Do you think that it is incumbent upon the Imam to give advice to the women (on `Id day)?" He said, "No doubt, it is incumbent upon the Imams to do so and why should they not do so?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ شَهِدْتُ الْفِطْرَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ يُصَلُّونَهَا قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ، ثُمَّ يُخْطَبُ بَعْدُ، خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ حِينَ يُجْلِسُ بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ يَشُقُّهُمْ حَتَّى جَاءَ النِّسَاءَ مَعَهُ بِلاَلٌ فَقَالَ ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ‏}‏ الآيَةَ ثُمَّ قَالَ حِينَ فَرَغَ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ آنْتُنَّ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ لَمْ يُجِبْهُ غَيْرُهَا نَعَمْ‏.‏ لاَ يَدْرِي حَسَنٌ مَنْ هِيَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَتَصَدَّقْنَ ‏"‏ فَبَسَطَ بِلاَلٌ ثَوْبَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ هَلُمَّ لَكُنَّ فِدَاءٌ أَبِي وَأُمِّي، فَيُلْقِينَ الْفَتَخَ وَالْخَوَاتِيمَ فِي ثَوْبِ بِلاَلٍ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ الْفَتَخُ الْخَوَاتِيمُ الْعِظَامُ كَانَتْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala abnu jurayjin waaakhbaraniy alhasanu bnu muslimin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala shahidtu alfitra ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabiy bakrin wa'umara wa'uthmaana rda allh 'nhm yusalluwnahaa qabla alkhutbaai, thumma yukhtabu ba'du, kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm kaaanniy aanzuru iilayhi hiyna yujlisu biyadihi, thumma aaqbala yashuqquhum hattaa jaa'a alnnisaa'a ma'ahu bilaalun faqaala ‏{‏yaa aayyuhaa alnnabiyyu iidhaa jaa'aka almuuminaatu yubaayi'naka‏}‏ alayaaa thumma qaala hiyna faragha minhaa ‏"‏ antunna 'alaa dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalati amraaaaun waahidaaun minhunna lam yujibhu ghayruhaa na'am‏.‏ laa yadriy hasanun man hiya‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fatasaddaqna ‏"‏ fabasata bilaalun thawbahu thumma qaala halumma lakunna fidaa'un aabiy waaummiy, fayulqiyna alfatakha waalkhawaatiyma fiy thawbi bilaalin‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alrrazzaaqi alfatakhu alkhawaatiymu al'izaamu kaanat fiy aljaahiliyyaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Hasan bin Muslim told me that Ibn `Abbas had said, "I joined the Prophet, Abu Bakr, `Umar and `Uthman in the `Id ul Fitr prayers. They used to offer the prayer before the Khutba and then they used to deliver the Khutba afterwards. Once the Prophet (ﷺ) I came out (for the `Id prayer) as if I were just observing him waving to the people to sit down. He, then accompanied by Bilal, came crossing the rows till he reached the women. He recited the following verse:'O Prophet! When the believing women come to you to take the oath of fealty to you . . . (to the end of the verse) (60.12).' After finishing the recitation he said, "O ladies! Are you fulfilling your covenant?" None except one woman said, "Yes." Hasan did not know who was that woman. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Then give alms." Bilal spread his garment and said, "Keep on giving alms. Let my father and mother sacrifice their lives for you (ladies)." So the ladies kept on putting their Fatkhs (big rings) and other kinds of rings in Bilal's garment." `Abdur-Razaq said, " 'Fatkhs' is a big ring which used to be worn in the (Pre-Islamic) period of ignorance
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا نَمْنَعُ جَوَارِيَنَا أَنْ يَخْرُجْنَ يَوْمَ الْعِيدِ، فَجَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ فَنَزَلَتْ قَصْرَ بَنِي خَلَفٍ فَأَتَيْتُهَا فَحَدَّثَتْ أَنَّ زَوْجَ أُخْتِهَا غَزَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ غَزْوَةً فَكَانَتْ أُخْتُهَا مَعَهُ فِي سِتِّ غَزَوَاتٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ فَكُنَّا نَقُومُ عَلَى الْمَرْضَى وَنُدَاوِي الْكَلْمَى، فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، عَلَى إِحْدَانَا بَأْسٌ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا جِلْبَابٌ أَنْ لاَ تَخْرُجَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لِتُلْبِسْهَا صَاحِبَتُهَا مِنْ جِلْبَابِهَا فَلْيَشْهَدْنَ الْخَيْرَ وَدَعْوَةَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَتْ أُمُّ عَطِيَّةَ أَتَيْتُهَا، فَسَأَلْتُهَا أَسَمِعْتِ فِي كَذَا وَكَذَا قَالَتْ نَعَمْ، بِأَبِي ـ وَقَلَّمَا ذَكَرَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ قَالَتْ بِأَبِي ـ قَالَ ‏"‏ لِيَخْرُجِ الْعَوَاتِقُ ذَوَاتُ الْخُدُورِ ـ أَوْ قَالَ الْعَوَاتِقُ وَذَوَاتُ الْخُدُورِ شَكَّ أَيُّوبُ ـ وَالْحُيَّضُ، وَيَعْتَزِلُ الْحُيَّضُ الْمُصَلَّى، وَلْيَشْهَدْنَ الْخَيْرَ وَدَعْوَةَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا آلْحُيَّضُ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ، أَلَيْسَ الْحَائِضُ تَشْهَدُ عَرَفَاتٍ وَتَشْهَدُ كَذَا وَتَشْهَدُ كَذَا
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, qaala haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an hafsaaa binti siyriyna, qaalat kunnaa namna'u jawaariyanaa aan yakhrujna yawma al'iydi, fajaa'ati amraaaaun fanazalat qasra baniy khalafin faaataytuhaa fahaddathat aanna zawja aukhtihaa ghazaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thintaa 'ashraaa ghazwaaan fakaanat aukhtuhaa ma'ahu fiy sitti ghazawaatin‏.‏ faqaalat fakunnaa naquwmu 'alaa almardaa wanudaawiy alkalmaa, faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi, 'alaa iihdaanaa baasun iidhaa lam yakun lahaa jilbaabun aan laa takhruja faqaala ‏"‏ litulbishaa saahibatuhaa min jilbaabihaa falyashhadna alkhayra wada'waaa almuuminiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat hafsaau falammaa qadimat aummu 'atiyyaaa aataytuhaa, fasaaaltuhaa aasami'ti fiy kadhaa wakadhaa qaalat na'am, biaabiy waqallamaa dhakarati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa qaalat biaabiy qaala ‏"‏ liyakhruji al'awaatiqu dhawaatu alkhuduwri aaw qaala al'awaatiqu wadhawaatu alkhuduwri shakka aayyuwbu waalhuyyadu, waya'tazilu alhuyyadu almusallaa, walyashhadna alkhayra wada'waaa almuuminiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat faqultu lahaa alhuyyadu qaalat na'am, aalaysa alhaaiidu tashhadu 'arafaatin watashhadu kadhaa watashhadu kadhaa
verses.translation: Narrated Aiyub:Hafsa bint Seereen said, "On Id we used to forbid our girls to go out for `Id prayer. A lady came and stayed at the palace of Bani Khalaf and I went to her. She said, 'The husband of my sister took part in twelve holy battles along with the Prophet (ﷺ) and my sister was with her husband in six of them. My sister said that they used to nurse the sick and treat the wounded. Once she asked, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! If a woman has no veil, is there any harm if she does not come out (on `Id day)?' The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Her companion should let her share her veil with her, and the women should participate in the good deeds and in the religious gatherings of the believers.' " Hafsa added, "When Um-`Atiya came, I went to her and asked her, 'Did you hear anything about so-and-so?' Um-`Atiya said, 'Yes, let my father be sacrificed for the Prophet (ﷺ). (And whenever she mentioned the name of the Prophet (ﷺ) she always used to say, 'Let my father be sacrificed for him'). He said, 'Virgin mature girls staying often screened (or said, 'Mature girls and virgins staying often screened--Aiyub is not sure as which was right) and menstruating women should come out (on the `Id day). But the menstruating women should keep away from the Musalla. And all the women should participate in the good deeds and in the religious gatherings of the believers'." Hafsa said, "On that I said to Um-`Atiya, 'Also those who are menstruating?' " Um-`Atiya replied, "Yes. Do they not present themselves at `Arafat and elsewhere?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَتْ أُمُّ عَطِيَّةَ أُمِرْنَا أَنْ نَخْرُجَ فَنُخْرِجَ الْحُيَّضَ وَالْعَوَاتِقَ وَذَوَاتِ الْخُدُورِ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ أَوِ الْعَوَاتِقَ ذَوَاتِ الْخُدُورِ، فَأَمَّا الْحُيَّضُ فَيَشْهَدْنَ جَمَاعَةَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَدَعْوَتَهُمْ، وَيَعْتَزِلْنَ مُصَلاَّهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an muhammadin, qaala qaalat aummu 'atiyyaaa aumirnaa aan nakhruja fanukhrija alhuyyada waal'awaatiqa wadhawaati alkhuduwri‏.‏ qaala abnu 'awnin aawi al'awaatiqa dhawaati alkhuduwri, faaammaa alhuyyadu fayashhadna jamaa'aaa almuslimiyna wada'watahum, waya'tazilna musalaaahum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um-`Atiya:We were ordered to go out (for `Id) and also to take along with us the menstruating women, mature girls and virgins staying in seclusion. (Ibn `Aun said, "Or mature virgins staying in seclusion)." The menstruating women could present themselves at the religious gathering and invocation of Muslims but should keep away from their Musalla
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي كَثِيرُ بْنُ فَرْقَدٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَنْحَرُ أَوْ يَذْبَحُ بِالْمُصَلَّى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, qaala haddathaniy kathiyru bnu farqadin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yanharu aaw yadhbahu bialmusallaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to Nahr or slaughter sacrifices at the Musalla (on `Id-ul-Adha)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ الْمُعْتَمِرِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ صَلَّى صَلاَتَنَا وَنَسَكَ نُسْكَنَا فَقَدْ أَصَابَ النُّسُكَ، وَمَنْ نَسَكَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَتِلْكَ شَاةُ لَحْمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَامَ أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ نِيَارٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ نَسَكْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ، وَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّ الْيَوْمَ يَوْمُ أَكْلٍ وَشُرْبٍ فَتَعَجَّلْتُ وَأَكَلْتُ وَأَطْعَمْتُ أَهْلِي وَجِيرَانِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تِلْكَ شَاةُ لَحْمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّ عِنْدِي عَنَاقَ جَذَعَةٍ، هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ شَاتَىْ لَحْمٍ، فَهَلْ تَجْزِي عَنِّي قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ، وَلَنْ تَجْزِيَ عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, qaala haddathanaa mansuwru bnu almu'tamiri, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, qaala khatabanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alnnahri ba'da alssalaaai faqaala ‏"‏ man sallaa salaatanaa wanasaka nuskanaa faqad aasaaba alnnusuka, waman nasaka qabla alssalaaai fatilka shaaau lahmin ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaama aabuw burdaaa bnu niyaarin faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi waalllahi laqad nasaktu qabla aan aakhruja iilaa alssalaaai, wa'araftu aanna alyawma yawmu aaklin washurbin fata'ajjaltu waaakaltu waaat'amtu aahliy wajiyraaniy‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tilka shaaau lahmin ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faiinna 'indiy 'anaaqa jadha'aain, hiya khayrun min shaataa lahmin, fahal tajziy 'anniy qaala ‏"‏ na'am, walan tajziya 'an aahadin ba'daka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara' bin `Azib:On the day of Nahr Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered the Khutba after the `Id prayer and said, "Anyone who prayed like us and slaughtered the sacrifice like we did then he acted according to our (Nusuk) tradition of sacrificing, and whoever slaughtered the sacrifice before the prayer, then that was just mutton (i.e. not sacrifice)." Abu Burda bin Niyar stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, I slaughtered my sacrifice before I offered the (Id) prayer and thought that today was the day of eating and drinking (non-alcoholic drinks) and so I made haste (in slaughtering) and ate and also fed my family and neighbors." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "That was just mutton (not a sacrifice)." Then Abu Burda said, "I have a young she-goat and no doubt, it is better than two sheep. Will that be sufficient as a sacrifice for me?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Yes. But it will not be sufficient for anyone else (as a sacrifice), after you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، ثُمَّ خَطَبَ فَأَمَرَ مَنْ ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ ذَبْحَهُ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، جِيرَانٌ لِي ـ إِمَّا قَالَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ، وَإِمَّا قَالَ بِهِمْ فَقْرٌ ـ وَإِنِّي ذَبَحْتُ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ وَعِنْدِي عَنَاقٌ لِي أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ شَاتَىْ لَحْمٍ‏.‏ فَرَخَّصَ لَهُ فِيهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haamidu bnu 'umara, 'an hammaadi bni zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, aanna aanasa bna maalikin, qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa yawma alnnahri, thumma khataba faaamara man dhabaha qabla alssalaaai aan yu'iyda dhabhahu faqaama rajulun mina alaansaari faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, jiyraanun liy iimmaa qaala bihim khasaasaaun, waiimmaa qaala bihim faqrun waiinniy dhabahtu qabla alssalaaai wa'indiy 'anaaqun liy aahabbu iilaaaa min shaataa lahmin‏.‏ farakhhasa lahu fiyhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the prayer on the day of Nahr and then delivered the Khutba and ordered that whoever had slaughtered his sacrifice before the prayer should repeat it, that is, should slaughter another sacrifice. Then a person from the Ansar stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! because of my neighbors (he described them as being very needy or poor) I slaughtered before the prayer. I have a young she-goat which, in my opinion, is better than two sheep." The Prophet (ﷺ) gave him the permission for slaughtering it as a sacrifice
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ثُمَّ خَطَبَ، ثُمَّ ذَبَحَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فَلْيَذْبَحْ أُخْرَى مَكَانَهَا، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَذْبَحْ فَلْيَذْبَحْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an jundabin, qaala sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alnnahri thumma khataba, thumma dhabaha faqaala ‏ "‏ man dhabaha qabla aan yusalliya falyadhbah aukhraa makaanahaa, waman lam yadhbah falyadhbah biasmi alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jundab:On the day of Nahr the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the prayer and delivered the Khutba and then slaughtered the sacrifice and said, "Anybody who slaughtered (his sacrifice) before the prayer should slaughter another animal in lieu of it, and the one who has not yet slaughtered should slaughter the sacrifice mentioning Allah's name on it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو تُمَيْلَةَ، يَحْيَى بْنُ وَاضِحٍ عَنْ فُلَيْحِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ عِيدٍ خَالَفَ الطَّرِيقَ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ فُلَيْحٍ‏.‏ وَحَدِيثُ جَابِرٍ أَصَحُّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw tumaylaaa, yahyaa bnu waadihin 'an fulayhi bni sulaymaana, 'an sa'iydi bni alhaarithi, 'an jaabirin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa kaana yawmu 'iydin khaalafa alttariyqa‏.‏ taaba'ahu yuwnusu bnu muhammadin 'an fulayhin‏.‏ wahadiythu jaabirin aasahhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the Day of `Id the Prophet (ﷺ) used to return (after offering the `Id prayer) through a way different from that by which he went
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا وَعِنْدَهَا جَارِيَتَانِ فِي أَيَّامِ مِنًى تُدَفِّفَانِ وَتَضْرِبَانِ، وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُتَغَشٍّ بِثَوْبِهِ، فَانْتَهَرَهُمَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَكَشَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعْهُمَا يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَإِنَّهَا أَيَّامُ عِيدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَتِلْكَ الأَيَّامُ أَيَّامُ مِنًى‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتُرُنِي، وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْحَبَشَةِ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَزَجَرَهُمْ عُمَرُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ دَعْهُمْ، أَمْنًا بَنِي أَرْفِدَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ يَعْنِي مِنَ الأَمْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh dakhala 'alayhaa wa'indahaa jaariyataani fiy aayyaami minana tudaffifaani watadribaani, waalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mutaghashhin bithawbihi, faantaharahumaa aabuw bakrin fakashafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an wajhihi faqaala ‏"‏ da'humaa yaa aabaa bakrin faiinnahaa aayyaamu 'iydin ‏"‏‏.‏ watilka alaayyaamu aayyaamu minana‏.‏ waqaalat 'aaiishaau raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yasturuniy, waaanaa aanzuru iilaa alhabashaai wahum yal'abuwna fiy almasjidi, fazajarahum 'umaru faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ da'hum, aamnana baniy aarfidaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ ya'niy mina alaamni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa on the authority of `Aisha:On the days of Mina, (11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhul-Hijjah) Abu Bakr came to her while two young girls were beating the tambourine and the Prophet (ﷺ) was lying covered with his clothes. Abu Bakr scolded them and the Prophet (ﷺ) uncovered his face and said to Abu Bakr, "Leave them, for these days are the days of `Id and the days of Mina." `Aisha further said, "Once the Prophet (ﷺ) was screening me and I was watching the display of black slaves in the Mosque and (`Umar) scolded them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Leave them. O Bani Arfida! (carry on), you are safe (protected)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ لَمْ يُصَلِّ قَبْلَهَا وَلاَ بَعْدَهَا وَمَعَهُ بِلاَلٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathaniy 'adiyyu bnu thaabitin, qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja yawma alfitri, fasallaa rak'atayni lam yusalli qablahaa walaa ba'dahaa wama'ahu bilaalun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out and offered a two rak`at prayer on the Day of `Id ul Fitr and did not offer any other prayer before or after it and at that time Bilal was accompanying him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، فَإِذَا خَشِيَ أَحَدُكُمُ الصُّبْحَ صَلَّى رَكْعَةً وَاحِدَةً، تُوتِرُ لَهُ مَا قَدْ صَلَّى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, wa'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rajulaan, saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an salaaai alllayli faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ salaaau alllayli mathnaa mathnaa, faiidhaa khashiya aahadukumu alssubha sallaa rak'aaan waahidaaan, tuwtiru lahu maa qad sallaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar: Once a person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the night prayer. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) replied, "The night prayer is offered as two Rak`at followed by two Rak`at and so on and if anyone is afraid of the approaching dawn (Fajr prayer) he should pray one Rak`ah and this will be a Witr for all the Rak`at which he has prayed before
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَعَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، كَانَ يُسَلِّمُ بَيْنَ الرَّكْعَةِ وَالرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فِي الْوِتْرِ، حَتَّى يَأْمُرَ بِبَعْضِ حَاجَتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, kaana yusallimu bayna alrrak'aai waalrrak'atayni fiy alwitri, hattaa yaamura biba'di haajatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi` told that `Abdullah bin `Umar used to say Taslim between (the first) two Rak`at and (the third) odd one in the Witr prayer, when he wanted to attend to a certain matter (during that interval between the Rak`at)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، بَاتَ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ، وَهْىَ خَالَتُهُ، فَاضْطَجَعْتُ فِي عَرْضِ وِسَادَةٍ، وَاضْطَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْلُهُ فِي طُولِهَا، فَنَامَ حَتَّى انْتَصَفَ اللَّيْلُ أَوْ قَرِيبًا مِنْهُ، فَاسْتَيْقَظَ يَمْسَحُ النَّوْمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقَةٍ، فَتَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَهُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رَأْسِي، وَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي يَفْتِلُهَا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى جَاءَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ، خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an makhramaaa bni sulaymaana, 'an kuraybin, aanna abna 'abbaasin, aakhbarahu aannahu, baata 'inda maymuwnaaa, wahaa khaalatuhu, faadtaja'tu fiy 'ardi wisaadaain, waadtaja'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaahluhu fiy tuwlihaa, fanaama hattaa antasafa alllaylu aaw qariybana minhu, faastayqaza yamsahu alnnawma 'an wajhihi, thumma qaraaa 'ashra ayaatin min ali 'imraana, thumma qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa shannin mu'allaqaain, fatawaddaaa faaahsana alwuduw'a, thumma qaama yusalliy fasana'tu mithlahu faqumtu iilaa janbihi, fawada'a yadahu alyumnaa 'alaa raasiy, waaakhadha biaudhuniy yaftiluhaa, thumma sallaa rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma aawtara, thumma adtaja'a hattaa jaa'ahu almuuadhhinu faqaama fasallaa rak'atayni thumma, kharaja fasallaa alssubha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Once I passed the night in the house of Maimuna (his aunt). I slept across the bed while Allah's Apostle and his wife slept length-wise. The Prophet (ﷺ) slept till midnight or nearly so and woke up rubbing his face and recited ten verses from Surat "Al-`Imran." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went towards a leather skin and performed ablution in the most perfect way and then stood for the prayer. I did the same and stood beside him. The Prophet (ﷺ) put his right hand on my head, twisted my ear and then prayed two rak`at five times and then ended his prayer with witr. He laid down till the Mu'adh-dhin came then he stood up and offered two rak`at (Sunnah of Fajr prayer) and then went out and offered the Fajr prayer. (See Hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، فَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَنْصَرِفَ فَارْكَعْ رَكْعَةً تُوتِرُ لَكَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ الْقَاسِمُ وَرَأَيْنَا أُنَاسًا مُنْذُ أَدْرَكْنَا يُوتِرُونَ بِثَلاَثٍ، وَإِنَّ كُلاًّ لَوَاسِعٌ أَرْجُو أَنْ لاَ يَكُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِنْهُ بَأْسٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, qaala haddathaniy abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna alqaasimi, haddathahu 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ salaaau alllayli mathnaa mathnaa, faiidhaa aaradta aan tansarifa faarka' rak'aaan tuwtiru laka maa sallayta ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala alqaasimu waraaaynaa aunaasana mundhu aadraknaa yuwtiruwna bithalaathin, waiinna kulaaan lawaasi'un aarjuw aan laa yakuwna bishaa'in minhu baasun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Night prayer is offered as two rak`at followed by two rak`at and so on, and if you want to finish it, pray only one rak`a which will be witr for all the previous rak`at." Al-Qasim said, "Since we attained the age of puberty we have seen some people offering a three-rak`at prayer as witr and all that is permissible. I hope there will be no harm in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، كَانَتْ تِلْكَ صَلاَتَهُ ـ تَعْنِي بِاللَّيْلِ ـ فَيَسْجُدُ السَّجْدَةَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ قَدْرَ مَا يَقْرَأُ أَحَدُكُمْ خَمْسِينَ آيَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ رَأْسَهُ، وَيَرْكَعُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ، ثُمَّ يَضْطَجِعُ عَلَى شِقِّهِ الأَيْمَنِ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ لِلصَّلاَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, aanna 'aaiishaaa, aakhbarathu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy iihdaa 'ashraaa rak'aaan, kaanat tilka salaatahu ta'niy bialllayli fayasjudu alssajdaaa min dhalika qadra maa yaqraau aahadukum khamsiyna ayaaan qabla aan yarfa'a raasahu, wayarka'u rak'atayni qabla salaaai alfajri, thumma yadtaji'u 'alaa shiqqihi alaaymani hattaa yaatiyahu almuuadhhinu lilssalaaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `A'isha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray eleven rak`at at night and that was his night prayer and each of his prostrations lasted for a period enough for one of you to recite fifty verses before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised his head. He also used to pray two rak`at (Sunnah) before the (compulsory) Fajr prayer and then lie down on his right side till the Mu'adh-dhin came to him for the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ أَرَأَيْتَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الْغَدَاةِ أُطِيلُ فِيهِمَا الْقِرَاءَةَ فَقَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، وَيُوتِرُ بِرَكْعَةٍ وَيُصَلِّي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الْغَدَاةِ وَكَأَنَّ الأَذَانَ بِأُذُنَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ حَمَّادٌ أَىْ سُرْعَةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, qaala haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, qaala haddathanaa aanasu bnu siyriyna, qaala qultu laibni 'umara aaraaayta alrrak'atayni qabla salaaai alghadaaai autiylu fiyhimaa alqiraa'aaa faqaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy mina alllayli mathnaa mathnaa, wayuwtiru birak'aain wayusalliy alrrak'atayni qabla salaaai alghadaaai wakaaanna alaadhaana biaudhunayhi‏.‏ qaala hammaadun aaa sur'aaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Seereen:I asked Ibn `Umar, "What is your opinion about the two rak`at before the Fajr (compulsory) prayer, as to prolonging the recitation in them?" He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to pray at night two rak`at followed by two and so on, and end the prayer by one rak`ah witr. He used to offer two rak`at before the Fajr prayer immediately after the Adhan." (Hammad, the sub-narrator said, "That meant (that he prayed) quickly
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُسْلِمٌ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُلَّ اللَّيْلِ أَوْتَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَانْتَهَى وِتْرُهُ إِلَى السَّحَرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, qaala haddathanaa aabiy qaala, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala haddathaniy muslimun, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kulla alllayli aawtara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waantahaa witruhu iilaa alssahari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered witr prayer at different nights at various hours extending (from the `Isha' prayer) up to the last hour of the night
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي، وَأَنَا رَاقِدَةٌ مُعْتَرِضَةً عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ، فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُوتِرَ أَيْقَظَنِي فَأَوْتَرْتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, qaala haddathanaa hishaamun, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy, waaanaa raaqidaaun mu'taridaaan 'alaa firaashihi, faiidhaa aaraada aan yuwtira aayqazaniy faaawtartu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `A'isha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer his night prayer while I was sleeping across in his bed. Whenever he intended to offer the witr prayer, he used to wake me up and I would offer the witr prayer too
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
