verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اجْعَلُوا آخِرَ صَلاَتِكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وِتْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, haddathaniy naafi'un, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aj'aluwa akhira salaatikum bialllayli witrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Make witr as your last prayer at night
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَسِيرُ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بِطَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ فَلَمَّا خَشِيتُ الصُّبْحَ نَزَلْتُ فَأَوْتَرْتُ، ثُمَّ لَحِقْتُهُ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَيْنَ كُنْتَ فَقُلْتُ خَشِيتُ الصُّبْحَ، فَنَزَلْتُ فَأَوْتَرْتُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَلَيْسَ لَكَ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فَقُلْتُ بَلَى وَاللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُوتِرُ عَلَى الْبَعِيرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an aabiy bakri bni 'umara bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara bni alkhattaabi, 'an sa'iydi bni yasaarin, aannahu qaala kuntu aasiyru ma'a 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara bitariyqi makkaaa faqaala sa'iydun falammaa khashiytu alssubha nazaltu faaawtartu, thumma lahiqtuhu faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara aayna kunta faqultu khashiytu alssubha, fanazaltu faaawtartu‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi aalaysa laka fiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm auswaaun hasanaaun faqultu balaa waalllahi‏.‏ qaala faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yuwtiru 'alaa alba'iyri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Yasar:I was going to Mecca in the company of `Abdullah bin `Umar and when I apprehended the approaching dawn, I dismounted and offered the witr prayer and then joined him. `Abdullah bin `Umar said, "Where have you been?" I replied, "I apprehended the approaching dawn so I dismounted and prayed the witr prayer." `Abdullah said, "Isn't it sufficient for you to follow the good example of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" I replied, "Yes, by Allah." He said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to pray witr on the back of the camel (while on a journey)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ بْنُ أَسْمَاءَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي فِي السَّفَرِ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، حَيْثُ تَوَجَّهَتْ بِهِ، يُومِئُ إِيمَاءً، صَلاَةَ اللَّيْلِ إِلاَّ الْفَرَائِضَ، وَيُوتِرُ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathanaa juwayriyaau bnu aasmaa'a, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy fiy alssafari 'alaa raahilatihi, haythu tawajjahat bihi, yuwmiiu iiymaa'an, salaaaa alllayli iilaaa alfaraaiida, wayuwtiru 'alaa raahilatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer (Nawafil) prayers on his Rahila (mount) facing its direction by signals, but not the compulsory prayer. He also used to pray witr on his (mount) Rahila
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ سُئِلَ أَنَسٌ أَقَنَتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الصُّبْحِ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَوَقَنَتَ قَبْلَ الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ يَسِيرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, qaala suiila aanasun aaqanata alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alssubhi qaala na'am‏.‏ faqiyla lahu aawaqanata qabla alrrukuw'i qaala ba'da alrrukuw'i yasiyrana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad bin Seereen:Anas was asked, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) recite Qunut in the Fajr prayer?" Anas replied in the affirmative. He was further asked, "Did he recite Qunut before bowing?" Anas replied, "He recited Qunut after bowing for some time (for one month)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ عَنِ الْقُنُوتِ،‏.‏ فَقَالَ قَدْ كَانَ الْقُنُوتُ‏.‏ قُلْتُ قَبْلَ الرُّكُوعِ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ قَالَ قَبْلَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّ فُلاَنًا أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْكَ أَنَّكَ قُلْتَ بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ كَذَبَ، إِنَّمَا قَنَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ شَهْرًا ـ أُرَاهُ ـ كَانَ بَعَثَ قَوْمًا يُقَالُ لَهُمُ الْقُرَّاءُ زُهَاءَ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلاً إِلَى قَوْمٍ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ دُونَ أُولَئِكَ، وَكَانَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَهْدٌ فَقَنَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَهْرًا يَدْعُو عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, qaala haddathanaa 'aasimun, qaala saaaltu aanasa bna maalikin 'ani alqunuwti, ‏.‏ faqaala qad kaana alqunuwtu‏.‏ qultu qabla alrrukuw'i aaw ba'dahu qaala qablahu‏.‏ qaala faiinna fulaanana aakhbaraniy 'anka aannaka qulta ba'da alrrukuw'i‏.‏ faqaala kadhaba, iinnamaa qanata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da alrrukuw'i shahrana auraahu kaana ba'atha qawmana yuqaalu lahumu alqurraa'u zuhaa'a sab'iyna rajulaan iilaa qawmin mina almushrikiyna duwna auwlaiika, wakaana baynahum wabayna rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ahdun faqanata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shahrana yad'uw 'alayhim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Asim:I asked Anas bin Malik about the Qunut. Anas replied, "Definitely it was (recited)". I asked, "Before bowing or after it?" Anas replied, "Before bowing." I added, "So and so has told me that you had informed him that it had been after bowing." Anas said, "He told an untruth (i.e. "was mistaken," according to the Hijazi dialect). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited Qunut after bowing for a period of one month." Anas added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) sent about seventy men (who knew the Qur'an by heart) towards the pagans (of Najd) who were less than they in number and there was a peace treaty between them and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (but the Pagans broke the treaty and killed the seventy men). So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited Qunut for a period of one month asking Allah to punish them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَنَتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَهْرًا يَدْعُو عَلَى رِعْلٍ وَذَكْوَانَ‏.‏
verses.translit: aakhbaranaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, qaala haddathanaa zaaiidaau, 'ani alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiy mijlazin, 'an aanasin, qaala qanata alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm shahrana yad'uw 'alaa ri'lin wadhakwaana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) recited Qunut for one month (in the Fajr prayer) asking Allah to punish the tribes of Ral and Dhakwan
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ الْقُنُوتُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْفَجْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana alqunuwtu fiy almaghribi waalfajri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Qunut used to be recited in the Maghrib and the Fajr prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَسْقِي وَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi, qaala kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yastasqiy wahawwala ridaa'ahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim's uncle:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to offer the Istisqa' prayer and turned (and put on) his cloak inside out
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرَّكْعَةِ الآخِرَةِ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِ عَيَّاشَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِ سَلَمَةَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ اشْدُدْ وَطْأَتَكَ عَلَى مُضَرَ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا سِنِينَ كَسِنِي يُوسُفَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ غِفَارُ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهَا، وَأَسْلَمُ سَالَمَهَا اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ هَذَا كُلُّهُ فِي الصُّبْحِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa mughiyraau bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa rafa'a raasahu mina alrrak'aai alakhiraai yaquwlu ‏"‏ alllahumma aanji 'ayyaasha bna aabiy rabiy'aaa, alllahumma aanji salamaaa bna hishaamin, alllahumma aanji alwaliyda bna alwaliydi, alllahumma aanji almustad'afiyna mina almuuminiyna, alllahumma ashdud wataataka 'alaa mudara, alllahumma aj'alhaa siniyna kasiniy yuwsufa ‏"‏‏.‏ waaanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ ghifaaru ghafara alllahu lahaa, waaaslamu saalamahaa alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu aabiy alzzinaadi 'an aabiyhi hadhaa kulluhu fiy alssubhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira;:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) lifted his head from the bowing in the last rak`a he used to say: "O Allah! Save `Aiyash bin Abi Rabi`a. O Allah! Save Salama bin Hisham. O Allah! Save Walid bin Walid. O Allah! Save the weak faithful believers. O Allah! Be hard on the tribes of Mudar and send (famine) years on them like the famine years of (Prophet) Joseph ." The Prophet (ﷺ) further said, "Allah forgive the tribes of Ghifar and save the tribes of Aslam." Abu Az-Zinad (a sub-narrator) said, "The Qunut used to be recited by the Prophet (ﷺ) in the Fajr prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا رَأَى مِنَ النَّاسِ إِدْبَارًا قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ سَبْعٌ كَسَبْعِ يُوسُفَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ سَنَةٌ حَصَّتْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّى أَكَلُوا الْجُلُودَ وَالْمَيْتَةَ وَالْجِيَفَ، وَيَنْظُرَ أَحَدُهُمْ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَيَرَى الدُّخَانَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ، فَأَتَاهُ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنَّكَ تَأْمُرُ بِطَاعَةِ اللَّهِ وَبِصِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ وَإِنَّ قَوْمَكَ قَدْ هَلَكُوا، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ لَهُمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏عَائِدُونَ * يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَى‏}‏ فَالْبَطْشَةُ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ، وَقَدْ مَضَتِ الدُّخَانُ وَالْبَطْشَةُ وَاللِّزَامُ وَآيَةُ الرُّومِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaala haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, qaala kunnaa 'inda 'abdi alllahi faqaala iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm lammaa raaaa mina alnnaasi iidbaarana qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma sab'un kasab'i yuwsufa ‏"‏‏.‏ faaakhadhathum sanaaun hassat kulla shaa'in hattaa aakaluwa aljuluwda waalmaytaaa waaljiyafa, wayanzura aahaduhum iilaa alssamaa'i fayaraa alddukhaana mina aljuw'i, faaataahu aabuw sufyaana faqaala yaa muhammadu iinnaka taamuru bitaa'aai alllahi wabisilaai alrrahimi waiinna qawmaka qad halakuwa, faad'u alllaha lahum qaala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏faartaqib yawma taatiy alssamaa'u bidukhaanin mubiynin‏}‏ iilaa qawlihi ‏{‏'aaiiduwna * yawma nabtishu albatshaaa alkubraa‏}‏ faalbatshaau yawma badrin, waqad madati alddukhaanu waalbatshaau waalllizaamu waayaau alrruwmi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Masruq:We were with `Abdullah and he said, "When the Prophet (ﷺ) saw the refusal of the people to accept Islam he said, "O Allah! Send (famine) years on them for (seven years) like the seven years (of famine during the time) of (Prophet) Joseph." So famine overtook them for one year and destroyed every kind of life to such an extent that the people started eating hides, carcasses and rotten dead animals. Whenever one of them looked towards the sky, he would (imagine himself to) see smoke because of hunger. So Abu Sufyan went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Muhammad! You order people to obey Allah and to keep good relations with kith and kin. No doubt the people of your tribe are dying, so please pray to Allah for them." So Allah revealed: "Then watch you For the day that The sky will bring forth a kind Of smoke Plainly visible ... Verily! You will return (to disbelief) On the day when We shall seize You with a mighty grasp. (44.10-16) Ibn Mas`ud added, "Al-Batsha (i.e. grasp) happened in the battle of Badr and no doubt smoke, Al-Batsha, Al-Lizam, and the verse of Surat Ar-Rum have all passed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو قُتَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَتَمَثَّلُ بِشِعْرِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَأَبْيَضَ يُسْتَسْقَى الْغَمَامُ بِوَجْهِهِ ثِمَالُ الْيَتَامَى عِصْمَةٌ لِلأَرَامِلِ وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ حَمْزَةَ حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، رُبَّمَا ذَكَرْتُ قَوْلَ الشَّاعِرِ وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ، إِلَى وَجْهِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَسْقِي، فَمَا يَنْزِلُ حَتَّى يَجِيشَ كُلُّ مِيزَابٍ‏.‏ وَأَبْيَضَ يُسْتَسْقَى الْغَمَامُ بِوَجْهِهِ ثِمَالَ الْيَتَامَى عِصْمَةً لِلأَرَامِلِ وَهْوَ قَوْلُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, qaala haddathanaa aabuw qutaybaaa, qaala haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara, yatamathhalu bishi'ri aabiy taalibin waaabyada yustasqaa alghamaamu biwajhihi thimaalu alyataamaa 'ismaaun lilaaraamili waqaala 'umaru bnu hamzaaa haddathanaa saalimun, 'an aabiyhi, rubbamaa dhakartu qawla alshhaa'iri waaanaa aanzuru, iilaa wajhi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yastasqiy, famaa yanzilu hattaa yajiysha kullu miyzaabin‏.‏ waaabyada yustasqaa alghamaamu biwajhihi thimaala alyataamaa 'ismaaan lilaaraamili wahwa qawlu aabiy taalibin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:My father said, "I heard Ibn `Umar reciting the poetic verses of Abu Talib: And a white (person) (i.e. the Prophet) who is requested to pray for rain and who takes care of the orphans and is the guardian of widows." Salim's father (Ibn `Umar) said, "The following poetic verse occurred to my mind while I was looking at the face of the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was praying for rain. He did not get down till the rain water flowed profusely from every roof-gutter: And a white (person) who is requested to pray for rain and who takes care of the orphans and is the guardian of widows . . . And these were the words of Abu Talib
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَانَ إِذَا قَحَطُوا اسْتَسْقَى بِالْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّنَا فَتَسْقِينَا وَإِنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِعَمِّ نَبِيِّنَا فَاسْقِنَا‏.‏ قَالَ فَيُسْقَوْنَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabiy 'abdu alllahi bnu almuthannaa, 'an thumaamaaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aanasin, 'an aanasin, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh kaana iidhaa qahatuwa astasqaa bial'abbaasi bni 'abdi almuttalibi faqaala alllahumma iinnaa kunnaa natawassalu iilayka binabiyyinaa fatasqiynaa waiinnaa natawassalu iilayka bi'ammi nabiyyinaa faasqinaa‏.‏ qaala fayusqawna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Whenever drought threatened them, `Umar bin Al-Khattab, used to ask Al-Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib to invoke Allah for rain. He used to say, "O Allah! We used to ask our Prophet to invoke You for rain, and You would bless us with rain, and now we ask his uncle to invoke You for rain. O Allah ! Bless us with rain."(1) And so it would rain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَسْقَى فَقَلَبَ رِدَاءَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, qaala haddathanaa wahbun, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni zaydin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm astasqaa faqalaba ridaa'ahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) turned his cloak inside out on Istisqa
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبَّادَ بْنَ تَمِيمٍ، يُحَدِّثُ أَبَاهُ عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى فَاسْتَسْقَى، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، وَقَلَبَ رِدَاءَهُ، وَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ كَانَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ يَقُولُ هُوَ صَاحِبُ الأَذَانِ، وَلَكِنَّهُ وَهْمٌ، لأَنَّ هَذَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ الْمَازِنِيُّ، مَازِنُ الأَنْصَارِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy bakrin aannahu sami'a 'abbaada bna tamiymin, yuhaddithu aabaahu 'an 'ammihi 'abdi alllahi bni zaydin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja iilaa almusallaa faastasqaa, faastaqbala alqiblaaa, waqalaba ridaa'ahu, wasallaa rak'atayni‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi kaana abnu 'uyaynaaa yaquwlu huwa saahibu alaadhaani, walakinnahu wahmun, laanna hadhaa 'abdu alllahi bnu zaydi bni 'aasimin almaaziniyyu, maazinu alaansaari‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid:The Prophet (ﷺ) went towards the Musalla and invoked Allah for rain. He faced the Qibla and wore his cloak inside out, and offered two rak`at
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو ضَمْرَةَ، أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَذْكُرُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، دَخَلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ مِنْ باب كَانَ وُجَاهَ الْمِنْبَرِ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمٌ يَخْطُبُ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمًا فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلَكَتِ الْمَوَاشِي وَانْقَطَعَتِ السُّبُلُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ يُغِيثُنَا‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا، اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا، اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ وَلاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا نَرَى فِي السَّمَاءِ مِنْ سَحَابٍ وَلاَ قَزَعَةً وَلاَ شَيْئًا، وَمَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ سَلْعٍ مِنْ بَيْتٍ وَلاَ دَارٍ، قَالَ فَطَلَعَتْ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ سَحَابَةٌ مِثْلُ التُّرْسِ، فَلَمَّا تَوَسَّطَتِ السَّمَاءَ انْتَشَرَتْ ثُمَّ أَمْطَرَتْ‏.‏ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَيْنَا الشَّمْسَ سِتًّا، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْبَابِ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ الْمُقْبِلَةِ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمٌ يَخْطُبُ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَهُ قَائِمًا فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلَكَتِ الأَمْوَالُ وَانْقَطَعَتِ السُّبُلُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكْهَا، قَالَ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالْجِبَالِ وَالآجَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَالأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْقَطَعَتْ وَخَرَجْنَا نَمْشِي فِي الشَّمْسِ‏.‏ قَالَ شَرِيكٌ فَسَأَلْتُ أَنَسًا أَهُوَ الرَّجُلُ الأَوَّلُ قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw damraaa, aanasu bnu 'iyaadin qaala haddathanaa shariyku bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy namirin, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yadhkuru aanna rajulaan, dakhala yawma aljumu'aai min bab kaana wujaaha alminbari, warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimun yakhtubu faastaqbala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimana faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, halakati almawaashiy waanqata'ati alssubulu, faad'u alllaha yughiythunaa‏.‏ qaala farafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadayhi faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma asqinaa, alllahumma asqinaa, alllahumma asqinaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aanasun walaa waalllahi maa naraa fiy alssamaa'i min sahaabin walaa qaza'aaan walaa shayiana, wamaa baynanaa wabayna sal'in min baytin walaa daarin, qaala fatala'at min waraaiihi sahaabaaun mithlu alttursi, falammaa tawassatati alssamaa'a antasharat thumma aamtarat‏.‏ qaala waalllahi maa raaaynaa alshhamsa sittana, thumma dakhala rajulun min dhalika albaabi fiy aljumu'aai almuqbilaai, warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimun yakhtubu, faastaqbalahu qaaiimana faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, halakati alaamwaalu waanqata'ati alssubulu, faad'u alllaha yumsikhaa, qaala farafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma hawaalaynaa walaa 'alaynaa, alllahumma 'alaa alakaami waaljibaali waalajaami waalzziraabi waalaawdiyaai wamanaabiti alshhajari ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faanqata'at wakharajnaa namshiy fiy alshhamsi‏.‏ qaala shariykun fasaaaltu aanasana aahuwa alrrajulu alaawwalu qaala laa aadriy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sharik bin `Abdullah bin Abi Namir:I heard Anas bin Malik saying, "On a Friday a person entered the main Mosque through the gate facing the pulpit while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the Khutba. The man stood in front of Allah's Apostle and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The livestock are dying and the roads are cut off; so please pray to Allah for rain.' " Anas added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, 'O Allah! Bless us with rain! O Allah! Bless us with rain! O Allah! Bless us with rain!' " Anas added, "By Allah, we could not see any trace of cloud in the sky and there was no building or a house between us and (the mountains of) Sila." Anas added, "A heavy cloud like a shield appeared from behind it (i.e. Sila' Mountain). When it came in the middle of the sky, it spread and then rained." Anas further said, "By Allah! We could not see the sun for a week. Next Friday a person entered through the same gate and at that time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the Friday's Khutba. The man stood in front of him and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The livestock are dying and the roads are cut off, please pray to Allah to withhold rain.'" Anas added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, 'O Allah! Round about us and not on us. O Allah! On the plateaus, on the mountains, on the hills, in the valleys and on the places where trees grow.' So the rain stopped and we came out walking in the sun." Sharik asked Anas whether it was the same person who had asked for the rain (the last Friday). Anas replied that he did not know
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ يَوْمَ جُمُعَةٍ مِنْ بَابٍ كَانَ نَحْوَ دَارِ الْقَضَاءِ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمٌ يَخْطُبُ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمًا ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلَكَتِ الأَمْوَالُ وَانْقَطَعَتِ السُّبُلُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ يُغِيثُنَا فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ وَلاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا نَرَى فِي السَّمَاءِ مِنْ سَحَابٍ، وَلاَ قَزَعَةً، وَمَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ سَلْعٍ مِنْ بَيْتٍ وَلاَ دَارٍ‏.‏ قَالَ فَطَلَعَتْ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ سَحَابَةٌ مِثْلُ التُّرْسِ، فَلَمَّا تَوَسَّطَتِ السَّمَاءَ انْتَشَرَتْ ثُمَّ أَمْطَرَتْ، فَلاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَيْنَا الشَّمْسَ سِتًّا، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْبَابِ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمٌ يَخْطُبُ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَهُ قَائِمًا فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلَكَتِ الأَمْوَالُ وَانْقَطَعَتِ السُّبُلُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكْهَا عَنَّا‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَقْلَعَتْ وَخَرَجْنَا نَمْشِي فِي الشَّمْسِ‏.‏ قَالَ شَرِيكٌ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ أَهُوَ الرَّجُلُ الأَوَّلُ فَقَالَ مَا أَدْرِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an shariykin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rajulaan, dakhala almasjida yawma jumu'aain min baabin kaana nahwa daari alqadaa'i, warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimun yakhtubu, faastaqbala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimana thumma qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi halakati alaamwaalu waanqata'ati alssubulu, faad'u alllaha yughiythunaa farafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aaghithnaa, alllahumma aaghithnaa, alllahumma aaghithnaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aanasun walaa waalllahi maa naraa fiy alssamaa'i min sahaabin, walaa qaza'aaan, wamaa baynanaa wabayna sal'in min baytin walaa daarin‏.‏ qaala fatala'at min waraaiihi sahaabaaun mithlu alttursi, falammaa tawassatati alssamaa'a antasharat thumma aamtarat, falaa waalllahi maa raaaynaa alshhamsa sittana, thumma dakhala rajulun min dhalika albaabi fiy aljumu'aai warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimun yakhtubu, faastaqbalahu qaaiimana faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi halakati alaamwaalu waanqata'ati alssubulu, faad'u alllaha yumsikhaa 'annaa‏.‏ qaala farafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma hawaalaynaa walaa 'alaynaa, alllahumma 'alaa alakaami waalzziraabi wabutuwni alaawdiyaai wamanaabiti alshhajari ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faaaqla'at wakharajnaa namshiy fiy alshhamsi‏.‏ qaala shariykun saaaltu aanasa bna maalikin aahuwa alrrajulu alaawwalu faqaala maa aadriy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sharik:Anas bin Malik said, "A person entered the Mosque on a Friday through the gate facing the Daril- Qada' and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was standing delivering the Khutba (sermon). The man stood in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), livestock are dying and the roads are cut off; please pray to Allah for rain.' So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, 'O Allah! Bless us with rain. O Allah! Bless us with rain. O Allah! Bless us with rain!" Anas added, "By Allah, there were no clouds in the sky and there was no house or building between us and the mountain of Sila'. Then a big cloud like a shield appeared from behind it (i.e. Sila' Mountain) and when it came in the middle of the sky, it spread and then rained. By Allah! We could not see the sun for a week. The next Friday, a person entered through the same gate and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the Friday Khutba and the man stood in front of him and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The livestock are dying and the roads are cut off; Please pray to Allah to withhold rain.' " Anas added, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, 'O Allah! Round about us and not on us. O Allah!' On the plateaus, on the mountains, on the hills, in the valleys and on the places where trees grow.' " Anas added, "The rain stopped and we came out, walking in the sun." Sharik asked Anas whether it was the same person who had asked for rain the previous Friday. Anas replied that he did not know
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَحَطَ الْمَطَرُ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَسْقِيَنَا‏.‏ فَدَعَا فَمُطِرْنَا، فَمَا كِدْنَا أَنْ نَصِلَ إِلَى مَنَازِلِنَا فَمَا زِلْنَا نُمْطَرُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ الْمُقْبِلَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَامَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ أَوْ غَيْرُهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَصْرِفَهُ عَنَّا‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ السَّحَابَ يَتَقَطَّعُ يَمِينًا وَشِمَالاً يُمْطَرُونَ وَلاَ يُمْطَرُ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala baynamaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu yawma aljumu'aai iidh jaa'a rajulun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, qahata almataru faad'u alllaha aan yasqiyanaa‏.‏ fada'aa famutirnaa, famaa kidnaa aan nasila iilaa manaazilinaa famaa zilnaa numtaru iilaa aljumu'aai almuqbilaai‏.‏ qaala faqaama dhalika alrrajulu aaw ghayruhu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi ad'u alllaha aan yasrifahu 'annaa‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma hawaalaynaa walaa 'alaynaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala falaqad raaaytu alssahaaba yataqatta'u yamiynana washimaalaan yumtaruwna walaa yumtaru aahlu almadiynaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qatada:Anas said, "While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the Friday Khutba (sermon) a man came and said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Rain is scarce; please ask Allah to bless us with rain.' So he invoked Allah for it, and it rained so much that we could hardly reach our homes and it continued raining till the next Friday." Anas further said, "Then the same or some other person stood up and said, 'O Allah's Apostle! Invoke Allah to withhold the rain.' On that, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'O Allah! Round about us and not on us.'" Anas added, "I saw the clouds dispersing right and left and it continued to rain but not over Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ هَلَكَتِ الْمَوَاشِي وَتَقَطَّعَتِ السُّبُلُ‏.‏ فَدَعَا، فَمُطِرْنَا مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقَالَ تَهَدَّمَتِ الْبُيُوتُ وَتَقَطَّعَتِ السُّبُلُ، وَهَلَكَتِ الْمَوَاشِي فَادْعُ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكْهَا‏.‏ فَقَامَ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَالأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْجَابَتْ عَنِ الْمَدِينَةِ انْجِيَابَ الثَّوْبِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an shariyki bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aanasin, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala halakati almawaashiy wataqatta'ati alssubulu‏.‏ fada'aa, famutirnaa mina aljumu'aai iilaa aljumu'aai, thumma jaa'a faqaala tahaddamati albuyuwtu wataqatta'ati alssubulu, wahalakati almawaashiy faad'u alllaha yumsikhaa‏.‏ faqaama sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma 'alaa alakaami waalzziraabi waalaawdiyaai wamanaabiti alshhajari ‏"‏‏.‏ faanjaabat 'ani almadiynaai anjiyaaba althhawbi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Livestock are destroyed and the roads are cut off." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked Allah for rain and it rained from that Friday till the next Friday. The same person came again and said, "Houses have collapsed, roads are cut off, and the livestock are destroyed. Please pray to Allah to withhold the rain." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (stood up and) said, "O Allah! (Let it rain) on the plateaus, on the hills, in the valleys and over the places where trees grow." So the clouds cleared away from Medina as clothes are taken off
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلَكَتِ الْمَوَاشِي وَانْقَطَعَتِ السُّبُلُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ، فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمُطِرُوا مِنْ جُمُعَةٍ إِلَى جُمُعَةٍ، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، تَهَدَّمَتِ الْبُيُوتُ وَتَقَطَّعَتِ السُّبُلُ وَهَلَكَتِ الْمَوَاشِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الْجِبَالِ وَالآكَامِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْجَابَتْ عَنِ الْمَدِينَةِ انْجِيَابَ الثَّوْبِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an shariyki bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy namirin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, halakati almawaashiy waanqata'ati alssubulu, faad'u alllaha, fada'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm famutiruwa min jumu'aain iilaa jumu'aain, fajaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, tahaddamati albuyuwtu wataqatta'ati alssubulu wahalakati almawaashiy‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma 'alaa ru'uwsi aljibaali waalakaami wabutuwni alaawdiyaai wamanaabiti alshhajari ‏"‏‏.‏ faanjaabat 'ani almadiynaai anjiyaaba althhawbi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Livestock are destroyed and the roads are cut off. So please invoke Allah." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed and it rained from that Friday to the next Friday. Then he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Houses have collapsed, roads are cut off and the livestock are destroyed." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed, "O Allah! (Let it rain) on the tops of mountains, on the plateaus, in the valleys and over the places where trees grow." So the clouds cleared away from Medina as clothes are taken off
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَافَى بْنُ عِمْرَانَ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، شَكَا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَلاَكَ الْمَالِ وَجَهْدَ الْعِيَالِ، فَدَعَا اللَّهَ يَسْتَسْقِي، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَنَّهُ حَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ وَلاَ اسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu bishrin, qaala haddathanaa mu'aafaa bnu 'imraana, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rajulaan, shakaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm halaaka almaali wajahda al'iyaali, fada'aa alllaha yastasqiy, walam yadhkur aannahu hawwala ridaa'ahu walaa astaqbala alqiblaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man complained to the Prophet (ﷺ) about the destruction of livestock and property and the hunger of the offspring. So he invoked (Allah for rain. The narrator (Anas) did not mention that the Prophet (ﷺ) had worn his cloak inside out or faced the Qibla
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلَكَتِ الْمَوَاشِي، وَتَقَطَّعَتِ السُّبُلُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ‏.‏ فَدَعَا اللَّهَ، فَمُطِرْنَا مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، تَهَدَّمَتِ الْبُيُوتُ وَتَقَطَّعَتِ السُّبُلُ وَهَلَكَتِ الْمَوَاشِي‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى ظُهُورِ الْجِبَالِ وَالآكَامِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْجَابَتْ عَنِ الْمَدِينَةِ انْجِيَابَ الثَّوْبِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an shariyki bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy namirin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi halakati almawaashiy, wataqatta'ati alssubulu, faad'u alllaha‏.‏ fada'aa alllaha, famutirnaa mina aljumu'aai iilaa aljumu'aai, fajaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, tahaddamati albuyuwtu wataqatta'ati alssubulu wahalakati almawaashiy‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma 'alaa zuhuwri aljibaali waalakaami wabutuwni alaawdiyaai wamanaabiti alshhajari ‏"‏‏.‏ faanjaabat 'ani almadiynaai anjiyaaba althhawbi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Livestock are destroyed and the roads are cut off; so please invoke Allah." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed for rain and it rained from that Friday till the next Friday. Then a man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The houses have collapsed, roads are cut off and the livestock are destroyed." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah ! (Let it rain) on the tops of the mountains, on the plateaus, in the valleys and over the places where trees grow." So the clouds cleared away from Medina as clothes are taken off
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، وَالأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ قُرَيْشًا أَبْطَئُوا عَنِ الإِسْلاَمِ،، فَدَعَا عَلَيْهِمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ سَنَةٌ حَتَّى هَلَكُوا فِيهَا وَأَكَلُوا الْمَيْتَةَ وَالْعِظَامَ، فَجَاءَهُ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ فَقَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ، جِئْتَ تَأْمُرُ بِصِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ، وَإِنَّ قَوْمَكَ هَلَكُوا، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ‏.‏ فَقَرَأَ ‏{‏فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ‏}‏ ثُمَّ عَادُوا إِلَى كُفْرِهِمْ فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَى‏}‏ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ‏.‏ قَالَ وَزَادَ أَسْبَاطٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَسُقُوا الْغَيْثَ، فَأَطْبَقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعًا، وَشَكَا النَّاسُ كَثْرَةَ الْمَطَرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَانْحَدَرَتِ السَّحَابَةُ عَنْ رَأْسِهِ، فَسُقُوا النَّاسُ حَوْلَهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, 'an sufyaana, haddathanaa mansuwrun, waalaa'mashu, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, qaala aataytu abna mas'uwdin faqaala iinna qurayshana aabtaiuwa 'ani aliislaami, , fada'aa 'alayhimu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhadhathum sanaaun hattaa halakuwa fiyhaa waaakaluwa almaytaaa waal'izaama, fajaa'ahu aabuw sufyaana faqaala yaa muhammadu, jiita taamuru bisilaai alrrahimi, waiinna qawmaka halakuwa, faad'u alllaha‏.‏ faqaraaa ‏{‏faartaqib yawma taatiy alssamaa'u bidukhaanin mubiynin‏}‏ thumma 'aaduwa iilaa kufrihim fadhalika qawluhu ta'aalaa ‏{‏yawma nabtishu albatshaaa alkubraa‏}‏ yawma badrin‏.‏ qaala wazaada aasbaatun 'an mansuwrin fada'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, fasuquwa alghaytha, faaatbaqat 'alayhim sab'ana, washakaa alnnaasu kathraaa almatari faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma hawaalaynaa walaa 'alaynaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faanhadarati alssahaabaau 'an raasihi, fasuquwa alnnaasu hawlahum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Masruq:One day I went to Ibn Mas`ud who said, "When Quraish delayed in embracing Islam, the Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah to curse them, so they were afflicted with a (famine) year because of which many of them died and they ate the carcasses and Abu Sufyan came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, 'O Muhammad! You came to order people to keep good relation with kith and kin and your nation is being destroyed, so invoke Allah.' So the Prophet (ﷺ) recited the Holy verses of Surat-Ad-Dukhan: 'Then watch you For the day that The sky will Bring forth a kind Of smoke Plainly visible.' (44.10) When the famine was taken off, the people renegade once again as nonbelievers. The statement of Allah, (in Sura "Ad- Dukhan"-44) refers to that: 'On the day when We shall seize You with a mighty grasp.' (44.16) And that was what happened on the day of the battle of Badr." Asbat added on the authority of Mansur, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prayed for them and it rained heavily for seven days. So the people complained of the excessive rain. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'O Allah! (Let it rain) around us and not on us.' So the clouds dispersed over his head and it rained over the surroundings
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ جُمُعَةٍ، فَقَامَ النَّاسُ فَصَاحُوا فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَحَطَ الْمَطَرُ وَاحْمَرَّتِ الشَّجَرُ وَهَلَكَتِ الْبَهَائِمُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ يَسْقِينَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ، وَايْمُ اللَّهِ مَا نَرَى فِي السَّمَاءِ قَزَعَةً مِنْ سَحَابٍ، فَنَشَأَتْ سَحَابَةٌ وَأَمْطَرَتْ، وَنَزَلَ عَنِ الْمِنْبَرِ فَصَلَّى، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ لَمْ تَزَلْ تُمْطِرُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ الَّتِي تَلِيهَا، فَلَمَّا قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ صَاحُوا إِلَيْهِ تَهَدَّمَتِ الْبُيُوتُ وَانْقَطَعَتِ السُّبُلُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ يَحْبِسُهَا عَنَّا‏.‏ فَتَبَسَّمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكُشِطَتِ الْمَدِينَةُ، فَجَعَلَتْ تُمْطِرُ حَوْلَهَا وَلاَ تَمْطُرُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ قَطْرَةً، فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَإِنَّهَا لَفِي مِثْلِ الإِكْلِيلِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu yawma jumu'aain, faqaama alnnaasu fasaahuwa faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, qahata almataru waahmarrati alshhajaru wahalakati albahaaiimu, faad'u alllaha yasqiynaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma asqinaa ‏"‏‏.‏ marratayni, waaymu alllahi maa naraa fiy alssamaa'i qaza'aaan min sahaabin, fanashaaat sahaabaaun waaamtarat, wanazala 'ani alminbari fasallaa, falammaa ansarafa lam tazal tumtiru iilaa aljumu'aai allatiy taliyhaa, falammaa qaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu saahuwa iilayhi tahaddamati albuyuwtu waanqata'ati alssubulu, faad'u alllaha yahbisuhaa 'annaa‏.‏ fatabassama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma hawaalaynaa walaa 'alaynaa ‏"‏‏.‏ fakushitati almadiynaau, faja'alat tumtiru hawlahaa walaa tamturu bialmadiynaai qatraaan, fanazartu iilaa almadiynaai waiinnahaa lafiy mithli aliikliyli‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering the Khutba (sermon) on a Friday when the people stood up, shouted and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! There is no rain (drought), the trees have dried and the livestock are destroyed; Please pray to Allah for rain." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said twice, "O Allah! Bless us with rain." By Allah, there was no trace of cloud in the sky and suddenly the sky became overcast with clouds and it started raining. The Prophet (ﷺ) came down the pulpit and offered the prayer. When he came back from the prayer (to his house) it was raining and it rained continuously till the next Friday. When the Prophet started delivering the Friday Khutba (sermon), the people started shouting and said to him, "The houses have collapsed and the roads are cut off; so please pray to Allah to withhold the rain." So the Prophet (ﷺ) smiled and said, "O Allah! Round about us and not on us." So the sky became clear over Medina but it kept on raining over the outskirts (of Medina) and not a single drop of rain fell over Medina. I looked towards the sky which was as bright and clear as a crown
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ لَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ عَنْ زُهَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، خَرَجَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ وَخَرَجَ مَعَهُ الْبَرَاءُ بْنُ عَازِبٍ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ أَرْقَمَ رضى الله عنهم فَاسْتَسْقَى، فَقَامَ بِهِمْ عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى غَيْرِ مِنْبَرٍ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ يَجْهَرُ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ وَلَمْ يُؤَذِّنْ، وَلَمْ يُقِمْ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ وَرَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala lanaa aabuw nu'aymin 'an zuhayrin, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, kharaja 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda alaansaariyyu wakharaja ma'ahu albaraa'u bnu 'aazibin wazaydu bnu aarqama rda allh 'nhm faastasqaa, faqaama bihim 'alaa rijlayhi 'alaa ghayri minbarin faastaghfara, thumma sallaa rak'atayni yajharu bialqiraa'aai walam yuuadhhin, walam yuqim‏.‏ qaala aabuw iishaaqa waraaaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah bin Yazid Al-Ansari that he went out with Al-Bara' bin 'Azib, and Zaid bin Arqam and invoked for rain. He ('Abdullah bin Yazid) stood up but not on a pulpit and invoked Allah for rain and then offered two Rak'a prayers with loud recitation without pronouncing Adhan or Iqama. Abu Ishaq said that 'Abdullah bin Yazid had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) (doing the same)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبَّادُ بْنُ تَمِيمٍ، أَنَّ عَمَّهُ ـ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ بِالنَّاسِ يَسْتَسْقِي لَهُمْ، فَقَامَ فَدَعَا اللَّهَ قَائِمًا، ثُمَّ تَوَجَّهَ قِبَلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، وَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ فَأُسْقُوا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'abbaadu bnu tamiymin, aanna 'ammahu wakaana min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja bialnnaasi yastasqiy lahum, faqaama fada'aa alllaha qaaiimana, thumma tawajjaha qibala alqiblaai, wahawwala ridaa'ahu faausquwa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim:that his uncle (who was one of the companions of the Prophet) had told him, "The Prophet (ﷺ) went out with the people to invoke Allah for rain for them. He stood up and invoked Allah for rain, then faced the Qibla and turned his cloak (inside out) and it rained
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَسْقِي فَتَوَجَّهَ إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ يَدْعُو، وَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ جَهَرَ فِيهِمَا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi, qaala kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yastasqiy fatawajjaha iilaa alqiblaai yad'uw, wahawwala ridaa'ahu, thumma sallaa rak'atayni jahara fiyhimaa bialqiraa'aai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim:from his uncle who said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to invoke Allah for rain. He faced the Qibla invoking Allah. He turned over his cloak (inside out) and then offered two rak`at and recited the Qur'an aloud in them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ خَرَجَ يَسْتَسْقِي قَالَ فَحَوَّلَ إِلَى النَّاسِ ظَهْرَهُ، وَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ يَدْعُو، ثُمَّ حَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّى لَنَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ جَهَرَ فِيهِمَا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi, qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma kharaja yastasqiy qaala fahawwala iilaa alnnaasi zahrahu, waastaqbala alqiblaaa yad'uw, thumma hawwala ridaa'ahu, thumma sallaa lanaa rak'atayni jahara fiyhimaa bialqiraa'aai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim from his uncle:"I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) on the day when he went out to offer the Istisqa' prayer. He turned his back towards the people and faced the Qibla and asked Allah for rain. Then he turned his cloak inside out and led us in a two rak`at prayer and recited the Qur'an aloud in them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَسْقَى فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَقَلَبَ رِدَاءَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm astasqaa fasallaa rak'atayni, waqalaba ridaa'ahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim from his uncle who said:"The Prophet (ﷺ) invoked Allah for rain and offered a two rak`at prayer and he put his cloak inside out
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، سَمِعَ عَبَّادَ بْنَ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى يَسْتَسْقِي، وَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، وَقَلَبَ رِدَاءَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فَأَخْبَرَنِي الْمَسْعُودِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَ جَعَلَ الْيَمِينَ عَلَى الشِّمَالِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, sami'a 'abbaada bna tamiymin, 'an 'ammihi, qaala kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa almusallaa yastasqiy, waastaqbala alqiblaaa fasallaa rak'atayni, waqalaba ridaa'ahu‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu faaakhbaraniy almas'uwdiyyu 'an aabiy bakrin qaala ja'ala alyamiyna 'alaa alshhimaali‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abbad bin Tamim from his uncle who said:"The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to the Musalla to offer the Istisqa' prayer, faced the Qibla and offered a two rak`at prayer and turned his cloak inside out." Narrated Abu Bakr, "The Prophet (ﷺ) put the right side of his cloak on his left side
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّ عَبَّادَ بْنَ تَمِيمٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زَيْدٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى يُصَلِّي، وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا دَعَا ـ أَوْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ ـ اسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ وَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ هَذَا مَازِنِيٌّ، وَالأَوَّلُ كُوفِيٌّ هُوَ ابْنُ يَزِيدَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw bakri bnu muhammadin, aanna 'abbaada bna tamiymin, aakhbarahu aanna 'abda alllahi bna zaydin alaansaariyya aakhbarahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja iilaa almusallaa yusalliy, waaannahu lammaa da'aa aaw aaraada aan yad'uwa astaqbala alqiblaaa wahawwala ridaa'ahu‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi abnu zaydin hadhaa maaziniyyun, waalaawwalu kuwfiyyun huwa abnu yaziyda‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid Al-Ansari:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out towards the Musalla in order to offer the Istisqa' prayer and when he intended to invoke (Allah) or started invoking, he faced the Qibla and turned his cloak inside out
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: قَالَ أَيُّوبُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ أَتَى رَجُلٌ أَعْرَابِيٌّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَدْوِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلَكَتِ الْمَاشِيَةُ هَلَكَ الْعِيَالُ هَلَكَ النَّاسُ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَيْهِ يَدْعُو، وَرَفَعَ النَّاسُ أَيْدِيَهُمْ مَعَهُ يَدْعُونَ، قَالَ فَمَا خَرَجْنَا مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ حَتَّى مُطِرْنَا، فَمَا زِلْنَا نُمْطَرُ حَتَّى كَانَتِ الْجُمُعَةُ الأُخْرَى، فَأَتَى الرَّجُلُ إِلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، بَشِقَ الْمُسَافِرُ، وَمُنِعَ الطَّرِيقُ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala aayyuwbu bnu sulaymaana haddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu aabiy auwaysin, 'an sulaymaana bni bilaalin, qaala yahyaa bnu sa'iydin sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, qaala aataa rajulun aa'raabiyyun min aahli albadwi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma aljumu'aai faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, halakati almaashiyaau halaka al'iyaalu halaka alnnaasu‏.‏ farafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadayhi yad'uw, warafa'a alnnaasu aaydiyahum ma'ahu yad'uwna, qaala famaa kharajnaa mina almasjidi hattaa mutirnaa, famaa zilnaa numtaru hattaa kaanati aljumu'aau alaukhraa, faaataa alrrajulu iilaa nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, bashiqa almusaafiru, wamuni'a alttariyqu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A bedouin came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on a Friday and said, "O Allah's Messenger ! The livestock, the offspring, and the people have perished." So, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands invoking Allah (for rain) and the people too raised their hands with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoking Allah (for rain). We had not left the mosque when it started raining. It rained till the next Friday when the same man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger! The travelers are compelled to postpone their journeys (because of excessive rain) and the roads are overflowed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ الأُوَيْسِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، وَشَرِيكٍ، سَمِعَا أَنَسًا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ بَيَاضَ إِبْطَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alauwaysiyyu haddathaniy muhammadu bnu ja'farin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, washariykin, sami'aa aanasana, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu rafa'a yadayhi hattaa raaaytu bayaada iibtayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: The narrator Anas added that the Prophet (ﷺ) raised his hands (during the invocation) to such an extent that the whiteness of his armpits was visible
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ دُعَائِهِ إِلاَّ فِي الاِسْتِسْقَاءِ، وَإِنَّهُ يَرْفَعُ حَتَّى يُرَى بَيَاضُ إِبْطَيْهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa yahyaa, waabnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm laa yarfa'u yadayhi fiy shaa'in min du'aaiihi iilaaa fiy alaistisqaa'i, waiinnahu yarfa'u hattaa yuraa bayaadu iibtayhi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) never raised his hands for any invocation except for that of Istisqa' and he used to raise them so much that the whiteness of his armpits became visible. (Note: It may be that Anas did not see the Prophet (ﷺ) raising his hands, but it is narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to raise his hands for invocations other than Istisqa. See Hadith No. 807 & 808 and also see Hadith No. 612, Vol
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْمَرْوَزِيُّ ـ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا رَأَى الْمَطَرَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ الأَوْزَاعِيُّ وَعُقَيْلٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun huwa abnu muqaatilin aabuw alhasani almarwaziyyu qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa raaaa almatara qaala ‏ "‏ sayyibana naafi'ana ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu alqaasimu bnu yahyaa 'an 'ubaydi alllahi‏.‏ warawaahu alaawzaa'iyyu wa'uqaylun 'an naafi'in‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw the rain, he used to say, "O Allah! Let it be a strong fruitful rain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ أَصَابَتِ النَّاسَ سَنَةٌ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَامَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَلَكَ الْمَالُ وَجَاعَ الْعِيَالُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا أَنْ يَسْقِيَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَيْهِ، وَمَا فِي السَّمَاءِ قَزَعَةٌ، قَالَ فَثَارَ سَحَابٌ أَمْثَالُ الْجِبَالِ، ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْزِلْ عَنْ مِنْبَرِهِ حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ الْمَطَرَ يَتَحَادَرُ عَلَى لِحْيَتِهِ، قَالَ فَمُطِرْنَا يَوْمَنَا ذَلِكَ، وَفِي الْغَدِ وَمِنْ بَعْدِ الْغَدِ وَالَّذِي يَلِيهِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ الأُخْرَى، فَقَامَ ذَلِكَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ أَوْ رَجُلٌ غَيْرُهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، تَهَدَّمَ الْبِنَاءُ وَغَرِقَ الْمَالُ، فَادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَيْهِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا جَعَلَ يُشِيرُ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى نَاحِيَةٍ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلاَّ تَفَرَّجَتْ حَتَّى صَارَتِ الْمَدِينَةُ فِي مِثْلِ الْجَوْبَةِ، حَتَّى سَالَ الْوَادِي ـ وَادِي قَنَاةَ ـ شَهْرًا‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمْ يَجِئْ أَحَدٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ إِلاَّ حَدَّثَ بِالْجَوْدِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almubaaraki, qaala aakhbaranaa alaawzaa'iyyu, qaala haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa alaansaariyyu, qaala haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin, qaala aasaabati alnnaasa sanaaun 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fabaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu 'alaa alminbari yawma aljumu'aai qaama aa'raabiyyun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, halaka almaalu wajaa'a al'iyaalu, faad'u alllaha lanaa aan yasqiyanaa‏.‏ qaala farafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadayhi, wamaa fiy alssamaa'i qaza'aaun, qaala fathaara sahaabun aamthaalu aljibaali, thumma lam yanzil 'an minbarihi hattaa raaaytu almatara yatahaadaru 'alaa lihyatihi, qaala famutirnaa yawmanaa dhalika, wafiy alghadi wamin ba'di alghadi waalladhiy yaliyhi iilaa aljumu'aai alaukhraa, faqaama dhalika alaa'raabiyyu aaw rajulun ghayruhu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi, tahaddama albinaa'u waghariqa almaalu, faad'u alllaha lanaa‏.‏ farafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadayhi waqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma hawaalaynaa walaa 'alaynaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala famaa ja'ala yushiyru biyadihi iilaa naahiyaain mina alssamaa'i iilaaa tafarrajat hattaa saarati almadiynaau fiy mithli aljawbaai, hattaa saala alwaadiy waadiy qanaaaa shahrana‏.‏ qaala falam yajii aahadun min naahiyaain iilaaa haddatha bialjawdi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the people were afflicted with a (famine) year. While the Prophet was delivering the Khutba (sermon) on the pulpit on a Friday, a Bedouin stood up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The livestock are dying and the families (offspring) are hungry: please pray to Allah to bless us with rain." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands towards the sky and at that time there was not a trace of cloud in the sky. Then the clouds started gathering like mountains. Before he got down from the pulpit I saw rainwater trickling down his beard. It rained that day, the next day, the third day, the fourth day and till the next Friday, when the same Bedouin or some other person stood up (during the Friday Khutba) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! The houses have collapsed and the livestock are drowned. Please invoke Allah for us." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised both his hands and said, "O Allah! Around us and not on us." Whichever side the Prophet (ﷺ) directed his hand, the clouds dispersed from there till a hole (in the clouds) was formed over Medina. The valley of Qanat remained flowing (with water) for one month and none, came from outside who didn't talk about the abundant rain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدٌ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ كَانَتِ الرِّيحُ الشَّدِيدَةُ إِذَا هَبَّتْ عُرِفَ ذَلِكَ فِي وَجْهِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, qaala aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala aakhbaraniy humaydun, aannahu sami'a aanasana, yaquwlu kaanati alrriyhu alshhadiydaau iidhaa habbat 'urifa dhalika fiy wajhi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Whenever a strong wind blew, anxiety appeared on the face of the Prophet (fearing that wind might be a sign of Allah's wrath)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ نُصِرْتُ بِالصَّبَا، وَأُهْلِكَتْ عَادٌ بِالدَّبُورِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, qaala haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ nusirtu bialssabaa, waauhlikat 'aadun bialddabuwri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I was granted victory with As-Saba and the nation of 'Ad was destroyed by Ad- Dabur (westerly wind)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يُقْبَضَ الْعِلْمُ، وَتَكْثُرَ الزَّلاَزِلُ، وَيَتَقَارَبَ الزَّمَانُ، وَتَظْهَرَ الْفِتَنُ، وَيَكْثُرَ الْهَرْجُ ـ وَهْوَ الْقَتْلُ الْقَتْلُ ـ حَتَّى يَكْثُرَ فِيكُمُ الْمَالُ فَيَفِيضُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, qaala aakhbaranaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa yuqbada al'ilmu, watakthura alzzalaazilu, wayataqaaraba alzzamaanu, watazhara alfitanu, wayakthura alharju wahwa alqatlu alqatlu hattaa yakthura fiykumu almaalu fayafiydu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour (Last Day) will not be established until (religious) knowledge will be taken away (by the death of religious learned men), earthquakes will be very frequent, time will pass quickly, afflictions will appear, murders will increase and money will overflow amongst you." (See Hadith No. 85 Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي شَامِنَا وَفِي يَمَنِنَا‏.‏ قَالَ قَالُوا وَفِي نَجْدِنَا قَالَ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي شَامِنَا وَفِي يَمَنِنَا‏.‏ قَالَ قَالُوا وَفِي نَجْدِنَا قَالَ قَالَ هُنَاكَ الزَّلاَزِلُ وَالْفِتَنُ، وَبِهَا يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaala haddathanaa husaynu bnu alhasani, qaala haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala alllahumma baarik lanaa fiy shaaminaa wafiy yamaninaa‏.‏ qaala qaaluwa wafiy najdinaa qaala qaala alllahumma baarik lanaa fiy shaaminaa wafiy yamaninaa‏.‏ qaala qaaluwa wafiy najdinaa qaala qaala hunaaka alzzalaazilu waalfitanu, wabihaa yatlu'u qarnu alshhaytaani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:(The Prophet) said, "O Allah! Bless our Sham and our Yemen." People said, "Our Najd as well." The Prophet again said, "O Allah! Bless our Sham and Yemen." They said again, "Our Najd as well." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will appear earthquakes and afflictions, and from there will come out the side of the head of Satan
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ صَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلاَةَ الصُّبْحِ بِالْحُدَيْبِيَةِ عَلَى إِثْرِ سَمَاءٍ كَانَتْ مِنَ اللَّيْلَةِ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَدْرُونَ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَصْبَحَ مِنْ عِبَادِي مُؤْمِنٌ بِي وَكَافِرٌ، فَأَمَّا مَنْ قَالَ مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ‏.‏ فَذَلِكَ مُؤْمِنٌ بِي كَافِرٌ بِالْكَوْكَبِ، وَأَمَّا مَنْ قَالَ بِنَوْءِ كَذَا وَكَذَا‏.‏ فَذَلِكَ كَافِرٌ بِي مُؤْمِنٌ بِالْكَوْكَبِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathaniy maalikun, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, 'an zaydi bni khaalidin aljuhaniyyi, aannahu qaala sallaa lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm salaaaa alssubhi bialhudaybiyaai 'alaa iithri samaa'in kaanat mina alllaylaai, falammaa ansarafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aaqbala 'alaa alnnaasi faqaala ‏"‏ hal tadruwna maadhaa qaala rabbukum ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aasbaha min 'ibaadiy muuminun biy wakaafirun, faaammaa man qaala mutirnaa bifadli alllahi warahmatihi‏.‏ fadhalika muuminun biy kaafirun bialkawkabi, waaammaa man qaala binaw'i kadhaa wakadhaa‏.‏ fadhalika kaafirun biy muuminun bialkawkabi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led the morning prayer in Al-Hudaibiya and it had rained the previous night. When the Prophet (ﷺ) had finished the prayer he faced the people and said, "Do you know what your Lord has said?" They replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." (The Prophet (ﷺ) said), "Allah says, 'In this morning some of My worshipers remained as true believers and some became non-believers; he who said that it had rained with the blessing and mercy of Allah is the one who believes in Me and does not believe in star, but he who said it had rained because of such and such (star) is a disbeliever in Me and is a believer in star
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مِفْتَاحُ الْغَيْبِ خَمْسٌ لاَ يَعْلَمُهَا إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لاَ يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ مَا يَكُونُ فِي غَدٍ، وَلاَ يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ مَا يَكُونُ فِي الأَرْحَامِ، وَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا، وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَىِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ، وَمَا يَدْرِي أَحَدٌ مَتَى يَجِيءُ الْمَطَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ miftaahu alghaybi khamsun laa ya'lamuhaa iilaaa alllahu laa ya'lamu aahadun maa yakuwnu fiy ghadin, walaa ya'lamu aahadun maa yakuwnu fiy alaarhaami, walaa ta'lamu nafsun maadhaa taksibu ghadana, wamaa tadriy nafsun biaaaai aardin tamuwtu, wamaa yadriy aahadun mataa yajiy'u almataru ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Keys of the unseen knowledge are five which nobody knows but Allah . . . nobody knows what will happen tomorrow; nobody knows what is in the womb; nobody knows what he will gain tomorrow; nobody knows at what place he will die; and nobody knows when it will rain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَانْكَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَجُرُّ رِدَاءَهُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ، فَدَخَلْنَا فَصَلَّى بِنَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ، حَتَّى انْجَلَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لاَ يَنْكَسِفَانِ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمُوهُمَا فَصَلُّوا، وَادْعُوا، حَتَّى يُكْشَفَ مَا بِكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'awnin, qaala haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani alhasani, 'an aabiy bakraaa, qaala kunnaa 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faankasafati alshhamsu, faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yajurru ridaa'ahu hattaa dakhala almasjida, fadakhalnaa fasallaa binaa rak'atayni, hattaa anjalati alshhamsu faqaala sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alshhamsa waalqamara laa yankasifaani limawti aahadin, faiidhaa raaaytumuwhumaa fasalluwa, waad'uwa, hattaa yukshafa maa bikum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakra:We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when the sun eclipsed. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up dragging his cloak till he entered the Mosque. He led us in a two-rak`at prayer till the sun (eclipse) had cleared. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of someone's death. So whenever you see these eclipses pray and invoke (Allah) till the eclipse is over
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لاَ يَنْكَسِفَانِ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَلَكِنَّهُمَا آيَتَانِ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمُوهُمَا فَقُومُوا فَصَلُّوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shihaabu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu humaydin, 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysin, qaala sami'tu aabaa mas'uwdin, yaquwlu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alshhamsa waalqamara laa yankasifaani limawti aahadin mina alnnaasi, walakinnahumaa ayataani min ayaati alllahi, faiidhaa raaaytumuwhumaa faquwmuwa fasalluwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of the death of someone from the people but they are two signs amongst the signs of Allah. When you see them stand up and pray
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَصْبَغُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُخْبِرُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لاَ يَخْسِفَانِ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ وَلاَ لِحَيَاتِهِ، وَلَكِنَّهُمَا آيَتَانِ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمُوهَا فَصَلُّوا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aasbaghu, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alqaasimi, haddathahu 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aannahu kaana yukhbiru 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ ‏ "‏ iinna alshhamsa waalqamara laa yakhsifaani limawti aahadin walaa lihayaatihi, walakinnahumaa ayataani min ayaati alllahi, faiidhaa raaaytumuwhaa fasalluwa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of the death or life (i.e. birth) of someone but they are two signs amongst the signs of Allah. When you see them offer the prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلاَقَةَ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ كَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ مَاتَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ، فَقَالَ النَّاسُ كَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ لِمَوْتِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لاَ يَنْكَسِفَانِ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ وَلاَ لِحَيَاتِهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ فَصَلُّوا وَادْعُوا اللَّهَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, qaala haddathanaa haashimu bnu alqaasimi, qaala haddathanaa shaybaanu aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an ziyaadi bni 'ilaaqaaa, 'ani almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, qaala kasafati alshhamsu 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma maata iibraahiymu, faqaala alnnaasu kasafati alshhamsu limawti iibraahiyma‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alshhamsa waalqamara laa yankasifaani limawti aahadin walaa lihayaatihi, faiidhaa raaaytum fasalluwa waad'uwa alllaha ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba:"The sun eclipsed in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day when (his son) Ibrahim died. So the people said that the sun had eclipsed because of the death of Ibrahim. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of the death or life (i.e. birth) of someone. When you see the eclipse pray and invoke Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ خَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالنَّاسِ، فَقَامَ فَأَطَالَ الْقِيَامَ، ثُمَّ رَكَعَ فَأَطَالَ الرُّكُوعَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ فَأَطَالَ الْقِيَامَ وَهْوَ دُونَ الْقِيَامِ الأَوَّلِ، ثُمَّ رَكَعَ فَأَطَالَ الرُّكُوعَ، وَهْوَ دُونَ الرُّكُوعِ الأَوَّلِ، ثُمَّ سَجَدَ فَأَطَالَ السُّجُودَ، ثُمَّ فَعَلَ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ مِثْلَ مَا فَعَلَ فِي الأُولَى، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ وَقَدِ انْجَلَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ، فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ، وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ آيَتَانِ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ، لاَ يَنْخَسِفَانِ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ وَلاَ لِحَيَاتِهِ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ ذَلِكَ فَادْعُوا اللَّهَ وَكَبِّرُوا، وَصَلُّوا وَتَصَدَّقُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَاللَّهِ مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ أَغْيَرُ مِنَ اللَّهِ أَنْ يَزْنِيَ عَبْدُهُ أَوْ تَزْنِيَ أَمَتُهُ، يَا أُمَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَاللَّهِ لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا أَعْلَمُ لَضَحِكْتُمْ قَلِيلاً وَلَبَكَيْتُمْ كَثِيرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat khasafati alshhamsu fiy 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialnnaasi, faqaama faaataala alqiyaama, thumma raka'a faaataala alrrukuw'a, thumma qaama faaataala alqiyaama wahwa duwna alqiyaami alaawwali, thumma raka'a faaataala alrrukuw'a, wahwa duwna alrrukuw'i alaawwali, thumma sajada faaataala alssujuwda, thumma fa'ala fiy alrrak'aai althhaaniyaai mithla maa fa'ala fiy alauwlaa, thumma ansarafa waqadi anjalati alshhamsu, fakhataba alnnaasa, fahamida alllaha, waaathnaa 'alayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinna alshhamsa waalqamara ayataani min ayaati alllahi, laa yankhasifaani limawti aahadin walaa lihayaatihi, faiidhaa raaaytum dhalika faad'uwa alllaha wakabbiruwa, wasalluwa watasaddaquwa ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ yaa aummaaa muhammadin, waalllahi maa min aahadin aaghyaru mina alllahi aan yazniya 'abduhu aaw tazniya aamatuhu, yaa aummaaa muhammadin, waalllahi law ta'lamuwna maa aa'lamu ladahiktum qaliylaan walabakaytum kathiyrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:In the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the sun eclipsed, so he led the people in prayer, and stood up and performed a long Qiyam, then bowed for a long while. He stood up again and performed a long Qiyam but this time the period of standing was shorter than the first. He bowed again for a long time but shorter than the first one, then he prostrated and prolonged the prostration. He did the same in the second rak`a as he did in the first and then finished the prayer; by then the sun (eclipse) had cleared. He delivered the Khutba (sermon) and after praising and glorifying Allah he said, "The sun and the moon are two signs amongst the signs of Allah; they do not eclipse on the death or life of anyone. So when you see the eclipse, remember Allah and say Takbir, pray and give Sadaqa." The Prophet then said, "O followers of Muhammad! By Allah! There is none who has more ghaira (self-respect) than Allah as He has forbidden that His slaves, male or female commit adultery (illegal sexual intercourse). O followers of Muhammad! By Allah! If you knew that which I know you would laugh little and weep much
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ سَلاَّمِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلاَّمٍ الْحَبَشِيُّ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا كَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نُودِيَ إِنَّ الصَّلاَةَ جَامِعَةٌ‏.‏
