verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَيْرُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جُنَادَةُ بْنُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَعَارَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ‏.‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي‏.‏ أَوْ دَعَا اسْتُجِيبَ، فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأَ وَصَلَّى قُبِلَتْ صَلاَتُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau bnu alfadli, aakhbaranaa alwaliydu, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'umayru bnu haaniiin, qaala haddathaniy junaadaau bnu aabiy aumayyaaa, haddathaniy 'ubaadaau bnu alssaamiti, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man ta'aarra mina alllayli faqaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu, lahu almulku, walahu alhamdu, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun‏.‏ alhamdu lillahi, wasubhaana alllahi, walaa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, waalllahu aakbaru, walaa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi‏.‏ thumma qaala alllahumma aghfir liy‏.‏ aaw da'aa astujiyba, faiin tawaddaaa wasallaa qubilat salaatuhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubada bin As-Samit:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever gets up at night and says: -- 'La ilaha il-lallah Wahdahu la Sharika lahu Lahu-lmulk, waLahu-l-hamd wahuwa 'ala kullishai'in Qadir. Al hamdu lil-lahi wa subhanal-lahi wa la-ilaha il-lal-lah wa-l-lahu akbar wa la hawla Wala Quwata il-la-bil-lah.' (None has the right to be worshipped but Allah. He is the Only One and has no partners . For Him is the Kingdom and all the praises are due for Him. He is Omnipotent. All the praises are for Allah. All the glories are for Allah. And none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, And Allah is Great And there is neither Might nor Power Except with Allah). And then says: -- Allahumma, Ighfir li (O Allah! Forgive me). Or invokes (Allah), he will be responded to and if he performs ablution (and prays), his prayer will be accepted
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ أَبِي سِنَانٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَهُوَ يَقْصُصُ فِي قَصَصِهِ وَهُوَ يَذْكُرُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ أَخًا لَكُمْ لاَ يَقُولُ الرَّفَثَ‏.‏ يَعْنِي بِذَلِكَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ رَوَاحَةَ وَفِينَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ يَتْلُو كِتَابَهُ إِذَا انْشَقَّ مَعْرُوفٌ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ سَاطِعُ أَرَانَا الْهُدَى بَعْدَ الْعَمَى فَقُلُوبُنَا بِهِ مُوقِنَاتٌ أَنَّ مَا قَالَ وَاقِعُ يَبِيتُ يُجَافِي جَنْبَهُ عَنْ فِرَاشِهِ إِذَا اسْتَثْقَلَتْ بِالْمُشْرِكِينَ الْمَضَاجِعُ تَابَعَهُ عُقَيْلٌ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الزُّبَيْدِيُّ أَخْبَرَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ وَالأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, qaala haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy alhaythamu bnu aabiy sinaanin, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh wahuwa yaqsusu fiy qasasihi wahuwa yadhkuru rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna aakhana lakum laa yaquwlu alrrafatha‏.‏ ya'niy bidhalika 'abda alllahi bna rawaahaaa wafiynaa rasuwlu alllahi yatluw kitaabahu iidhaa anshaqqa ma'ruwfun mina alfajri saati'u aaraanaa alhudaa ba'da al'amaa faquluwbunaa bihi muwqinaatun aanna maa qaala waaqi'u yabiytu yujaafiy janbahu 'an firaashihi iidhaa astathqalat bialmushrikiyna almadaaji'u taaba'ahu 'uqaylun‏.‏ waqaala alzzubaydiyyu aakhbaraniy alzzuhriyyu 'an sa'iydin waalaa'raji 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:That once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Your brother, i.e. `Abdullah bin Rawaha does not say obscene (referring to his verses): Amongst us is Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), who recites His Book when it dawns. He showed us the guidance, after we were blind. We believe that whatever he says will come true. And he spends his nights in such a way as his sides do not touch his bed. While the pagans were deeply asleep
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، رضى الله عنهما قَالَ رَأَيْتُ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَأَنَّ بِيَدِي قِطْعَةَ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ، فَكَأَنِّي لاَ أُرِيدُ مَكَانًا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ إِلاَّ طَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ، وَرَأَيْتُ كَأَنَّ اثْنَيْنِ أَتَيَانِي أَرَادَا أَنْ يَذْهَبَا بِي إِلَى النَّارِ فَتَلَقَّاهُمَا مَلَكٌ فَقَالَ لَمْ تُرَعْ خَلِّيَا عَنْهُ‏.‏ فَقَصَّتْ حَفْصَةُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِحْدَى رُؤْيَاىَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ نِعْمَ الرَّجُلُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَوْ كَانَ يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ‏.‏ وَكَانُوا لاَ يَزَالُونَ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرُّؤْيَا أَنَّهَا فِي اللَّيْلَةِ السَّابِعَةِ مِنَ الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرَى رُؤْيَاكُمْ قَدْ تَوَاطَتْ فِي الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ، فَمَنْ كَانَ مُتَحَرِّيْهَا فَلْيَتَحَرَّهَا مِنَ الْعَشْرِ الأَوَاخِرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, rda allh 'nhma qaala raaaytu 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaaanna biyadiy qit'aaa iistabraqin, fakaaanniy laa auriydu makaanana mina aljannaai iilaaa taarat iilayhi, waraaaytu kaaanna athnayni aatayaaniy aaraadaa aan yadhhabaa biy iilaa alnnaari fatalaqqaahumaa malakun faqaala lam tura' khalliyaa 'anhu‏.‏ faqassat hafsaau 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iihdaa ruuyaaaa faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ni'ma alrrajulu 'abdu alllahi law kaana yusalliy mina alllayli ‏"‏‏.‏ fakaana 'abdu alllahi rda allh 'nh yusalliy mina alllayli‏.‏ wakaanuwa laa yazaaluwna yaqussuwna 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm alrruuyaa aannahaa fiy alllaylaai alssaabi'aai mina al'ashri alaawaakhiri, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaraa ruuyaakum qad tawaatat fiy al'ashri alaawaakhiri, faman kaana mutaharriyhaa falyataharrahaa mina al'ashri alaawaakhiri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar said, "In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) I dreamt that a piece of silk cloth was in my hand and it flew with me to whichever part of Paradise I wanted. I also saw as if two persons (i.e. angels) came to me and wanted to take me to Hell. Then an angel met us and told me not to be afraid. He then told them to leave me. Hafsa narrated one of my dreams to the Prophet (ﷺ) and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Abdullah is a good man. Would that he offer the night prayer (Tahajjud)!" So after that day `Abdullah (bin `Umar) started offering Tahajjud. The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) used to tell him their dreams that (Laila-tul-Qadr) was on the 27th of the month of Ramadan. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I see that your dreams agree on the last ten nights of Ramadan and so whoever is in search of it should seek it in the last ten nights of Ramadan
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ ـ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعِشَاءَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ جَالِسًا وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَيْنَ النِّدَاءَيْنِ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ يَدَعُهُمَا أَبَدًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda, haddathanaa sa'iydun huwa abnu aabiy aayyuwba qaala haddathaniy ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, 'an 'iraaki bni maalikin, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm al'ishaa'a thumma sallaa thamaana raka'aatin warak'atayni jaalisana warak'atayni bayna alnnidaa'ayni, walam yakun yada'uhumaa aabadana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha;:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the `Isha' prayer (and then got up at the Tahajjud time) and offered eight rak`at and then offered two rak`at while sitting. He then offered two rak`at in between the Adhan and Iqama (of the Fajr prayer) and he never missed them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا صَلَّى رَكْعَتَىِ الْفَجْرِ اضْطَجَعَ عَلَى شِقِّهِ الأَيْمَنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy aayyuwba, qaala haddathaniy aabuw alaaswadi, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sallaa rak'ataai alfajri adtaja'a 'alaa shiqqihi alaaymani‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to lie down on his right side, after offering two rak`at (Sunna) of the Fajr prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ أَبُو النَّضْرِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى ‏{‏سُنَّةَ الْفَجْرِ‏}‏ فَإِنْ كُنْتُ مُسْتَيْقِظَةً حَدَّثَنِي وَإِلاَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى يُؤْذَنَ بِالصَّلاَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa bishru bnu alhakami, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala haddathaniy saalimun aabuw alnnadri, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa sallaa ‏{‏sunnaaa alfajri‏}‏ faiin kuntu mustayqizaaan haddathaniy waiilaaa adtaja'a hattaa yuudhana bialssalaaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:After offering the Sunna of the Fajr prayer, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to talk to me, if I happened to be awake; otherwise he would lie down till the Iqama call was proclaimed (for the Fajr prayer)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ أَبُو النَّضْرِ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِنْ كُنْتُ مُسْتَيْقِظَةً حَدَّثَنِي وَإِلاَّ اضْطَجَعَ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِسُفْيَانَ فَإِنَّ بَعْضَهُمْ يَرْوِيهِ رَكْعَتَىِ الْفَجْرِ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ هُوَ ذَاكَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala aabuw alnnadri 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy rak'atayni faiin kuntu mustayqizaaan haddathaniy waiilaaa adtaja'a‏.‏ qultu lisufyaana faiinna ba'dahum yarwiyhi rak'ataai alfajri‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu huwa dhaaka‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:After offering the two rak`at (Sunna) the Prophet (ﷺ) used to talk to me, if I happened to be awake; otherwise he would lie down
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بَيَانُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَمْ يَكُنِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى شَىْءٍ مِنَ النَّوَافِلِ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُ تَعَاهُدًا عَلَى رَكْعَتَىِ الْفَجْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa bayaanu bnu 'amrinw, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'an 'ubaydi bni 'umayrin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat lam yakuni alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa shaa'in mina alnnawaafili aashadda minhu ta'aahudana 'alaa rak'ataai alfajri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) was never more regular and particular in offering any Nawafil than the two rak`at (Sunna) of the Fajr prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي بِاللَّيْلِ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي إِذَا سَمِعَ النِّدَاءَ بِالصُّبْحِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy bialllayli thalaatha 'ashraaa rak'aaan, thumma yusalliy iidhaa sami'a alnnidaa'a bialssubhi rak'atayni khafiyfatayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to offer thirteen rak`at in the night prayer and on hearing the Adhan for the morning prayer, he used to offer two light rak`at
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَمَّتِهِ، عَمْرَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ـ هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ ـ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَمْرَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُخَفِّفُ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى إِنِّي لأَقُولُ هَلْ قَرَأَ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaala haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'ammatihi, 'amraaa 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa haddathanaa zuhayrun haddathanaa yahyaa huwa abnu sa'iydin 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani 'an 'amraaa 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yukhaffifu alrrak'atayni alllatayni qabla salaaai alssubhi hattaa iinniy laaquwlu hal qaraaa biaummi alkitaabi
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to make the two rak`at before the Fajr prayer so light that I would wonder whether he recited Al-Fatiha (or not)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَوَالِي، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُنَا الاِسْتِخَارَةَ فِي الأُمُورِ كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا هَمَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِالأَمْرِ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ الْفَرِيضَةِ ثُمَّ لِيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ فِي عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَآجِلِهِ ـ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِي الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ ـ قَالَ ـ وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa qutaybaau, qaala hadaathanaa 'abdu alraahmani bnu aabiy almawaaliy, 'an muhamaadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi allaahi rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yu'aliimunaa alaistikhaaraaa fiy alaumuwri kamaa yu'aliimunaa alsuuwraaa mina alqurani yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa hamaa aahadukum bialaamri falyarka' rak'atayni min ghayri alfariydaai thumaa liyaquli allaahumaa iiniiy aastakhiyruka bi'ilmika waaastaqdiruka biqudratika, waaasaaluka min fadlika al'aziymi, faiinaaka taqdiru walaa aaqdiru wata'lamu walaa aa'lamu waaanta 'alaaamu alghuyuwbi, allaahumaa iin kunta ta'lamu aanaa hadhaa alaamra khayrun liy fiy diyniy wama'aashiy wa'aaqibaai aamriy aaw qaala 'aajili aamriy waajilihi faaqdurhu liy wayasiirhu liy thumaa baarik liy fiyhi, waiin kunta ta'lamu aanaa hadhaa alaamra sharunn liy fiy diyniy wama'aashiy wa'aaqibaai aamriy aaw qaala fiy 'aajili aamriy waajilihi faasrifhu 'aniiy waasrifniy 'anhu, waaqdur liy alkhayra haythu kaana thumaa aardiniy bihi qaala wayusamiiy haajatahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to teach us the way of doing Istikhara (Istikhara means to ask Allah to guide one to the right sort of action concerning any job or a deed), in all matters as he taught us the Suras of the Qur'an. He said, "If anyone of you thinks of doing any job he should offer a two rak`at prayer other than the compulsory ones and say (after the prayer): -- 'Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika, Wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratika, Wa as'alaka min fadlika Al-`azlm Fa-innaka taqdiru Wala aqdiru, Wa ta'lamu Wala a'lamu, Wa anta 'allamu l-ghuyub. Allahumma, in kunta ta'lam anna hadha-lamra Khairun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa'aqibati `Amri (or 'ajili `Amri wa'ajilihi) Faqdirhu wa yas-sirhu li thumma barik li Fihi, Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadha-lamra shar-run li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa'aqibati `Amri (or fi'ajili `Amri wa ajilihi) Fasrifhu anni was-rifni anhu. Waqdir li al-khaira haithu kana Thumma ardini bihi.' (O Allah! I ask guidance from Your knowledge, And Power from Your Might and I ask for Your great blessings. You are capable and I am not. You know and I do not and You know the unseen. O Allah! If You know that this job is good for my religion and my subsistence and in my Hereafter--(or said: If it is better for my present and later needs)--Then You ordain it for me and make it easy for me to get, And then bless me in it, and if You know that this job is harmful to me In my religion and subsistence and in the Hereafter--(or said: If it is worse for my present and later needs)--Then keep it away from me and let me be away from it. And ordain for me whatever is good for me, And make me satisfied with it). The Prophet (ﷺ) added that then the person should name (mention) his need
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ، سَمِعَ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ بْنَ رِبْعِيٍّ الأَنْصَارِيّ َ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلاَ يَجْلِسْ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa almakkiyyu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni sa'iydin, 'an 'aamiri bni 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, 'an 'amriw bni sulaymin alzzuraqiyyi, sami'a aabaa qataadaaa bna rib'iyyin alaansaariyy a rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa dakhala aahadukumu almasjida falaa yajlis hattaa yusalliya rak'atayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Qatada bin Rabi Al-Ansari:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you enters a Mosque, he should not sit until he has offered a two-rak`at prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ صَلَّى لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala sallaa lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rak'atayni thumma ansarafa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us and offered a two rak`at prayer and then went away
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ، وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ، وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ، وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ، وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy saalimun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala sallaytu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rak'atayni qabla alzzuhri, warak'atayni ba'da alzzuhri, warak'atayni ba'da aljumu'aai, warak'atayni ba'da almaghribi, warak'atayni ba'da al'ishaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:I offered with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a two rak`at prayer before the Zuhr prayer and two rak`at after the Zuhr prayer, two rak`at after Jumua, Maghrib and `Isha' prayers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَخْطُبُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ ـ أَوْ قَدْ خَرَجَ ـ فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala aakhbaranaa shu'baau, aakhbaranaa 'amruw bnu diynaarin, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yakhtubu ‏ "‏ iidhaa jaa'a aahadukum waaliimaamu yakhtubu aaw qad kharaja falyusalli rak'atayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:While delivering a sermon, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If anyone of you comes while the Imam is delivering the sermon or has come out for it, he should offer a two rak`at prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَيْفُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الْمَكِّيُّ، سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، يَقُولُ أُتِيَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ هَذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ دَخَلَ الْكَعْبَةَ قَالَ فَأَقْبَلْتُ فَأَجِدُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ خَرَجَ، وَأَجِدُ بِلاَلاً عِنْدَ الْبَابِ قَائِمًا فَقُلْتُ يَا بِلاَلُ، صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْكَعْبَةِ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَأَيْنَ قَالَ بَيْنَ هَاتَيْنِ الأُسْطُوَانَتَيْنِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي وَجْهِ الْكَعْبَةِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَوْصَانِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَكْعَتَىِ الضُّحَى‏.‏ وَقَالَ عِتْبَانُ غَدَا عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ بَعْدَ مَا امْتَدَّ النَّهَارُ وَصَفَفْنَا وَرَاءَهُ فَرَكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, qaala haddathanaa sayfu bnu sulaymaana almakkiyyu, sami'tu mujaahidana, yaquwlu autiya abnu 'umara rda allh 'nhma fiy manzilihi faqiyla lahu hadhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad dakhala alka'baaa qaala faaaqbaltu faaajidu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad kharaja, waaajidu bilaalaan 'inda albaabi qaaiimana faqultu yaa bilaalu, sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alka'baai qaala na'am‏.‏ qultu faaayna qaala bayna haatayni alaustuwaanatayni‏.‏ thumma kharaja fasallaa rak'atayni fiy wajhi alka'baai‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi qaala aabuw hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aawsaaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm birak'ataai aldduhaa‏.‏ waqaala 'itbaanu ghadaa 'alaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh ba'da maa amtadda alnnahaaru wasafafnaa waraa'ahu faraka'a rak'atayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mujahid:Somebody came to the house of Ibn `Umar and told him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had entered the Ka`ba. Ibn `Umar said, "I went in front of the Ka`ba and found that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had come out of the Ka`ba and I saw Bilal standing by the side of the gate of the Ka`ba. I said, 'O Bilal! Has Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) prayed inside the Ka`ba?' Bilal replied in the affirmative. I said, 'Where (did he pray)?' He replied, '(He prayed) Between these two pillars and then he came out and offered a two rak`at prayer in front of the Ka`ba.' " Abu `Abdullah said: Abu Huraira said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) advised me to offer two rak`at of Duha prayer (prayer to be offered after sunrise and before midday). " Itban (bin Malik) said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr, came to me after sunrise and we aligned behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and offered two rak`at
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَجْدَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ، وَسَجْدَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ، وَسَجْدَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ، وَسَجْدَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ، وَسَجْدَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ، فَأَمَّا الْمَغْرِبُ وَالْعِشَاءُ فَفِي بَيْتِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ فِي أَهْلِهِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ كَثِيرُ بْنُ فَرْقَدٍ وَأَيُّوبُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَتْنِي أُخْتِي، حَفْصَةُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصَلِّي سَجْدَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ مَا يَطْلُعُ الْفَجْرُ، وَكَانَتْ سَاعَةً لاَ أَدْخُلُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهَا‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ كَثِيرُ بْنُ فَرْقَدٍ وَأَيُّوبُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ فِي أَهْلِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala aakhbaranaa naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala sallaytu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm sajdatayni qabla alzzuhri, wasajdatayni ba'da alzzuhri, wasajdatayni ba'da almaghribi, wasajdatayni ba'da al'ishaa'i, wasajdatayni ba'da aljumu'aai, faaammaa almaghribu waal'ishaa'u fafiy baytihi‏.‏ qaala abnu aabiy alzzinaadi 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa 'an naafi'in ba'da al'ishaa'i fiy aahlihi‏.‏ taaba'ahu kathiyru bnu farqadin waaayyuwbu 'an naafi'in‏.‏ wahaddathatniy aukhtiy, hafsaau aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yusalliy sajdatayni khafiyfatayni ba'da maa yatlu'u alfajru, wakaanat saa'aaan laa aadkhulu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhaa‏.‏ taaba'ahu kathiyru bnu farqadin waaayyuwbu 'an naafi'in‏.‏ waqaala abnu aabiy alzzinaadi 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa 'an naafi'in ba'da al'ishaa'i fiy aahlihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I offered with the Prophet (ﷺ) two rak`at before the Zuhr and two rak`at after the Zuhr prayer; two rak`at after Maghrib, `Isha' and the Jumua prayers. Those of the Maghrib and `Isha' were offered in his house. My sister Hafsa told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer two light rak`at after dawn and it was the time when I never went to the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الشَّعْثَاءِ، جَابِرًا قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَمَانِيًا جَمِيعًا وَسَبْعًا جَمِيعًا‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا أَبَا الشَّعْثَاءِ أَظُنُّهُ أَخَّرَ الظُّهْرَ وَعَجَّلَ الْعَصْرَ وَعَجَّلَ الْعِشَاءَ وَأَخَّرَ الْمَغْرِبَ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَنَا أَظُنُّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, qaala sami'tu aabaa alshha'thaa'i, jaabirana qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nh qaala sallaytu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thamaaniyana jamiy'ana wasab'ana jamiy'ana‏.‏ qultu yaa aabaa alshha'thaa'i aazunnuhu aakhhara alzzuhra wa'ajjala al'asra wa'ajjala al'ishaa'a waaakhhara almaghriba‏.‏ qaala waaanaa aazunnuhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr:I heard Abu Ash-sha'tha' Jabir saying, "I heard Ibn `Abbas saying, 'I offered with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eight rak`at (of Zuhr and `Asr prayers) together and seven rak`at (the Maghrib and the `Isha' prayers) together.' " I said, "O Abu Ash-shatha! I think he must have prayed the Zuhr late and the `Asr early; the `Isha early and the Maghrib late." Abu Ash-sha'tha' said, "I also think so." (See Hadith No. 518 Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ تَوْبَةَ، عَنْ مُوَرِّقٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَتُصَلِّي الضُّحَى قَالَ لاَ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَعُمَرُ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَأَبُو بَكْرٍ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لاَ إِخَالُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an tawbaaa, 'an muwarriqin, qaala qultu laibni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aatusalliy aldduhaa qaala laa‏.‏ qultu fa'umaru‏.‏ qaala laa‏.‏ qultu faaabuw bakrin‏.‏ qaala laa‏.‏ qultu faalnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala laa iikhaaluhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muwarriq:I asked Ibn `Umar "Do you offer the Duha prayer?" He replied in the negative. I further asked, "Did `Umar use to pray it?" He (Ibn `Umar) replied in the negative. I again asked, "Did Abu Bakr use to pray it?" He replied in the negative. I again asked, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to pray it?" Ibn `Umar replied, "I don't think he did
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى، يَقُولُ مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَحَدٌ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى غَيْرَ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ فَإِنَّهَا قَالَتْ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ بَيْتَهَا يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ فَاغْتَسَلَ وَصَلَّى ثَمَانِيَ رَكَعَاتٍ فَلَمْ أَرَ صَلاَةً قَطُّ أَخَفَّ مِنْهَا، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يُتِمُّ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu murraaa, qaala sami'tu 'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy laylaa, yaquwlu maa haddathanaa aahadun, aannahu raaaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy aldduhaa ghayra aummi haaniiin faiinnahaa qaalat iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala baytahaa yawma fathi makkaaa faaghtasala wasallaa thamaaniya raka'aatin falam aara salaaaan qattu aakhaffa minhaa, ghayra aannahu yutimmu alrrukuw'a waalssujuwda‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdur Rahman bin Abi Laila:Only Um Hani narrated to me that she had seen the Prophet (ﷺ) offering the Duha prayer. She said, "On the day of the conquest of Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) entered my house, took a bath and offered eight rak`at (of Duha prayers. I had never seen the Prophet (ﷺ) offering such a light prayer but he performed bowing and prostrations perfectly
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبَّحَ سُبْحَةَ الضُّحَى، وَإِنِّي لأُسَبِّحُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, qaala haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat maa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sabbaha subhaaa aldduhaa, waiinniy lausabbihuhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I never saw the Prophet (ﷺ) offering the Duha prayer but I always offer it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّاسٌ الْجُرَيْرِيُّ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ فَرُّوخَ ـ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، رضى الله عنه قَالَ أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي بِثَلاَثٍ لاَ أَدَعُهُنَّ حَتَّى أَمُوتَ صَوْمِ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ، وَصَلاَةِ الضُّحَى، وَنَوْمٍ عَلَى وِتْرٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'abbaasun aljurayriyyu huwa abnu farruwkha 'an aabiy 'uthmaana alnnahdiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, rda allh 'nh qaala aawsaaniy khaliyliy bithalaathin laa aada'uhunna hattaa aamuwta sawmi thalaathaai aayyaamin min kulli shahrin, wasalaaai aldduhaa, wanawmin 'alaa witrin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:My friend (the Prophet) advised me to do three things and I shall not leave them till I die, these are: To fast three days every month, to offer the Duha prayer, and to offer witr before sleeping
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ـ وَكَانَ ضَخْمًا ـ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنِّي لاَ أَسْتَطِيعُ الصَّلاَةَ مَعَكَ‏.‏ فَصَنَعَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَعَامًا، فَدَعَاهُ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ، وَنَضَحَ لَهُ طَرَفَ حَصِيرٍ بِمَاءٍ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فُلاَنُ بْنُ فُلاَنِ بْنِ جَارُودٍ لأَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى فَقَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُهُ صَلَّى غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu alja'di, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an aanasi bni siyriyna, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin alaansaariyya, qaala qaala rajulun mina alaansaari wakaana dakhmana lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinniy laa aastatiy'u alssalaaaa ma'aka‏.‏ fasana'a lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ta'aamana, fada'aahu iilaa baytihi, wanadaha lahu tarafa hasiyrin bimaa'in fasallaa 'alayhi rak'atayni‏.‏ waqaala fulaanu bnu fulaani bni jaaruwdin laanasin rda allh 'nh aakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusalliy aldduhaa faqaala maa raaaytuhu sallaa ghayra dhalika alyawmi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Sirin: I heard Anas bin Malik al-Ansari saying, "An Ansari man, who was very fat, said to the Prophet, 'I am unable to present myself for the prayer with you.' He prepared a meal for the Prophet (ﷺ) and invited him to his house. He washed one side of a mat with water and the Prophet (ﷺ) offered two Rakat on it." So and so, the son of so and so, the son of Al-Jarud asked Anas, "Did the Prophet (ﷺ) use to offer the Duha prayer?" Anas replied, "I never saw him praying (the Duha prayer) except on that day
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ حَفِظْتُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَشْرَ رَكَعَاتٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ، وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَهَا، وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ فِي بَيْتِهِ، وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ فِي بَيْتِهِ، وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ، وَكَانَتْ سَاعَةً لاَ يُدْخَلُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهَا‏.‏ حَدَّثَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا أَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ وَطَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, qaala haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala hafiztu mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ashra raka'aatin rak'atayni qabla alzzuhri, warak'atayni ba'dahaa, warak'atayni ba'da almaghribi fiy baytihi, warak'atayni ba'da al'ishaa'i fiy baytihi, warak'atayni qabla salaaai alssubhi, wakaanat saa'aaan laa yudkhalu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhaa‏.‏ haddathatniy hafsaau, aannahu kaana iidhaa aadhhana almuuadhhinu watala'a alfajru sallaa rak'atayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: I remember ten Rakat of Nawafil from the Prophet, two Rakat before the Zuhr prayer and two after it; two Rakat after Maghrib prayer in his house, and two Rakat after 'Isha' prayer in his house, and two Rakat before the Fajr prayer and at that time nobody would enter the house of the Prophet. Hafsa told me that the Prophet (ﷺ) used to offer two Rakat after the call maker had made the Adhan and the day had dawned
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ لاَ يَدَعُ أَرْبَعًا قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْغَدَاةِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ وَعَمْرٌو عَنْ شُعْبَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an iibraahiyma bni muhammadi bni almuntashiri, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana laa yada'u aarba'ana qabla alzzuhri warak'atayni qabla alghadaaai‏.‏ taaba'ahu abnu aabiy 'adiyyin wa'amrunw 'an shu'baaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) never missed four rak`at before the Zuhr prayer and two rak`at before the Fajr prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيُّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلُّوا قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الْمَغْرِبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ـ قَالَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ ـ لِمَنْ شَاءَ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَهَا النَّاسُ سُنَّةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'ani alhusayni, 'ani abni buraydaaa, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi almuzaniyyu, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ salluwa qabla salaaai almaghribi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fiy althhaalithaai liman shaa'a karaahiyaaa aan yattakhidhahaa alnnaasu sunnaaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah Al-Muzani:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Pray before the Maghrib (compulsory) prayer." He (said it thrice) and in the third time, he said, "Whoever wants to offer it can do so." He said so because he did not like the people to take it as a tradition
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَرْثَدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَزَنِيَّ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ فَقُلْتُ أَلاَ أُعْجِبُكَ مِنْ أَبِي تَمِيمٍ يَرْكَعُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الْمَغْرِبِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُقْبَةُ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَفْعَلُهُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَمَا يَمْنَعُكَ الآنَ قَالَ الشُّغْلُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda, qaala haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy aayyuwba, qaala haddathaniy yaziydu bnu aabiy habiybin, qaala sami'tu marthada bna 'abdi alllahi alyazaniyya, qaala aataytu 'uqbaaa bna 'aamirin aljuhaniyya faqultu aalaa au'jibuka min aabiy tamiymin yarka'u rak'atayni qabla salaaai almaghribi‏.‏ faqaala 'uqbaau iinnaa kunnaa naf'aluhu 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qultu famaa yamna'uka alana qaala alshhughlu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Marthad bin `Abdullah Al-Yazani:I went to `Uqba bin 'Amir Al-Juhani and said, "Is it not surprising that Abi Tamim offers two rak`at before the Maghrib prayer?" `Uqba said, "We used to do so in the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)." I asked him, "What prevents you from offering it now?" He replied, "Business
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَحْمُودُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، أَنَّهُ عَقَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَقَلَ مَجَّةً مَجَّهَا فِي وَجْهِهِ مِنْ بِئْرٍ كَانَتْ فِي دَارِهِمْ‏.‏ فَزَعَمَ مَحْمُودٌ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عِتْبَانَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ الأَنْصَارِيّ َ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَكَانَ مِمَّنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ كُنْتُ أُصَلِّي لِقَوْمِي بِبَنِي سَالِمٍ، وَكَانَ يَحُولُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ وَادٍ إِذَا جَاءَتِ الأَمْطَارُ فَيَشُقُّ عَلَىَّ اجْتِيَازُهُ قِبَلَ مَسْجِدِهِمْ، فَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنِّي أَنْكَرْتُ بَصَرِي، وَإِنَّ الْوَادِيَ الَّذِي بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِي يَسِيلُ إِذَا جَاءَتِ الأَمْطَارُ فَيَشُقُّ عَلَىَّ اجْتِيَازُهُ، فَوَدِدْتُ أَنَّكَ تَأْتِي فَتُصَلِّي مِنْ بَيْتِي مَكَانًا أَتَّخِذُهُ مُصَلًّى‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَأَفْعَلُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَغَدَا عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ بَعْدَ مَا اشْتَدَّ النَّهَارُ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَذِنْتُ لَهُ فَلَمْ يَجْلِسْ حَتَّى قَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ تُحِبُّ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ مِنْ بَيْتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَشَرْتُ لَهُ إِلَى الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ فِيهِ، فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَبَّرَ وَصَفَفْنَا وَرَاءَهُ، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ وَسَلَّمْنَا حِينَ سَلَّمَ، فَحَبَسْتُهُ عَلَى خَزِيرٍ يُصْنَعُ لَهُ فَسَمِعَ أَهْلُ الدَّارِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِي فَثَابَ رِجَالٌ مِنْهُمْ حَتَّى كَثُرَ الرِّجَالُ فِي الْبَيْتِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ مَا فَعَلَ مَالِكٌ لاَ أَرَاهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ ذَاكَ مُنَافِقٌ لاَ يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَقُلْ ذَاكَ أَلاَ تَرَاهُ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ يَبْتَغِي بِذَلِكَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ أَمَّا نَحْنُ فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ نَرَى وُدَّهُ وَلاَ حَدِيثَهُ إِلاَّ إِلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَ عَلَى النَّارِ مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ يَبْتَغِي بِذَلِكَ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَحْمُودٌ فَحَدَّثْتُهَا قَوْمًا فِيهِمْ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ صَاحِبُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَتِهِ الَّتِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهَا وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِأَرْضِ الرُّومِ، فَأَنْكَرَهَا عَلَىَّ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا أَظُنُّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ مَا قُلْتَ قَطُّ‏.‏ فَكَبُرَ ذَلِكَ عَلَىَّ فَجَعَلْتُ لِلَّهِ عَلَىَّ إِنْ سَلَّمَنِي حَتَّى أَقْفُلَ مِنْ غَزْوَتِي أَنْ أَسْأَلَ عَنْهَا عِتْبَانَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ إِنْ وَجَدْتُهُ حَيًّا فِي مَسْجِدِ قَوْمِهِ، فَقَفَلْتُ فَأَهْلَلْتُ بِحَجَّةٍ أَوْ بِعُمْرَةٍ، ثُمَّ سِرْتُ حَتَّى قَدِمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَأَتَيْتُ بَنِي سَالِمٍ، فَإِذَا عِتْبَانُ شَيْخٌ أَعْمَى يُصَلِّي لِقَوْمِهِ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ سَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَخْبَرْتُهُ مَنْ أَنَا، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ الْحَدِيثِ فَحَدَّثَنِيهِ كَمَا حَدَّثَنِيهِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy mahmuwdu bnu alrrabiy'i alaansaariyyu, aannahu 'aqala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, wa'aqala majjaaan majjahaa fiy wajhihi min biirin kaanat fiy daarihim‏.‏ faza'ama mahmuwdun aannahu sami'a 'itbaana bna maalikin alaansaariyy a rda allh 'nh wakaana mimman shahida badrana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu kuntu ausalliy liqawmiy bibaniy saalimin, wakaana yahuwlu bayniy wabaynahum waadin iidhaa jaa'ati alaamtaaru fayashuqqu 'alaaaa ajtiyaazuhu qibala masjidihim, fajiitu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu lahu iinniy aankartu basariy, waiinna alwaadiya alladhiy bayniy wabayna qawmiy yasiylu iidhaa jaa'ati alaamtaaru fayashuqqu 'alaaaa ajtiyaazuhu, fawadidtu aannaka taatiy fatusalliy min baytiy makaanana aattakhidhuhu musallana‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ saaaf'alu ‏"‏‏.‏ faghadaa 'alaaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh ba'da maa ashtadda alnnahaaru faastaadhana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaadhintu lahu falam yajlis hattaa qaala ‏"‏ aayna tuhibbu aan ausalliya min baytika ‏"‏‏.‏ faaashartu lahu iilaa almakaani alladhiy auhibbu aan ausalliya fiyhi, faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakabbara wasafafnaa waraa'ahu, fasallaa rak'atayni, thumma sallama wasallamnaa hiyna sallama, fahabastuhu 'alaa khaziyrin yusna'u lahu fasami'a aahlu alddaari rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy baytiy fathaaba rijaalun minhum hattaa kathura alrrijaalu fiy albayti‏.‏ faqaala rajulun minhum maa fa'ala maalikun laa aaraahu‏.‏ faqaala rajulun minhum dhaaka munaafiqun laa yuhibbu alllaha warasuwlahu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa taqul dhaaka aalaa taraahu qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ yabtaghiy bidhalika wajha alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏ aammaa nahnu fawaalllahi laa naraa wuddahu walaa hadiythahu iilaaa iilaa almunaafiqiyna‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faiinna alllaha qad harrama 'alaa alnnaari man qaala laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ yabtaghiy bidhalika wajha alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala mahmuwdun fahaddathtuhaa qawmana fiyhim aabuw aayyuwba saahibu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazwatihi allatiy tuwuffiya fiyhaa wayaziydu bnu mu'aawiyaaa 'alayhim biaardi alrruwmi, faaankarahaa 'alaaaa aabuw aayyuwba qaala waalllahi maa aazunnu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala maa qulta qattu‏.‏ fakabura dhalika 'alaaaa faja'altu lillahi 'alaaaa iin sallamaniy hattaa aaqfula min ghazwatiy aan aasaala 'anhaa 'itbaana bna maalikin rda allh 'nh iin wajadtuhu hayyana fiy masjidi qawmihi, faqafaltu faaahlaltu bihajjaain aaw bi'umraain, thumma sirtu hattaa qadimtu almadiynaaa faaataytu baniy saalimin, faiidhaa 'itbaanu shaykhun aa'maa yusalliy liqawmihi falammaa sallama mina alssalaaai sallamtu 'alayhi waaakhbartuhu man aanaa, thumma saaaltuhu 'an dhalika alhadiythi fahaddathaniyhi kamaa haddathaniyhi aawwala marraain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Mahmud bin Ar-rabi' Al-Ansari:that he remembered Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he also remembered a mouthful of water which he had thrown on his face, after taking it from a well that was in their house. Mahmud said that he had heard `Itban bin Malik, who was present with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the battle of Badr saying, "I used to lead my people at Bani Salim in the prayer and there was a valley between me and those people. Whenever it rained it used to be difficult for me to cross it to go to their mosque. So I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, 'I have weak eyesight and the valley between me and my people flows during the rainy season and it becomes difficult for me to cross it; I wish you would come to my house and pray at a place so that I could take that place as a praying place.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'I will do so.' So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came to my house in the (next) morning after the sun had risen high. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked my permission to let him in and I admitted him. He did not sit before saying, 'Where do you want us to offer the prayer in your house?' I pointed to the place where I wanted him to pray. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up for the prayer and started the prayer with Takbir and we aligned in rows behind him; and he offered two rak`at, and finished them with Taslim, and we also performed Taslim with him. I detained him for a meal called "Khazir" which I had prepared for him.--("Khazir" is a special type of dish prepared from barley flour and meat soup)-- When the neighbors got the news that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in my house, they poured in till there were a great number of men in the house. One of them said, 'What is wrong with Malik, for I do not see him?' One of them replied, 'He is a hypocrite and does not love Allah and His Apostle.' On that Allah's Apostle said, 'Don't say this. Haven't you seen that he said, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah for Allah's sake only.' The man replied, 'Allah and His Apostle know better; but by Allah, we never saw him but helping and talking with the hypocrites.' Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, 'No doubt, whoever says. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and by that he wants the pleasures of Allah, then Allah will save him from Hell." Mahmud added, "I told the above narration to some people, one of whom was Abu Aiyub, the companion of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the battle in which he (Abu Aiyub) died and Yazid bin Mu'awiya was their leader in Roman Territory. Abu Aiyub denounced the narration and said, 'I doubt that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ever said what you have said.' I felt that too much, and I vowed to Allah that if I remained alive in that holy battle, I would (go to Medina and) ask `Itban bin Malik if he was still living in the mosque of his people. So when he returned, I assumed Ihram for Hajj or `Umra and then I proceeded on till I reached Medina. I went to Bani Salim and `Itban bin Malik, who was by then an old blind man, was leading his people in the prayer. When he finished the prayer, I greeted him and introduced myself to him and then asked him about that narration. He told that narration again in the same manner as he had narrated it the first time
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اجْعَلُوا فى بُيُوتِكُمْ مِنْ صَلاَتِكُمْ وَلاَ تَتَّخِذُوهَا قُبُورًا ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an aayyuwba, wa'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aj'aluwa fa buyuwtikum min salaatikum walaa tattakhidhuwhaa qubuwrana ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'abdu alwahhaabi 'an aayyuwba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Offer some of your prayers in your houses and do not make them graves
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 20 — Virtues of Prayer at Masjid Makkah and Madinah

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — Virtues of Prayer at Masjid Makkah and Madinah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ قَزَعَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَرْبَعًا قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ غَزَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ غَزْوَةً ح‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu almaliki bnu 'umayrin, 'an qaza'aaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa sa'iydin rda allh 'nh aarba'ana qaala sami'tu mina alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana ghazaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thintaa 'ashraaa ghazwaaan h‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Quza'a: I heard Abu Said saying four words. He said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) (saying the following narrative)." He had participated in twelve holy battles with the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — Virtues of Prayer at Masjid Makkah and Madinah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ، وَمَسْجِدِ الرَّسُولِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَسْجِدِ الأَقْصَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tushaddu alrrihaalu iilaaa iilaa thalaathaai masaajida almasjidi alharaami, wamasjidi alrrasuwli sla allh 'lyh wslm wamasjidi alaaqsaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not set out on a journey except for three Mosques i.e. Al-Masjid-Al-Haram, the Mosque of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , and the Mosque of Al-Aqsa, (Mosque of Jerusalem)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — Virtues of Prayer at Masjid Makkah and Madinah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ، وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَغَرِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَغَرِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ صَلاَةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلاَةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ إِلاَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, qaala aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an zaydi bni rabaahin, wa'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy 'abdi alllahi alaagharri, 'an aabiy 'abdi alllahi alaagharri, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ salaaaun fiy masjidiy hadhaa khayrun min aalfi salaaain fiymaa siwaahu iilaaa almasjida alharaama ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "One prayer in my Mosque is better than one thousand prayers in any other mosque excepting Al-Masjid-Al-Haram
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — Virtues of Prayer at Masjid Makkah and Madinah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ـ هُوَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ ـ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ لاَ يُصَلِّي مِنَ الضُّحَى إِلاَّ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ يَوْمَ يَقْدَمُ بِمَكَّةَ، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يَقْدَمُهَا ضُحًى، فَيَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ، ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَلْفَ الْمَقَامِ، وَيَوْمَ يَأْتِي مَسْجِدَ قُبَاءٍ، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يَأْتِيهِ كُلَّ سَبْتٍ، فَإِذَا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ فِيهِ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَزُورُهُ رَاكِبًا وَمَاشِيًا‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا أَصْنَعُ كَمَا رَأَيْتُ أَصْحَابِي يَصْنَعُونَ، وَلاَ أَمْنَعُ أَحَدًا أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فِي أَىِّ سَاعَةٍ شَاءَ مِنْ لَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ، غَيْرَ أَنْ لاَ تَتَحَرَّوْا طُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ وَلاَ غُرُوبَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma huwa alddawraqiyyu haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, aakhbaranaa aayyuwbu, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma kaana laa yusalliy mina aldduhaa iilaaa fiy yawmayni yawma yaqdamu bimakkaaa, faiinnahu kaana yaqdamuhaa duhana, fayatuwfu bialbayti, thumma yusalliy rak'atayni khalfa almaqaami, wayawma yaatiy masjida qubaa'in, faiinnahu kaana yaatiyhi kulla sabtin, faiidhaa dakhala almasjida kariha aan yakhruja minhu hattaa yusalliya fiyhi‏.‏ qaala wakaana yuhaddithu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yazuwruhu raakibana wamaashiyana‏.‏ qaala wakaana yaquwlu iinnamaa aasna'u kamaa raaaytu aashaabiy yasna'uwna, walaa aamna'u aahadana aan yusalliya fiy aaaai saa'aain shaa'a min laylin aaw nahaarin, ghayra aan laa tataharrawa tuluw'a alshhamsi walaa ghuruwbahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar never offered the Duha prayer except on two occasions: (1) Whenever he reached Mecca; and he always used to reach Mecca in the forenoon. He would perform Tawaf round the Ka`ba and then offer two rak`at at the rear of Maqam Ibrahim. (2) Whenever he visited Quba, for he used to visit it every Saturday. When he entered the Mosque, he disliked to leave it without offering a prayer. Ibn `Umar narrated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to visit the Mosque of Quba (sometime) walking and (sometime) riding. And he (i.e. Ibn `Umar) used to say, "I do only what my companions used to do and I don't forbid anybody to pray at any time during the day or night except that one should not intend to pray at sunrise or sunset
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — Virtues of Prayer at Masjid Makkah and Madinah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْتِي مَسْجِدَ قُبَاءٍ كُلَّ سَبْتٍ مَاشِيًا وَرَاكِبًا‏.‏ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَفْعَلُهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muslimin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaatiy masjida qubaa'in kulla sabtin maashiyana waraakibana‏.‏ wakaana 'abdu alllahi rda allh 'nhma yaf'aluhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Dinar:Ibn `Umar said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to go to the Mosque of Quba every Saturday (sometimes) walking and (sometimes) riding." `Abdullah (Ibn `Umar) used to do the same
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — Virtues of Prayer at Masjid Makkah and Madinah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْتِي قُبَاءً رَاكِبًا وَمَاشِيًا‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ فَيُصَلِّي فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaatiy qubaa'an raakibana wamaashiyana‏.‏ zaada abnu numayrin haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi 'an naafi'in fayusalliy fiyhi rak'atayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) used to go to the Mosque of Quba (sometimes) walking and sometimes riding. Added Nafi` (in another narration), "He then would offer two rak`at (in the Mosque of Quba)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — Virtues of Prayer at Masjid Makkah and Madinah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْمَازِنِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا بَيْنَ بَيْتِي وَمِنْبَرِي رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an 'abbaadi bni tamiymin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni zaydin almaaziniyyi rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa bayna baytiy waminbariy rawdaaun min riyaadi aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid Al-Mazini:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Between my house and the pulpit there is a garden of the gardens of Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — Virtues of Prayer at Masjid Makkah and Madinah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي خُبَيْبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا بَيْنَ بَيْتِي وَمِنْبَرِي رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَمِنْبَرِي عَلَى حَوْضِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, 'an yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy khubaybu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa bayna baytiy waminbariy rawdaaun min riyaadi aljannaai, waminbariy 'alaa hawdiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Between my house and my pulpit there is a garden of the gardens of Paradise, and my pulpit is on my fountain tank (i.e. Al-Kauthar)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 20 — Virtues of Prayer at Masjid Makkah and Madinah
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، سَمِعْتُ قَزَعَةَ، مَوْلَى زِيَادٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يُحَدِّثُ بِأَرْبَعٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَعْجَبْنَنِي وَآنَقْنَنِي قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُسَافِرِ الْمَرْأَةُ يَوْمَيْنِ إِلاَّ مَعَهَا زَوْجُهَا أَوْ ذُو مَحْرَمٍ‏.‏ وَلاَ صَوْمَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ الْفِطْرِ وَالأَضْحَى، وَلاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ صَلاَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ، وَبَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ، وَلاَ تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ مَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَمَسْجِدِ الأَقْصَى وَمَسْجِدِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi almaliki, sami'tu qaza'aaa, mawlaa ziyaadin qaala sami'tu aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya rda allh 'nh yuhaddithu biaarba'in 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaa'jabnaniy waanaqnaniy qaala ‏ "‏ laa tusaafiri almaraaau yawmayni iilaaa ma'ahaa zawjuhaa aaw dhuw mahramin‏.‏ walaa sawma fiy yawmayni alfitri waalaadhaa, walaa salaaaa ba'da salaatayni ba'da alssubhi hattaa tatlu'a alshhamsu, waba'da al'asri hattaa taghruba, walaa tushaddu alrrihaalu iilaaa iilaa thalaathaai masaajida masjidi alharaami wamasjidi alaaqsaa wamasjidiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qaza'a Maula:(freed slave of) Ziyad: I heard Abu Sa`id Al-khudri narrating four things from the Prophet (ﷺ) and I appreciated them very much. He said, conveying the words of the Prophet. (1) "A woman should not go on a two day journey except with her husband or a Dhi-Mahram. (2) No fasting is permissible on two days: `Id-ul-Fitr and `Id-ul-Adha. (3) No prayer after two prayers, i.e. after the Fajr prayer till the sunrises and after the `Asr prayer till the sun sets. (4) Do not prepare yourself for a journey except to three Mosques, i.e. Al-Masjid-Al-Haram, the Mosque of Aqsa (Jerusalem) and my Mosque
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ بَاتَ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ وَهْىَ خَالَتُهُ ـ قَالَ فَاضْطَجَعْتُ عَلَى عَرْضِ الْوِسَادَةِ، وَاضْطَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْلُهُ فِي طُولِهَا، فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى انْتَصَفَ اللَّيْلُ أَوْ قَبْلَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ بِقَلِيلٍ، ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَلَسَ، فَمَسَحَ النَّوْمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الْعَشْرَ آيَاتٍ خَوَاتِيمَ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى شَنٍّ مُعَلَّقَةٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ مِنْهَا، فَأَحْسَنَ وُضُوءَهُ، ثُمَّ قَامَ يُصَلِّي‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فَقُمْتُ فَصَنَعْتُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعَ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رَأْسِي، وَأَخَذَ بِأُذُنِي الْيُمْنَى يَفْتِلُهَا بِيَدِهِ، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى جَاءَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an makhramaaa bni sulaymaana, 'an kuraybin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin aannahu aakhbarahu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aannahu baata 'inda maymuwnaaa aummi almuuminiyna rda allh 'nha wahaa khaalatuhu qaala faadtaja'tu 'alaa 'ardi alwisaadaai, waadtaja'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaahluhu fiy tuwlihaa, fanaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa antasafa alllaylu aaw qablahu biqaliylin aaw ba'dahu biqaliylin, thumma astayqaza rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajalasa, famasaha alnnawma 'an wajhihi biyadihi, thumma qaraaa al'ashra ayaatin khawaatiyma suwraai ali 'imraana, thumma qaama iilaa shannin mu'allaqaain fatawaddaaa minhaa, faaahsana wuduw'ahu, thumma qaama yusalliy‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma faqumtu fasana'tu mithla maa sana'a, thumma dhahabtu faqumtu iilaa janbihi, fawada'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadahu alyumnaa 'alaa raasiy, waaakhadha biaudhuniy alyumnaa yaftiluhaa biyadihi, fasallaa rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma rak'atayni, thumma aawtara, thumma adtaja'a hattaa jaa'ahu almuuadhhinu, faqaama fasallaa rak'atayni khafiyfatayni, thumma kharaja fasallaa alssubha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Kuraib Maula Ibn `Abbas:`Abdullah bin `Abbas said that he had passed a night in the house of Maimuna the mother of the faithful believers , who was his aunt. He said, "I slept across the bed, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with his wife slept lengthwise. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept till midnight or slightly before or after it. Then Allah's Apostle woke up, sat, and removed the traces of sleep by rubbing his hands over his face. Then he recited the last ten verses of Surat-Al `Imran (2). Then he went towards a hanging leather watercontainer and performed a perfect ablution and then stood up for prayer." `Abdullah bin `Abbas added, "I got up and did the same as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done and then went and stood by his side. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then put his right hand over my head and caught my right ear and twisted it. He offered two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at, then two rak`at and then offered one rak`a witr. Then he lay down till the Mu'adh-dhin came and then he prayed two light rak`at and went out and offered the early morning (Fajr) prayer
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا نُسَلِّمُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْنَا، فَلَمَّا رَجَعْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِ النَّجَاشِيِّ سَلَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْنَا وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي الصَّلاَةِ شُغْلاً ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala kunnaa nusallimu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa fiy alssalaaai fayaruddu 'alaynaa, falammaa raja'naa min 'indi alnnajaashiyyi sallamnaa 'alayhi falam yarudda 'alaynaa waqaala ‏ "‏ iinna fiy alssalaaai shughlaan ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:We used to greet the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was praying and he used to answer our greetings. When we returned from An-Najashi (the ruler of Ethiopia), we greeted him, but he did not answer us (during the prayer) and (after finishing the prayer) he said, "In the prayer one is occupied (with a more serious matter)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُرَيْمُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa huraymu bnu sufyaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The same as No. 290. from the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى ـ هُوَ ابْنُ يُونُسَ ـ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ شُبَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَرْقَمَ إِنْ كُنَّا لَنَتَكَلَّمُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يُكَلِّمُ أَحَدُنَا صَاحِبَهُ بِحَاجَتِهِ حَتَّى نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ‏}‏ الآيَةَ، فَأُمِرْنَا بِالسُّكُوتِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa huwa abnu yuwnusa 'an iismaa'iyla, 'ani alhaarithi bni shubaylin, 'an aabiy 'amrinw alshhaybaaniyyi, qaala qaala liy zaydu bnu aarqama iin kunnaa lanatakallamu fiy alssalaaai 'alaa 'ahdi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm, yukallimu aahadunaa saahibahu bihaajatihi hattaa nazalat ‏{‏haafizuwa 'alaa alssalawaati‏}‏ alayaaa, faaumirnaa bialssukuwti‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam:In the lifetime of the Prophet (ﷺ) we used to speak while praying, and one of us would tell his needs to his companions, till the verse, 'Guard strictly your prayers (2.238) was revealed. After that we were ordered to remain silent while praying
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُصْلِحُ بَيْنَ بَنِي عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ، وَحَانَتِ الصَّلاَةُ، فَجَاءَ بِلاَلٌ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فَقَالَ حُبِسَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَؤُمُّ النَّاسَ قَالَ نَعَمْ إِنْ شِئْتُمْ‏.‏ فَأَقَامَ بِلاَلٌ الصَّلاَةَ، فَتَقَدَّمَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَصَلَّى، فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْشِي فِي الصُّفُوفِ يَشُقُّهَا شَقًّا حَتَّى قَامَ فِي الصَّفِّ الأَوَّلِ، فَأَخَذَ النَّاسُ بِالتَّصْفِيحِ‏.‏ قَالَ سَهْلٌ هَلْ تَدْرُونَ مَا التَّصْفِيحُ هُوَ التَّصْفِيقُ‏.‏ وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ لاَ يَلْتَفِتُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ، فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرُوا الْتَفَتَ فَإِذَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الصَّفِّ، فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ مَكَانَكَ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَدَيْهِ، فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ، ثُمَّ رَجَعَ الْقَهْقَرَى وَرَاءَهُ وَتَقَدَّمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَلَّى‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sahlin rda allh 'nh qaala kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yuslihu bayna baniy 'amriw bni 'awfin, wahaanati alssalaaau, fajaa'a bilaalun aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nhma faqaala hubisa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fatauummu alnnaasa qaala na'am iin shiitum‏.‏ faaaqaama bilaalun alssalaaaa, fataqaddama aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh fasallaa, fajaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yamshiy fiy alssufuwfi yashuqquhaa shaqqana hattaa qaama fiy alssaffi alaawwali, faaakhadha alnnaasu bialttasfiyhi‏.‏ qaala sahlun hal tadruwna maa alttasfiyhu huwa alttasfiyqu‏.‏ wakaana aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh laa yaltafitu fiy salaatihi, falammaa aaktharuwa altafata faiidhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alssaffi, faaashaara iilayhi makaanaka‏.‏ farafa'a aabuw bakrin yadayhi, fahamida alllaha, thumma raja'a alqahqaraa waraa'ahu wataqaddama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out to affect a reconciliation between the tribes of Bani `Amr bin `Auf and the time of the prayer became due; Bilal went to Abu Bakr and said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) is detained. Will you lead the people in the prayer?" Abu Bakr replied, "Yes, if you wish." So Bilal pronounced the Iqama and Abu Bakr led the prayer. In the meantime the Prophet (ﷺ) came crossing the rows (of the praying people) till he stood in the first row and the people started clapping. Abu Bakr never looked hither and thither during the prayer but when the people clapped too much, he looked back and saw the Prophet (ﷺ) in the (first) row. The Prophet (ﷺ) waved him to remain at his place, but Abu Bakr raised both his hands and sent praises to Allah and then retreated and the Prophet (ﷺ) went forward and led the prayer. (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا نَقُولُ التَّحِيَّةُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَنُسَمِّي، وَيُسَلِّمُ بَعْضُنَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ، فَسَمِعَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ قُولُوا التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، فَإِنَّكُمْ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمْ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ سَلَّمْتُمْ عَلَى كُلِّ عَبْدٍ لِلَّهِ صَالِحٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'iysaa, haddathanaa aabuw 'abdi alssamadi 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh qaala kunnaa naquwlu alttahiyyaau fiy alssalaaai wanusammiy, wayusallimu ba'dunaa 'alaa ba'din, fasami'ahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ quwluwa alttahiyyaatu lillahi waalssalawaatu waalttayyibaatu, alssalaamu 'alayka aayyuhaa alnnabiyyu warahmaau alllahi wabarakaatuhu, alssalaamu 'alaynaa wa'alaa 'ibaadi alllahi alssaalihiyna, aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaashhadu aanna muhammadana 'abduhu warasuwluhu, faiinnakum iidhaa fa'altum dhalika faqad sallamtum 'alaa kulli 'abdin lillahi saalihin fiy alssamaa'i waalaardi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:We used to say the greeting, name and greet each other in the prayer. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard it and said:--"Say, 'at-tahiyyatu lil-lahi was-salawatu wat-taiyibatu . Assalamu 'Alaika aiyuha-n-Nabiyu warahmatu- l-lahi wa-barakatuhu. _ Assalamu alaina wa-'ala 'ibadi-l-lahi as-salihin.. Ashhadu an la ilaha illa-l-lah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan `Abdu hu wa Rasuluh. (All the compliments are for Allah and all the prayers and all the good things (are for Allah). Peace be on you, O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and blessings (are on you). And peace be on us and on the good (pious) worshipers of Allah. I testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is His slave and Apostle.) So, when you have said this, then you have surely sent the greetings to every good (pious) worshipper of Allah, whether he be in the Heaven or on the Earth
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ التَّسْبِيحُ لِلرِّجَالِ وَالتَّصْفِيقُ لِلنِّسَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa alzzuhriyyu, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alttasbiyhu lilrrijaali waalttasfiyqu lilnnisaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The saying 'Subhan Allah' is for men and clapping is for women." (If something happens in the prayer, the men can invite the attention of the Imam by saying "Subhan Allah". And women, by clapping their hands)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ التَّسْبِيحُ لِلرِّجَالِ وَالتَّصْفِيحُ لِلنِّسَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa, aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alttasbiyhu lilrrijaali waalttasfiyhu lilnnisaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Sa`d:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The saying 'Subhan Allah' is for men and clapping is for women
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، قَالَ يُونُسُ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، بَيْنَا هُمْ فِي الْفَجْرِ يَوْمَ الاِثْنَيْنِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ فَفَجَأَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ كَشَفَ سِتْرَ حُجْرَةِ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ، وَهُمْ صُفُوفٌ، فَتَبَسَّمَ يَضْحَكُ، فَنَكَصَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ، وَظَنَّ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ، وَهَمَّ الْمُسْلِمُونَ أَنْ يَفْتَتِنُوا فِي صَلاَتِهِمْ فَرَحًا بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ رَأَوْهُ، فَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ أَنْ أَتِمُّوا، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ الْحُجْرَةَ وَأَرْخَى السِّتْرَ، وَتُوُفِّيَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa bishru bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, qaala yuwnusu qaala alzzuhriyyu aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna almuslimiyna, baynaa hum fiy alfajri yawma alaithnayni, waaabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh yusalliy bihim fafajaaahumu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qad kashafa sitra hujraai 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha fanazara iilayhim, wahum sufuwfun, fatabassama yadhaku, fanakasa aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh 'alaa 'aqibayhi, wazanna aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuriydu aan yakhruja iilaa alssalaaai, wahamma almuslimuwna aan yaftatinuwa fiy salaatihim farahana bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna raaawhu, faaashaara biyadihi aan aatimmuwa, thumma dakhala alhujraaa waaarkhaa alssitra, watuwuffiya dhalika alyawma‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik: While Abu Bakr was leading the people in the morning prayer on a Monday, the Prophet (ﷺ) came towards them suddenly having lifted the curtain of 'Aisha's house, and looked at them as they were standing in rows and smiled. Abu Bakr tried to come back thinking that Allah's Apostle wanted to come out for the prayer. The attention of the Muslims was diverted from the prayer because they were delighted to see the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) waved his hand to them to complete their prayer, then he went back into the room and let down the curtain. The Prophet expired on that very day
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَادَتِ امْرَأَةٌ ابْنَهَا، وَهْوَ فِي صَوْمَعَةٍ قَالَتْ يَا جُرَيْجُ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ أُمِّي وَصَلاَتِي‏.‏ قَالَتْ يَا جُرَيْجُ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ أُمِّي وَصَلاَتِي‏.‏ قَالَتْ يَا جُرَيْجُ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ أُمِّي وَصَلاَتِي‏.‏ قَالَتِ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ يَمُوتُ جُرَيْجٌ حَتَّى يَنْظُرَ فِي وَجْهِ الْمَيَامِيسِ‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ تَأْوِي إِلَى صَوْمَعَتِهِ رَاعِيَةٌ تَرْعَى الْغَنَمَ فَوَلَدَتْ فَقِيلَ لَهَا مِمَّنْ هَذَا الْوَلَدُ قَالَتْ مِنْ جُرَيْجٍ نَزَلَ مِنْ صَوْمَعَتِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ جُرَيْجٌ أَيْنَ هَذِهِ الَّتِي تَزْعُمُ أَنَّ وَلَدَهَا لِي قَالَ يَا بَابُوسُ مَنْ أَبُوكَ قَالَ رَاعِي الْغَنَمِ ‏"‏‏.‏
