verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا مِنَ النَّاسِ مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُتَوَفَّى لَهُ ثَلاَثٌ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحِنْثَ، إِلاَّ أَدْخَلَهُ اللَّهُ الْجَنَّةَ بِفَضْلِ رَحْمَتِهِ إِيَّاهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa mina alnnaasi min muslimin yutawaffaa lahu thalaathun lam yablughuwa alhintha, iilaaa aadkhalahu alllahu aljannaaa bifadli rahmatihi iiyyaahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim whose three children die before the age of puberty will be granted Paradise by Allah due to his mercy for them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الأَصْبَهَانِيِّ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، رضى الله عنه أَنَّ النِّسَاءَ، قُلْنَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اجْعَلْ لَنَا يَوْمًا‏.‏ فَوَعَظَهُنَّ، وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ مَاتَ لَهَا ثَلاَثَةٌ مِنَ الْوَلَدِ كَانُوا حِجَابًا مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ وَاثْنَانِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَاثْنَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ شَرِيكٌ عَنِ ابْنِ الأَصْبَهَانِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ‏"‏ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحِنْثَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu alaasbahaaniyyi, 'an dhakwaana, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, rda allh 'nh aanna alnnisaa'a, qulna lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aj'al lanaa yawmana‏.‏ fawa'azahunna, waqaala ‏"‏ aayyumaa amraaaain maata lahaa thalaathaaun mina alwaladi kaanuwa hijaabana mina alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalati amraaaaun waathnaani‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ waathnaani ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala shariykun 'ani abni alaasbahaaniyyi, haddathaniy aabuw saalihin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, waaabiy, hurayraaa rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala aabuw hurayraaa ‏"‏ lam yablughuwa alhintha ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id:The women requested the Prophet, "Please fix a day for us." So the Prophet (ﷺ) preached to them and said, "A woman whose three children died would be screened from the Hell Fire by them," Hearing that, a woman asked, "If two died?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Even two (would screen her from the (Hell) Fire. " And Abu Huraira added, "Those children should be below the age of puberty
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَمُوتُ لِمُسْلِمٍ ثَلاَثَةٌ مِنَ الْوَلَدِ، فَيَلِجَ النَّارَ إِلاَّ تَحِلَّةَ الْقَسَمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏{‏وَإِنْ مِنْكُمْ إِلاَّ وَارِدُهَا‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'tu alzzuhriyya, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa yamuwtu limuslimin thalaathaaun mina alwaladi, fayalija alnnaara iilaaa tahillaaa alqasami ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi ‏{‏waiin minkum iilaaa waariduhaa‏}‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No Muslim whose three children died will go to the Fire except for Allah's oath (i.e. everyone has to pass over the bridge above the lake of fire)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِامْرَأَةٍ عِنْدَ قَبْرٍ وَهِيَ تَبْكِي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اتَّقِي اللَّهَ وَاصْبِرِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala marra alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biamraaaain 'inda qabrin wahiya tabkiy faqaala ‏ "‏ attaqiy alllaha waasbiriy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a woman who was sitting and weeping beside a grave and said to her, "Fear Allah and be patient
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ الأَنْصَارِيَّةِ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ تُوُفِّيَتِ ابْنَتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اغْسِلْنَهَا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مَنْ ذَلِكَ إِنْ رَأَيْتُنَّ ذَلِكَ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَاجْعَلْنَ فِي الآخِرَةِ كَافُورًا أَوْ شَيْئًا مِنْ كَافُورٍ، فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُنَّ فَآذِنَّنِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَرَغْنَا آذَنَّاهُ فَأَعْطَانَا حِقْوَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشْعِرْنَهَا إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَعْنِي إِزَارَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an aayyuwba alssakhtiyaaniyyi, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa alaansaariyyaai rda allh 'nha qaalat dakhala 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna tuwuffiyati abnatuhu faqaala ‏"‏ aghsilnahaa thalaathana aaw khamsana aaw aakthara man dhalika iin raaaytunna dhalika bimaa'in wasidrin, waaj'alna fiy alakhiraai kaafuwrana aaw shayiana min kaafuwrin, faiidhaa faraghtunna faadhinnaniy ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa faraghnaa adhannaahu faaa'taanaa hiqwahu faqaala ‏"‏ aash'irnahaa iiyyaahu ‏"‏‏.‏ ta'niy iizaarahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um 'Atiyya al-Ansariya:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us when his daughter died and said, "Wash her thrice or five times or more, if you see it necessary, with water and Sidr and then apply camphor or some camphor at the end; and when you finish, notify me." So when we finished it, we informed him and he gave us his waist-sheet and told us to shroud the dead body in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ نَغْسِلُ ابْنَتَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اغْسِلْنَهَا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَاجْعَلْنَ فِي الآخِرَةِ كَافُورًا، فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُنَّ فَآذِنَّنِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَرَغْنَا آذَنَّاهُ، فَأَلْقَى إِلَيْنَا حِقْوَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشْعِرْنَهَا إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَيُّوبُ وَحَدَّثَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَكَانَ فِي حَدِيثِ حَفْصَةَ ‏"‏ اغْسِلْنَهَا وِتْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ فِيهِ ‏:‏ ‏"‏ ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ سَبْعًا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ فِيهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ ابْدَأْنَ بِمَيَامِنِهَا وَمَوَاضِعِ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ فِيهِ أَنَّ أُمَّ عَطِيَّةَ قَالَتْ وَمَشَطْنَاهَا ثَلاَثَةَ قُرُونٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi althhaqafiyyu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat dakhala 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu naghsilu abnatahu faqaala ‏"‏ aghsilnahaa thalaathana aaw khamsana aaw aakthara min dhalika bimaa'in wasidrin, waaj'alna fiy alakhiraai kaafuwrana, faiidhaa faraghtunna faadhinnaniy ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa faraghnaa adhannaahu, faaalqaa iilaynaa hiqwahu faqaala ‏"‏ aash'irnahaa iiyyaahu ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aayyuwbu wahaddathatniy hafsaau bimithli hadiythi muhammadin wakaana fiy hadiythi hafsaaa ‏"‏ aghsilnahaa witrana ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana fiyhi ‏:‏ ‏"‏ thalaathana aaw khamsana aaw sab'ana ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana fiyhi aannahu qaala ‏"‏ abdaana bimayaaminihaa wamawaadi'i alwuduw'i minhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaana fiyhi aanna aumma 'atiyyaaa qaalat wamashatnaahaa thalaathaaa quruwnin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us and we were giving a bath to his (dead) daughter and said, "Wash her three, five or more times with water and Sidr and sprinkle camphor on her at the end; and when you finish, notify me." So when we finished, we informed him and he gave us his waist-sheet and told us to shroud her in it. Aiyub said that Hafsa narrated to him a narration similar to that of Muhammad in which it was said that the bath was to be given for an odd number of times, and the numbers 3, 5 or 7 were mentioned. It was also said that they were to start with the right side and with the parts which were washed in ablution, and that Um 'Atiyya also mentioned, "We combed her hair and divided them in three braids
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَسْلِ ابْنَتِهِ ‏ "‏ ابْدَأْنَ بِمَيَامِنِهَا وَمَوَاضِعِ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an hafsaaa binti siyriyna, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghasli abnatihi ‏ "‏ abdaana bimayaaminihaa wamawaadi'i alwuduw'i minhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , concerning his (dead) daughter's bath, said, "Start with the right side, and the parts which are washed in ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَمَّا غَسَّلْنَا بِنْتَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَنَا وَنَحْنُ نَغْسِلُهَا ‏ "‏ ابْدَأْنَ بِمَيَامِنِهَا وَمَوَاضِعِ الْوُضُوءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, 'an hafsaaa binti siyriyna, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat lammaa ghassalnaa binta alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lanaa wanahnu naghsiluhaa ‏ "‏ abdaana bimayaaminihaa wamawaadi'i alwuduw'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:When we washed the deceased daughter of the Prophet, he said to us, while we were washing her, "Start the bath from the right side and from the parts which are washed in ablution
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ تُوُفِّيَتْ بِنْتُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَنَا ‏"‏ اغْسِلْنَهَا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ إِنْ رَأَيْتُنَّ، فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُنَّ فَآذِنَّنِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَرَغْنَا آذَنَّاهُ فَنَزَعَ مِنْ حِقْوِهِ إِزَارَهُ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشْعِرْنَهَا إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu hammaadin, aakhbaranaa abnu 'awnin, 'an muhammadin, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat tuwuffiyat bintu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala lanaa ‏"‏ aghsilnahaa thalaathana aaw khamsana aaw aakthara min dhalika iin raaaytunna, faiidhaa faraghtunna faadhinnaniy ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa faraghnaa adhannaahu fanaza'a min hiqwihi iizaarahu waqaala ‏"‏ aash'irnahaa iiyyaahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:The daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) expired, and he said to us, "Wash her three or five times, or more if you see it necessary, and when you finish, notify me." So, (when we finished) we informed him and he unfastened his waist-sheet and told us to shroud her in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ تُوُفِّيَتْ إِحْدَى بَنَاتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَجَ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اغْسِلْنَهَا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ إِنْ رَأَيْتُنَّ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَاجْعَلْنَ فِي الآخِرَةِ كَافُورًا أَوْ شَيْئًا مِنْ كَافُورٍ، فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُنَّ فَآذِنَّنِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَمَّا فَرَغْنَا آذَنَّاهُ، فَأَلْقَى إِلَيْنَا حِقْوَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشْعِرْنَهَا إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ بِنَحْوِهِ وَقَالَتْ إِنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ اغْسِلْنَهَا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ سَبْعًا أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ إِنْ رَأَيْتُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ قَالَتْ أُمُّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ وَجَعَلْنَا رَأْسَهَا ثَلاَثَةَ قُرُونٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haamidu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa, qaalat tuwuffiyat iihdaa banaati alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fakharaja, faqaala ‏"‏ aghsilnahaa thalaathana aaw khamsana aaw aakthara min dhalika iin raaaytunna bimaa'in wasidrin, waaj'alna fiy alakhiraai kaafuwrana aaw shayiana min kaafuwrin, faiidhaa faraghtunna faadhinnaniy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat falammaa faraghnaa adhannaahu, faaalqaa iilaynaa hiqwahu faqaala ‏"‏ aash'irnahaa iiyyaahu ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'an aayyuwba, 'an hafsaaa, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nhma binahwihi waqaalat iinnahu qaala ‏"‏ aghsilnahaa thalaathana aaw khamsana aaw sab'ana aaw aakthara min dhalika iin raaaytunna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat hafsaau qaalat aummu 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nha waja'alnaa raasahaa thalaathaaa quruwnin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad:Um 'Atiyya said, "One of the daughters of the Prophet (ﷺ) died and he came out and said, 'Wash her three or five times or more, if you think it necessary, with water and Sidr, and last of all put camphor (or some camphor) and when you finish, inform me.' " Um Atiyya added, "When we finished we informed him and he gave us his waist-sheet and said, 'Shroud her in it.' " And Um 'Atiyya (in another narration) added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Wash her three, five or seven times or more, if you think it necessary.' " Hafsa said that Um 'Atiyya had also said, "We entwined her hair into three braids
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَيُّوبُ وَسَمِعْتُ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتَ سِيرِينَ، قَالَتْ حَدَّثَتْنَا أُمُّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهُنَّ جَعَلْنَ رَأْسَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثَةَ قُرُونٍ نَقَضْنَهُ ثُمَّ غَسَلْنَهُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَهُ ثَلاَثَةَ قُرُونٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aayyuwbu wasami'tu hafsaaa binta siyriyna, qaalat haddathatnaa aummu 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nha aannahunna ja'alna raasa binti rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaathaaa quruwnin naqadnahu thumma ghasalnahu thumma ja'alnahu thalaathaaa quruwnin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hafsa bint Seereen:Um 'Atiyya said that they had entwined the hair of the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in three braids. They first undid her hair, washed and then entwined it in three braids
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَنَّ أَيُّوبَ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ سِيرِينَ، يَقُولُ جَاءَتْ أُمُّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ مِنَ اللاَّتِي بَايَعْنَ، قَدِمَتِ الْبِصْرَةَ، تُبَادِرُ ابْنًا لَهَا فَلَمْ تُدْرِكْهُ ـ فَحَدَّثَتْنَا قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ نَغْسِلُ ابْنَتَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اغْسِلْنَهَا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ إِنْ رَأَيْتُنَّ ذَلِكَ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَاجْعَلْنَ فِي الآخِرَةِ كَافُورًا، فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُنَّ فَآذِنَّنِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَمَّا فَرَغْنَا أَلْقَى إِلَيْنَا حَقْوَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشْعِرْنَهَا إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَزِدْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، وَلاَ أَدْرِي أَىُّ بَنَاتِهِ‏.‏ وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ الإِشْعَارَ الْفُفْنَهَا فِيهِ، وَكَذَلِكَ كَانَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْمَرْأَةِ أَنْ تُشْعَرَ وَلاَ تُؤْزَرَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aanna aayyuwba, aakhbarahu qaala sami'tu abna siyriyna, yaquwlu jaa'at aummu 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nha amraaaaun mina alaansaari mina allaaatiy baaya'na, qadimati albisraaa, tubaadiru abnana lahaa falam tudrikhu fahaddathatnaa qaalat dakhala 'alaynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu naghsilu abnatahu faqaala ‏"‏ aghsilnahaa thalaathana aaw khamsana aaw aakthara min dhalika iin raaaytunna dhalika bimaa'in wasidrin, waaj'alna fiy alakhiraai kaafuwrana, faiidhaa faraghtunna faadhinnaniy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat falammaa faraghnaa aalqaa iilaynaa haqwahu faqaala ‏"‏ aash'irnahaa iiyyaahu ‏"‏‏.‏ walam yazid 'alaa dhalika, walaa aadriy aaaau banaatihi‏.‏ waza'ama aanna aliish'aara alfufnahaa fiyhi, wakadhalika kaana abnu siyriyna yaamuru bialmaraaai aan tush'ara walaa tuuzara‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Seereen:Um 'Atiyya (an Ansari woman who gave the pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) ) came to Basra to visit her son, but she could not find him. She narrated to us, "The Prophet (ﷺ) came to us while we were giving bath to his (dead) daughter, he said: 'Wash her three times, five times or more, if you think it necessary, with water and Sidr, and last of all put camphor, and when you finish, notify me.' " Um 'Atiyya added, "After finishing, we informed him and he gave us his waist sheet and told us to shroud her in it and did not say more than that
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ الْهُذَيْلِ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ ضَفَرْنَا شَعَرَ بِنْتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ تَعْنِي ثَلاَثَةَ قُرُونٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَكِيعٌ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ نَاصِيَتَهَا وَقَرْنَيْهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an hishaamin, 'an aummi alhudhayli, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat dafarnaa sha'ara binti alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ ta'niy thalaathaaa quruwnin‏.‏ waqaala wakiy'un qaala sufyaanu naasiyatahaa waqarnayhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:We entwined the hair of the dead daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) into three braids. Waki said that Sufyan said, "One braid was entwined in front and the other two were entwined on the sides of the head
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنَا حَفْصَةُ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ تُوُفِّيَتْ إِحْدَى بَنَاتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَانَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اغْسِلْنَهَا بِالسِّدْرِ وِتْرًا ثَلاَثًا أَوْ خَمْسًا أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ إِنْ رَأَيْتُنَّ ذَلِكَ، وَاجْعَلْنَ فِي الآخِرَةِ كَافُورًا أَوْ شَيْئًا مِنْ كَافُورٍ، فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُنَّ فَآذِنَّنِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَرَغْنَا آذَنَّاهُ، فَأَلْقَى إِلَيْنَا حِقْوَهُ، فَضَفَرْنَا شَعَرَهَا ثَلاَثَةَ قُرُونٍ وَأَلْقَيْنَاهَا خَلْفَهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an hishaami bni hassaana, qaala haddathatnaa hafsaau, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat tuwuffiyat iihdaa banaati alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaataanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aghsilnahaa bialssidri witrana thalaathana aaw khamsana aaw aakthara min dhalika iin raaaytunna dhalika, waaj'alna fiy alakhiraai kaafuwrana aaw shayiana min kaafuwrin, faiidhaa faraghtunna faadhinnaniy ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa faraghnaa adhannaahu, faaalqaa iilaynaa hiqwahu, fadafarnaa sha'arahaa thalaathaaa quruwnin waaalqaynaahaa khalfahaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:One of the daughters of the Prophet (ﷺ) expired and he came to us and said, "Wash her with Sidr (water) for odd number of times, i.e. three, five or more, if you think it necessary, and in the last, put camphor or (some camphor on her), and when you finish, notify me." So when we finished we informed him. He gave his waist-sheet to us (to shroud her). We entwined the hair (of the deceased girl) in three braids and made them fall at her back
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُفِّنَ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ يَمَانِيَةٍ بِيضٍ سَحُولِيَّةٍ مِنْ كُرْسُفٍ، لَيْسَ فِيهِنَّ قَمِيصٌ وَلاَ عِمَامَةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kuffina fiy thalaathaai aathwaabin yamaaniyaain biydin sahuwliyyaain min kursufin, laysa fiyhinna qamiysun walaa 'imaamaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was shrouded in three Yemenite white Suhuliya (pieces of cloth) of cotton, and in them there was neither a shirt nor a turban
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ وَاقِفٌ بِعَرَفَةَ إِذْ وَقَعَ عَنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ فَوَقَصَتْهُ ـ أَوْ قَالَ فَأَوْقَصَتْهُ ـ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْنِ، وَلاَ تُحَنِّطُوهُ وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ، فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّيًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhm qaala baynamaa rajulun waaqifun bi'arafaaa iidh waqa'a 'an raahilatihi fawaqasathu aaw qaala faaawqasathu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin, wakaffinuwhu fiy thawbayni, walaa tuhannituwhu walaa tukhammiruwa raasahu, faiinnahu yub'athu yawma alqiyaamaai mulabbiyana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While a man was riding (his Mount) in `Arafat, he fell down from it (his Mount) and broke his neck (and died). The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wash him with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth, and neither perfume him, nor cover his head, for he will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection saying, 'Labbaik,' (i.e. like a pilgrim)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ وَاقِفٌ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَرَفَةَ إِذْ وَقَعَ مِنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ فَأَقْصَعَتْهُ ـ أَوْ قَالَ فَأَقْعَصَتْهُ ـ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْنِ، وَلاَ تُحَنِّطُوهُ وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّيًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala baynamaa rajulun waaqifun ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'arafaaa iidh waqa'a min raahilatihi faaaqsa'athu aaw qaala faaaq'asathu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin, wakaffinuwhu fiy thawbayni, walaa tuhannituwhu walaa tukhammiruwa raasahu, faiinna alllaha yab'athuhu yawma alqiyaamaai mulabbiyana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While a man was at `Arafat (for Hajj) with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he fell down from his Mount and broke his neck (and died). So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Wash him with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth and neither perfume him nor cover his head, for Allah will resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection and he will be saying 'Labbaik
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، وَقَصَهُ بَعِيرُهُ، وَنَحْنُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْنِ، وَلاَ تُمِسُّوهُ طِيبًا، وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّدًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhm aanna rajulaan, waqasahu ba'iyruhu, wanahnu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa muhrimun faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin, wakaffinuwhu fiy thawbayni, walaa tumissuwhu tiybana, walaa tukhammiruwa raasahu, faiinna alllaha yab'athuhu yawma alqiyaamaai mulabbidana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man was killed by his camel while we were with the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was a Muhrim. So the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wash him with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth and neither perfume him nor cover his head, for Allah will resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection and he will be saying 'Labbaik
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، وَأَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَجُلٌ وَاقِفٌ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَرَفَةَ فَوَقَعَ عَنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ ـ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ فَوَقَصَتْهُ، وَقَالَ عَمْرٌو فَأَقْصَعَتْهُ ـ فَمَاتَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْنِ، وَلاَ تُحَنِّطُوهُ وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ، فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ـ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ يُلَبِّي، وَقَالَ عَمْرٌو ـ مُلَبِّيًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'amrinw, waaayyuwba, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhm qaala kaana rajulun waaqifun ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'arafaaa fawaqa'a 'an raahilatihi qaala aayyuwbu fawaqasathu, waqaala 'amrunw faaaqsa'athu famaata faqaala ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin, wakaffinuwhu fiy thawbayni, walaa tuhannituwhu walaa tukhammiruwa raasahu, faiinnahu yub'athu yawma alqiyaamaai qaala aayyuwbu yulabbiy, waqaala 'amrunw mulabbiyana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man fell from his Mount and died while he was with the Prophet (ﷺ) at `Arafat. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wash him with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth and neither perfume him nor cover his head, for he will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection saying, 'Labbaik
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ عَبْدَ، اللَّهِ بْنَ أُبَىٍّ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ جَاءَ ابْنُهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَعْطِنِي قَمِيصَكَ أُكَفِّنْهُ فِيهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُ، فَأَعْطَاهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَمِيصَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ آذِنِّي أُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَآذَنَهُ، فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ جَذَبَهُ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَقَالَ أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ نَهَاكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنَا بَيْنَ خِيرَتَيْنِ قَالَ ‏{‏اسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ أَوْ لاَ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ إِنْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً فَلَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, qaala haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna 'abda, alllahi bna aubaaain lammaa tuwuffiya jaa'a abnuhu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aa'tiniy qamiysaka aukaffinhu fiyhi, wasalli 'alayhi waastaghfir lahu, faaa'taahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qamiysahu faqaala ‏"‏ adhinniy ausalliy 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ faadhanahu, falammaa aaraada aan yusalliya 'alayhi jadhabahu 'umaru rda allh 'nh faqaala aalaysa alllahu nahaaka aan tusalliya 'alaa almunaafiqiyna faqaala ‏"‏ aanaa bayna khiyratayni qaala ‏{‏astaghfir lahum aaw laa tastaghfir lahum iin tastaghfir lahum sab'iyna marraaan falan yaghfira alllahu lahum‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ fasallaa 'alayhi fanazalat ‏{‏walaa tusalli 'alaa aahadin minhum maata aabadana‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:When `Abdullah bin Ubai (the chief of hypocrites) died, his son came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Please give me your shirt to shroud him in it, offer his funeral prayer and ask for Allah's forgiveness for him." So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave his shirt to him and said, "Inform me (When the funeral is ready) so that I may offer the funeral prayer." So, he informed him and when the Prophet intended to offer the funeral prayer, `Umar took hold of his hand and said, "Has Allah not forbidden you to offer the funeral prayer for the hypocrites? The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have been given the choice for Allah says: '(It does not avail) Whether you (O Muhammad) ask forgiveness for them (hypocrites), or do not ask for forgiveness for them. Even though you ask for their forgiveness seventy times, Allah will not forgive them. (9.80)" So the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the funeral prayer and on that the revelation came: "And never (O Muhammad) pray (funeral prayer) for any of them (i.e. hypocrites) that dies
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ جَابِرًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَتَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أُبَىٍّ بَعْدَ مَا دُفِنَ فَأَخْرَجَهُ، فَنَفَثَ فِيهِ مِنْ رِيقِهِ وَأَلْبَسَهُ قَمِيصَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa maaliku bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, sami'a jaabirana rda allh 'nh qaala aataa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'abda alllahi bna aubaaain ba'da maa dufina faaakhrajahu, fanafatha fiyhi min riyqihi waaalbasahu qamiysahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to (the grave of) `Abdullah bin Ubai after his body was buried. The body was brought out and then the Prophet (ﷺ) put his saliva over the body and clothed it in his shirt
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كُفِّنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابِ سَحُولَ كُرْسُفٍ، لَيْسَ فِيهَا قَمِيصٌ وَلاَ عِمَامَةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an hishaamin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kuffina alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy thalaathaai aathwaabi sahuwla kursufin, laysa fiyhaa qamiysun walaa 'imaamaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) was shrouded in three pieces of cloth which were made of Suhul (a type of cotton), and neither a shirt nor a turban were used
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُفِّنَ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ، لَيْسَ فِيهَا قَمِيصٌ وَلاَ عِمَامَةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kuffina fiy thalaathaai aathwaabin, laysa fiyhaa qamiysun walaa 'imaamaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was shrouded in three pieces of cloth and neither a shirt nor a turban were used
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُفِّنَ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ بِيضٍ سَحُولِيَّةٍ، لَيْسَ فِيهَا قَمِيصٌ وَلاَ عِمَامَةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kuffina fiy thalaathaai aathwaabin biydin sahuwliyyaain, laysa fiyhaa qamiysun walaa 'imaamaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was shrouded in three pieces of cloth which were made of white Suhul and neither a shirt nor a turban were used
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أُتِيَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَوْمًا بِطَعَامِهِ فَقَالَ قُتِلَ مُصْعَبُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ ـ وَكَانَ خَيْرًا مِنِّي ـ فَلَمْ يُوجَدْ لَهُ مَا يُكَفَّنُ فِيهِ إِلاَّ بُرْدَةٌ، وَقُتِلَ حَمْزَةُ أَوْ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي فَلَمْ يُوجَدْ لَهُ مَا يُكَفَّنُ فِيهِ إِلاَّ بُرْدَةٌ، لَقَدْ خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدْ عُجِّلَتْ لَنَا طَيِّبَاتُنَا فِي حَيَاتِنَا الدُّنْيَا، ثُمَّ جَعَلَ يَبْكِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu muhammadin almakkiyyu, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala autiya 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'awfin rda allh 'nh yawmana bita'aamihi faqaala qutila mus'abu bnu 'umayrin wakaana khayrana minniy falam yuwjad lahu maa yukaffanu fiyhi iilaaa burdaaun, waqutila hamzaau aaw rajulun akharu khayrun minniy falam yuwjad lahu maa yukaffanu fiyhi iilaaa burdaaun, laqad khashiytu aan yakuwna qad 'ujjilat lanaa tayyibaatunaa fiy hayaatinaa alddunyaa, thumma ja'ala yabkiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d from his father:Once the meal of `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf was brought in front of him, and he said, "Mus`ab bin `Umair was martyred and he was better than I, and he had nothing except his Burd (a black square narrow dress) to be shrouded in. Hamza or another person was martyred and he was also better than I and he had nothing to be shrouded in except his Burd. No doubt, I fear that the rewards of my deeds might have been given early in this world." Then he started weeping
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أُتِيَ بِطَعَامٍ وَكَانَ صَائِمًا فَقَالَ قُتِلَ مُصْعَبُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي، كُفِّنَ فِي بُرْدَةٍ، إِنْ غُطِّيَ رَأْسُهُ بَدَتْ رِجْلاَهُ، وَإِنْ غُطِّيَ رِجْلاَهُ بَدَا رَأْسُهُ ـ وَأُرَاهُ قَالَ ـ وَقُتِلَ حَمْزَةُ وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي، ثُمَّ بُسِطَ لَنَا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا مَا بُسِطَ ـ أَوْ قَالَ أُعْطِينَا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا مَا أُعْطِينَا ـ وَقَدْ خَشِينَا أَنْ تَكُونَ حَسَنَاتُنَا عُجِّلَتْ لَنَا، ثُمَّ جَعَلَ يَبْكِي حَتَّى تَرَكَ الطَّعَامَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an aabiyhi, iibraahiyma aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna 'awfin rda allh 'nh autiya bita'aamin wakaana saaiimana faqaala qutila mus'abu bnu 'umayrin wahuwa khayrun minniy, kuffina fiy burdaain, iin ghuttiya raasuhu badat rijlaahu, waiin ghuttiya rijlaahu badaa raasuhu waauraahu qaala waqutila hamzaau wahuwa khayrun minniy, thumma busita lanaa mina alddunyaa maa busita aaw qaala au'tiynaa mina alddunyaa maa au'tiynaa waqad khashiynaa aan takuwna hasanaatunaa 'ujjilat lanaa, thumma ja'ala yabkiy hattaa taraka altta'aama‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibrahim:Once a meal was brought to `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf and he was fasting. He said, "Mus`ab bin `Umair was martyred and he was better than I and was shrouded in his Burd and when his head was covered with it, his legs became bare, and when his legs were covered his head got uncovered. Hamza was martyred and was better than I. Now the worldly wealth have been bestowed upon us (or said a similar thing). No doubt, I fear that the rewards of my deeds might have been given earlier in this world." Then he started weeping and left his food
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَقِيقٌ، حَدَّثَنَا خَبَّابٌ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ هَاجَرْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَلْتَمِسُ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ، فَوَقَعَ أَجْرُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ، فَمِنَّا مَنْ مَاتَ لَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنْ أَجْرِهِ شَيْئًا مِنْهُمْ مُصْعَبُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَيْنَعَتْ لَهُ ثَمَرَتُهُ فَهُوَ يَهْدِبُهَا‏.‏ قُتِلَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ، فَلَمْ نَجِدْ مَا نُكَفِّنُهُ إِلاَّ بُرْدَةً إِذَا غَطَّيْنَا بِهَا رَأْسَهُ خَرَجَتْ رِجْلاَهُ، وَإِذَا غَطَّيْنَا رِجْلَيْهِ خَرَجَ رَأْسُهُ، فَأَمَرَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نُغَطِّيَ رَأْسَهُ، وَأَنْ نَجْعَلَ عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ مِنَ الإِذْخِرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa shaqiyqun, haddathanaa khabbaabun rda allh 'nh qaala haajarnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm naltamisu wajha alllahi, fawaqa'a aajrunaa 'alaa alllahi, faminnaa man maata lam yaakul min aajrihi shayiana minhum mus'abu bnu 'umayrin, waminnaa man aayna'at lahu thamaratuhu fahuwa yahdibuhaa‏.‏ qutila yawma auhudin, falam najid maa nukaffinuhu iilaaa burdaaan iidhaa ghattaynaa bihaa raasahu kharajat rijlaahu, waiidhaa ghattaynaa rijlayhi kharaja raasuhu, faaamaranaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nughattiya raasahu, waaan naj'ala 'alaa rijlayhi mina aliidhkhiri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Khabbab:We emigrated with the Prophet (ﷺ) in Allah's cause, and so our reward was then surely incumbent on Allah. Some of us died and they did not take anything from their rewards in this world, and amongst them was Mus`ab bin `Umair; and the others were those who got their rewards. Mus`ab bin `Umair was martyred on the day of the Battle of Uhud and we could get nothing except his Burd to shroud him in. And when we covered his head his feet became bare and vice versa. So the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered us to cover his head only and to put idhkhir (a kind of shrub) over his feet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، جَاءَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِبُرْدَةٍ مَنْسُوجَةٍ فِيهَا حَاشِيَتُهَا ـ أَتَدْرُونَ مَا الْبُرْدَةُ قَالُوا الشَّمْلَةُ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَسَجْتُهَا بِيَدِي، فَجِئْتُ لأَكْسُوَكَهَا‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُحْتَاجًا إِلَيْهَا، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْنَا وَإِنَّهَا إِزَارُهُ، فَحَسَّنَهَا فُلاَنٌ فَقَالَ اكْسُنِيهَا، مَا أَحْسَنَهَا‏.‏ قَالَ الْقَوْمُ مَا أَحْسَنْتَ، لَبِسَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُحْتَاجًا إِلَيْهَا، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتَهُ وَعَلِمْتَ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَرُدُّ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ مَا سَأَلْتُهُ لأَلْبَسَهَا إِنَّمَا سَأَلْتُهُ لِتَكُونَ كَفَنِي‏.‏ قَالَ سَهْلٌ فَكَانَتْ كَفَنَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an sahlin rda allh 'nh aanna amraaaaan, jaa'ati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm biburdaain mansuwjaain fiyhaa haashiyatuhaa aatadruwna maa alburdaau qaaluwa alshhamlaau‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaalat nasajtuhaa biyadiy, fajiitu laaksuwakahaa‏.‏ faaakhadhahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm muhtaajana iilayhaa, fakharaja iilaynaa waiinnahaa iizaaruhu, fahassanahaa fulaanun faqaala aksuniyhaa, maa aahsanahaa‏.‏ qaala alqawmu maa aahsanta, labisahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm muhtaajana iilayhaa, thumma saaaltahu wa'alimta aannahu laa yaruddu‏.‏ qaala iinniy waalllahi maa saaaltuhu laalbasahaa iinnamaa saaaltuhu litakuwna kafaniy‏.‏ qaala sahlun fakaanat kafanahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl:A woman brought a woven Burda (sheet) having edging (border) to the Prophet, Then Sahl asked them whether they knew what is Burda, they said that Burda is a cloak and Sahl confirmed their reply. Then the woman said, "I have woven it with my own hands and I have brought it so that you may wear it." The Prophet (ﷺ) accepted it, and at that time he was in need of it. So he came out wearing it as his waist-sheet. A man praised it and said, "Will you give it to me? How nice it is!" The other people said, "You have not done the right thing as the Prophet (ﷺ) is in need of it and you have asked for it when you know that he never turns down anybody's request." The man replied, "By Allah, I have not asked for it to wear it but to make it my shroud." Later it was his shroud
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أُمِّ الْهُذَيْلِ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ نُهِينَا عَنِ اتِّبَاعِ الْجَنَائِزِ، وَلَمْ يُعْزَمْ عَلَيْنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau bnu 'uqbaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, 'an aummi alhudhayli, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat nuhiynaa 'ani attibaa'i aljanaaiizi, walam yu'zam 'alaynaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:We were forbidden to accompany funeral processions but not strictly
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ تُوُفِّيَ ابْنٌ لأُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْيَوْمُ الثَّالِثُ دَعَتْ بِصُفْرَةٍ، فَتَمَسَّحَتْ بِهِ وَقَالَتْ نُهِينَا أَنْ نُحِدَّ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَلاَثٍ إِلاَّ بِزَوْجٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa bishru bnu almufaddali, haddathanaa salamaau bnu 'alqamaaa, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, qaala tuwuffiya abnun laummi 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nha falammaa kaana alyawmu althhaalithu da'at bisufraain, fatamassahat bihi waqaalat nuhiynaa aan nuhidda aakthara min thalaathin iilaaa bizawjin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muhammad bin Seereen:One of the sons of Um 'Atiyya died, and when it was the third day she asked for a yellow perfume and put it over her body, and said, "We were forbidden to mourn for more than three days except for our husbands
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمَّا جَاءَ نَعْىُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ مِنَ الشَّأْمِ دَعَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ بِصُفْرَةٍ فِي الْيَوْمِ الثَّالِثِ، فَمَسَحَتْ عَارِضَيْهَا وَذِرَاعَيْهَا وَقَالَتْ إِنِّي كُنْتُ عَنْ هَذَا لَغَنِيَّةً، لَوْلاَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ تُحِدَّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ، إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ، فَإِنَّهَا تُحِدُّ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhumaydiyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa aayyuwbu bnu muwsaa, qaala aakhbaraniy humaydu bnu naafi'in, 'an zaynaba abnaai aabiy salamaaa, qaalat lammaa jaa'a na'au aabiy sufyaana mina alshhaami da'at aummu habiybaaa rda allh 'nha bisufraain fiy alyawmi althhaalithi, famasahat 'aaridayhaa wadhiraa'ayhaa waqaalat iinniy kuntu 'an hadhaa laghaniyyaaan, lawlaa aanniy sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yahillu laimraaaain tuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri aan tuhidda 'alaa mayyitin fawqa thalaathin, iilaaa 'alaa zawjin, faiinnahaa tuhiddu 'alayhi aarba'aaa aashhurin wa'ashrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zainab bint Abi Salama:When the news of the death of Abu Sufyan reached from Sham, Um Habiba on the third day, asked for a yellow perfume and scented her cheeks and forearms and said, "No doubt, I would not have been in need of this, had I not heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying: "It is not legal for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days for any dead person except her husband, for whom she should mourn for four months and ten days
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ قَالَتْ، دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ تُحِدُّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ، إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ أَخُوهَا، فَدَعَتْ بِطِيبٍ فَمَسَّتْ ثُمَّ قَالَتْ مَا لِي بِالطِّيبِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ، غَيْرَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ تُحِدُّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ، إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathaniy maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakri bni muhammadi bni 'amriw bni hazmin, 'an humaydi bni naafi'in, 'an zaynaba binti aabiy salamaaa, aakhbarathu qaalat, dakhaltu 'alaa aummi habiybaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa yahillu laimraaaain tuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri tuhiddu 'alaa mayyitin fawqa thalaathin, iilaaa 'alaa zawjin aarba'aaa aashhurin wa'ashrana ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma dakhaltu 'alaa zaynaba binti jahshin hiyna tuwuffiya aakhuwhaa, fada'at bitiybin famassat thumma qaalat maa liy bialttiybi min haajaain, ghayra aanniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alminbari yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa yahillu laimraaaain tuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri tuhiddu 'alaa mayyitin fawqa thalaathin, iilaaa 'alaa zawjin aarba'aaa aashhurin wa'ashrana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zainab bint Abi Salama:I went to Um Habiba, the wife of Prophet, who said, "I heard the Prophets saying, 'It is not legal for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for any dead person for more than three days except for her husband, (for whom she should mourn) for four months and ten days'." Later I went to Zainab bint Jahsh when her brother died; she asked for some scent, and after using it she said, "I am not in need of scent but I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'It is not legal for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days for any dead person except her husband, (for whom she should mourn) for four months and ten days
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِامْرَأَةٍ تَبْكِي عِنْدَ قَبْرٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اتَّقِي اللَّهَ وَاصْبِرِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ إِلَيْكَ عَنِّي، فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَبْ بِمُصِيبَتِي، وَلَمْ تَعْرِفْهُ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لَهَا إِنَّهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَأَتَتْ باب النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ تَجِدْ عِنْدَهُ بَوَّابِينَ فَقَالَتْ لَمْ أَعْرِفْكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا الصَّبْرُ عِنْدَ الصَّدْمَةِ الأُولَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala marra alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biamraaaain tabkiy 'inda qabrin faqaala ‏"‏ attaqiy alllaha waasbiriy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat iilayka 'anniy, faiinnaka lam tusab bimusiybatiy, walam ta'rifhu‏.‏ faqiyla lahaa iinnahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faaatat bab alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falam tajid 'indahu bawwaabiyna faqaalat lam aa'rifka‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa alssabru 'inda alssadmaai alauwlaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a woman who was weeping beside a grave. He told her to fear Allah and be patient. She said to him, "Go away, for you have not been afflicted with a calamity like mine." And she did not recognize him. Then she was informed that he was the Prophet (ﷺ) . so she went to the house of the Prophet (ﷺ) and there she did not find any guard. Then she said to him, "I did not recognize you." He said, "Verily, the patience is at the first stroke of a calamity
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَرْسَلَتِ ابْنَةُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ ابْنًا لِي قُبِضَ فَائْتِنَا‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَ يُقْرِئُ السَّلاَمَ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى وَكُلٌّ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِ تُقْسِمُ عَلَيْهِ لَيَأْتِيَنَّهَا، فَقَامَ وَمَعَهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ وَمُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ وَأُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ وَرِجَالٌ، فَرُفِعَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّبِيُّ وَنَفْسُهُ تَتَقَعْقَعُ ـ قَالَ حَسِبْتُهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ـ كَأَنَّهَا شَنٌّ‏.‏ فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَاهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا هَذَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ رَحْمَةٌ جَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِ عِبَادِهِ، وَإِنَّمَا يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الرُّحَمَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, wamuhammadun, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa 'aasimu bnu sulaymaana, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, qaala haddathaniy ausaamaau bnu zaydin rda allh 'nhma qaala aarsalati abnaau alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilayhi iinna abnana liy qubida faaitinaa‏.‏ faaarsala yuqriiu alssalaama wayaquwlu ‏"‏ iinna lillahi maa aakhadha walahu maa aa'taa wakullun 'indahu biaajalin musammana, faltasbir waltahtasib ‏"‏‏.‏ faaarsalat iilayhi tuqsimu 'alayhi layaatiyannahaa, faqaama wama'ahu sa'du bnu 'ubaadaaa wamu'aadhu bnu jabalin waaubaaau bnu ka'bin wazaydu bnu thaabitin warijaalun, farufi'a iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alssabiyyu wanafsuhu tataqa'qa'u qaala hasibtuhu aannahu qaala kaaannahaa shannun‏.‏ fafaadat 'aynaahu‏.‏ faqaala sa'dun yaa rasuwla alllahi maa hadhaa faqaala ‏"‏ hadhihi rahmaaun ja'alahaa alllahu fiy quluwbi 'ibaadihi, waiinnamaa yarhamu alllahu min 'ibaadihi alrruhamaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama bin Zaid:The daughter of the Prophet (ﷺ) sent (a messenger) to the Prophet (ﷺ) requesting him to come as her child was dying (or was gasping), but the Prophet (ﷺ) returned the messenger and told him to convey his greeting to her and say: "Whatever Allah takes is for Him and whatever He gives, is for Him, and everything with Him has a limited fixed term (in this world) and so she should be patient and hope for Allah's reward." She again sent for him, swearing that he should come. The Prophet (ﷺ) got up, and so did Sa`d bin 'Ubada, Mu`adh bin Jabal, Ubai bin Ka`b, Zaid bin Thabit and some other men. The child was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while his breath was disturbed in his chest (the sub-narrator thinks that Usama added: ) as if it was a leather water-skin. On that the eyes of the Prophet (ﷺ) started shedding tears. Sa`d said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is this?" He replied, "It is mercy which Allah has lodged in the hearts of His slaves, and Allah is merciful only to those of His slaves who are merciful (to others)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ شَهِدْنَا بِنْتًا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسٌ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ ـ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُ عَيْنَيْهِ تَدْمَعَانِ قَالَ ـ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ لَمْ يُقَارِفِ اللَّيْلَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَانْزِلْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَزَلَ فِي قَبْرِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin, haddathanaa fulayhu bnu sulaymaana, 'an hilaali bni 'aliyyin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala shahidnaa bintana lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaalisun 'alaa alqabri qaala faraaaytu 'aynayhi tadma'aani qaala faqaala ‏"‏ hal minkum rajulun lam yuqaarifi alllaylaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw talhaaa aanaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faanzil ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fanazala fiy qabrihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:We were (in the funeral procession) of one of the daughters of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he was sitting by the side of the grave. I saw his eyes shedding tears. He said, "Is there anyone among you who did not have sexual relations with his wife last night?" Abu Talha replied in the affirmative. And so the Prophet told him to get down in the grave. And so he got down in her grave
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ تُوُفِّيَتِ ابْنَةٌ لِعُثْمَانَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ بِمَكَّةَ وَجِئْنَا لِنَشْهَدَهَا، وَحَضَرَهَا ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ وَإِنِّي لَجَالِسٌ بَيْنَهُمَا ـ أَوْ قَالَ جَلَسْتُ إِلَى أَحَدِهِمَا‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَاءَ الآخَرُ، فَجَلَسَ إِلَى جَنْبِي فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ أَلاَ تَنْهَى عَنِ الْبُكَاءِ، فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ لَيُعَذَّبُ بِبُكَاءِ أَهْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَدْ كَانَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ بَعْضَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ حَدَّثَ قَالَ صَدَرْتُ مَعَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ مِنْ مَكَّةَ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِالْبَيْدَاءِ، إِذَا هُوَ بِرَكْبٍ تَحْتَ ظِلِّ سَمُرَةٍ فَقَالَ اذْهَبْ، فَانْظُرْ مَنْ هَؤُلاَءِ الرَّكْبُ قَالَ فَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا صُهَيْبٌ، فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ ادْعُهُ لِي‏.‏ فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى صُهَيْبٍ فَقُلْتُ ارْتَحِلْ فَالْحَقْ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أُصِيبَ عُمَرُ دَخَلَ صُهَيْبٌ يَبْكِي يَقُولُ وَاأَخَاهُ، وَاصَاحِبَاهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَا صُهَيْبُ أَتَبْكِي عَلَىَّ وَقَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ يُعَذَّبُ بِبَعْضِ بُكَاءِ أَهْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما فَلَمَّا مَاتَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَقَالَتْ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ عُمَرَ، وَاللَّهِ مَا حَدَّثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُعَذِّبُ الْمُؤْمِنَ بِبُكَاءِ أَهْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ وَلَكِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيَزِيدُ الْكَافِرَ عَذَابًا بِبُكَاءِ أَهْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ حَسْبُكُمُ الْقُرْآنُ ‏{‏وَلاَ تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَى‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَى‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ وَاللَّهِ مَا قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ شَيْئًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy mulaykaaa, qaala tuwuffiyati abnaaun li'uthmaana rda allh 'nh bimakkaaa wajiinaa linashhadahaa, wahadarahaa abnu 'umara waabnu 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhm waiinniy lajaalisun baynahumaa aaw qaala jalastu iilaa aahadihimaa‏.‏ thumma jaa'a alakharu, fajalasa iilaa janbiy faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'amara rda allh 'nhma li'amriw bni 'uthmaana aalaa tanhaa 'ani albukaa'i, faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna almayyita layu'adhhabu bibukaa'i aahlihi 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qad kaana 'umaru rda allh 'nh yaquwlu ba'da dhalika, thumma haddatha qaala sadartu ma'a 'umara rda allh 'nh min makkaaa hattaa iidhaa kunnaa bialbaydaa'i, iidhaa huwa birakbin tahta zilli samuraain faqaala adhhab, faanzur man hauulaa'i alrrakbu qaala fanazartu faiidhaa suhaybun, faaakhbartuhu faqaala ad'uhu liy‏.‏ faraja'tu iilaa suhaybin faqultu artahil faalhaq aamiyra almuuminiyna‏.‏ falammaa ausiyba 'umaru dakhala suhaybun yabkiy yaquwlu waaaakhaahu, waasaahibaahu‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh yaa suhaybu aatabkiy 'alaaaa waqad qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna almayyita yu'adhhabu biba'di bukaa'i aahlihi 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma falammaa maata 'umaru rda allh 'nh dhakartu dhalika li'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha faqaalat rahima alllahu 'umara, waalllahi maa haddatha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna alllaha layu'adhhibu almuumina bibukaa'i aahlihi 'alayhi‏.‏ walakinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha layaziydu alkaafira 'adhaabana bibukaa'i aahlihi 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaalat hasbukumu alquranu ‏{‏walaa taziru waaziraaun wizra aukhraa‏}‏‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'inda dhalika waalllahu huwa aadhaka waaabkaa‏.‏ qaala abnu aabiy mulaykaaa waalllahi maa qaala abnu 'umara rda allh 'nhma shayiana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin 'Ubaidullah bin Abi Mulaika:One of the daughters of `Uthman died at Mecca. We went to attend her funeral procession. Ibn `Umar and Ibn `Abbas were also present. I sat in between them (or said, I sat beside one of them. Then a man came and sat beside me.) `Abdullah bin `Umar said to `Amr bin `Uthman, "Will you not prohibit crying as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has said, 'The dead person is tortured by the crying of his relatives.?" Ibn `Abbas said, "`Umar used to say so." Then he added narrating, "I accompanied `Umar on a journey from Mecca till we reached Al-Baida. There he saw some travelers in the shade of a Samura (A kind of forest tree). He said (to me), "Go and see who those travelers are." So I went and saw that one of them was Suhaib. I told this to `Umar who then asked me to call him. So I went back to Suhaib and said to him, "Depart and follow the chief of the faithful believers." Later, when `Umar was stabbed, Suhaib came in weeping and saying, "O my brother, O my friend!" (on this `Umar said to him, "O Suhaib! Are you weeping for me while the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The dead person is punished by some of the weeping of his relatives?" Ibn `Abbas added, "When `Umar died I told all this to Aisha and she said, 'May Allah be merciful to `Umar. By Allah, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not say that a believer is punished by the weeping of his relatives. But he said, Allah increases the punishment of a non-believer because of the weeping of his relatives." Aisha further added, "The Qur'an is sufficient for you (to clear up this point) as Allah has stated: 'No burdened soul will bear another's burden.' " (35.18). Ibn `Abbas then said, "Only Allah makes one laugh or cry." Ibn `Umar did not say anything after that
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا، سَمِعَتْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ إِنَّمَا مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى يَهُودِيَّةٍ يَبْكِي عَلَيْهَا أَهْلُهَا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَبْكُونَ عَلَيْهَا، وَإِنَّهَا لَتُعَذَّبُ فِي قَبْرِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahaa aakhbarathu aannahaa, sami'at 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat iinnamaa marra rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa yahuwdiyyaain yabkiy 'alayhaa aahluhaa faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnahum layabkuwna 'alayhaa, waiinnahaa latu'adhhabu fiy qabrihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) passed by (the grave of) a Jewess whose relatives were weeping over her. He said, "They are weeping over her and she is being tortured in her grave
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ ـ وَهْوَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ ـ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا أُصِيبَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ جَعَلَ صُهَيْبٌ يَقُولُ وَاأَخَاهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ لَيُعَذَّبُ بِبُكَاءِ الْحَىِّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu khaliylin, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa wahwa alshhaybaaniyyu 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala lammaa ausiyba 'umaru rda allh 'nh ja'ala suhaybun yaquwlu waaaakhaahu‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru aamaa 'alimta aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna almayyita layu'adhhabu bibukaa'i alhaaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda:That his father said, "When `Umar was stabbed, Suhaib started crying: O my brother! `Umar said, 'Don't you know that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: The deceased is tortured for the weeping of the living'?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ كَذِبًا عَلَىَّ لَيْسَ كَكَذِبٍ عَلَى أَحَدٍ، مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَىَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَنْ نِيحَ عَلَيْهِ يُعَذَّبُ بِمَا نِيحَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ubaydin, 'an 'aliyyi bni rabiy'aaa, 'ani almughiyraai rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iinna kadhibana 'alaaaa laysa kakadhibin 'alaa aahadin, man kadhaba 'alaaaa muta'ammidana falyatabawwaa maq'adahu mina alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ man niyha 'alayhi yu'adhhabu bimaa niyha 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Mughira:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "Ascribing false things to me is not like ascribing false things to anyone else. Whosoever tells a lie against me intentionally then surely let him occupy his seat in Hell-Fire." I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "The deceased who is wailed over is tortured for that wailing
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْمَيِّتُ يُعَذَّبُ فِي قَبْرِهِ بِمَا نِيحَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ آدَمُ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ‏"‏ الْمَيِّتُ يُعَذَّبُ بِبُكَاءِ الْحَىِّ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an aabiyhi rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ almayyitu yu'adhhabu fiy qabrihi bimaa niyha 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'abdu alaa'laa haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in haddathanaa sa'iydun haddathanaa qataadaau‏.‏ waqaala adamu 'an shu'baaa ‏"‏ almayyitu yu'adhhabu bibukaa'i alhaaai 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn 'Umar from his father: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The deceased is tortured in his grave for the wailing done over him." Narrated Shu'ba: The deceased is tortured for the wailing of the living ones over him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ جِيءَ بِأَبِي يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ، قَدْ مُثِّلَ بِهِ حَتَّى وُضِعَ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ سُجِّيَ ثَوْبًا فَذَهَبْتُ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكْشِفَ عَنْهُ فَنَهَانِي قَوْمِي، ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ أَكْشِفُ عَنْهُ فَنَهَانِي قَوْمِي، فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُفِعَ فَسَمِعَ صَوْتَ صَائِحَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا ابْنَةُ عَمْرٍو أَوْ أُخْتُ عَمْرٍو‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلِمَ تَبْكِي أَوْ لاَ تَبْكِي فَمَا زَالَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ تُظِلُّهُ بِأَجْنِحَتِهَا حَتَّى رُفِعَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa abnu almunkadiri, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala jiy'a biaabiy yawma auhudin, qad muthhila bihi hattaa wudi'a bayna yadaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad sujjiya thawbana fadhahabtu auriydu aan aakshifa 'anhu fanahaaniy qawmiy, thumma dhahabtu aakshifu 'anhu fanahaaniy qawmiy, faaamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm farufi'a fasami'a sawta saaiihaain faqaala ‏"‏ man hadhihi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa abnaau 'amrinw aaw aukhtu 'amrinw‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ falima tabkiy aaw laa tabkiy famaa zaalati almalaaiikaau tuzilluhu biaajnihatihaa hattaa rufi'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah:On the day of the Battle of Uhud, my father was brought and he had been mutilated (in battle) and was placed in front of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and a sheet was over him. I went intending to uncover my father but my people forbade me; again I wanted to uncover him but my people forbade me. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave his order and he was shifted away. At that time he heard the voice of a crying woman and asked, "Who is this?" They said, "It is the daughter or the sister of `Amr." He said, "Why does she weep? (or let her stop weeping), for the angels had been shading him with their wings till he (i.e. the body of the martyr) was shifted away
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا زُبَيْدٌ الْيَامِيُّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَطَمَ الْخُدُودَ، وَشَقَّ الْجُيُوبَ، وَدَعَا بِدَعْوَى الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa zubaydun alyaamiyyu, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laysa minnaa man latama alkhuduwda, washaqqa aljuyuwba, wada'aa bida'waa aljaahiliyyaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who slaps his cheeks, tears his clothes and follows the ways and traditions of the Days of Ignorance is not one of us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُنِي عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ مِنْ وَجَعٍ اشْتَدَّ بِي فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي قَدْ بَلَغَ بِي مِنَ الْوَجَعِ وَأَنَا ذُو مَالٍ، وَلاَ يَرِثُنِي إِلاَّ ابْنَةٌ، أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثَىْ مَالِي قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ بِالشَّطْرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلْثُ كَبِيرٌ ـ أَوْ كَثِيرٌ ـ إِنَّكَ أَنْ تَذَرَ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَذَرَهُمْ عَالَةً يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ، وَإِنَّكَ لَنْ تُنْفِقَ نَفَقَةً تَبْتَغِي بِهَا وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ أُجِرْتَ بِهَا، حَتَّى مَا تَجْعَلُ فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أُخَلَّفُ بَعْدَ أَصْحَابِي قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تُخَلَّفَ فَتَعْمَلَ عَمَلاً صَالِحًا إِلاَّ ازْدَدْتَ بِهِ دَرَجَةً وَرِفْعَةً، ثُمَّ لَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تُخَلَّفَ حَتَّى يَنْتَفِعَ بِكَ أَقْوَامٌ وَيُضَرَّ بِكَ آخَرُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أَمْضِ لأَصْحَابِي هِجْرَتَهُمْ، وَلاَ تَرُدَّهُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ، لَكِنِ الْبَائِسُ سَعْدُ ابْنُ خَوْلَةَ، يَرْثِي لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ مَاتَ بِمَكَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, 'an aabiyhi rda allh 'nh qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'uwduniy 'aama hajjaai alwadaa'i min waja'in ashtadda biy faqultu iinniy qad balagha biy mina alwaja'i waaanaa dhuw maalin, walaa yarithuniy iilaaa abnaaun, aafaaatasaddaqu bithuluthaa maaliy qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu bialshhatri faqaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ althhuluthu waalthhulthu kabiyrun aaw kathiyrun iinnaka aan tadhara warathataka aaghniyaa'a khayrun min aan tadharahum 'aalaaan yatakaffafuwna alnnaasa, waiinnaka lan tunfiqa nafaqaaan tabtaghiy bihaa wajha alllahi iilaaa aujirta bihaa, hattaa maa taj'alu fiy fiy amraaatika ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, aukhallafu ba'da aashaabiy qaala ‏"‏ iinnaka lan tukhallafa fata'mala 'amalaan saalihana iilaaa azdadta bihi darajaaan warif'aaan, thumma la'allaka aan tukhallafa hattaa yantafi'a bika aaqwaamun wayudarra bika akharuwna, alllahumma aamdi laashaabiy hijratahum, walaa taruddahum 'alaa aa'qaabihim, lakini albaaiisu sa'du abnu khawlaaa, yarthiy lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan maata bimakkaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Amir bin Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas:That his father said, "In the year of the last Hajj of the Prophet (ﷺ) I became seriously ill and the Prophet (ﷺ) used to visit me inquiring about my health. I told him, 'I am reduced to this state because of illness and I am wealthy and have no inheritors except a daughter, (In this narration the name of 'Amir bin Sa`d is mentioned and in fact it is a mistake; the narrator is `Aisha bint Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas). Should I give two-thirds of my property in charity?' He said, 'No.' I asked, 'Half?' He said, 'No.' then he added, 'One-third, and even one-third is much. You'd better leave your inheritors wealthy rather than leaving them poor, begging others. You will get a reward for whatever you spend for Allah's sake, even for what you put in your wife's mouth.' I said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Will I be left alone after my companions have gone?' He said, 'If you are left behind, whatever good deeds you will do will upgrade you and raise you high. And perhaps you will have a long life so that some people will be benefited by you while others will be harmed by you. O Allah! Complete the emigration of my companions and do not turn them renegades.' But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt sorry for poor Sa`d bin Khaula as he died in Mecca." (but Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas lived long after the Prophet (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُخَيْمِرَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ وَجِعَ أَبُو مُوسَى وَجَعًا فَغُشِيَ عَلَيْهِ، وَرَأْسُهُ فِي حَجْرِ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهَا شَيْئًا، فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ أَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّنْ بَرِئَ مِنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَرِئَ مِنَ الصَّالِقَةِ وَالْحَالِقَةِ وَالشَّاقَّةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala alhakamu bnu muwsaa haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hamzaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jaabirin, aanna alqaasima bna mukhaymiraaa, haddathahu qaala haddathaniy aabuw burdaaa bnu aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh qaala waji'a aabuw muwsaa waja'ana faghushiya 'alayhi, waraasuhu fiy hajri amraaaain min aahlihi, falam yastati' aan yarudda 'alayhaa shayiana, falammaa aafaaqa qaala aanaa bariy'un mimman bariia minhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm, iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bariia mina alssaaliqaai waalhaaliqaai waalshhaaqqaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda bin Abi Musa:Abu Musa got seriously ill, fainted and could not reply to his wife while he was lying with his head in her lap. When he came to his senses, he said, "I am innocent of those, of whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was innocent. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is innocent of a woman who cries aloud (or slaps her face) who shaves her head and who tear off her clothes (on the falling of a calamity)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ ضَرَبَ الْخُدُودَ، وَشَقَّ الْجُيُوبَ، وَدَعَا بِدَعْوَى الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laysa minnaa man daraba alkhuduwda, washaqqa aljuyuwba, wada'aa bida'waa aljaahiliyyaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who slaps the cheeks, tears the clothes and follows the tradition of the Days of Ignorance is not from us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ ضَرَبَ الْخُدُودَ، وَشَقَّ الْجُيُوبَ، وَدَعَا بِدَعْوَى الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni murraaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laysa minnaa man daraba alkhuduwda, washaqqa aljuyuwba, wada'aa bida'waa aljaahiliyyaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who slaps the cheeks, tears the clothes and follows the traditions of the Days of Ignorance is not from us
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي عَمْرَةُ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَمَّا جَاءَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَتْلُ ابْنِ حَارِثَةَ وَجَعْفَرٍ وَابْنِ رَوَاحَةَ جَلَسَ يُعْرَفُ فِيهِ الْحُزْنُ، وَأَنَا أَنْظُرُ مِنْ صَائِرِ الْبَابِ ـ شَقِّ الْبَابِ ـ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ إِنَّ نِسَاءَ جَعْفَرٍ، وَذَكَرَ بُكَاءَهُنَّ، فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَنْهَاهُنَّ، فَذَهَبَ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ الثَّانِيَةَ، لَمْ يُطِعْنَهُ فَقَالَ انْهَهُنَّ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ الثَّالِثَةَ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ غَلَبْنَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَزَعَمَتْ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَاحْثُ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِنَّ التُّرَابَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَرْغَمَ اللَّهُ أَنْفَكَ، لَمْ تَفْعَلْ مَا أَمَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ تَتْرُكْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْعَنَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala sami'tu yahyaa, qaala aakhbaratniy 'amraau, qaalat sami'tu 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat lammaa jaa'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qatlu abni haarithaaa waja'farin waabni rawaahaaa jalasa yu'rafu fiyhi alhuznu, waaanaa aanzuru min saaiiri albaabi shaqqi albaabi faaataahu rajulun, faqaala iinna nisaa'a ja'farin, wadhakara bukaa'ahunna, faaamarahu aan yanhaahunna, fadhahaba thumma aataahu althhaaniyaaa, lam yuti'nahu faqaala anhahunna‏.‏ faaataahu althhaalithaaa qaala waalllahi ghalabnanaa yaa rasuwla alllahi faza'amat aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ faahthu fiy aafwaahihinna altturaaba ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu aarghama alllahu aanfaka, lam taf'al maa aamaraka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walam tatruk rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina al'anaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:When the Prophet (ﷺ) got the news of the death of Ibn Haritha, Ja`far and Ibn Rawaha he sat down and looked sad and I was looking at him through the chink of the door. A man came and told him about the crying of the women of Ja`far. The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered him to forbid them. The man went and came back saying that he had told them but they did not listen to him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Forbid them." So again he went and came back for the third time and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! By Allah, they did not listen to us at all." (`Aisha added): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered him to go and put dust in their mouths. I said, (to that man) "May Allah stick your nose in the dust (i.e. humiliate you)! You could neither (persuade the women to) fulfill the order of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) nor did you relieve Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) from fatigue
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَنَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَهْرًا حِينَ قُتِلَ الْقُرَّاءُ، فَمَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَزِنَ حُزْنًا قَطُّ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, haddathanaa 'aasimun alaahwalu, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala qanata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shahrana hiyna qutila alqurraa'u, famaa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hazina huznana qattu aashadda minhu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:When the reciters of Qur'an were martyred, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited Qunut for one month and I never saw him (i.e. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)) so sad as he was on that day
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
