yash'ur hattaa daraba alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi thumma qaala laibni sayyaadin ‏"‏ tashhadu aanniy rasuwlu alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ fanazara iilayhi abnu sayyaadin faqaala aashhadu aannaka rasuwlu alaummiyyiyna‏.‏ faqaala abnu sayyaadin lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aatashhadu aanniy rasuwlu alllahi farafadahu waqaala amantu bialllahi wabirusulihi‏.‏ faqaala lahu ‏"‏ maadhaa taraa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala abnu sayyaadin yaatiyniy saadiqun wakaadhibun‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ khullita 'alayka alaamru ‏"‏ thumma qaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinniy qad khabaatu laka khabiyiana ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala abnu sayyaadin huwa alddukhhu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ akhsaa, falan ta'duwa qadraka ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh da'niy yaa rasuwla alllahi aadrib 'unuqahu‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iin yakunhu falan tusallata 'alayhi, waiin lam yakunhu falaa khayra laka fiy qatlihi ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala saalimun sami'tu abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu antalaqa ba'da dhalika rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaubaaau bnu ka'bin iilaa alnnakhli allatiy fiyhaa abnu sayyaadin wahuwa yakhtilu aan yasma'a mini abni sayyaadin shayiana qabla aan yaraahu abnu sayyaadin faraahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa mudtaji'un, ya'niy fiy qatiyfaain lahu fiyhaa ramzaaun aaw zamraaun, faraaat aummu abni sayyaadin rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yattaqiy bijudhuw'i alnnakhli faqaalat laibni sayyaadin yaa saafi wahwa asmu abni sayyaadin hadhaa muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ fathaara abnu sayyaadin faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ law tarakathu bayyana ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala shu'aybun fiy hadiythihi farafasahu ramramaaun, aaw zamzamaaun‏.‏ waqaala iishaaqu alkalbiyyu wa'uqaylun ramramaaun‏.‏ waqaala ma'marun ramzaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:`Umar set out along with the Prophet (ﷺ) with a group of people to Ibn Saiyad till they saw him playing with the boys near the hillocks of Bani Mughala. Ibn Saiyad at that time was nearing his puberty and did not notice (us) until the Prophet (ﷺ) stroked him with his hand and said to him, "Do you testify that I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" Ibn Saiyad looked at him and said, "I testify that you are the Messenger of illiterates." Then Ibn Saiyad asked the Prophet (ﷺ), "Do you testify that I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)?" The Prophet (ﷺ) refuted it and said, "I believe in Allah and His Apostles." Then he said (to Ibn Saiyad), "What do you think?" Ibn Saiyad answered, "True people and liars visit me." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have been confused as to this matter." Then the Prophet (ﷺ) said to him, "I have kept something (in my mind) for you, (can you tell me that?)" Ibn Saiyad said, "It is Al-Dukh (the smoke)." (2) The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Let you be in ignominy. You cannot cross your limits." On that `Umar, said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allow me to chop his head off." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If he is he (i.e. Dajjal), then you cannot overpower him, and if he is not, then there is no use of murdering him." (Ibn `Umar added): Later on Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) once again went along with Ubai bin Ka`b to the date-palm trees (garden) where Ibn Saiyad was staying. The Prophet (ﷺ) wanted to hear something from Ibn Saiyad before Ibn Saiyad could see him, and the Prophet (ﷺ) saw him lying covered with a sheet and from where his murmurs were heard. Ibn Saiyad's mother saw Allah's Apostle while he was hiding himself behind the trunks of the date-palm trees. She addressed Ibn Saiyad, "O Saf ! (and this was the name of Ibn Saiyad) Here is Muhammad." And with that Ibn Saiyad got up. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Had this woman left him (Had she not disturbed him), then Ibn Saiyad would have revealed the reality of his case
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ ـ وَهْوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ ـ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ غُلاَمٌ يَهُودِيٌّ يَخْدُمُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَرِضَ، فَأَتَاهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُهُ، فَقَعَدَ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏"‏ أَسْلِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى أَبِيهِ وَهْوَ عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَطِعْ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَأَسْلَمَ، فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَنْقَذَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadun wahwa abnu zaydin 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala kaana ghulaamun yahuwdiyyun yakhdumu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm famarida, faaataahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'uwduhu, faqa'ada 'inda raasihi faqaala lahu ‏"‏ aaslim ‏"‏‏.‏ fanazara iilaa aabiyhi wahwa 'indahu faqaala lahu aati' aabaa alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faaaslama, fakharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa yaquwlu ‏"‏ alhamdu lillahi alladhiy aanqadhahu mina alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:A young Jewish boy used to serve the Prophet (ﷺ) and he became sick. So the Prophet (ﷺ) went to visit him. He sat near his head and asked him to embrace Islam. The boy looked at his father, who was sitting there; the latter told him to obey Abul-Qasim and the boy embraced Islam. The Prophet (ﷺ) came out saying: "Praises be to Allah Who saved the boy from the Hell-fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ كُنْتُ أَنَا وَأُمِّي، مِنَ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ أَنَا مِنَ الْوِلْدَانِ، وَأُمِّي، مِنَ النِّسَاءِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala qaala 'ubaydu alllahi sami'tu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu kuntu aanaa waaummiy, mina almustad'afiyna aanaa mina alwildaani, waaummiy, mina alnnisaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:My mother and I were among the weak and oppressed. I from among the children, and my mother from among the women
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ يُصَلَّى عَلَى كُلِّ مَوْلُودٍ مُتَوَفًّى وَإِنْ كَانَ لِغَيَّةٍ، مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ وُلِدَ عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الإِسْلاَمِ، يَدَّعِي أَبَوَاهُ الإِسْلاَمَ أَوْ أَبُوهُ خَاصَّةً، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ أُمُّهُ عَلَى غَيْرِ الإِسْلاَمِ، إِذَا اسْتَهَلَّ صَارِخًا صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ، وَلاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى مَنْ لاَ يَسْتَهِلُّ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ سِقْطٌ، فَإِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ إِلاَّ يُولَدُ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ، فَأَبَوَاهُ يُهَوِّدَانِهِ أَوْ يُنَصِّرَانِهِ أَوْ يُمَجِّسَانِهِ، كَمَا تُنْتَجُ الْبَهِيمَةُ بَهِيمَةً جَمْعَاءَ هَلْ تُحِسُّونَ فِيهَا مِنْ جَدْعَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه – ‏{‏فِطْرَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, qaala abnu shihaabin yusallaa 'alaa kulli mawluwdin mutawaffana waiin kaana lighayyaain, min aajli aannahu wulida 'alaa fitraai aliislaami, yadda'iy aabawaahu aliislaama aaw aabuwhu khaassaaan, waiin kaanat aummuhu 'alaa ghayri aliislaami, iidhaa astahalla saarikhana sulliya 'alayhi, walaa yusallaa 'alaa man laa yastahillu min aajli aannahu siqtun, faiinna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh kaana yuhaddithu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa min mawluwdin iilaaa yuwladu 'alaa alfitraai, faaabawaahu yuhawwidaanihi aaw yunassiraanihi aaw yumajjisaanihi, kamaa tuntaju albahiymaau bahiymaaan jam'aa'a hal tuhissuwna fiyhaa min jad'aa'a ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma yaquwlu aabuw hurayraaa rda allh 'nh – ‏{‏fitraaa alllahi allatiy fatara alnnaasa 'alayhaa‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Shihab:The funeral prayer should be offered for every child even if he were the son of a prostitute as he was born with a true faith of Islam (i.e. to worship none but Allah Alone). If his parents are Muslims, particularly the father, even if his mother were a non-Muslim, and if he after the delivery cries (even once) before his death (i.e. born alive) then the funeral prayer must be offered. And if the child does not cry after his delivery (i.e. born dead) then his funeral prayer should not be offered, and he will be considered as a miscarriage. Abu Huraira, narrated that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every child is born with a true faith (i.e. to worship none but Allah Alone) but his parents convert him to Judaism or to Christianity or to Magianism, as an animal delivers a perfect baby animal. Do you find it mutilated?" Then Abu Huraira recited the holy verses: 'The pure Allah's Islamic nature (true faith i.e. to worship none but Allah Alone), with which He has created human beings
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ إِلاَّ يُولَدُ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ، فَأَبَوَاهُ يُهَوِّدَانِهِ أَوْ يُنَصِّرَانِهِ أَوْ يُمَجِّسَانِهِ، كَمَا تُنْتَجُ الْبَهِيمَةُ بَهِيمَةً جَمْعَاءَ، هَلْ تُحِسُّونَ فِيهَا مِنْ جَدْعَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ‏{‏فِطْرَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا لاَ تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّهِ ذَلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa min mawluwdin iilaaa yuwladu 'alaa alfitraai, faaabawaahu yuhawwidaanihi aaw yunassiraanihi aaw yumajjisaanihi, kamaa tuntaju albahiymaau bahiymaaan jam'aa'a, hal tuhissuwna fiyhaa min jad'aa'a ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma yaquwlu aabuw hurayraaa rda allh 'nh ‏{‏fitraaa alllahi allatiy fatara alnnaasa 'alayhaa laa tabdiyla likhalqi alllahi dhalika alddiynu alqayyimu‏}‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Every child is born with a true faith of Islam (i.e. to worship none but Allah Alone) but his parents convert him to Judaism, Christianity or Magianism, as an animal delivers a perfect baby animal. Do you find it mutilated?" Then Abu Huraira recited the holy verses: "The pure Allah's Islamic nature (true faith of Islam) (i.e. worshipping none but Allah) with which He has created human beings. No change let there be in the religion of Allah (i.e. joining none in worship with Allah). That is the straight religion (Islam) but most of men know, not
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، لَمَّا حَضَرَتْ أَبَا طَالِبٍ الْوَفَاةُ جَاءَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهُ أَبَا جَهْلِ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَبِي طَالِبٍ ‏"‏ يَا عَمِّ، قُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، كَلِمَةً أَشْهَدُ لَكَ بِهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ يَا أَبَا طَالِبٍ، أَتَرْغَبُ عَنْ مِلَّةِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْرِضُهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَيَعُودَانِ بِتِلْكَ الْمَقَالَةِ، حَتَّى قَالَ أَبُو طَالِبٍ آخِرَ مَا كَلَّمَهُمْ هُوَ عَلَى مِلَّةِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ، وَأَبَى أَنْ يَقُولَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ، مَا لَمْ أُنْهَ عَنْكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِيهِ ‏{‏مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu aakhbarahu aannahu, lammaa hadarat aabaa taalibin alwafaaau jaa'ahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fawajada 'indahu aabaa jahli bna hishaamin, wa'abda alllahi bna aabiy aumayyaaa bni almughiyraai, qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laabiy taalibin ‏"‏ yaa 'ammi, qul laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, kalimaaan aashhadu laka bihaa 'inda alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw jahlin wa'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy aumayyaaa yaa aabaa taalibin, aatarghabu 'an millaai 'abdi almuttalibi falam yazal rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ya'riduhaa 'alayhi, waya'uwdaani bitilka almaqaalaai, hattaa qaala aabuw taalibin akhira maa kallamahum huwa 'alaa millaai 'abdi almuttalibi, waaabaa aan yaquwla laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aamaa waalllahi laastaghfiranna laka, maa lam aunha 'anka ‏"‏‏.‏ faaanzala alllahu ta'aalaa fiyhi ‏{‏maa kaana lilnnabiyyi‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab from his father:When the time of the death of Abu Talib approached, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to him and found Abu Jahl bin Hisham and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya bin Al-Mughira by his side. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Abu Talib, "O uncle! Say: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, a sentence with which I shall be a witness (i.e. argue) for you before Allah. Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya said, "O Abu Talib! Are you going to denounce the religion of `Abdul Muttalib?" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept on inviting Abu Talib to say it (i.e. 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah') while they (Abu Jahl and `Abdullah) kept on repeating their statement till Abu Talib said as his last statement that he was on the religion of `Abdul Muttalib and refused to say, 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah.' (Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I will keep on asking Allah's forgiveness for you unless I am forbidden (by Allah) to do so." So Allah revealed (the verse) concerning him (i.e. It is not fitting for the Prophet (ﷺ) and those who believe that they should invoke (Allah) for forgiveness for pagans even though they be of kin, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of the fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ مَرَّ بِقَبْرَيْنِ يُعَذَّبَانِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمَا لَيُعَذَّبَانِ وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ أَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَكَانَ لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنَ الْبَوْلِ، وَأَمَّا الآخَرُ فَكَانَ يَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ جَرِيدَةً رَطْبَةً فَشَقَّهَا بِنِصْفَيْنِ، ثُمَّ غَرَزَ فِي كُلِّ قَبْرٍ وَاحِدَةً‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، لِمَ صَنَعْتَ هَذَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يُخَفَّفَ عَنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَيْبَسَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an mujaahidin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu marra biqabrayni yu'adhhabaani faqaala ‏"‏ iinnahumaa layu'adhhabaani wamaa yu'adhhabaani fiy kabiyrin aammaa aahaduhumaa fakaana laa yastatiru mina albawli, waaammaa alakharu fakaana yamshiy bialnnamiymaai ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma aakhadha jariydaaan ratbaaan fashaqqahaa binisfayni, thumma gharaza fiy kulli qabrin waahidaaan‏.‏ faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, lima sana'ta hadhaa faqaala ‏"‏ la'allahu aan yukhaffafa 'anhumaa maa lam yaybasaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) once passed by two graves, and those two persons (in the graves) were being tortured. He said, "They are being tortured not for a great thing (to avoid). One of them never saved himself from being soiled with his urine, while the other went about committing slander (to make enmity between friends). He then took a green leaf of a date-palm tree split it into two pieces and fixed one on each grave. The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Why have you done so?" He replied, "I hope that their punishment may be lessened till they (the leaf) become dry
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنَّا فِي جَنَازَةٍ فِي بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ، فَأَتَانَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَعَدَ وَقَعَدْنَا حَوْلَهُ، وَمَعَهُ مِخْصَرَةٌ فَنَكَّسَ، فَجَعَلَ يَنْكُتُ بِمِخْصَرَتِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ، مَا مِنْ نَفْسٍ مَنْفُوسَةٍ إِلاَّ كُتِبَ مَكَانُهَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ، وَإِلاَّ قَدْ كُتِبَ شَقِيَّةً أَوْ سَعِيدَةً ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَفَلاَ نَتَّكِلُ عَلَى كِتَابِنَا وَنَدَعُ الْعَمَلَ، فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنَّا مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ فَسَيَصِيرُ إِلَى عَمَلِ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ، وَأَمَّا مَنْ كَانَ مِنَّا مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ فَسَيَصِيرُ إِلَى عَمَلِ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا أَهْلُ السَّعَادَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ السَّعَادَةِ، وَأَمَّا أَهْلُ الشَّقَاوَةِ فَيُيَسَّرُونَ لِعَمَلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ ‏"‏، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, qaala haddathaniy jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an sa'di bni 'ubaydaaa, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh qaala kunnaa fiy janaazaain fiy baqiy'i algharqadi, faaataanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqa'ada waqa'adnaa hawlahu, wama'ahu mikhsaraaun fanakkasa, faja'ala yankutu bimikhsaratihi thumma qaala ‏"‏ maa minkum min aahadin, maa min nafsin manfuwsaain iilaaa kutiba makaanuhaa mina aljannaai waalnnaari, waiilaaa qad kutiba shaqiyyaaan aaw sa'iydaaan ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi, aafalaa nattakilu 'alaa kitaabinaa wanada'u al'amala, faman kaana minnaa min aahli alssa'aadaai fasayasiyru iilaa 'amali aahli alssa'aadaai, waaammaa man kaana minnaa min aahli alshhaqaawaai fasayasiyru iilaa 'amali aahli alshhaqaawaai qaala ‏"‏ aammaa aahlu alssa'aadaai fayuyassaruwna li'amali alssa'aadaai, waaammaa aahlu alshhaqaawaai fayuyassaruwna li'amali alshhaqaawaai ‏"‏, thumma qaraaa ‏{‏faaammaa man aa'taa waattaqaa‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:" We were accompanying a funeral procession in Baqi-I-Gharqad. The Prophet (ﷺ) came to us and sat and we sat around him. He had a small stick in his hand then he bent his head and started scraping the ground with it. He then said, "There is none among you, and not a created soul, but has place either in Paradise or in Hell assigned for him and it is also determined for him whether he will be among the blessed or wretched." A man said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Should we not depend on what has been written for us and leave the deeds as whoever amongst us is blessed will do the deeds of a blessed person and whoever amongst us will be wretched, will do the deeds of a wretched person?" The Prophet said, "The good deeds are made easy for the blessed, and bad deeds are made easy for the wretched." Then he recited the Verses:-- "As for him who gives (in charity) and is Allah-fearing And believes in the Best reward from Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ الضَّحَّاكِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ حَلَفَ بِمِلَّةٍ غَيْرِ الإِسْلاَمِ كَاذِبًا مُتَعَمِّدًا فَهُوَ كَمَا قَالَ، وَمَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِحَدِيدَةٍ عُذِّبَ بِهِ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا جُنْدَبٌ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فِي هَذَا الْمَسْجِدِ فَمَا نَسِينَا، وَمَا نَخَافُ أَنْ يَكْذِبَ جُنْدَبٌ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ كَانَ بِرَجُلٍ جِرَاحٌ فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ بَدَرَنِي عَبْدِي بِنَفْسِهِ حَرَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an thaabiti bni alddahhaaki rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man halafa bimillaain ghayri aliislaami kaadhibana muta'ammidana fahuwa kamaa qaala, waman qatala nafsahu bihadiydaain 'udhhiba bihi fiy naari jahannama ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala hajjaaju bnu minhaalin haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, 'ani alhasani, haddathanaa jundabun rda allh 'nh fiy hadhaa almasjidi famaa nasiynaa, wamaa nakhaafu aan yakdhiba jundabun 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ kaana birajulin jiraahun faqatala nafsahu faqaala alllahu badaraniy 'abdiy binafsihi harramtu 'alayhi aljannaaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Thabit bin Ad-Dahhak:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever intentionally swears falsely by a religion other than Islam, then he is what he has said, (e.g. if he says, 'If such thing is not true then I am a Jew,' he is really a Jew). And whoever commits suicide with piece of iron will be punished with the same piece of iron in the Hell Fire." Narrated Jundab the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man was inflicted with wounds and he committed suicide, and so Allah said: My slave has caused death on himself hurriedly, so I forbid Paradise for him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الَّذِي يَخْنُقُ نَفْسَهُ يَخْنُقُهَا فِي النَّارِ، وَالَّذِي يَطْعُنُهَا يَطْعُنُهَا فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alladhiy yakhnuqu nafsahu yakhnuquhaa fiy alnnaari, waalladhiy yat'unuhaa yat'unuhaa fiy alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira-:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who commits suicide by throttling shall keep on throttling himself in the Hell Fire (forever) and he who commits suicide by stabbing himself shall keep on stabbing himself in the Hell-Fire
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لَمَّا مَاتَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ دُعِيَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَثَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَتُصَلِّي عَلَى ابْنِ أُبَىٍّ وَقَدْ قَالَ يَوْمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا كَذَا وَكَذَا ـ أُعَدِّدُ عَلَيْهِ قَوْلَهُ ـ فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَخِّرْ عَنِّي يَا عُمَرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرْتُ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي خُيِّرْتُ فَاخْتَرْتُ، لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنِّي إِنْ زِدْتُ عَلَى السَّبْعِينَ فَغُفِرَ لَهُ لَزِدْتُ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ، فَلَمْ يَمْكُثْ إِلاَّ يَسِيرًا حَتَّى نَزَلَتِ الآيَتَانِ مِنْ ‏{‏بَرَاءَةٌ‏}‏ ‏{‏وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا‏}‏ إِلَى ‏{‏وَهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ‏}‏ قَالَ فَعَجِبْتُ بَعْدُ مِنْ جُرْأَتِي عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَئِذٍ، وَاللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathaniy alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an 'umara bni alkhattaabi rda allh 'nhm aannahu qaala lammaa maata 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain abnu saluwla du'iya lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liyusalliya 'alayhi, falammaa qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wathabtu iilayhi faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi, aatusalliy 'alaa abni aubaaain waqad qaala yawma kadhaa wakadhaa kadhaa wakadhaa au'addidu 'alayhi qawlahu fatabassama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala ‏"‏ aakhhir 'anniy yaa 'umaru ‏"‏‏.‏ falammaa aakthartu 'alayhi qaala ‏"‏ iinniy khuyyirtu faakhtartu, law aa'lamu aanniy iin zidtu 'alaa alssab'iyna faghufira lahu lazidtu 'alayhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fasallaa 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma ansarafa, falam yamkuth iilaaa yasiyrana hattaa nazalati alayataani min ‏{‏baraa'aaun‏}‏ ‏{‏walaa tusalli 'alaa aahadin minhum maata aabadana‏}‏ iilaa ‏{‏wahum faasiquwna‏}‏ qaala fa'ajibtu ba'du min juraatiy 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmaiidhin, waalllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:When `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul died, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was called upon to offer his funeral prayer. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up to offer the prayer, I got up quickly and said, "O Allah's Apostle! Are you going to pray for Ibn Ubai and he said so and so on such and such occasions?" And started mentioning all that he had said. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and said, "O `Umar! Go away from me." When I talked too much he said, "I have been given the choice and so I have chosen (to offer the prayer). Had I known that he would be forgiven by asking for Allah's forgiveness for more than seventy times, surely I would have done so." (`Umar added): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered his funeral prayer and returned and after a short while the two verses of Surat Bara' were revealed: i.e. "And never (O Muhammad) pray for any of them who dies . . . (to the end of the verse) rebellion (9.84)" -- (`Umar added), "Later I was astonished at my daring before Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on that day. And Allah and His Apostle know better
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ مَرُّوا بِجَنَازَةٍ فَأَثْنَوْا عَلَيْهَا خَيْرًا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَجَبَتْ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ مَرُّوا بِأُخْرَى فَأَثْنَوْا عَلَيْهَا شَرًّا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَجَبَتْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ مَا وَجَبَتْ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا أَثْنَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ خَيْرًا فَوَجَبَتْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ، وَهَذَا أَثْنَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ شَرًّا فَوَجَبَتْ لَهُ النَّارُ، أَنْتُمْ شُهَدَاءُ اللَّهِ فِي الأَرْضِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu suhaybin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu marruwa bijanaazaain faaathnawa 'alayhaa khayrana, faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ wajabat ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma marruwa biaukhraa faaathnawa 'alayhaa sharrana faqaala ‏"‏ wajabat ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh maa wajabat qaala ‏"‏ hadhaa aathnaytum 'alayhi khayrana fawajabat lahu aljannaau, wahadhaa aathnaytum 'alayhi sharrana fawajabat lahu alnnaaru, aantum shuhadaa'u alllahi fiy alaardi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:A funeral procession passed and the people praised the deceased. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It has been affirmed to him." Then another funeral procession passed and the people spoke badly of the deceased. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It has been affirmed to him". `Umar bin Al-Khattab asked (Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ), "What has been affirmed?" He replied, "You praised this, so Paradise has been affirmed to him; and you spoke badly of this, so Hell has been affirmed to him. You people are Allah's witnesses on earth
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي الْفُرَاتِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ قَدِمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ وَقَدْ وَقَعَ بِهَا مَرَضٌ، فَجَلَسْتُ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَمَرَّتْ بِهِمْ جَنَازَةٌ فَأُثْنِيَ عَلَى صَاحِبِهَا خَيْرًا فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَجَبَتْ‏.‏ ثُمَّ مُرَّ بِأُخْرَى فَأُثْنِيَ عَلَى صَاحِبِهَا خَيْرًا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَجَبَتْ‏.‏ ثُمَّ مُرَّ بِالثَّالِثَةِ، فَأُثْنِيَ عَلَى صَاحِبِهَا شَرًّا فَقَالَ وَجَبَتْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو الأَسْوَدِ فَقُلْتُ وَمَا وَجَبَتْ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَالَ قُلْتُ كَمَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيُّمَا مُسْلِمٍ شَهِدَ لَهُ أَرْبَعَةٌ بِخَيْرٍ أَدْخَلَهُ اللَّهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا وَثَلاَثَةٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَثَلاَثَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا وَاثْنَانِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَاثْنَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ لَمْ نَسْأَلْهُ عَنِ الْوَاحِدِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'affaanu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa daawudu bnu aabiy alfuraati, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni buraydaaa, 'an aabiy alaaswadi, qaala qadimtu almadiynaaa waqad waqa'a bihaa maradun, fajalastu iilaa 'umara bni alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh famarrat bihim janaazaaun faauthniya 'alaa saahibihaa khayrana faqaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh wajabat‏.‏ thumma murra biaukhraa faauthniya 'alaa saahibihaa khayrana, faqaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh wajabat‏.‏ thumma murra bialthhaalithaai, faauthniya 'alaa saahibihaa sharrana faqaala wajabat‏.‏ faqaala aabuw alaaswadi faqultu wamaa wajabat yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna qaala qultu kamaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aayyumaa muslimin shahida lahu aarba'aaun bikhayrin aadkhalahu alllahu aljannaaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqulnaa wathalaathaaun qaala ‏"‏ wathalaathaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ faqulnaa waathnaani qaala ‏"‏ waathnaani ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma lam nasaalhu 'ani alwaahidi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Al-Aswad:I came to Medina when an epidemic had broken out. While I was sitting with `Umar bin Al-Khattab a funeral procession passed by and the people praised the deceased. `Umar said, "It has been affirmed to him." And another funeral procession passed by and the people praised the deceased. `Umar said, "It has been affirmed to him." A third (funeral procession) passed by and the people spoke badly of the deceased. He said, "It has been affirmed to him." I (Abu Al-Aswad) asked, "O chief of the believers! What has been affirmed?" He replied, "I said the same as the Prophet (ﷺ) had said, that is: if four persons testify the piety of a Muslim, Allah will grant him Paradise." We asked, "If three persons testify his piety?" He (the Prophet) replied, "Even three." Then we asked, "If two?" He replied, "Even two." We did not ask him regarding one witness
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أُقْعِدَ الْمُؤْمِنُ فِي قَبْرِهِ أُتِيَ، ثُمَّ شَهِدَ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ ‏{‏يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ بِهَذَا وَزَادَ ‏{‏يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا‏}‏ نَزَلَتْ فِي عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'alqamaaa bni marthadin, 'an sa'di bni 'ubaydaaa, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa auq'ida almuuminu fiy qabrihi autiya, thumma shahida aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, waaanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi, fadhalika qawluhu ‏{‏yuthabbitu alllahu alladhiyna amanuwa bialqawli althhaabiti‏}‏ ‏"‏‏.‏ haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin haddathanaa ghundarun haddathanaa shu'baau bihadhaa wazaada ‏{‏yuthabbitu alllahu alladhiyna amanuwa‏}‏ nazalat fiy 'adhaabi alqabri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara' bin 'Azib : The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a faithful believer is made to sit in his grave, then (the angels) come to him and he testifies that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and Muhammad is Allah's Apostle. And that corresponds to Allah's statement: Allah will keep firm those who believe with the word that stands firm . . . (14.27). Narrated Shu'ba: Same as above and added, "Allah will keep firm those who believe . . . (14.27) was revealed concerning the punishment of the grave
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ اطَّلَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى أَهْلِ الْقَلِيبِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَجَدْتُمْ مَا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لَهُ تَدْعُو أَمْوَاتًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَنْتُمْ بِأَسْمَعَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَكِنْ لاَ يُجِيبُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an saalihin, haddathaniy naafi'un, aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma aakhbarahu qaala attala'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa aahli alqaliybi faqaala ‏"‏ wajadtum maa wa'ada rabbukum haqqana ‏"‏‏.‏ faqiyla lahu tad'uw aamwaatana faqaala ‏"‏ maa aantum biaasma'a minhum walakin laa yujiybuwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) looked at the people of the well (the well in which the bodies of the pagans killed in the Battle of Badr were thrown) and said, "Have you found true what your Lord promised you?" Somebody said to him, "You are addressing dead people." He replied, "You do not hear better than they but they cannot reply
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ إِنَّمَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَعْلَمُونَ الآنَ أَنَّ مَا كُنْتُ أَقُولُ حَقٌّ وَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِنَّكَ لاَ تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتَى‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat iinnamaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnahum laya'lamuwna alana aanna maa kuntu aaquwlu haqqun waqad qaala alllahu ta'aalaa ‏{‏iinnaka laa tusmi'u almawtaa‏}‏‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "They now realize that what I used to tell them was the truth. "And Allah said, 'Verily! You cannot make the dead to hear (i.e. benefit them, and similarly the disbelievers) nor can you make the deaf hear
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، سَمِعْتُ الأَشْعَثَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ يَهُودِيَّةً، دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْهَا، فَذَكَرَتْ عَذَابَ الْقَبْرِ، فَقَالَتْ لَهَا أَعَاذَكِ اللَّهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَتْ عَائِشَةُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ عَذَابُ الْقَبْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَمَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدُ صَلَّى صَلاَةً إِلاَّ تَعَوَّذَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ‏.‏ زَادَ غُنْدَرٌ ‏"‏ عَذَابُ الْقَبْرِ حَقٌّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an shu'baaa, sami'tu alaash'atha, 'an aabiyhi, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aanna yahuwdiyyaaan, dakhalat 'alayhaa, fadhakarat 'adhaaba alqabri, faqaalat lahaa aa'aadhaki alllahu min 'adhaabi alqabri‏.‏ fasaaalat 'aaiishaau rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an 'adhaabi alqabri faqaala ‏"‏ na'am 'adhaabu alqabri ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau rda allh 'nha famaa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'du sallaa salaaaan iilaaa ta'awwadha min 'adhaabi alqabri‏.‏ zaada ghundarun ‏"‏ 'adhaabu alqabri haqqun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Masruq:`Aisha said that a Jewess came to her and mentioned the punishment in the grave, saying to her, "May Allah protect you from the punishment of the grave." `Aisha then asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the punishment of the grave. He said, "Yes, (there is) punishment in the grave." `Aisha added, "After that I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) but seeking refuge with Allah from the punishment in the grave in every prayer he prayed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ تَقُولُ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطِيبًا فَذَكَرَ فِتْنَةَ الْقَبْرِ الَّتِي يَفْتَتِنُ فِيهَا الْمَرْءُ، فَلَمَّا ذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ ضَجَّ الْمُسْلِمُونَ ضَجَّةً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, qaala aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a aasmaa'a binta aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nhma taquwlu qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khatiybana fadhakara fitnaaa alqabri allatiy yaftatinu fiyhaa almar'u, falammaa dhakara dhalika dajja almuslimuwna dajjaaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Asma' bint Abi Bakr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) once stood up delivering a sermon and mentioned the trial which people will face in the grave. When he mentioned that, the Muslims started shouting loudly
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا وُضِعَ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُ أَصْحَابُهُ، وَإِنَّهُ لَيَسْمَعُ قَرْعَ نِعَالِهِمْ، أَتَاهُ مَلَكَانِ فَيُقْعِدَانِهِ فَيَقُولاَنِ مَا كُنْتَ تَقُولُ فِي الرَّجُلِ لِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَأَمَّا الْمُؤْمِنُ فَيَقُولُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ انْظُرْ إِلَى مَقْعَدِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ، قَدْ أَبْدَلَكَ اللَّهُ بِهِ مَقْعَدًا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، فَيَرَاهُمَا جَمِيعًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ وَذُكِرَ لَنَا أَنَّهُ يُفْسَحُ فِي قَبْرِهِ‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى حَدِيثِ أَنَسٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَأَمَّا الْمُنَافِقُ وَالْكَافِرُ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ مَا كُنْتَ تَقُولُ فِي هَذَا الرَّجُلِ فَيَقُولُ لاَ أَدْرِي، كُنْتُ أَقُولُ مَا يَقُولُ النَّاسُ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لاَ دَرَيْتَ وَلاَ تَلَيْتَ‏.‏ وَيُضْرَبُ بِمَطَارِقَ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ضَرْبَةً، فَيَصِيحُ صَيْحَةً يَسْمَعُهَا مَنْ يَلِيهِ، غَيْرَ الثَّقَلَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ayyaashu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aannahu haddathahum aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna al'abda iidhaa wudi'a fiy qabrihi, watawallaa 'anhu aashaabuhu, waiinnahu layasma'u qar'a ni'aalihim, aataahu malakaani fayuq'idaanihi fayaquwlaani maa kunta taquwlu fiy alrrajuli limuhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faaammaa almuuminu fayaquwlu aashhadu aannahu 'abdu alllahi warasuwluhu‏.‏ fayuqaalu lahu anzur iilaa maq'adika mina alnnaari, qad aabdalaka alllahu bihi maq'adana mina aljannaai, fayaraahumaa jamiy'ana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala qataadaau wadhukira lanaa aannahu yufsahu fiy qabrihi‏.‏ thumma raja'a iilaa hadiythi aanasin qaala ‏"‏ waaammaa almunaafiqu waalkaafiru fayuqaalu lahu maa kunta taquwlu fiy hadhaa alrrajuli fayaquwlu laa aadriy, kuntu aaquwlu maa yaquwlu alnnaasu‏.‏ fayuqaalu laa darayta walaa talayta‏.‏ wayudrabu bimataariqa min hadiydin darbaaan, fayasiyhu sayhaaan yasma'uhaa man yaliyhi, ghayra althhaqalayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When (Allah's) slave is put in his grave and his companions return and he even hears their footsteps, two angels come to him and make him sit and ask, 'What did you use to say about this man (i.e. Muhammad)?' The faithful Believer will say, 'I testify that he is Allah's slave and His Apostle.' Then they will say to him, 'Look at your place in the Hell Fire; Allah has given you a place in Paradise instead of it.' So he will see both his places." (Qatada said, "We were informed that his grave would be made spacious." Then Qatada went back to the narration of Anas who said;) Whereas a hypocrite or a non-believer will be asked, "What did you use to say about this man." He will reply, "I do not know; but I used to say what the people used to say." So they will say to him, "Neither did you know nor did you take the guidance (by reciting the Qur'an)." Then he will be hit with iron hammers once, that he will send such a cry as everything near to him will hear, except Jinns and human beings. (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَوْنُ بْنُ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ وَجَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَسَمِعَ صَوْتًا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَهُودُ تُعَذَّبُ فِي قُبُورِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ النَّضْرُ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْنٌ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala haddathaniy 'awnu bnu aabiy juhayfaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, 'an aabiy aayyuwba rda allh 'nhm qaala kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad wajabati alshhamsu, fasami'a sawtana faqaala ‏ "‏ yahuwdu tu'adhhabu fiy qubuwrihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala alnnadru aakhbaranaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'awnun, sami'tu aabiy, sami'tu albaraa'a, 'an aabiy aayyuwba rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abi Aiyub:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) went out after sunset and heard a dreadful voice, and said, "The Jews are being punished in their graves
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلًّى، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي ابْنَةُ خَالِدِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allana, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, qaala haddathatniy abnaau khaalidi bni sa'iydi bni al'aasi, aannahaa sami'ati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yata'awwadhu min 'adhaabi alqabri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Musa bin `Uqba:(From the daughter of Khalid bin Sa`id bin Al-`Asi) who said that she had heard the Prophet (ﷺ) seeking refuge with Allah from the punishment in the grave
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْعُو ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa hishaamun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yad'uw ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min 'adhaabi alqabri, wamin 'adhaabi alnnaari, wamin fitnaai almahyaa waalmamaati, wamin fitnaai almasiyhi alddajjaali ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to invoke (Allah): "Allahumma ini a`udhu bika min 'adhabi-l-Qabr, wa min 'adhabi-nnar, wa min fitnati-l-mahya wa-lmamat, wa min fitnati-l-masih ad-dajjal. (O Allah! I seek refuge with you from the punishment in the grave and from the punishment in the Hell fire and from the afflictions of life and death, and the afflictions of Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ مَرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى قَبْرَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمَا لَيُعَذَّبَانِ، وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ مِنْ كَبِيرٍ ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ ـ بَلَى أَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَكَانَ يَسْعَى بِالنَّمِيمَةِ، وَأَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَكَانَ لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ عُودًا رَطْبًا فَكَسَرَهُ بِاثْنَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ غَرَزَ كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا عَلَى قَبْرٍ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّهُ يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَيْبَسَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an mujaahidin, 'an taawusin, qaala abnu 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma marra alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa qabrayni faqaala ‏"‏ iinnahumaa layu'adhhabaani, wamaa yu'adhhabaani min kabiyrin thumma qaala balaa aammaa aahaduhumaa fakaana yas'aa bialnnamiymaai, waaammaa aahaduhumaa fakaana laa yastatiru min bawlihi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala thumma aakhadha 'uwdana ratbana fakasarahu biathnatayni thumma gharaza kulla waahidin minhumaa 'alaa qabrin, thumma qaala ‏"‏ la'allahu yukhaffafu 'anhumaa maa lam yaybasaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) once passed by two graves and said, "They (the deceased persons in those graves) are being tortured not for a great thing to avoid." And then added, "Yes, (they are being punished for a big sin), for one of them used to go about with calumnies while the other never saved himself from being soiled with his urine." (Ibn `Abbas added): Then he took a green leaf of a date-palm) and split it into two pieces and fixed one piece on each grave and said, "May their punishment be abated till these (two pieces) get dry
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا مَاتَ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ مَقْعَدُهُ بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ، إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فَمِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ، فَيُقَالُ هَذَا مَقْعَدُكَ حَتَّى يَبْعَثَكَ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna aahadakum iidhaa maata 'urida 'alayhi maq'aduhu bialghadaaai waal'ashiyyi, iin kaana min aahli aljannaai famin aahli aljannaai, waiin kaana min aahli alnnaari famin aahli alnnaari, fayuqaalu hadhaa maq'aduka hattaa yab'athaka alllahu yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When anyone of you dies, he is shown his place both in the morning and in the evening. If he is one of the people of Paradise; he is shown his place in it, and if he is from the people of the Hell-Fire; he is shown his place there-in. Then it is said to him, 'This is your place till Allah resurrect you on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا وُضِعَتِ الْجَنَازَةُ فَاحْتَمَلَهَا الرِّجَالُ عَلَى أَعْنَاقِهِمْ، فَإِنْ كَانَتْ صَالِحَةً قَالَتْ قَدِّمُونِي قَدِّمُونِي‏.‏ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ غَيْرَ صَالِحَةٍ قَالَتْ يَا وَيْلَهَا أَيْنَ يَذْهَبُونَ بِهَا‏.‏ يَسْمَعُ صَوْتَهَا كُلُّ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ الإِنْسَانَ، وَلَوْ سَمِعَهَا الإِنْسَانُ لَصَعِقَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sami'a aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya rda allh 'nh yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa wudi'ati aljanaazaau faahtamalahaa alrrijaalu 'alaa aa'naaqihim, faiin kaanat saalihaaan qaalat qaddimuwniy qaddimuwniy‏.‏ waiin kaanat ghayra saalihaain qaalat yaa waylahaa aayna yadhhabuwna bihaa‏.‏ yasma'u sawtahaa kullu shaa'in iilaaa aliinsaana, walaw sami'ahaa aliinsaanu lasa'iqa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When the funeral is ready (for its burial) and the people lift it on their shoulders, then if the deceased is a righteous person he says, 'Take me ahead,' and if he is not a righteous one then he says, 'Woe to it (me)! Where are you taking it (me)?' And his voice is audible to everything except human beings; and if they heard it they would fall down unconscious
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا مِنَ النَّاسِ مُسْلِمٌ يَمُوتُ لَهُ ثَلاَثَةٌ مِنَ الْوَلَدِ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحِنْثَ إِلاَّ أَدْخَلَهُ اللَّهُ الْجَنَّةَ بِفَضْلِ رَحْمَتِهِ إِيَّاهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu suhaybin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa mina alnnaasi muslimun yamuwtu lahu thalaathaaun mina alwaladi lam yablughuwa alhintha iilaaa aadkhalahu alllahu aljannaaa bifadli rahmatihi iiyyaahum ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Any Muslim whose three children died before the age of puberty will be granted Paradise by Allah because of His mercy to them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لَهُ مُرْضِعًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyi bni thaabitin, aannahu sami'a albaraa'a rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa tuwuffiya iibraahiymu 'alayhi alssalaamu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna lahu murdi'ana fiy aljannaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara':When Ibrahim (the son of Prophet) expired, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is a wet-nurse for him in Paradise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ قَالَ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَوْلاَدِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُ إِذْ خَلَقَهُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا عَامِلِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hibbaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhm qaala suiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aawlaadi almushrikiyna faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahu iidh khalaqahum aa'lamu bimaa kaanuwa 'aamiliyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the children of (Mushrikeen) pagans. The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Since Allah created them, He knows what sort of deeds they would have done
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَرَارِيِّ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا عَامِلِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ataa'u bnu yaziyda alllaythiyyu, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh yaquwlu suiila alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dharaariyyi almushrikiyna faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahu aa'lamu bimaa kaanuwa 'aamiliyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about the offspring of pagans (Mushrikeen); so he said, "Allah knows what sort of deeds they would have done
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كُلُّ مَوْلُودٍ يُولَدُ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ، فَأَبَوَاهُ يُهَوِّدَانِهِ أَوْ يُنَصِّرَانِهِ أَوْ يُمَجِّسَانِهِ، كَمَثَلِ الْبَهِيمَةِ تُنْتَجُ الْبَهِيمَةَ، هَلْ تَرَى فِيهَا جَدْعَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kullu mawluwdin yuwladu 'alaa alfitraai, faaabawaahu yuhawwidaanihi aaw yunassiraanihi aaw yumajjisaanihi, kamathali albahiymaai tuntaju albahiymaaa, hal taraa fiyhaa jad'aa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every child is born with a true faith of Islam (i.e. to worship none but Allah Alone) and his parents convert him to Judaism or Christianity or Magianism, as an animal delivers a perfect baby animal. Do you find it mutilated?
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا صَلَّى صَلاَةً أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ رَأَى مِنْكُمُ اللَّيْلَةَ رُؤْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنْ رَأَى أَحَدٌ قَصَّهَا، فَيَقُولُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، فَسَأَلَنَا يَوْمًا، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ رَأَى أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ رُؤْيَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْنَا لاَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَكِنِّي رَأَيْتُ اللَّيْلَةَ رَجُلَيْنِ أَتَيَانِي فَأَخَذَا بِيَدِي، فَأَخْرَجَانِي إِلَى الأَرْضِ الْمُقَدَّسَةِ، فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ جَالِسٌ، وَرَجُلٌ قَائِمٌ بِيَدِهِ كَلُّوبٌ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ـ قَالَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ مُوسَى إِنَّهُ ـ يُدْخِلُ ذَلِكَ الْكَلُّوبَ فِي شِدْقِهِ، حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ قَفَاهُ، ثُمَّ يَفْعَلُ بِشِدْقِهِ الآخَرِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، وَيَلْتَئِمُ شِدْقُهُ هَذَا، فَيَعُودُ فَيَصْنَعُ مِثْلَهُ‏.‏ قُلْتُ مَا هَذَا قَالاَ انْطَلِقْ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْنَا حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا عَلَى رَجُلٍ مُضْطَجِعٍ عَلَى قَفَاهُ، وَرَجُلٌ قَائِمٌ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ بِفِهْرٍ أَوْ صَخْرَةٍ، فَيَشْدَخُ بِهِ رَأْسَهُ، فَإِذَا ضَرَبَهُ تَدَهْدَهَ الْحَجَرُ، فَانْطَلَقَ إِلَيْهِ لِيَأْخُذَهُ، فَلاَ يَرْجِعُ إِلَى هَذَا حَتَّى يَلْتَئِمَ رَأْسُهُ، وَعَادَ رَأْسُهُ كَمَا هُوَ، فَعَادَ إِلَيْهِ فَضَرَبَهُ، قُلْتُ مَنْ هَذَا قَالاَ انْطَلِقْ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْنَا إِلَى ثَقْبٍ مِثْلِ التَّنُّورِ، أَعْلاَهُ ضَيِّقٌ وَأَسْفَلُهُ وَاسِعٌ، يَتَوَقَّدُ تَحْتَهُ نَارًا، فَإِذَا اقْتَرَبَ ارْتَفَعُوا حَتَّى كَادَ أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا، فَإِذَا خَمَدَتْ رَجَعُوا فِيهَا، وَفِيهَا رِجَالٌ وَنِسَاءٌ عُرَاةٌ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ هَذَا قَالاَ انْطَلِقْ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْنَا حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا عَلَى نَهَرٍ مِنْ دَمٍ، فِيهِ رَجُلٌ قَائِمٌ عَلَى وَسَطِ النَّهَرِ رَجُلٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ حِجَارَةٌ، فَأَقْبَلَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي فِي النَّهَرِ، فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ رَمَى الرَّجُلُ بِحَجَرٍ فِي فِيهِ، فَرَدَّهُ حَيْثُ كَانَ، فَجَعَلَ كُلَّمَا جَاءَ لِيَخْرُجَ رَمَى فِي فِيهِ بِحَجَرٍ، فَيَرْجِعُ كَمَا كَانَ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مَا هَذَا قَالاَ انْطَلِقْ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْنَا حَتَّى انْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى رَوْضَةٍ خَضْرَاءَ، فِيهَا شَجَرَةٌ عَظِيمَةٌ، وَفِي أَصْلِهَا شَيْخٌ وَصِبْيَانٌ، وَإِذَا رَجُلٌ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ نَارٌ يُوقِدُهَا، فَصَعِدَا بِي فِي الشَّجَرَةِ، وَأَدْخَلاَنِي دَارًا لَمْ أَرَ قَطُّ أَحْسَنَ مِنْهَا، فِيهَا رِجَالٌ شُيُوخٌ وَشَبَابٌ، وَنِسَاءٌ وَصِبْيَانٌ، ثُمَّ أَخْرَجَانِي مِنْهَا فَصَعِدَا بِي الشَّجَرَةَ فَأَدْخَلاَنِي دَارًا هِيَ أَحْسَنُ وَأَفْضَلُ، فِيهَا شُيُوخٌ وَشَبَابٌ‏.‏ قُلْتُ طَوَّفْتُمَانِي اللَّيْلَةَ، فَأَخْبِرَانِي عَمَّا رَأَيْتُ‏.‏ قَالاَ نَعَمْ، أَمَّا الَّذِي رَأَيْتَهُ يُشَقُّ شِدْقُهُ فَكَذَّابٌ يُحَدِّثُ بِالْكَذْبَةِ، فَتُحْمَلُ عَنْهُ حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ الآفَاقَ، فَيُصْنَعُ بِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ‏.‏ وَالَّذِي رَأَيْتَهُ يُشْدَخُ رَأْسُهُ فَرَجُلٌ عَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ الْقُرْآنَ، فَنَامَ عَنْهُ بِاللَّيْلِ، وَلَمْ يَعْمَلْ فِيهِ بِالنَّهَارِ، يُفْعَلُ بِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ‏.‏ وَالَّذِي رَأَيْتَهُ فِي الثَّقْبِ فَهُمُ الزُّنَاةُ‏.‏ وَالَّذِي رَأَيْتَهُ فِي النَّهَرِ آكِلُو الرِّبَا‏.‏ وَالشَّيْخُ فِي أَصْلِ الشَّجَرَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ وَالصِّبْيَانُ حَوْلَهُ فَأَوْلاَدُ النَّاسِ، وَالَّذِي يُوقِدُ النَّارَ مَالِكٌ خَازِنُ النَّارِ‏.‏ وَالدَّارُ الأُولَى الَّتِي دَخَلْتَ دَارُ عَامَّةِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَأَمَّا هَذِهِ الدَّارُ فَدَارُ الشُّهَدَاءِ، وَأَنَا جِبْرِيلُ، وَهَذَا مِيكَائِيلُ، فَارْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ، فَرَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي فَإِذَا فَوْقِي مِثْلُ السَّحَابِ‏.‏ قَالاَ ذَاكَ مَنْزِلُكَ‏.‏ قُلْتُ دَعَانِي أَدْخُلْ مَنْزِلِي‏.‏ قَالاَ إِنَّهُ بَقِيَ لَكَ عُمْرٌ لَمْ تَسْتَكْمِلْهُ، فَلَوِ اسْتَكْمَلْتَ أَتَيْتَ مَنْزِلَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, haddathanaa aabuw rajaa'in, 'an samuraaa bni jundabin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sallaa salaaaan aaqbala 'alaynaa biwajhihi faqaala ‏"‏ man raaaa minkumu alllaylaaa ruuyaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala faiin raaaa aahadun qassahaa, fayaquwlu maa shaa'a alllahu, fasaaalanaa yawmana, faqaala ‏"‏ hal raaaa aahadun minkum ruuyaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qulnaa laa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ lakinniy raaaytu alllaylaaa rajulayni aatayaaniy faaakhadhaa biyadiy, faaakhrajaaniy iilaa alaardi almuqaddasaai, faiidhaa rajulun jaalisun, warajulun qaaiimun biyadihi kalluwbun min hadiydin qaala ba'du aashaabinaa 'an muwsaa iinnahu yudkhilu dhalika alkalluwba fiy shidqihi, hattaa yablugha qafaahu, thumma yaf'alu bishidqihi alakhari mithla dhalika, wayaltaiimu shidquhu hadhaa, faya'uwdu fayasna'u mithlahu‏.‏ qultu maa hadhaa qaalaa antaliq‏.‏ faantalaqnaa hattaa aataynaa 'alaa rajulin mudtaji'in 'alaa qafaahu, warajulun qaaiimun 'alaa raasihi bifihrin aaw sakhraain, fayashdakhu bihi raasahu, faiidhaa darabahu tadahdaha alhajaru, faantalaqa iilayhi liyaakhudhahu, falaa yarji'u iilaa hadhaa hattaa yaltaiima raasuhu, wa'aada raasuhu kamaa huwa, fa'aada iilayhi fadarabahu, qultu man hadhaa qaalaa antaliq‏.‏ faantalaqnaa iilaa thaqbin mithli alttannuwri, aa'laahu dayyiqun waaasfaluhu waasi'un, yatawaqqadu tahtahu naarana, faiidhaa aqtaraba artafa'uwa hattaa kaada aan yakhrujuwa, faiidhaa khamadat raja'uwa fiyhaa, wafiyhaa rijaalun wanisaa'un 'uraaaun‏.‏ faqultu man hadhaa qaalaa antaliq‏.‏ faantalaqnaa hattaa aataynaa 'alaa naharin min damin, fiyhi rajulun qaaiimun 'alaa wasati alnnahari rajulun bayna yadayhi hijaaraaun, faaaqbala alrrajulu alladhiy fiy alnnahari, faiidhaa aaraada aan yakhruja ramaa alrrajulu bihajarin fiy fiyhi, faraddahu haythu kaana, faja'ala kullamaa jaa'a liyakhruja ramaa fiy fiyhi bihajarin, fayarji'u kamaa kaana‏.‏ faqultu maa hadhaa qaalaa antaliq‏.‏ faantalaqnaa hattaa antahaynaa iilaa rawdaain khadraa'a, fiyhaa shajaraaun 'aziymaaun, wafiy aaslihaa shaykhun wasibyaanun, waiidhaa rajulun qariybun mina alshhajaraai bayna yadayhi naarun yuwqiduhaa, fasa'idaa biy fiy alshhajaraai, waaadkhalaaniy daarana lam aara qattu aahsana minhaa, fiyhaa rijaalun shuyuwkhun washabaabun, wanisaa'un wasibyaanun, thumma aakhrajaaniy minhaa fasa'idaa biy alshhajaraaa faaadkhalaaniy daarana hiya aahsanu waaafdalu, fiyhaa shuyuwkhun washabaabun‏.‏ qultu tawwaftumaaniy alllaylaaa, faaakhbiraaniy 'ammaa raaaytu‏.‏ qaalaa na'am, aammaa alladhiy raaaytahu yushaqqu shidquhu fakadhhaabun yuhaddithu bialkadhbaai, fatuhmalu 'anhu hattaa tablugha alafaaqa, fayusna'u bihi iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai‏.‏ waalladhiy raaaytahu yushdakhu raasuhu farajulun 'allamahu alllahu alqurana, fanaama 'anhu bialllayli, walam ya'mal fiyhi bialnnahaari, yuf'alu bihi iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai‏.‏ waalladhiy raaaytahu fiy althhaqbi fahumu alzzunaaau‏.‏ waalladhiy raaaytahu fiy alnnahari akiluw alrribaa‏.‏ waalshhaykhu fiy aasli alshhajaraai iibraahiymu 'alayhi alssalaamu waalssibyaanu hawlahu faaawlaadu alnnaasi, waalladhiy yuwqidu alnnaara maalikun khaazinu alnnaari‏.‏ waalddaaru alauwlaa allatiy dakhalta daaru 'aammaai almuuminiyna, waaammaa hadhihi alddaaru fadaaru alshhuhadaa'i, waaanaa jibriylu, wahadhaa miykaaiiylu, faarfa' raasaka, farafa'tu raasiy faiidhaa fawqiy mithlu alssahaabi‏.‏ qaalaa dhaaka manziluka‏.‏ qultu da'aaniy aadkhul manziliy‏.‏ qaalaa iinnahu baqiya laka 'umrun lam tastakmilhu, falawi astakmalta aatayta manzilaka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Samura bin Jundab:Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) finished the (morning) prayer, he would face us and ask, "Who amongst you had a dream last night?" So if anyone had seen a dream he would narrate it. The Prophet (ﷺ) would say: "Ma sha'a-llah" (An Arabic maxim meaning literally, 'What Allah wished,' and it indicates a good omen.) One day, he asked us whether anyone of us had seen a dream. We replied in the negative. The Prophet said, "But I had seen (a dream) last night that two men came to me, caught hold of my hands, and took me to the Sacred Land (Jerusalem). There, I saw a person sitting and another standing with an iron hook in his hand pushing it inside the mouth of the former till it reached the jawbone, and then tore off one side of his cheek, and then did the same with the other side; in the meantime the first side of his cheek became normal again and then he repeated the same operation again. I said, 'What is this?' They told me to proceed on and we went on till we came to a man Lying flat on his back, and another man standing at his head carrying a stone or a piece of rock, and crushing the head of the Lying man, with that stone. Whenever he struck him, the stone rolled away. The man went to pick it up and by the time he returned to him, the crushed head had returned to its normal state and the man came back and struck him again (and so on). I said, 'Who is this?' They told me to proceed on; so we proceeded on and passed by a hole like an oven; with a narrow top and wide bottom, and the fire was kindling underneath that hole. Whenever the fire-flame went up, the people were lifted up to such an extent that they were about to get out of it, and whenever the fire got quieter, the people went down into it, and there were naked men and women in it. I said, 'Who is this?' They told me to proceed on. So we proceeded on till we reached a river of blood and a man was in it, and another man was standing at its bank with stones in front of him, facing the man standing in the river. Whenever the man in the river wanted to come out, the other one threw a stone in his mouth and caused him to retreat to his original position; and so whenever he wanted to come out the other would throw a stone in his mouth, and he would retreat to his original position. I asked, 'What is this?' They told me to proceed on and we did so till we reached a well-flourished green garden having a huge tree and near its root was sitting an old man with some children. (I saw) Another man near the tree with fire in front of him and he was kindling it up. Then they (i.e. my two companions) made me climb up the tree and made me enter a house, better than which I have ever seen. In it were some old men and young men, women and children. Then they took me out of this house and made me climb up the tree and made me enter another house that was better and superior (to the first) containing old and young people. I said to them (i.e. my two companions), 'You have made me ramble all the night. Tell me all about that I have seen.' They said, 'Yes. As for the one whose cheek you saw being torn away, he was a liar and he used to tell lies, and the people would report those lies on his authority till they spread all over the world. So, he will be punished like that till the Day of Resurrection. The one whose head you saw being crushed is the one whom Allah had given the knowledge of Qur'an (i.e. knowing it by heart) but he used to sleep at night (i.e. he did not recite it then) and did not use to act upon it (i.e. upon its orders etc.) by day; and so this punishment will go on till the Day of Resurrection. And those you saw in the hole (like oven) were adulterers (those men and women who commit illegal sexual intercourse). And those you saw in the river of blood were those dealing in Riba (usury). And the old man who was sitting at the base of the tree was Abraham and the little children around him were the offspring of the people. And the one who was kindling the fire was Malik, the gatekeeper of the Hell-fire. And the first house in which you have gone was the house of the common believers, and the second house was of the martyrs. I am Gabriel and this is Michael. Raise your head.' I raised my head and saw a thing like a cloud over me. They said, 'That is your place.' I said, 'Let me enter my place.' They said, 'You still have some life which you have not yet completed, and when you complete (that remaining portion of your life) you will then enter your place
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَقَالَ فِي كَمْ كَفَّنْتُمُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ فِي ثَلاَثَةِ أَثْوَابٍ بِيضٍ سَحُولِيَّةٍ، لَيْسَ فِيهَا قَمِيصٌ وَلاَ عِمَامَةٌ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لَهَا فِي أَىِّ يَوْمٍ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ يَوْمَ الاِثْنَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَىُّ يَوْمٍ هَذَا قَالَتْ يَوْمُ الاِثْنَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ أَرْجُو فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ اللَّيْلِ‏.‏ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى ثَوْبٍ عَلَيْهِ كَانَ يُمَرَّضُ فِيهِ، بِهِ رَدْعٌ مِنْ زَعْفَرَانٍ فَقَالَ اغْسِلُوا ثَوْبِي هَذَا، وَزِيدُوا عَلَيْهِ ثَوْبَيْنِ فَكَفِّنُونِي فِيهَا‏.‏ قُلْتُ إِنَّ هَذَا خَلَقٌ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّ الْحَىَّ أَحَقُّ بِالْجَدِيدِ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ، إِنَّمَا هُوَ لِلْمُهْلَةِ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يُتَوَفَّ حَتَّى أَمْسَى مِنْ لَيْلَةِ الثُّلاَثَاءِ وَدُفِنَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat dakhaltu 'alaa aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nh faqaala fiy kam kaffantumu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat fiy thalaathaai aathwaabin biydin sahuwliyyaain, laysa fiyhaa qamiysun walaa 'imaamaaun‏.‏ waqaala lahaa fiy aaaai yawmin tuwuffiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat yawma alaithnayni‏.‏ qaala faaaaau yawmin hadhaa qaalat yawmu alaithnayni‏.‏ qaala aarjuw fiymaa bayniy wabayna alllayli‏.‏ fanazara iilaa thawbin 'alayhi kaana yumarradu fiyhi, bihi rad'un min za'faraanin faqaala aghsiluwa thawbiy hadhaa, waziyduwa 'alayhi thawbayni fakaffinuwniy fiyhaa‏.‏ qultu iinna hadhaa khalaqun‏.‏ qaala iinna alhaaaa aahaqqu bialjadiydi mina almayyiti, iinnamaa huwa lilmuhlaai‏.‏ falam yutawaffa hattaa aamsaa min laylaai althhulaathaa'i wadufina qabla aan yusbiha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hisham's father:Aisha said, "I went to Abu Bakr (during his fatal illness) and he asked me, 'In how many garments was the Prophet (ﷺ) shrouded?' She replied, 'In three Suhuliya pieces of white cloth of cotton, and there was neither a shirt nor a turban among them.' Abu Bakr further asked her, 'On which day did the Prophet die?' She replied, 'He died on Monday.' He asked, 'What is today?' She replied, 'Today is Monday.' He added, 'I hope I shall die sometime between this morning and tonight.' Then he looked at a garment that he was wearing during his illness and it had some stains of saffron. Then he said, 'Wash this garment of mine and add two more garments and shroud me in them.' I said, 'This is worn out.' He said, 'A living person has more right to wear new clothes than a dead one; the shroud is only for the body's pus.' He did not die till it was the night of Tuesday and was buried before the morning
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ‏.‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّ أُمِّي افْتُلِتَتْ نَفْسُهَا، وَأَظُنُّهَا لَوْ تَكَلَّمَتْ تَصَدَّقَتْ، فَهَلْ لَهَا أَجْرٌ إِنْ تَصَدَّقْتُ عَنْهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala aakhbaraniy hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha ‏.‏ aanna rajulaan, qaala lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinna aummiy aftulitat nafsuhaa, waaazunnuhaa law takallamat tasaddaqat, fahal lahaa aajrun iin tasaddaqtu 'anhaa qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:A man said to the Prophet (ﷺ), "My mother died suddenly and I thought that if she had lived she would have given alms. So, if I give alms now on her behalf, will she get the reward?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَرْوَانَ، يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَكَرِيَّاءَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ إِنْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيَتَعَذَّرُ فِي مَرَضِهِ ‏ "‏ أَيْنَ أَنَا الْيَوْمَ أَيْنَ أَنَا غَدًا ‏"‏ اسْتِبْطَاءً لِيَوْمِ عَائِشَةَ، فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمِي قَبَضَهُ اللَّهُ بَيْنَ سَحْرِي وَنَحْرِي، وَدُفِنَ فِي بَيْتِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathaniy sulaymaanu, 'an hishaamin, wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu harbin, haddathanaa aabuw marwaana, yahyaa bnu aabiy zakariyyaa'a 'an hishaamin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat iin kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm layata'adhharu fiy maradihi ‏ "‏ aayna aanaa alyawma aayna aanaa ghadana ‏"‏ astibtaa'an liyawmi 'aaiishaaa, falammaa kaana yawmiy qabadahu alllahu bayna sahriy wanahriy, wadufina fiy baytiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:During his sickness, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asking repeatedly, "Where am I today? Where will I be tomorrow?" And I was waiting for the day of my turn (impatiently). Then, when my turn came, Allah took his soul away (in my lap) between my chest and arms and he was buried in my house
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَقُمْ مِنْهُ ‏ "‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَى، اتَّخَذُوا قُبُورَ أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ مَسَاجِدَ ‏"‏‏.‏ لَوْلاَ ذَلِكَ أُبْرِزَ قَبْرُهُ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ خَشِيَ أَوْ خُشِيَ أَنَّ يُتَّخَذَ مَسْجِدًا‏.‏ وَعَنْ هِلاَلٍ قَالَ كَنَّانِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ لِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an hilaalin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy maradihi alladhiy lam yaqum minhu ‏ "‏ la'ana alllahu alyahuwda waalnnasaaraa, attakhadhuwa qubuwra aanbiyaaiihim masaajida ‏"‏‏.‏ lawlaa dhalika aubriza qabruhu, ghayra aannahu khashiya aaw khushiya aanna yuttakhadha masjidana‏.‏ wa'an hilaalin qaala kannaaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri walam yuwlad liy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his fatal illness said, "Allah cursed the Jews and the Christians, for they built the places of worship at the graves of their prophets." And if that had not been the case, then the Prophet's grave would have been made prominent before the people. So (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) was afraid, or the people were afraid that his grave might be taken as a place for worship
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ التَّمَّارِ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، رَأَى قَبْرَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُسَنَّمًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu muqaatilin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa aabuw bakri bnu 'ayyaashin, 'an sufyaana alttammaari, aannahu haddathahu aannahu, raaaa qabra alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm musannamana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakr bin `Aiyash:Sufyan at-Tammar told me that he had seen the grave of the Prophet (ﷺ) elevated and convex
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، لَمَّا سَقَطَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْحَائِطُ فِي زَمَانِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ أَخَذُوا فِي بِنَائِهِ، فَبَدَتْ لَهُمْ قَدَمٌ فَفَزِعُوا، وَظَنُّوا أَنَّهَا قَدَمُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا وَجَدُوا أَحَدًا يَعْلَمُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَالَ لَهُمْ عُرْوَةُ لاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا هِيَ قَدَمُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا هِيَ إِلاَّ قَدَمُ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa farwaau, haddathanaa 'aliyyun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, lammaa saqata 'alayhimu alhaaiitu fiy zamaani alwaliydi bni 'abdi almaliki aakhadhuwa fiy binaaiihi, fabadat lahum qadamun fafazi'uwa, wazannuwa aannahaa qadamu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm famaa wajaduwa aahadana ya'lamu dhalika hattaa qaala lahum 'urwaau laa waalllahi maa hiya qadamu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa hiya iilaaa qadamu 'umara rda allh 'nh ‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa:When the wall fell on them (i.e. graves) during the caliphate of Al-Walid bin `Abdul Malik, the people started repairing it, and a foot appeared to them. The people got scared and thought that it was the foot of the Prophet. No one could be found who could tell them about it till I (`Urwa) said to them, "By Allah, this is not the foot of the Prophet (ﷺ) but it is the foot of `Umar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَعَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا أَوْصَتْ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ لاَ تَدْفِنِّي مَعَهُمْ وَادْفِنِّي مَعَ صَوَاحِبِي بِالْبَقِيعِ، لاَ أُزَكَّى بِهِ أَبَدًا‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aannahaa aawsat 'abda alllahi bna alzzubayri rda allh 'nhma laa tadfinniy ma'ahum waadfinniy ma'a sawaahibiy bialbaqiy'i, laa auzakkaa bihi aabadana‏.‏
verses.translation: Aisha narrated that she made a will to `Abdullah bin Zubair, "Do not bury me with them (the Prophet (ﷺ) and his two companions) but bury me with my companions (wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) in Al-Baqi as I would not like to be looked upon as better than I really am (by being buried near the Prophet)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ الأَوْدِيِّ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، اذْهَبْ إِلَى أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَقُلْ يَقْرَأُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ عَلَيْكِ السَّلاَمَ، ثُمَّ سَلْهَا أَنْ أُدْفَنَ مَعَ صَاحِبَىَّ‏.‏ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أُرِيدُهُ لِنَفْسِي، فَلأُوثِرَنَّهُ الْيَوْمَ عَلَى نَفْسِي‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَقْبَلَ قَالَ لَهُ مَا لَدَيْكَ قَالَ أَذِنَتْ لَكَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا كَانَ شَىْءٌ أَهَمَّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْمَضْجَعِ، فَإِذَا قُبِضْتُ فَاحْمِلُونِي ثُمَّ سَلِّمُوا ثُمَّ قُلْ يَسْتَأْذِنُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ‏.‏ فَإِنْ أَذِنَتْ لِي فَادْفِنُونِي، وَإِلاَّ فَرُدُّونِي إِلَى مَقَابِرِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، إِنِّي لاَ أَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا أَحَقَّ بِهَذَا الأَمْرِ مِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ النَّفَرِ الَّذِينَ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ عَنْهُمْ رَاضٍ، فَمَنِ اسْتَخْلَفُوا بَعْدِي فَهُوَ الْخَلِيفَةُ، فَاسْمَعُوا لَهُ وَأَطِيعُوا‏.‏ فَسَمَّى عُثْمَانَ وَعَلِيًّا وَطَلْحَةَ وَالزُّبَيْرَ وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ وَسَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، وَوَلَجَ عَلَيْهِ شَابٌّ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ أَبْشِرْ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِبُشْرَى اللَّهِ، كَانَ لَكَ مِنَ الْقَدَمِ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ مَا قَدْ عَلِمْتَ، ثُمَّ اسْتُخْلِفْتَ فَعَدَلْتَ، ثُمَّ الشَّهَادَةُ بَعْدَ هَذَا كُلِّهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَيْتَنِي يَا ابْنَ أَخِي وَذَلِكَ كَفَافًا لاَ عَلَىَّ وَلاَ لِي أُوصِي الْخَلِيفَةَ مِنْ بَعْدِي بِالْمُهَاجِرِينَ الأَوَّلِينَ خَيْرًا، أَنْ يَعْرِفَ لَهُمْ حَقَّهُمْ، وَأَنْ يَحْفَظَ لَهُمْ حُرْمَتَهُمْ، وَأُوصِيهِ بِالأَنْصَارِ خَيْرًا الَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُوا الدَّارَ وَالإِيمَانَ أَنْ يُقْبَلَ مِنْ مُحْسِنِهِمْ، وَيُعْفَى عَنْ مُسِيئِهِمْ، وَأُوصِيهِ بِذِمَّةِ اللَّهِ وَذِمَّةِ رَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُوفَى لَهُمْ بِعَهْدِهِمْ، وَأَنْ يُقَاتَلَ مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ، وَأَنْ لاَ يُكَلَّفُوا فَوْقَ طَاقَتِهِمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa jariyru bnu 'abdi alhamiydi, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'amriw bni maymuwnin alaawdiyyi, qaala raaaytu 'umara bna alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh qaala yaa 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, adhhab iilaa aummi almuuminiyna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha faqul yaqraau 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi 'alayki alssalaama, thumma salhaa aan audfana ma'a saahibaaaa‏.‏ qaalat kuntu auriyduhu linafsiy, falauwthirannahu alyawma 'alaa nafsiy‏.‏ falammaa aaqbala qaala lahu maa ladayka qaala aadhinat laka yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna‏.‏ qaala maa kaana shaa'un aahamma iilaaaa min dhalika almadja'i, faiidhaa qubidtu faahmiluwniy thumma sallimuwa thumma qul yastaadhinu 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi‏.‏ faiin aadhinat liy faadfinuwniy, waiilaaa farudduwniy iilaa maqaabiri almuslimiyna, iinniy laa aa'lamu aahadana aahaqqa bihadhaa alaamri min hauulaa'i alnnafari alladhiyna tuwuffiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa 'anhum raadin, famani astakhlafuwa ba'diy fahuwa alkhaliyfaau, faasma'uwa lahu waaatiy'uwa‏.‏ fasammaa 'uthmaana wa'aliyyana watalhaaa waalzzubayra wa'abda alrrahmani bna 'awfin wasa'da bna aabiy waqqaasin, wawalaja 'alayhi shaabbun mina alaansaari faqaala aabshir yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna bibushraa alllahi, kaana laka mina alqadami fiy aliislaami maa qad 'alimta, thumma astukhlifta fa'adalta, thumma alshhahaadaau ba'da hadhaa kullihi‏.‏ faqaala laytaniy yaa abna aakhiy wadhalika kafaafana laa 'alaaaa walaa liy auwsiy alkhaliyfaaa min ba'diy bialmuhaajiriyna alaawwaliyna khayrana, aan ya'rifa lahum haqqahum, waaan yahfaza lahum hurmatahum, waauwsiyhi bialaansaari khayrana alladhiyna tabawwa'uwa alddaara waaliiymaana aan yuqbala min muhsinihim, wayu'faa 'an musiyiihim, waauwsiyhi bidhimmaai alllahi wadhimmaai rasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuwfaa lahum bi'ahdihim, waaan yuqaatala min waraaiihim, waaan laa yukallafuwa fawqa taaqatihim‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun Al-Audi:I saw `Umar bin Al-Khattab (when he was stabbed) saying, "O `Abdullah bin `Umar! Go to the mother of the believers Aisha and say, `Umar bin Al-Khattab sends his greetings to you,' and request her to allow me to be buried with my companions."
