(So, Ibn `Umar conveyed the message to `Aisha.) She said, "I had the idea of having this place for myself but today I prefer him (`Umar) to myself (and allow him to be buried there)." When `Abdullah bin `Umar returned, `Umar asked him, "What (news) do you have?" He replied, "O chief of the believers! She has allowed you (to be buried there)." On that `Umar said, "Nothing was more important to me than to be buried in that (sacred) place. So, when I expire, carry me there and pay my greetings to her (`Aisha ) and say, `Umar bin Al-Khattab asks permission; and if she gives permission, then bury me (there) and if she does not, then take me to the graveyard of the Muslims. I do not think any person has more right for the caliphate than those with whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was always pleased till his death. And whoever is chosen by the people after me will be the caliph, and you people must listen to him and obey him," and then he mentioned the name of `Uthman, `Ali, Talha, Az-Zubair, `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf and Sa`d bin Abi Waqqas. By this time a young man from Ansar came and said, "O chief of the believers! Be happy with Allah's glad tidings. The grade which you have in Islam is known to you, then you became the caliph and you ruled with justice and then you have been awarded martyrdom after all this." `Umar replied, "O son of my brother! Would that all that privileges will counterbalance (my short comings), so that I neither lose nor gain anything. I recommend my successor to be good to the early emigrants and realize their rights and to protect their honor and sacred things. And I also recommend him to be good to the Ansar who before them, had homes (in Medina) and had adopted the Faith. He should accept the good of the righteous among them and should excuse their wrongdoers. I recommend him to abide by the rules and regulations concerning the Dhimmis (protectees) of Allah and His Apostle, to fulfill their contracts completely and fight for them and not to tax (overburden) them beyond their capabilities
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَسُبُّوا الأَمْوَاتَ فَإِنَّهُمْ قَدْ أَفْضَوْا إِلَى مَا قَدَّمُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْقُدُّوسِ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ وَابْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ وَابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tasubbuwa alaamwaata faiinnahum qad aafdawa iilaa maa qaddamuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ warawaahu 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alqudduwsi 'ani alaa'mashi, wamuhammadu bnu aanasin 'ani alaa'mashi‏.‏ taaba'ahu 'aliyyu bnu alja'di waabnu 'ar'araaa waabnu aabiy 'adiyyin 'an shu'baaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Don't abuse the dead, because they have reached the result of what they forwarded
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو لَهَبٍ ـ عَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ ـ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَبًّا لَكَ سَائِرَ الْيَوْمِ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathaniy 'amruw bnu murraaa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala aabuw lahabin 'alayhi la'naau alllahi lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm tabbana laka saaiira alyawmi‏.‏ fanazalat ‏{‏tabbat yadaa aabiy lahabin watabba‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas.:Abu Lahab, may Allah curse him, once said to the Prophet (ﷺ), "Perish you all the day." Then the Divine Inspiration came: "Perish the hands of Abi Lahab! And perish he
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَيْفِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْبَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ مُعَاذًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ إِلَى الْيَمَنِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ ادْعُهُمْ إِلَى شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ هُمْ أَطَاعُوا لِذَلِكَ فَأَعْلِمْهُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدِ افْتَرَضَ عَلَيْهِمْ خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ، فَإِنْ هُمْ أَطَاعُوا لِذَلِكَ فَأَعْلِمْهُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ افْتَرَضَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَدَقَةً فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ، تُؤْخَذُ مِنْ أَغْنِيَائِهِمْ وَتُرَدُّ عَلَى فُقَرَائِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin alddahhaaku bnu makhladin, 'an zakariyyaa'a bni iishaaqa, 'an yahyaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni sayfiyyin, 'an aabiy ma'badin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'atha mu'aadhana rda allh 'nh iilaa alyamani faqaala ‏ "‏ ad'uhum iilaa shahaadaai aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu, waaanniy rasuwlu alllahi, faiin hum aataa'uwa lidhalika faaa'limhum aanna alllaha qadi aftarada 'alayhim khamsa salawaatin fiy kulli yawmin walaylaain, faiin hum aataa'uwa lidhalika faaa'limhum aanna alllaha aftarada 'alayhim sadaqaaan fiy aamwaalihim, tuukhadhu min aaghniyaaiihim waturaddu 'alaa fuqaraaiihim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent Mu`adh to Yemen and said, "Invite the people to testify that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and I am Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and if they obey you to do so, then teach them that Allah has enjoined on them five prayers in every day and night (in twenty-four hours), and if they obey you to do so, then teach them that Allah has made it obligatory for them to pay the Zakat from their property and it is to be taken from the wealthy among them and given to the poor
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، رضى الله عنه أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبِرْنِي بِعَمَلٍ يُدْخِلُنِي الْجَنَّةَ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا لَهُ مَا لَهُ وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَرَبٌ مَالَهُ، تَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ، وَلاَ تُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا، وَتُقِيمُ الصَّلاَةَ، وَتُؤْتِي الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَهْزٌ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، وَأَبُوهُ، عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا مُوسَى بْنَ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَخْشَى أَنْ يَكُونَ، مُحَمَّدٌ غَيْرَ مَحْفُوظٍ إِنَّمَا هُوَ عَمْرٌو‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hafsu bnu 'umara, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani abni 'uthmaana bni 'abdi alllahi bni mawhabin, 'an muwsaa bni talhaaa, 'an aabiy aayyuwba, rda allh 'nh aanna rajulaan, qaala lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbirniy bi'amalin yudkhiluniy aljannaaa‏.‏ qaala maa lahu maa lahu waqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aarabun maalahu, ta'budu alllaha, walaa tushriku bihi shayiana, watuqiymu alssalaaaa, watuutiy alzzakaaaa, watasilu alrrahima ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala bahzun haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'uthmaana, waaabuwhu, 'uthmaanu bnu 'abdi alllahi aannahumaa sami'aa muwsaa bna talhaaa, 'an aabiy aayyuwba, bihadhaa‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi aakhshaa aan yakuwna, muhammadun ghayra mahfuwzin iinnamaa huwa 'amrunw‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Aiyub:A man said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "Tell me of such a deed as will make me enter Paradise." The people said, "What is the matter with him? What is the matter with him?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He has something to ask. (What he needs greatly) The Prophet (ﷺ) said: (In order to enter Paradise) you should worship Allah and do not ascribe any partners to Him, offer prayer perfectly, pay the Zakat and keep good relations with your Kith and kin." (See Hadith No. 12, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ دُلَّنِي عَلَى عَمَلٍ إِذَا عَمِلْتُهُ دَخَلْتُ الْجَنَّةَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ لاَ تُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا، وَتُقِيمُ الصَّلاَةَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ، وَتُؤَدِّي الزَّكَاةَ الْمَفْرُوضَةَ، وَتَصُومُ رَمَضَانَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ أَزِيدُ عَلَى هَذَا‏.‏ فَلَمَّا وَلَّى قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَلْيَنْظُرْ إِلَى هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, haddathanaa 'affaanu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydi bni hayyaana, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna aa'raabiyyana, aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala dullaniy 'alaa 'amalin iidhaa 'amiltuhu dakhaltu aljannaaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ ta'budu alllaha laa tushriku bihi shayiana, watuqiymu alssalaaaa almaktuwbaaa, watuuaddiy alzzakaaaa almafruwdaaa, watasuwmu ramadaana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laa aaziydu 'alaa hadhaa‏.‏ falammaa wallaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man sarrahu aan yanzura iilaa rajulin min aahli aljannaai falyanzur iilaa hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ haddathanaa musaddadun, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy hayyaana, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw zur'aaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A Bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Tell me of such a deed as will make me enter Paradise, if I do it." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Worship Allah, and worship none along with Him, offer the (five) prescribed compulsory prayers perfectly, pay the compulsory Zakat, and fast the month of Ramadan." The Bedouin said, "By Him, in Whose Hands my life is, I will not do more than this." When he (the Bedouin) left, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Whoever likes to see a man of Paradise, then he may look at this man." Narrated Abu Zur'a: From the Prophet (ﷺ) the same as above
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَمْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ قَدِمَ وَفْدُ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ هَذَا الْحَىَّ مِنْ رَبِيعَةَ قَدْ حَالَتْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ كُفَّارُ مُضَرَ، وَلَسْنَا نَخْلُصُ إِلَيْكَ إِلاَّ فِي الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ، فَمُرْنَا بِشَىْءٍ نَأْخُذُهُ عَنْكَ، وَنَدْعُو إِلَيْهِ مَنْ وَرَاءَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ آمُرُكُمْ بِأَرْبَعٍ، وَأَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ أَرْبَعٍ الإِيمَانِ بِاللَّهِ وَشَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ـ وَعَقَدَ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا ـ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَأَنْ تُؤَدُّوا خُمُسَ مَا غَنِمْتُمْ، وَأَنْهَاكُمْ عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَأَبُو النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ ‏"‏ الإِيمَانِ بِاللَّهِ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaajun, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa aabuw jamraaa, qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu qadima wafdu 'abdi alqaysi 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna hadhaa alhaaaa min rabiy'aaa qad haalat baynanaa wabaynaka kuffaaru mudara, walasnaa nakhlusu iilayka iilaaa fiy alshhahri alharaami, famurnaa bishaa'in naakhudhuhu 'anka, wanad'uw iilayhi man waraa'anaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ amurukum biaarba'in, waaanhaakum 'an aarba'in aliiymaani bialllahi washahaadaai aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wa'aqada biyadihi hakadhaa waiiqaami alssalaaai, waiiytaa'i alzzakaaai, waaan tuuadduwa khumusa maa ghanimtum, waaanhaakum 'ani alddubbaa'i waalhantami waalnnaqiyri waalmuzaffati ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala sulaymaanu waaabuw alnnu'maani 'an hammaadin ‏"‏ aliiymaani bialllahi shahaadaai aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A delegation of the tribe of `Abdul Qais came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! We are from the tribe of Rabi`a, and the infidels of the tribe of Mudar stand between us and you; so we cannot come to you except during the Sacred Months. Please order us to do something (religious deeds) which we may carry out and also invite to it our people whom we have left behind." The Prophet said, "I order you to do four things and forbid you four others: (I order you) to have faith in Allah, and confess that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, (and the Prophet (ﷺ) gestured with his hand like this (i.e. one knot) and to offer prayers perfectly and to pay the Zakat, and to pay one-fifth of the booty in Allah's Cause. And I forbid you to use Dubba', Hantam, Naqir and Muzaffat (all these are the names of utensils used for preparing alcoholic drinks)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَكَفَرَ مَنْ كَفَرَ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه كَيْفَ تُقَاتِلُ النَّاسَ، وَقَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَقُولُوا لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَمَنْ قَالَهَا فَقَدْ عَصَمَ مِنِّي مَالَهُ وَنَفْسَهُ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّهِ، وَحِسَابُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لأُقَاتِلَنَّ مَنْ فَرَّقَ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ، فَإِنَّ الزَّكَاةَ حَقُّ الْمَالِ، وَاللَّهِ لَوْ مَنَعُونِي عَنَاقًا كَانُوا يُؤَدُّونَهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَقَاتَلْتُهُمْ عَلَى مَنْعِهَا‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا هُوَ إِلاَّ أَنْ قَدْ شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani alhakamu bnu naafi'in, aakhbaranaa shu'aybu bnu aabiy hamzaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa tuwuffiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh wakafara man kafara mina al'arabi faqaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh kayfa tuqaatilu alnnaasa, waqad qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aumirtu aan auqaatila alnnaasa hattaa yaquwluwa laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu‏.‏ faman qaalahaa faqad 'asama minniy maalahu wanafsahu iilaaa bihaqqihi, wahisaabuhu 'alaa alllahi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala waalllahi lauqaatilanna man farraqa bayna alssalaaai waalzzakaaai, faiinna alzzakaaaa haqqu almaali, waalllahi law mana'uwniy 'anaaqana kaanuwa yuuadduwnahaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laqaataltuhum 'alaa man'ihaa‏.‏ qaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh fawaalllahi maa huwa iilaaa aan qad sharaha alllahu sadra aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nh fa'araftu aannahu alhaqqu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died and Abu Bakr became the caliph some Arabs renegade (reverted to disbelief) (Abu Bakr decided to declare war against them), `Umar, said to Abu Bakr, "How can you fight with these people although Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'I have been ordered (by Allah) to fight the people till they say: "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and whoever said it then he will save his life and property from me except on trespassing the law (rights and conditions for which he will be punished justly), and his accounts will be with Allah.' " Abu Bakr said, "By Allah! I will fight those who differentiate between the prayer and the Zakat as Zakat is the compulsory right to be taken from the property (according to Allah's orders) By Allah! If they refuse to pay me even a she-kid which they used to pay at the time of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . I would fight with them for withholding it" Then `Umar said, "By Allah, it was nothing, but Allah opened Abu Bakr's chest towards the decision (to fight) and I came to know that his decision was right
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بَايَعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى إِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَالنُّصْحِ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an qaysin, qaala qaala jariyru bnu 'abdi alllahi baaya'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa iiqaami alssalaaai, waiiytaa'i alzzakaaai, waalnnushi likulli muslimin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jarir bin `Abdullah:I gave the pledge of allegiance to the Prophet (ﷺ) for offering prayer perfectly, giving Zakat, and giving good advice to every Muslim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ هُرْمُزَ الأَعْرَجَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَأْتِي الإِبِلُ عَلَى صَاحِبِهَا، عَلَى خَيْرِ مَا كَانَتْ، إِذَا هُوَ لَمْ يُعْطِ فِيهَا حَقَّهَا، تَطَؤُهُ بِأَخْفَافِهَا، وَتَأْتِي الْغَنَمُ عَلَى صَاحِبِهَا عَلَى خَيْرِ مَا كَانَتْ، إِذَا لَمْ يُعْطِ فِيهَا حَقَّهَا، تَطَؤُهُ بِأَظْلاَفِهَا، وَتَنْطَحُهُ بِقُرُونِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَمِنْ حَقِّهَا أَنْ تُحْلَبَ عَلَى الْمَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ يَأْتِي أَحَدُكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِشَاةٍ يَحْمِلُهَا عَلَى رَقَبَتِهِ لَهَا يُعَارٌ، فَيَقُولُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ لاَ أَمْلِكُ لَكَ شَيْئًا قَدْ بَلَّغْتُ‏.‏ وَلاَ يَأْتِي بِبَعِيرٍ، يَحْمِلُهُ عَلَى رَقَبَتِهِ لَهُ رُغَاءٌ، فَيَقُولُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ لاَ أَمْلِكُ لَكَ شَيْئًا قَدْ بَلَّغْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhakamu bnu naafi'in, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna hurmuza alaa'raja, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh yaquwlu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ taatiy aliibilu 'alaa saahibihaa, 'alaa khayri maa kaanat, iidhaa huwa lam yu'ti fiyhaa haqqahaa, tatauuhu biaakhfaafihaa, wataatiy alghanamu 'alaa saahibihaa 'alaa khayri maa kaanat, iidhaa lam yu'ti fiyhaa haqqahaa, tatauuhu biaazlaafihaa, watantahuhu biquruwnihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ wamin haqqihaa aan tuhlaba 'alaa almaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ walaa yaatiy aahadukum yawma alqiyaamaai bishaaain yahmiluhaa 'alaa raqabatihi lahaa yu'aarun, fayaquwlu yaa muhammadu‏.‏ faaaquwlu laa aamliku laka shayiana qad ballaghtu‏.‏ walaa yaatiy biba'iyrin, yahmiluhu 'alaa raqabatihi lahu rughaa'un, fayaquwlu yaa muhammadu‏.‏ faaaquwlu laa aamliku laka shayiana qad ballaghtu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "(On the Day of Resurrection) camels will come to their owner in the best state of health they have ever had (in the world), and if he had not paid their Zakat (in the world) then they would tread him with their feet; and similarly, sheep will come to their owner in the best state of health they have ever had in the world, and if he had not paid their Zakat, then they would tread him with their hooves and would butt him with their horns." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "One of their rights is that they should be milked while water is kept in front of them." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "I do not want anyone of you to come to me on the Day of Resurrection, carrying over his neck a sheep that will be bleating. Such a person will (then) say, 'O Muhammad! (please intercede for me,) I will say to him. 'I can't help you, for I conveyed Allah's Message to you.' Similarly, I do not want anyone of you to come to me carrying over his neck a camel that will be grunting. Such a person (then) will say "O Muhammad! (please intercede for me)." I will say to him, "I can't help you for I conveyed Allah's message to you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً، فَلَمْ يُؤَدِّ زَكَاتَهُ مُثِّلَ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شُجَاعًا أَقْرَعَ، لَهُ زَبِيبَتَانِ، يُطَوَّقُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ بِلِهْزِمَتَيْهِ ـ يَعْنِي شِدْقَيْهِ ـ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا مَالُكَ، أَنَا كَنْزُكَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ تَلاَ ‏{‏لاَ يَحْسِبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa haashimu bnu alqaasimi, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy saalihin alssammaani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man ataahu alllahu maalaan, falam yuuaddi zakaatahu muthhila lahu yawma alqiyaamaai shujaa'ana aaqra'a, lahu zabiybataani, yutawwaquhu yawma alqiyaamaai, thumma yaakhudhu bilihzimatayhi ya'niy shidqayhi thumma yaquwlu aanaa maaluka, aanaa kanzuka ‏"‏ thumma talaa ‏{‏laa yahsibanna alladhiyna yabkhaluwna‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Whoever is made wealthy by Allah and does not pay the Zakat of his wealth, then on the Day of Resurrection his wealth will be made like a baldheaded poisonous male snake with two black spots over the eyes. The snake will encircle his neck and bite his cheeks and say, 'I am your wealth, I am your treasure.' " Then the Prophet (ﷺ) recited the holy verses:-- 'Let not those who withhold . . .' (to the end of the verse)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ شَبِيبِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فَقَالَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ أَخْبِرْنِي قَوْلَ اللَّهِ، ‏{‏وَالَّذِينَ يَكْنِزُونَ الذَّهَبَ وَالْفِضَّةَ وَلاَ يُنْفِقُونَهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ‏}‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ مَنْ كَنَزَهَا فَلَمْ يُؤَدِّ زَكَاتَهَا فَوَيْلٌ لَهُ، إِنَّمَا كَانَ هَذَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُنْزَلَ الزَّكَاةُ فَلَمَّا أُنْزِلَتْ جَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ طُهْرًا لِلأَمْوَالِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala aahmadu bnu shabiybi bni sa'iydin haddathanaa aabiy, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an khaalidi bni aaslama, qaala kharajnaa ma'a 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma faqaala aa'raabiyyun aakhbirniy qawla alllahi, ‏{‏waalladhiyna yaknizuwna aldhhahaba waalfiddaaa walaa yunfiquwnahaa fiy sabiyli alllahi‏}‏ qaala abnu 'umara rda allh 'nhma man kanazahaa falam yuuaddi zakaatahaa fawaylun lahu, iinnamaa kaana hadhaa qabla aan tunzala alzzakaaau falammaa aunzilat ja'alahaa alllahu tuhrana lilaamwaali‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Khalid bin Aslam:We went out with 'Abdullah bin 'Umar and a bedouin said (to 'Abdullah), "Tell me about Allah's saying: "And those who hoard up gold and silver (Al-Kanz - money, gold, silver etc., the Zakat of which has not been paid) and spend it not in the Way of Allah (V.9:34)." Ibn 'Umar said, "Whoever hoarded them and did not pay the Zakat thereof, then woe to him. But these holy Verses were revealed before the Verses of Zakat. So when the Verses of Zakat were revealed, Allah made Zakat a purifier of the property
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ الأَوْزَاعِيُّ أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُمَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، يَحْيَى بْنِ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ أَوَاقٍ صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ ذَوْدٍ صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu yaziyda, aakhbaranaa shu'aybu bnu iishaaqa, qaala alaawzaa'iyyu aakhbaraniy yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, aanna 'amraw bna yahyaa bni 'umaaraaa, aakhbarahu 'an aabiyhi, yahyaa bni 'umaaraaa bni aabiy alhasani aannahu sami'a aabaa sa'iydin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laysa fiymaa duwna khamsi aawaaqin sadaqaaun, walaysa fiymaa duwna khamsi dhawdin sadaqaaun, walaysa fiymaa duwna khamsi aawsuqin sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No Zakat is due on property mounting to less than five Uqiyas (of silver), and no Zakat is due on less than five camels, and there is no Zakat on less than five Wasqs." (A Wasqs equals 60 Sa's) & (1 Sa=3 K gms App)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، سَمِعَ هُشَيْمًا، أَخْبَرَنَا حُصَيْنٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ مَرَرْتُ بِالرَّبَذَةِ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِأَبِي، ذَرٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ مَا أَنْزَلَكَ مَنْزِلَكَ هَذَا قَالَ كُنْتُ بِالشَّأْمِ، فَاخْتَلَفْتُ أَنَا وَمُعَاوِيَةُ فِي الَّذِينَ يَكْنِزُونَ الذَّهَبَ وَالْفِضَّةَ وَلاَ يُنْفِقُونَهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ نَزَلَتْ فِي أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَزَلَتْ فِينَا وَفِيهِمْ‏.‏ فَكَانَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ فِي ذَاكَ، وَكَتَبَ إِلَى عُثْمَانَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَشْكُونِي، فَكَتَبَ إِلَىَّ عُثْمَانُ أَنِ اقْدَمِ الْمَدِينَةَ‏.‏ فَقَدِمْتُهَا فَكَثُرَ عَلَىَّ النَّاسُ حَتَّى كَأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَرَوْنِي قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَاكَ لِعُثْمَانَ فَقَالَ لِي إِنْ شِئْتَ تَنَحَّيْتَ فَكُنْتَ قَرِيبًا‏.‏ فَذَاكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَنِي هَذَا الْمَنْزِلَ، وَلَوْ أَمَّرُوا عَلَىَّ حَبَشِيًّا لَسَمِعْتُ وَأَطَعْتُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, sami'a hushaymana, aakhbaranaa husaynun, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, qaala marartu bialrrabadhaai faiidhaa aanaa biaabiy, dharrin rda allh 'nh faqultu lahu maa aanzalaka manzilaka hadhaa qaala kuntu bialshhaami, faakhtalaftu aanaa wamu'aawiyaau fiy alladhiyna yaknizuwna aldhhahaba waalfiddaaa walaa yunfiquwnahaa fiy sabiyli alllahi‏.‏ qaala mu'aawiyaau nazalat fiy aahli alkitaabi‏.‏ faqultu nazalat fiynaa wafiyhim‏.‏ fakaana bayniy wabaynahu fiy dhaaka, wakataba iilaa 'uthmaana rda allh 'nh yashkuwniy, fakataba iilaaaa 'uthmaanu aani aqdami almadiynaaa‏.‏ faqadimtuhaa fakathura 'alaaaa alnnaasu hattaa kaaannahum lam yarawniy qabla dhalika, fadhakartu dhaaka li'uthmaana faqaala liy iin shiita tanahhayta fakunta qariybana‏.‏ fadhaaka alladhiy aanzalaniy hadhaa almanzila, walaw aammaruwa 'alaaaa habashiyyana lasami'tu waaata'tu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zaid bin Wahab:I passed by a place called Ar-Rabadha and by chance I met Abu Dhar and asked him, "What has brought you to this place?" He said, "I was in Sham and differed with Muawiya on the meaning of (the following verses of the Qur'an): 'They who hoard up gold and silver and spend them not in the way of Allah.' (9.34). Muawiya said, 'This verse is revealed regarding the people of the scriptures." I said, It was revealed regarding us and also the people of the scriptures." So we had a quarrel and Mu'awiya sent a complaint against me to `Uthman. `Uthman wrote to me to come to Medina, and I came to Medina. Many people came to me as if they had not seen me before. So I told this to `Uthman who said to me, "You may depart and live nearby if you wish." That was the reason for my being here for even if an Ethiopian had been nominated as my ruler, I would have obeyed him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلاَءِ، عَنِ الأَحْنَفِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ جَلَسْتُ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْعَلاَءِ بْنُ الشِّخِّيرِ، أَنَّ الأَحْنَفَ بْنَ قَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَهُمْ قَالَ جَلَسْتُ إِلَى مَلإٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ خَشِنُ الشَّعَرِ وَالثِّيَابِ وَالْهَيْئَةِ حَتَّى قَامَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ قَالَ بَشِّرِ الْكَانِزِينَ بِرَضْفٍ يُحْمَى عَلَيْهِ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ، ثُمَّ يُوضَعُ عَلَى حَلَمَةِ ثَدْىِ أَحَدِهِمْ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ مِنْ نُغْضِ كَتِفِهِ، وَيُوضَعُ عَلَى نُغْضِ كَتِفِهِ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ مِنْ حَلَمَةِ ثَدْيِهِ يَتَزَلْزَلُ، ثُمَّ وَلَّى فَجَلَسَ إِلَى سَارِيَةٍ، وَتَبِعْتُهُ وَجَلَسْتُ إِلَيْهِ، وَأَنَا لاَ أَدْرِي مَنْ هُوَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ لاَ أُرَى الْقَوْمَ إِلاَّ قَدْ كَرِهُوا الَّذِي قُلْتَ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهُمْ لاَ يَعْقِلُونَ شَيْئًا‏.‏ قَالَ لِي خَلِيلِي ـ قَالَ قُلْتُ مَنْ خَلِيلُكَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ أَتُبْصِرُ أُحُدًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى الشَّمْسِ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ النَّهَارِ وَأَنَا أُرَى أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُرْسِلُنِي فِي حَاجَةٍ لَهُ، قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنَّ لِي مِثْلَ أُحُدٍ ذَهَبًا أُنْفِقُهُ كُلَّهُ إِلاَّ ثَلاَثَةَ دَنَانِيرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَإِنَّ هَؤُلاَءِ لاَ يَعْقِلُونَ، إِنَّمَا يَجْمَعُونَ الدُّنْيَا‏.‏ لاَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَسْأَلُهُمْ دُنْيَا، وَلاَ أَسْتَفْتِيهِمْ عَنْ دِينٍ حَتَّى أَلْقَى اللَّهَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ayyaashun, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa aljurayriyyu, 'an aabiy al'alaa'i, 'ani alaahnafi bni qaysin, qaala jalastu‏.‏ wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alssamadi, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa aljurayriyyu, haddathanaa aabuw al'alaa'i bnu alshhikhhiyri, aanna alaahnafa bna qaysin, haddathahum qaala jalastu iilaa maliin min qurayshin, fajaa'a rajulun khashinu alshha'ari waalthhiyaabi waalhayiaai hattaa qaama 'alayhim fasallama thumma qaala bashhiri alkaaniziyna biradfin yuhmaa 'alayhi fiy naari jahannama, thumma yuwda'u 'alaa halamaai thadai aahadihim hattaa yakhruja min nughdi katifihi, wayuwda'u 'alaa nughdi katifihi hattaa yakhruja min halamaai thadyihi yatazalzalu, thumma wallaa fajalasa iilaa saariyaain, watabi'tuhu wajalastu iilayhi, waaanaa laa aadriy man huwa faqultu lahu laa auraa alqawma iilaaa qad karihuwa alladhiy qulta‏.‏ qaala iinnahum laa ya'qiluwna shayiana‏.‏ qaala liy khaliyliy qaala qultu man khaliyluka qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa aabaa dharrin aatubsiru auhudana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fanazartu iilaa alshhamsi maa baqiya mina alnnahaari waaanaa auraa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yursiluniy fiy haajaain lahu, qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ maa auhibbu aanna liy mithla auhudin dhahabana aunfiquhu kullahu iilaaa thalaathaaa danaaniyra ‏"‏‏.‏ waiinna hauulaa'i laa ya'qiluwna, iinnamaa yajma'uwna alddunyaa‏.‏ laa waalllahi laa aasaaluhum dunyaa, walaa aastaftiyhim 'an diynin hattaa aalqaa alllaha‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Ahnaf bin Qais:While I was sitting with some people from Quraish, a man with very rough hair, clothes, and appearance came and stood in front of us, greeted us and said, "Inform those who hoard wealth, that a stone will be heated in the Hell-fire and will be put on the nipples of their breasts till it comes out from the bones of their shoulders and then put on the bones of their shoulders till it comes through the nipples of their breasts the stone will be moving and hitting." After saying that, the person retreated and sat by the side of the pillar, I followed him and sat beside him, and I did not know who he was. I said to him, "I think the people disliked what you had said." He said, "These people do not understand anything, although my friend told me." I asked, "Who is your friend?" He said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to me), 'O Abu Dhar! Do you see the mountain of Uhud?' And on that I (Abu Dhar) started looking towards the sun to judge how much remained of the day as I thought that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wanted to send me to do something for him and I said, 'Yes!' He said, 'I do not love to have gold equal to the mountain of Uhud unless I spend it all (in Allah's cause) except three Dinars (pounds). These people do not understand and collect worldly wealth. No, by Allah, Neither I ask them for worldly benefits nor am I in need of their religious advice till I meet Allah, The Honorable, The Majestic
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي قَيْسٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ حَسَدَ إِلاَّ فِي اثْنَتَيْنِ رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مَالاً فَسَلَّطَهُ عَلَى هَلَكَتِهِ فِي الْحَقِّ، وَرَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ حِكْمَةً فَهْوَ يَقْضِي بِهَا وَيُعَلِّمُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an iismaa'iyla, qaala haddathaniy qaysun, 'ani abni mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa hasada iilaaa fiy athnatayni rajulun ataahu alllahu maalaan fasallatahu 'alaa halakatihi fiy alhaqqi, warajulun ataahu alllahu hikmaaan fahwa yaqdiy bihaa wayu'allimuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "There is no envy except in two: a person whom Allah has given wealth and he spends it in the right way, and a person whom Allah has given wisdom (i.e. religious knowledge) and he gives his decisions accordingly and teaches it to the others
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُنِيرٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ـ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِعَدْلِ تَمْرَةٍ مِنْ كَسْبٍ طَيِّبٍ ـ وَلاَ يَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ الطَّيِّبَ ـ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَتَقَبَّلُهَا بِيَمِينِهِ، ثُمَّ يُرَبِّيهَا لِصَاحِبِهِ كَمَا يُرَبِّي أَحَدُكُمْ فَلُوَّهُ حَتَّى تَكُونَ مِثْلَ الْجَبَلِ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ سُلَيْمَانُ عَنِ ابْنِ دِينَارٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَرْقَاءُ عَنِ ابْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ مُسْلِمُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ وَسُهَيْلٌ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muniyrin, sami'a aabaa alnnadri, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani huwa abnu 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man tasaddaqa bi'adli tamraain min kasbin tayyibin walaa yaqbalu alllahu iilaaa alttayyiba waiinna alllaha yataqabbaluhaa biyamiynihi, thumma yurabbiyhaa lisaahibihi kamaa yurabbiy aahadukum faluwwahu hattaa takuwna mithla aljabali ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu sulaymaanu 'ani abni diynaarin‏.‏ waqaala warqaa'u 'ani abni diynaarin, 'an sa'iydi bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ warawaahu muslimu bnu aabiy maryama wazaydu bnu aaslama wasuhaylun 'an aabiy saalihin 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If one gives in charity what equals one date-fruit from the honestly earned money and Allah accepts only the honestly earned money --Allah takes it in His right (hand) and then enlarges its reward for that person (who has given it), as anyone of you brings up his baby horse, so much so that it becomes as big as a mountain
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْبَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حَارِثَةَ بْنَ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ تَصَدَّقُوا فَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِي عَلَيْكُمْ زَمَانٌ يَمْشِي الرَّجُلُ بِصَدَقَتِهِ، فَلاَ يَجِدُ مَنْ يَقْبَلُهَا يَقُولُ الرَّجُلُ لَوْ جِئْتَ بِهَا بِالأَمْسِ لَقَبِلْتُهَا، فَأَمَّا الْيَوْمَ فَلاَ حَاجَةَ لِي بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa ma'badu bnu khaalidin, qaala sami'tu haarithaaa bna wahbin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ tasaddaquwa faiinnahu yaatiy 'alaykum zamaanun yamshiy alrrajulu bisadaqatihi, falaa yajidu man yaqbaluhaa yaquwlu alrrajulu law jiita bihaa bialaamsi laqabiltuhaa, faaammaa alyawma falaa haajaaa liy bihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Haritha bin Wahab:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "O people! Give in charity as a time will come upon you when a person will wander about with his object of charity and will not find anybody to accept it, and one (who will be requested to take it) will say, "If you had brought it yesterday, would have taken it, but today I am not in need of it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَكْثُرَ فِيكُمُ الْمَالُ فَيَفِيضَ، حَتَّى يُهِمَّ رَبَّ الْمَالِ مَنْ يَقْبَلُ صَدَقَتَهُ، وَحَتَّى يَعْرِضَهُ فَيَقُولَ الَّذِي يَعْرِضُهُ عَلَيْهِ لاَ أَرَبَ لِي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa yakthura fiykumu almaalu fayafiyda, hattaa yuhimma rabba almaali man yaqbalu sadaqatahu, wahattaa ya'ridahu fayaquwla alladhiy ya'riduhu 'alayhi laa aaraba liy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The Hour (Day of Judgment) will not be established till your wealth increases so much so that one will be worried, for no one will accept his Zakat and the person to whom he will give it will reply, 'I am not in need of it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ النَّبِيلُ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَعْدَانُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُجَاهِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحِلُّ بْنُ خَلِيفَةَ الطَّائِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَهُ رَجُلاَنِ أَحَدُهُمَا يَشْكُو الْعَيْلَةَ، وَالآخَرُ يَشْكُو قَطْعَ السَّبِيلِ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَمَّا قَطْعُ السَّبِيلِ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَأْتِي عَلَيْكَ إِلاَّ قَلِيلٌ حَتَّى تَخْرُجَ الْعِيرُ إِلَى مَكَّةَ بِغَيْرِ خَفِيرٍ، وَأَمَّا الْعَيْلَةُ فَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لاَ تَقُومُ حَتَّى يَطُوفَ أَحَدُكُمْ بِصَدَقَتِهِ لاَ يَجِدُ مَنْ يَقْبَلُهَا مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ لَيَقِفَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ اللَّهِ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُ حِجَابٌ وَلاَ تُرْجُمَانٌ يُتَرْجِمُ لَهُ، ثُمَّ لَيَقُولَنَّ لَهُ أَلَمْ أُوتِكَ مَالاً فَلَيَقُولَنَّ بَلَى‏.‏ ثُمَّ لَيَقُولَنَّ أَلَمْ أُرْسِلْ إِلَيْكَ رَسُولاً فَلَيَقُولَنَّ بَلَى‏.‏ فَيَنْظُرُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ فَلاَ يَرَى إِلاَّ النَّارَ، ثُمَّ يَنْظُرُ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ فَلاَ يَرَى إِلاَّ النَّارَ، فَلْيَتَّقِيَنَّ أَحَدُكُمُ النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَبِكَلِمَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin alnnabiylu, aakhbaranaa sa'daanu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa aabuw mujaahidin, haddathanaa muhillu bnu khaliyfaaa alttaaiiyyu, qaala sami'tu 'adiyya bna haatimin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu kuntu 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajaa'ahu rajulaani aahaduhumaa yashkuw al'aylaaa, waalakharu yashkuw qat'a alssabiyli, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aammaa qat'u alssabiyli faiinnahu laa yaatiy 'alayka iilaaa qaliylun hattaa takhruja al'iyru iilaa makkaaa bighayri khafiyrin, waaammaa al'aylaau faiinna alssaa'aaa laa taquwmu hattaa yatuwfa aahadukum bisadaqatihi laa yajidu man yaqbaluhaa minhu, thumma layaqifanna aahadukum bayna yadaai alllahi laysa baynahu wabaynahu hijaabun walaa turjumaanun yutarjimu lahu, thumma layaquwlanna lahu aalam auwtika maalaan falayaquwlanna balaa‏.‏ thumma layaquwlanna aalam aursil iilayka rasuwlaan falayaquwlanna balaa‏.‏ fayanzuru 'an yamiynihi falaa yaraa iilaaa alnnaara, thumma yanzuru 'an shimaalihi falaa yaraa iilaaa alnnaara, falyattaqiyanna aahadukumu alnnaara walaw bishiqqi tamraain, faiin lam yajid fabikalimaain tayyibaain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim:While I was sitting with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) two persons came to him; one of them complained about his poverty and the other complained about the prevalence of robberies. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "As regards stealing and robberies, there will shortly come a time when a caravan will go to Mecca (from Medina) without any guard. And regarding poverty, The Hour (Day of Judgment) will not be established till one of you wanders about with his object of charity and will not find anybody to accept it And (no doubt) each one of you will stand in front of Allah and there will be neither a curtain nor an interpreter between him and Allah, and Allah will ask him, 'Did not I give you wealth?' He will reply in the affirmative. Allah will further ask, 'Didn't I send a messenger to you?' And again that person will reply in the affirmative Then he will look to his right and he will see nothing but Hell-fire, and then he will look to his left and will see nothing but Hell-fire. And so, any (each one) of you should save himself from the fire even by giving half of a date-fruit (in charity). And if you do not find a half date-fruit, then (you can do it through saying) a good pleasant word (to your brethren). (See Hadith No. 793 Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيَأْتِيَنَّ عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ يَطُوفُ الرَّجُلُ فِيهِ بِالصَّدَقَةِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ ثُمَّ لاَ يَجِدُ أَحَدًا يَأْخُذُهَا مِنْهُ، وَيُرَى الرَّجُلُ الْوَاحِدُ يَتْبَعُهُ أَرْبَعُونَ امْرَأَةً، يَلُذْنَ بِهِ مِنْ قِلَّةِ الرِّجَالِ وَكَثْرَةِ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ layaatiyanna 'alaa alnnaasi zamaanun yatuwfu alrrajulu fiyhi bialssadaqaai mina aldhhahabi thumma laa yajidu aahadana yaakhudhuhaa minhu, wayuraa alrrajulu alwaahidu yatba'uhu aarba'uwna amraaaaan, yaludhna bihi min qillaai alrrijaali wakathraai alnnisaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A time will come upon the people when a person will wander about with gold as Zakat and will not find anybody to accept it, and one man will be seen followed by forty women to be their guardian because of scarcity of men and great number of women
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ الْحَكَمُ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَصْرِيُّ ـ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ آيَةُ الصَّدَقَةِ كُنَّا نُحَامِلُ، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَتَصَدَّقَ بِشَىْءٍ كَثِيرٍ فَقَالُوا مُرَائِي‏.‏ وَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَتَصَدَّقَ بِصَاعٍ فَقَالُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنْ صَاعِ هَذَا‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتِ ‏{‏الَّذِينَ يَلْمِزُونَ الْمُطَّوِّعِينَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي الصَّدَقَاتِ وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَجِدُونَ إِلاَّ جُهْدَهُمْ‏}‏ الآيَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani alhakamu huwa abnu 'abdi alllahi albasriyyu haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sulaymaana, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin rda allh 'nh qaala lammaa nazalat ayaau alssadaqaai kunnaa nuhaamilu, fajaa'a rajulun fatasaddaqa bishaa'in kathiyrin faqaaluwa muraaiiy‏.‏ wajaa'a rajulun fatasaddaqa bisaa'in faqaaluwa iinna alllaha laghaniyyun 'an saa'i hadhaa‏.‏ fanazalati ‏{‏alladhiyna yalmizuwna almuttawwi'iyna mina almuuminiyna fiy alssadaqaati waalladhiyna laa yajiduwna iilaaa juhdahum‏}‏ alayaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Mas`ud:When the verses of charity were revealed, we used to work as porters. A man came and distributed objects of charity in abundance. And they (the people) said, "He is showing off." And another man came and gave a Sa (a small measure of food grains); they said, "Allah is not in need of this small amount of charity." And then the Divine Inspiration came: "Those who criticize such of the believers who give in charity voluntarily and those who could not find to give in charity except what is available to them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَمَرَنَا بِالصَّدَقَةِ انْطَلَقَ أَحَدُنَا إِلَى السُّوقِ فَتَحَامَلَ فَيُصِيبُ الْمُدَّ، وَإِنَّ لِبَعْضِهِمُ الْيَوْمَ لَمِائَةَ أَلْفٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin alaansaariyyi rda allh 'nh qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aamaranaa bialssadaqaai antalaqa aahadunaa iilaa alssuwqi fatahaamala fayusiybu almudda, waiinna liba'dihimu alyawma lamiaiaaa aalfin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Mas`ud Al-Ansari:Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered us to give in charity, we used to go to the market and work as porters and get a Mudd (a special measure of grain) and then give it in charity. (Those were the days of poverty) and today some of us have one hundred thousand
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَعْقِلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اتَّقُوا النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna ma'qilin, qaala sami'tu 'adiyya bna haatimin rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ attaquwa alnnaara walaw bishiqqi tamraain ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Adi bin Hatim heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying:"Save yourself from Hell-fire even by giving half a date-fruit in charity
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مَعَهَا ابْنَتَانِ لَهَا تَسْأَلُ، فَلَمْ تَجِدْ عِنْدِي شَيْئًا غَيْرَ تَمْرَةٍ فَأَعْطَيْتُهَا إِيَّاهَا، فَقَسَمَتْهَا بَيْنَ ابْنَتَيْهَا وَلَمْ تَأْكُلْ مِنْهَا، ثُمَّ قَامَتْ فَخَرَجَتْ، فَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْنَا، فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ ابْتُلِيَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْبَنَاتِ بِشَىْءٍ كُنَّ لَهُ سِتْرًا مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa bishru bnu muhammadin, qaala aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy bakri bni hazmin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat dakhalati amraaaaun ma'ahaa abnataani lahaa tasaalu, falam tajid 'indiy shayiana ghayra tamraain faaa'taytuhaa iiyyaahaa, faqasamathaa bayna abnatayhaa walam taakul minhaa, thumma qaamat fakharajat, fadakhala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaynaa, faaakhbartuhu faqaala ‏ "‏ mani abtuliya min hadhihi albanaati bishaa'in kunna lahu sitrana mina alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:A lady along with her two daughters came to me asking (for some alms), but she found nothing with me except one date which I gave to her and she divided it between her two daughters, and did not eat anything herself, and then she got up and went away. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) came in and I informed him about this story. He said, "Whoever is put to trial by these daughters and he treats them generously (with benevolence) then these daughters will act as a shield for him from Hell-Fire." (See Hadith No. 24, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الصَّدَقَةِ أَعْظَمُ أَجْرًا قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنْ تَصَدَّقَ وَأَنْتَ صَحِيحٌ شَحِيحٌ، تَخْشَى الْفَقْرَ وَتَأْمُلُ الْغِنَى، وَلاَ تُمْهِلُ حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَتِ الْحُلْقُومَ قُلْتَ لِفُلاَنٍ كَذَا، وَلِفُلاَنٍ كَذَا، وَقَدْ كَانَ لِفُلاَنٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa 'umaaraau bnu alqa'qaa'i, haddathanaa aabuw zur'aaa, haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aaaau alssadaqaai aa'zamu aajrana qaala ‏ "‏ aan tasaddaqa waaanta sahiyhun shahiyhun, takhshaa alfaqra wataamulu alghinaa, walaa tumhilu hattaa iidhaa balaghati alhulquwma qulta lifulaanin kadhaa, walifulaanin kadhaa, waqad kaana lifulaanin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Which charity is the most superior in reward?" He replied, "The charity which you practice while you are healthy, niggardly and afraid of poverty and wish to become wealthy. Do not delay it to the time of approaching death and then say, 'Give so much to such and such, and so much to such and such.' And it has already belonged to such and such (as it is too late)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها أَنَّ بَعْضَ، أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْنَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيُّنَا أَسْرَعُ بِكَ لُحُوقًا قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَطْوَلُكُنَّ يَدًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَخَذُوا قَصَبَةً يَذْرَعُونَهَا، فَكَانَتْ سَوْدَةُ أَطْوَلَهُنَّ يَدًا، فَعَلِمْنَا بَعْدُ أَنَّمَا كَانَتْ طُولَ يَدِهَا الصَّدَقَةُ، وَكَانَتْ أَسْرَعَنَا لُحُوقًا بِهِ وَكَانَتْ تُحِبُّ الصَّدَقَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, hadaathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an firaasin, 'ani alshaa'biyii, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, rda allh 'nha aanaa ba'da, aazwaaji alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qulna lilnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm aayuunaa aasra'u bika luhuwqana qaala ‏ "‏ aatwalukunaa yadana ‏"‏‏.‏ faaakhadhuwa qasabaaan yadhra'uwnahaa, fakaanat sawdaau aatwalahunaa yadana, fa'alimnaa ba'du aanaamaa kaanat tuwla yadihaa alsaadaqaau, wakaanat aasra'anaa luhuwqana bihi wakaanat tuhibuu alsaadaqaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Some of the wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) asked him, "Who amongst us will be the first to follow you (i.e. die after you)?" He said, "Whoever has the longest hand." So they started measuring their hands with a stick and Sauda's hand turned out to be the longest. (When Zainab bint Jahsh died first of all in the caliphate of `Umar), we came to know that the long hand was a symbol of practicing charity, so she was the first to follow the Prophet (ﷺ) and she used to love to practice charity. (Sauda died later in the caliphate of Muawiya)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لأَتَصَدَّقَنَّ بِصَدَقَةٍ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ بِصَدَقَتِهِ فَوَضَعَهَا فِي يَدِ سَارِقٍ فَأَصْبَحُوا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ تُصُدِّقَ عَلَى سَارِقٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ لأَتَصَدَّقَنَّ بِصَدَقَةٍ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ بِصَدَقَتِهِ فَوَضَعَهَا فِي يَدَىْ زَانِيَةٍ، فَأَصْبَحُوا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ تُصُدِّقَ اللَّيْلَةَ عَلَى زَانِيَةٍ‏.‏ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى زَانِيَةٍ، لأَتَصَدَّقَنَّ بِصَدَقَةٍ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ بِصَدَقَتِهِ فَوَضَعَهَا فِي يَدَىْ غَنِيٍّ فَأَصْبَحُوا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ تُصُدِّقَ عَلَى غَنِيٍّ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، عَلَى سَارِقٍ وَعَلَى زَانِيَةٍ وَعَلَى غَنِيٍّ‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَمَّا صَدَقَتُكَ عَلَى سَارِقٍ فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَسْتَعِفَّ عَنْ سَرِقَتِهِ، وَأَمَّا الزَّانِيَةُ فَلَعَلَّهَا أَنْ تَسْتَعِفَّ عَنْ زِنَاهَا، وَأَمَّا الْغَنِيُّ فَلَعَلَّهُ يَعْتَبِرُ فَيُنْفِقُ مِمَّا أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ qaala rajulun laatasaddaqanna bisadaqaain‏.‏ fakharaja bisadaqatihi fawada'ahaa fiy yadi saariqin faaasbahuwa yatahaddathuwna tusuddiqa 'alaa saariqin‏.‏ faqaala alllahumma laka alhamdu laatasaddaqanna bisadaqaain‏.‏ fakharaja bisadaqatihi fawada'ahaa fiy yadaa zaaniyaain, faaasbahuwa yatahaddathuwna tusuddiqa alllaylaaa 'alaa zaaniyaain‏.‏ faqaala alllahumma laka alhamdu 'alaa zaaniyaain, laatasaddaqanna bisadaqaain‏.‏ fakharaja bisadaqatihi fawada'ahaa fiy yadaa ghaniyyin faaasbahuwa yatahaddathuwna tusuddiqa 'alaa ghaniyyin faqaala alllahumma laka alhamdu, 'alaa saariqin wa'alaa zaaniyaain wa'alaa ghaniyyin‏.‏ faautiya faqiyla lahu aammaa sadaqatuka 'alaa saariqin fala'allahu aan yasta'iffa 'an sariqatihi, waaammaa alzzaaniyaau fala'allahaa aan tasta'iffa 'an zinaahaa, waaammaa alghaniyyu fala'allahu ya'tabiru fayunfiqu mimmaa aa'taahu alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "A man said that he would give something in charity. He went out with his object of charity and unknowingly gave it to a thief. Next morning the people said that he had given his object of charity to a thief. (On hearing that) he said, "O Allah! All the praises are for you. I will give alms again." And so he again went out with his alms and (unknowingly) gave it to an adulteress. Next morning the people said that he had given his alms to an adulteress last night. The man said, "O Allah! All the praises are for you. (I gave my alms) to an adulteress. I will give alms again." So he went out with his alms again and (unknowingly) gave it to a rich person. (The people) next morning said that he had given his alms to a wealthy person. He said, "O Allah! All the praises are for you. (I had given alms) to a thief, to an adulteress and to a wealthy man." Then someone came and said to him, "The alms which you gave to the thief, might make him abstain from stealing, and that given to the adulteress might make her abstain from illegal sexual intercourse (adultery), and that given to the wealthy man might make him take a lesson from it and spend his wealth which Allah has given him, in Allah's cause
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْجُوَيْرِيَةِ، أَنَّ مَعْنَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ بَايَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَا وَأَبِي وَجَدِّي وَخَطَبَ عَلَىَّ فَأَنْكَحَنِي وَخَاصَمْتُ إِلَيْهِ ـ وَـ كَانَ أَبِي يَزِيدُ أَخْرَجَ دَنَانِيرَ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِهَا فَوَضَعَهَا عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَجِئْتُ فَأَخَذْتُهَا فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِهَا فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا إِيَّاكَ أَرَدْتُ‏.‏ فَخَاصَمْتُهُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَكَ مَا نَوَيْتَ يَا يَزِيدُ، وَلَكَ مَا أَخَذْتَ يَا مَعْنُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, haddathanaa aabuw aljuwayriyaai, aanna ma'na bna yaziyda rda allh 'nh haddathahu qaala baaya'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanaa waaabiy wajaddiy wakhataba 'alaaaa faaankahaniy wakhaasamtu iilayhi wa kaana aabiy yaziydu aakhraja danaaniyra yatasaddaqu bihaa fawada'ahaa 'inda rajulin fiy almasjidi, fajiitu faaakhadhtuhaa faaataytuhu bihaa faqaala waalllahi maa iiyyaaka aaradtu‏.‏ fakhaasamtuhu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ laka maa nawayta yaa yaziydu, walaka maa aakhadhta yaa ma'nu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ma'n bin Yazid:My grandfather, my father and I gave the pledge of allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The Prophet (ﷺ) got me engaged and then got me married. One day I went to the Prophet (ﷺ) with a complaint. My father Yazid had taken some gold coins for charity and kept them with a man in the mosque (to give them to the poor) But I went and took them and brought them to him (my father). My father said, "By Allah! I did not intend to give them to you. " I took (the case) to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) . On that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Yazid, you will be rewarded for what you intended. O Ma'n, whatever you have taken is yours
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي خُبَيْبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَبْعَةٌ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِي ظِلِّهِ يَوْمَ لاَ ظِلَّ إِلاَّ ظِلُّهُ إِمَامٌ عَدْلٌ، وَشَابٌّ نَشَأَ فِي عِبَادَةِ اللَّهِ، وَرَجُلٌ قَلْبُهُ مُعَلَّقٌ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ، وَرَجُلاَنِ تَحَابَّا فِي اللَّهِ اجْتَمَعَا عَلَيْهِ وَتَفَرَّقَا عَلَيْهِ، وَرَجُلٌ دَعَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ ذَاتُ مَنْصِبٍ وَجَمَالٍ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ اللَّهَ، وَرَجُلٌ تَصَدَّقَ بِصَدَقَةٍ فَأَخْفَاهَا حَتَّى لاَ تَعْلَمَ شِمَالُهُ مَا تُنْفِقُ يَمِينُهُ، وَرَجُلٌ ذَكَرَ اللَّهَ خَالِيًا فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَاهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy khubaybu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ sab'aaun yuzilluhumu alllahu ta'aalaa fiy zillihi yawma laa zilla iilaaa zilluhu iimaamun 'adlun, washaabbun nashaaa fiy 'ibaadaai alllahi, warajulun qalbuhu mu'allaqun fiy almasaajidi, warajulaani tahaabbaa fiy alllahi ajtama'aa 'alayhi watafarraqaa 'alayhi, warajulun da'athu amraaaaun dhaatu mansibin wajamaalin faqaala iinniy aakhaafu alllaha, warajulun tasaddaqa bisadaqaain faaakhfaahaa hattaa laa ta'lama shimaaluhu maa tunfiqu yamiynuhu, warajulun dhakara alllaha khaaliyana fafaadat 'aynaahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Seven people will be shaded by Allah under His shade on the day when there will be no shade except His. They are: (1) a just ruler; (2) a young man who has been brought up in the worship of Allah, (i.e. worship Allah (Alone) sincerely from his childhood), (3) a man whose heart is attached to the mosque (who offers the five compulsory congregational prayers in the mosque); (4) two persons who love each other only for Allah's sake and they meet and part in Allah's cause only; (5) a man who refuses the call of a charming woman of noble birth for an illegal sexual intercourse with her and says: I am afraid of Allah; (6) a person who practices charity so secretly that his left hand does not know what his right hand has given (i.e. nobody knows how much he has given in charity). (7) a person who remembers Allah in seclusion and his eyes get flooded with tears
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْجَعْدِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَعْبَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حَارِثَةَ بْنَ وَهْبٍ الْخُزَاعِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ تَصَدَّقُوا، فَسَيَأْتِي عَلَيْكُمْ زَمَانٌ يَمْشِي الرَّجُلُ بِصَدَقَتِهِ فَيَقُولُ الرَّجُلُ لَوْ جِئْتَ بِهَا بِالأَمْسِ لَقَبِلْتُهَا مِنْكَ، فَأَمَّا الْيَوْمَ فَلاَ حَاجَةَ لِي فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu alja'di, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy ma'badu bnu khaalidin, qaala sami'tu haarithaaa bna wahbin alkhuzaa'iyya rda allh 'nh yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ tasaddaquwa, fasayaatiy 'alaykum zamaanun yamshiy alrrajulu bisadaqatihi fayaquwlu alrrajulu law jiita bihaa bialaamsi laqabiltuhaa minka, faaammaa alyawma falaa haajaaa liy fiyhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Haritha bin Wahab Al-Khuza`i:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "(O people!) Give in charity (for Allah's cause) because a time will come when a person will carry his object of charity from place to place (and he will not find any person to take it) and any person whom he shall request to take it, will reply, 'If you had brought it yesterday I would have taken it, but today I am not in need of it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَنْفَقَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ طَعَامِ بَيْتِهَا غَيْرَ مُفْسِدَةٍ كَانَ لَهَا أَجْرُهَا بِمَا أَنْفَقَتْ وَلِزَوْجِهَا أَجْرُهُ بِمَا كَسَبَ، وَلِلْخَازِنِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ، لاَ يَنْقُصُ بَعْضُهُمْ أَجْرَ بَعْضٍ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aanfaqati almaraaau min ta'aami baytihaa ghayra mufsidaain kaana lahaa aajruhaa bimaa aanfaqat walizawjihaa aajruhu bimaa kasaba, walilkhaazini mithlu dhalika, laa yanqusu ba'duhum aajra ba'din shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When a woman gives in charity some of the foodstuff (which she has in her house) without spoiling it, she will receive the reward for what she has spent, and her husband will receive the reward because of his earning, and the storekeeper will also have a reward similar to it. The reward of one will not decrease the reward of the others
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَيْرُ الصَّدَقَةِ مَا كَانَ عَنْ ظَهْرِ غِنًى، وَابْدَأْ بِمَنْ تَعُولُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ khayru alssadaqaai maa kaana 'an zahri ghinana, waabdaa biman ta'uwlu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The best charity is that which is practiced by a wealthy person. And start giving first to your dependents
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى، وَابْدَأْ بِمَنْ تَعُولُ، وَخَيْرُ الصَّدَقَةِ عَنْ ظَهْرِ غِنًى، وَمَنْ يَسْتَعْفِفْ يُعِفَّهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَغْنِ يُغْنِهِ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَنْ وُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an hakiymi bni hizaamin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alyadu al'ulyaa khayrun mina alyadi alssuflaa, waabdaa biman ta'uwlu, wakhayru alssadaqaai 'an zahri ghinana, waman yasta'fif yu'iffahu alllahu, waman yastaghni yughnihi alllahu ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'an wuhaybin, qaala aakhbaranaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The upper hand is better than the lower hand (i.e. he who gives in charity is better than him who takes it). One should start giving first to his dependents. And the best object of charity is that which is given by a wealthy person (from the money which is left after his expenses). And whoever abstains from asking others for some financial help, Allah will give him and save him from asking others, Allah will make him self-sufficient
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، وَذَكَرَ الصَّدَقَةَ وَالتَّعَفُّفَ وَالْمَسْأَلَةَ ‏ "‏ الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى، فَالْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا هِيَ الْمُنْفِقَةُ، وَالسُّفْلَى هِيَ السَّائِلَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, qaala haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm h‏.‏ wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala wahuwa 'alaa alminbari, wadhakara alssadaqaaa waaltta'affufa waalmasaalaaa ‏ "‏ alyadu al'ulyaa khayrun mina alyadi alssuflaa, faalyadu al'ulyaa hiya almunfiqaau, waalssuflaa hiya alssaaiilaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while he was on the pulpit speaking about charity, to abstain from asking others for some financial help and about begging others, saying, "The upper hand is better than the lower hand. The upper hand is that of the giver and the lower (hand) is that of the beggar
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، أَنَّ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْعَصْرَ، فَأَسْرَعَ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ الْبَيْتَ، فَلَمْ يَلْبَثْ أَنْ خَرَجَ، فَقُلْتُ أَوْ قِيلَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ كُنْتُ خَلَّفْتُ فِي الْبَيْتِ تِبْرًا مِنَ الصَّدَقَةِ، فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُبَيِّتَهُ فَقَسَمْتُهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'an 'umara bni sa'iydin, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, aanna 'uqbaaa bna alhaarithi rda allh 'nh haddathahu qaala sallaa binaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm al'asra, faaasra'a thumma dakhala albayta, falam yalbath aan kharaja, faqultu aaw qiyla lahu faqaala ‏ "‏ kuntu khallaftu fiy albayti tibrana mina alssadaqaai, fakarihtu aan aubayyitahu faqasamtuhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) offered the `Asr prayer and then hurriedly went to his house and returned immediately. I (or somebody else) asked him (as to what was the matter) and he said, "I left at home a piece of gold which was from the charity and I disliked to let it remain a night in my house, so I got it distributed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَدِيٌّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ عِيدٍ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ لَمْ يُصَلِّ قَبْلُ وَلاَ بَعْدُ، ثُمَّ مَالَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ وَمَعَهُ بِلاَلٌ، فَوَعَظَهُنَّ وَأَمَرَهُنَّ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقْنَ، فَجَعَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ تُلْقِي الْقُلْبَ وَالْخُرْصَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'adiyyun, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma 'iydin fasallaa rak'atayni lam yusalli qablu walaa ba'du, thumma maala 'alaa alnnisaa'i wama'ahu bilaalun, fawa'azahunna waaamarahunna aan yatasaddaqna, faja'alati almaraaau tulqiy alqulba waalkhursa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) went out for the `Id prayer on the `Id day and offered a two rak`at prayer; and he neither offered a prayer before it or after it. Then he went towards the women along with Bilal. He preached them and ordered them to give in charity. And some (amongst the women) started giving their forearm bangles and earrings
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا جَاءَهُ السَّائِلُ، أَوْ طُلِبَتْ إِلَيْهِ حَاجَةٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اشْفَعُوا تُؤْجَرُوا، وَيَقْضِي اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا شَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa aabuw burdaaa bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy burdaaa, haddathanaa aabuw burdaaa bnu aabiy muwsaa, 'an aabiyhi rda allh 'nh qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa jaa'ahu alssaaiilu, aaw tulibat iilayhi haajaaun qaala ‏ "‏ ashfa'uwa tuujaruwa, wayaqdiy alllahu 'alaa lisaani nabiyyihi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa shaa'a ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda bin Abu Musa:that his father said, "Whenever a beggar came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) or he was asked for something, he used to say (to his companions), "Help and recommend him and you will receive the reward for it; and Allah will bring about what He will through His Prophet's tongue
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُوكِي فَيُوكَى عَلَيْكِ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدَةَ، وَقَالَ، ‏"‏ لاَ تُحْصِي فَيُحْصِيَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكِ ‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sadaqaau bnu alfadli, aakhbaranaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaamin, 'an faatimaaa, 'an aasmaa'a rda allh 'nha qaalat qaala liy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tuwkiy fayuwkaa 'alayki ‏"‏‏.‏ haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, 'an 'abdaaa, waqaala, ‏"‏ laa tuhsiy fayuhsiya alllahu 'alayki ‏"‏
verses.translation: Narrated Asma:The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Do not withhold your money, (for if you did so) Allah would withhold His blessings from you." Narrated `Abda: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not withhold your money by counting it (i.e. hoarding it), (for if you did so), Allah would also withhold His blessings from you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهَا جَاءَتْ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُوعِي فَيُوعِيَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكِ، ارْضَخِي مَا اسْتَطَعْتِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahiymi, 'an hajjaaji bni muhammadin, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu aabiy mulaykaaa, 'an 'abbaadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, aakhbarahu 'an aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nhma aannahaa jaa'at iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ laa tuw'iy fayuw'iya alllahu 'alayki, ardakhiy maa astata'ti ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Asma' bint Abu Bakr:that she had gone to the Prophet (ﷺ) and he said, "Do not shut your money bag; otherwise Allah too will withhold His blessings from you. Spend (in Allah's Cause) as much as you can afford
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَيُّكُمْ يَحْفَظُ حَدِيثَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْفِتْنَةِ قَالَ قُلْتُ أَنَا أَحْفَظُهُ كَمَا قَالَ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّكَ عَلَيْهِ لَجَرِيءٌ فَكَيْفَ قَالَ قُلْتُ فِتْنَةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ وَجَارِهِ تُكَفِّرُهَا الصَّلاَةُ وَالصَّدَقَةُ وَالْمَعْرُوفُ‏.‏ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ قَدْ كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الصَّلاَةُ وَالصَّدَقَةُ، وَالأَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهْىُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَيْسَ هَذِهِ أُرِيدُ، وَلَكِنِّي أُرِيدُ الَّتِي تَمُوجُ كَمَوْجِ الْبَحْرِ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ بِهَا يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بَأْسٌ، بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهَا باب مُغْلَقٌ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيُكْسَرُ الْبَابُ أَوْ يُفْتَحُ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ‏.‏ بَلْ يُكْسَرُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنَّهُ إِذَا كُسِرَ لَمْ يُغْلَقْ أَبَدًا‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ أَجَلْ‏.‏ فَهِبْنَا أَنْ نَسْأَلَهُ مَنِ الْبَابُ فَقُلْنَا لِمَسْرُوقٍ سَلْهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَأَلَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْنَا فَعَلِمَ عُمَرُ مَنْ تَعْنِي قَالَ نَعَمْ، كَمَا أَنَّ دُونَ غَدٍ لَيْلَةً، وَذَلِكَ أَنِّي حَدَّثْتُهُ حَدِيثًا لَيْسَ بِالأَغَالِيطِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an hudhayfaaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh aayyukum yahfazu hadiytha rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alfitnaai qaala qultu aanaa aahfazuhu kamaa qaala‏.‏ qaala iinnaka 'alayhi lajariy'un fakayfa qaala qultu fitnaau alrrajuli fiy aahlihi wawaladihi wajaarihi tukaffiruhaa alssalaaau waalssadaqaau waalma'ruwfu‏.‏ qaala sulaymaanu qad kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alssalaaau waalssadaqaau, waalaamru bialma'ruwfi waalnnahau 'ani almunkari ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala laysa hadhihi auriydu, walakinniy auriydu allatiy tamuwju kamawji albahri‏.‏ qaala qultu laysa 'alayka bihaa yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna baasun, baynaka wabaynahaa bab mughlaqun‏.‏ qaala fayuksaru albaabu aaw yuftahu‏.‏ qaala qultu laa‏.‏ bal yuksaru‏.‏ qaala faiinnahu iidhaa kusira lam yughlaq aabadana‏.‏ qaala qultu aajal‏.‏ fahibnaa aan nasaalahu mani albaabu faqulnaa limasruwqin salhu‏.‏ qaala fasaaalahu‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh ‏.‏ qaala qulnaa fa'alima 'umaru man ta'niy qaala na'am, kamaa aanna duwna ghadin laylaaan, wadhalika aanniy haddathtuhu hadiythana laysa bialaaghaaliyti‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Wail:Hudhaifa said, "`Umar said, 'Who amongst you remembers the statement of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about afflictions'?' I said, 'I know it as the Prophet (ﷺ) had said it.' `Umar said, 'No doubt, you are bold. How did he say it?' I said, 'A man's afflictions (wrong deeds) concerning his wife, children and neighbors are expiated by (his) prayers, charity, and enjoining good.' (The sub-narrator Sulaiman added that he said, 'The prayer, charity, enjoining good and forbidding evil.') `Umar said, 'I did not mean that, but I ask about that affliction which will spread like the waves of the sea.' I said, 'O chief of the believers! You need not be afraid of it as there is a closed door between you and it.' He asked, 'Will the door be broken or opened?' I replied, 'No, it will be broken.' He said, 'Then, if it is broken, it will never be closed again?' I replied, 'Yes.' " Then we were afraid to ask what that door was, so we asked Masruq to inquire, and he asked Hudhaifa regarding it. Hudhaifa said, "The door was `Umar. "We further asked Hudhaifa whether `Umar knew what that door meant. Hudhaifa replied in the affirmative and added, "He knew it as one knows that there will be a night before the tomorrow morning
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ أَشْيَاءَ كُنْتُ أَتَحَنَّثُ بِهَا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مِنْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ عَتَاقَةٍ وَصِلَةِ رَحِمٍ فَهَلْ فِيهَا مِنْ أَجْرٍ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَسْلَمْتَ عَلَى مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa hishaamun, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an hakiymi bni hizaamin rda allh 'nh qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta aashyaa'a kuntu aatahannathu bihaa fiy aljaahiliyyaai min sadaqaain aaw 'ataaqaain wasilaai rahimin fahal fiyhaa min aajrin faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aaslamta 'alaa maa salafa min khayrin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hakim bin Hizam:I said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), "Before embracing Islam I used to do good deeds like giving in charity, slave-manumitting, and the keeping of good relations with Kith and kin. Shall I be rewarded for those deeds?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "You became Muslim with all those good deeds (Without losing their reward)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا تَصَدَّقَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ طَعَامِ زَوْجِهَا غَيْرَ مُفْسِدَةٍ كَانَ لَهَا أَجْرُهَا، وَلِزَوْجِهَا بِمَا كَسَبَ، وَلِلْخَازِنِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa tasaddaqati almaraaau min ta'aami zawjihaa ghayra mufsidaain kaana lahaa aajruhaa, walizawjihaa bimaa kasaba, walilkhaazini mithlu dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "When a woman gives in charity from her husband's meals without wasting the property of her husband, she will get a reward for it, and her husband too will get a reward for what he earned and the storekeeper will have the reward likewise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
