verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْخَازِنُ الْمُسْلِمُ الأَمِينُ الَّذِي يُنْفِذُ ـ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ يُعْطِي ـ مَا أُمِرَ بِهِ كَامِلاً مُوَفَّرًا طَيِّبٌ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ، فَيَدْفَعُهُ إِلَى الَّذِي أُمِرَ لَهُ بِهِ، أَحَدُ الْمُتَصَدِّقَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alkhaazinu almuslimu alaamiynu alladhiy yunfidhu warubbamaa qaala yu'tiy maa aumira bihi kaamilaan muwaffarana tayyibun bihi nafsuhu, fayadfa'uhu iilaa alladhiy aumira lahu bihi, aahadu almutasaddiqayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "An honest Muslim storekeeper who carries out the orders of his master and pays fully what he has been ordered to give with a good heart and pays to that person to whom he was ordered to pay, is regarded as one of the two charitable persons
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، وَالأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَعْنِي إِذَا تَصَدَّقَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa mansuwrun, waalaa'mashu, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ta'niy iidhaa tasaddaqati almaraaau min bayti zawjihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Aishah:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a woman gives in charity from her husband's house ..." (See next hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَطْعَمَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا غَيْرَ مُفْسِدَةٍ، لَهَا أَجْرُهَا، وَلَهُ مِثْلُهُ، وَلِلْخَازِنِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ، لَهُ بِمَا اكْتَسَبَ، وَلَهَا بِمَا أَنْفَقَتْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aat'amati almaraaau min bayti zawjihaa ghayra mufsidaain, lahaa aajruhaa, walahu mithluhu, walilkhaazini mithlu dhalika, lahu bimaa aktasaba, walahaa bimaa aanfaqat ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrate Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "If a woman gives in charity from her husband's house .." The Prophet (ﷺ) also said, "If a lady gives meals (in charity) from her husband's house without spoiling her husband's property, she will get a reward and her husband will also get a reward likewise. The husband will get a reward because of his earnings and the woman because of her spending
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَنْفَقَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ طَعَامِ بَيْتِهَا غَيْرَ مُفْسِدَةٍ فَلَهَا أَجْرُهَا، وَلِلزَّوْجِ بِمَا اكْتَسَبَ، وَلِلْخَازِنِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa aanfaqati almaraaau min ta'aami baytihaa ghayra mufsidaain falahaa aajruhaa, walilzzawji bimaa aktasaba, walilkhaazini mithlu dhalika ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "When a woman gives in charity from her house meals in Allah's Cause without spoiling her husband's property, she will get a reward for it, and her husband will also get the reward for his earnings and the storekeeper will get a reward likewise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْحُبَابِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ يَوْمٍ يُصْبِحُ الْعِبَادُ فِيهِ إِلاَّ مَلَكَانِ يَنْزِلاَنِ فَيَقُولُ أَحَدُهُمَا اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِ مُنْفِقًا خَلَفًا، وَيَقُولُ الآخَرُ اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِ مُمْسِكًا تَلَفًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy aakhiy, 'an sulaymaana, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni aabiy muzarridin, 'an aabiy alhubaabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa min yawmin yusbihu al'ibaadu fiyhi iilaaa malakaani yanzilaani fayaquwlu aahaduhumaa alllahumma aa'ti munfiqana khalafana, wayaquwlu alakharu alllahumma aa'ti mumsikana talafana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every day two angels come down from Heaven and one of them says, 'O Allah! Compensate every person who spends in Your Cause,' and the other (angel) says, 'O Allah! Destroy every miser
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَثَلُ الْبَخِيلِ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلَيْنِ، عَلَيْهِمَا جُبَّتَانِ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَثَلُ الْبَخِيلِ وَالْمُنْفِقِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلَيْنِ، عَلَيْهِمَا جُبَّتَانِ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ، مِنْ ثُدِيِّهِمَا إِلَى تَرَاقِيهِمَا، فَأَمَّا الْمُنْفِقُ فَلاَ يُنْفِقُ إِلاَّ سَبَغَتْ ـ أَوْ وَفَرَتْ ـ عَلَى جِلْدِهِ حَتَّى تُخْفِيَ بَنَانَهُ وَتَعْفُوَ أَثَرَهُ، وَأَمَّا الْبَخِيلُ فَلاَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُنْفِقَ شَيْئًا إِلاَّ لَزِقَتْ كُلُّ حَلْقَةٍ مَكَانَهَا، فَهُوَ يُوَسِّعُهَا وَلاَ تَتَّسِعُ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ فِي الْجُبَّتَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa abnu taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ mathalu albakhiyli waalmutasaddiqi kamathali rajulayni, 'alayhimaa jubbataani min hadiydin ‏"‏‏.‏ wahaddathanaa aabuw alyamaani aakhbaranaa shu'aybun haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi aanna 'abda alrrahmani haddathahu aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ mathalu albakhiyli waalmunfiqi kamathali rajulayni, 'alayhimaa jubbataani min hadiydin, min thudiyyihimaa iilaa taraaqiyhimaa, faaammaa almunfiqu falaa yunfiqu iilaaa sabaghat aaw wafarat 'alaa jildihi hattaa tukhfiya banaanahu wata'fuwa aatharahu, waaammaa albakhiylu falaa yuriydu aan yunfiqa shayiana iilaaa laziqat kullu halqaain makaanahaa, fahuwa yuwassi'uhaa walaa tattasi'u ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu alhasanu bnu muslimin 'an taawusin fiy aljubbatayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The example of a miser and an almsgiver is like the example of two persons wearing iron cloaks." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also said, "The example of an almsgiver and a miser is like the example of two persons who have two iron cloaks on them from their breasts to their collar bones, and when the almsgiver wants to give in charity, the cloak becomes capacious till it covers his whole body to such an extent that it hides his fingertips and covers his footprints (obliterates his tracks). (1) And when the miser wants to spend, it (the iron cloak) sticks and every ring gets stuck to its place and he tries to widen it, but it did not become wide
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ حَنْظَلَةُ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، ‏"‏ جُنَّتَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ هُرْمُزٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ جُنَّتَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala hanzalaau 'an taawusin, ‏"‏ junnataani ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy ja'farun, 'ani abni hurmuzin, sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ junnataani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: See previous hadith
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَعْمَلُ بِيَدِهِ فَيَنْفَعُ نَفْسَهُ وَيَتَصَدَّقُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُعِينُ ذَا الْحَاجَةِ الْمَلْهُوفَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلْيَعْمَلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، وَلْيُمْسِكْ عَنِ الشَّرِّ فَإِنَّهَا لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaddihi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ 'alaa kulli muslimin sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa yaa nabiyya alllahi faman lam yajid qaala ‏"‏ ya'malu biyadihi fayanfa'u nafsahu wayatasaddaqu ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa faiin lam yajid qaala ‏"‏ yu'iynu dhaa alhaajaai almalhuwfa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa faiin lam yajid‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ falya'mal bialma'ruwfi, walyumsik 'ani alshharri faiinnahaa lahu sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Burda:from his father from his grandfather that the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Every Muslim has to give in charity." The people asked, "O Allah's Prophet! If someone has nothing to give, what will he do?" He said, "He should work with his hands and benefit himself and also give in charity (from what he earns)." The people further asked, "If he cannot find even that?" He replied, "He should help the needy who appeal for help." Then the people asked, "If he cannot do that?" He replied, "Then he should perform good deeds and keep away from evil deeds and this will be regarded as charitable deeds
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ بُعِثَ إِلَى نُسَيْبَةَ الأَنْصَارِيَّةِ بِشَاةٍ فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ مِنْهَا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عِنْدَكُمْ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لاَ إِلاَّ مَا أَرْسَلَتْ بِهِ نُسَيْبَةُ مِنْ تِلْكَ الشَّاةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَاتِ فَقَدْ بَلَغَتْ مَحِلَّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa aabuw shihaabin, 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, 'an hafsaaa binti siyriyna, 'an aummi 'atiyyaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat bu'itha iilaa nusaybaaa alaansaariyyaai bishaaain faaarsalat iilaa 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha minhaa faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ 'indakum shaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏ faqultu laa iilaaa maa aarsalat bihi nusaybaau min tilka alshhaaai faqaala ‏"‏ haati faqad balaghat mahillahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Um 'Atiyya:A sheep was sent to me (Nusaiba Al-Ansariya) (in charity) and I sent some of it to `Aisha. The Prophet asked `Aisha for something to eat. `Aisha replied that there was nothing except what Nusaiba Al-Ansariya had sent of that sheep. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to her, "Bring it as it has reached its place
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى الْمَازِنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ ذَوْدٍ صَدَقَةٌ مِنَ الإِبِلِ، وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ أَوَاقٍ صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، سَمِعَ أَبَاهُ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'amriw bni yahyaa almaaziniyyi, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laysa fiymaa duwna khamsi dhawdin sadaqaaun mina aliibili, walaysa fiymaa duwna khamsi aawaaqin sadaqaaun, walaysa fiymaa duwna khamsaai aawsuqin sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏ haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, sami'a aabaahu, 'an aabiy sa'iydin rda allh 'nh sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is no Zakat on less than five camels and also there is no Zakat on less than five Awaq (of silver). (5 Awaq = 22 Fransa Riyals of Yemen or 200 Dirhams.) And there is no Zakat on less than five Awsuq. (A special measure of food-grains, and one Wasq equals 60 Sa's.) (For gold 20, Dinars i.e. equal to 12 Guinea English. No Zakat for less than 12 Guinea (English) of gold or for silver less than 22 Fransa Riyals of Yemen.) Narrated Abi Sa`id Al-Khudri: I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying (as above)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنِي ثُمَامَةُ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَتَبَ لَهُ الَّتِي أَمَرَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَمَنْ بَلَغَتْ صَدَقَتُهُ بِنْتَ مَخَاضٍ وَلَيْسَتْ عِنْدَهُ وَعِنْدَهُ بِنْتُ لَبُونٍ فَإِنَّهَا تُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ، وَيُعْطِيهِ الْمُصَدِّقُ عِشْرِينَ دِرْهَمًا أَوْ شَاتَيْنِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَهُ بِنْتُ مَخَاضٍ عَلَى وَجْهِهَا، وَعِنْدَهُ ابْنُ لَبُونٍ فَإِنَّهُ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy aabiy qaala, haddathaniy thumaamaau, aanna aanasana rda allh 'nh haddathahu aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh kataba lahu allatiy aamara alllahu rasuwlahu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waman balaghat sadaqatuhu binta makhaadin walaysat 'indahu wa'indahu bintu labuwnin faiinnahaa tuqbalu minhu, wayu'tiyhi almusaddiqu 'ishriyna dirhamana aaw shaatayni, faiin lam yakun 'indahu bintu makhaadin 'alaa wajhihaa, wa'indahu abnu labuwnin faiinnahu yuqbalu minhu walaysa ma'ahu shaa'un ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Abu Bakr wrote to me what Allah had instructed His Apostle (ﷺ) to do regarding the one who had to pay one Bint Makhad (i.e. one year-old she-camel) as Zakat, and he did not have it but had got Bint Labun (two year old she-camel). (He wrote that) it could be accepted from him as Zakat, and the collector of Zakat would return him 20 Dirhams or two sheep; and if the Zakat payer had not a Bint Makhad, but he had Ibn Labun (a two year old he-camel) then it could be accepted as his Zakat, but he would not be paid anything
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُؤَمَّلٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَشْهَدُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَصَلَّى قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ، فَرَأَى أَنَّهُ لَمْ يُسْمِعِ النِّسَاءَ، فَأَتَاهُنَّ وَمَعَهُ بِلاَلٌ نَاشِرَ ثَوْبِهِ فَوَعَظَهُنَّ، وَأَمَرَهُنَّ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقْنَ، فَجَعَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ تُلْقِي، وَأَشَارَ أَيُّوبُ إِلَى أُذُنِهِ وَإِلَى حَلْقِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muuammalun, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'ataa'i bni aabiy rabaahin, qaala qaala abnu 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aashhadu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lasallaa qabla alkhutbaai, faraaaa aannahu lam yusmi'i alnnisaa'a, faaataahunna wama'ahu bilaalun naashira thawbihi fawa'azahunna, waaamarahunna aan yatasaddaqna, faja'alati almaraaau tulqiy, waaashaara aayyuwbu iilaa audhunihi waiilaa halqihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I am a witness that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) offered the Id prayer before delivering the sermon and then he thought that the women would not be able to hear him (because of the distance), so he went to them along with Bilal who was spreading his garment. The Prophet (ﷺ) advised and ordered them to give in charity. So the women started giving their ornaments (in charity). (The sub-narrator Aiyub pointed towards his ears and neck meaning that they gave ornaments from those places such as earrings and necklaces)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنِي ثُمَامَةُ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَتَبَ لَهُ الَّتِي فَرَضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَلاَ يُجْمَعُ بَيْنَ مُتَفَرِّقٍ، وَلاَ يُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَ مُجْتَمِعٍ، خَشْيَةَ الصَّدَقَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabiy qaala, haddathaniy thumaamaau, aanna aanasana rda allh 'nh haddathahu aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh kataba lahu allatiy farada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ walaa yujma'u bayna mutafarriqin, walaa yufarraqu bayna mujtami'in, khashyaaa alssadaqaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Abu Bakr wrote to me what was made compulsory by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and that was (regarding the payments of Zakat): Neither the property of different people may be taken together nor the joint property may be split for fear of (paying more, or receiving less) Zakat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنِي ثُمَامَةُ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَتَبَ لَهُ الَّتِي فَرَضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَمَا كَانَ مِنْ خَلِيطَيْنِ فَإِنَّهُمَا يَتَرَاجَعَانِ بَيْنَهُمَا بِالسَّوِيَّةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy aabiy qaala, haddathaniy thumaamaau, aanna aanasana, haddathahu aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh kataba lahu allatiy farada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ wamaa kaana min khaliytayni faiinnahumaa yataraaja'aani baynahumaa bialssawiyyaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Abu Bakr wrote to me what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has made compulsory (regarding Zakat) and this was mentioned in it: If a property is equally owned by two partners, they should pay the combined Zakat and it will be considered that both of them have paid their Zakat equally
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْهِجْرَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَيْحَكَ، إِنَّ شَأْنَهَا شَدِيدٌ، فَهَلْ لَكَ مِنْ إِبِلٍ تُؤَدِّي صَدَقَتَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاعْمَلْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْبِحَارِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَنْ يَتِرَكَ مِنْ عَمَلِكَ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, qaala haddathaniy abnu shihaabin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh aanna aa'raabiyyana saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alhijraai faqaala ‏"‏ wayhaka, iinna shaanahaa shadiydun, fahal laka min iibilin tuuaddiy sadaqatahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faa'mal min waraa'i albihaari faiinna alllaha lan yatiraka min 'amalika shayiana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:A Bedouin asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the emigration. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May Allah have mercy on you! The matter of emigration is very hard. Have you got camels? Do you pay their Zakat?" The Bedouin said, "Yes, I have camels and I pay their Zakat." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, Work beyond the seas and Allah will not decrease (waste) any of your good deeds." (See Hadith No. 260 Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنِي ثُمَامَةُ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَتَبَ لَهُ فَرِيضَةَ الصَّدَقَةِ الَّتِي أَمَرَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ بَلَغَتْ عِنْدَهُ مِنَ الإِبِلِ صَدَقَةُ الْجَذَعَةِ، وَلَيْسَتْ عِنْدَهُ جَذَعَةٌ وَعِنْدَهُ حِقَّةٌ، فَإِنَّهَا تُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ الْحِقَّةُ وَيَجْعَلُ مَعَهَا شَاتَيْنِ إِنِ اسْتَيْسَرَتَا لَهُ أَوْ عِشْرِينَ دِرْهَمًا، وَمَنْ بَلَغَتْ عِنْدَهُ صَدَقَةُ الْحِقَّةِ وَلَيْسَتْ عِنْدَهُ الْحِقَّةُ وَعِنْدَهُ الْجَذَعَةُ، فَإِنَّهَا تُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ الْجَذَعَةُ، وَيُعْطِيهِ الْمُصَدِّقُ عِشْرِينَ دِرْهَمًا أَوْ شَاتَيْنِ، وَمَنْ بَلَغَتْ عِنْدَهُ صَدَقَةُ الْحِقَّةِ وَلَيْسَتْ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِنْتُ لَبُونٍ فَإِنَّهَا تُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ بِنْتُ لَبُونٍ، وَيُعْطِي شَاتَيْنِ أَوْ عِشْرِينَ دِرْهَمًا، وَمَنْ بَلَغَتْ صَدَقَتُهُ بِنْتَ لَبُونٍ وَعِنْدَهُ حِقَّةٌ فَإِنَّهَا تُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ الْحِقَّةُ وَيُعْطِيهِ الْمُصَدِّقُ عِشْرِينَ دِرْهَمًا أَوْ شَاتَيْنِ، وَمَنْ بَلَغَتْ صَدَقَتُهُ بِنْتَ لَبُونٍ وَلَيْسَتْ عِنْدَهُ وَعِنْدَهُ بِنْتُ مَخَاضٍ، فَإِنَّهَا تُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ بِنْتُ مَخَاضٍ وَيُعْطِي مَعَهَا عِشْرِينَ دِرْهَمًا أَوْ شَاتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy aabiy qaala, haddathaniy thumaamaau, aanna aanasana rda allh 'nh haddathahu aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh kataba lahu fariydaaa alssadaqaai allatiy aamara alllahu rasuwlahu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man balaghat 'indahu mina aliibili sadaqaau aljadha'aai, walaysat 'indahu jadha'aaun wa'indahu hiqqaaun, faiinnahaa tuqbalu minhu alhiqqaau wayaj'alu ma'ahaa shaatayni iini astaysarataa lahu aaw 'ishriyna dirhamana, waman balaghat 'indahu sadaqaau alhiqqaai walaysat 'indahu alhiqqaau wa'indahu aljadha'aau, faiinnahaa tuqbalu minhu aljadha'aau, wayu'tiyhi almusaddiqu 'ishriyna dirhamana aaw shaatayni, waman balaghat 'indahu sadaqaau alhiqqaai walaysat 'indahu iilaaa bintu labuwnin faiinnahaa tuqbalu minhu bintu labuwnin, wayu'tiy shaatayni aaw 'ishriyna dirhamana, waman balaghat sadaqatuhu binta labuwnin wa'indahu hiqqaaun faiinnahaa tuqbalu minhu alhiqqaau wayu'tiyhi almusaddiqu 'ishriyna dirhamana aaw shaatayni, waman balaghat sadaqatuhu binta labuwnin walaysat 'indahu wa'indahu bintu makhaadin, faiinnahaa tuqbalu minhu bintu makhaadin wayu'tiy ma'ahaa 'ishriyna dirhamana aaw shaatayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Abu Bakr , wrote to me about the Zakat which Allah had ordered His Apostle to observe: Whoever had to pay Jadha (Jadha means a four-year-old she-camel) as Zakat from his herd of camels and he had not got one, and he had Hiqqa (three-year-old she-camel), that Hiqqa should be accepted from him along with two sheep if they were available or twenty Dirhams (one Durham equals about 1/4 Saudi Riyal) and whoever had to pay Hiqqa as Zakat and he had no Hiqqa but had a Jadha, the Jadha should be accepted from him, and the Zakat collector should repay him twenty Dirhams or two sheep; and whoever had to pay Hiqqa as Zakat and he had not got one, but had a Bint Labun (two-year-old she-camel), it should be accepted from him along with two sheep or twenty Dirhams; and whoever had to pay Bint Labun and had a Hiqqa, that Hiqqa should be accepted from him and the Zakat collector should repay him twenty Dirhams or two sheep; and whoever had to pay Bint Labun and he had not got one but had a Bint Makhad (one-year-old she camel), that Bint Makhad should be accepted from him along with twenty Dirhams or two sheep
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُثَنَّى الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنِي ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَتَبَ لَهُ هَذَا الْكِتَابَ لَمَّا وَجَّهَهُ إِلَى الْبَحْرَيْنِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ‏ "‏ هَذِهِ فَرِيضَةُ الصَّدَقَةِ الَّتِي فَرَضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَالَّتِي أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا رَسُولَهُ، فَمَنْ سُئِلَهَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَلَى وَجْهِهَا فَلْيُعْطِهَا، وَمَنْ سُئِلَ فَوْقَهَا فَلاَ يُعْطِ فِي أَرْبَعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ مِنَ الإِبِلِ فَمَا دُونَهَا مِنَ الْغَنَمِ مِنْ كُلِّ خَمْسٍ شَاةٌ، إِذَا بَلَغَتْ خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَثَلاَثِينَ فَفِيهَا بِنْتُ مَخَاضٍ أُنْثَى، فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ سِتًّا وَثَلاَثِينَ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ فَفِيهَا بِنْتُ لَبُونٍ أُنْثَى، فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ سِتًّا وَأَرْبَعِينَ إِلَى سِتِّينَ فَفِيهَا حِقَّةٌ طَرُوقَةُ الْجَمَلِ، فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ وَاحِدَةً وَسِتِّينَ إِلَى خَمْسٍ وَسَبْعِينَ فَفِيهَا جَذَعَةٌ، فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ ـ يَعْنِي ـ سِتًّا وَسَبْعِينَ إِلَى تِسْعِينَ فَفِيهَا بِنْتَا لَبُونٍ، فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ إِحْدَى وَتِسْعِينَ إِلَى عِشْرِينَ وَمِائَةٍ فَفِيهَا حِقَّتَانِ طَرُوقَتَا الْجَمَلِ، فَإِذَا زَادَتْ عَلَى عِشْرِينَ وَمِائَةٍ فَفِي كُلِّ أَرْبَعِينَ بِنْتُ لَبُونٍ، وَفِي كُلِّ خَمْسِينَ حِقَّةٌ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ إِلاَّ أَرْبَعٌ مِنَ الإِبِلِ فَلَيْسَ فِيهَا صَدَقَةٌ، إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشَاءَ رَبُّهَا، فَإِذَا بَلَغَتْ خَمْسًا مِنَ الإِبِلِ فَفِيهَا شَاةٌ، وَفِي صَدَقَةِ الْغَنَمِ فِي سَائِمَتِهَا إِذَا كَانَتْ أَرْبَعِينَ إِلَى عِشْرِينَ وَمِائَةٍ شَاةٌ، فَإِذَا زَادَتْ عَلَى عِشْرِينَ وَمِائَةٍ إِلَى مِائَتَيْنِ شَاتَانِ، فَإِذَا زَادَتْ عَلَى مِائَتَيْنِ إِلَى ثَلاَثِمِائَةٍ فَفِيهَا ثَلاَثٌ، فَإِذَا زَادَتْ عَلَى ثَلاَثِمِائَةٍ فَفِي كُلِّ مِائَةٍ شَاةٌ، فَإِذَا كَانَتْ سَائِمَةُ الرَّجُلِ نَاقِصَةً مِنْ أَرْبَعِينَ شَاةً وَاحِدَةً فَلَيْسَ فِيهَا صَدَقَةٌ، إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشَاءَ رَبُّهَا، وَفِي الرِّقَةِ رُبْعُ الْعُشْرِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ إِلاَّ تِسْعِينَ وَمِائَةً فَلَيْسَ فِيهَا شَىْءٌ، إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشَاءَ رَبُّهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni almuthannaa alaansaariyyu, qaala haddathaniy aabiy qaala, haddathaniy thumaamaau bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aanasin, aanna aanasana, haddathahu aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh kataba lahu hadhaa alkitaaba lammaa wajjahahu iilaa albahrayni bismi alllahi alrrahmani alrrahiymi ‏ "‏ hadhihi fariydaau alssadaqaai allatiy farada rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa almuslimiyna, waallatiy aamara alllahu bihaa rasuwlahu, faman suiilahaa mina almuslimiyna 'alaa wajhihaa falyu'tihaa, waman suiila fawqahaa falaa yu'ti fiy aarba'in wa'ishriyna mina aliibili famaa duwnahaa mina alghanami min kulli khamsin shaaaun, iidhaa balaghat khamsana wa'ishriyna iilaa khamsin wathalaathiyna fafiyhaa bintu makhaadin aunthaa, faiidhaa balaghat sittana wathalaathiyna iilaa khamsin waaarba'iyna fafiyhaa bintu labuwnin aunthaa, faiidhaa balaghat sittana waaarba'iyna iilaa sittiyna fafiyhaa hiqqaaun taruwqaau aljamali, faiidhaa balaghat waahidaaan wasittiyna iilaa khamsin wasab'iyna fafiyhaa jadha'aaun, faiidhaa balaghat ya'niy sittana wasab'iyna iilaa tis'iyna fafiyhaa bintaa labuwnin, faiidhaa balaghat iihdaa watis'iyna iilaa 'ishriyna wamiaiaain fafiyhaa hiqqataani taruwqataa aljamali, faiidhaa zaadat 'alaa 'ishriyna wamiaiaain fafiy kulli aarba'iyna bintu labuwnin, wafiy kulli khamsiyna hiqqaaun, waman lam yakun ma'ahu iilaaa aarba'un mina aliibili falaysa fiyhaa sadaqaaun, iilaaa aan yashaa'a rabbuhaa, faiidhaa balaghat khamsana mina aliibili fafiyhaa shaaaun, wafiy sadaqaai alghanami fiy saaiimatihaa iidhaa kaanat aarba'iyna iilaa 'ishriyna wamiaiaain shaaaun, faiidhaa zaadat 'alaa 'ishriyna wamiaiaain iilaa miaiatayni shaataani, faiidhaa zaadat 'alaa miaiatayni iilaa thalaathimiaiaain fafiyhaa thalaathun, faiidhaa zaadat 'alaa thalaathimiaiaain fafiy kulli miaiaain shaaaun, faiidhaa kaanat saaiimaau alrrajuli naaqisaaan min aarba'iyna shaaaan waahidaaan falaysa fiyhaa sadaqaaun, iilaaa aan yashaa'a rabbuhaa, wafiy alrriqaai rub'u al'ushri, faiin lam takun iilaaa tis'iyna wamiaiaaan falaysa fiyhaa shaa'un, iilaaa aan yashaa'a rabbuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:When Abu Bakr; sent me to (collect the Zakat from) Bahrain, he wrote to me the following:-- (In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful). These are the orders for compulsory charity (Zakat) which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had made obligatory for every Muslim, and which Allah had ordered His Apostle to observe: Whoever amongst the Muslims is asked to pay Zakat accordingly, he should pay it (to the Zakat collector) and whoever is asked more than that (what is specified in this script) he should not pay it; for twenty-four camels or less, sheep are to be paid as Zakat; for every five camels one sheep is to be paid, and if there are between twenty-five to thirty-five camels, one Bint Makhad is to be paid; and if there are between thirty-six to forty-five (camels), one Bint Labun is to be paid; and if there are between forty-six to sixty (camels), one Hiqqa is to be paid; and if the number is between sixty-one to seventy-five (camels), one Jadha is to be paid; and if the number is between seventy-six to ninety (camels), two Bint Labuns are to be paid; and if they are from ninety-one to one-hundredand twenty (camels), two Hiqqas are to be paid; and if they are over one-hundred and-twenty (camels), for every forty (over one-hundred-and-twenty) one Bint Labun is to be paid, and for every fifty camels (over one-hundred-and-twenty) one Hiqqa is to be paid; and who ever has got only four camels, has to pay nothing as Zakat, but if the owner of these four camels wants to give something, he can. If the number of camels increases to five, the owner has to pay one sheep as Zakat. As regards the Zakat for the (flock) of sheep; if they are between forty and one-hundred-and-twenty sheep, one sheep is to be paid; and if they are between one-hundred-and-twenty to two hundred (sheep), two sheep are to be paid; and if they are between two-hundred to three-hundred (sheep), three sheep are to be paid; and for over three-hundred sheep, for every extra hundred sheep, one sheep is to be paid as Zakat. And if somebody has got less than forty sheep, no Zakat is required, but if he wants to give, he can. For silver the Zakat is one-fortieth of the lot (i.e. 2.5%), and if its value is less than two-hundred Dirhams, Zakat is not required, but if the owner wants to pay he can
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنِي ثُمَامَةُ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَتَبَ لَهُ ‏{‏الصَّدَقَةَ‏}‏ الَّتِي أَمَرَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَلاَ يُخْرَجُ فِي الصَّدَقَةِ هَرِمَةٌ، وَلاَ ذَاتُ عَوَارٍ، وَلاَ تَيْسٌ، إِلاَّ مَا شَاءَ الْمُصَدِّقُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy aabiy qaala, haddathaniy thumaamaau, aanna aanasana rda allh 'nh haddathahu aanna aabaa bakrin rda allh 'nh kataba lahu ‏{‏alssadaqaaa‏}‏ allatiy aamara alllahu rasuwlahu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ walaa yukhraju fiy alssadaqaai harimaaun, walaa dhaatu 'awaarin, walaa taysun, iilaaa maa shaa'a almusaddiqu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:Abu Bakr wrote to me what Allah had ordered His Apostle (about Zakat) which goes: Neither an old nor a defected animal, nor a male-goat may be taken as Zakat except if the Zakat collector wishes (to take it)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ح وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ وَاللَّهِ لَوْ مَنَعُونِي عَنَاقًا كَانُوا يُؤَدُّونَهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَقَاتَلْتُهُمْ عَلَى مَنْعِهَا‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَمَا هُوَ إِلاَّ أَنْ رَأَيْتُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ شَرَحَ صَدْرَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ بِالْقِتَالِ، فَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzuuhriyii, h waqaala allaaythu hadaathaniy 'abdu alraahmani bnu khaalidin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi allaahi bni 'abdi allaahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, aanaa aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh waallaahi law mana'uwniy 'anaaqana kaanuwa yuuaduuwnahaa iilaa rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laqaataltuhum 'alaa man'ihaa‏.‏ qaala 'umaru rda allh 'nh famaa huwa iilaaa aan raaaytu aanaa allaaha sharaha sadra aabiy bakrin rda allh 'nh bialqitaali, fa'araftu aanaahu alhaquu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Abu Bakr said, "By Allah! If they (pay me the Zakat and) withhold even a young (female) goat which they used to pay during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I will fight with them for it." `Umar said, "It was nothing but Allah Who opened Abu Bakr's chest towards the decision to fight, and I came to know that his decision was right
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَيْفِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْبَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا بَعَثَ مُعَاذًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَلَى الْيَمَنِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّكَ تَقْدَمُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ أَهْلِ كِتَابٍ، فَلْيَكُنْ أَوَّلَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ عِبَادَةُ اللَّهِ، فَإِذَا عَرَفُوا اللَّهَ فَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ فَرَضَ عَلَيْهِمْ خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍ فِي يَوْمِهِمْ وَلَيْلَتِهِمْ، فَإِذَا فَعَلُوا، فَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ فَرَضَ عَلَيْهُمْ زَكَاةً ‏{‏تُؤْخَذُ‏}‏ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَتُرَدُّ عَلَى فُقَرَائِهِمْ، فَإِذَا أَطَاعُوا بِهَا فَخُذْ مِنْهُمْ، وَتَوَقَّ كَرَائِمَ أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aumayyaau bnu bistaamin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa rawhu bnu alqaasimi, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aumayyaaa, 'an yahyaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni sayfiyyin, 'an aabiy ma'badin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lammaa ba'atha mu'aadhana rda allh 'nh 'alaa alyamani qaala ‏ "‏ iinnaka taqdamu 'alaa qawmin aahli kitaabin, falyakun aawwala maa tad'uwhum iilayhi 'ibaadaau alllahi, faiidhaa 'arafuwa alllaha faaakhbirhum aanna alllaha qad farada 'alayhim khamsa salawaatin fiy yawmihim walaylatihim, faiidhaa fa'aluwa, faaakhbirhum aanna alllaha farada 'alayhum zakaaaan ‏{‏tuukhadhu‏}‏ min aamwaalihim waturaddu 'alaa fuqaraaiihim, faiidhaa aataa'uwa bihaa fakhudh minhum, watawaqqa karaaiima aamwaali alnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent Mu`adh to Yemen, he said (to him), "YOU are going to people of a (Divine) Book. First of all invite them to worship Allah (alone) and when they come to know Allah, inform them that Allah has enjoined on them, five prayers in every day and night; and if they start offering these prayers, inform them that Allah has enjoined on them, the Zakat. And it is to be taken from the rich amongst them and given to the poor amongst them; and if they obey you in that, take Zakat from them and avoid (don't take) the best property of the people as Zakat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ الْمَازِنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ مِنَ التَّمْرِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ أَوَاقٍ مِنَ الْوَرِقِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَلَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسِ ذَوْدٍ مِنَ الإِبِلِ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy sa'sa'aaa almaaziniyyi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laysa fiymaa duwna khamsaai aawsuqin mina alttamri sadaqaaun, walaysa fiymaa duwna khamsi aawaaqin mina alwariqi sadaqaaun, walaysa fiymaa duwna khamsi dhawdin mina aliibili sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "No Zakat is imposed on less than five Awsuq of dates; no Zakat is imposed on less than five Awaq of silver, and no Zakat is imposed on less than five camels
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ انْتَهَيْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ ـ أَوْ وَالَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ، أَوْ كَمَا حَلَفَ ـ مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ تَكُونُ لَهُ إِبِلٌ أَوْ بَقَرٌ أَوْ غَنَمٌ لاَ يُؤَدِّي حَقَّهَا إِلاَّ أُتِيَ بِهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَعْظَمَ مَا تَكُونُ وَأَسْمَنَهُ، تَطَؤُهُ بِأَخْفَافِهَا، وَتَنْطَحُهُ بِقُرُونِهَا، كُلَّمَا جَازَتْ أُخْرَاهَا رُدَّتْ عَلَيْهِ أُولاَهَا، حَتَّى يُقْضَى بَيْنَ النَّاسِ ‏"‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ بُكَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'ani alma'ruwri bni suwaydin, 'an aabiy dharrin rda allh 'nh qaala antahaytu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi aaw waalladhiy laa iilaha ghayruhu, aaw kamaa halafa maa min rajulin takuwnu lahu iibilun aaw baqarun aaw ghanamun laa yuuaddiy haqqahaa iilaaa autiya bihaa yawma alqiyaamaai aa'zama maa takuwnu waaasmanahu, tatauuhu biaakhfaafihaa, watantahuhu biquruwnihaa, kullamaa jaazat aukhraahaa ruddat 'alayhi auwlaahaa, hattaa yuqdaa bayna alnnaasi ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu bukayrun 'an aabiy saalihin 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Dhar:Once I went to him (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) and he said, "By Allah in Whose Hands my life is (or probably said, 'By Allah, except Whom none has the right to be worshipped) whoever had camels or cows or sheep and did not pay their Zakat, those animals will be brought on the Day of Resurrection far bigger and fatter than before and they will tread him under their hooves, and will butt him with their horns, and (those animals will come in circle): When the last does its turn, the first will start again, and this punishment will go on till Allah has finished the judgments amongst the people
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ كَانَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَكْثَرَ الأَنْصَارِ بِالْمَدِينَةِ مَالاً مِنْ نَخْلٍ، وَكَانَ أَحَبَّ أَمْوَالِهِ إِلَيْهِ بَيْرُحَاءَ وَكَانَتْ مُسْتَقْبِلَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْخُلُهَا وَيَشْرَبُ مِنْ مَاءٍ فِيهَا طَيِّبٍ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَلَمَّا أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ‏}‏ قَامَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى يَقُولُ ‏{‏لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ‏}‏ وَإِنَّ أَحَبَّ أَمْوَالِي إِلَىَّ بَيْرُحَاءَ، وَإِنَّهَا صَدَقَةٌ لِلَّهِ أَرْجُو بِرَّهَا وَذُخْرَهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، فَضَعْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ حَيْثُ أَرَاكَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَخْ، ذَلِكَ مَالٌ رَابِحٌ، ذَلِكَ مَالٌ رَابِحٌ، وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ مَا قُلْتَ وَإِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهَا فِي الأَقْرَبِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَفْعَلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَقَسَمَهَا أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فِي أَقَارِبِهِ وَبَنِي عَمِّهِ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ رَوْحٌ‏.‏ وَقَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ عَنْ مَالِكٍ رَايِحٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin rda allh 'nh yaquwlu kaana aabuw talhaaa aakthara alaansaari bialmadiynaai maalaan min nakhlin, wakaana aahabba aamwaalihi iilayhi bayruhaa'a wakaanat mustaqbilaaa almasjidi, wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadkhuluhaa wayashrabu min maa'in fiyhaa tayyibin qaala aanasun falammaa aunzilat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏lan tanaaluwa albirra hattaa tunfiquwa mimmaa tuhibbuwna‏}‏ qaama aabuw talhaaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ iinna alllaha tabaaraka wata'aalaa yaquwlu ‏{‏lan tanaaluwa albirra hattaa tunfiquwa mimmaa tuhibbuwna‏}‏ waiinna aahabba aamwaaliy iilaaaa bayruhaa'a, waiinnahaa sadaqaaun lillahi aarjuw birrahaa wadhukhrahaa 'inda alllahi, fada'haa yaa rasuwla alllahi haythu aaraaka alllahu‏.‏ qaala faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ bakh, dhalika maalun raabihun, dhalika maalun raabihun, waqad sami'tu maa qulta waiinniy aaraa aan taj'alahaa fiy alaaqrabiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala aabuw talhaaa aaf'alu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ faqasamahaa aabuw talhaaa fiy aaqaaribihi wabaniy 'ammihi‏.‏ taaba'ahu rawhun‏.‏ waqaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa waiismaa'iylu 'an maalikin raayihun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Is-haq bin `Abdullah bin Abi Talha:I heard Anas bin Malik saying, "Abu Talha had more property of date-palm trees gardens than any other amongst the Ansar in Medina and the most beloved of them to him was Bairuha garden, and it was in front of the Mosque of the Prophet (ﷺ) . Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to go there and used to drink its nice water." Anas added, "When these verses were revealed:--'By no means shall you Attain righteousness unless You spend (in charity) of that Which you love. ' (3.92) Abu Talha said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Allah, the Blessed, the Superior says: By no means shall you attain righteousness, unless you spend (in charity) of that which you love. And no doubt, Bairuha' garden is the most beloved of all my property to me. So I want to give it in charity in Allah's Cause. I expect its reward from Allah. O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Spend it where Allah makes you think it feasible.' On that Allah's Apostle said, 'Bravo! It is useful property. I have heard what you have said (O Abu Talha), and I think it would be proper if you gave it to your Kith and kin.' Abu Talha said, I will do so, O Allah's Apostle.' Then Abu Talha distributed that garden amongst his relatives and his cousins
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زَيْدٌ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَضْحًى أَوْ فِطْرٍ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَوَعَظَ النَّاسَ وَأَمَرَهُمْ بِالصَّدَقَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تَصَدَّقُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَمَرَّ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ النِّسَاءِ تَصَدَّقْنَ، فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُكُنَّ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْنَ وَبِمَ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ تُكْثِرْنَ اللَّعْنَ وَتَكْفُرْنَ الْعَشِيرَ، مَا رَأَيْتُ مِنْ نَاقِصَاتِ عَقْلٍ وَدِينٍ أَذْهَبَ لِلُبِّ الرَّجُلِ الْحَازِمِ مِنْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ يَا مَعْشَرَ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَلَمَّا صَارَ إِلَى مَنْزِلِهِ جَاءَتْ زَيْنَبُ امْرَأَةُ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ تَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَيْهِ فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذِهِ زَيْنَبُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَىُّ الزَّيَانِبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقِيلَ امْرَأَةُ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمِ ائْذَنُوا لَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأُذِنَ لَهَا قَالَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ أَمَرْتَ الْيَوْمَ بِالصَّدَقَةِ، وَكَانَ عِنْدِي حُلِيٌّ لِي، فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَتَصَدَّقَ بِهِ، فَزَعَمَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ أَنَّهُ وَوَلَدَهُ أَحَقُّ مَنْ تَصَدَّقْتُ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ صَدَقَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، زَوْجُكِ وَوَلَدُكِ أَحَقُّ مَنْ تَصَدَّقْتِ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaala aakhbaraniy zaydun, 'an 'iyaadi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy aadhana aaw fitrin iilaa almusallaa thumma ansarafa fawa'aza alnnaasa waaamarahum bialssadaqaai faqaala ‏"‏ aayyuhaa alnnaasu tasaddaquwa ‏"‏‏.‏ famarra 'alaa alnnisaa'i faqaala ‏"‏ yaa ma'shara alnnisaa'i tasaddaqna, faiinniy raaaytukunna aakthara aahli alnnaari ‏"‏‏.‏ faqulna wabima dhalika yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ tukthirna allla'na watakfurna al'ashiyra, maa raaaytu min naaqisaati 'aqlin wadiynin aadhhaba lilubbi alrrajuli alhaazimi min iihdaakunna yaa ma'shara alnnisaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma ansarafa falammaa saara iilaa manzilihi jaa'at zaynabu amraaaau abni mas'uwdin tastaadhinu 'alayhi faqiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi hadhihi zaynabu faqaala ‏"‏ aaaau alzzayaanibi ‏"‏‏.‏ faqiyla amraaaau abni mas'uwdin‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ na'ami aidhanuwa lahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faaudhina lahaa qaalat yaa nabiyya alllahi iinnaka aamarta alyawma bialssadaqaai, wakaana 'indiy huliyyun liy, faaaradtu aan aatasaddaqa bihi, faza'ama abnu mas'uwdin aannahu wawaladahu aahaqqu man tasaddaqtu bihi 'alayhim‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ sadaqa abnu mas'uwdin, zawjuki wawaladuki aahaqqu man tasaddaqti bihi 'alayhim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:On `Id ul Fitr or `Id ul Adha Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to the Musalla. After finishing the prayer, he delivered the sermon and ordered the people to give alms. He said, "O people! Give alms." Then he went towards the women and said, "O women! Give alms, for I have seen that the majority of the dwellers of Hell-Fire were you (women)." The women asked, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is the reason for it?" He replied, "O women! You curse frequently, and are ungrateful to your husbands. I have not seen anyone more deficient in intelligence and religion than you. O women, some of you can lead a cautious wise man astray." Then he left. And when he reached his house, Zainab, the wife of Ibn Mas`ud, came and asked permission to enter It was said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! It is Zainab." He asked, 'Which Zainab?" The reply was that she was the wife of Ibn Mas'ud. He said, "Yes, allow her to enter." And she was admitted. Then she said, "O Prophet of Allah! Today you ordered people to give alms and I had an ornament and intended to give it as alms, but Ibn Mas`ud said that he and his children deserved it more than anybody else." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Ibn Mas`ud had spoken the truth. Your husband and your children had more right to it than anybody else
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ فِي فَرَسِهِ وَغُلاَمِهِ صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, qaala sami'tu sulaymaana bna yasaarin, 'an 'iraaki bni maalikin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laysa 'alaa almuslimi fiy farasihi waghulaamihi sadaqaaun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There is no Zakat either on a horse or a slave belonging to a Muslim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ خُثَيْمِ بْنِ عِرَاكٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خُثَيْمُ بْنُ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ صَدَقَةٌ فِي عَبْدِهِ وَلاَ فِي فَرَسِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa musadaadun, hadaathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an khuthaymi bni 'iraakin, qaala hadaathaniy aabiy, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ hadaathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, hadaathanaa wuhaybu bnu khaalidin, hadaathanaa khuthaymu bnu 'iraaki bni maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laysa 'alaa almuslimi sadaqaaun fiy 'abdihi walaa fiy farasihi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no Zakat either on a slave or on a horse belonging to a Muslim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَلَسَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَجَلَسْنَا حَوْلَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي مِمَّا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِي مَا يُفْتَحُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ زَهْرَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَوَيَأْتِي الْخَيْرُ بِالشَّرِّ فَسَكَتَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقِيلَ لَهُ مَا شَأْنُكَ تُكَلِّمُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلاَ يُكَلِّمُكَ فَرَأَيْنَا أَنَّهُ يُنْزَلُ عَلَيْهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ـ فَمَسَحَ عَنْهُ الرُّحَضَاءَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ السَّائِلُ ‏"‏ وَكَأَنَّهُ حَمِدَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لاَ يَأْتِي الْخَيْرُ بِالشَّرِّ، وَإِنَّ مِمَّا يُنْبِتُ الرَّبِيعُ يَقْتُلُ أَوْ يُلِمُّ إِلاَّ آكِلَةَ الْخَضْرَاءِ، أَكَلَتْ حَتَّى إِذَا امْتَدَّتْ خَاصِرَتَاهَا اسْتَقْبَلَتْ عَيْنَ الشَّمْسِ، فَثَلَطَتْ وَبَالَتْ وَرَتَعَتْ، وَإِنَّ هَذَا الْمَالَ خَضِرَةٌ حُلْوَةٌ، فَنِعْمَ صَاحِبُ الْمُسْلِمِ مَا أَعْطَى مِنْهُ الْمِسْكِينَ وَالْيَتِيمَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ ـ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَإِنَّهُ مَنْ يَأْخُذُهُ بِغَيْرِ حَقِّهِ كَالَّذِي يَأْكُلُ وَلاَ يَشْبَعُ، وَيَكُونُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu fadaalaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an yahyaa, 'an hilaali bni aabiy maymuwnaaa, haddathanaa 'ataa'u bnu yasaarin, aannahu sami'a aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya rda allh 'nh yuhaddithu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm jalasa dhaata yawmin 'alaa alminbari wajalasnaa hawlahu faqaala ‏"‏ iinniy mimmaa aakhaafu 'alaykum min ba'diy maa yuftahu 'alaykum min zahraai alddunyaa waziynatihaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi aawayaatiy alkhayru bialshharri fasakata alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqiyla lahu maa shaanuka tukallimu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm walaa yukallimuka faraaaynaa aannahu yunzalu 'alayhi‏.‏ qaala famasaha 'anhu alrruhadaa'a faqaala ‏"‏ aayna alssaaiilu ‏"‏ wakaaannahu hamidahu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinnahu laa yaatiy alkhayru bialshharri, waiinna mimmaa yunbitu alrrabiy'u yaqtulu aaw yulimmu iilaaa akilaaa alkhadraa'i, aakalat hattaa iidhaa amtaddat khaasirataahaa astaqbalat 'ayna alshhamsi, fathalatat wabaalat warata'at, waiinna hadhaa almaala khadiraaun hulwaaun, fani'ma saahibu almuslimi maa aa'taa minhu almiskiyna waalyatiyma waabna alssabiyli aaw kamaa qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waiinnahu man yaakhudhuhu bighayri haqqihi kaalladhiy yaakulu walaa yashba'u, wayakuwnu shahiydana 'alayhi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) sat on a pulpit and we sat around him. Then he said, "The things I am afraid of most for your sake (concerning what will befall you after me) is the pleasures and splendors of the world and its beauties which will be disclosed to you." Somebody said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Can the good bring forth evil?" The Prophet (ﷺ) remained silent for a while. It was said to that person, "What is wrong with you? You are talking to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he is not talking to you." Then we noticed that he was being inspired divinely. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) wiped off his sweat and said, "Where is the questioner?" It seemed as if the Prophet (ﷺ) liked his question. Then he said, "Good never brings forth evil. Indeed it is like what grows on the banks of a water-stream which either kill or make the animals sick, except if an animal eats its fill the Khadira (a kind of vegetable) and then faces the sun, and then defecates and urinates and grazes again. No doubt this wealth is sweet and green. Blessed is the wealth of a Muslim from which he gives to the poor, the orphans and to needy travelers. (Or the Prophet said something similar to it) No doubt, whoever takes it illegally will be like the one who eats but is never satisfied, and his wealth will be a witness against him on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي شَقِيقٌ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ، امْرَأَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ فَذَكَرْتُهُ لإِبْرَاهِيمَ فَحَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ زَيْنَبَ امْرَأَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بِمِثْلِهِ سَوَاءً، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَرَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَصَدَّقْنَ وَلَوْ مِنْ حُلِيِّكُنَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ زَيْنَبُ تُنْفِقُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَيْتَامٍ فِي حَجْرِهَا، قَالَ فَقَالَتْ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ سَلْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيَجْزِي عَنِّي أَنْ أُنْفِقَ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى أَيْتَامِي فِي حَجْرِي مِنَ الصَّدَقَةِ فَقَالَ سَلِي أَنْتِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَوَجَدْتُ امْرَأَةً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ عَلَى الْبَابِ، حَاجَتُهَا مِثْلُ حَاجَتِي، فَمَرَّ عَلَيْنَا بِلاَلٌ فَقُلْنَا سَلِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيَجْزِي عَنِّي أَنْ أُنْفِقَ عَلَى زَوْجِي وَأَيْتَامٍ لِي فِي حَجْرِي وَقُلْنَا لاَ تُخْبِرْ بِنَا‏.‏ فَدَخَلَ فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ هُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ زَيْنَبُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَىُّ الزَّيَانِبِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ امْرَأَةُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ لَهَا أَجْرَانِ أَجْرُ الْقَرَابَةِ وَأَجْرُ الصَّدَقَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, qaala haddathaniy shaqiyqun, 'an 'amriw bni alhaarithi, 'an zaynaba, amraaaai 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma qaala fadhakartuhu liibraahiyma fahaddathaniy iibraahiymu 'an aabiy 'ubaydaaa 'an 'amriw bni alhaarithi 'an zaynaba amraaaai 'abdi alllahi bimithlihi sawaa'an, qaalat kuntu fiy almasjidi faraaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ tasaddaqna walaw min huliyyikunna ‏"‏‏.‏ wakaanat zaynabu tunfiqu 'alaa 'abdi alllahi waaaytaamin fiy hajrihaa, qaala faqaalat li'abdi alllahi sal rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aayajziy 'anniy aan aunfiqa 'alayka wa'alaa aaytaamiy fiy hajriy mina alssadaqaai faqaala saliy aanti rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ faantalaqtu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ fawajadtu amraaaaan mina alaansaari 'alaa albaabi, haajatuhaa mithlu haajatiy, famarra 'alaynaa bilaalun faqulnaa sali alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aayajziy 'anniy aan aunfiqa 'alaa zawjiy waaaytaamin liy fiy hajriy waqulnaa laa tukhbir binaa‏.‏ fadakhala fasaaalahu faqaala ‏"‏ man humaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala zaynabu qaala ‏"‏ aaaau alzzayaanibi ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala amraaaau 'abdi alllahi‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ na'am lahaa aajraani aajru alqaraabaai waaajru alssadaqaai ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr bin Al-Harith:Zainab, the wife of `Abdullah said, "I was in the Mosque and saw the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, 'O women ! Give alms even from your ornaments.' " Zainab used to provide for `Abdullah and those orphans who were under her protection. So she said to `Abdullah, "Will you ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whether it will be sufficient for me to spend part of the Zakat on you and the orphans who are under my protection?" He replied "Will you yourself ask Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ?" (Zainab added): So I went to the Prophet and I saw there an Ansari woman who was standing at the door (of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) with a similar problem as mine. Bilal passed by us and we asked him, 'Ask the Prophet (ﷺ) whether it is permissible for me to spend (the Zakat) on my husband and the orphans under my protection.' And we requested Bilal not to inform the Prophet (ﷺ) about us. So Bilal went inside and asked the Prophet (ﷺ) regarding our problem. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Who are those two?" Bilal replied that she was Zainab. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Which Zainab?" Bilal said, "The wife of `Abdullah (bin Mas`ud)." The Prophet said, "Yes, (it is sufficient for her) and she will receive a double reward (for that): One for helping relatives, and the other for giving Zakat
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، ‏{‏عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ،‏}‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلِيَ أَجْرٌ أَنْ أُنْفِقَ عَلَى بَنِي أَبِي سَلَمَةَ إِنَّمَا هُمْ بَنِيَّ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنْفِقِي عَلَيْهِمْ، فَلَكِ أَجْرُ مَا أَنْفَقْتِ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an zaynaba abnaai aummi salamaaa, ‏{‏'an aummi salamaaa, ‏}‏ qaalat qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aaliya aajrun aan aunfiqa 'alaa baniy aabiy salamaaa iinnamaa hum baniyya‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ aanfiqiy 'alayhim, falaki aajru maa aanfaqti 'alayhim ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Zainab:(the daughter of Um Salama) My mother said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shall I receive a reward if I spend for the sustenance of Abu Salama's offspring, and in fact they are also my sons?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Spend on them and you will get a reward for what you spend on them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالصَّدَقَةِ فَقِيلَ مَنَعَ ابْنُ جَمِيلٍ وَخَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ وَعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا يَنْقِمُ ابْنُ جَمِيلٍ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَأَغْنَاهُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، وَأَمَّا خَالِدٌ فَإِنَّكُمْ تَظْلِمُونَ خَالِدًا، قَدِ احْتَبَسَ أَدْرَاعَهُ وَأَعْتُدَهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، وَأَمَّا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَعَمُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَهْىَ عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ وَمِثْلُهَا مَعَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ هِيَ عَلَيْهِ وَمِثْلُهَا مَعَهَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ حُدِّثْتُ عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ بِمِثْلِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala aamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialssadaqaai faqiyla mana'a abnu jamiylin wakhaalidu bnu alwaliydi wa'abbaasu bnu 'abdi almuttalibi‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa yanqimu abnu jamiylin iilaaa aannahu kaana faqiyrana faaaghnaahu alllahu warasuwluhu, waaammaa khaalidun faiinnakum tazlimuwna khaalidana, qadi ahtabasa aadraa'ahu waaa'tudahu fiy sabiyli alllahi, waaammaa al'abbaasu bnu 'abdi almuttalibi fa'ammu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fahaa 'alayhi sadaqaaun wamithluhaa ma'ahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu abnu aabiy alzzinaadi 'an aabiyhi‏.‏ waqaala abnu iishaaqa 'an aabiy alzzinaadi hiya 'alayhi wamithluhaa ma'ahaa‏.‏ waqaala abnu jurayjin huddithtu 'ani alaa'raji bimithlihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered (a person) to collect Zakat, and that person returned and told him that Ibn Jamil, Khalid bin Al-Walid, and `Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib had refused to give Zakat." The Prophet said, "What made Ibn Jamil refuse to give Zakat though he was a poor man, and was made wealthy by Allah and His Apostle ? But you are unfair in asking Zakat from Khalid as he is keeping his armor for Allah's Cause (for Jihad). As for `Abbas bin `Abdul Muttalib, he is the uncle of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and Zakat is compulsory on him and he should pay it double
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ نَاسًا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ سَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَعْطَاهُمْ، ثُمَّ سَأَلُوهُ فَأَعْطَاهُمْ، حَتَّى نَفِدَ مَا عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا يَكُونُ عِنْدِي مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَنْ أَدَّخِرَهُ عَنْكُمْ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَعْفِفْ يُعِفَّهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَغْنِ يُغْنِهِ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَتَصَبَّرْ يُصَبِّرْهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَا أُعْطِيَ أَحَدٌ عَطَاءً خَيْرًا وَأَوْسَعَ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda alllaythiyyi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi rda allh 'nh aanna naasana mina alaansaari saaaluwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaa'taahum, thumma saaaluwhu faaa'taahum, hattaa nafida maa 'indahu faqaala ‏ "‏ maa yakuwnu 'indiy min khayrin falan aaddakhirahu 'ankum, waman yasta'fif yu'iffahu alllahu, waman yastaghni yughnihi alllahu, waman yatasabbar yusabbirhu alllahu, wamaa au'tiya aahadun 'ataa'an khayrana waaawsa'a mina alssabri ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Some Ansari persons asked for (something) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he gave them. They again asked him for (something) and he again gave them. And then they asked him and he gave them again till all that was with him finished. And then he said "If I had anything. I would not keep it away from you. (Remember) Whoever abstains from asking others, Allah will make him contented, and whoever tries to make himself self-sufficient, Allah will make him self-sufficient. And whoever remains patient, Allah will make him patient. Nobody can be given a blessing better and greater than patience
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لأَنْ يَأْخُذَ أَحَدُكُمْ حَبْلَهُ فَيَحْتَطِبَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ رَجُلاً، فَيَسْأَلَهُ، أَعْطَاهُ أَوْ مَنَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laan yaakhudha aahadukum hablahu fayahtatiba 'alaa zahrihi khayrun lahu min aan yaatiya rajulaan, fayasaalahu, aa'taahu aaw mana'ahu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my life is, it is better for anyone of you to take a rope and cut the wood (from the forest) and carry it over his back and sell it (as a means of earning his living) rather than to ask a person for something and that person may give him or not
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لأَنْ يَأْخُذَ أَحَدُكُمْ حَبْلَهُ فَيَأْتِيَ بِحُزْمَةِ الْحَطَبِ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ فَيَبِيعَهَا فَيَكُفَّ اللَّهُ بِهَا وَجْهَهُ، خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ النَّاسَ أَعْطَوْهُ أَوْ مَنَعُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alzzubayri bni al'awwaami rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laan yaakhudha aahadukum hablahu fayaatiya bihuzmaai alhatabi 'alaa zahrihi fayabiy'ahaa fayakuffa alllahu bihaa wajhahu, khayrun lahu min aan yasaala alnnaasa aa'tawhu aaw mana'uwhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Az-Zubair bin Al-`Awwam:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "It is better for anyone of you to take a rope (and cut) and bring a bundle of wood (from the forest) over his back and sell it and Allah will save his face (from the Hell-Fire) because of that, rather than to ask the people who may give him or not
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ حَكِيمَ بْنَ حِزَامٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَعْطَانِي، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَأَعْطَانِي، ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَأَعْطَانِي ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا حَكِيمُ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَالَ خَضِرَةٌ حُلْوَةٌ، فَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِسَخَاوَةِ نَفْسٍ بُورِكَ لَهُ فِيهِ، وَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِإِشْرَافِ نَفْسٍ لَمْ يُبَارَكْ لَهُ فِيهِ كَالَّذِي يَأْكُلُ وَلاَ يَشْبَعُ، الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ حَكِيمٌ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ لاَ أَرْزَأُ أَحَدًا بَعْدَكَ شَيْئًا حَتَّى أُفَارِقَ الدُّنْيَا، فَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَدْعُو حَكِيمًا إِلَى الْعَطَاءِ فَيَأْبَى أَنْ يَقْبَلَهُ مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ دَعَاهُ لِيُعْطِيَهُ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَقْبَلَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُكُمْ يَا مَعْشَرَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَلَى حَكِيمٍ، أَنِّي أَعْرِضُ عَلَيْهِ حَقَّهُ مِنْ هَذَا الْفَىْءِ فَيَأْبَى أَنْ يَأْخُذَهُ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَرْزَأْ حَكِيمٌ أَحَدًا مِنَ النَّاسِ بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى تُوُفِّيَ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, wasa'iydi bni almusayyabi, aanna hakiyma bna hizaamin rda allh 'nh qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaa'taaniy, thumma saaaltuhu faaa'taaniy, thumma saaaltuhu faaa'taaniy thumma qaala ‏ "‏ yaa hakiymu iinna hadhaa almaala khadiraaun hulwaaun, faman aakhadhahu bisakhaawaai nafsin buwrika lahu fiyhi, waman aakhadhahu biiishraafi nafsin lam yubaarak lahu fiyhi kaalladhiy yaakulu walaa yashba'u, alyadu al'ulyaa khayrun mina alyadi alssuflaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala hakiymun faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi laa aarzaau aahadana ba'daka shayiana hattaa aufaariqa alddunyaa, fakaana aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh yad'uw hakiymana iilaa al'ataa'i fayaabaa aan yaqbalahu minhu, thumma iinna 'umara rda allh 'nh da'aahu liyu'tiyahu faaabaa aan yaqbala minhu shayiana‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru iinniy aushhidukum yaa ma'shara almuslimiyna 'alaa hakiymin, aanniy aa'ridu 'alayhi haqqahu min hadhaa alfaa'i fayaabaa aan yaakhudhahu‏.‏ falam yarzaa hakiymun aahadana mina alnnaasi ba'da rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa tuwuffiya‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Urwa bin Az-Zubair and Sa`id bin Al-Musaiyab:Hakim bin Hizam said, "(Once) I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (for something) and he gave it to me. Again I asked and he gave (it to me). Again I asked and he gave (it to me). And then he said, "O Hakim! This property is like a sweet fresh fruit; whoever takes it without greediness, he is blessed in it, and whoever takes it with greediness, he is not blessed in it, and he is like a person who eats but is never satisfied; and the upper (giving) hand is better than the lower (receiving) hand." Hakim added, "I said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) , 'By Him (Allah) Who sent you with the Truth, I shall never accept anything from anybody after you, till I leave this world.' " Then Abu Bakr (during his caliphate) called Hakim to give him his share from the war booty (like the other companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) ), he refused to accept anything. Then `Umar (during his caliphate) called him to give him his share but he refused. On that `Umar said, "O Muslims! I would like you to witness that I offered Hakim his share from this booty and he refused to take it." So Hakim never took anything from anybody after the Prophet (ﷺ) till he died
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعْطِينِي الْعَطَاءَ فَأَقُولُ أَعْطِهِ مَنْ هُوَ أَفْقَرُ إِلَيْهِ مِنِّي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ خُذْهُ، إِذَا جَاءَكَ مِنْ هَذَا الْمَالِ شَىْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ غَيْرُ مُشْرِفٍ وَلاَ سَائِلٍ، فَخُذْهُ، وَمَا لاَ فَلاَ تُتْبِعْهُ نَفْسَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu 'umara, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yu'tiyniy al'ataa'a faaaquwlu aa'tihi man huwa aafqaru iilayhi minniy faqaala ‏ "‏ khudhhu, iidhaa jaa'aka min hadhaa almaali shaa'un, waaanta ghayru mushrifin walaa saaiilin, fakhudhhu, wamaa laa falaa tutbi'hu nafsaka ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to give me something but I would say to him, "would you give it to a poorer and more needy one than l?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Take it. If you are given something from this property, without asking for it or having greed for it take it; and if not given, do not run for it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حَمْزَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا يَزَالُ الرَّجُلُ يَسْأَلُ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لَيْسَ فِي وَجْهِهِ مُزْعَةُ لَحْمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ تَدْنُو يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الْعَرَقُ نِصْفَ الأُذُنِ، فَبَيْنَا هُمْ كَذَلِكَ اسْتَغَاثُوا بِآدَمَ، ثُمَّ بِمُوسَى، ثُمَّ بِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏‏.‏ وَزَادَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ‏"‏ فَيَشْفَعُ لِيُقْضَى بَيْنَ الْخَلْقِ، فَيَمْشِي حَتَّى يَأْخُذَ بِحَلْقَةِ الْبَابِ، فَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَبْعَثُهُ اللَّهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا، يَحْمَدُهُ أَهْلُ الْجَمْعِ كُلُّهُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُعَلًّى حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، أَخِي الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَسْأَلَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy ja'farin, qaala sami'tu hamzaaa bna 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna 'umara rda allh 'nh qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa yazaalu alrrajulu yasaalu alnnaasa hattaa yaatiya yawma alqiyaamaai laysa fiy wajhihi muz'aau lahmin ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala iinna alshhamsa tadnuw yawma alqiyaamaai hattaa yablugha al'araqu nisfa alaudhuni, fabaynaa hum kadhalika astaghaathuwa biadama, thumma bimuwsaa, thumma bimuhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏‏.‏ wazaada 'abdu alllahi haddathaniy alllaythu haddathaniy abnu aabiy ja'farin ‏"‏ fayashfa'u liyuqdaa bayna alkhalqi, fayamshiy hattaa yaakhudha bihalqaai albaabi, fayawmaiidhin yab'athuhu alllahu maqaamana mahmuwdana, yahmaduhu aahlu aljam'i kulluhum ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala mu'allana haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'ani alnnu'maani bni raashidin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni muslimin, aakhiy alzzuhriyyi 'an hamzaaa, sami'a abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy almasaalaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A man keeps on asking others for something till he comes on the Day of Resurrection without any piece of flesh on his face." The Prophet (ﷺ) added, "On the Day of Resurrection, the Sun will come near (to, the people) to such an extent that the sweat will reach up to the middle of the ears, so, when all the people are in that state, they will ask Adam for help, and then Moses, and then Muhammad (ﷺ) ." The sub-narrator added "Muhammad will intercede with Allah to judge amongst the people. He will proceed on till he will hold the ring of the door (of Paradise) and then Allah will exalt him to Maqam Mahmud (the privilege of intercession, etc.). And all the people of the gathering will send their praises to Allah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ الْمِسْكِينُ الَّذِي تَرُدُّهُ الأُكْلَةُ وَالأُكْلَتَانِ، وَلَكِنِ الْمِسْكِينُ الَّذِي لَيْسَ لَهُ غِنًى وَيَسْتَحْيِي أَوْ لاَ يَسْأَلُ النَّاسَ إِلْحَافًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'baau, aakhbaraniy muhammadu bnu ziyaadin, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laysa almiskiynu alladhiy tarudduhu alauklaau waalauklataani, walakini almiskiynu alladhiy laysa lahu ghinana wayastahyiy aaw laa yasaalu alnnaasa iilhaafana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The poor person is not the one who asks a morsel or two (of meals) from the others, but the poor is the one who has nothing and is ashamed to beg from others
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَشْوَعَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي كَاتِبُ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ كَتَبَ مُعَاوِيَةُ إِلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ أَنِ اكْتُبْ، إِلَىَّ بِشَىْءٍ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَرِهَ لَكُمْ ثَلاَثًا قِيلَ وَقَالَ، وَإِضَاعَةَ الْمَالِ، وَكَثْرَةَ السُّؤَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, haddathanaa khaalidun alhadhhaa'u, 'ani abni aashwa'a, 'ani alshha'biyyi, haddathaniy kaatibu almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, qaala kataba mu'aawiyaau iilaa almughiyraai bni shu'baaa aani aktub, iilaaaa bishaa'in sami'tahu mina alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ fakataba iilayhi sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha kariha lakum thalaathana qiyla waqaala, waiidaa'aaa almaali, wakathraaa alssuuaali ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ash-Shu`bi:The clerk of Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba narrated, "Muawiya wrote to Al-Mughira bin Shu`ba: Write to me something which you have heard from the Prophet (ﷺ) ." So Al-Mughira wrote: I heard the Prophet saying, "Allah has hated for you three things: -1. Vain talks, (useless talk) that you talk too much or about others. -2. Wasting of wealth (by extravagance) -3. And asking too many questions (in disputed religious matters) or asking others for something (except in great need). (See Hadith No. 591, Vol. Ill)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ غُرَيْرٍ الزُّهْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَعْطَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَهْطًا وَأَنَا جَالِسٌ فِيهِمْ قَالَ فَتَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهُمْ رَجُلاً لَمْ يُعْطِهِ، وَهُوَ أَعْجَبُهُمْ إِلَىَّ، فَقُمْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَارَرْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ مَا لَكَ عَنْ فُلاَنٍ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأُرَاهُ مُؤْمِنًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْ مُسْلِمًا ‏"‏ قَالَ فَسَكَتُّ قَلِيلاً ثُمَّ غَلَبَنِي مَا أَعْلَمُ فِيهِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ مَا لَكَ عَنْ فُلاَنٍ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأُرَاهُ مُؤْمِنًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْ مُسْلِمًا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَكَتُّ قَلِيلاً ثُمَّ غَلَبَنِي مَا أَعْلَمُ فِيهِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَكَ عَنْ فُلاَنٍ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأُرَاهُ مُؤْمِنًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْ مُسْلِمًا ـ يَعْنِي فَقَالَ ـ إِنِّي لأُعْطِي الرَّجُلَ وَغَيْرُهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْهُ، خَشْيَةَ أَنْ يُكَبَّ فِي النَّارِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ صَالِحٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ هَذَا فَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ فَضَرَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ فَجَمَعَ بَيْنَ عُنُقِي وَكَتِفِي ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَقْبِلْ أَىْ سَعْدُ إِنِّي لأُعْطِي الرَّجُلَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏{‏فَكُبْكِبُوا‏}‏ قُلِبُوا ‏{‏مُكِبًّا‏}‏ أَكَبَّ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا كَانَ فِعْلُهُ غَيْرَ وَاقِعٍ عَلَى أَحَدٍ، فَإِذَا وَقَعَ الْفِعْلُ قُلْتَ كَبَّهُ اللَّهُ لِوَجْهِهِ، وَكَبَبْتُهُ أَنَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ghurayrin alzzuhriyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an aabiyhi, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'aamiru bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala aa'taa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rahtana waaanaa jaalisun fiyhim qaala fataraka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm minhum rajulaan lam yu'tihi, wahuwa aa'jabuhum iilaaaa, faqumtu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaarartuhu faqultu maa laka 'an fulaanin waalllahi iinniy lauraahu muuminana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aaw muslimana ‏"‏ qaala fasakattu qaliylaan thumma ghalabaniy maa aa'lamu fiyhi faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ maa laka 'an fulaanin waalllahi iinniy lauraahu muuminana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aaw muslimana ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala fasakattu qaliylaan thumma ghalabaniy maa aa'lamu fiyhi faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi maa laka 'an fulaanin waalllahi iinniy lauraahu muuminana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aaw muslimana ya'niy faqaala iinniy lau'tiy alrrajula waghayruhu aahabbu iilaaaa minhu, khashyaaa aan yukabba fiy alnnaari 'alaa wajhihi ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'an aabiyhi 'an saalihin 'an iismaa'iyla bni muhammadin aannahu qaala sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu hadhaa faqaala fiy hadiythihi fadaraba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi fajama'a bayna 'unuqiy wakatifiy thumma qaala ‏"‏ aaqbil aaa sa'du iinniy lau'tiy alrrajula ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abdi alllahi ‏{‏fakubkibuwa‏}‏ qulibuwa ‏{‏mukibbana‏}‏ aakabba alrrajulu iidhaa kaana fi'luhu ghayra waaqi'in 'alaa aahadin, faiidhaa waqa'a alfi'lu qulta kabbahu alllahu liwajhihi, wakababtuhu aanaa‏.‏
