verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ إِلَى مَكَّةَ، ثُمَّ قَدِمْنَا جَمْعًا، فَصَلَّى الصَّلاَتَيْنِ، كُلَّ صَلاَةٍ وَحْدَهَا بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَةٍ، وَالْعَشَاءُ بَيْنَهُمَا، ثُمَّ صَلَّى الْفَجْرَ حِينَ طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ، قَائِلٌ يَقُولُ طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ‏.‏ وَقَائِلٌ يَقُولُ لَمْ يَطْلُعِ الْفَجْرُ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ هَاتَيْنِ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ حُوِّلَتَا عَنْ وَقْتِهِمَا فِي هَذَا الْمَكَانِ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ، فَلاَ يَقْدَمُ النَّاسُ جَمْعًا حَتَّى يُعْتِمُوا، وَصَلاَةَ الْفَجْرِ هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ وَقَفَ حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَفَاضَ الآنَ أَصَابَ السُّنَّةَ‏.‏ فَمَا أَدْرِي أَقَوْلُهُ كَانَ أَسْرَعَ أَمْ دَفْعُ عُثْمَانَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يُلَبِّي حَتَّى رَمَى جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu rajaa'in, haddathanaa iisraaiiylu, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, qaala kharajnaa ma'a 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh iilaa makkaaa, thumma qadimnaa jam'ana, fasallaa alssalaatayni, kulla salaaain wahdahaa biaadhaanin waiiqaamaain, waal'ashaa'u baynahumaa, thumma sallaa alfajra hiyna tala'a alfajru, qaaiilun yaquwlu tala'a alfajru‏.‏ waqaaiilun yaquwlu lam yatlu'i alfajru‏.‏ thumma qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna haatayni alssalaatayni huwwilataa 'an waqtihimaa fiy hadhaa almakaani almaghriba waal'ishaa'a, falaa yaqdamu alnnaasu jam'ana hattaa yu'timuwa, wasalaaaa alfajri hadhihi alssaa'aaa ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma waqafa hattaa aasfara, thumma qaala law aanna aamiyra almuuminiyna aafaada alana aasaaba alssunnaaa‏.‏ famaa aadriy aaqawluhu kaana aasra'a aam daf'u 'uthmaana rda allh 'nh falam yazal yulabbiy hattaa ramaa jamraaa al'aqabaai yawma alnnahri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdur-Rahman bin Yazid:I went out with `Abdullah to Mecca and when we proceeded to Jam', he offered the two prayers (the Maghrib and the `Isha') together, making the Adhan and Iqama separately for each prayer. He took his supper in between the two prayers. He offered the Fajr prayer as soon as the day dawned. Some people said, "The day had dawned (at the time of the prayer)," and others said, "The day had not dawned." `Abdullah then said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'These two prayers have been shifted from their stated times at this place only (at Al-Muzdalifa); first: The Maghrib and the `Isha'. So the people should not arrive at Al-Muzdalifa till the time of the `Isha' prayer has become due. The second prayer is the morning prayer which is offered at this hour.' " Then `Abdullah stayed there till it became a bit brighter. He then said, "If the chief of the believers hastened onwards to Mina just now, then he had indeed followed the Sunna." I do not know which proceeded the other, his (`Abdullah's) statement or the departure of `Uthman . `Abdullah was reciting Talbiya till he threw pebbles at the Jamrat-Al- `Aqaba on the Day of Nahr (slaughtering) (that is the 10th of Dhul-Hijja)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ مَيْمُونٍ، يَقُولُ شَهِدْتُ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ صَلَّى بِجَمْعٍ الصُّبْحَ، ثُمَّ وَقَفَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْمُشْرِكِينَ كَانُوا لاَ يُفِيضُونَ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ، وَيَقُولُونَ أَشْرِقْ ثَبِيرُ‏.‏ وَأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَالَفَهُمْ، ثُمَّ أَفَاضَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu minhaalin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, sami'tu 'amraw bna maymuwnin, yaquwlu shahidtu 'umara rda allh 'nh sallaa bijam'in alssubha, thumma waqafa faqaala iinna almushrikiyna kaanuwa laa yufiyduwna hattaa tatlu'a alshhamsu, wayaquwluwna aashriq thabiyru‏.‏ waaanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm khaalafahum, thumma aafaada qabla aan tatlu'a alshhamsu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amr bin Maimun:I saw `Umar, offering the Fajr (morning) prayer at Jam'; then he got up and said, "The pagans did not use to depart (from Jam') till the sun had risen, and they used to say, 'Let the sun shine on Thabir (a mountain).' But the Prophet (ﷺ) contradicted them and departed from Jam' before sunrise
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْدَفَ الْفَضْلَ، فَأَخْبَرَ الْفَضْلُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَزَلْ يُلَبِّي حَتَّى رَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin alddahhaaku bnu makhladin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aardafa alfadla, faaakhbara alfadlu aannahu lam yazal yulabbiy hattaa ramaa aljamraaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) made Al-Fadl ride behind him, and Al-Fadl informed that he (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) kept on reciting Talbiya till he did the Rami of the Jamra. (Jamrat-Al-`Aqaba)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ يُونُسَ الأَيْلِيِّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ رِدْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ عَرَفَةَ إِلَى الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ، ثُمَّ أَرْدَفَ الْفَضْلَ مِنَ الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ إِلَى مِنًى ـ قَالَ ـ فَكِلاَهُمَا قَالاَ لَمْ يَزَلِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُلَبِّي حَتَّى رَمَى جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an yuwnusa alaayliyyi, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna ausaamaaa bna zaydin rda allh 'nhma kaana ridfa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm min 'arafaaa iilaa almuzdalifaai, thumma aardafa alfadla mina almuzdalifaai iilaa minana qaala fakilaahumaa qaalaa lam yazali alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yulabbiy hattaa ramaa jamraaa al'aqabaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Ubaidullah bin `Abdullah:Ibn `Abbas said, "Usama bin Zaid rode behind the Prophet (ﷺ) from `Arafat to Al-Muzdalifa; and then from Al-Muzdalifa to Mina, Al-Fadl rode behind him." He added, "Both of them (Usama and Al-Fadl) said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) was constantly reciting Talbiya till he did Rami of the Jamarat-Al-`Aqaba
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَمْرَةَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ، فَأَمَرَنِي بِهَا، وَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْهَدْىِ، فَقَالَ فِيهَا جَزُورٌ أَوْ بَقَرَةٌ أَوْ شَاةٌ أَوْ شِرْكٌ فِي دَمٍ قَالَ وَكَأَنَّ نَاسًا كَرِهُوهَا، فَنِمْتُ فَرَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنَّ إِنْسَانًا يُنَادِي حَجٌّ مَبْرُورٌ، وَمُتْعَةٌ مُتَقَبَّلَةٌ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ سُنَّةُ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَقَالَ آدَمُ وَوَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ وَغُنْدَرٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عُمْرَةٌ مُتَقَبَّلَةٌ، وَحَجٌّ مَبْرُورٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa alnnadru, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, haddathanaa aabuw jamraaa, qaala saaaltu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'ani almut'aai, faaamaraniy bihaa, wasaaaltuhu 'ani alhadai, faqaala fiyhaa jazuwrun aaw baqaraaun aaw shaaaun aaw shirkun fiy damin qaala wakaaanna naasana karihuwhaa, fanimtu faraaaytu fiy almanaami kaaanna iinsaanana yunaadiy hajjun mabruwrun, wamut'aaun mutaqabbalaaun‏.‏ faaataytu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma fahaddathtuhu faqaala alllahu aakbaru sunnaau aabiy alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala waqaala adamu wawahbu bnu jariyrin waghundarun 'an shu'baaa 'umraaun mutaqabbalaaun, wahajjun mabruwrun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Jamra:I asked Ibn `Abbas about Hajj-at-Tamattu`. He ordered me to perform it. I asked him about the Hadi (sacrifice). He said, "You have to slaughter a camel, a cow or a sheep, or you may share the Hadi with the others." It seemed that some people disliked it (Hajj-at-Tamattu`). I slept and dreamt as if a person was announcing: "Hajj Mabrur and accepted Mut'ah (Hajj-at-Tamattu`)" I went to Ibn `Abbas and narrated it to him. He said, "Allah is Greater. (That was) the tradition of Abu Al-Qasim (i.e. Prophet). Narrated Shu`ba that the call in the dream was. "An accepted `Umra and Hajj-Mabrur
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى رَجُلاً يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا، وَيْلَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوْ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa rajulaan yasuwqu badanaaan faqaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala iinnahaa badanaaun‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala iinnahaa badanaaun‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa, waylaka ‏"‏‏.‏ fiy althhaalithaai aaw fiy althhaaniyaai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira':Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw a man driving his Badana (sacrificial camel). He said, "Ride on it." The man said, "It is a Badana." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Ride on it." He (the man) said, "It is a Badana." The Prophet said, "Ride on it." And on the second or the third time he (the Prophet (ﷺ) ) added, "Woe to you
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، وَشُعْبَةُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى رَجُلاً يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa hishaamun, washu'baau, qaalaa haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa rajulaan yasuwqu badanaaan, faqaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala iinnahaa badanaaun‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala iinnahaa badanaaun‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ thalaathana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a man driving a Badana. He said, "Ride on it." The man replied, "It is a Badana." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (again), "Ride on it." He (the man) said, "It is a Badana." The Prophet (ﷺ) said thrice, "Ride on it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ تَمَتَّعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ، وَأَهْدَى فَسَاقَ مَعَهُ الْهَدْىَ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ، وَبَدَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَهَلَّ بِالْعُمْرَةِ، ثُمَّ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ، فَتَمَتَّعَ النَّاسُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ، فَكَانَ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ أَهْدَى فَسَاقَ الْهَدْىَ، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَمْ يُهْدِ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ، قَالَ لِلنَّاسِ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ أَهْدَى فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَحِلُّ لِشَىْءٍ حَرُمَ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ حَجَّهُ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ أَهْدَى فَلْيَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ، وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، وَلْيُقَصِّرْ، وَلْيَحْلِلْ، ثُمَّ لِيُهِلَّ بِالْحَجِّ، فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ هَدْيًا فَلْيَصُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فِي الْحَجِّ وَسَبْعَةً إِذَا رَجَعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَطَافَ حِينَ قَدِمَ مَكَّةَ، وَاسْتَلَمَ الرُّكْنَ أَوَّلَ شَىْءٍ، ثُمَّ خَبَّ ثَلاَثَةَ أَطْوَافٍ، وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا، فَرَكَعَ حِينَ قَضَى طَوَافَهُ بِالْبَيْتِ عِنْدَ الْمَقَامِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ، فَانْصَرَفَ فَأَتَى الصَّفَا فَطَافَ بِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ سَبْعَةَ أَطْوَافٍ، ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْلِلْ مِنْ شَىْءٍ حَرُمَ مِنْهُ حَتَّى قَضَى حَجَّهُ وَنَحَرَ هَدْيَهُ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، وَأَفَاضَ فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ، ثُمَّ حَلَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَرُمَ مِنْهُ، وَفَعَلَ مِثْلَ مَا فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْ أَهْدَى وَسَاقَ الْهَدْىَ مِنَ النَّاسِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala tamatta'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i bial'umraai iilaa alhajji, waaahdaa fasaaqa ma'ahu alhadaa min dhiy alhulayfaai, wabadaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaahalla bial'umraai, thumma aahalla bialhajji, fatamatta'a alnnaasu ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bial'umraai iilaa alhajji, fakaana mina alnnaasi man aahdaa fasaaqa alhadaa, waminhum man lam yuhdi, falammaa qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm makkaaa, qaala lilnnaasi ‏ "‏ man kaana minkum aahdaa faiinnahu laa yahillu lishaa'in haruma minhu hattaa yaqdiya hajjahu, waman lam yakun minkum aahdaa falyatuf bialbayti, wabialssafaa waalmarwaai, walyuqassir, walyahlil, thumma liyuhilla bialhajji, faman lam yajid hadyana falyasum thalaathaaa aayyaamin fiy alhajji wasab'aaan iidhaa raja'a iilaa aahlihi ‏"‏‏.‏ fataafa hiyna qadima makkaaa, waastalama alrrukna aawwala shaa'in, thumma khabba thalaathaaa aatwaafin, wamashaa aarba'ana, faraka'a hiyna qadaa tawaafahu bialbayti 'inda almaqaami rak'atayni, thumma sallama, faansarafa faaataa alssafaa fataafa bialssafaa waalmarwaai sab'aaa aatwaafin, thumma lam yahlil min shaa'in haruma minhu hattaa qadaa hajjahu wanahara hadyahu yawma alnnahri, waaafaada fataafa bialbayti, thumma halla min kulli shaa'in haruma minhu, wafa'ala mithla maa fa'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm man aahdaa wasaaqa alhadaa mina alnnaasi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:During the last Hajj (Hajj-al-Wada`) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he performed `Umra and Hajj. He drove a Hadi along with him from Dhul-Hulaifa. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) started by assuming Ihram for `Umra and Hajj. And the people, too, performed the `Umra and Hajj along with the Prophet. Some of them brought the Hadi and drove it along with them, while the others did not. So, when the Prophet (ﷺ) arrived at Mecca. he said to the people, "Whoever among you has driven the Hadi, should not finish his Ihram till he completes his Hajj. And whoever among you has not (driven) the Hadi with him, should perform Tawaf of the Ka`ba and the Tawaf between Safa and Marwa, then cut short his hair and finish his Ihram, and should later assume Ihram for Hajj; but he must offer a Hadi (sacrifice); and if anyone cannot afford a Hadi, he should fast for three days during the Hajj and seven days when he returns home. The Prophet (ﷺ) performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba on his arrival (at Mecca); he touched the (Black Stone) corner first of all and then did Ramal (fast walking with moving of the shoulders) during the first three rounds round the Ka`ba, and during the last four rounds he walked. After finishing Tawaf of the Ka`ba, he offered a two rak`at prayer at Maqam Ibrahim, and after finishing the prayer he went to Safa and Marwa and performed seven rounds of Tawaf between them and did not do any deed forbidden because of Ihram, till he finished all the ceremonies of his Hajj and sacrificed his Hadi on the day of Nahr (10th day of Dhul-Hijja). He then hastened onwards (to Mecca) and performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba and then everything that was forbidden because of Ihram became permissible. Those who took and drove the Hadi with them did the same as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَعَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي تَمَتُّعِهِ بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ فَتَمَتَّعَ النَّاسُ مَعَهُ بِمِثْلِ الَّذِي أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'an 'urwaaa, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aakhbarathu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy tamattu'ihi bial'umraai iilaa alhajji fatamatta'a alnnaasu ma'ahu bimithli alladhiy aakhbaraniy saalimun 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Urwa:" 'Aishah informed me about the Hajj and 'Umra (together) of the Prophet (ﷺ) and so did the people who were with him (during the Hajj and 'Umra) and narration similar to the narration of the Ibn 'Umar (previous hadith)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ لأَبِيهِ أَقِمْ، فَإِنِّي لاَ آمَنُهَا أَنْ سَتُصَدُّ عَنِ الْبَيْتِ‏.‏ قَالَ إِذًا أَفْعَلَ كَمَا فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ‏}‏ فَأَنَا أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي الْعُمْرَةَ‏.‏ فَأَهَلَّ بِالْعُمْرَةِ، قَالَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِالْبَيْدَاءِ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ، وَقَالَ مَا شَأْنُ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ إِلاَّ وَاحِدٌ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اشْتَرَى الْهَدْىَ مِنْ قُدَيْدٍ، ثُمَّ قَدِمَ فَطَافَ لَهُمَا طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا، فَلَمْ يَحِلَّ حَتَّى حَلَّ مِنْهُمَا جَمِيعًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhm laabiyhi aaqim, faiinniy laa amanuhaa aan satusaddu 'ani albayti‏.‏ qaala iidhana aaf'ala kamaa fa'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad qaala alllahu ‏{‏laqad kaana lakum fiy rasuwli alllahi auswaaun hasanaaun‏}‏ faaanaa aushhidukum aanniy qad aawjabtu 'alaa nafsiy al'umraaa‏.‏ faaahalla bial'umraai, qaala thumma kharaja hattaa iidhaa kaana bialbaydaa'i aahalla bialhajji waal'umraai, waqaala maa shaanu alhajji waal'umraai iilaaa waahidun‏.‏ thumma ashtaraa alhadaa min qudaydin, thumma qadima fataafa lahumaa tawaafana waahidana, falam yahilla hattaa halla minhumaa jamiy'ana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah (bin `Abdullah) bin `Umar said to his father, "Stay here, for I am afraid that it (affliction between Ibn Az-Zubair and Al-Hajjaj) might prevent you from reaching the Ka`ba." Ibn `Umar said, "(In this case) I would do the same as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did, and Allah has said, 'Verily, in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), you have a good example (to follow).' So, I make you, people, witness that I have made `Umra compulsory for me." So he assumed Ihram for `Umra. Then he went out and when he reached Al- Baida', he assumed Ihram for Hajj and `Umra (together) and said, "The conditions (requisites) of Hajj and `Umra are the same." He, then brought a Hadi from Qudaid. Then he arrived (at Mecca) and performed Tawaf (between Safa and Marwa) once for both Hajj and `Umra and did not finish the Ihram till he had finished both Hajj and `Umra
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، وَمَرْوَانَ، قَالاَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ زَمَنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانُوا بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ قَلَّدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْهَدْىَ وَأَشْعَرَ وَأَحْرَمَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'ani almiswari bni makhramaaa, wamarwaana, qaalaa kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm mina almadiynaai zamana alhudaybiyaai fiy bid'a 'ashraaa miaiaaan min aashaabihi, hattaa iidhaa kaanuwa bidhiy alhulayfaai qallada alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alhadaa waaash'ara waaahrama bial'umraai‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Miswar bin Makhrama and Marwan:The Prophet (ﷺ) set out from Medina with over one thousand of his companions (at the time of the Treaty of Hudaibiya) and when they reached Dhul-Hulaifa, the Prophet (ﷺ) garlanded his Hadi and marked it and assumed Ihram for `Umra
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ فَتَلْتُ قَلاَئِدَ بُدْنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَىَّ، ثُمَّ قَلَّدَهَا وَأَشْعَرَهَا وَأَهْدَاهَا، فَمَا حَرُمَ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ كَانَ أُحِلَّ لَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa aaflahu, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat fataltu qalaaiida budni alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadaaaa, thumma qalladahaa waaash'arahaa waaahdaahaa, famaa haruma 'alayhi shaa'un kaana auhilla lahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I twisted with my own hands the garlands for the Budn of the Prophet (ﷺ) who garlanded and marked them, and then made them proceed to Mecca; Yet no permissible thing was regarded as illegal for him then
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، رضى الله عنهم قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا شَأْنُ النَّاسِ حَلُّوا وَلَمْ تَحْلِلْ أَنْتَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لَبَّدْتُ رَأْسِي، وَقَلَّدْتُ هَدْيِي، فَلاَ أَحِلُّ حَتَّى أَحِلَّ مِنَ الْحَجِّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, qaala aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an hafsaaa, rda allh 'nhm qaalat qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi maa shaanu alnnaasi halluwa walam tahlil aanta qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy labbadtu raasiy, waqalladtu hadyiy, falaa aahillu hattaa aahilla mina alhajji ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Hafsa:I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is wrong with the people, they have finished their Ihram but you have not?" He said, "I matted my hair and I have garlanded my Hadi, so I will not finish my Ihram till I have finished my Hajj
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، وَعَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُهْدِي مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ، فَأَفْتِلُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْيِهِ، ثُمَّ لاَ يَجْتَنِبُ شَيْئًا مِمَّا يَجْتَنِبُهُ الْمُحْرِمُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, haddathanaa alllaythu, haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, wa'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhdiy mina almadiynaai, faaaftilu qalaaiida hadyihi, thumma laa yajtanibu shayiana mimmaa yajtanibuhu almuhrimu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to send the Hadi from Medina and I used to twist the garlands for his Hadi and he did not keep away from any of these things which a Muhrim keeps away from
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ فَتَلْتُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْىِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ أَشْعَرَهَا وَقَلَّدَهَا ـ أَوْ قَلَّدْتُهَا ـ ثُمَّ بَعَثَ بِهَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ، وَأَقَامَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَمَا حَرُمَ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ كَانَ لَهُ حِلٌّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa aaflahu bnu humaydin, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat fataltu qalaaiida hadai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma aash'arahaa waqalladahaa aaw qalladtuhaa thumma ba'atha bihaa iilaa albayti, waaaqaama bialmadiynaai, famaa haruma 'alayhi shaa'un kaana lahu hillun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I twisted the garlands for the Hadis of the Prophet (ﷺ) and then he marked and garlanded them (or I garlanded them) and then made them proceed to the Ka`ba but he remained in Medina and no permissible thing was regarded as illegal for him then
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ زِيَادَ بْنَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ كَتَبَ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ مَنْ أَهْدَى هَدْيًا حَرُمَ عَلَيْهِ مَا يَحْرُمُ عَلَى الْحَاجِّ حَتَّى يُنْحَرَ هَدْيُهُ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَمْرَةُ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ لَيْسَ كَمَا قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَا فَتَلْتُ قَلاَئِدَ هَدْىِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَىَّ، ثُمَّ قَلَّدَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدَيْهِ، ثُمَّ بَعَثَ بِهَا مَعَ أَبِي فَلَمْ يَحْرُمْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَىْءٌ أَحَلَّهُ اللَّهُ حَتَّى نُحِرَ الْهَدْىُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakri bni 'amriw bni hazmin, 'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahaa aakhbarathu aanna ziyaada bna aabiy sufyaana kataba iilaa 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha iinna 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala man aahdaa hadyana haruma 'alayhi maa yahrumu 'alaa alhaajji hattaa yunhara hadyuhu‏.‏ qaalat 'amraau faqaalat 'aaiishaau rda allh 'nha laysa kamaa qaala abnu 'abbaasin, aanaa fataltu qalaaiida hadai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadaaaa, thumma qalladahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadayhi, thumma ba'atha bihaa ma'a aabiy falam yahrum 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shaa'un aahallahu alllahu hattaa nuhira alhadau‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Abu Bakr bin `Amr bin Hazm:That `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman had told him, "Zaid bin Abu Sufyan wrote to `Aisha that `Abdullah bin `Abbas had stated, 'Whoever sends his Hadi (to the Ka`ba), all the things which are illegal for a (pilgrim) become illegal for that person till he slaughters it (i.e. till the 10th of Dhul-Hijja).' " `Amra added, `Aisha said, 'It is not like what Ibn `Abbas had said: I twisted the garlands of the Hadis of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with my own hands. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put them round their necks with his own hands, sending them with my father; Yet nothing permitted by Allah was considered illegal for Allah's Apostle till he slaughtered the Hadis
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ أَهْدَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّةً غَنَمًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat aahdaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm marraaan ghanamana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) sent sheep as Hadi
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ الْقَلاَئِدَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيُقَلِّدُ الْغَنَمَ، وَيُقِيمُ فِي أَهْلِهِ حَلاَلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kuntu aaftilu alqalaaiida lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fayuqallidu alghanama, wayuqiymu fiy aahlihi halaalaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I used to make the garlands for (the Hadis of) the Prophet (ﷺ) and he would garland the sheep (with them) and would stay with his family as a non-Muhrim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ الْمُعْتَمِرِ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ قَلاَئِدَ الْغَنَمِ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَبْعَثُ بِهَا، ثُمَّ يَمْكُثُ حَلاَلاً‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa mansuwru bnu almu'tamiri, ‏.‏ wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat kuntu aaftilu qalaaiida alghanami lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fayab'athu bihaa, thumma yamkuthu halaalaan‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha:I used to twist the garlands for the sheep of the Prophet (ﷺ) and he would send them (to the Ka`ba), and stay as a non-Muhrim
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ فَتَلْتُ لِهَدْىِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ تَعْنِي الْقَلاَئِدَ ـ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُحْرِمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, 'an 'aamirin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat fataltu lihadai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ta'niy alqalaaiida qabla aan yuhrima‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I twisted (the garlands) for the Hadis of the Prophet (ﷺ) before he assumed Ihram
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ فَتَلْتُ قَلاَئِدَهَا مِنْ عِهْنٍ كَانَ عِنْدِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an aummi almuuminiyna rda allh 'nha qaalat fataltu qalaaiidahaa min 'ihnin kaana 'indiy‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:I twisted the garlands of the Hadis from the wool which was with me
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى رَجُلاً يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً، قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْكَبْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ رَاكِبَهَا يُسَايِرُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّعْلُ فِي عُنُقِهَا‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa muhamaadun, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, 'an ma'marin, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanaa nabiyaa allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa rajulaan yasuwqu badanaaan, qaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala iinaahaa badanaaun‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ arkabhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala falaqad raaaytuhu raakibahaa yusaayiru alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm waalnaa'lu fiy 'unuqihaa‏.‏ taaba'ahu muhamaadu bnu bashaaarin hadaathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, aakhbaranaa 'aliyuu bnu almubaaraki, 'an yahyaa, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ikrima:Abu Huraira said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) saw a man driving a Badana (sacrificial camel). The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), 'Ride on it.' He replied, 'It is a Badana.' The Prophet (ﷺ) again said, 'Ride on it!' Abu Huraira added, 'Then I saw that man riding it, showing obedience to the Prophet (ﷺ), and a shoe was (hanging) from its neck.' " Narrated Abu Huraira: From the Prophet: (as above)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَتَصَدَّقَ بِجِلاَلِ الْبُدْنِ الَّتِي نَحَرْتُ وَبِجُلُودِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qabiysaau, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh qaala aamaraniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan aatasaddaqa bijilaali albudni allatiy nahartu wabijuluwdihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered me to give in charity the skin and the coverings of the Budn which I had slaughtered
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو ضَمْرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ أَرَادَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ الْحَجَّ عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْحَرُورِيَّةِ فِي عَهْدِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فَقِيلَ لَهُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ كَائِنٌ بَيْنَهُمْ قِتَالٌ، وَنَخَافُ أَنْ يَصُدُّوكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏{‏لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ‏}‏ إِذًا أَصْنَعَ كَمَا صَنَعَ، أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي أَوْجَبْتُ عُمْرَةً‏.‏ حَتَّى كَانَ بِظَاهِرِ الْبَيْدَاءِ قَالَ مَا شَأْنُ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ إِلاَّ وَاحِدٌ، أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي جَمَعْتُ حَجَّةً مَعَ عُمْرَةٍ‏.‏ وَأَهْدَى هَدْيًا مُقَلَّدًا اشْتَرَاهُ حَتَّى قَدِمَ، فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبِالصَّفَا، وَلَمْ يَزِدْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ، وَلَمْ يَحْلِلْ مِنْ شَىْءٍ حَرُمَ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَوْمِ النَّحْرِ، فَحَلَقَ وَنَحَرَ وَرَأَى أَنْ قَدْ قَضَى طَوَافَهُ الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ بِطَوَافِهِ الأَوَّلِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ كَذَلِكَ صَنَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa aabuw damraaa, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, qaala aaraada abnu 'umara rda allh 'nhma alhajja 'aama hajjaai alharuwriyyaai fiy 'ahdi abni alzzubayri rda allh 'nhma faqiyla lahu iinna alnnaasa kaaiinun baynahum qitaalun, wanakhaafu aan yasudduwka‏.‏ faqaala ‏{‏laqad kaana lakum fiy rasuwli alllahi auswaaun hasanaaun‏}‏ iidhana aasna'a kamaa sana'a, aushhidukum aanniy aawjabtu 'umraaan‏.‏ hattaa kaana bizaahiri albaydaa'i qaala maa shaanu alhajji waal'umraai iilaaa waahidun, aushhidukum aanniy jama'tu hajjaaan ma'a 'umraain‏.‏ waaahdaa hadyana muqalladana ashtaraahu hattaa qadima, fataafa bialbayti wabialssafaa, walam yazid 'alaa dhalika, walam yahlil min shaa'in haruma minhu hattaa yawmi alnnahri, fahalaqa wanahara waraaaa aan qad qadaa tawaafahu alhajja waal'umraaa bitawaafihi alaawwali, thumma qaala kadhalika sana'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar intended to perform Hajj in the year of the Hajj of Al-Harawriya during the rule of Ibn Az-Zubair. Some people said to him, "It is very likely that there will be a fight among the people, and we are afraid that they might prevent you (from performing Hajj)." He replied, "Verily, in Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) there is a good example for you (to follow). In this case I would do the same as he had done. I make you witness that I have intended to perform `Umra." When he reached Al-Baida', he said, "The conditions for both Hajj and `Umra are the same. I make you witness that I have intended to perform Hajj along with `Umra." After that he took a garlanded Hadi (to Mecca) which he bought (on the way). When he reached (Mecca), he performed Tawaf of the Ka`ba and of Safa (and Marwa) and did not do more than that. He did not make legal for himself the things which were illegal for a Muhrim till it was the Day of Nahr (sacrifice), when he had his head shaved and slaughtered (the sacrifice) and considered sufficient his first Tawaf (between Safa and Marwa), as a (Sa`i) for his Hajj and `Umra both. He then said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to do like that
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ تَقُولُ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِخَمْسٍ بَقِينَ مِنْ ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ، لاَ نُرَى إِلاَّ الْحَجَّ، فَلَمَّا دَنَوْنَا مِنْ مَكَّةَ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ هَدْىٌ، إِذَا طَافَ وَسَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ أَنْ يَحِلَّ، قَالَتْ فَدُخِلَ عَلَيْنَا يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ بِلَحْمِ بَقَرٍ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مَا هَذَا قَالَ نَحَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى فَذَكَرْتُهُ لِلْقَاسِمِ، فَقَالَ أَتَتْكَ بِالْحَدِيثِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an 'amraaa binti 'abdi alrrahmani, qaalat sami'tu 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha taquwlu kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm likhamsin baqiyna min dhiy alqa'daai, laa nuraa iilaaa alhajja, falammaa danawnaa min makkaaa aamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm man lam yakun ma'ahu hadaun, iidhaa taafa wasa'aa bayna alssafaa waalmarwaai aan yahilla, qaalat fadukhila 'alaynaa yawma alnnahri bilahmi baqarin‏.‏ faqultu maa hadhaa qaala nahara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aazwaajihi‏.‏ qaala yahyaa fadhakartuhu lilqaasimi, faqaala aatatka bialhadiythi 'alaa wajhihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amra bint `Abdur-Rahman:I heard `Aisha saying, "Five days before the end of Dhul-Qa'da we set out from Medina in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the intention of performing Hajj only. When we approached Mecca, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered those who had no Hadi with them to finish their Ihram after performing Tawaf of the Ka`ba and (Sa`i) between Safa and Marwa." `Aisha added, "On the day of Nahr (slaughtering of sacrifice) beef was brought to us. I asked, 'What is this?' The reply was, 'Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) has slaughtered (sacrifices) on behalf of his wives
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، سَمِعَ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ كَانَ يَنْحَرُ فِي الْمَنْحَرِ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ مَنْحَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, sami'a khaalida bna alhaarithi, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi rda allh 'nh kaana yanharu fiy almanhari‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi manhari rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:`Abdullah (bin `Umar), used to slaughter (his sacrifice) at the Manhar. ('Ubaidullah, a sub-narrator said, "The Manhar of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ كَانَ يَبْعَثُ بِهَدْيِهِ مِنْ جَمْعٍ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ، حَتَّى يُدْخَلَ بِهِ مَنْحَرُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ حُجَّاجٍ فِيهِمُ الْحُرُّ وَالْمَمْلُوكُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma kaana yab'athu bihadyihi min jam'in min akhiri alllayli, hattaa yudkhala bihi manharu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'a hujjaajin fiyhimu alhurru waalmamluwku‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi`:Ibn `Umar used to send his Hadi from Jam' (to Mina) in the last third of the night with the pilgrims amongst whom there were free men and slaves, till it was taken into the Manhar (slaughtering place) of the Prophet (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ بَكَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ وَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ ـ قَالَ وَنَحَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ سَبْعَ بُدْنٍ قِيَامًا، وَضَحَّى بِالْمَدِينَةِ كَبْشَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ أَقْرَنَيْنِ‏.‏ مُخْتَصَرًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sahlu bnu bakkaarin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin wadhakara alhadiytha qaala wanahara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi sab'a budnin qiyaamana, wadahhaa bialmadiynaai kabshayni aamlahayni aaqranayni‏.‏ mukhtasarana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sahl bin Bakkar:The narration of Anas abridged, saying, "The Prophet (ﷺ) slaughtered seven Budn (camels) while standing, with his own hands. On the day of `Id-ul-Adha he slaughtered (sacrificed) two horned rams, black and white in color
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ زِيَادِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَتَى عَلَى رَجُلٍ، قَدْ أَنَاخَ بَدَنَتَهُ يَنْحَرُهَا، قَالَ ابْعَثْهَا قِيَامًا مُقَيَّدَةً، سُنَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ شُعْبَةُ عَنْ يُونُسَ أَخْبَرَنِي زِيَادٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani ziyaadi bni jubayrin, qaala raaaytu abna 'umara rda allh 'nhma aataa 'alaa rajulin, qad aanaakha badanatahu yanharuhaa, qaala ab'athhaa qiyaamana muqayyadaaan, sunnaaa muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala shu'baau 'an yuwnusa aakhbaraniy ziyaadun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ziyad bin Jubair:I saw Ibn `Umar passing by a man who had made his Badana sit to slaughter it. Ibn `Umar said, "Slaughter it while it is standing with one leg tied up as is the tradition of Muhammad
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ بَكَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الظُّهْرَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَرْبَعًا، وَالْعَصْرَ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فَبَاتَ بِهَا، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ رَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ، فَجَعَلَ يُهَلِّلُ وَيُسَبِّحُ، فَلَمَّا عَلاَ عَلَى الْبَيْدَاءِ لَبَّى بِهِمَا جَمِيعًا، فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ أَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَحِلُّوا‏.‏ وَنَحَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ سَبْعَ بُدْنٍ قِيَامًا، وَضَحَّى بِالْمَدِينَةِ كَبْشَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ أَقْرَنَيْنِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sahlu bnu bakkaarin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qaala sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alzzuhra bialmadiynaai aarba'ana, waal'asra bidhiy alhulayfaai rak'atayni, fabaata bihaa, falammaa aasbaha rakiba raahilatahu, faja'ala yuhallilu wayusabbihu, falammaa 'alaa 'alaa albaydaa'i labbaa bihimaa jamiy'ana, falammaa dakhala makkaaa aamarahum aan yahilluwa‏.‏ wanahara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi sab'a budnin qiyaamana, wadahhaa bialmadiynaai kabshayni aamlahayni aaqranayni‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered four rak`at of Zuhr prayer at Medina; and two rak`at of `Asr prayer at Dhil- Hulaifa and spent the night there and when (the day) dawned, he mounted his Mount and started saying, "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and Glorified be Allah." When he reached Al- Baida' he recited Talbiya for both Hajj and `Umra. And when he arrived at Mecca, he ordered them (his companions) to finish their Ihram. The Prophet (ﷺ) slaughtered seven Budn (camel) with his own hands while the camels were standing He also sacrificed two horned rams (black and white in color) at Medina
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الظُّهْرَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَرْبَعًا، وَالْعَصْرَ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ‏.‏ وَعَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ ثُمَّ بَاتَ حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ، فَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ، ثُمَّ رَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا اسْتَوَتْ بِهِ الْبَيْدَاءَ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَحَجَّةٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh qaala sallaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alzzuhra bialmadiynaai aarba'ana, waal'asra bidhiy alhulayfaai rak'atayni‏.‏ wa'an aayyuwba 'an rajulin 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh thumma baata hattaa aasbaha, fasallaa alssubha, thumma rakiba raahilatahu hattaa iidhaa astawat bihi albaydaa'a aahalla bi'umraain wahajjaain‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered four rak`at of Zuhr prayer at Medina and two rak`at of `Asr prayer at Dhul-Hulaifa. Narrated Aiyub: "A man said: Anas said, "Then he (the Prophet (ﷺ) passed the night there till dawn and then he offered the morning (Fajr) prayer, and mounted his Mount and when it arrived at Al-Baida' he assumed Ihram for both `Umra and Hajj
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ بَعَثَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُمْتُ عَلَى الْبُدْنِ، فَأَمَرَنِي فَقَسَمْتُ لُحُومَهَا، ثُمَّ أَمَرَنِي فَقَسَمْتُ جِلاَلَهَا وَجُلُودَهَا‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَمَرَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ أَقُومَ عَلَى الْبُدْنِ، وَلاَ أُعْطِيَ عَلَيْهَا شَيْئًا فِي جِزَارَتِهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu kathiyrin, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, qaala aakhbaraniy abnu aabiy najiyhin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh qaala ba'athaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqumtu 'alaa albudni, faaamaraniy faqasamtu luhuwmahaa, thumma aamaraniy faqasamtu jilaalahaa wajuluwdahaa‏.‏ qaala sufyaanu wahaddathaniy 'abdu alkariymi, 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh qaala aamaraniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan aaquwma 'alaa albudni, walaa au'tiya 'alayhaa shayiana fiy jizaaratihaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent me to supervise the (slaughtering of) Budn (Hadi camels) and ordered me to distribute their meat, and then he ordered me to distribute their covering sheets and skins. 'Ali added, "The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to supervise the slaughtering (of the Budn) and not to give anything (of their bodies) to the butcher as wages for slaughtering
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، وَعَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيُّ، أَنَّ مُجَاهِدًا، أَخْبَرَهُمَا أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَقُومَ عَلَى بُدْنِهِ، وَأَنْ يَقْسِمَ بُدْنَهُ كُلَّهَا، لُحُومَهَا وَجُلُودَهَا وَجِلاَلَهَا، وَلاَ يُعْطِيَ فِي جِزَارَتِهَا شَيْئًا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy alhasanu bnu muslimin, wa'abdu alkariymi aljazariyyu, aanna mujaahidana, aakhbarahumaa aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy laylaa aakhbarahu aanna 'aliyyana rda allh 'nh aakhbarahu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aamarahu aan yaquwma 'alaa budnihi, waaan yaqsima budnahu kullahaa, luhuwmahaa wajuluwdahaa wajilaalahaa, walaa yu'tiya fiy jizaaratihaa shayiana‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) ordered me to supervise the (slaughtering) of Budn (Hadi camel) and to distribute their meat, skins and covering sheets in charity and not to give anything (of their bodies) to the butcher as wages for slaughtering
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَيْفُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ أَهْدَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِائَةَ بَدَنَةٍ، فَأَمَرَنِي بِلُحُومِهَا فَقَسَمْتُهَا، ثُمَّ أَمَرَنِي بِجِلاَلِهَا فَقَسَمْتُهَا، ثُمَّ بِجُلُودِهَا فَقَسَمْتُهَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa sayfu bnu aabiy sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu mujaahidana, yaquwlu haddathaniy abnu aabiy laylaa, aanna 'aliyyana rda allh 'nh haddathahu qaala aahdaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm miaiaaa badanaain, faaamaraniy biluhuwmihaa faqasamtuhaa, thumma aamaraniy bijilaalihaa faqasamtuhaa, thumma bijuluwdihaa faqasamtuhaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:The Prophet (ﷺ) offered one hundred Budn as Hadi and ordered me to distribute their meat (in charity) and I did so. Then he ordered me to distribute their covering sheets in charity and I did so. Then he ordered me to distribute their skins in charity and I did so
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءٌ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ كُنَّا لاَ نَأْكُلُ مِنْ لُحُومِ بُدْنِنَا فَوْقَ ثَلاَثِ مِنًى، فَرَخَّصَ لَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُوا وَتَزَوَّدُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَكَلْنَا وَتَزَوَّدْنَا‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ أَقَالَ حَتَّى جِئْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ قَالَ لاَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'ani abni jurayjin, haddathanaa 'ataa'un, sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu kunnaa laa naakulu min luhuwmi budninaa fawqa thalaathi minana, farakhhasa lanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ kuluwa watazawwaduwa ‏"‏‏.‏ faaakalnaa watazawwadnaa‏.‏ qultu li'ataa'in aaqaala hattaa jiinaa almadiynaaa qaala laa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Juraij:`Ata' said, "I heard Jabir bin `Abdullah saying, 'We never ate the meat of the Budn for more than three days of Mina. Later, the Prophet (ﷺ) gave us permission by saying: 'Eat and take (meat) with you. So we ate (some) and took (some) with us.' " I asked `Ata', "Did Jabir say (that they went on eating the meat) till they reached Medina?" `Ata' replied, "No
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي عَمْرَةُ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ تَقُولُ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِخَمْسٍ بَقِينَ مِنْ ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ، وَلاَ نَرَى إِلاَّ الْحَجَّ، حَتَّى إِذَا دَنَوْنَا مِنْ مَكَّةَ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ هَدْىٌ إِذَا طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ ثُمَّ يَحِلُّ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ فَدُخِلَ عَلَيْنَا يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ بِلَحْمِ بَقَرٍ فَقُلْتُ مَا هَذَا فَقِيلَ ذَبَحَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ‏.‏ قَالَ يَحْيَى فَذَكَرْتُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ لِلْقَاسِمِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَتَتْكَ بِالْحَدِيثِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa, qaala haddathatniy 'amraau, qaalat sami'tu 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha taquwlu kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm likhamsin baqiyna min dhiy alqa'daai, walaa naraa iilaaa alhajja, hattaa iidhaa danawnaa min makkaaa aamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm man lam yakun ma'ahu hadaun iidhaa taafa bialbayti thumma yahillu‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau rda allh 'nha fadukhila 'alaynaa yawma alnnahri bilahmi baqarin faqultu maa hadhaa faqiyla dhabaha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aazwaajihi‏.‏ qaala yahyaa fadhakartu hadhaa alhadiytha lilqaasimi‏.‏ faqaala aatatka bialhadiythi 'alaa wajhihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Amra:I heard `Aisha saying, "We set out (from Medina) along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) five days before the end of Dhul-Qa'da with the intention of performing Hajj only. When we approached Mecca, Allah's Apostle ordered those who had no Hadi along with them to finish the Ihram after performing Tawaf of the Ka`ba, (Safa and Marwa). `Aisha added, "Beef was brought to us on the Day of Nahr and I said, 'What is this?' Somebody said, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) has slaughtered (cows) on behalf of his wives
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَمَّنْ حَلَقَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَذْبَحَ وَنَحْوِهِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ حَرَجَ، لاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni hawshabin, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa mansuwrun, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala suiila alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'amman halaqa qabla aan yadhbaha wanahwihi‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ laa haraja, laa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about a person who had his head shaved before slaughtering (his Hadi) (or other similar ceremonies of Hajj). He replied, "There is no harm, there is no harm
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زُرْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْبَحَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ذَبَحْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ الرَّازِيُّ عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ خُثَيْمٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَفَّانُ أُرَاهُ عَنْ وُهَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ حَمَّادٌ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ وَعَبَّادِ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, aakhbaranaa aabuw bakrin, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni rufay'in, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala rajulun lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm zurtu qabla aan aarmiya‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala halaqtu qabla aan aadhbaha‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala dhabahtu qabla aan aarmiya‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala 'abdu alrrahiymi alrraaziyyu 'ani abni khuthaymin aakhbaraniy 'ataa'un 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala alqaasimu bnu yahyaa haddathaniy abnu khuthaymin 'an 'ataa'in 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala 'affaanu auraahu 'an wuhaybin, haddathanaa abnu khuthaymin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala hammaadun 'an qaysi bni sa'din wa'abbaadi bni mansuwrin 'an 'ataa'in 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man said to the Prophet (ﷺ) "I performed the Tawaf-al-Ifada before the Rami (throwing pebbles at the Jamra)." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There is no harm." The man said, "I had my head shaved before slaughtering." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There is no harm." He said, "I have slaughtered the Hadi before the Rami." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There is no harm
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَمَيْتُ بَعْدَ مَا أَمْسَيْتُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala suiila alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ramaytu ba'da maa aamsaytu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala halaqtu qabla aan aanhara‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked by a man who said, "I have done the Rami in the evening." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There is no harm in it." Another man asked, "I had my head shaved before the slaughtering." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There is no harm in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَدِمْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ بِالْبَطْحَاءِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَحَجَجْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ بِمَا أَهْلَلْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ بِإِهْلاَلٍ كَإِهْلاَلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَحْسَنْتَ، انْطَلِقْ فَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ امْرَأَةً مِنْ نِسَاءِ بَنِي قَيْسٍ، فَفَلَتْ رَأْسِي، ثُمَّ أَهْلَلْتُ بِالْحَجِّ، فَكُنْتُ أُفْتِي بِهِ النَّاسَ، حَتَّى خِلاَفَةِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ فَذَكَرْتُهُ لَهُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنْ نَأْخُذْ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْمُرُنَا بِالتَّمَامِ، وَإِنْ نَأْخُذْ بِسُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَحِلَّ حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْهَدْىُ مَحِلَّهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, qaala aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qaysi bni muslimin, 'an taariqi bni shihaabin, 'an aabiy muwsaa rda allh 'nh qaala qadimtu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa bialbathaa'i‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aahajajta ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu na'am‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ bimaa aahlalta ‏"‏‏.‏ qultu labbayka biiihlaalin kaiihlaali alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aahsanta, antaliq fatuf bialbayti wabialssafaa waalmarwaai ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma aataytu amraaaaan min nisaa'i baniy qaysin, fafalat raasiy, thumma aahlaltu bialhajji, fakuntu auftiy bihi alnnaasa, hattaa khilaafaai 'umara rda allh 'nh fadhakartuhu lahu‏.‏ faqaala iin naakhudh bikitaabi alllahi faiinnahu yaamurunaa bialttamaami, waiin naakhudh bisunnaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yahilla hattaa balagha alhadau mahillahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Musa:I came upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) when he was at Al-Batha. He asked me, "Have you intended to perform the Hajj?" I replied in the affirmative. He asked, "For what have you assumed Ihram?" I replied," I have assumed Ihram with the same intention as that of the Prophet (ﷺ) ." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "You have done well! Go and perform Tawaf round the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa." Then I went to one of the women of Bani Qais and she took out lice from my head. Later, I assumed the Ihram for Hajj. So, I used to give this verdict to the people till the caliphate of `Umar. When I told him about it, he said, "If we take (follow) the Holy Book, then it orders us to complete Hajj and `Umra (Hajj-at- Tamattu`) and if we follow the tradition of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not finish his Ihram till the Hadi had reached its destination (had been slaughtered). (i.e. Hajj-al-Qiran). (See Hadith No)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا شَأْنُ النَّاسِ حَلُّوا بِعُمْرَةٍ وَلَمْ تَحْلِلْ أَنْتَ مِنْ عُمْرَتِكَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لَبَّدْتُ رَأْسِي، وَقَلَّدْتُ هَدْيِي، فَلاَ أَحِلُّ حَتَّى أَنْحَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'an hafsaaa rda allh 'nhm aannahaa qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi, maa shaanu alnnaasi halluwa bi'umraain walam tahlil aanta min 'umratika qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy labbadtu raasiy, waqalladtu hadyiy, falaa aahillu hattaa aanhara ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Hafsa said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What is wrong with the people; they finished their Ihram after performing `Umra, but you have not finished it after your `Umra?" He replied, "I matted my hair and have garlanded my Hadi. So, I cannot finish my Ihram till I slaughter (my Hadi)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، قَالَ نَافِعٌ كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ حَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَجَّتِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybu bnu aabiy hamzaaa, qaala naafi'un kaana abnu 'umara rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu halaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy hajjatihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (got) his head shaved after performing his Hajj
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمِ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمِ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ ‏"‏ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ وَقَالَ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ ‏"‏ وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma arhami almuhalliqiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa waalmuqassiriyna yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma arhami almuhalliqiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa waalmuqassiriyna yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ waalmuqassiriyna ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala alllaythu haddathaniy naafi'un ‏"‏ rahima alllahu almuhalliqiyna ‏"‏ marraaan aaw marratayni‏.‏ qaala waqaala 'ubaydu alllahi haddathaniy naafi'un waqaala fiy alrraabi'aai ‏"‏ waalmuqassiriyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Be merciful to those who have their head shaved." The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! And (invoke Allah for) those who get their hair cut short." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Be merciful to those who have their head shaved." The people said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! And those who get their hair cut short." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (the third time), "And to those who get their hair cut short." Nafi` said that the Prophet (ﷺ) had said once or twice, "O Allah! Be merciful to those who get their head shaved," and on the fourth time he added, "And to those who have their hair cut short
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلِلْمُقَصِّرِينَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلِلْمُقَصِّرِينَ‏.‏ قَالَهَا ثَلاَثًا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلِلْمُقَصِّرِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ayyaashu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, haddathanaa 'umaaraau bnu alqa'qaa'i, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alllahumma aghfir lilmuhalliqiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa walilmuqassiriyna‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aghfir lilmuhalliqiyna ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa walilmuqassiriyna‏.‏ qaalahaa thalaathana‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ walilmuqassiriyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Forgive those who get their heads shaved." The people asked. "Also those who get their hair cut short?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O Allah! Forgive those who have their heads shaved." The people said, "Also those who get their hair cut short?" The Prophet (invoke Allah for those who have their heads shaved and) at the third time said, "also (forgive) those who get their hair cut short
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ بْنُ أَسْمَاءَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَلَقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَطَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ، وَقَصَّرَ بَعْضُهُمْ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a, haddathanaa juwayriyaau bnu aasmaa'a, 'an naafi'in, aanna 'abda alllahi, qaala halaqa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wataaiifaaun min aashaabihi, waqassara ba'duhum‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:The Prophet (ﷺ) and some of his companions got their heads shaved and some others got their hair cut short
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ قَالَ قَصَّرْتُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِشْقَصٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'ani alhasani bni muslimin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an mu'aawiyaaa rda allh 'nhm qaala qassartu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimishqasin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Muawiya:I cut short the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with a long blade
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي كُرَيْبٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَّةَ أَمَرَ أَصْحَابَهُ أَنْ يَطُوفُوا بِالْبَيْتِ، وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، ثُمَّ يَحِلُّوا، وَيَحْلِقُوا أَوْ يُقَصِّرُوا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin, haddathanaa fudaylu bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, aakhbaraniy kuraybun, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala lammaa qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm makkaaa aamara aashaabahu aan yatuwfuwa bialbayti, wabialssafaa waalmarwaai, thumma yahilluwa, wayahliquwa aaw yuqassiruwa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) came to Mecca, he ordered his Companions to perform Tawaf round the Ka`ba and between Safa and Marwa, to finish their Ihram and get their hair shaved off or cut short
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: وَقَالَ لَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ طَافَ طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا، ثُمَّ يَقِيلُ ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِنًى ـ يَعْنِي يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ـ‏.‏ وَرَفَعَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala lanaa aabuw nu'aymin haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara rda allh 'nhma aannahu taafa tawaafana waahidana, thumma yaqiylu thumma yaatiy minana ya'niy yawma alnnahri ‏.‏ warafa'ahu 'abdu alrrazzaaqi aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Nafi' that Ibn 'Umar (ra) performed only one Tawaf. He would take an afternoon nap and then return to Mina. That was on the day of Nahr (slaughtering)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ حَجَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَفَضْنَا يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، فَحَاضَتْ صَفِيَّةُ، فَأَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهَا مَا يُرِيدُ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا حَائِضٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَابِسَتُنَا هِيَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَفَاضَتْ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اخْرُجُوا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَيُذْكَرُ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ وَعُرْوَةَ وَالأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَفَاضَتْ صَفِيَّةُ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an ja'fari bni rabiy'aaa, 'ani alaa'raji, qaala haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha qaalat hajajnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaafadnaa yawma alnnahri, fahaadat safiyyaau, faaaraada alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm minhaa maa yuriydu alrrajulu min aahlihi‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnahaa haaiidun‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ haabisatunaa hiya ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi, aafaadat yawma alnnahri‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ akhrujuwa ‏"‏‏.‏ wayudhkaru 'ani alqaasimi wa'urwaaa waalaaswadi 'an 'aaiishaaa rda allh 'nha aafaadat safiyyaau yawma alnnahri‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Aisha:We performed Hajj with the Prophet (ﷺ) and performed Tawaf-al-ifada on the Day of Nahr (slaughtering). Safiya got her menses and the Prophet desired from her what a husband desires from his wife. I said to him, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! She is having her menses." He said, "Is she going to detain us?" We informed him that she had performed Tawaf-al-Ifada on the Day of Nahr. He said, "(Then you can) depart
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قِيلَ لَهُ فِي الذَّبْحِ وَالْحَلْقِ وَالرَّمْىِ وَالتَّقْدِيمِ وَالتَّأْخِيرِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa abnu taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qiyla lahu fiy aldhhabhi waalhalqi waalrramai waalttaqdiymi waalttaakhiyri faqaala ‏ "‏ laa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about the slaughtering, shaving (of the head), and the doing of Rami before or after the due times. He said, "There is no harm in that
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُسْأَلُ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ بِمِنًى، فَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَسَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْبَحَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْبَحْ، وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ رَمَيْتُ بَعْدَ مَا أَمْسَيْتُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yusaalu yawma alnnahri biminana, fayaquwlu ‏"‏ laa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏ fasaaalahu rajulun, faqaala halaqtu qabla aan aadhbaha‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adhbah, walaa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ramaytu ba'da maa aamsaytu‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked (as regards the ceremonies of Hajj) at Mina on the Day of Nahr and he replied that there was no harm. Then a man said to him, "I got my head shaved before slaughtering." He replied, "Slaughter (now) and there is no harm in it." (Another) man said, "I did the Rami (of the Jimar) after midday." The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "There was no harm in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَفَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، فَجَعَلُوا يَسْأَلُونَهُ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لَمْ أَشْعُرْ فَحَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْبَحَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْبَحْ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءَ آخَرُ فَقَالَ لَمْ أَشْعُرْ فَنَحَرْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْمِ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَمَا سُئِلَ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنْ شَىْءٍ قُدِّمَ وَلاَ أُخِّرَ إِلاَّ قَالَ افْعَلْ وَلاَ حَرَجَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'iysaa bni talhaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqafa fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i, faja'aluwa yasaaluwnahu, faqaala rajulun lam aash'ur fahalaqtu qabla aan aadhbaha‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ adhbah walaa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏ fajaa'a akharu faqaala lam aash'ur fanahartu qabla aan aarmiya‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ armi walaa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏ famaa suiila yawmaiidhin 'an shaa'in quddima walaa aukhhira iilaaa qaala af'al walaa haraja‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stopped (for a while near the Jimar at Mina) during his last Hajj and the people started asking him questions. A man said, "Ignorantly I got my head shaved before slaughtering." The Prophet replied, "Slaughter (now) and there is no harm in it." Another man said, "Unknowingly I slaughtered the Hadi before doing the Rami." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do Rami now and there is no harm in it." So, on that day, when the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about anything (about the ceremonies of Hajj) done before or after (its stated time) his reply was, "Do it (now) and there is no harm
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، شَهِدَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ كُنْتُ أَحْسِبُ أَنَّ كَذَا قَبْلَ كَذَا‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَ آخَرُ فَقَالَ كُنْتُ أَحْسِبُ أَنَّ كَذَا قَبْلَ كَذَا حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ، نَحَرْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ‏.‏ وَأَشْبَاهَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ افْعَلْ وَلاَ حَرَجَ ‏"‏‏.‏ لَهُنَّ كُلِّهِنَّ، فَمَا سُئِلَ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنْ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ قَالَ افْعَلْ وَلاَ حَرَجَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu yahyaa bni sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, haddathaniy alzzuhriyyu, 'an 'iysaa bni talhaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amriw bni al'aasi rda allh 'nh haddathahu aannahu, shahida alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu yawma alnnahri, faqaama iilayhi rajulun, faqaala kuntu aahsibu aanna kadhaa qabla kadhaa‏.‏ thumma qaama akharu faqaala kuntu aahsibu aanna kadhaa qabla kadhaa halaqtu qabla aan aanhara, nahartu qabla aan aarmiya‏.‏ waaashbaaha dhalika‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ af'al walaa haraja ‏"‏‏.‏ lahunna kullihinna, famaa suiila yawmaiidhin 'an shaa'in iilaaa qaala af'al walaa haraja‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:I witnessed the Prophet (ﷺ) when he was delivering the sermon on the Day of Nahr. A man stood up and said, "I thought that such and such was to be done before such and such. I got my hair shaved before slaughtering." (Another said), "I slaughtered the Hadi before doing the Rami." So, the people asked about many similar things. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do it (now) and there is no harm in all these cases." Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) was asked about anything on that day, he replied, "Do it (now) and there is no harm in it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ وَقَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى نَاقَتِهِ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مَعْمَرٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, qaala aakhbaranaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy 'iysaa bnu talhaaa bni 'ubaydi alllahi, aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'amriw bni al'aasi rda allh 'nhma qaala waqafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa naaqatihi‏.‏ fadhakara alhadiytha‏.‏ taaba'ahu ma'marun 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Amr bin Al-`As:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stopped while on his she-camel (the sub-narrator then narrated the Hadith as above, i.e)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ غَزْوَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطَبَ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ‏.‏ أَىُّ يَوْمٍ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا يَوْمٌ حَرَامٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَىُّ بَلَدٍ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَدٌ حَرَامٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَىُّ شَهْرٍ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا شَهْرٌ حَرَامٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ دِمَاءَكُمْ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ وَأَعْرَاضَكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ حَرَامٌ، كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا، فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَعَادَهَا مِرَارًا، ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ اللَّهُمَّ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّهَا لَوَصِيَّتُهُ إِلَى أُمَّتِهِ ـ ‏"‏ فَلْيُبْلِغِ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ، لاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
