verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْعَدَوِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، وَهُوَ يَبْعَثُ الْبُعُوثَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ ائْذَنْ لِي أَيُّهَا الأَمِيرُ أُحَدِّثْكَ قَوْلاً قَامَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلْغَدِ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْفَتْحِ، فَسَمِعَتْهُ أُذُنَاىَ، وَوَعَاهُ قَلْبِي، وَأَبْصَرَتْهُ عَيْنَاىَ حِينَ تَكَلَّمَ بِهِ، إِنَّهُ حَمِدَ اللَّهَ، وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مَكَّةَ حَرَّمَهَا اللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُحَرِّمْهَا النَّاسُ، فَلاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرِئٍ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ يَسْفِكَ بِهَا دَمًا وَلاَ يَعْضُدَ بِهَا شَجَرَةً، فَإِنْ أَحَدٌ تَرَخَّصَ لِقِتَالِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُولُوا لَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَذِنَ لِرَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ يَأْذَنْ لَكُمْ، وَإِنَّمَا أَذِنَ لِي سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ، وَقَدْ عَادَتْ حُرْمَتُهَا الْيَوْمَ كَحُرْمَتِهَا بِالأَمْسِ، وَلْيُبَلِّغِ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لأَبِي شُرَيْحٍ مَا قَالَ لَكَ عَمْرٌو قَالَ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِذَلِكَ مِنْكَ يَا أَبَا شُرَيْحٍ، إِنَّ الْحَرَمَ لاَ يُعِيذُ عَاصِيًا، وَلاَ فَارًّا بِدَمٍ، وَلاَ فَارًّا بِخَرْبَةٍ‏.‏ خَرْبَةٌ بَلِيَّةٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy shurayhin al'adawiyyi, aannahu qaala li'amriw bni sa'iydin, wahuwa yab'athu albu'uwtha iilaa makkaaa aidhan liy aayyuhaa alaamiyru auhaddithka qawlaan qaama bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lilghadi min yawmi alfathi, fasami'athu audhunaaaa, wawa'aahu qalbiy, waaabsarathu 'aynaaaa hiyna takallama bihi, iinnahu hamida alllaha, waaathnaa 'alayhi, thumma qaala ‏ "‏ iinna makkaaa harramahaa alllahu walam yuharrimhaa alnnaasu, falaa yahillu laimriiin yuuminu bialllahi waalyawmi alakhiri aan yasfika bihaa damana walaa ya'duda bihaa shajaraaan, faiin aahadun tarakhhasa liqitaali rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faquwluwa lahu iinna alllaha aadhina lirasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm walam yaadhan lakum, waiinnamaa aadhina liy saa'aaan min nahaarin, waqad 'aadat hurmatuhaa alyawma kahurmatihaa bialaamsi, walyuballighi alshhaahidu alghaaiiba ‏"‏‏.‏ faqiyla laabiy shurayhin maa qaala laka 'amrunw qaala aanaa aa'lamu bidhalika minka yaa aabaa shurayhin, iinna alharama laa yu'iydhu 'aasiyana, walaa faarrana bidamin, walaa faarrana bikharbaain‏.‏ kharbaaun baliyyaaun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`id bin Abu Sa`id Al-Maqburi:Abu Shuraih, Al-`Adawi said that he had said to `Amr bin Sa`id when he was sending the troops to Mecca (to fight `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair), "O Chief! Allow me to tell you what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the day following the Conquest of Mecca. My ears heard that and my heart understood it thoroughly and I saw with my own eyes the Prophet (ﷺ) when he, after Glorifying and Praising Allah, started saying, 'Allah, not the people, made Mecca a sanctuary, so anybody who has belief in Allah and the Last Day should neither shed blood in it, nor should he cut down its trees. If anybody tells (argues) that fighting in it is permissible on the basis that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did fight in Mecca, say to him, 'Allah allowed His Apostle and did not allow you.' "Allah allowed me only for a few hours on that day (of the conquest) and today its sanctity is valid as it was before. So, those who are present should inform those who are absent (concerning this fact." Abu Shuraih was asked, "What did `Amr reply?" He said, (`Amr said) 'O Abu Shuraih! I know better than you in this respect Mecca does not give protection to a sinner, a murderer or a thief
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ مَكَّةَ، فَلَمْ تَحِلَّ لأَحَدٍ قَبْلِي، وَلاَ تَحِلُّ لأَحَدٍ بَعْدِي، وَإِنَّمَا أُحِلَّتْ لِي سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ، لاَ يُخْتَلَى خَلاَهَا، وَلاَ يُعْضَدُ شَجَرُهَا، وَلاَ يُنَفَّرُ صَيْدُهَا، وَلاَ تُلْتَقَطُ لُقَطَتُهَا إِلاَّ لِمُعَرِّفٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْعَبَّاسُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ لِصَاغَتِنَا وَقُبُورِنَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَعَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ قَالَ هَلْ تَدْرِي مَا لاَ يُنَفَّرُ صَيْدُهَا هُوَ أَنْ يُنَحِّيَهُ مِنَ الظِّلِّ، يَنْزِلُ مَكَانَهُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an 'ikrimaaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha harrama makkaaa, falam tahilla laahadin qabliy, walaa tahillu laahadin ba'diy, waiinnamaa auhillat liy saa'aaan min nahaarin, laa yukhtalaa khalaahaa, walaa yu'dadu shajaruhaa, walaa yunaffaru sayduhaa, walaa tultaqatu luqatatuhaa iilaaa limu'arrifin ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala al'abbaasu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ iilaaa aliidhkhira lisaaghatinaa waqubuwrinaa‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iilaaa aliidhkhira ‏"‏‏.‏ wa'an khaalidin 'an 'ikrimaaa qaala hal tadriy maa laa yunaffaru sayduhaa huwa aan yunahhiyahu mina alzzilli, yanzilu makaanahu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:"The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'Allah has made Mecca, a sanctuary, so it was a sanctuary before me and will continue to be a sanctuary after me. It was made legal for me (i.e. I was allowed to fight in it) for a few hours of a day. It is not allowed to uproot its shrubs or to cut its trees, or to chase (or disturb) its game, or to pick up its luqata (fallen things) except by a person who would announce that (what he has found) publicly.' Al-`Abbas said, 'O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Except Al-Idhkhir (a kind of grass) (for it is used) by our goldsmiths and for our graves.' The Prophet (ﷺ) then said, 'Except Al-Idhkhir.' " `Ikrima said, 'Do you know what "chasing or disturbing" the game means? It means driving it out of the shade to occupy its place
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ افْتَتَحَ مَكَّةَ ‏"‏ لاَ هِجْرَةَ وَلَكِنْ جِهَادٌ وَنِيَّةٌ، وَإِذَا اسْتُنْفِرْتُمْ فَانْفِرُوا، فَإِنَّ هَذَا بَلَدٌ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ، وَهُوَ حَرَامٌ بِحُرْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَحِلَّ الْقِتَالُ فِيهِ لأَحَدٍ قَبْلِي، وَلَمْ يَحِلَّ لِي إِلاَّ سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ، فَهُوَ حَرَامٌ بِحُرْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، لاَ يُعْضَدُ شَوْكُهُ، وَلاَ يُنَفَّرُ صَيْدُهُ، وَلاَ يَلْتَقِطُ لُقَطَتَهُ إِلاَّ مَنْ عَرَّفَهَا، وَلاَ يُخْتَلَى خَلاَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ الْعَبَّاسُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ، فَإِنَّهُ لِقَيْنِهِمْ وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِلاَّ الإِذْخِرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an mujaahidin, 'an taawusin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma aftataha makkaaa ‏"‏ laa hijraaa walakin jihaadun waniyyaaun, waiidhaa astunfirtum faanfiruwa, faiinna hadhaa baladun harrama alllahu yawma khalaqa alssamawaati waalaarda, wahuwa haraamun bihurmaai alllahi iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai, waiinnahu lam yahilla alqitaalu fiyhi laahadin qabliy, walam yahilla liy iilaaa saa'aaan min nahaarin, fahuwa haraamun bihurmaai alllahi iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai, laa yu'dadu shawkuhu, walaa yunaffaru sayduhu, walaa yaltaqitu luqatatahu iilaaa man 'arrafahaa, walaa yukhtalaa khalaahaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala al'abbaasu yaa rasuwla alllahi‏.‏ iilaaa aliidhkhira, faiinnahu liqaynihim walibuyuwtihim‏.‏ qaala qaala ‏"‏ iilaaa aliidhkhira ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:On the day of the conquest of Mecca, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There is no more emigration (from Mecca) but Jihad and intentions, and whenever you are called for Jihad, you should go immediately. No doubt, Allah has made this place (Mecca) a sanctuary since the creation of the heavens and the earth and will remain a sanctuary till the Day of Resurrection as Allah has ordained its sanctity. Fighting was not permissible in it for anyone before me, and even for me it was allowed only for a portion of a day. So, it is a sanctuary with Allah's sanctity till the Day of Resurrection. Its thorns should not be uprooted and its game should not be chased; and its luqata (fallen things) should not be picked up except by one who would announce that publicly, and its vegetation (grass etc.) should not be cut." Al-`Abbas said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Except Al-Idhkhir, (for it is used by their blacksmiths and for their domestic purposes)." So, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Except Al-Idhkhir
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ قَالَ عَمْرٌو أَوَّلُ شَىْءٍ سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءً، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي طَاوُسٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْتُ لَعَلَّهُ سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُمَا‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala qaala 'amrunw aawwalu shaa'in sami'tu 'ataa'an, yaquwlu sami'tu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu ahtajama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa muhrimun‏.‏ thumma sami'tuhu yaquwlu haddathaniy taawusun 'ani abni 'abbaasin faqultu la'allahu sami'ahu minhumaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was cupped while he was in a state of Ihram
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ احْتَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ مُحْرِمٌ بِلَحْىِ جَمَلٍ فِي وَسَطِ رَأْسِهِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an 'alqamaaa bni aabiy 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'ani abni buhaynaaa rda allh 'nh qaala ahtajama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wahwa muhrimun bilahai jamalin fiy wasati raasihi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn Buhaina:The Prophet, while in the state of Ihram, was cupped at the middle of his head at Liha-Jamal
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ عَبْدُ الْقُدُّوسِ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَزَوَّجَ مَيْمُونَةَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw almughiyraai 'abdu alqudduwsi bnu alhajjaaji, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, haddathaniy 'ataa'u bnu aabiy rabaahin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm tazawwaja maymuwnaaa wahuwa muhrimun‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) married Maimuna while he was in the state of Ihram, (only the ceremonies of marriage were held)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَاذَا تَأْمُرُنَا أَنْ نَلْبَسَ مِنَ الثِّيَابِ فِي الإِحْرَامِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَلْبَسُوا الْقَمِيصَ وَلاَ السَّرَاوِيلاَتِ وَلاَ الْعَمَائِمَ، وَلاَ الْبَرَانِسَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَحَدٌ لَيْسَتْ لَهُ نَعْلاَنِ، فَلْيَلْبَسِ الْخُفَّيْنِ، وَلْيَقْطَعْ أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ، وَلاَ تَلْبَسُوا شَيْئًا مَسَّهُ زَعْفَرَانٌ، وَلاَ الْوَرْسُ، وَلاَ تَنْتَقِبِ الْمَرْأَةُ الْمُحْرِمَةُ وَلاَ تَلْبَسِ الْقُفَّازَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ وَجُوَيْرِيَةُ وَابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ فِي النِّقَابِ وَالْقُفَّازَيْنِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ وَلاَ وَرْسٌ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ لاَ تَتَنَقَّبِ الْمُحْرِمَةُ، وَلاَ تَلْبَسِ الْقُفَّازَيْنِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ لاَ تَتَنَقَّبِ الْمُحْرِمَةُ‏.‏ وَتَابَعَهُ لَيْثُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda, haddathanaa alllaythu, haddathanaa naafi'un, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara rda allh 'nhma qaala qaama rajulun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi maadhaa taamurunaa aan nalbasa mina althhiyaabi fiy aliihraami faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa talbasuwa alqamiysa walaa alssaraawiylaati walaa al'amaaiima, walaa albaraanisa iilaaa aan yakuwna aahadun laysat lahu na'laani, falyalbasi alkhuffayni, walyaqta' aasfala mina alka'bayni, walaa talbasuwa shayiana massahu za'faraanun, walaa alwarsu, walaa tantaqibi almaraaau almuhrimaau walaa talbasi alquffaazayni ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa waiismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma bni 'uqbaaa wajuwayriyaau waabnu iishaaqa fiy alnniqaabi waalquffaazayni‏.‏ waqaala 'ubaydu alllahi walaa warsun wakaana yaquwlu laa tatanaqqabi almuhrimaau, walaa talbasi alquffaazayni‏.‏ waqaala maalikun 'an naafi'in 'ani abni 'umara laa tatanaqqabi almuhrimaau‏.‏ wataaba'ahu laythu bnu aabiy sulaymin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:A person stood up and asked, "O Allah's: Apostle! What clothes may be worn in the state of Ihram?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Do not wear a shirt or trousers, or any headgear (e.g. a turban), or a hooded cloak; but if somebody has no shoes he can wear leather stockings provided they are cut short off the ankles, and also, do not wear anything perfumed with Wars or saffron, and the Muhrima (a woman in the state of Ihram) should not cover her face, or wear gloves
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ وَقَصَتْ بِرَجُلٍ مُحْرِمٍ نَاقَتُهُ، فَقَتَلَتْهُ، فَأُتِيَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ، وَكَفِّنُوهُ، وَلاَ تُغَطُّوا رَأْسَهُ، وَلاَ تُقَرِّبُوهُ طِيبًا، فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يُهِلُّ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'ani alhakami, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala waqasat birajulin muhrimin naaqatuhu, faqatalathu, faautiya bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu, wakaffinuwhu, walaa tughattuwa raasahu, walaa tuqarribuwhu tiybana, faiinnahu yub'athu yuhillu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man was crushed to death by his she-camel and was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) who said, "Give him a bath and shroud him, but do not cover his head, and do not bring any perfume near to him, as he will be resurrected reciting Talbiya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْعَبَّاسِ، وَالْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، اخْتَلَفَا بِالأَبْوَاءِ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَغْسِلُ الْمُحْرِمُ رَأْسَهُ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْمِسْوَرُ لاَ يَغْسِلُ الْمُحْرِمُ رَأْسَهُ‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْعَبَّاسِ إِلَى أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، فَوَجَدْتُهُ يَغْتَسِلُ بَيْنَ الْقَرْنَيْنِ، وَهُوَ يُسْتَرُ بِثَوْبٍ، فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ مَنْ هَذَا فَقُلْتُ أَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ حُنَيْنٍ، أَرْسَلَنِي إِلَيْكَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْعَبَّاسِ، أَسْأَلُكَ كَيْفَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ، وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ، فَوَضَعَ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ يَدَهُ عَلَى الثَّوْبِ، فَطَأْطَأَهُ حَتَّى بَدَا لِي رَأْسُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لإِنْسَانٍ يَصُبُّ عَلَيْهِ اصْبُبْ‏.‏ فَصَبَّ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ، ثُمَّ حَرَّكَ رَأْسَهُ بِيَدَيْهِ فَأَقْبَلَ بِهِمَا وَأَدْبَرَ وَقَالَ هَكَذَا رَأَيْتُهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْعَلُ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an iibraahiyma bni 'abdi alllahi bni hunaynin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna al'abbaasi, waalmiswara bna makhramaaa, akhtalafaa bialaabwaa'i, faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abbaasin yaghsilu almuhrimu raasahu‏.‏ waqaala almiswaru laa yaghsilu almuhrimu raasahu‏.‏ faaarsalaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu al'abbaasi iilaa aabiy aayyuwba alaansaariyyi, fawajadtuhu yaghtasilu bayna alqarnayni, wahuwa yustaru bithawbin, fasallamtu 'alayhi faqaala man hadhaa faqultu aanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu hunaynin, aarsalaniy iilayka 'abdu alllahi bnu al'abbaasi, aasaaluka kayfa kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaghsilu raasahu, wahuwa muhrimun, fawada'a aabuw aayyuwba yadahu 'alaa althhawbi, fataataaahu hattaa badaa liy raasuhu thumma qaala liinsaanin yasubbu 'alayhi asbub‏.‏ fasabba 'alaa raasihi, thumma harraka raasahu biyadayhi faaaqbala bihimaa waaadbara waqaala hakadhaa raaaytuhu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaf'alu‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin Hunain:`Abdullah bin Al-Abbas and Al-Miswar bin Makhrama differed at Al-Abwa'; Ibn `Abbas said that a Muhrim could wash his head; while Al-Miswar maintained that he should not do so. `Abdullah bin `Abbas sent me to Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari and I found him bathing between the two wooden posts (of the well) and was screened with a sheet of cloth. I greeted him and he asked who I was. I replied, "I am `Abdullah bin Hunain and I have been sent to you by Ibn `Abbas to ask you how Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to wash his head while in the state of Ihram." Abu Aiyub Al-Ansari caught hold of the sheet of cloth and lowered it till his head appeared before me, and then told somebody to pour water on his head. He poured water on his head, and he (Abu Aiyub) rubbed his head with his hands by bringing them from back to front and from front to back and said, "I saw the Prophet (ﷺ) doing like this
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ بِعَرَفَاتٍ ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ النَّعْلَيْنِ فَلْيَلْبَسِ الْخُفَّيْنِ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ إِزَارًا فَلْيَلْبَسْ سَرَاوِيلَ ‏"‏‏.‏ لِلْمُحْرِمِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu diynaarin, sami'tu jaabira bna zaydin, sami'tu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu bi'arafaatin ‏ "‏ man lam yajidi alnna'layni falyalbasi alkhuffayni, waman lam yajid iizaarana falyalbas saraawiyla ‏"‏‏.‏ lilmuhrimi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) delivering a sermon at `Arafat saying, "If a Muhrim does not find slippers, he could wear Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather, but he has to cut short the Khuffs below the ankles), and if he does not find an Izar (a waist sheet for wrapping the lower half of the body) he could wear trousers
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنَ الثِّيَابِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَلْبَسِ الْقَمِيصَ، وَلاَ الْعَمَائِمَ، وَلاَ السَّرَاوِيلاَتِ، وَلاَ الْبُرْنُسَ، وَلاَ ثَوْبًا مَسَّهُ زَعْفَرَانٌ وَلاَ وَرْسٌ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ نَعْلَيْنِ فَلْيَلْبَسِ الْخُفَّيْنِ، وَلْيَقْطَعْهُمَا حَتَّى يَكُونَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an saalimin, 'an 'abdi alllahi rda allh 'nh suiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa yalbasu almuhrimu mina althhiyaabi faqaala ‏ "‏ laa yalbasi alqamiysa, walaa al'amaaiima, walaa alssaraawiylaati, walaa alburnusa, walaa thawbana massahu za'faraanun walaa warsun, waiin lam yajid na'layni falyalbasi alkhuffayni, walyaqta'humaa hattaa yakuwnaa aasfala mina alka'bayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked what sort of clothes a Muhrim should wear. He replied, "He should not wear a shirt, turbans, trousers, a hooded cloak, or a dress perfumed with saffron or Wars; and if slippers are not available he can wear Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather) but he should cut them so that they reach below the ankles
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ خَطَبَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَرَفَاتٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ الإِزَارَ فَلْيَلْبَسِ السَّرَاوِيلَ، وَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ النَّعْلَيْنِ فَلْيَلْبَسِ الْخُفَّيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa adamu, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu diynaarin, 'an jaabiri bni zaydin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala khatabanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'arafaatin faqaala ‏ "‏ man lam yajidi aliizaara falyalbasi alssaraawiyla, waman lam yajidi alnna'layni falyalbasi alkhuffayni ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) delivered a sermon at `Arafat and said, "Whoever does not get an Izar can wear trousers, and whoever cannot get a pair of shoes can wear Khuffs (socks made from thick fabric or leather)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ اعْتَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ، فَأَبَى أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ أَنْ يَدَعُوهُ يَدْخُلُ مَكَّةَ، حَتَّى قَاضَاهُمْ لاَ يُدْخِلُ مَكَّةَ سِلاَحًا إِلاَّ فِي الْقِرَابِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i rda allh 'nh a'tamara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy dhiy alqa'daai, faaabaa aahlu makkaaa aan yada'uwhu yadkhulu makkaaa, hattaa qaadaahum laa yudkhilu makkaaa silaahana iilaaa fiy alqiraabi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Bara:The Prophet (ﷺ) assumed Ihram for Umra in the month of Dhul-Qa'da but the (pagan) people of Mecca refused to admit him into Mecca till he agreed on the condition that he would not bring into Mecca any arms but sheathed
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَّتَ لأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ، وَلأَهْلِ نَجْدٍ قَرْنَ الْمَنَازِلِ، وَلأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ يَلَمْلَمَ، هُنَّ لَهُنَّ وَلِكُلِّ آتٍ أَتَى عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ غَيْرِهِمْ مِمَّنْ أَرَادَ الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ، فَمَنْ كَانَ دُونَ ذَلِكَ فَمِنْ حَيْثُ أَنْشَأَ، حَتَّى أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muslimun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa abnu taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waqqata laahli almadiynaai dhaa alhulayfaai, walaahli najdin qarna almanaazili, walaahli alyamani yalamlama, hunna lahunna walikulli atin aataa 'alayhinna min ghayrihim mimman aaraada alhajja waal'umraaa, faman kaana duwna dhalika famin haythu aanshaaa, hattaa aahlu makkaaa min makkaaa‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) fixed Dhul-Hulaifa as the Miqat (the place for assuming Ihram) for the people of Medina, and Qaran-al-Manazil for the people of Najd, and Yalamlam for the people of Yemen. These Mawaqit are for those people and also for those who come through these Mawaqit (from places other than the above-mentioned) with the intention of (performing) Hajj and Umra. And those living inside these Mawaqit can assume Ihram from the place where they start; even the people of Mecca can assume Ihram from Mecca
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ، وَعَلَى رَأْسِهِ الْمِغْفَرُ، فَلَمَّا نَزَعَهُ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ إِنَّ ابْنَ خَطَلٍ مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِأَسْتَارِ الْكَعْبَةِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اقْتُلُوهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'aama alfathi, wa'alaa raasihi almighfaru, falammaa naza'ahu jaa'a rajulun, faqaala iinna abna khatalin muta'alliqun biaastaari alka'baai‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ aqtuluwhu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) entered Mecca in the year of its Conquest wearing an Arabian helmet on his head and when the Prophet (ﷺ) took it off, a person came and said, "Ibn Khatal is holding the covering of the Ka`ba (taking refuge in the Ka`ba)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Kill him
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَعْلَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ عَلَيْهِ جُبَّةٌ فِيهِ أَثَرُ صُفْرَةٍ أَوْ نَحْوُهُ، وَكَانَ عُمَرُ يَقُولُ لِي تُحِبُّ إِذَا نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْىُ أَنْ تَرَاهُ فَنَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اصْنَعْ فِي عُمْرَتِكَ مَا تَصْنَعُ فِي حَجِّكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa 'ataa'un, qaala haddathaniy safwaanu bnu ya'laa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kuntu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaataahu rajulun 'alayhi jubbaaun fiyhi aatharu sufraain aaw nahwuhu, wakaana 'umaru yaquwlu liy tuhibbu iidhaa nazala 'alayhi alwahau aan taraahu fanazala 'alayhi thumma surriya 'anhu faqaala ‏ "‏ asna' fiy 'umratika maa tasna'u fiy hajjika ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ya'li:While I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) there came to him a man wearing a cloak having a trace of yellowish perfume or a similar thing on it. `Umar used to say to me, "Would you like to see the Prophet (ﷺ) at the time when he is inspired divinely?" So, it happened that he was inspired (then) and when the inspiration was over the Prophet (ﷺ) said (to that man), "Do in your `Umra the same as you do in your Hajj
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: وَعَضَّ رَجُلٌ يَدَ رَجُلٍ ـ يَعْنِي فَانْتَزَعَ ثَنِيَّتَهُ ـ فَأَبْطَلَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: wa'adda rajulun yada rajulin ya'niy faantaza'a thaniyyatahu faaabtalahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: A man bit the hand of another man but in that process the latter broke one incisor tooth of the former, and the Prophet (ﷺ) forgave the latter
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بَيْنَا رَجُلٌ وَاقِفٌ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَرَفَةَ إِذْ وَقَعَ عَنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ، فَوَقَصَتْهُ ـ أَوْ قَالَ فَأَقْعَصَتْهُ ـ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْنِ ـ أَوْ قَالَ ثَوْبَيْهِ ـ وَلاَ تُحَنِّطُوهُ، وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُلَبِّي ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala baynaa rajulun waaqifun ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'arafaaa iidh waqa'a 'an raahilatihi, fawaqasathu aaw qaala faaaq'asathu faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin, wakaffinuwhu fiy thawbayni aaw qaala thawbayhi walaa tuhannituwhu, walaa tukhammiruwa raasahu, faiinna alllaha yab'athuhu yawma alqiyaamaai yulabbiy ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While a man was standing with the Prophet (ﷺ) at `Arafat, he fell from his Mount and his neck was crushed by it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wash the deceased with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth, and neither perfume him nor cover his head, for Allah will resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection and he will be reciting Talbiya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ بَيْنَا رَجُلٌ وَاقِفٌ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَرَفَةَ إِذْ وَقَعَ عَنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ فَوَقَصَتْهُ ـ أَوْ قَالَ فَأَوْقَصَتْهُ ـ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْنِ، وَلاَ تَمَسُّوهُ طِيبًا، وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ، وَلاَ تُحَنِّطُوهُ، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّيًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala baynaa rajulun waaqifun ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'arafaaa iidh waqa'a 'an raahilatihi fawaqasathu aaw qaala faaawqasathu faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin, wakaffinuwhu fiy thawbayni, walaa tamassuwhu tiybana, walaa tukhammiruwa raasahu, walaa tuhannituwhu, faiinna alllaha yab'athuhu yawma alqiyaamaai mulabbiyana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:While a man was standing with the Prophet (ﷺ) at `Arafat, he fell from his Mount and his neck was crushed by it. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Wash the deceased with water and Sidr and shroud him in two pieces of cloth, and neither perfume him nor cover his head, for Allah will resurrect him on the Day of Resurrection and he will be reciting Talbiya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، كَانَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَقَصَتْهُ نَاقَتُهُ، وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ، فَمَاتَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ، وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْهِ، وَلاَ تَمَسُّوهُ بِطِيبٍ، وَلاَ تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ، فَإِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّيًا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa aabuw bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna rajulaan, kaana ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fawaqasathu naaqatuhu, wahuwa muhrimun, famaata, faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aghsiluwhu bimaa'in wasidrin, wakaffinuwhu fiy thawbayhi, walaa tamassuwhu bitiybin, walaa tukhammiruwa raasahu, faiinnahu yub'athu yawma alqiyaamaai mulabbiyana ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A man was in the company of the Prophet (ﷺ) and his she-camel crushed his neck while he was in a state of Ihram and he died Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Wash him with water and Sidr and shroud him in his two garments; neither perfume him nor cover his head, for he will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection, reciting Talbiya
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ جَاءَتْ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ أُمِّي نَذَرَتْ أَنْ تَحُجَّ، فَلَمْ تَحُجَّ حَتَّى مَاتَتْ أَفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ‏.‏ حُجِّي عَنْهَا، أَرَأَيْتِ لَوْ كَانَ عَلَى أُمِّكِ دَيْنٌ أَكُنْتِ قَاضِيَةً اقْضُوا اللَّهَ، فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ بِالْوَفَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma aanna amraaaaan, min juhaynaaa jaa'at iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat iinna aummiy nadharat aan tahujja, falam tahujja hattaa maatat aafaaahujju 'anhaa qaala ‏ "‏ na'am‏.‏ hujjiy 'anhaa, aaraaayti law kaana 'alaa aummiki daynun aakunti qaadiyaaan aqduwa alllaha, faalllahu aahaqqu bialwafaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A woman from the tribe of Juhaina came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "My mother had vowed to perform Hajj but she died before performing it. May I perform Hajj on my mother's behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied, "Perform Hajj on her behalf. Had there been a debt on your mother, would you have paid it or not? So, pay Allah's debt as He has more right to be paid
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهم ـ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، ح‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'ani alfadli bni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhm aanna amraaaaan, h‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:A woman from the tribe of Khath'am came in the year (of ,Hajjat-al-Wada` of the Prophet (ﷺ) ) and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! My father has come under Allah's obligation of performing Hajj but he is a very old man and cannot sit properly on his Mount. Will the obligation be fulfilled if I perform Hajj on his behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ خَثْعَمَ، عَامَ حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ، قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ فِي الْحَجِّ أَدْرَكَتْ أَبِي شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا، لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ عَلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ فَهَلْ يَقْضِي عَنْهُ أَنْ أَحُجَّ عَنْهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala jaa'ati amraaaaun min khath'ama, 'aama hajjaai alwadaa'i, qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna fariydaaa alllahi 'alaa 'ibaadihi fiy alhajji aadrakat aabiy shaykhana kabiyrana, laa yastatiy'u aan yastawiya 'alaa alrraahilaai fahal yaqdiy 'anhu aan aahujja 'anhu qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:Al-Fadl was riding behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and a woman from the tribe of Khath'am came up. Al-Fadl started looking at her and she looked at him. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned Al-Fadl's face to the other side. She said, "My father has come under Allah's obligation of performing Hajj but he is a very old man and cannot sit properly on his Mount. Shall I perform Hajj on his behalf? The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative. That happened during Hajjat-al-Wada` of the Prophet (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ كَانَ الْفَضْلُ رَدِيفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ خَثْعَمٍ، فَجَعَلَ الْفَضْلُ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهَا، وَتَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْرِفُ وَجْهَ الْفَضْلِ إِلَى الشِّقِّ الآخَرِ، فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ أَدْرَكَتْ أَبِي شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا، لاَ يَثْبُتُ عَلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ، أَفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَذَلِكَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, 'an maalikin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala kaana alfadlu radiyfa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajaa'ati amraaaaun min khath'amin, faja'ala alfadlu yanzuru iilayhaa, watanzuru iilayhi faja'ala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yasrifu wajha alfadli iilaa alshhiqqi alakhari, faqaalat iinna fariydaaa alllahi aadrakat aabiy shaykhana kabiyrana, laa yathbutu 'alaa alrraahilaai, aafaaahujju 'anhu qaala ‏ "‏ na'am ‏"‏‏.‏ wadhalika fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Abbas (ra):Al Fadl was riding behind the Prophet (ﷺ) and a woman from the tribe of Khath'am came up. Al Fadl started looking at her and she looked at him. The Prophet (ﷺ) turned Al-Fadl's face to the other side. She said, "My father has come under Allah's obligation of performing Hajj but he is very old man and cannot sit properly on his Rahila (mount). Shall I perform Hajj on his behalf?" The Prophet (ﷺ) replied in the affirmative. That happened during Hajjat-ul-Wada' of the Prophet (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ يَقُولُ بَعَثَنِي ـ أَوْ قَدَّمَنِي ـ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الثَّقَلِ مِنْ جَمْعٍ بِلَيْلٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy yaziyda, qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma yaquwlu ba'athaniy aaw qaddamaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy althhaqali min jam'in bilaylin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) sent me (to Mina) with the luggage from Jam' (i.e. Al-Muzdalifa) at night
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَقْبَلْتُ وَقَدْ نَاهَزْتُ الْحُلُمَ، أَسِيرُ عَلَى أَتَانٍ لِي، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي بِمِنًى، حَتَّى سِرْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ بَعْضِ الصَّفِّ الأَوَّلِ، ثُمَّ نَزَلْتُ عَنْهَا فَرَتَعَتْ، فَصَفَفْتُ مَعَ النَّاسِ وَرَاءَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ يُونُسُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ بِمِنًى فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu, aakhbaranaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa abnu aakhiy abni shihaabin, 'an 'ammihi, aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala aaqbaltu waqad naahaztu alhuluma, aasiyru 'alaa aataanin liy, warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaaiimun yusalliy biminana, hattaa sirtu bayna yadaa ba'di alssaffi alaawwali, thumma nazaltu 'anhaa farata'at, fasafaftu ma'a alnnaasi waraa'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ waqaala yuwnusu 'ani abni shihaabin biminana fiy hajjaai alwadaa'i‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Abbas:I came riding on my she-ass and had (just) then attained the age of puberty. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was praying at Mina. I passed in front of a part of the first row and then dismounted from it, and the animal started grazing. I aligned with the people behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (The sub-narrator added that happened in Mina during the Prophet's Hajjat-al-Wada)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ، عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ حُجَّ بِي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا ابْنُ سَبْعِ سِنِينَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa haatimu bnu iismaa'iyla, 'an muhammadi bni yuwsufa, 'ani alssaaiibi bni yaziyda, qaala hujja biy ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa abnu sab'i siniyna‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated As-Sa'ib bin Yazid:(While in the company of my parents) I was made to perform Hajj with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I was a seven-year-old boy then. (Fath-ul-Bari, p.443, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الْجُعَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، يَقُولُ لِلسَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، وَكَانَ قَدْ حُجَّ بِهِ فِي ثَقَلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu zuraaraaa, aakhbaranaa alqaasimu bnu maalikin, 'ani alju'aydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala sami'tu 'umara bna 'abdi al'aziyzi, yaquwlu lilssaaiibi bni yaziyda, wakaana qad hujja bihi fiy thaqali alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Al-Ju'aid bin `Abdur-Rahman:I heard `Umar bin `Abdul `Aziz telling about As-Sa'ib bin Yazid that he had performed Hajj (while carried) with the belongings of the Prophet
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: وَقَالَ لِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَذِنَ عُمَرُ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ لأَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي آخِرِ حَجَّةٍ حَجَّهَا، فَبَعَثَ مَعَهُنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ‏.‏
verses.translit: waqaala liy aahmadu bnu muhammadin haddathanaa iibraahiymu, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaddihi, aadhina 'umaru rda allh 'nh laazwaaji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy akhiri hajjaain hajjahaa, faba'atha ma'ahunna 'uthmaana bna 'affaana wa'abda alrrahmani bna 'awfin‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibrahim's grand-father that 'Umar(ra) in his last Hajj allowed the wives of the Prophet(ﷺ)to perform Hajj and he sent with them 'Uthman bin 'Affan(ra) and 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf(ra) as escorts
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنَا عَائِشَةُ بِنْتُ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلاَ نَغْزُوا وَنُجَاهِدُ مَعَكُمْ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَكُنَّ أَحْسَنُ الْجِهَادِ وَأَجْمَلُهُ الْحَجُّ، حَجٌّ مَبْرُورٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَلاَ أَدَعُ الْحَجَّ بَعْدَ إِذْ سَمِعْتُ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa musaddadun, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, haddathanaa habiybu bnu aabiy 'amraaa, qaala haddathatnaa 'aaiishaau bintu talhaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa aummi almuuminiyna rda allh 'nha qaalat qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aalaa naghzuwa wanujaahidu ma'akum faqaala ‏ "‏ lakunna aahsanu aljihaadi waaajmaluhu alhajju, hajjun mabruwrun ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaalat 'aaiishaau falaa aada'u alhajja ba'da iidh sami'tu hadhaa min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Aisha (mother of the faithful believers):I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Shouldn't we participate in Holy battles and Jihad along with you?" He replied, "The best and the most superior Jihad (for women) is Hajj which is accepted by Allah." `Aisha added: Ever since I heard that from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I have determined not to miss Hajj
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْبَدٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُسَافِرِ الْمَرْأَةُ إِلاَّ مَعَ ذِي مَحْرَمٍ، وَلاَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا رَجُلٌ إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا مَحْرَمٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ فِي جَيْشِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، وَامْرَأَتِي تُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اخْرُجْ مَعَهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'amrinw, 'an aabiy ma'badin, mawlaa abni 'abbaasin 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tusaafiri almaraaau iilaaa ma'a dhiy mahramin, walaa yadkhulu 'alayhaa rajulun iilaaa wama'ahaa mahramun ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy auriydu aan aakhruja fiy jayshi kadhaa wakadhaa, waamraaatiy turiydu alhajja‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ akhruj ma'ahaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A woman should not travel except with a Dhu-Mahram (her husband or a man with whom that woman cannot marry at all according to the Islamic Jurisprudence), and no man may visit her except in the presence of a Dhu-Mahram." A man got up and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I intend to go to such and such an army and my wife wants to perform Hajj." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to him), "Go along with her (to Hajj)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَبِيبٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ لَمَّا رَجَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ حَجَّتِهِ قَالَ لأُمِّ سِنَانٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّةِ ‏"‏ مَا مَنَعَكِ مِنَ الْحَجِّ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ أَبُو فُلاَنٍ ـ تَعْنِي زَوْجَهَا ـ كَانَ لَهُ نَاضِحَانِ، حَجَّ عَلَى أَحَدِهِمَا، وَالآخَرُ يَسْقِي أَرْضًا لَنَا‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ عُمْرَةً فِي رَمَضَانَ تَقْضِي حَجَّةً مَعِي ‏"‏‏.‏ رَوَاهُ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdaanu, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, aakhbaranaa habiybun almu'allimu, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin rda allh 'nhma qaala lammaa raja'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm min hajjatihi qaala laummi sinaanin alaansaariyyaai ‏"‏ maa mana'aki mina alhajji ‏"‏‏.‏ qaalat aabuw fulaanin ta'niy zawjahaa kaana lahu naadihaani, hajja 'alaa aahadihimaa, waalakharu yasqiy aardana lanaa‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinna 'umraaan fiy ramadaana taqdiy hajjaaan ma'iy ‏"‏‏.‏ rawaahu abnu jurayjin 'an 'ataa'in sami'tu abna 'abbaasin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Ibn `Abbas:When the Prophet (ﷺ) returned after performing his Hajj, he asked Um Sinan Al-Ansari, "What did forbid you to perform Hajj?" She replied, "Father of so-and-so (i.e. her husband) had two camels and he performed Hajj on one of them, and the second is used for the irrigation of our land." The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to her), "Perform `Umra in the month of Ramadan, (as it is equivalent to Hajj or Hajj with me (in reward)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ قَزَعَةَ، مَوْلَى زِيَادٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ ـ وَقَدْ غَزَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ ـ غَزْوَةً ـ قَالَ أَرْبَعٌ سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ قَالَ يُحَدِّثُهُنَّ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فَأَعْجَبْنَنِي وَآنَقْنَنِي ‏ "‏ أَنْ لاَ تُسَافِرَ امْرَأَةٌ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمَيْنِ لَيْسَ مَعَهَا زَوْجُهَا أَوْ ذُو مَحْرَمٍ، وَلاَ صَوْمَ يَوْمَيْنِ الْفِطْرِ وَالأَضْحَى، وَلاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ صَلاَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ، وَبَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ، وَلاَ تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ مَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ، وَمَسْجِدِي، وَمَسْجِدِ الأَقْصَى ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, hadaathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an qaza'aaa, mawlaa ziyaadin qaala sami'tu aabaa sa'iydin waqad ghazaa ma'a alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm thintaa 'ashraaa ghazwaaan qaala aarba'un sami'tuhunaa min rasuwli allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaw qaala yuhadiithuhunaa 'ani alnaabiyii sla allh 'lyh wslm faaa'jabnaniy waanaqnaniy ‏ "‏ aan laa tusaafira amraaaaun masiyraaa yawmayni laysa ma'ahaa zawjuhaa aaw dhuw mahramin, walaa sawma yawmayni alfitri waalaadhaa, walaa salaaaa ba'da salaatayni ba'da al'asri hataaa taghruba alshaamsu, waba'da alsuubhi hataaa tatlu'a alshaamsu, walaa tushaduu alriihaalu iilaaa iilaa thalaathaai masaajida masjidi alharaami, wamasjidiy, wamasjidi alaaqsaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Qaza'a the slave of Ziyad:Abu Sa`id who participated in twelve Ghazawat with the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I heard four things from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (or I narrate them from the Prophet (ﷺ) ) which won my admiration and appreciation. They are: -1. "No lady should travel without her husband or without a Dhu-Mahram for a two-days' journey. -2. No fasting is permissible on two days of `Id-ul-Fitr, and `Id-al-Adha. -3. No prayer (may be offered) after two prayers: after the `Asr prayer till the sun set and after the morning prayer till the sun rises. -4. Not to travel (for visiting) except for three mosques: Masjid-al-Haram (in Mecca), my Mosque (in Medina), and Masjid-al-Aqsa (in Jerusalem)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ سَلاَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَزَارِيُّ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى شَيْخًا يُهَادَى بَيْنَ ابْنَيْهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ هَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا نَذَرَ أَنْ يَمْشِيَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَنْ تَعْذِيبِ هَذَا نَفْسَهُ لَغَنِيٌّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَرْكَبَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu salaamin, aakhbaranaa alfazaariyyu, 'an humaydin alttawiyli, qaala haddathaniy thaabitun, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa shaykhana yuhaadaa bayna abnayhi qaala ‏"‏ maa baalu hadhaa ‏"‏‏.‏ qaaluwa nadhara aan yamshiya‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha 'an ta'dhiybi hadhaa nafsahu laghaniyyun ‏"‏‏.‏ waaamarahu aan yarkaba‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) saw an old man walking, supported by his two sons, and asked about him. The people informed him that he had vowed to go on foot (to the Ka`ba). He said, "Allah is not in need of this old man's torturing himself," and ordered him to ride
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 28 — Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَهُمْ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، أَنَّ يَزِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا الْخَيْرِ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ نَذَرَتْ أُخْتِي أَنْ تَمْشِيَ، إِلَى بَيْتِ اللَّهِ، وَأَمَرَتْنِي أَنْ أَسْتَفْتِيَ لَهَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَفْتَيْتُهُ، فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ‏ "‏ لِتَمْشِ وَلْتَرْكَبْ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ أَبُو الْخَيْرِ لاَ يُفَارِقُ عُقْبَةَ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْد اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ
verses.translit: hadaathanaa iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu yuwsufa, aanaa abna jurayjin, aakhbarahum qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu aabiy aayuuwba, aanaa yaziyda bna aabiy habiybin, aakhbarahu aanaa aabaa alkhayri hadaathahu 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin, qaala nadharat aukhtiy aan tamshiya, iilaa bayti allaahi, waaamaratniy aan aastaftiya lahaa alnaabiyaa sla allh 'lyh wslm faastaftaytuhu, faqaala 'alayhi alsaalaamu ‏ "‏ litamshi waltarkab ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala wakaana aabuw alkhayri laa yufaariqu 'uqbaaa‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'abd allaahi hadaathanaa aabuw 'aasimin 'an abni jurayjin 'an yahyaa bni aayuuwba 'an yaziyda 'an aabiy alkhayri 'an 'uqbaaa fadhakara alhadiytha
verses.translation: Narrated `Uqba bin 'Amir:My sister vowed to go on foot to the Ka`ba, and she asked me to take the verdict of the Prophet (ﷺ) about it. So, I did and the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "She should walk and also should ride." Narrated Abul-Khair from `Uqba as above.:
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمَدِينَةُ حَرَمٌ، مِنْ كَذَا إِلَى كَذَا، لاَ يُقْطَعُ شَجَرُهَا، وَلاَ يُحْدَثُ فِيهَا حَدَثٌ، مَنْ أَحْدَثَ حَدَثًا فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa thaabitu bnu yaziyda, haddathanaa 'aasimun aabuw 'abdi alrrahmani alaahwalu, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almadiynaau haramun, min kadhaa iilaa kadhaa, laa yuqta'u shajaruhaa, walaa yuhdathu fiyhaa hadathun, man aahdatha hadathana fa'alayhi la'naau alllahi waalmalaaiikaai waalnnaasi aajma'iyna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Medina is a sanctuary from that place to that. Its trees should not be cut and no heresy should be innovated nor any sin should be committed in it, and whoever innovates in it an heresy or commits sins (bad deeds), then he will incur the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people." (See Hadith No. 409, Vol)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ فَأَمَرَ بِبِنَاءِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا بَنِي النَّجَّارِ ثَامِنُونِي ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لاَ نَطْلُبُ ثَمَنَهُ إِلاَّ إِلَى اللَّهِ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِقُبُورِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، فَنُبِشَتْ، ثُمَّ بِالْخِرَبِ فَسُوِّيَتْ، وَبِالنَّخْلِ فَقُطِعَ، فَصَفُّوا النَّخْلَ قِبْلَةَ الْمَسْجِدِ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, 'an aanasin rda allh 'nh qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa faaamara bibinaa'i almasjidi faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa baniy alnnajjaari thaaminuwniy ‏"‏‏.‏ faqaaluwa laa natlubu thamanahu iilaaa iilaa alllahi‏.‏ faaamara biqubuwri almushrikiyna, fanubishat, thumma bialkhirabi fasuwwiyat, wabialnnakhli faquti'a, fasaffuwa alnnakhla qiblaaa almasjidi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to Medina and ordered a mosque to be built and said, "O Bani Najjar! Suggest to me the price (of your land)." They said, "We do not want its price except from Allah" (i.e. they wished for a reward from Allah for giving up their land freely). So, the Prophet (ﷺ) ordered the graves of the pagans to be dug out and the land to be leveled, and the date-palm trees to be cut down. The cut datepalms were fixed in the direction of the Qibla of the mosque
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ حُرِّمَ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَىِ الْمَدِينَةِ عَلَى لِسَانِي ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَتَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَنِي حَارِثَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَرَاكُمْ يَا بَنِي حَارِثَةَ قَدْ خَرَجْتُمْ مِنَ الْحَرَمِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ فِيهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy aakhiy, 'an sulaymaana, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ hurrima maa bayna laabataai almadiynaai 'alaa lisaaniy ‏"‏‏.‏ qaala waaataa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm baniy haarithaaa faqaala ‏"‏ aaraakum yaa baniy haarithaaa qad kharajtum mina alharami ‏"‏‏.‏ thumma altafata, faqaala ‏"‏ bal aantum fiyhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I have made Medina a sanctuary between its two (Harrat) mountains." The Prophet (ﷺ) went to the tribe of Bani Haritha and said (to them), "I see that you have gone out of the sanctuary," but looking around, he added, "No, you are inside the sanctuary
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ مَا عِنْدَنَا شَىْءٌ إِلاَّ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ، وَهَذِهِ الصَّحِيفَةُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْمَدِينَةُ حَرَمٌ، مَا بَيْنَ عَائِرٍ إِلَى كَذَا، مَنْ أَحْدَثَ فِيهَا حَدَثًا، أَوْ آوَى مُحْدِثًا، فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ، لاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ صَرْفٌ وَلاَ عَدْلٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ ذِمَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَاحِدَةٌ، فَمَنْ أَخْفَرَ مُسْلِمًا فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ، لاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ صَرْفٌ وَلاَ عَدْلٌ، وَمَنْ تَوَلَّى قَوْمًا بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ مَوَالِيهِ، فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ، لاَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ صَرْفٌ وَلاَ عَدْلٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aliyyin rda allh 'nh qaala maa 'indanaa shaa'un iilaaa kitaabu alllahi, wahadhihi alssahiyfaau 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ almadiynaau haramun, maa bayna 'aaiirin iilaa kadhaa, man aahdatha fiyhaa hadathana, aaw awaa muhdithana, fa'alayhi la'naau alllahi waalmalaaiikaai waalnnaasi aajma'iyna, laa yuqbalu minhu sarfun walaa 'adlun ‏"‏‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ dhimmaau almuslimiyna waahidaaun, faman aakhfara muslimana fa'alayhi la'naau alllahi waalmalaaiikaai waalnnaasi aajma'iyna, laa yuqbalu minhu sarfun walaa 'adlun, waman tawallaa qawmana bighayri iidhni mawaaliyhi, fa'alayhi la'naau alllahi waalmalaaiikaai waalnnaasi aajma'iyna, laa yuqbalu minhu sarfun walaa 'adlun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated `Ali:We have nothing except the Book of Allah and this written paper from the Prophet (wherein is written:) Medina is a sanctuary from the 'Air Mountain to such and such a place, and whoever innovates in it an heresy or commits a sin, or gives shelter to such an innovator in it will incur the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, none of his compulsory or optional good deeds of worship will be accepted. And the asylum (of protection) granted by any Muslim is to be secured (respected) by all the other Muslims; and whoever betrays a Muslim in this respect incurs the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, and none of his compulsory or optional good deeds of worship will be accepted, and whoever (freed slave) befriends (take as masters) other than his manumitters without their permission incurs the curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, and none of his compulsory or optional good deeds of worship will be accepted
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْحُبَابِ، سَعِيدَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ ‏ "‏ أُمِرْتُ بِقَرْيَةٍ تَأْكُلُ الْقُرَى يَقُولُونَ يَثْرِبُ‏.‏ وَهْىَ الْمَدِينَةُ، تَنْفِي النَّاسَ كَمَا يَنْفِي الْكِيرُ خَبَثَ الْحَدِيدِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, qaala sami'tu aabaa alhubaabi, sa'iyda bna yasaarin yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ ‏ "‏ aumirtu biqaryaain taakulu alquraa yaquwluwna yathribu‏.‏ wahaa almadiynaau, tanfiy alnnaasa kamaa yanfiy alkiyru khabatha alhadiydi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "I was ordered to migrate to a town which will swallow (conquer) other towns and is called Yathrib and that is Medina, and it turns out (bad) persons as a furnace removes the impurities of iron
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ تَبُوكَ حَتَّى أَشْرَفْنَا عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هَذِهِ طَابَةُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, qaala haddathaniy 'amruw bnu yahyaa, 'an 'abbaasi bni sahli bni sa'din, 'an aabiy humaydin rda allh 'nh aaqbalnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm min tabuwka hattaa aashrafnaa 'alaa almadiynaai faqaala ‏ "‏ hadhihi taabaau ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Humaid:We came with the Prophet (ﷺ) from Tabuk, and when we reached near Medina, the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "This is Tabah
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ لَوْ رَأَيْتُ الظِّبَاءَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ تَرْتَعُ مَا ذَعَرْتُهَا، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا حَرَامٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aannahu kaana yaquwlu law raaaytu alzzibaa'a bialmadiynaai tarta'u maa dha'artuhaa, qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa bayna laabatayhaa haraamun ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:If I saw deers grazing in Medina, I would not chase them, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "(Medina) is a sanctuary between its two mountains
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَتْرُكُونَ الْمَدِينَةَ عَلَى خَيْرِ مَا كَانَتْ، لاَ يَغْشَاهَا إِلاَّ الْعَوَافِ ـ يُرِيدُ عَوَافِيَ السِّبَاعِ وَالطَّيْرِ ـ وَآخِرُ مَنْ يُحْشَرُ رَاعِيَانِ مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ، يُرِيدَانِ الْمَدِينَةَ يَنْعِقَانِ بِغَنَمِهِمَا، فَيَجِدَانِهَا وَحْشًا، حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَا ثَنِيَّةَ الْوَدَاعِ خَرَّا عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yatrukuwna almadiynaaa 'alaa khayri maa kaanat, laa yaghshaahaa iilaaa al'awaafi yuriydu 'awaafiya alssibaa'i waalttayri waakhiru man yuhsharu raa'iyaani min muzaynaaa, yuriydaani almadiynaaa yan'iqaani bighanamihimaa, fayajidaanihaa wahshana, hattaa iidhaa balaghaa thaniyyaaa alwadaa'i kharraa 'alaa wujuwhihimaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "The people will leave Medina in spite of the best state it will have, and none except the wild birds and the beasts of prey will live in it, and the last persons who will die will be two shepherds from the tribe of Muzaina, who will be driving their sheep towards Medina, but will find nobody in it, and when they reach the valley of Thaniyat-al-Wada`, they will fall down on their faces dead
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ أَبِي زُهَيْرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ تُفْتَحُ الْيَمَنُ فَيَأْتِي قَوْمٌ يُبِسُّونَ، فَيَتَحَمَّلُونَ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ وَمَنْ أَطَاعَهُمْ، وَالْمَدِينَةُ خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ، وَتُفْتَحُ الشَّأْمُ، فَيَأْتِي قَوْمٌ يُبِسُّونَ فَيَتَحَمَّلُونَ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ وَمَنْ أَطَاعَهُمْ، وَالْمَدِينَةُ خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ، وَتُفْتَحُ الْعِرَاقُ، فَيَأْتِي قَوْمٌ يُبِسُّونَ فَيَتَحَمَّلُونَ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ وَمَنْ أَطَاعَهُمْ‏.‏ وَالْمَدِينَةُ خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yuwsufa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, 'an sufyaana bni aabiy zuhayrin rda allh 'nh aannahu qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ tuftahu alyamanu fayaatiy qawmun yubissuwna, fayatahammaluwna biaahliyhim waman aataa'ahum, waalmadiynaau khayrun lahum law kaanuwa ya'lamuwna, watuftahu alshhaamu, fayaatiy qawmun yubissuwna fayatahammaluwna biaahliyhim waman aataa'ahum, waalmadiynaau khayrun lahum law kaanuwa ya'lamuwna, watuftahu al'iraaqu, fayaatiy qawmun yubissuwna fayatahammaluwna biaahliyhim waman aataa'ahum‏.‏ waalmadiynaau khayrun lahum law kaanuwa ya'lamuwna ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sufyan b. Abu Zuhair:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, "Yemen will be conquered and some people will migrate (from Medina) and will urge their families, and those who will obey them to migrate (to Yemen) although Medina will be better for them; if they but knew. Sham will also be conquered and some people will migrate (from Medina) and will urge their families and those who will obey them, to migrate (to Sham) although Medina will be better for them; if they but knew. 'Iraq will be conquered and some people will migrate (from Medina) and will urge their families and those who will obey them to migrate (to 'Iraq) although Medina will be better for them; if they but knew
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الإِيمَانَ لَيَأْرِزُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ كَمَا تَأْرِزُ الْحَيَّةُ إِلَى جُحْرِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, qaala haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an khubaybi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna aliiymaana layaarizu iilaa almadiynaai kamaa taarizu alhayyaau iilaa juhrihaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "Verily, Belief returns and goes back to Medina as a snake returns and goes back to its hole (when in danger)
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ حُرَيْثٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْفَضْلُ، عَنْ جُعَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدًا ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَكِيدُ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ انْمَاعَ كَمَا يَنْمَاعُ الْمِلْحُ فِي الْمَاءِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa husaynu bnu huraythin, aakhbaranaa alfadlu, 'an ju'aydin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat sami'tu sa'dana rda allh 'nh qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yakiydu aahla almadiynaai aahadun iilaaa anmaa'a kamaa yanmaa'u almilhu fiy almaa'i ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Sa`d:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) saying, "None plots against the people of Medina but that he will be dissolved (destroyed) like the salt is dissolved in water
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، سَمِعْتُ أُسَامَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ أَشْرَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى أُطُمٍ مِنْ آطَامِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلْ تَرَوْنَ مَا أَرَى إِنِّي لأَرَى مَوَاقِعَ الْفِتَنِ خِلاَلَ بُيُوتِكُمْ كَمَوَاقِعِ الْقَطْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَابَعَهُ مَعْمَرٌ وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyun, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'urwaau, sami'tu ausaamaaa rda allh 'nh qaala aashrafa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa autumin min ataami almadiynaai faqaala ‏ "‏ hal tarawna maa aaraa iinniy laaraa mawaaqi'a alfitani khilaala buyuwtikum kamawaaqi'i alqatri ‏"‏‏.‏ taaba'ahu ma'marun wasulaymaanu bnu kathiyrin 'ani alzzuhriyyi‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Usama:Once the Prophet (ﷺ) stood at the top of a (looked out from upon one) castle amongst the castles (or the high buildings) of Medina and said, "Do you see what I see? (No doubt) I see the spots where afflictions will take place among your houses (and these afflictions will be) as numerous as the spots where raindrops fall
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْمَدِينَةَ رُعْبُ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، لَهَا يَوْمَئِذٍ سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ، عَلَى كُلِّ باب مَلَكَانِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, qaala haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaddihi, 'an aabiy bakraaa rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yadkhulu almadiynaaa ru'bu almasiyhi alddajjaali, lahaa yawmaiidhin sab'aau aabwaabin, 'alaa kulli bab malakaani ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The terror caused by Al-Masih Ad-Dajjal will not enter Medina and at that time Medina will have seven gates and there will be two angels at each gate guarding them
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُجْمِرِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ ‏ "‏ عَلَى أَنْقَابِ الْمَدِينَةِ مَلاَئِكَةٌ، لاَ يَدْخُلُهَا الطَّاعُونُ وَلاَ الدَّجَّالُ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, qaala haddathaniy maalikun, 'an nu'aymi bni 'abdi alllahi almujmiri, 'an aabiy hurayraaa rda allh 'nh qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm‏.‏ ‏ "‏ 'alaa aanqaabi almadiynaai malaaiikaaun, laa yadkhuluhaa alttaa'uwnu walaa alddajjaalu ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Huraira:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "There are angels guarding the entrances (or roads) of Medina, neither plague nor Ad-Dajjal will be able to enter it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَمْرٍو، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلاَّ سَيَطَؤُهُ الدَّجَّالُ، إِلاَّ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةَ، لَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ نِقَابِهَا نَقْبٌ إِلاَّ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ صَافِّينَ، يَحْرُسُونَهَا، ثُمَّ تَرْجُفُ الْمَدِينَةُ بِأَهْلِهَا ثَلاَثَ رَجَفَاتٍ، فَيُخْرِجُ اللَّهُ كُلَّ كَافِرٍ وَمُنَافِقٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu almundhiri, haddathanaa alwaliydu, haddathanaa aabuw 'amrinw, haddathanaa iishaaqu, haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin rda allh 'nh 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laysa min baladin iilaaa sayatauuhu alddajjaalu, iilaaa makkaaa waalmadiynaaa, laysa lahu min niqaabihaa naqbun iilaaa 'alayhi almalaaiikaau saaffiyna, yahrusuwnahaa, thumma tarjufu almadiynaau biaahlihaa thalaatha rajafaatin, fayukhriju alllahu kulla kaafirin wamunaafiqin ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Anas bin Malik:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There will be no town which Ad-Dajjal will not enter except Mecca and Medina, and there will be no entrance (road) (of both Mecca and Medina) but the angels will be standing in rows guarding it against him, and then Medina will shake with its inhabitants thrice (i.e. three earthquakes will take place) and Allah will expel all the non-believers and the hypocrites from it
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدِيثًا طَوِيلاً عَنِ الدَّجَّالِ، فَكَانَ فِيمَا حَدَّثَنَا بِهِ أَنْ قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَأْتِي الدَّجَّالُ ـ وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ نِقَابَ الْمَدِينَةِ ـ بَعْضَ السِّبَاخِ الَّتِي بِالْمَدِينَةِ، فَيَخْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ رَجُلٌ، هُوَ خَيْرُ النَّاسِ ـ أَوْ مِنْ خَيْرِ النَّاسِ ـ فَيَقُولُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ الدَّجَّالُ، الَّذِي حَدَّثَنَا عَنْكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدِيثَهُ، فَيَقُولُ الدَّجَّالُ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ قَتَلْتُ هَذَا ثُمَّ أَحْيَيْتُهُ، هَلْ تَشُكُّونَ فِي الأَمْرِ فَيَقُولُونَ لاَ‏.‏ فَيَقْتُلُهُ، ثُمَّ يُحْيِيهِ فَيَقُولُ حِينَ يُحْيِيهِ وَاللَّهِ مَا كُنْتُ قَطُّ أَشَدَّ بَصِيرَةً مِنِّي الْيَوْمَ، فَيَقُولُ الدَّجَّالُ أَقْتُلُهُ فَلاَ أُسَلَّطُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu bukayrin, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, aanna aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya rda allh 'nh qaala haddathanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hadiythana tawiylaan 'ani alddajjaali, fakaana fiymaa haddathanaa bihi aan qaala ‏ "‏ yaatiy alddajjaalu wahuwa muharramun 'alayhi aan yadkhula niqaaba almadiynaai ba'da alssibaakhi allatiy bialmadiynaai, fayakhruju iilayhi yawmaiidhin rajulun, huwa khayru alnnaasi aaw min khayri alnnaasi fayaquwlu aashhadu aannaka alddajjaalu, alladhiy haddathanaa 'anka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hadiythahu, fayaquwlu alddajjaalu aaraaayta iin qataltu hadhaa thumma aahyaytuhu, hal tashukkuwna fiy alaamri fayaquwluwna laa‏.‏ fayaqtuluhu, thumma yuhyiyhi fayaquwlu hiyna yuhyiyhi waalllahi maa kuntu qattu aashadda basiyraaan minniy alyawma, fayaquwlu alddajjaalu aaqtuluhu falaa ausallatu 'alayhi ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told us a long narrative about Ad-Dajjal, and among the many things he mentioned, was his saying, "Ad-Dajjal will come and it will be forbidden for him to pass through the entrances of Medina. He will land in some of the salty barren areas (outside) Medina; on that day the best man or one of the best men will come up to him and say, 'I testify that you are the same Dajjal whose description was given to us by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) .' Ad-Dajjal will say to the people, 'If I kill this man and bring him back to life again, will you doubt my claim?' They will say, 'No.' Then Ad-Dajjal will kill that man and bring him back to life. That man will say, 'Now I know your reality better than before.' Ad-Dajjal will say, 'I want to kill him but I cannot
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَايَعَهُ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ، فَجَاءَ مِنَ الْغَدِ مَحْمُومًا، فَقَالَ أَقِلْنِي، فَأَبَى ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ، فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمَدِينَةُ كَالْكِيرِ، تَنْفِي خَبَثَهَا، وَيَنْصَعُ طَيِّبُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'abbaasin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabirin rda allh 'nh jaa'a aa'raabiyyun alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fabaaya'ahu 'alaa aliislaami, fajaa'a mina alghadi mahmuwmana, faqaala aaqilniy, faaabaa thalaatha miraarin, faqaala ‏ "‏ almadiynaau kaalkiyri, tanfiy khabathahaa, wayansa'u tayyibuhaa ‏"‏‏.‏
verses.translation: Narrated Jabir:A bedouin came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and gave a pledge of allegiance for embracing Islam. The next day he came with fever and said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "Please cancel my pledge (of embracing Islam and of emigrating to Medina)." The Prophet (ﷺ) refused (that request) three times and said, "Medina is like a furnace, it expels out the impurities (bad persons) and selects the good ones and makes them perfect
verses.translator: Muhammad Muhsin Khan (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
